[p.1] yo vidhvastasamastabandhanagatis samyag viśitve sthitaḥ
 sarvajñeyavisārinirmalatamajñānaprabandhodayaḥ |
 sattvārthodyatamānasaś ca suciraṃ śrīmañjunātho vibhuḥ
 tan natvā bahuśo'dya vārttikagataṃ kiñcid vivakṣāmy ahaṃ ||
 ṭīkākṛtaḥ sakala eva guṇaḥ sa eṣa brūte'tra vastugahane'pi yad asmadādiḥ |
 dignāgadantamusa(?śa)lair viṣame 'panīte labdheṣu vartmasu sukhaṃ kalabhāḥ prayānti ||
 yo mām avajñāyati ko'pi guṇābhimānī jānāty asau kimapi taṃ prati naiṣa yatnaḥ |
 kaścid bhaviṣyati kadācid anena cārthī nānādhiyāñ jagati janmavatāṃ hi nāntaḥ ||
 yady api hi śāstrārambhe namaskāraślokopanyāsam antareṇa kāyavāṅmanobhir iṣṭadevatānamaskārakaraṇena puṇyopacayād avighnena śāstrasya parisamātir bhavati | tathāpi vyākhyātṛśrotṝṇāṃ stutipurassarayā pravṛttyā puṇyātiśayotpādāt pārārthyaṃ sadācārānupālanaṃ cālocya viśiṣṭadevatāpūjāślokam upanyastavān ācāryaḥ |
vidhūtakalpanetyādi |
 yadā samantabhadraśabdo rūḍhyā bodhisattvavṛtto na gṛhyate tadeyaṃ buddhasya bhagavataḥ pūjā | sā ca dvidhā stotrataḥ praṇāmataś ca | namaḥśabdena praṇāmataḥ pariśiṣṭaiḥ stotrataḥ | stotram api svārthasampattitaḥ parārthasampattitaḥ parārthasaṃpadupāyataś ca tridhā | svārthasampannaś ca parārthaṃ prati samartho bhavatīvi [p.2] prathamaṃ pūrvārdhena svārthasampad uktā | svārthasampac ca kāyatrayalakṣaṇā tribhir viśeṣair viśiṣṭodbhāvitā | āvaraṇaprahāṇaviśeṣeṇa | gāmbhīryaviśeṣeṇa | audāryaviśeṣeṇa ca |
 tatrātmātmīyādyākārapravṛttā grāhyagrāhakākārapravṛttāś ca traidhātukāś cittacaittāḥ kalpanā | saiva jālam bandhanātmakatvāt | tadvidhūtaṃ vidhvastaṃ savāsanaṃ punaranutpattidharmatvam āpāditaṃ yāsāṃ mūrttīnān tās tathoktāḥ | etenāvaraṇaprahāṇaviśeṣa uktaḥ | gāmbhīryaudāryaviśeṣau tu gambhīrodārapadābhyām uktau | vidhūtakalpanājālā gambhīrāḥ śrāvakapratyekabuddhādyaviṣayatvāt | udārās sakalajñeyasakalasatvārthavyāpanāt | mūrttayas trayaḥ kāyāḥ svābhāvikasāmbhogikanairmāṇikā yasya bhagavataḥ | asau vidhūtakalpanājālagambhīrodāramūrttiḥ | bhadraṃ kalyāṇam abhyudayaniḥśreyasalakṣaṇaṃ | tat samantān niravaśeṣan tadarthināṃ yathā bhavyam bhavati yasmāt sakāśā(d asau samantabhadraḥ | etena parārthasampad uktā | asyāś ca parārthasampadaḥ samantasphuraṇatviṣa) ity anena siddhyupāya uktaḥ | (tviṣo raśmaya <|> iha tu yathāvasthitavastugrahaṇa) evaṃ sādharmyeṇa dharmadeśanā |(sic?) abhyudayaniḥśreyasasādhanaviṣayās tviṣa iva tviṣa ucyante | samanto niravaśeṣaḥ parārthasādhanopāyaḥ spharyate vyāpyate vinayebhyaḥ sākalye[na] (kathanāt yābhis tāḥ samantaspharaṇyas tatra tatābhūtās tviṣo dharmadeśanā yasya sa samantaspharaṇatviṭ | namaḥśabdayogāc ca sarvatra caturthī |
 yadā tu rūḍhir apekṣyate tadāyaṃ samantabhadraśa)bdo mahāyāne bodhisattvaviśeṣe rūḍha iti bodhisattvasyeyaṃ pūjā (|) padārthas tu pūrvavad yojyaḥ | ayan tu viśeṣo vidhūtakalpanājālatvaṃ bodhisattvabhūmyāvaraṇaprahāṇato draṣṭavyaṃ | gāmbhīryaṃ śrāvaka[pratyekabuddhapṛthagjanāviṣayatvataḥ | audāryan tu bodhisattvam(ā)hātma(?tmya)taḥ | kāyatrayam apy anurūpaṃ bodhisattvānāṃ vidyata e]va prakarṣagamanāt tu buddhānāṃ vyavasthāpyata iti ||
 santy eva hi santo'sya vārttikākhyasya śāstrasya grahītāras tathāpi śrotṛdoṣabāhulyena santam apy upakāram asantam iva kṛtvā sūktābhyāsabhāvitacittatvam eva śāstrārambhe kāraṇan darśayan | ayaṃ ca mahārthabhraṅśe hetudoṣas tyaktuṃ yukta ity etac ca vakroktyā kathayituṃ dvitīyaṃ ślokam āha –
[p.3] prāyaḥprākṛtetyādi | atra caturvidhaḥ śrotṛdoṣa udbhāvitaḥ | kuprajñatvam ajñatvaṃ anarthitvaṃ amādhyasthyañ ca | prāyaḥśabda okārānto bāhulyavacanaḥ | prāyo jano bhūyān janaḥ | prākṛtasaktiḥ prākṛtāni bahiḥśāstrāṇi tatra saktir yasyeti (|) gamakatvād vyadhikaraṇo bahuvrīhiḥ | prākṛtā vā saktir yasyeti | samānādhikaraṇa eva | prākṛtaviṣayatvāc ca saktiḥ prākṛtā | anena kuprajñatvaṃ śrotṛdoṣa uktaḥ |
 apratibalā śāstragrahaṇam praty asa(śa)ktā prajñā yasya so'pratibalaprajñaḥ prāyo jana iti sambandhaḥ | anenājñatvam uktaṃ (|) subhāṣitair nānarthy eva kintu subhāṣītābhidhāyinam vidveṣṭy apīrṣyāmalaiḥ parigataḥ san | anarthī ca vidveṣṭi cetyarthaḥ | etena yathākramam anarthitvam amādhyasthyaṃ coktaṃ | atrāpi prāyo jana iti sambandhanīyaṃ |
 anye tu prāyaśśabdasyā(?sa)kārānto'py asti nipātaḥ (|) sa ca bāhulyenety asmiṃs tṛtīyārthe svabhāvād varttata iti vyācakṣate | (NO SB)
 īrṣyā parasampattau cetaso vyāroṣaḥ | saiva malaś cittamalinīkaraṇāt | vyaktibhedād bahuvacanaṃ | yata evaṃ tena kāraṇenāyam āripsito vārttikākhyo granthaḥ | paropakāraḥ pareṣām upakāraḥ | upakriyate'neneti karaṇe ghañ | parān vopakarotīti paropakāraḥ "karmaṇy aṇ" (Pāṇini 3.2.1) | paropakāra iti naḥ asmākaṃ cintāpi nāsti | kathan tarhi śāstraracanāyāṃ pravṛttir ity āha – cetaś ciram ityādi | ciran dīrghakālaṃ sūktābhyāsena vivarddhitaṃ vyasanaṃ saktis tatparatā sūktābhyāsavivardhitaṃ vyasanaṃ yasya cetasas tat tathoktaṃ | iti hetor atra vārttikaracanāyām anubaddhaspṛhaṃ jātābhilāṣaṃ ceta iti | evam eke vyācakṣate |
 anye tv anyathā | kasmād ayam ācāryadharmakīrtir vārttikanyāyena pramāṇasamuccayavyākhyāṃ karoti na punaḥ svatantram eva śāstram ity asmin praśnāvasare prāha – prāya ityādi | asya ślokasyāyaṃ samāsārthaḥ | cintayā karuṇayā ca me pramāṇasamuccayavyākhyāyāṃ ceto jātābhilāṣam iti | cintā karuṇā ca ācāryadignāgaracitaśāstrasyālpopakāritvena | alpopakāritvañ ca śrātṛjanāparādhena | padārthas tūcyate | prāya iti bāhulyena prākṛtasaktir jana iti sambandhaḥ | prākṛta ucyate [p.4] loke nīcaḥ | yasya duṣṭo'nvayaḥ | evaṃ tīrthikaśāstrāṇi parapraṇītāni cācāryanītiśāstradūṣaṇāni | viparyastajñānaprabhavatvād duṣṭānvayād yataḥ prākṛtāni | teṣu saktir anurāgo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | kasmāt punaḥ prākṛtasaktir ityāha – apratibalaprajña iti | ato 'sau durbhāṣitam api subhāṣitam iti gṛhītvā prākṛte sajyate | apratibalaprajñatvād eva cācāryasubhāṣitāni svayaṃ yathāvad avaboddhum akṣamo doṣavattvena gṛhītvā tair ācāryasubhāṣitair anarthī | ācārye ca vidveṣavān bhavatīty āha – kevalam ityādi | na kevalam anarthī subhāṣitair ācāryīyair api tu vidveṣṭy apīrṣyāmalaiḥ parigataḥ sann ācāryadignāgaṃ (|) kiṃ bhūtaṃ sūktābhyāsavivarddhitavyasanaṃ | vyavahitenāpi sambandho bhavaty eva |
 "yena yasyābhisambandho dūrasthasyāpi tena sa" iti nyāyāt |
 śobhanam uktaṃ sūktaṃ bhagavatpravacanan tatrābhyāsas tatra vivarddhitaṃ vyasanan tatraivātyartham āsaktatvaṃ yasyācāryadignāgasya sa tathoktaḥ | anenācāryadignāgasyopacitapuṇyajñānatvam āha – upacitapuṇyajñānā eva hi sūktābhyāsavivarddhitavyasanā bhavanti | yenāpratibalaprajña ācāryasubhāṣitair anarthī prākṛtasaktiś ca tena kāraṇenāyaṃ pramāṇasamuccayo na paropakāraḥ | upakaraṇam upakāro bhāve ghañ (P.3.3.18) | para utkṛṣṭa upakāro nāsmād bhavatīti kṛtvā na paropakāro 'lpas tūpakāro'sty eva sa ca prāyaśabdena sūcita eva | itiśabdo hetau (|) asmād dhetor asmākaṃ cintā | mahārtham apīdaṃ śāstraṃ na bahūnām upakārakaṃ jātan tat katham asyātyarthaṃ sāphalyaṃ kuryām ity evamākārā | ācārye ca bodhisattvakalpe vidveṣaḥ svalpo'py anarthahetur ato'ham ācaryanīter aviparītaprakāśanenācārye bahumānam utpādya tato'narthahetor janan nivartayiṣyāmīty evaṃ duḥkhaviyogecchākārā karuṇāpy apiśabdāt | ity atrānubaddhaspṛham iti dvitīyeneti śabdena cintākaruṇayor hetutvam āha – ity ābhyāṃ cintākaruṇābhyāṃ cetaś ciraṃ dīrghakālam atra pramāṇasamuccayavyākhyābhūta pramāṇavārttikaracanāyām anubaddhaspṛhaṃ santānena pravṛtteccham iti || NOTEREF _Ref9587956 \f \h A
 yadi pramāṇasamuccayavyākhyāṃ cikīrṣur ācāryadharmakīrtiḥ kasmāt svātantryeṇānumānaṃ vyavasthāpayatīty āśaṅkām apanayann āha – arthānarthetyādi | artho hitam [p.5] ahitam anarthas tayor vivecanan tasyānumānāśrayatvād anumānam āśrayo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | anumānena hy arthānarthau niścityānumānapṛṣṭhabhāvinā prabandhapravṛttena jñānenārthānarthau yathākramaṃ prāpti(parihārārtham vibhāgena vyavasthāpayati | tasmād anumānāśrayam arthānarthavivecanaṃ | tadvipratipatter iti tasminn)anumāne vipratipattes tadvyavasthāpanāyāhety evam eke vyācakṣate |
 atra tv idaṃ cintyaṃ |
 yadi tāvad evam avadhāryate – arthānarthavivecanasyaivānumānāśrayatvād iti (|) tan na | arthānarthābhyām anyasyāpy upekṣaṇīyasya tṛtīyasya viṣayasya yad vivecanan tasyāpy anumānāśrayatvāt (arthānarthavivecanasya cāniyatatvāt | pratyakṣāśrayatvam anivāritam iti ko'tiśayo'numānasya khyāpito yena tadādau vyutpādyate |) athāpy evam avadhāryate | arthānarthavivecanasyānumānāśrayatvād eveti | tathāpy ayuktam avadhāraṇaṃ | arthānarthavivecanasya pratyakṣāśrayatvād api | tathā hy arthānarthau vibhaktarūpāv eva pratyakṣe pratibhāsete | tac ca pratyakṣam abhyāsātiśayasamāsāditapāṭavatayā apasāritabhrāntinimittaṃ pāścātyam arthānarthavivecana[vikalpaṃ janayati | etad e(va) hi pratyakṣasyārthānarthavive]canāśrayatvaṃ yadarthānarthau vibhāgenānubhūya yathānubhavan tatra niścayajananaṃ |
16 na ca śakyam vaktuṃ pāścāt yenaivārthānarthau vibhaktāv iti | vikalpena vastusvarūpasyāgrahaṇād grahaṇe vā vikalpakatvahāner vikalpānubaddhasya pramātuḥ spaṣṭārthapratibhāsitvavirodhāt |
19 yatra tu kvacid viṣaye pāṭavābhāvād bhrāntinimittāpanayanāsamarthaṃ pratyakṣam, 20 tatrānumānād niścayaḥ prārthyate, na sarvatra. tasmāt pratyakṣe svataḥ parataś ca 21 prāmāṇyaniścayaḥ, niścāyayiṣyate cāyam artho dvitīyapariccheda iti neha 22 pratanyate.
 avaśyaṃ ca pratyakṣasyābhyāsabalād apasāritabhrāntinimittasya yathānubhavan niścayajananāt svato'rthānarthavivecanāśrayatvam eṣṭavyam anyathānumānasyāpi vyavasthā na syād dhūmāder liṅgasyāniścayāt | dhūmāder apy anumānāt pratipattāv anavasthā syāt | tatrāpi liṅgāntarasyānumānāntareṇa niścayād iti |
 yadi ca pratyakṣam arthānarthavivecanasyānāśrayaḥ, tadā śāstrakāreṇa prakaraṇāntare yad uktaṃ – hitāhitaprāptiparihārayor niyamena samyagjñānapūrvakatvād NOTEREF _Ref516398800 \f \h B ityādi tad bādhyeta | tathā – na hy ābhyām artham paricchidyetyādi | punaś coktaṃ [p.6] – 
dṛṣṭeṣu samvitsāmarthyabhāvinaḥ smaraṇād NOTEREF _Ref516912550 \f \h D PVin 1.18
ityādi |
 tasmād anyathā vyākhyāyata ity apare | ācāryadignāgapraṇītaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇādikam artho yuktatvāt | tīrthikapraṇītaṃ na yuktatvād anarthas tayor vivecanaṃ yuktāyuktatvena vyavasthāpanan tasyānumānāśrayatvāt | anumānam eva hy āśritya lakṣaṇavākyānāṃ yuktāyuktatvaṃ vyavasthāpyanna pratyakṣan tasyāvicārakatvād iti |
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | yato lakṣaṇavākyānāṃ na svarūpeṇa yuktāyuktatvam api tvarthadvāreṇa (|) sa cārtho yathānumānena yuktaḥ pratīyate tathā pratyakṣeṇāpi | tathā ca vakṣyati (|)
 pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva sidhyati | (PV 3.123) tathā
 pakṣadharmatvaniścayaḥ pratyakṣata ityādi |
 yo'pi manyate (|) satyam arthānarthavivecanaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ kriyata eva (|) kevalaṃ yad arthānarthavivecanasyānumānāśrayatvam ucyate tatpratyakṣaviṣayepi vivādasambhave sati nānumānād anyannirṇayanibandhanam asty ato'numānasya prādhānyāt tadvivecanāśrayatvam uktam iti |
 etad apy ayuktaṃ | yataḥ pratyakṣasya sa eva viṣayo vyavasthāpyate yo niścito na ca niścite vivādaḥ sambhavatīty ayuktam etat |
 anyas tv āha (|) arthānarthavivecanam anumānād eva bhavati na pratyakṣāt | yato ye'rthānarthā anubhūtaphalā anubhūyamānaphalā vā na te pravṛttiviṣayā niṣpannatvāt phalasya | tasmād anāgatārthakriyārthan tatsamartheṣv arthānartheṣu pravṛttiḥ | na ca tatsāmarthyan teṣu pratyakṣeṇa pratīyate yena pravṛttiviṣayatvaṃ syāt | pravṛttisādhyārthakriyāyā bhāvitvena tatsāmarthya(kurvadrūpatā)syāpi bhāvitvāt | tasmāt pūrvānubhūtārthakriyāsādhanavastusādharmyāt pratyakṣeṣv api vastuṣv anāgataphalayogyatāniścayo na pratyakṣatas tenānumānād evārthānarthavivecanam iti |
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | yato yadi sā yogyatā (kurvadrūpatā)rtheṣu varttamānakālabhāvinī tadābhyāsātiśayavatāpi pratyakṣeṇa niścīyeta | liṅgavat | athānāgataiva sā tadānumānenāpi (na) niścīyetānāgate'rthe'numānābhāvād iti vakṣyate |
 etena yad ucyate "pravṛttiviṣayavastuprāpaṇaṃ pratyakṣānumānayor aviśiṣṭam" iti tad api nirastaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | anāgatārthakriyāsamartho hi pravṛttiviṣayo na ca tatsāmarthyaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ niścīyata ity uktaṃ | paricchinnaś ca pravṛttiviṣaya iṣyate na ca santānaḥ pratyakṣādikṣaṇena paricchinnas tat kathaṃ pravṛttiviṣayaḥ |
[p.7] athaikasmin kṣaṇe pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttam api niścayavaśāt kṣaṇasāmānyaviṣayatvenaikasantativiṣayan tad ayuktaṃ | pratibhāsamānenaiva hi viṣayeṇa niścayavaśāt pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ vyavasthāpyate na paramārthataḥ | svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt | yathā liṅgaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ | tathā hi pratibhāsamānam idaṃ dhūmasvalakṣaṇantārṇṇamvā pārṇṇamvānyad vā sambhavati (|) tatra ca viśeṣānavadhāraṇena kṣaṇamātraniścayena ca svalakṣaṇaviṣayam api sāmānyaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vyavasthāpyate | pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvino niścayasya pratyakṣaviṣayānusāritvāt | na punar ekakṣaṇaviṣayam pratyakṣam evaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate yato yaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate kṣaṇo nāsau niścito nāpi pūrvakṣaṇarūpo parakṣaṇarūpo vā sambhavati bhinnakālatvāt | tat kathan tatra viśeṣānavadhāraṇena kṣaṇamātraniścayena ca kṣaṇasāmānyaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vyavasthāpyeta | pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvinaḥ sa evāyam iti niścayasya sāmānyaviṣayatve (')pi na santānaviṣayatvaṃ | pratipannapratīyamānayor viṣayīkaraṇenānāgatakṣaṇāniścayād vijātīyavyāvṛttarūpaviṣayatvāc cāta eva kṣaṇasya pratibhāse (')py ayaṃ ghaṭa iti jñāpananiścayaḥ |
 nanu yady arthakriyāsamartho vastusantāno (na) pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ paricchidyate (|) kathan tarhi tayoḥ pravarttakatvam? vastusvarūpamātraparicchedād iti brūmaḥ | tathā hy agnyādikam vastv ekatra prabandhavṛttyā dāhādyarthakriyāsamarthaṃ pratyakṣeṇa niścinvann anyatrāpi deśādāv etad upalabhyamānaṃ prabandhavṛttyaivedṛgvidhārthakārīti niścāyayati | sa eva punaḥ kālāntare phalārthī tatsvarūpam paryeṣamāṇo (')gnyādikaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tad evedam iti niścayapūrvvakaṃ pravartate | tenāyam arthas tatsvarūpamātraparicchede pramāṇavyāpāro na prabandhavṛttiparicchede | nāpy arthakriyāsāmarthyaparicchede pūrvam evāsya sarvasya paricchinnatvāt | tena pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pravarttakattvaṃ yuktam eva | kathan tarhy arthānarthavivecanasyānumānāśra[yatvam uktam | ----------]ta naivātrārthā(?tma)nā[bhipretam api tu caturāryasatyaṃ |] yato muktyarthino vayaṃ muktiś ca caturāryasatyadarśanād bhavatīti bhagavatoktaṃ (|) taddarśanañ ca bhāvanābhyāsato niṣpadyate (|) bhāvanāyāṃ pravṛttiś ca caturāryasatyaniścayena (|) tanniścayaś ca parokṣatvād anumānād eva bhavatīty arthānarthavivecanāśrayatvam anumānasyaiva |
 artho nirodhamārgāv upādeyatvād anartho duḥkhasamudayau tyājyatvāt | yad vārthaḥ paramārthasatyam anarthaḥ (saṃvṛttisatyaṃ tayor yad vivecanaṃ svarūpeṇa vyavasthāpanan tasyānumānāśrayatvāt | arthānarthavivecanakāri ca sarvaṃ jñānaṃ na svalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhṇāty api tv adhyavasyatīti bhrāntam eva (|) tena yadi śabdādijñānam arthānarthavivecanāśrayam iṣyate tad api bhrāntatvād apramāṇam eva (|) ata eva na tasyeha vyutpādyāprasaṅgaḥ | anumānasya [p.8] tu bhrāntatve saty api pratibandhavaśāt prāmāṇyaṃ (|) śabdādijñānasya tv evaṃ prāmāṇyebhyupagamyamāne 'numānentarbhāvād apakṣadharmasyāgamakatvād arthānarthavivecanāśrayatvam anumānasyaiva |
 nanu pratibandhavaśād anumānasya pramāṇye nityādivikalpasyāpi pramāṇyaṃ syāt kṣaṇikādyarthe pratibandhād (|) athādhyavasitārthapratibandhena prāmāṇyaṃ maṇiprabhāyāmmaṇijñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ syāt | tad api hy adhyavasitena maṇinā sambaddhantasmāt saty api pratibandhe yaddeśādisambandhitayā yorthodhyavasitas taddeśādisambandhitayā santānaikatvādhyavasāyāt tam arthaṃ prāpayadanumānajñānaṃ pramāṇam eva | na sarvaṃ jñānaṃ |
 arthānarthavivecanaṃ cādhigamarūpamākāronumānampramāṇatvāt | yadvā liṅgam evānumānam atorthānarthavivecanasyānumānāśrayatvaṃ | tadvipratipatter iti tasminn anumāne sammohāt | tadvyavasthāpanāya tasyānumānasya vipratipattyapanayanenāvasthāpanāyāha sūtrakāraḥ |
 pakṣadharma ityādi |
 yady anumānaṃ vyavasthāpyaṃ kasmāt pakṣadharma ityādinā hetum eva vyavasthāpayatīti cet | adoṣo [']yaṃ hetuvipratipattidvāreṇānumāne vipratipattes tadvyutpattidvāreṇaiva tasya vyavasthāpanaṃ | anumānajñānaṃ ca trirūpaliṅgād utpadyamānaṃ lokapratītam evāto vipratipattiḥ pratītyaiva nirākriyate |
 yadvānumānaśabdena yadā liṅgam evocyate tadā tadvipratipatter hetum eva vyavasthāpayatīty adoṣaḥ |
 atra śloke liṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ saṃkhyāniyamaḥ saṃkhyāniyamakāraṇam vipakṣanivṛttiś coktā | pakṣadharmas tadaṃśena vyāpta iti lakṣaṇaṃ |
 tasya pakṣasyāṃśaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭo dharmas tena vyāpta evety avadhāraṇaṃ (|) tridhaiveti saṃkhyāniyamaḥ | avinābhāvaniyamād iti saṃkhyāniyamakāraṇaṃ | triṣv evāvinābhāvasya niyatatvād ityarthaḥ | hetvābhāsās tato [']para iti vipakṣanivṛttiḥ | tasmād dhetutrayādanye hetvābhāsaḥ |
[p.9] nanu yadi tadaṃśavyāptir dṛṣṭānta eva gṛhyate tadānumānasyotthānan na syāt | sādhyadharmiṇi sādhyadharmeṇa hetor vyāptyagrahāt | tadā ca pakṣadharmo hetur iti vyarthaṃ lakṣaṇam agamakatvāt | sarvopasaṃhāreṇa vyāptigrahaṇe (')pi nānumānasya prāmāṇyaṃ syāt | vyāptigrāhakapramāṇaṃ pratipannaviṣayatvena smṛtirūpatvāt | pakṣadharmo hetur iti ca na vaktavyan tadaṃśavyāptivacanenaiva gatatvāt | tadaṃśavyāptibalena ca pakṣadharmasya gamakatvan na pakṣe sattāmātreṇa tatrasthasya gardabhāder agamakatvāt | tasmān na pakṣadharmo hetur iti pṛthag lakṣaṇam vaktavyaṃ |
 tad uktam |
  "anyathānupapannatvaṃ yatra tatra trayeṇa kiṃ |
  nānyathānupapannatvaṃ yatra tatra trayeṇa kim" iti |
 kiṃ cānupalabdhes tāvan na pakṣadharmatvam anyopalabdheḥ puruṣadharmatvāt | svabhāvahetoś ca dharmirūpatvāt kāryahetor api svātantryeṇa dharmyanapekṣatvāt | na ca kalpitasya pakṣadharmasya kāryasvabhāvahetutvaṃ sādhyavyāptiś ceti na pakṣadharmo hetur iti vaktavyaṃ |
 tathā yadi hetutvena tritvaṃ vyāptan tadā hetutvasyāniyatatvād anyatrāpi saṃyogyādiṣu hetutvam anivāritam eveti tridhaivety avadhāraṇaṃ na yujyate |
 atha hetutvaṃ tritvena vyāptan tadā tritvasya hetāv aniyatatvāt kāryādīnām apy ahetutvan tataś ca kāryāder eva hetutvam iti na ghaṭate |
 kiṃ ca | yady anupalambhasya sādhyapratibandho nāsti tadā'pratibaddho [']pi hetur gamaka iti tridhaiva sa iti niyamo na ghaṭate (|)
 atha pratibandho [']sti tadā kāryasvabhāvayor evāntarbhāvāt tridhaiva sa hetur iti tathāpi na yujyate | hetvābhāsās tato 'para iti na yuktaṃ hetvantarasyātyantaparokṣatvān na tadabhāvaḥ pratyakṣādiniścita ity ayuktam uktaṃ |
  pakṣadharmas tadaṃśena vyāpto hetus tridhaiva saḥ |
  avinābhāvaniyamād dhetvābhāsās tato 'para iti ||
 atrocyate | yady api sādhyasādhanayor vyāptiḥ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipannā tathāpi na vyāptigrahaṇamātrād iha sādhyadharmiṇīdānīṃ sādhyadharma iti viśeṣeṇa niścayo bhavaty anumānāt tu syāt | tasmād pratipannaviśiṣṭadeśādisambandhisādhyārthapratipādakatvena pramāṇam evānumānan tac ca pakṣadharmatve saty eva bhavati nānyathā | yato nānyadeśādisthena sādhyadharmiṇānyadeśādisthaḥ sādhanadharmaḥ sambaddho 'to viśiṣṭadeśādyavacchinnasādhanāvagatisāmarthyād eva viśiṣṭadeśādyavacchinnasādhyapratītir evānumānaṃ (|) na tu dhamamātrād(dhūmamātrād ?) agnimātrapratītis tasyā vyāptigrāhakapramāṇaphalatvāt | [p.10] nāpi yatra sādhanadharmas tatra sādhyadharma ity aviśeṣeṇāvagame [']pi sādhanasya pakṣadharmatvaṃ sidhyati sādhyadharmidharmatayā viśeṣeṇāpratīteḥ sāmānyenābhidhānāt | tasmād viśiṣṭadeśādyavacchinnasādhyapratipattaye pakṣadharmatvan darśanīyaṃ |
 tena yad uktaṃ "yatra yatra dhūmas tatra tatrāgnir ity anenaiva pakṣadharmasyoktatvāt pradeśaviśeṣe [']gnisiddhyarthan dhūmaś cātreti na vaktavyam uktārthatvād" iti tad apāstaṃ |
 nanv evam anumānasya prāmāṇye 'pakṣadharmmam apy anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ syād apratipannādhigamāt | yathādhastān nadīpūran dṛṣṭvopari vṛṣṭyanumānaṃ | tathā śiśur ayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ mātāpitror brāhmaṇyād iti. tad uktam –
  nadīpūro [']py adho deśe dṛṣṭaḥ (sann upari sthitāṃ |
  niyamyo gamayaty eva) vṛttāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ niyāmikāṃ ||
  evaṃ (pratyakṣadharmatvaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hetvaṅga)[m iṣyate] |
  tat pūrvoktānyadharmatvadarśanād vyabhicāryate ||
  pitroś ca brāhmaṇatvena putrabrāhmaṇatānumā |
  sarvalokaprasiddhā na pakṣadharmam apekṣate ||
  kleśena pakṣadharmatvaṃ yas tatrāpi prakalpayet |
  na saṅgaccheta tasyaitallakṣyeṇa saha lakṣaṇaṃ ||
  yathā lokaprasiddhaṃ ca lakṣaṇair anugamyate |
  lakṣyasya lakṣaṇam evaṃ [syāt] tadapūrvan na sādhyata iti |
atrocyate | kasmād upary eva vṛṣṭya(numānaṃ nānyatra (|) pūrasya tatsambandhitvād i)ti cet | yady evaṃ yato [']yaṃ nadīpūra āyātas tatra vṛṣṭyanumānan nānyatra vyabhicārāt | parasya ca tatsambandhitvaniścaye sati gamakatvam anyathā (')naikāntikatvaṃ syāt | tathā śiśur ayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ mātāpitror brāhmaṇyād ity atrāpi yasyaiva śiśor brāhmaṇyaṃ sādhyan tasyaiva mātāpitṛbrāhmaṇyalakṣaṇo dharmaḥ sambandhī gamako na mātāpitṛ(brāhmaṇyamātram anyasambandhimā)tāpitṛbrāhmaṇyasyāgamakatvāt | tenāsyāpi pakṣadharmatve sati gamakatvam ato na kleśena pakṣadharmatvakalpanā (|) yadvā ya evāvyabhicāre nimittaṃ sa eva hetur yathā dhūmasyāgnikāryatvaṃ brāhmaṇabhūtamātāpitṛjanyatvaṃ ca śiśor brāhmaṇyanimittam iti tad eva hetur yukto [']nyasya tatkalpanā kleśena syād iti | tathā na candrodayāt samudravṛddhyanumānaṃ candrodayāt (pūrvaṃ paścād api) [p.11] tadanumānaprasaṅgāt | candrodayakāla eva tadanumānan tad eva vyāpter gṛhītatvād iti cet |
 yady evaṃ tatkālasambandhitvam eva sādhyasādhanayoḥ | tadā ca sa eva kālo dharmī tatraiva ca sādhyānumānaṃ candrodayaś ca tatsambandhīti katham apakṣadharmatvam (|) atha kālo neṣyate na tadā tarhy etad anumānam vyabhicārād (|) atha bauddhānām etad anumānan nāsti kālābhāvāt (|)
 tad ayuktaṃ | pūrvāhṇādipratyayaviṣayasya mahābhūtaviśeṣasya kāla ity abhidheyasyābhyupagamāt | evam anyatrāpi pakṣadharmatvaṃ yojyaṃ |
 nanu bhavatu pakṣadharmatve saty anumānasya prāmāṇyan tathāpi pakṣadharma iti pṛthag lakṣaṇaṃ na karttavyan tadaṃśavyāptavacanenaiva gatatvāt |
 satyaṃ (|) kin tv apakṣadharmasyāpi sādhyavyāptasya hetutvanirāsārthaṃ kṛtaṃ | mahānasādidṛṣṭadhūmādi codadhāv agnyanumāne |
 nanu vyāptasya liṅgatvaṃ na ca mahānasādigato dhūma udadhau sādhyenāgninā vyāptaḥ (|)
 satyaṃ (|) kevalaṃ vyāpto hetur ity etāvanmātrakeṇa lakṣaṇavacanena yatraiva vyāpyadharmas tatraiva vyāpakadharmānu(māna)m ity etan na labhyate | tataś cānyatrāpi sādhyānumānāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaṃ pakṣadharmavacanaṃ | anupalabdher api pakṣadharmatvam asty eva | yadā hy anyasya bhūtalāder upalambhajananayogyataivānyānupalabdhis tadā yogyatānyabhūtalādisvabhāveti kathan nānupalabdheḥ pakṣadharmatvaṃ | kṛtakatvāder apy evaṃ śabdādidharmatvaṃ | puruṣadharmarūpāyā apy anupalabdher anyabhūtalādikāryatvam eva paramārthatas taddharmatvan tadāyattatvāt | dhūmāder api kāryasyaivaṃ pradeśādidharmatvaṅ kevalam vikalpena teṣāṃ sambandhisvarūpam eva pakṣasyāyaṃ dharma iti vyavasthāpyate |
 hetutvaṃ ca dhūmāder avinābhāvena vyāptam ajñātāvinābhāvasyāgamakatvena(-a)hetutvāt | avinābhāvaś ca kāryasvabhāvābhyāṃ vyāptaḥ | vidhipratiṣedhayoś ca sādhyatve saty arthāntaravidhāne (kāryahetoḥ) svabhāvahetoḥ pratiṣedhe cānupalabdhes tena hetus tritvena vyāpto 'to [']sau trividha eva bhavati | na tu trividho hetur eva kāryāder apy ajñātasyāhetutvāt | kāraṇavyāpakānulabdyor [kāraṇavyāpakānulabhdyor] api pratibandhād eva gamakatvaṃ | tathā hi (|) yata eva pratibandhāt kāryavyāpye kāraṇavyāpake gamayataḥ | tata eva pratibandhāt kāraṇavyāpakānupalabdhī kāryavyāpyābhāvaṅ gamayataḥ | svabhāvānupalabdhāv api yadā ghaṭāder upalambhajananayogya ātmā upalabdhir ucyate [']nyahetusākalye copalambhāvyabhicārād upalabdhiḥ sattā tadānayos tādātmyan tenātrāpi pakṣe pratibandhanibandhanam [P.12] eva gamakatvaṃ | na cānupalabdheḥ kāryādihetāv antarbhāvaḥ svasādhye pratibandhānapekṣatvāt | hetoś ca sakāśāt sādhyapratītis tadāyattatve sati syāt (|) na ca saṃyoge sati tadāyattatvam asaṃyuktānāṃ saṃyogābhāvāt (|) saṃyuktānām api na saṃyogatas tadāyattatā 'nyata eva saṃyuktānām utpatteḥ | evaṃ samavāye [']pi vācyaṃ | tasmāt tadāyattatvan tādātmyatadutpattibhyān tena kāryasvabhāvānupalambhabahirbhūtānāṃ saṃyogyādīnām ahetutvan tadāyattatvābhāvenāvinābhāvābhāvāt |
 atha tadāyattatvam asti tad eva tarhi gamakatve nimittam iti sa hetus tridhaiveti siddhaṃ |
 nanu tathāpi katham anumānasyotthānan nirvikalpakapratyakṣeṇa dharmadharmitatsambandhāgrahāt svātantryeṇa vastudvyādhigateḥ |
 ucyate (|) savikalpakenāpi dhūmapradeśādīnāṃ dharmadharmibhāvagrahaṇam upary uparibhāvapratibhāsa eva (|) sa ca nirvikalpake [']py asti kevalaṃ vikalpetarayor jñānayor ullekhānullekhakṛto viśeṣaḥ (|) tac ca nirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ yathāgṛhītaviṣayam evedam ihāstīdaṃ nāstīti vidhipratiṣedhaṃ janayat pramāṇam iṣyate | tena dharmadharmiṇoḥ svarūpaniścayaḥ sambandhaniścaya(ḥ pratyakṣakṛta) eva bhavatīti ||
 pakṣadharma ity uktaṃ (|) sūtre pakṣadharmaś ca dharmadharmisamudāyaḥ | na ca prativādinaṃ prati samudāyadharmatvaṃ hetoḥ siddhan tena sa sarvo hetur asiddhaḥ syāt | siddhau vānumānasya vaiyarthyam ity āha –
 pakṣo dharmīti | avayave samudāyopacārāt | ekadeśatvaṃ ca samudāyopacāranimittan tena na dṛṣṭāntadharmī pakṣa ucyate |
 īśvarasenaḥ prāha – dharmidha(rmmo hetur ity etāvad vaktavyaṃ pra)yojanābhāvād anupacāra iti | tad āha – prayojanetyādi | netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na prayojanasyābhāvaḥ kathaṃ sarvadharmidharmapratiṣedhārthatvād upacārasyety apekṣyate | asaty upacāre dharmidharma iti nirdeśaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā ca dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇo (')pi dharmo hetuḥ syāt | upacāre tu sarvasya dharmiṇo dharmaḥ pratiṣiddho bhavati | katha(m iti ced āha – tadekadeśatvādi) | tathā hi samudāyasyāvayaveṣūpacāraḥ | tadekadeśatvaṃ nibandhanatvena na sarvatropacāraḥ | sādhyadharmī ca tadekadeśatvāt pakṣasyāvayavatvāt pakṣopacārayogyas tasya yo dharmas tatpratipattyartham upacārakaraṇaṃ | tathā cety upacārayogyadharmipratipattau cākṣuṣatvādiparihāraḥ | ādiśabdāt kākasya kā(rṣṇyād ityādi | [p.13] nanu yadi cākṣuṣatvād iti ) cakṣurvijñānaviṣayatvād iti hetvarthas tadāyaṃ hetur anaikāntikatvāt tadaṃśavyāptivacanenaiva nirasta iti kim upacāreṇa | atha cakṣurvijñānajanakatvād iti hetvarthas tadāpi tajjanakatvaṃ sattvam eva (|) tac ca śabde (')py astīti na dṛṣṭāntadharmidharma evāyam iti kaścit |
 tad ayuktaṃ | cakṣurvijñānajanakatvaṃ hi sattvaviśeṣaḥ sa ca ghaṭādīnām eva dharmo na śa(bdasyātas tan nivṛtyartham upacāra)karaṇaṃ | na tv asaty apy upacāre vyāptaya liṅgatvaṃ (|) na ca śabdānityattvena cākṣuṣatvaṃ vyāptan tat katham asya liṅgatvaṃ |
 naiṣa doṣaḥ | anityatvamātreṇa hy asya vyāptatvan tac ca śabde (')py astīti katham ahetutvaṃ syāt |
[PVSV 1,15] dharmavacanenetyādi | dharmas tadaṃśena vyāpta iti kevalena dharmavacanenāpi dharmiparatantratvād dharmasyāvaśyam asau dharmiṇam ākṣipati (|) tena dharmiṇa āśrayaṇam āśra(yaḥ parigrahas ta)sya siddhau satyāṃ yad etad dharmidharma ity atra dharmigrahaṇan tasya sāmarthyāt pratyāsattir iha vivakṣiteti gamyate (|) vyāptivivakṣāyāṃ dharmigrahaṇam anarthakaṃ syāt | tasmād dharmivacanasāmarthyāt pratyāsattiḥ siddhā (|) pratyāsattiś ca sādhyadharmiṇa eva tatra prathamaṃ hetūpadarśanāt | tayā pratyāsattyā sādhyadharmiparigraho bhaviṣyati | na pratyāsatteḥ sādhyadharmiparigrahaḥ kutoḥ (|) dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇo (')pi na kevalaṃ sādhyadharmiṇaḥ pratyāsatteḥ | kadācid vyāptidarśanapūrvake prayoge dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇo (')pi prathamaṃ hetusadbhāvopadarśanāt |
 yadi na pratyāsatteḥ sādhyadharmisiddhiḥ pāriśeṣyāt tarhi bhaviṣyati | yatas tadaṃśavyāptyā hetubhūtayā dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi dharmasya sattvasiddhiḥ | na hi dṛṣṭāntam antareṇa hetoḥ sādhyena vyāptiḥ pradarśayituṃ śakyata iti manyate | tato dharmigrahaṇād vyatiricyamānāt sādhyadharmiṇa eva parigrahaḥ | tadaṃśeneti ca tacchabdena dharmavacanākṣipto dharmī sambadhyata iti tatsambandhanārtham api dharmigrahaṇaṃ nāśaṅkanīyaṃ |
 yatra prayojanānantaraṃ na sambhavati sa pāriśeṣyasya viṣayo dharmivacanasya tv anyad api [P.14] prayojanaṃ sambhāvyata iti manyamānaḥ siddhāntavādy āha – siddhe tadaṃśavyāptyā dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi sattve punar ddharmiṇo vacanandṛṣṭāntadharmiṇa eva yo dharmaḥ sa hetur iti niyamārtham āśaṃkyate | tataś ca cākṣuṣatvādaya eva hetavaḥ syurna kṛtakatvādaya ity aniṣṭam eva syāt | tasmād upacāraḥ karttavya iti |
 kiṃ punaḥ kvacit tarkkaśāstre dṛṣṭa niyamārtham vacanam ity ata āha – sajātīya evetyādi | tatra yaḥ san sajātīye dvedhā cāsaṃstadatyaye sa hetur ity atrācāryī ye hetulakṣaṇe | sajātīya eva sattvam ity avadhāraṇena siddhe (')pi vijātīyād vipakṣāddhetor vyatireke yadetad asaṃs tadatyaya iti sādhyābhāve 'sattvavacanaṃ tanniyamārtham ācāryeṇa vyākhyātamasaty eva nāstitā yathā syān nānyatra na viruddha iti | tathehāpi dharmivacanam bhāvaniyamārtham āśaṃkyate |
 nanv apakṣadharmasyāhetutvān na niyamārthā śaṅkā | yato vyāptasya hetutvaṃ na cānyadharmisthena sādhyadharmeṇānyadharmisthaḥ sādhanadharmo vyāptas tasmāt tadaṃśavyāptahetuvacanasāmarthyād eva sādhyadharmiparigraho bhaviṣyatīty ata āha – sāmarthyād ityādi | anantaroditāt sāmarthyād arthasya sādhyadharmiparigrahalakṣaṇasya bhavati pratītiḥ paṭudhiyāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ kintv aśabdakam arthaṃ svayamanusaratāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt | ata upacāramātrāt svayam aśabdakārthābhyūharahitād dharmidharma ity anena pakṣadharma iti samānanirdeśāt pratipattigauravaṃ ca parihṛtam bhavati | ca śabdenaitad āha – ye paropadeśam ākāṃkṣanti tair ayam artho lakṣaṇavacanād boddhavya iti |
 yathālakṣaṇaṃ pratīter apakṣadharmo na hetur iti kuta iyam āśaṅkā | tatas teṣāṃ lakṣaṇānusāriṇāṃ niyamāśaṃkāparihārārthañ copacārakaraṇam iti | iha vyavacchedaphalatvāc chabdaprayogasyāvaśyam evāvadhārayitavyaṃ (|) ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāc ca pakṣadharma iti nānyas samāsas sambhavati | tathā ca pakṣasyaiva dharmma ity evam avadhāraṇāt tadaṃśavyāptir virudhyata iti viruddhalakṣaṇatām udbhāvayann āha –
 pakṣasya dharmatve tampakṣaṃ viśeṣaṇam anyato vyavacchedam apekṣata iti | tadviśeṣaṇāpekṣasya dharmasyānyatra pakṣīkṛtād anyasmin sapakṣe 'nanuvṛttiḥ | tathā hi yaḥ [p.15] pakṣeṇa viśeṣyate sa pakṣasyaiva bhavati | yathā devadattasya putraḥ (|) tatonyatrānanuvṛtter asādhāraṇatā sādhāraṇatā na syāt | tadaṃśavyāptivirodha iti yāvat | sādhāraṇatayā tadaṃśavyāptipratipādanāt | tato yadi pakṣadharmo na tadaṃśavyāptir atha tadaṃśavyāptir na pakṣadharma iti vyāhataṃ lakṣaṇam iti |
 nanu yadi sādhyadharmiṇi sādhanadharmasya sādhyavyāptir na gṛhītā tadā hetor anaikāntikatvam atha gṛhītā kiṃ dṛṣṭānte heto(r anvayena kathañ ca pakṣadha)rmasya tadaṃśavyāptir virudhyate sādhyadharmiṇy api vyāpteḥ pratipannatvāt | sarvapadārthasya kṣaṇikatve sādhye sattvalakṣaṇasya vā hetoḥ ko dṛṣṭāntenvayaḥ | tasmāt svasādhyapratibandhād dhetus tena vyāptaḥ sidhyati (|) sa ca viparyaye bādhakapramāṇavṛttyā sādhyadharmiṇy api sidhyatīti na kiṃcid anyatrānvayāpekṣayā (|) tat kathaṃ idam āśaṃkitam anyatrānanavṛtter asādhāraṇateti |
 (sattyaṃ yady api sādhyadharmiṇi hetoḥ ) sādhyavyāptim antareṇa nānumānasyotthānan tathāpi dṛṣṭānte sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakapramāṇam antareṇa na sādhyadharmiṇy api vyāptiḥ sidhyatīti tadarham idam āśaṃkitaṃ |
 yat tūcyate kāryahetvapekṣayā svabhāvahetuviśeṣāpekṣayaitadāśaṃkitaṃ tat tu kṣaṇikatvānumāne sattvāpekṣayā | tasya hi vipakṣabādhakapramāṇavṛttyaiva gamakatvā(d iti tad etad uttaratra nirūpayiṣyā)maḥ | tasmāt pūrvagṛhītapratibandhasādhakapramāṇasmṛtaye hetor anyatra vṛttir apekṣaṇīyā |
 etat pariharati netyādinā (|) na anyatrānanuvṛttiḥ (|) kutaḥ | ayogo sambandhas tadvyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt pakṣasya | na hyanyayogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣaṇam bhavati kintvayogavyavacchedenāpi | yatra dharmiṇi dharmasya sadbhāvaḥ sandihyate tatrāyogavyavacchedasya nyāyaprāptatvāt | atra dṛṣṭānto yathā caitro dhanurdhara iti (|) caitre hi dhanurdharatvaṃ sandihyate kim asti nāstīti | tataścaitro dhanurdhara ity ukte pakṣāntaram adhanurddharatvaṃ śroturākāṃkṣopasthāpitaṃ nirākaroty ayogavyavacchedotra nyāyaprāptaḥ |
 parābhimatavyavacchedaṃ nirācikīrṣannāha – nānyayogavyavacchedena viśeṣaṇād [p.16] anyatrānanuvṛtterasādhāraṇateti sambandhaḥ | atrāpi dṛṣṭānto yathā (pārtho dhanurddhara iti sāmānyaśabdopyayaṃ) dhanurddharaśabdaḥ prakaraṇasāmarthyādinā prakṛṣṭaguṇavṛttiriha pārthe hi dhanurddharatvaṃ siddhameveti nāyogāśaṅkā | tādṛśantu sātiśayaṃ kimanyatrāpyasti nāstīty anyayogaśaṃkāyāṃ śroturyadā pārtho dhanurddhara ity ucyate tadā sātiśayaḥ pārtha eva dhanurddharo nānya iti pratīyate | tenātrānyayogavyavacchedo nyāyaprāptaḥ | tathā kiṃ pakṣestyayaṃ dharmo na (veti saṃśaye pakṣadharma) ity ukte pakṣasya dharma eva nādharmaḥ | dharmaścāśritatvād viśeṣaṇantenāyogo vyavacchidyate nānyayogaḥ | tadaṃśavyāptyānyayogasya pratipādanena dṛṣṭānte sandehābhāvāt | ākṣepsyāma iti nirdekṣyāmaścaturthe paricchede (4|160) |
 tadaṃśastaddharma iti tacchabdena pakṣaḥ parāmṛśyate na dharmaḥ ? |) dharmasya dharmāsambhavāt | tasya pakṣasyāṃśastasyaiva sādhyo dharmaḥ | ekadeśe rūḍhoṃśaśabdaḥ kathaṃ dharmaṃ pratipādayatīti cedāha – vakturabhiprāyavaśād iti | na vastubalena śabdānāṃ vācakatvaṃ kintu vakturvivakṣāvaśānna tadekadeśastadaṃśa iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ (|)
 kiṃ punar evam iti cedāha – pakṣaśabdena samudāyāvacanād iti | yadi pakṣaśabdena samudāyobhihitaḥ syāt tadā dharmadharmisamudāyātmakasya pakṣasyaikadeśo dharmātmakoṅśo bhavati | upacaritena tu pakṣaśabdena dharmyevābhidhīyate (|) tasya caikātmakasya kuta ekadeśaḥ |
 vyāptaṃ padam vyāptir ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasya pakṣadharmasya sato vyāptir yo vyāpnoti yaś ca vyāpyate vyāpyavyāpakadharmatayā pratīteḥ | yadā vyāpakadharmatayā vivakṣyate tadā vyāpakasya gamyasya bhāva eveti sambandhaḥ | tatreti saptamyarthapradhānam etan nādhārārthapradhānaṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmāntaratvābhāvāt | tenāyam arthaḥ (|) yatra dharmiṇi vyāpyam asti tatra sarvatra vyāpakasya bhāva eveti vyāpakadharmo vyāptiḥ | na tv evam avadhāryate vyāpakasyaiva tatra bhāva iti | hetvabhāvaprasaṅgāt | avyāpakasyāpi mūrttatvādes tatra bhāvāt | nāpi tatraivety avadhāryate | prayatnānantarīyakatvāder ahetutvāpatteḥ | sādhāraṇaś ca hetuḥ syān nityatvasya prameyeṣv eva bhāvāt | yadā tu vyāpyadharmatā [p.17] vyāpter vivakṣitā tadā yatra dharmiṇi vyāpako (')sti tatraiva vyāpyasya bhāvo nānyatra | atrāpi vyāpyasyaiva | tatra bhāva ity avadhāraṇaṃ hetvabhāvaprasakter eva nāśritam avyāpyasyāpi tatra bhāvāt | nāpi vyāpyasya tatra bhāva evety avadhāryate | sapakṣaikadeśavṛtter ahetutvaprāpteḥ | sādhāraṇasya ca hetutvaṃ syāt prameyatvasya nityeṣv avaṃśyam bhāvād iti | vyāpakasya tatra bhāva ity anena cānvaya ākṣipto vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāva ity anena vyatireka ākṣiptaḥ |
 yad vā vyāpter vyāpyavyāpakadharmmasamvarṇṇanaṃ niyatāniyatatvakhyāpanārthaṃ | tena vyāpto hetur bhavati na tu vyāpako 'niyatatvāt |

 satyaṃ | kevalan dharmayoḥ sāmānyena vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo niścīyate | yac cānityatvasāmānyaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvavyāpakaṃ niścitan tadaprayatnānantarīyake (')pi dṛśyata iti vyāpako 'niyata ucyate | atha prayatnānantarīyakasvabhāvam evānityatvaṃ niścetum pāryate tadānayoḥ parasparaṃ vyāpyatvam iti vyāpta eva hetur bhavati | yadā ca yatra vipratipattis tadeva sādhyam itarat sādhanam iti nyāya eṣaḥ |
 yadi tarhi "pakṣadharmas tadaṃśena vyāpta" ity etāvad dhetulakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ pakṣadharmatvan tadaṃśavyāptiś ceti dvirūpo hetuḥ syād anyatra ca trirūpa uktas tat kathan na vyādhāta ity āha –
 etena tadaṃśavyāptivacanenānvayavyatirekāv uktau | anvayavyatirekarūpatvād vyāpter iti bhāvaḥ | tathā hi (|) ya eva yenānvito yannivṛttau ca nivartate sa eva tena vyāpta ucyata iti tadātmakatvād vyāpter vyāptivacanenānvayavyatirekābhidhānantato vyāptivacanena rūpadvayābhidhānān na vyāghāta iti | tau ca jñāpakahetvadhikārān niścitau | niścayaś ca tayor naikeneva pramāṇenāpi tu yathāsvaṃ yasya yadātmīyaṃ pramāṇaṃ niścāyakantena | yasya ca yatpramāṇan taduttaratra vakṣyate |
 nanu bhāvarūpatvāl liṅgasya kathaṃ vyatirekaḥ (|) sādhyābhāve 'bhāvalakṣaṇosya rūpam iti cet | na | ya eva hi sādhya eva liṅgasya bhāvaḥ sa eva sādhyābhāve vyatirekaḥ | tenānvayavyatireka(yor api tādātmyaṃ vi)kalpakalpitas tu bhedaḥ | sādhyābhāve liṅgasya nirvṛttidharmakatvaṃ vyatireka ity apare | yataś ca yatra yatra sādhanadharmmas tatra tatra sādhyadharma ity evaṃ rūponvayaḥ | tena yad ucyate (kumārila) bhaṭṭena ||

 nanu yaḥ pradeśo (')gnisambandhī so pratyakṣaḥ | yaś ca pratyakṣo nabhobhāgarūpa ālokādyātmā dhūmavattayā dṛśyamāno na sognimānataḥ kathaṃ pradeśe dhūmasya pratyakṣataḥ siddhis tasmād dhūma eva dharmī yuktaḥ |
sāgnirayaṃ dhūmo dhūmatvād ity evaṃ sādhyasādhanabhāva ity udyotakaraḥ. | tasyāpi sāgner dhūmāvayavasyāpatyakṣatvāt | paridṛśyamānasya corddhvabhāgavartino 'gninā sahāvṛtteḥ kathaṃ dhūmasāmānyasya sādhyadharmiṇi pratyakṣato niścayaḥ | dhūmāvayavī pratyakṣa iti cet | na (|) avayavavyatirekeṇa tasyābhāvāta | lokādhyavasāyaḥ tasyaikatve vā pradeśasyāpi tāvataḥ kalpitam ekātmakatvaṃ na vāryate | pradeśa eva ca loko 'gniṃ pratipadyate na dhūme dharmiṇi | tena yady agner anumānam iṣyate, pradeśa eva dharmiṇy anumānam astv ity evam param etat |
 na tv atra pūrvokto doṣaparihāra ity eke | yadvā dṛśyamānaḥ pradeśo dharmī adhastād agnimān ity etāvat sādhyadharmo nāgnimātraṃ | īdṛgvidhena ca sādhyadharmeṇa pūrvam eva vyāptiḥ pratipannā | dhūmaś cātra pratyakṣasiddha iti kathaṃ nānumānaṃ | yat tu deśādyapekṣayā kāryahetor gamakatvam atrocyate | tadasaṅgatam eva deśāder viśeṣaṇasyāsiddhatvāt | dhūmamātradarśanād evāsya sādhyasya siddatvāc ca | yadvā pradeśe 'gniṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃśukādirūpeṇa sandehaṃ yadā dhūmadaṛśanān nivartayati | tadaitad udāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | tadā hi pratyakṣeṇa dharmī sādhanadharmaś ca siddho bhavati |
 yat tūcyate – pratyakṣāpratyakṣarūpa eva dharmiṇy anumānam iti , tad ayuktam. pratyakṣāṅśe yady api hetuḥ siddhas tathāpi na tatra sādhyadharmānumānaṃ pratyakṣabādhitatvāt | parokṣāṅśe tu syādanumānaṃ kevalantatra hetur asiddhaḥ | na ca pratyakṣaṃ pratyakṣarūpasya dharmiṇo dharmaḥ pratyakṣasiddho 'pratyakṣeṅśe pratyakṣāvyāpārāt | yadā vā śravaṇagrāhye śabde 'nityatvānumānantadā kathaṃ dharmiṇaḥ pratyakṣāpratyakṣarūpateti yatkiñcid etat |
 śiṃśapātvād iti svabhāvahetor udāharaṇaṃ |
[p.21] umbekas tv atrāha – "svabhāvahetor gamakatvaṃ dūrotsāri(tam eva | bhedādhiṣṭhāna)tvād gamyagamakabhāvasya | na hy abhinne pratibandho nāma | na śiṃśapā vṛkṣātmikā | tato vyāvarttamānatvāt | yo hi yasmād vyāvarttate na sa tadātmā | ghaṭād iva paṭaḥ | vyāvarttate ca khadirādibhyaḥ śiśaṃpetyatadātmakā | tadātmatve ca liṅgagrahaṇavelāyāmevāvyatirekāt sādhyasvarūpavalliṅgāgrahaṇavattvaṃ sādhyasya gṛhītatvādanume(yatvahāniḥ | tādātmyena ca śiṃ)śapātvasya gamakatve tādātmyāviśeṣād vṛkṣatvasya śiṃśapāṃ prati gamakatvaprasaṅgaḥ | athāsyāniyatatvād agamakatvaṃ niyatataiva tarhi gamakatve nimittaṃ na tu tādātmyaṃ vyabhicāriṇy api vṛkṣatve tādātmyasya darśanāt | atha tadātmanaiva vṛkṣe nāsti śiṃśapā .......... tadātmikā | sarvathā yayoreva .......... tayā gamyagamaka(bhāvo nānātmye tu tādātmyābhāvaḥ |) evamaśiṃśapā'vṛkṣāpohayor apohabuddhyor vā gamyagamakabhāvo nirākarttavya" iti |
 tadayuktaṃ | śiṃśapā hi vṛkṣaviśeṣasvabhāvā | vṛkṣaviśeṣopi śiṃśapāsvabhāva evety ubhayagatantādātmyaṃ | tādātmyepi ca kaścid avṛkṣavyāvṛtte svabhāve kathaṃcinmūḍho nāśiṃśapāvyāvṛtte (|) tena śiṃśapāder liṅgasya grahaṇānnānu(meyatvahāniḥ | yataś ca na vṛkṣamātra)svabhāvā śiṃśapā (|) tena na vṛkṣatvasya śiṃśapāṃ prati gamakatvaṃ | sādhyasādhanādyabhāvadoṣantu svayam eva śāstrakāro nirākariṣyatīti yatkiñcid etat |
 pradeśa ity anupalabdheḥ kathanaṃ | pradeśaviśeṣa ity uddiṣṭe deśe | kvacid iti vādiprativādiprasiddhe | na ghaṭa iti ghaṭābhāvavyavahāraḥ sādhyaḥ | upalabdhītyādinā hetunirdeśaḥ | upalabdhe(rlakṣaṇāni karaṇāni cakṣurādīny a)pratibaddhasāmarthyādy upalabdhilakṣaṇāni | tāni prāptaḥ svābhāsajñānajananayogyaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ | svajñānajananasāmagryantarbhūtortha ity arthaḥ | tasyānupalabdhestathābhūtasyāsadvyavahārasiddhiḥ |
 kathaṃ punar yo yatra nāsti sa tatropalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpto bhavati | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaṃ hi jñānaviṣayatvan tasmiṃś ca sati kuto nāstitvaṃ |
 ucyate | yāvatyāṃ (sāmagryāṃ satyāṃ pūrvaṃ prati)panno bhāvastāvatyām eva [p.22] sāmagryāṃ satyāṃ yadi syāt pūrvakālavadupalabhyetety evam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaṃ buddhyā parāmṛśya bhāvasyāpratibhāsanān nāstīti niṣedhaḥ kriyate | na tv adṛśyasya | pratibhāsaparāmarśopāyābhāvāt | sarvadā'pratipannatvāt |
 nanu dṛśyasyābhāve sati saiva sāmagrī kathaṃ pratipanneti cet | na | ekajñānaviṣayayor bhāvayor eko(palambhāditi) brūmaḥ | svata eva ca niṣidhyamānasyopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvan niścīyate | etadevaikajñānajananayogyatayopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvandarśayitum āha –
 yadi syād ghaṭādir upalabhyaṃ sattvaṃ yasya sa tathābhūta eva syāt | nānyatheti na kadācid agrāhyas tathābhūto 'vaśyaṃ jñānan na vyabhicaratīti yāvat | yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyeti yadviśeṣaṇam uktan tadarthād upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasattvasyety uktam bhavati | atra tv ayaṃ bāhyārthaḥ | lakṣyate 'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ | upalabdhir eva lakṣaṇan tatprāptam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ jñānenāvyabhicaritasambandham ity arthaḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ sattvaṃ yasya tat tathoktaṃ | tathābhūtaṃ hi sattvaṃ jñānaṃ nivṛttyāvaśyaṃ nivartata iti bhāvaḥ | vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ sarvaṃ sādhanaṃ vyāptaṃ | vidhīyamānaś ca sādhyaḥ pratibandhadvayena bhidyata iti vidhipratiṣedhau hetutrayāyattāv iti darśayann āha – tatretyādi |
 tatra triṣu hetuṣu dvau kāryasvabhāvahetū vastusādhanau vidhisādhanau | dvāveveti cāvadhāraṇaṃ na tu vastusādhanāv eveti | ābhyāṃ sāmarthyād vyavacchedasyāpi siddheḥ | ekaḥ pratiṣedhahetur iti | uktalakṣaṇonupalambhaḥ pratiṣedhahetur eva | na tveka evety avadhāryate pūrvvābhyām api vyavacchedagateḥ |
 kaścid āha – "vyavacchedaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ prasādhyate yāvāṃścid vyavacchedaḥ sa sarvo [']nupalambhād evety anupalambha evaiko hetur" iti |
 tadayuktaṃ | yato na tāvat pramāṇavyāpārāpekṣayaitad ucyate | vastuny eva pramāṇavyāpārāt | tadāhāta eva vastuviṣayaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ dvayor iti | nāpy adhyavasāyavaśād etad ucyate vastuna evādhyavasāyāt | vyavacchedena saha liṅgasya sambandhābhāvāc ca |
[p.23]  yo (')pi manyate 'nupalambhe 'sadvyavahārayogyatā sādhyate na pratiṣedhaḥ | yogyatā ca svabhāvabhūtaiva | tathāgnimati pradeśe sādhye agnimattā pradeśasya svabhāva eva sādhyo dhūmavattvād iti ca hetuḥ | pradeśābhinna iti sarvo hetuḥ svabhāvahetur eveti (|) tadayuktam (|) evaṃ hi gamakattve gardabhatvāder api gamakatvaṃ syāt (|) na bhavaty agnikāryatvābhāvād gardabhasyeti cet | yady evaṃ dhūmasyāgnikāryatvam eva gamakatve nibandhanam iti kathaṃ na kāryahetuḥ |
anyas tu manyate – anupalambhas tu pradeśakārya ity asadvyavahāre sādhye kāryahetur eva | kṛtakavikalpaś cānityaśabdakārya iti sarva eva hetuḥ kāryahetur iti.
tad apy ayuktam, kṛtakavikalpo hi kṛtakakāraṇatvāt tasyaivānumāpakaḥ syān nānityasya | kṛtakasyānityasvabhāvatvād anityatvaṃ sādhayatīti cet | yady evaṃ kṛtakatvād evānityatvapratītiḥ syān na kṛtakavikalpāt | kṛtakasvabhāvatayaivānityatve gamakatvāt | yad vā kṛtakavikalpaś ca syān na vānitya ity anaikānataḥ | kṛtakavikalpajananasāmarthyaṃ kṛtakāvyatiriktan tac ca na pūrvan na paścāt tenāsāv anityo 'vyatiriktan tarhi sāmarthyam anityatvaṃ sādhayatīti kathaṃ na svabhāvo hetur iti yat kiñcid etat |
 kiṃ punar dvāv eva vastusādhanāv ity āha – svabhāvena pratibandhaḥ "sādhanaṃ kṛte"ti samāsaḥ | svabhāvena pratibaddhatvaṃ | pratibaddhasvabhāvam iti yāvat | tasmin saty artho liṅgam artham iti liṅginaṃ na vyabhicarati |
 sa ca svabhāvapratibandhaḥ kuta ity āha – tadātmatvād iti sādhyasvabhāvatvāt | tadātmatve sādhyasvabhāvātmatve sādhanasya | yad eva sādhyan tad eva sādha(nam iti sādhyasādhanayo)r bhedābhāvas tena pratijñārthaikadeśo hetur iti paramāśaṅkyāha – netyādi | sādhyasādhanabhūtānāṃ dharmabhedānāṃ vyāvṛttibhedena parikalpanād āropād (|)
 etad uktam bhavati | dharmabhedaḥ samāropyate tena sādhyasādhanabhedaḥ | yato niścito gamako niścetavyaś ca gamya ucyate | niścayaviṣayaś cāropita eveti niścayabhedāropito dharma(bhedaḥ | etac ca vakṣyāmo 'nyāpohapra)stāve | 2*
fn. 2*: Pramāṇavārtika 3:163-73.
[p.24] ācāryadignāgenāpy etad uktam ity āha – tathā cetyādi | sarva eveti yatrāpi sādhyasādhanayor agnidhūmayorvāstavo bhedastatrāpi svalakṣaṇena vyavahārāyogād anumīyate (')nenety anumānaliṅgam anumeyaḥ sādhyadharmī sādhyadharmaś ca teṣāṃ vyavahāro nānātvapratirūpaḥ | buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmiṇo(rbhedastena buddhipratibhāsagatena)3* bhinnena rūpeṇa bhedavyavahāra iti yāvat | yadi tarhi buddhiparikalpito dharmadharmivyavahāra evantarhi kalpitād dhetoḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ prāptā | tataś ca hetudoṣo yāvān ucyate sa sarvaḥ syāt | tadāha bhaṭṭaḥ ||2*
fn. 2*: Ślokavārtika, Nirālamba 171-72. 3*: In the margin.
  "yadi vā vidyamānopi bhedo buddhiprakalpitaḥ (|)
  sādhyasādhanadharmāder vyavahārāya kalpyate ||
  tato bhavat prayukte (')smin sādhanaṃ yā(vad ucyate |
  sarvatrotpadyate buddhir iti)3* dūṣaṇatā bhaved" iti |
 atrāha – bheda ityādi | etadāhārtha eva vārthaṃ gamayati kevalaṃ dharmadharmitayā 'yaṃ dharmo 'yaṃ dharmīti yo bhedo nānātvamayam eva buddhyākārakṛto buddhyā parikalpito nārthopi na liṅgam api buddhyākārakṛtam (|) vikalpanirmitād eva liṅgāt kasmād arthapratipattir na bhavatīty āha – vikalpetyādi | vikalpabhedānāṃ vikalpaviśe(ṣāṇām icchāmātrānurodhitvena svata)3*ntrāṇām anarthāśrayād arthāpratibaddhatve (sākṣād anutpatte)3*r nārthālambanatvād ity arthaḥ | tair arthī nāśrayair vikalpaḥ kalpitaś cāsau viṣayaś ceti tatkalpitaviṣayas tasmād evaṃbhūtād dhetor arthapratītāv abhyupagamyamānāyām anarthapratilambha eva syād arthapratilambha eva na syāt |
fn. 3*: In the margin.
 dvitīyaṃ pratibandhalakṣaṇam āha – kāryasyāpītyādi | tatsvabhāvasyeti kāryasvabhāvasya tadutpatteḥ kā(raṇād utpatter yo 'numā)nasya prāmāṇyaṃ necchati taṃ praty āha – etāv anumeyapratyayau pramāṇam iti sambandhaḥ | etāv iti svabhāvakāryaliṅgau | anupalabdheḥ svabhāvahetāv antarbhāvād dvāv ity āha – yad vā prakrāntāpekṣayā dvāv ity āha – [p.25] svabhāvakāraṇayor anumeyayoḥ pratyayāv ity anumeyapratyayau atatpratibhāsitve (')pīty anumeyasvalakṣaṇāpratibhāsitve (')pi | atatpratibhāsitvan tataḥ sākṣād anutpatteḥ | kathan tarhy avyabhicāra ity āha – taduptatter ity anumeyābhyāṃ svabhāvakāraṇābhyāṃ pāramparyeṇotpatteḥ | tadavyabhicāriṇāv ity anumeyāvyabhicāriṇau | iti hetoḥ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣavat |
 tena yad ucyate 'viddhakarṇena – anadhigatārthaparicchittiḥ pramāṇam. ato nānumānam pramāṇam, arthaparicchedakatvābhāvād iti tadapāstaṃ | yataḥ sarva eva prekṣāvān pravṛttikāmaḥ pramāṇam anveṣate pravṛttiviṣayārthopadarśakatvena pravṛttiviṣayaś cārtho 'rthakriyāsamartha eva | na cānāgataṃ pravṛttisādhyārthakriyā sāmarthyam vastunaḥ pratyakṣam paricchinattīty uktamataḥ katham asyārthaparicchedamātrātprāmāṇyaṃ | tasmāt svaviṣaye tadutpattyā pratyakṣaṃ yanmayā pūrvapratipannaṃ prabandhenārthakriyākāri tad evedam iti niścayaṃ kurvat pravarttakatvāt pramāṇantathānumānam api |
 pratyakṣasyāpītyādinā vyāptim āha – arthāvyabhicāra eveti | pūrvam abhimatārthakāritvena niścitasyārthasya sambhave sati bhāva eva pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyam anyathā tadabhāve arthābhāve bhāvinaḥ pratyakṣasya tadvipralambhān niścitārthāsamvādāt | etad uktam bhavati | yadārthakriyāsamartham vastu pratyakṣaṃ na paricchinatti | yadi ca tathābhūtam api vastu vyabhicaret pramāṇam api na syāt | avyabhicāraś cānyasya ko (')nyas tadutpatter ity anyasyārthāntarabhūtasya yo (')nyena sahāvyabhicāraḥ sa tadutpatteḥ ko (')nyo naivānyaḥ | tadutpattir evāvyabhicāra ity arthaḥ |
 kasmād (|) anāyattarūpāṇām apratibaddhasvabhāvānāṃ sahabhāvaniyamābhāvād avyabhicāraniyamābhāvāt | tasmād arthakriyākāritvena niścitād arthād utpatter eva pratyakṣasyāvyabhicāra iti prāmāṇyan tac cānumāne (')py astīti samaṃ dvayam iti bhāvaḥ |
 etenaitad (')pi nirasta – pramāṇasyāgauṇatvād anumānād arthaniścayo durlabha iti. yady agauṇatvam anupacaritatvam ucyate, tadānumānam apy anupacaritam evāskhaladbuddhirūpatvāt.
 atha dharmadharmisamudāyasya sādhyatve hetoḥ pakṣadharmatvamanvayo vā na sambhavati tena pakṣadharmatvaprasiddhyarthaṃ dharmiṇaḥ sādhyatvam upacaritavyamanvayasiddhyarthañ ca dharmasyetyevam upacaritaviṣayatvād anumānam upacaritaṃ |
[p.26] tad ayuktaṃ yato loke dhūmamātram agnimātravyāptaṃ yatra dharmiṇi dṛśyate tatraivāgnipratītir bhavatīti kasyātropacāra evaṃ ca samudāyasyāpi sādhaytvaṃ sidhyati | yad āha – "kevala eva dharmo dharmiṇi sādhyastatheṣṭasamudāyasya siddhiḥ kṛtā bhavatī"ti (|) na cānumānaviṣaye sādhyaśabdopacāre saty anumānam upacaritan nāma |
 atha pramāṇasyāgauṇatvād abhrāntatvād anumānasya tu bhrāntatvād aprāmāṇyam ity ucyate |
 tad ayuktaṃ (|) bhrāntasyāpy agnyanumānasya tadutpattyā bāhyāgnyadhyavasāyena loke prāmāṇyadarśanāt pratyakṣavat | atha pratyakṣam api pramāṇan neṣyate tadā lokapratītibādhā | pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pramāṇayor lokapratītatvāt |
 atha naiva pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pramāṇatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate | kin tu liṅgantrilakṣaṇaṃ caturlakṣaṇaṃ vā na kenacit pramāṇena siddham iti paryanuyoge yady anumānam ucyate sādhakaṃ | punastatrāpi sa eva paryanuyoga ity evaṃ sarvatra paryanuyogaparāṇy eva sūtrāṇi | tathā ca sūtraṃ (|)
  "viśeṣenugamābhāvaḥ sāmānye siddhasādhanam" iti1* (|)
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | pūrvam eva trairūpyagrāhakasya pramāṇasya vyāptivacanenākṣiptatvāt | (na cāpramāṇakena paraḥ)2* paryanuyujyate vādiprativādinor asiddhatvāt |
fn. 1*: Pramāna-Samuccaya.  2*: In the margin.
 atha vacanātmakam anumānaṃ na vaktuḥ pramāṇam atha (va)canena paraṃ pratipādayati tathā 'pramāṇakena paryanuyogaḥ kriyata iti |
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | dvayor api hi vacanād arthapratītiḥ pramāṇabhūtaivotpadyate 'rthaparicchedakatvāt kevalam vaktur adhigamasya niṣpannatvāt pramāṇaṃ no vā tena punar apramā(ṇaṃ bhavaty aprāmāṇye vā dvayor apy apramā)ṇam iti kathan tato (')rthapratītiḥ |
 yad apy ucyate (|) "parasiddhenānumānenānumānan niṣidhyata" iti tad apy etena nirastam iti | saṃyogavaśād gamakatve |
  "na ca kenacid aṅgena na saṃyogī hutāśanaḥ |
  dhūmo vā sarvathā tena prāptaṃ dhūmāt prakāśanam" iti |
 yaḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaprasaṅga ācārya dignāgenākṣiptaṃ paraṃ prati tad ihāpi kārya(hetau āśaṅkate yadītyādinā)2* sādhyād utpatteḥ kāraṇāt kāryaṅ gamakaṅ kāraṇasyety [p.27] adhyāhāraḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ prāptaḥ | agneḥ sāmānyadharmavad viśeṣadharmā api tārṇapārṇṇādayo gamyāḥ syuḥ | dhūmasyāpi viśeṣadharmavad dravyatvapārthivatvādayopi sāmānyadharmā gamakā bhaveyuḥ | kutaḥ | sarvathā janyajanakabhāvāt (|) tathā hi yathāgnir agnitvadravyatvasattvādibhiḥ (sāmānyadharmmair janakaḥ tathā tārṇṇapārṇṇādibhi)1*r viśeṣair api | yathā ca dhūmo dhūmatvapāṇḍutvādibhiḥ svaniyatair viśeṣadharmair yukto janyas tathā sāmānyadharmair api sattvadravyatvādibhis tataś ca yathānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvas tathaiva gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syād ity ata āha –
 netyādi | na sarvathā janyajanakabhāvas tataś ca kutas tathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syāt | kasmād iti cet | tadabhāve teṣān tārṇṇa(pārṇṇatvādīnāṃ viśeṣadharmmāṇām abhāve)1* bhavato dhūmamātrasya tebhya eva viśeṣadharmebhyo bhavatīty evamātmanas tadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt | tathā tadabhāve 'gnyabhāve bhavato dravyatvādeḥ sāmānyadharmasyāgner evāyaṃ bhavatīty evaṃrūpasya tadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt | kutaḥ sarvathā janyajanakabhāvo yataḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syāt ||
 yata evaṃ tasmāt kāryaṃ dhūmādikaṃ svabhāvair yā(vadbhir dhūmatvādibhiḥ svagatai)1*r itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā | avinābhāvi | vinā na bhavati | kvāvinābhāvi (|) kāraṇe | kāraṇaviṣaye | yad vā kāraṇe ity ādhārasaptamī | kāraṇasthaiḥ svabhāvair yāvadbhir agnitvadravyatvādibhir avinābhāvi | teṣāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ hetuḥ kāryaṃ gamakam ity arthaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tatkāryatvaniyamāt | teṣām eva kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇān tatkāryam ity e(vaṃrūpasya niya)1*masya sadbhāvāt | na hi tatsāmānyadharmāt kadācid api kāryaṃ vyabhicarati | evaṃ tāvat kāraṇagatāḥ sāmānyadhrmā gamyā ity ākhyātaṃ |

 kāryagatās tu viśeṣadharmā gamakā iti darśayann āha – tair evetyādi | kāryam api tair eva dharmaiḥ svagataiḥ kāraṇagatānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ gamakāḥ | ye (')rthāntarāsambhavino dhūmatvapāṇḍutvādayo [p.28] viśeṣarūpās taiḥ kāraṇagataiḥ sāmānyadharmair vinā na bhavanti | atrāpi tatkāryatvaniyamād ity apekṣyate | teṣām eva kāryagatānāṃ viśeṣadharmāṇāṃ kāraṇagatasāmānyadharmāpekṣayā kāryatvaniyamāt |
 yadi sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ kāryagatair viśeṣadharmair evāvinābhāvād gamyagamakabhāvas tadāṃśena janyajanakabhāvaḥ syāt | agneḥ sāmānyadharmā eva janakāḥ (|) dhūmasya ca viśeṣadharmā eva janyāḥ syuḥ | sarvathā ca janyajanakabhāvobhimata ity abhyupagamavirodhaḥ | etat pariharati (|) nāṃśena janyajanakabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | niraṃśatvena vastunaḥ sarvathā janyajanakatvābhyupagamāt | gamyagamakabhāvasyāpi sarvathābhimatatvāt | tad āha – tajjanyetyādi | yadi hi kāryasya taiḥ kāraṇagatair viśeṣadharmair janyo yo viśeṣaḥ sa grahītuṃ śakyate jñāpakahetvadhikārāt | tadā tajjanyaviśeṣagrahaṇe 'bhimatatvāt kāraṇagataviśeṣadharmāṇāṃ gamyatvasya | tathā hy agurudhūmagrahaṇe bhavaty eva tadagner anumānaṃ | tathā liṅgaviśeṣo liṅgam eva viśeṣo dhūmalakṣaṇaḥ sa upādhir viśeṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ dravyatvādīnān teṣāṃ grahaṇe 'bhimatatvād gamakatvasya | na hi dhūmena viśeṣitā dravyatvādayo 'gniṃ vyabhicaranti |
 nanu dhūma eva tatra gamako na tu tadviśiṣṭā dravyatvādayaḥ | yathā kṛtakatve sati prameyatvād ity atra kṛtakatvam eva gamakaṃ na prameyatvaṃ |
 satyam etad | avyabhicāramātrapradarśanārthan tv evam abhidhānam ity eke | anyas tv āha – na dhūmasya vyabhicārād iha sāmānyopādānam, kiṃ tarhi sarveṣāṃ pratipattṝṇāṃ dṛṣṭe vastuni sāmānyākāre pratipattir bhavati paścād viśeṣāvasāyaḥ. tatra ca yad upāttaṃ sāmānyam, tad aparityaktam eva. tasmāt pratipattur adhyavasāyavaśād viśeṣopahitaṃ sāmānyaṅ gamakam bhavati na viśeṣasya vyabhicārād iti |
 yuktam etat | kevalaṃ yady eṣa niyamaḥ sāmānyapratipattipurassaraiva viśeṣapratipattiḥ (|) kathan tarhi dhūmamātrasya dravyatvādirahitasya pratītiḥ | pūrvoktaṃ ca codyan tadavastham eva | tasmād idam atra sādhu (|) liṅgaviśeṣasya sāmānyaviśeṣaṇatvenaivopādānā(d) ahetutvaṃ hetutvopādāne hi hetutvaṃ syān nānyathā |
 kadā tarhi liṅgagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇām agamakatvam ity āha – aviśiṣṭetyādi | yadā dravyatvādīny aviśiṣṭāni vivakṣitāni tadā teṣāṃ vyabhicārād [p.29] gamakatvan neṣyate |
svabhāvahetum adhikṛtyāha – svabhāva ityādi | hetur iti vartata iti teṣāṃ hetur ity ataḥ | svabhāve sādhye kimbhūte bhāvamātrānurodhini hetusadbhāvamātrānurodhini (bhāvo hetuḥ)1* svabhāvo hetuḥ | mātragrahaṇam arthāntarānapekṣāsandarśanārthaṃ | kasmāt tanmātrānurodhiny eva svabhāvo hetur ity āha – tādātmyaṃ hy arthasya tanmātrānurodhiny eveti | yo (')sāv arthasya sādhanasyātmā tadbhāviny eva | nānyāyatte | na kāraṇāntarapratibaddhe paścādbhāvini tādātmyaṃ | kasmād iti ced āha – tadbhāva ityādi | tasya hetor bhāve abhūtasya [Sāṃkṛtyāyana:bhāvi(ni) bhūtasya] kāra(ṇāntarāyattasya dharmasya paścād yo bhā)1*vas tasya niyamābhāvāt | na hi kāraṇāntarapratibaddhena paścād bhāvināvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) kāraṇānāṃ kāryavyabhicārāt | sambhavatpratibandhatvāt kāraṇānāṃ kutas tebhyo 'vaśyam bhāvaḥ kāryasya ||

 etena kāraṇaviruddhodāharaṇena tatkāryād apīti viruddhasy yatkāryan tasmād api | [p.42] tadviruddhakāryābhāvagatir ukteti | yasya viruddhasya kāryam upalabhyate tena viruddho yo dvitīyaḥ pratiyogī sa tadviruddhas tasya yat kāryan tasyābhāvagatir uktā | yathety udāharaṇaṃ | romaharṣādiviśeṣo yaḥ śītakṛtas tena yukto yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa yasmin pradeśe vidyate sa tathā | pradeśopādānaṃ dhūmād ity asya pakṣadharmatvapratipādanārthaṃ | puruṣe hi dharmiṇi na pakṣadharmo hetuḥ syād dhūmasya pradeśadharmatvāt | ayaṃ ca prayogaḥ (|) yatra vahniḥ śītasparśo romaharṣādiviśeṣaś ca parokṣas tatrābhāvasādhane draṣṭavyaḥ | tatra hi śītaviruddhāgnikāryasya dhūmasyoplabdhyā agniviruddhaśītakāryasya romaharṣāder abhāvaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭas tena tathābhūta eva sādhyaḥ | dhūmo hi dahanaṃ sannidhāpayati sa śītan nivartayati (|) sa nivartamānaḥ svakāryaṃ romaharṣādikan nivartayatīty arthāt kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhir iyaṃ |
 iyan tadviruddhopalabdhir (1.32) iti sambandhaḥ | kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhir ity arthaḥ | hetv asiddhyaiva kāraṇānupalabdhyaiva prāg eva nirdiṣṭā | yasmād anayor api prayogayoḥ kāraṇānupalabdher eva kāryābhāvagatis tasmād iyaṃ kāraṇānupalabdhyaivoktā |
 itīyam ityādi | maulena prabhedena caturvidhāpi satī avāntaraprayogabhedād aṣṭavidhā bhavati | tathā hi svabhāvaviruddhopalabdher vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ prabheda uktaḥ | svabhāvānupalabdher vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | kāraṇānupalabdheḥ kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhiḥ kāraṇaviruddhakāryopalabdhiś ca | viruddhakāryopalabdhis tv ekaprakārety aṣṭavidhā bhavati ||
 nanu ciravinaṣṭe [']py agnau vāsagṛhādau dhūmasya sadbhāvāt katham viruddhakāryopalabdher na vyabhicāra ity ata āha –
 tatretyādi | tatra viruddhakārye [']pīṣṭaṃ deśakālādyapekṣaṇaṃ | nātra śītaḥ kasmiṃś cit kāle yadāgnir vartamānībhūta iti kālāpekṣaṇaṃ vyomni dhūmāt kutra cid deśe nāsti śīto yatra sannihito vahnir yato [']yaṃ dhūma utthita iti deśāpekṣaṇaṃ | ādiśabdād avasthāviśeṣāpekṣaṇaṃ (|) yo [']vasthāviśeṣo dhūmasya sannihitāgner dṛṣṭas tam apekṣya varttamāne [']pi kāle śītābhāvo [']numīyate | agnir atra dhūmād iti kāryahetāv api deśakālādyapekṣaṇam iṣṭaṃ | asyaivārthasya samuccayārtho 'piśabdaḥ |
 nanu deśakālādyapekṣitvasya kāryahetuviśeṣaṇatve 'siddho hetuḥ syād dharmiṇo 'bhāvād iti cet (|) na | pradeśa eva dharmiṇi deśakālādyapekṣitvena gamakatvād ity uktatvāt |
[p.43] anyatheti yadi na deśādyapekṣaṇan tadā vyabhicāri viruddhakāryaṃ syāt | yathā bhasmān apekṣitadeśakālaṃ aśītasādhane śītābhāve sādhye vyabhicāri | tadvat evaṃ tāvad viruddhādyupalabdhir anupalabdhir iti pratipāditaṃ |
 yas tarhītyādi paraḥ | samaguṇeti sannihitānupahitena yathā kṣitivījodakādikāraṇakalāpaṃ dṛṣṭvāṃkuraḥ kāryo [']numīyate | sa kathaṃ kāraṇākhyo hetus trividhe svabhāvakāryānupalambhākhye hetāv antarbhavati | na tāvad anupalabdhau vidhisādhanatvāt | kāraṇasvabhāvatvān na kāryahetau | arthāntareṇārthāntarasyānumānān na svabhāvahetau ||
 antarbhāvam āha –
 hetunetyādi | samagreṇeti yāvataḥ kāraṇakalāpāt kāryam utpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭan tāvatā nāntyāvasthāprāptena tatra liṅgigrahaṇāt prāg eva kāryasya pratyakṣatvāt | apratyakṣatve vāntyāvasthāniścayāyogād anumānaṃ | na ca yas tān niścetuṃ śakṣyati tasyānumānam antyakṣaṇānām arvāg darśanenāniścayāt | yaḥ kāryotpādo [']numīyate sa hetoḥ svabhāvo varṇitaḥ | kuto [']rthāntarānapekṣatvāt | tenāyam arthaḥ kāryotpādanayogyatāmātrānubandhitvāt svabhāvabhūtā ||
 nanu yadāntyāvasthāpekṣaḥ kāryotpādas tadā katham anyānapekṣa ity āha – asāv apīti kāryotpādaḥ | yathāsannihito yādṛśaḥ sannihitaḥ | kāraṇakalāpaḥ | tādṛśāt sannihitān nānyam artham apekṣata iti tādṛgmātrānubandhī svabhāvaḥ | (kasya bhāvaḥ) | samagrasya kāraṇakalāpasya (|) santānāpekṣayaitad ucayte na kṣaṇāpekṣayā | janakaḥ kāraṇakalāpasantāno [']napekṣa ity arthaḥ |
 yady apy anapekṣaḥ kāryotpādas tathāpy arthāntaratvāt kathaṃ svabhāva ity āha – tatretyādi | yasmāt tatra samagreṣu kāraṇeṣu samagrāt kāraṇāl liṅgāt kāryotpatti(sambhava)s tathānumīyate | sambhavaty asmād iti sambhavaḥ | kāryotpādanayogyatānumīyata ity arthaḥ | etad eva vyanakti | samagrāṇāṃ kāryotpādanayogyatānumānād iti | yogyatā ca [p.44] sāmagrīmātrānubandhinī kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvāt |
 yadi tarhi kāryotpādanaśaktis tanmātrānubandhinī niyatas tarhi kāryotpāda iti sa eva kasmān nānumīyata iti paraḥ pṛcchati | kiṃ punaḥ sāmagryāḥ sakāśāt kāryam evānumīyata ity atrāha – sāmagrītyādi | sāmagryāḥ phalaṇ ca tāḥ śaktayaś ceti sāmagrīphalaśaktayaḥ | tathā hi pūrvasmāt samagrād uttarasya samarthasya kṣaṇasyotpattis tasay cātmātiśayaḥ śaktir iti sāmagrī phalaṃ śaktis tāsāṃ pariṇāmaḥ | uttarottaraprabandhenotpattis tadanubandhini tadapekṣiṇi kārye | kāraṇenānumātavye 'naikāntikatā | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratibanadha(sya)[pratibandha(sya)?] sambhavāt |
 tad vyācaṣṭe – na hītyādi. samagrāṇīty eva sannihitānīty eva kāraṇadravyāṇi svakāryaṃ janayanti | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ | sāmagrītyādi | sāmagryāḥ sakāśāj janma yāsāṃ śaktīnān tāsām uttarottarapariṇāmaḥ | pūrvvapūrvvakṣaṇād uttarottaraviśiṣṭakṣaṇotpādo yas tadapekṣatvāt kāryotpādasya | atrāntare ceti santānapariṇāmakāle | pratibandhasambhavāt |
 nanu yogyatāpy uttarottarakṣaṇaparināmapratibaddhā tatrāpi ca pratibandhasambhavāt kathan tadanumānam apīty āha – yogyatāyās tv ityādi | dravyāntarānapekṣatvāt sannihitakāraṇakalāpavyatirekeṇa kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvān na virudhyate 'numānaṃ |
 tad evānumānam āha – uttarottaretyādi pūrvapūrvakṣaṇam upādāyottarasamarthakṣaṇotpāda uttarottaraśaktipariṇāmaḥ | tena hetubhūtena kāryotpādanasamartheti sādhyanirdeśaḥ | iyaṃ kāraṇasāmagrīti dharmī | śaktipariṇāmapratyayasyānyasyāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāvād iti hetuḥ śakteḥ pariṇāmasya yo 'paraḥ sahakāripratyayas tasyāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt |
[p.45]  kutas tarhi śakteḥ prasava ity āha – pūrvetyādi | pūrvasajātiḥ sadṛśaḥ pūrvaḥ kāraṇakalāpas tāvan mātraṃ hetur yasyāḥ śaktiprasūteḥ sā tathā | tadbhāvas tasmāt | ataḥ kāraṇāt sā yogyatān anyāpekṣiṇīty ucyate ||
 nanu kāryaṃ prati kāraṇasya yogyatā yadi śaktir ucyate tadā kāryavyabhicāre yogyatāyā api vyabhicāra iti katham etad anumānaṃ | atha yogyatāsambhava ucyate tadāyam arthaḥ syāt kāryaṃ syād vā na veti | tathāpi katham asyānumānaṃ sandehād iti |
 atrocyate | pareṇa hi katham etad anumānan trividhahetujanyam iti codyate | yady etad anumānam pareṇa samarthyate tadā trividhaliṅgajam evety ācāryeṇa pratipādyate | na tv etat paramārthatānumānam ity evam param etad ity eke | atha vā yady ekāntena kāryotpādanayogyatānumīyate | tadā vyabhicārād anumānaṃ na syāt | yadā tu kadācit kāryaṃ syād ity evaṃrūpaḥ sambhavo [']numīyate tadā katham asya vyabhicāraḥ | tenāyam artha uttarottarapariṇāme yadi prabandhābhāvas tadā kāryaṃ syād anyadā tu nāstīti | parokte tv ekāntenakāryānumāne vyabhicāra eva |
 anye tu pariṇāmavat yāṃ sāmagryāṃ pratibandhakābhāve saty ekāntena kāryotpādanayogyatā bhavatīti saivānumīyate | kāryotpādanayogyatāpratītiś ca kāryam api viśeṣaṇatvenākṣipatīti na pṛthak kāryānumānaṃ kriyata iti manyante | kevalaṃ sāmagrīmātrāt kāryānumāne vyabhicāra ucyate pratibandhakābhāvaḥ katham pratipanna iti cet (|) satyaṃ | yo hi taṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasyaitad anumānaṃ yo hi dhūmasyāgnijanyatvaṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasya dhūmād agnyanumānaṃ nānyasya tadvat |
 yā tarhītyādinā punar api tridhaiva sa ity asya vyāghātam āha – akāryakāraṇabhūtena | anumeyād arthād anyenāsvabhāvena rasādinā | ādiśabdād gandhādinā rūpādigatiḥ | atrāpy ādiśabdāt sparśādigrahaṇaṃ | andhakāre hi mātuluṅgādirasam āsvādya | campakagandham āghrāya | vahneś ca sparśam anubhūya | teṣāṃ rūpasāmānyam anumīyate tathā vahnirūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsparśaḥ | sā kathan trividhe hetāv antarbhavatīti prakṛte |
[p.46]  na cāpramāṇam iyan tato liṅgāntaraprasaṅga ity āha – sāpītyādi sāpi gatir iti saṃbandhaḥ | rūpādeḥ kim iva śiṣṭasyaiksāmagryadhīnasya | rasasya janikā yā sāgagrī tasyām eva sāgagryāmāyattasya rasato liṅgādyā gatiḥ (|) sā hedharmānumānena | rasasya yo hetuḥ pūrvam apādānantasya yo dharmo rūpajanakatvantarsyānumānena | tenāyam artho rasāt sakaśāt taddhetor asasamānakālabhāvi rūpajanakatvan niścīyate | evaṃ hi tasya rasasamānakālabhāvi rūpajanakatvaṃ niścīyate | yadi samānakālabhāvino rūpasyāpi niśayaḥ syāt tenātītaikakālānām ekaiva gatiḥ kāryaliṅgajā |
 nanv anabhihitād rasahetoḥ sakāśāt paścātsamānakālasya rūpasyānumānaṃ hetoḥ kāryānumāne vyabhicārāt | kāryotpādanayogyatānumāne ca na rasasamānakālasya rūpasyānumānaṃ syāt | anumitānumānaprtīter abhāvāc ca | tena yad ucyate (|) yadtītānāṃ gatis tadā kāryaś ca talliṅgaś a (|) tasmāj jāteti kāryliṅgajā (|) yadā tu samānakālānāṅgatis tadā kāryaṃ liṅgaṃ yasy hetudharmānumānasya tatkāryaliṅgant tasmāj jātā kāryaliṅgajeti tadapāstaṃ | [tatra pare mā...] cāvayavidradvye rūpādayo guṇā vyavasthiāstena tatra rūpāder asato gatir yuktā | na bauddhānāṃ rūpādivyatirekeṇāvayavino 'nabhupagamāt na dharmiṇo 'bhāvāt | dharmiṇam antareṇa cānumāne rasato rūpādeḥ sarvatrānumānaprasaṅgāt | asamudāyaś c sādhyaḥ syāt | avpakṣadharmaś ca hetuḥ syāt | nāpi hetudharmānumānaṃ yujyate rūpādikāryatvena rsādr apratipannatvāt | na c kṣaṇikapakṣamaniścityaivam ucyate | kṣaṇikatve hi rūpādeḥ samānajātīyakāryatvaṃ syān na rasadikāryatvaṃ pratibandhagrāhakābhāvāt | na kṣaṇānām anumānānumeyavavahāraḥ sambandhāniścayāt | santānāśrayeṇa tv anumānādivyavahāre rūpādisantānānāṃ na parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pratipanna iti katham anumānānumeyavyavahāra iti |
 evam manyate (|) na sarvatrasāde rūpādyanumānam api tvāmrādau dharmiṇi | tatra ca rūpādīnāṃ parasparāvinirbhāgarbhāga (?) niyamaḥ pratīyata eva (|) sa ca pratibandhahetuko 'nyathā ghaṭapaṭādīnām api parasparāvinirbhāganiyamaḥ syāt | pratibandhaś ca teṣāṃ na tādātmyaṃ bhedena pratīter (|) nāpi tadutpattiḥ samānakālatvāt | na caikārthasamavāyasteṣāṃ yato na tāvadasamavetānāṃ samavāyabalādekārthasamavāyaḥ samavāyasthaivābhāvāt | atiprasaṅgāc ca samavetānām api kiṃ samavāyena svahetubhya eva tathā niṣpatteḥ | tathā niṣpattyaiva vācyābhidhānād gamakatvam (|) tasmād ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ pratibndhaḥ | niścitapratibandhasya cānyasmin kālenumānaṃ | yady api cātrāvayavī na vidyate tathāpy āmrādipratyayaviṣayasya dharmitvantena tatra rasato rūpādigatiḥ |
 nanu tathāpi katham eṣām ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ | yato yai(?yenai)va svabhāvena rūpaṃ (p.47) rūpaṃ janayati na tenaiva rasādikaṃ janayati teṣām parasparābhedaprasaṅgāt | nāpyanyenānyaṃ janayati tasya svabhāvabhedaprasaṅgāt |
 naiṣa doṣo yasmāt | na tratra rūpasya pūrvvvam ekakāryajanakatvaṃ yenāyan doṣaḥ syāt | kin tv ekakālam anekakāryajanakatvam eva | tatas tasyaivotpattidarśanāt | na ca kāraṇasya kāryābhāva ev kāraṇavaṃ yenānekam ekas mādutpadyamānam ekaṃ prasajyeta kin tu kāryotpattau prāgbhāva eva tasya kāraṇatvaṃ loke | yathā caikakāryotpattau tasya prāgbhāvakāraṇatvan tathā kalāpotpattāv api dṛṣṭatvāt | yad vā yenaiv vabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpaṃ janayati tenaiva rasādikam api svarūpabheds tv eṣām upānabhedakṛto na sahakārikṛtaḥ | tathā hi vāyau sparśasadbhāvepi rūpādyabhāvād rūpādyanutpattiḥ | agnau ca rūpādisadbhāvepi rasābhāvād rasābhāvād rasānutpattiḥ | apsu rasādibhāvepi gandhābhāvād gandhānutpattis tena rasāder niyataṃ kāraṇaṃ rasādir evāvsīyate | niyataṃ ca kāraṇam upādānakāraṇaṃ samānajātīyam abhinnasantānavartti vā | asmād upādānakāraṇabhedād rūpād īnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ |
 yat punar ucyate | tatrānekaśaktīnāṃ samucayaḥ | tena rūpam ekayā śaktyā rūpaṃ janayatyanyānyayā rasādikam iti |
 tad ayuktam (|) anekaśaktidvāreṇāpy ekasyānekakāryakāraṇābhupagme 'nekatvaprasaṅgo 'nivārita eva bhāvas yānekaśaktīnām evānekasvabhāvatvāt | abhinnatvāc ca śaktīnāṃ śaktibhede rūpasya bhedprsaṅgaḥ | bhede vā śaktīnāṃ rūpasyākārakatvaprasaṅāt | na ca śaktiyogāt kārakatvam aśaktasya śaktiyogābhāvāt | śaktasyāpi kiṃ śaktiyogena svarūpeṇaiva kārkatvāc chakteś ca kraktvaṃ na syāc chaktiyogābhāvāt | atha śaktitvān na sā śaktim apekṣate (|) bhāvo 'pi tarhi śakta(i)tvāt kim iti śaktim apekṣate |
 yo 'pi mīmāṃsako manyate | bhāvasya svarūpātiśaya eva śaktiḥ sā ca bhinnābhinnā | yato bhāve gṛhyamāṇe śaktir na gṛhyate :to bhāvād bhinnā | kāryānyathānupapattyā tu sā bhāvayābhinnā 'nyathā bhāvasya kārakatvan na syāt | tad uktaṃ (|)
 "śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ kāryārthapattikalpitā" iti (|)
 so 'pi nirastaḥ | ekasyāḥ śakter bhinnābhinnarūpatvavirodhāt | kiṃ cārthāpattyā kāryāt prāgbhāvina eva bhāvasyābhinnā śśaktiḥ kalpyatāṃ iti prāgbhāva eva śaktitaḥ (|) sa ca pratyakṣasiddha iti kathaṃ na śaktitḥ pratyakṣā | kevalaṃ sā kāryadarśanān niścīyate | tasmāt kāryād rasādeḥ kāraṇadharmānumānād asya kāryahetāv antarbhāvaḥ | dhūmes dhanavikāravad iti | yathā dhūmād agnyādisāmagryanumitau bhasmāṅgārādīndhanavikārānumitiḥ (p.48) tadvat ||
 nanu ca rsakāryeṇānumitāt kāraṇāt sakāśāt samānakālinaḥ kāryasyānumānam idaṃ na tu hetudharmānumānam ity ata āha – tatreti (|) rasād rūpe pratipattau hetur eva tathābhūta iti rūpajananasambandhonumīyate (|) yasminn anumīyamāne kāryāntaram api tadviśeṣaṇan niścitam bhavati | na tv anumitāt kāraṇāt paścāt kāryāntaram anumeyaṃ | kuta ity āha – hi yasmāt | pravṛttā na pratibaddhā śaktir yasya tat pravṛttaśakti | tathābhūtaṃ ca tadrūpopādānakāraṇaṃ ceti tathouktaṃ | tasya sahakāripratyayaḥ san | rasahetū rasaṃ janayati | tathābhūte ca hetāv anumite 'rthād rūpānumānaṃ rūparasayor ekasāmagryadhīnatvāt | indhanavikāraviśeṣo bhasmāṅgārādiḥ | tasyopādānaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ tasya sahakāripratyayogniḥ | tasya yathā dhūmajananan tena tulyan tadvad rūparasayor ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ |

 syān mataṃ (|) vītarāgābhimatānāṃ maitrīkaruṇādaya iṣyante | te ca satvālambanatvād ātmādidarśanapravṛttāḥ sattvānunayapravṛttyā cābhiṣvaṅgasvabhāvās tato vītarāgā api rāgiṇaḥ rprasaktā ity ata āha – naivaṃ karuṇādaya iti (|) na sattvālambanā vītarāgāṇāṃ karuṇādayaḥ | anyathāpi sambhavāt | (dharmālambanānām api sambhavāt)1* etac cānantaram eva nivedayiṣyāmaḥ | atra vacanād rāgānumāne kriyamāṇe vacanamātrādapratipattir ity anena sambandhaḥ | yasmād yathā rakto bravīti tathā viraktopīti prakṣīṇarāgopi | na vacanamātrād rāgānumānaṃ kin tarhi vacanaviśeṣāt | yo rāgeṇaiva janyata ity āha – nāpi viśeṣād iti | kiṅkāraṇam (|) abhiprāyasya durbodhatvāt | virakto hi raktavacceṣṭate | raktopi viraktavad ity abhiprāyo durbodhaḥ | tataś ca vyavahārasaṃkareṇa1* sarveṣām iti vacanānāṃ | vacanamātrasya vacanaviśeṣasya ca rāgāder liṅgatvenopanītasya vyabhicārāt | na viśeṣād api rāgādyanumānaṃ | yad uktan tathā virakto bravītīti tatrottaramāśaṃkate | prayojanetyādi | vacanoccāraṇaṃ vyavahāraḥ | na hi vītarāgasya vacanoccāraṇe phalam asti tathā cāvyabhicāro rāgavacanayor iti bhāvaḥ | netyācāryaḥ | na prayojanābhāvaḥ parārthatvād vyāhārasya |

 tasmād ityādi nigamanam. nāntarīyakam eveti kāraṇenāvinābhāvy eva, tatpratibandhāt tatra kāraṇe āyattatvāt. nānyad apratibaddhaṃ vipakṣe hetor adarśane 'pi, arvāgdarśanasyādarśanamātreṇāniścayāt. sarvadarśinas tu darśananivṛttyā syān niścayaḥ. tasya hi sarvajñeyavyāpi jñānam. etad evāha – sarvadarśana ityādi. kim punar adarśanamātrān nābhāvaniścaya ity āha – kvacit tathetyādi. tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānāṃ prāk | punar deśakālasaṃskārabhedeneti bhedaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ. saṃskāraḥ kṣīrāvasekādiḥ. pūrvadṛṣṭaprakārād anyathā syāt. kim ivetyāha – yathāmalakya iti saṃskārabhedasyaitad udāharaṇam. na caivam bahulam iti na madhuraphalā bahulaṃ dṛśyante, kaṣāyaphalānāṃ bāhulyena darśanāt. na cedānīṃ bahulaṃ madhuraphalānām adarśanāt | kvacit sambhavati no madhuraphalasya pratikṣepaḥ. tathā deśabhedena piṇḍakharjjūrasya sambhavaḥ | kālabhedena puṣpādeḥ | āmalakīdṛṣṭāntena caitad āha – yathāmalakyaḥ kṣīrādisaṃskārād anyathā bhavanti, tathā rāgādiyogyaś cittasantānas tattvābhyāsābhisaṃskārād yogyo bhavati. abhyāsāc ca nairātmyālambanam eva vijñānaṃ spaṣṭābham vairārāgyam ucyate. nairātmyadarśanād ātmādyabhiniveśavigamena rāgādyanutpatteḥ. sarvadharmakṣaṇikatvādyālambanaṃ ca jñānaṃ spaṣṭābhaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ cocyate, sarvājñānivigamāt. tasmāt tattvābhyāsanimittā sphuṭābhatvavṛddhir eva tattvasākṣātkaraṇena pratyakṣatvakāriṇī rāgādiyogyasvabhāvatāṃ jñānasya bādhate. tataś cānyathādṛṣṭam api hetubalād anyathā bhaved api. tena yadi nāma rāgārahite kvacid vacanaṃ na dṛṣṭantāvatā sarvatra vītarāge vacanena na bhāvyam iti nāsit niścayaḥ. tataś cāniścitavyatirekād vacanamātrān na rāgadyanumānam, yat evaṃ tena kāraṇenaitad yuktaṃ vaktuṃ mādṛśo vaktā | yo 'ham ivāyoniśomanaskārān. tad evāha – rāgotpattītyādi. kaḥ punar asāv ity āha – ātmetyādi. ātmadarśanaṃ satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ. nityasukhādiviparyāso 'yoniśo manaskāraḥ. dvandvasamāsaś cāyam. ātmadarśanam evāyoniśomanaskāra iti viśeṣaṇasamāso (p.56) vā. tadeti mādṛśo vakteti viśeṣaṇe 'py apārthako vacanodāhāraḥ. vacanād ity asya hetor udāharaṇam anarthakam ity arthaḥ. tadā hi yo mādṛśo rāgotpattipratyayaviśeṣṇa yuktaḥ, sa rāgī. yathāham ity ayam eva hetuḥ syāt, yata evam adarśanamātrān nāsti niścayas. tasmād vipakṣe 'dṛṣṭo 'dṛṣṭavipakṣe hetor adarśanam ahetur liṅgasya vyatirekaniścayaṃ prati ||
on PV(SV) 1.13
syān matiḥ – vipakṣadṛṣṭyā hetor vyabhicāraḥ. na ca vītarāge vacanaṃ dṛṣṭam. tasmād adarśanāt sādhyābhāve vyatirekaḥ siddha ity ata āha – na cādarśanamātreṇeti vipakṣe hetor avyabhicāritā. kasmāt? sambhāvyavyabhicāratvāt sambhāvyovyabhicāratvāt. sambhāvyo vyabhicāro yasya, sa tathā tadbhāvaḥ, tasmāt. yady api na dṛṣṭo vipakṣe, tathāpi tatra sambhavo na viruddha it sambhāvyate vyabhicāraḥ. sthālyantargatās taṇḍulāḥ sthālītaṇḍulāḥ, teṣāṃ pākavat.
etam eva dṛṣṭāntaṃ samarthayitum āha – na hītyādi. bāhulyena sthālyantargatānāṃ pakvānāndarśane 'pi na sthālyantargatatvena kevalena pākaḥ sidhyati. mātragrahaṇan tu viśeṣanirāsārtham, yad vakṣyati – evaṃ tu syād iti. kuto 'siddhiḥ? vyabhicārasya darśanāt. evaṃsvabhāvā iti ye pakvā dṛṣṭāḥ, tais tulyasvabhāvāḥ. etair eva pakvaiḥ samānaḥ pākahetuḥ, yeṣāṃ te pakvā iti. anyathā tv ity asaty tasmin viśeṣaṇe śeṣo 'stīti, śeṣavad anirṇīto viṣayo 'stīti yāvat. tac ca vyabhicāri.
on PV(SV) 1.14
kiṃ naiyāyikoktaṃ kāryāt kāraṇānumānarūpaṃ śeṣavad anumānam ihābhipretam utānyad eveti (p.57) pṛcchati – kiṃ punar ityādi. śeṣavatsvarūpam āha – yasyetyādi. yasya hetor adarśanamātreṇāpramāṇakena vipakṣavyatirekaḥ prasādhyate, tasya hetoḥ saṃśayahetutvāt saṃśayakāritvāc cheṣavat tad anumānam udāhṛtam. kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya hetoḥ sa vyatireko 'niścita iti vipakṣe 'pi vṛttir āśaṅkyeta. kiṃ punar na niścita ity āha – vyatireketyādi. anupalambhe 'pi kathaṃ saṃśaya ity āha – na sarvetyādi. dṛśyānupalabdhir eva na? gamikā. yata evaṃ nādarśanamātrād vyatirekaḥ, tasmād ekanivṛttyā sādhyanivṛttyānyanivṛttiṃ sādhananivṛttim icchatā tayoḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ kaścit svabhāvena pratibandhas tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇo 'py eṣṭavyaḥ, na kevalam adṛṣṭimātram. anyathā pratibandhāniṣṭāv agamako hetuḥ syāt, vyāpter aniścitatvāt.
on PV(SV) 1.15
yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena hetos triṣv api rūpeṣu pakṣadharmānvayavyatirekeṣu niścayo varṇita ācāryadignāgena pramāṃasamuccayādiṣu | asiddhas tu dvayor api sādhanam NOTEREF _Ref40259998 \f \h F ityādinā. kasya nirāsenety āha – asiddhetyādi. ādyāditvāt tṛtīyārthe tasi vipakṣeṇety arthaḥ.
tatrāsiddhavipakṣeṇa pakṣadharmatvaniścayo varṇitaḥ | viparītārthāviruddhas tasya vipakṣeṇānvayaniścayaḥ | vyabhicāryanaikāntikas tasya vipakṣeṇa vyatirekaniścayaḥ ||

prasiddhas tu dvayor NOTEREF _Ref512930551 \f \h G ity ācāryagrantham idānīṃ vyācaṣṭe – dvayor ityādi. dvayor ity anaikasya vādinaḥ prativādino vā yaḥ siddhaḥ, tasya pratiṣedhaḥ. prasiddhavacanena sandigdhayoḥ śeṣavadasādhāraṇayoḥ pratiṣedha iti sambandhaḥ. kva sandigdhayor ity āha – sapakṣavipakṣayor apīti śeṣvato 'sapakṣasandehaḥ. asādhāraṇasya tu sapakṣavipakṣayoḥ. tasmān niścayavacanād ācāryeṇāpi pratibandha iṣṭa eva.
[PVSV 11,5] anyathā 'sati pratibandhe sādhyasādhanayoḥ vipakṣe 'darśanamātreṇa vyatireke ācāryeṇeṣyamāṇe | vyabhicārivipakṣeṇānaikāntikapratipakṣeṇa vaidharmyavacanaṃ ca yat pratijñātantadapārthakam ityākūtaṃ |
 kva punar ācāryeṇa pratijñātam ity āha – yad etyādi | nyāyamukhe caitad uktaṃ | yad ubhayaṃ vaktavyam iti sādharmyaṃ vaidharmyaṃ ca | kasya pratipakṣeṇa kim uktam ity āha – viruddhetyādi | sādhanasya vacanaṃ viruddhapratipakṣeṇa vaikdharmyavacanam anakāntikapratipakṣeṇa | yady adṛṣṭiphalantac ca | adarśanamātraphalan tac ceti vaidharmyavacanaṃ | (p.59) etad eva vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi | teneti vaidharmyavacanena vipakṣe hetor adarśanaṃ khyāpyate | tad ity adarśnam anukte 'pi vaidharmye gamyate | darśnābhāvalakṣaṇasyādarśnasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāg api siddhatvāt | tasmād apārthakamvaidharmyavacanaṃ |
 hetor darśanabhrāntir vipakṣe 'sti tannivṛtyartham vaidharmyavacanam iti ced āha – na hītyādi | tasyeti pratipādyasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāk | htor vipakṣe darśanabhrāntir asti yāvaidharmyavananena vivarttyate | tasmād etad yathā sapakṣe hetor darśane na bhrāntiḥ kin tu tadvismṛtim iti sādharmyavacanena smaryate | tathā smṛtir vācā vaidharmyavananenādarśane kriyata iti cet | dṛṣṭāntam eva vighaṭayium āha – darśanam ityādi | darśanam apratīyamānam asmaryamāṇaṃ na sādhyapratipattyaṅgim iti yuktan tatreti darśane vācā smaraṇādhānaṃ smṛtijananaṃ | adarśanārthan tu na yuktaṃ | yasmād adarśanan tu darśanābhāvo hetor vipakṣe | sa darśanena bādhyate | tadabhāve vipakṣadarśanābhāve sidda eva darśanābhāva ity apārthakantatsiddhye darśanābhāvasiddhaye vaidharmyavacanaṃ | ayam abhiprāyo darśanam parokṣatvād vismaryeteti tatsmaraṇārtham vacanaṃ yuktaṃ | darśanābhāvas tu darśananivṛttirūpaḥ sa ca darśanānubhavābhāvād eva pratibhāsate (|) pratibhāsamānasya ca kiṃ smaraṇena | tatsiddhaye 'pārthakamvacanaṃ ||
 na vai anupalabhamānasya puṃsastāvatety adarśanamātreṇa vipakṣe hetur nāstīty evaṃ niścayo bhavati deśādiviprakṛṣṭānām anupalambhe 'pi sattvāt | tadarthan nāstīti niścayotpādanārtham vaidharmyavacanam iti cet tan na | yasmān na ca nāstīti vacanād apramāṇakāt tatpratikṣipyamāṇaṃ nāsty eva | kathan tarhi nāstīti gamyata ity āha – yathetyādi |
 etad uktam bhavati | hetoḥ svasādhye pratibandhagrāhakam eva pramāṇaṃ sādhyāyattatāgrāhakan tac ceha darśanam abhipretaṃ yac ca sādhya eva hetor darśanam idam eva sarvatra vipakṣe 'darśanaṃ | tena yasy asādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ darśanaṃ pravṛttam iva smṛtaṃ ca tasyaiva puṃsaḥ darśanād adarśanayoḥ pratītayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmyavacanābhyāṃ smaraṇaṃ kriyate nāny asyety arthaḥ | yad āha (|) pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntābhyām upadarśyata iti | yathā yadi nāsti sa khyāpyata (p.60) iti | yathā yena prakāreṇa svasādhyapratibandhena vipakṣe hetur nāsti yadi sa nyāya iti pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ khyāpyate smaryate tadā nāstīti gamyate | na tu pratibandhamantareṇa (|)
 yadītyādi prathamaṃ kārikābhāgam āha – yady anupalabhamāno 'nupalambhamātrān nāstīti na pratyeti tadā vaidharmyavacanād apy apramāṇakān na pratyeṣyati | yasmāt tad api vaidharmyavacanaṃ | tv atā(?) tenānupalambham eva khyāpayati nādhikam iva śeṣaṃ |
 syān mataṃ | sādhyābhāvakṛto hetvabhāvo vaidharmyavacanena khyāpyate tato 'sti viśeṣa ity ata āha – na caiketyādi | ekānuplambha iti sādhyānupalambhaḥ | anyābhāvaṃ sādhanābhāvaṃ | asati pratibandha iti bhāvaḥ | atiprasaṅgād it pratibandham antareṇa nivṛttau gonivṛttyāpy aśvasya niyamena nivṛttiḥ syāt |
