 nanv ityādi paraḥ | tadabhāve sādhyābhāve 'nupalambhāt (a)siddhā vyāvṛttir hetor ayam eva nyāya iti manyate | yady adṛṣṭyā hetor vipakṣān nivṛttiḥ syāt tadā śeṣavad anumānaṃ vyabhicāri kiṃ naiva vyabhicāri syāt (|) kīdṛśaṃ punas tad ity āha – yathetyādi | (p.61) etāni phalānīty upayuktād anyāni | ayaṃ ca dharminirddeḥaḥ pakvānyevaṃ rasāmni ceti sādhyadharmaḥ | evaṃ rasāni madhurāṇyamlāni vā | rūpāviśeṣād iti hetuḥ | upayuktasya phalasya yadrūpaṃ raktatādi | tena tulyatvāt | ekaśākhāprabhavād veti hetuḥ | upayuktavad iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kasmād adarśanamātrād vyatireka iṣyamāṇe śeṣavatovyabhicāritvaṃ syād ity āha – atrāpītyādi | atra śeṣavad anumāne vivakṣitaṃ rūpaviśeṣādiyuktam upabhuktād anyatphalantasyāśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇe | heto rūpādiśeṣādikasya sādhyābhāvenupalaṃbho 'stīti vipakṣāvyāvṛttir ataś cāvyabhicāritā syāt | tathā hi yat pakṣīkṛtaṃ phalaṃ yac copayuktaṃ sapakṣatvenopāttan tad vyatirekeṇa vipakṣabhūte tṛtīye rāśau nāsti yathoktasya hetor vṛttiḥ |
 pratyakṣabādhetyādi | kadācid ekaśākhāprabhavasyāpi phalasyāpakvasyāt adrasasya vā pratyakṣṇānubhavasambhavāt pratyakṣabādhāśaṅkā eva śeṣavato vyabhicra ity eke īśavarasena prabhṛtayaḥ | tad ayam artho na kevalābhyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hetur gamakaḥ (,a)pi tv abādhitaviṣayatve satīti | netyādinā pariharati | pakṣīkṛto yoviṣayaḥ parokṣas tatra pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvāt | na pravṛttena pratyakṣeṇa bādhāśaṅkā kin tu kadācid gandhapratyakṣabādhāpakṣa iti ced āha – tathetyādi tathā kadācit pratyakṣabādhā bhaved ity āśaṅkāyām atiprasaṅgaḥ | yasmād anyatrābhimate hetau pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvaniyamābhāvāt | na hi sambandhābhyupagame parsya bādhāśaṅkā nivartata iti bhāvaḥ | tasmāt pratibandhānabhyupagamavādinā vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ bādhakam eṣṭavyaṃ | avṛttabādhane 'pravṛttenaiva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syād āśvāso gamakatvaniścayaḥ | bādhakasya śaṃkyamānatvāt | naivaṃ pratibandhavādinaḥ sarvatra hetāv anāśvāsaḥ sādhyapratibaddhe hetau bādhāśaṃkāyā apy abhāvāt | hetuprayogāt tu pūrvaṃ syād bādhāśaṃkā (|) ata eva sandigdhe hetuvacanam ucyate (|) naca vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ śeṣavato bādhakam asti | tasmāt sthitam etad adarśanamātrad vyatireke śeṣavato 'py avyavhicāritvaṃ (p.62) syād iti |
 nanu pratibandhabalāt sādhyābhāve hetor vyatireke sati sattāmātreṇa vyatireko gamakaḥ syād ity ata āha – vyatirekas tv ityādi | hetor yo vipakṣād vyatirekaḥ sa siddha eva niścita eva sādhanaṃ | iti hetos tathābhāvaniścayaṃ sādhyābhāve yo hetv abhvas tanniścayam apekṣate | retad āha (|) nāsmākam bhavatām iva darśanābhāvamātrād vyatirekaḥ | kin tu sādhyasādhanayoḥ sati pratibandhe sādhyābhāve hetor vipakṣādvyāvṛttatvaṃ svagato dharmaḥ | hetoś ca yadūpan tad avaśyaṃ svaniścayam apekṣate jñāpakatvād iti | kathaṃ tv anmatena śeṣavato vyabhicāritvam iti ced āha – anupalambhāt tv ityādi | kvacid vipakṣaikadeśo hetor abhāvasiddhāv apy apratibaddhasya hetoḥ sādhye | tadabhāve sādhyābhāve sarvatra vipakṣ 'bhāvāsiddheḥ kārtaṇāt saṃśayas tato vipakṣād avyatireko yaḥ sa eva vyabhicāraḥ śeṣavataḥ (|)
 kiṃceti doṣāntarasamuccayaḥ | yady adarśanād vyatirekas tadā vyatirekyapi hetuḥ syāt | kīdṛśaṃ nedaṃ nirātmakam ityādi | prasaṅgamukhena cedam uktam aprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāt | prāṇādimatvāc ca sātmakaṃ ayaṃ ca hetuḥ sātmake kvacin na dṛṣṭo nirātmakebhyaś ca vyāvṛtta iti sādhyanivṛttau nivṛttidharmāvyatirekī kathyate | tathā hi nirātmakeṣv ātmarahiteṣu ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣu prāṇādyadarśanāt prāṇāpānonmeṣanimeṣādarśanāt | dṛṣṭeṣu svabhāvānupalambhenaivādarśanaṃ prāṇādīnām upalabdhilakṣaṇa prāptatvāt | adṛṣṭeṣv api tajjātīyatayā | tena nairātmyaṃ prāṇādyabhāvena vyāptaṃ | jīvaccharīre tu tannivṛttyā prāṇādimattvābhāvanivṛttyā nairātmyasya nivṛtter ātmagatiḥ syāt | tava tarhi kathaṃ saṃśayahetur iti ced āha – adṛśyetyādi | adṛśyasyātmano 'nupalambhād ghaṭādisva(?ṣva)bhāvāprasiddhau ghaṭādī(nā)n nairātmyāsiddheḥ kāraṇān nirātmakāt prāṇāder anivṛttiḥ | prāṇādyabhāvena sandigdhasya nairātmyasyāpy asiddhir (p.63) iti yāvat |
 bauddhena nairātmyamabhyugatamato 'byupagamān nirātmakatvaṃ ghaṭādeḥ siddam iti cet | yadi bauddhābhyupagamaḥ pramāṇaṃ kathim idānīm ātmasiddhir jīvaccharīre | tad api bauddhena nirātmakam iṣṭaṃ | jīvaccharīre nairātmyābhyupagama 'pramāṇakas tato 'syātmā sādhyata iti | yady evaṃ parasyāpi jīvaccharīrād anyasyāpi ghaṭāder apramāṇikā kathaṃ nairātmyasiddhiḥ | na hi bauddhasyābhyupagamaḥ kvacit pramāṇaṃ kvacin neti | kiṃ cābhyupagamena kevalena sātmakānātmakau vibhajya ghaṭādyaḥ pareṇāsmābhiś cānātmakā abhyupagatāḥ | tenānātmakāḥ | jīvaccharīraṃ sātmakam asmābhir abhyupagatan tvayā tu nirātmakam evam ivabhajya tatranirātmakeṣu prāṇādīnāmabhāve nātmaviṣaye gamakatvaṃ kathayatā pareṇāgamikatvamātmani pratipannaṃ nānumeyatvaṃ | tasmād ātmano ghaṭādāv adarśanepy adṛśyasvabhāvasyātmano nivṛtty asiddher nāsi kutaścin nirātmakāt prāṇāder nnivṛttir ity agamakatvaṃ | etat tāvan naivātmanaḥ kutaś cin nivṛttiḥ siddhā | abhyupagamya tūcyate | tannivṛttāv apy ātmanivṛttāv api kvacid iti dṛṣṭe ghaṭādau nivṛttāv api prāṇādīnām apratibandhādātmanā saha sambandhābhāvāt | sarvatrādṛṣṭeṣv api ghaṭādiṣv ātmanivṛttyā prāṇādīnāṃ nivṛttyasiddheḥ sandigdhavyatirekitvād (na) gamakatvaṃ |
 adarśanamātrād vyatirekābhyupagame saty ayam aparo doṣa ity āha – yāpītyādi | kā punḥ sety āha – tathā sapakṣe sann ityādi | ācāryasya cāyaṅgranthaḥ tatra sandihyuktam pakṣadharmo vādiprativādiniścito gṛhyate | tenobhayor anyatarasya cāsiddhasya gdhasyāśrayāsiddhasya ca vyudāsaḥ | yathā ca pakṣadharmaniścayena caturvidhasyāsiddhasya vyudāsas tathā sapakṣ sannasannityevam ādiṣv apy anvayavyatirekaniścayena nirastam asiddhajātamanyatarāsiddhādīnāṃ sapakṣādiṣv asambhvāt | yathāyogam udāhāryam ity āha – sāpi na vācyā asiddhiyojanā | (p.64) tad vyācaṣṭe – anupalambha evetyādi. apramāṇakenupalambha eva sati hetor vipakṣe saṃśayāt (|) katham upalambhe tad asambhavāt | vipakṣe hetor upalambhe sati tasya saṃśayasyābhāvāt | tasmād anupalambhād dhetoḥ vipakṣād vyatireka ity arthāt sandigdhavyatireko hetur iṣṭa eva | tasmāt saṃśayito 'nivāryaḥ | saṃśayena viṣayīkṛtaḥ saṃśayito vyatireko na vāryaḥ syāt |
 yathāyogam udāhāryam ity ato yathāyogavacanāt saṃśayito 'nivārita eveti cet | naitad evaṃ | tadanantaram eva "ya eva tūbhayaniścayavācī"tyādi vacanāt | ya eva śabda ubhayaniścitasya trairūpyasyāsiddhatvād er vācakaḥ sa eva sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ "na cānyataraprasiddhasandigdhavācī punaḥ sādhanāpekṣaṇādi"ty ayaṃ grantha ihodāharaṇaṃ | anayatarasya vādinaḥ prativādino vā (|) yosiddhaṃ sandigdham vā vakti na sa sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vā (|) sandigdhavyatirekaniścayahetur ubhayor api vipakṣe sandigdhas tasmāt tadabhidhānam asādhanam | yasmād ubhayaniścita eva hetur uktas tenānupalambhe 'pi sati nivṛttisaṃśayād vipakṣād dhetor anivṛttiṃ manyamānas tasya sandigdhavyatirekasya hetutvapratiṣedham āha asiddhiyojanayā ||
 kiñ ca | yady adṛṣṭyā nivṛttir iṣyate tadā viśeṣasyāsādhāraṇasya śrāvaṇatvāder vyavacchedahetutā syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) nityānityayor adarśanāt | tad vyācaṣṭe – śrāvaṇatvasyāpītyādi | tathā hy adarśanamātdrād vyāvṛttir iṣṭā ( | a)sti ca nityānityayor adarśanaṃ śrāvaṇatvasya tadvyavacchedahetutā syāt | nityānityapratiṣedhahetutvam bhavet | yadi nāmādarśanāt tato vyāvartteta śrāvaṇatvan tadvyavacchedahetutvan tu kuta ity āha – na hīti | na tadvyāvṛtter anyad vyavacchedanannityānityavyavacchedanam (|) tavāpi kathaṃ śrāvaṇatvan na vyavacchedahetur iti ced āha – avyavacchedas (p.65) tv ityādi | kutaś cin nityād anityāc cādarśanamātreṇa vyāvṛtter evāniścayāt | aniścayaś cānyataratra pratibandhāniścayāt | avaśyaṃ caitad evam anyathā yo hi dharmo yatra nāstīti niśvitaḥ sa bhavan kvacid dharmiṇi kathan tadbhāvaṃ yatra nāstīti niścitas tasyābhāśvaṃ kathaṃ na gamayet |
 nityānityād vyāvṛttasyāpi śrāvaṇatvasyobhayavyavacchede sādhye pramāṇāntarabādhā cec chaṃkyeta | athāpītyādyasyeaiva vyākhyānaṃ | śrāvaṇatvenobhayavyavacchede nityānityavyavacchede sādhye pramāṇāntaraṃ bādhakam asti | tad āha – anyonyetyādi | anyonyavyavacchedo rūpaṃ yeṣānte tathā | tathā hi nityavyavaccheda evānityatvantadvyavaccheda eva ca nityatvan tathā bhāvavyavaccheda evābhāvo 'bhāvavyavaccheda eva ca bhāvaḥ | teṣām ekasya vyavacchedenānyavidhānāt | dvitīyasya viruddhasya vidhānādapratiṣedhaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | yadā hi śrāvaṇatvaṃ nityād vyāvṛttam iti tad vyavacchidyāt | tad evānityatvam iva dadhyāt | tad eva ca tad anityād vyāvṛttam ity anityaṃ vyavacchidyāt | nityaṃ ca vidhatta ity ekasyaikadaiva vidhipratiṣedhau syātāṃ tac cāyuktam iti vidhipratiṣedhayor yugapadvirodhān na kasyacid api pratiṣedhaḥ | pratiṣedhavinivṛttilakṣaṇo hi vidhiḥ | vidhinivṛttir eva ca pratiṣedhas tau ca parasparaviruddhau yugpad ekasya kathaṃ syātām (|) ato na kutaś cid api vyāvṛttiniścayaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt | nedānīm iti siddhāntavādī | idānīm iti bādhāsambhave sati | adṛśo 'darśanād vipakṣe hetor nāstitā | tasmād evaṃ saty adarśanan na pramāṇam bādhāsambhavāt |
 śrāvaṇatva evāpramāṇaṃ bhavatu nānyatra bādhābhāvād iti ced āha – tathetyādi | anyatrāpi hetor vyatirekasādhanasyādarśanasya sambhāvyaṃ pramāṇāntarabādhanaṃ | kutaḥ | lakṣaṇetyādi | hetor vipakṣādarśanavyāvṛttinibandhanam iti yallakṣaṇan tena yuktaṃ śrāvaṇatvasya (p.66) yadadarśanan tasmin bādhāsambhave sati tallakṣaṇam eva tasya vyatirekasādhanasyādarśanasya sarvaviṣayam eva lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ dūṣitaṃ syād iti sarvatrādarśane vyatirekasādhanenāśvāsaḥ | na gamakatvaniścayaḥ ||
 yady evam anumānaviṣayepi kvacit pratyakṣānumānavirodhadarśant (|) tathā hi nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāc chabdatvavid iti kṛte nityatvam anumānena bādhyate | evam aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvād ghaṭavid iti pratyakṣeṇa | tataś ca ssarvatra tadaviśiṣṭalakṣaṇenānumānepy anāśvāsaprasaṅga iti cet |
 naitad evaṃ yathokta iti kāryasvabhāvānupalambhajeṅgajenumāne pratyakṣānumānavirodhasyābhāvāt | pratyakṣād ivirodhasambhavinaś cātallakṣaṇatvāt tadanumānālakṣaṇatvāt | yidi yathoktalakṣane 'numāne nāsti bādhā tadā hetulakṣaṇayuktaṃ parasparaviruddhārthasādhakaṃ hetudvayam ekasmin dharmiṇyavatīrṇṇam ivaruddhāvyabhicāry uktam ācāryeṇa tasyāvacanam iti cet | anenābhyukpetahānim āha – anumānaviṣaye viruddhavyabhicāryavacanād iṣṭam etreti kutobhyupatahānaṃ | kva tarhy ācāryeṇokta ity āha – viṣayaṃ cetyādi | asya viruddhāvyabhicāriṇaḥ | kiṃ cetyādi | iha vaiśeṣikeṇa vāyoḥ sattvasādhanārthaṃ sparśaś ca na ca dṛṣṭānām NOTEREF _Ref57086871 \f \h  \* MERGEFORMAT H iti sūtram uktam. asyāyam arthaḥ – yo guṇaḥ, sa dravyāśrayī. tad yathā rūpādiḥ. apākajānuṣṇāśītasparśaś ca guṇas. tasmāt tasyāśrayabhūtena dravyeṇa bhavitavyam. na cāyaṃ dṛṣṭānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇaḥ, teṣāṃ pākajānuṣṇāśītasparśādiguṇatvāt. tato yasyāyaṃ guṇaḥ, sa vāyur bhaviṣyatīty ukte vaiśeṣikeṇa, tatrācāryadiṅnāgenoktaṃ – yady adarśanamātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na ca so 'pi yukta NOTEREF _Ref57114206 \f \h I iti. yad etad uktam, tad virudhyata iti vārttikakāro darśayann āha – dṛṣṭetyādi. yady dṛṣṭyā nivṛttiḥ syāt tathā 'dṛṣṭer adarśanāt kāraṇād (p.67) apākajasyānuṣṇāśītasparśasya dṛṣṭā 'yuktiḥ | dṛṣṭeṣu pṛthivyādiṣvasaṅgatir yā varṇitā vaiśeṣikair yasyā ācāryeṇāyuktatvam uktaṃ sā syād avirodhinī yuktaiva syād ity arthaḥ |
tad vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi. yad āhācāryaḥ – vāyuprakaraṇe yady adarśanamātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivyādibhyaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate vaiśeṣikeṇa na ca so 'pi yukta iti | yady ācāryasyāpy adarśanamātreṇa vyatireko 'bhimataḥ, tadā katham ayuktaḥ, sparśasya pratiṣdho yukta eva syāt. kiṃ kāraṇam? atrāpi hetor anupalambhād abhāvasiddher abhyupagamāt.
nanv ityādi paraḥ. upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpteḥ kāraṇād apākajasyānuṣṇāśītasparśasyānupalabhyamānasya pṛthivyādiṣu yukta eva pratiṣdhaḥ. na yukta iti sidhāntavādī. kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? yaḥ pṛthivyādir anuṣṇāśītād anyena sparśena yuktaḥ pratyakṣaḥ, sa dṛśyaḥ. anyatra ca deśādāv apratyakṣo 'pi tathābhūtasparśayukta eva pṛthivyādis tatsvabhāvaḥ. dṛśyaś ca tatsvabhāvaś ceti dvandvaḥ. tad eva viṣayaḥ sa eva tanmātraṃ "supsupeti" samāsaḥ. tasminn apratiṣedhāt sparśasya. tatra hi pratiṣdhe syād eva niścayaḥ yāvatāś pṛthivyādidharmibhūtaṃ sāmānyenāviśeṣeṇaiva gṛhītvāyam vaiśeṣikaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedham āha. yat kiṃcit pṛthivyādi, tat sarvam anuṣṇāśītasparśarahitam iti .na ca pṛthivyādimātre sparśasyopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptir asti. na caikasparśaniyamaḥ pṛthivyādīnām, yatas tatra pṛthivyādisāmānye tūlopalapallavādiṣu bhedeṣu pṛthivyādibhāve 'pi sparśabhedadarśanāt. tathā hi tūlasyānyaḥ sparśaḥ ślakṣṇatvalakṣaṇonyaścopalādeḥ karkaśatvādilakṣaṇaḥ | asyāpīty anuṣṇāśītasparśasya kvacit pārthivadravyaviśeṣe sambhavāśaṃkayā bhavitavyam iti kṛtvā sarvatra pṛthivyādāv (p.68) adarśanamātreṇāṇuṣṇāśītasparśasyāyuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
 yat tūcyate | (|) sarvatra pṛthivyādes tulyatvāttulya evānuyṣṇāśītasparśo yas tu pṛthivyādibhāvepi ślakṣaṇatvādibhedaḥ sa pṛthivyādiparamāṇusaṃyogasya niviḍāniviḍakṛtatvād iti |
 tad ayuktam (|) aniviḍānāṃ hi nairantaryābhāvāt saṃyogābhāvaḥ | tena yathopalaparamāṇūnāṃ saṃyogasya niviḍatvan tathā tūlaparamānūnām iti kathaṃ ślakṣṇatvādibhedaḥ syāt | tasmād saty api saṃyoge svarūpeṇānyādṛśā evopalaparamāṇavonyādṛśāś ca tūlaparamāṇavastatkṛta eva ca ślakṣṇatvādibhedaḥ | na saṃyoganiviḍāniviḍakṛtaḥ | tathā ca yathā pṛthivyādibhedāt sparśasya ślakṣṇatvādibhedas tathā nuṣṇāśītabhedopi sambhāvyeta |
 nanu mābhūd adṛṣṭaviṣaye vāyvanumānaṃ dṛṣṭaviṣaye tv anuṣṇāśītasparśasya dṛśyasya pathivyādisambandhitvenānupalabhyamānatvāt tato vyāyvanumānaṃ syāt |

[PVSV 15,11] yadītyādinaitad eva vyācaṣṭe. yadi vipakṣe hetor adarśanamātreṇāpratibaddhasya svasādhye tadavyabhicāraḥ sādhyāvyabhicāra iṣyate, tadaikatra dṛṣṭasya dravyasya yad rūpam upalabdhan tat tasyānyatrāpi dravyasāmānyādanumeyaṃ syāt | asti hi trāpi tatkālaṃ hetor vipakṣe 'darśanamātraṃ |
na cedaṃ yuktam, yasmāt kvacid deśe kānicid dravyāṇi kathaṃ cid dṛṣṭāni pratiniyatarasāditvena | punar anyatheti yathādṛṣṭākāravaiparīty enān yatra deśe dṛśyante | yathetyādinā viṣayam āha – vīryandoṣāpanayanaśaktiḥ (|) pariṇāmo vipākaḥ | viśiṣṭā rasavīryavipākā yāsām iti vigrahaḥ | nānyatreti kṣetraviśeṣād anyatra | yathā deśa viśeṣāt tathā kālasaṃskārabhedād viśiṣṭarasavīryavipākā bhavanti | saṃskāraḥ kṣīrādyavasekaḥ | sa ca taddeśair iti pradeśo yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāntarais tathā viśiṣṭarasādiyuktā dṛṣṭā iti kṛtvā sarvā atadeśā api tattvena tulyarūpāditvena tthābhūtā yathāgṛhītasvabhāvatulyāḥ sidhyanti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) guṇāntarāṇāṃ rasādiviśeṣāṇāṃ kāraṇāntarāpekṣatvāt | viśeṣahetvabhāve tu syād ekasvabhāvatānumānaṃ | adṣṭaḥ krttā yasya vaidikasya tat tathā | tad api puruṣasaṃskārapūrvakaṃ puruṣaprayatnahetukaṃ | etac ca sādhyaphalaṃ | vākyeṣu pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyatvenabhimateṣu viśeṣābhāvād anena hetuḥ kathitaḥ | prayogā punar yadvastu yadabhinnasvabhāvanta(tta)tsamānahetukaṃ (|) yathaiko dhūmo dhūmāntarasamānajātīyaḥ | pauruṣeyavākyābhinnasvabhāvāni cāpauruṣeyābhimatāni vākyānīti svabhāvahetuḥ | na cāsiddho hetuḥ | tathā hi yaiḥ prakārair viṣādyapanayanād iti vaidikānāṃ viśeṣa iṣyate | teṣāṃ sarvaprakārāṇāṃ puruṣaiḥ kāraṇadarśanāt | tathā hi śabarādimantrāṇām api viṣādyapanayanādayo dṛśyante |
 yadi śabdasvabhāvasāmyād adṛṣṭakarttṛ kasyāpi pauruṣeyatvam anumīyate | evaṃ tarhi svacittasantatidarśanāt sarve cittadharmā jñātāḥ (|) tena yāvad bodharūpan tāvat (p.70) pañcendriyāśritaṃ savikalpakaṃ ca sarvaṃ ca rāgādijananavāsanāgarbhaṃ yathedānīn tathānāgatāvasthāyām api yathā ca mama tathā pareṣām api (|) tena cittatvenendriyāśritatvena vacanādihetutvena ca sarvasya puṃsaścittaṃ sarvadā rāgādiyuktan niyatavastugrāhitvād asarvaviṣayaṃ kin nānumīyata ity āśaṃkyāha – naivam ityādi | yathā vākyānyasambhavadviśeṣahetūni naivaṃ sambhavadviśeṣahetavaḥ puruṣāḥ yena viśeṣahetv asambhavena | vacanāder ādigrahaṇenendriyāśritatvacittatvādigrahṇaṃ | vacanāder eva kiṃ cin mātreṇaikadeśena sādharmyāttasmālliṅgāt puṃsāṃ rāgādimatvena niyataviṣayatvenānyena vā sarvākāreṇa sāmyam anumīyeta |
 viśeṣahetusambhava eva kuta ityāha – srveṣv eva cetoguṇeṣu viśeṣasaya darśanāt | rāgaprajñādayo hi svaviṣayagrahaṇaṃ prati mandamandavṛttayopi kālāntareṇa puṭutarā bhavanti | svaviṣayaś caiṣāṃ spaṣṭataro bhavatīti viśeṣo dṛśyate | sapunaḥ kuto bhavatīty āha – saṃskārobhyāsan tasya viśeṣeṇa prajñādīnāṃ viśeṣapratīteḥ | bhavatu prajñādīnāṃ manoguṇānām abhyāsāt prakarṣo dṛṣṭatvāt sarvajñādayas tu na dṛṣṭā iti kathan teṣām bhāva ity ata āha – tadvad ityādi | anyasyāpi sarvajñatvāder viśeṣasya sambhavāt | abhyāsavaśāc ca nairātmyākārasya sarvapadārthagrāhiṇaś ca sāmānyavikalpasya yatas phuṭābhatvan tad eva vairāgyaṃ sārvajñaṃ ca padaṃ | tena tribhiḥ prakārair vairāgyasarvajñatvaviśeṣāsambhavānumānaṃ syāt | yadi nairātmyaviṣayasya sarvaviṣayasya vā vikalpasyāsambhavaḥ | sambhave vā yadi manoguṇānāṃ na viśeṣaḥ syāt | sati vā viśeṣe viśeṣahetur yadi na jñātaḥ syāt | yāvatā nairātmyādiviṣayasya vikalpasya sambhvo 'sti viśeṣahetuś cābhyāso vijñātaḥ | tasmād yathā 'sati pratibandhavikalye samartheyaṃ bījakāraṇasāmagrī aṅkurotpādāyeti sāmarthyānumānaṃ | tadvad asati pratibandhavikalye cirakālān nairantaryavataś cābhyāsaviśeṣāc ca nairātmyaviṣayasya sarvapddārthaviṣayasya ca jñānasya sphuṭābhavatvaṃ sambhavatīti vairāgyasarvajñatvayoḥ sambhavānumānaṃ | evaṃ tāvat sambhavānumānam asmākaṃ |
 asambhave tv anumātavye bhavatāṃ na tasya dharmasya bādhakaḥ kaścid dhetur vidyate | tadabhāvān nāsaṃbhavadviśeṣahetavaḥ pumāṃsa iti sambandhaḥ | kathaṃ punar bādhakasyābhāva ity āha – vairāgyasyādṛṣṭatvād (|) upalakṣaṇaṃ caitatsarvajñasyāpy adṛṣṭatvāt | adṛṣṭena ca vairāgyeṇa (p.71) saha hetor bādhyabādhakabhāvāsiddheḥ |
syān mataṃ – na vacanāder vairāgyādīnāṃ sākṣād asambhavo 'numīyate, yena bādhako hetur mṛgyate, | kin tu vītarāgābhimateṣu rāgādayo 'numīyante.) teṣv anumiteṣv artho vītarāgādipratiṣiddhamadṛṣṭenāpi vairāgyena(?ṇa) rāgitvasya virodhād ity ata āha – rāgetyādi | na hi rāgādīnāmavyabhicār kāryam asti | ādigrahaṇād asarvajñparigrahaḥ | tathā hi vyavahāravyutpattim ārabhya yathā yathārthaparijñānan tathā tathā tadviṣayam vaktṛtvam bhavatīti tena yadi sarvaviṣayaṃ kasyacid vijñānaṃ syāt tadviṣayam api vaktṛtvaṃ kena vāryate |
 syād etad (|) yadi vairāgyādilakṣaṇan tasya viśeṣo 'sit katham asmābhir nopalabhyata ity āha – sambhavepi teṣāṃ vairāgyādilakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ parasantāne draṣṭum aśakyatvāt | na ca tthābhūtānām anupalambhāt pratikṣepa ity āha – tādṛśo ca viprakarṣiṇām apratikṣepārhatvāt |
 syād etad (|) yathā puruṣā apratikṣepārhās tadvad vākyānīty āha – naivam ityādi | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | dṛśyaviśeṣatvāt | tathā hi vaidikānāṃ vākyānām viśeṣo dṛśya eveṣyate | atha neṣyate | evam adṛśyatve 'pi viśeṣasyābhyupagamyamāne | tenānupalabdhena viśeṣaṇādṛṣṭaviśe4ṣāṇāṃ viadikavākyānāṃ laukikavākyebhyo vijātīyatvopagamavirodhāt |
 syān mataṃ (|) dṛśyā eva viśeṣā vaidikānāṃ duḥśravaṇatvadurbhaṇatvādayas taiḥ pauruṣeyebhyo bhinnāni bhaviṣyantīty ata āha – tadviśeṣāṇām ityādi | anyatreti puruṣeyeṣu | na kevalam adṛṣṭaviśeṣāṇāṃ vijātīyatvopagamavirodhād adṛśyatvaṃ viśeṣāṇām ayuktam itaś ca pratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣasvabhāvavirodhāt | na hy ekasya svabhāvadvayaṃ viruddhaṃ ghaṭte | viśeṣāḥ pratyakā eva kevalaṃ bhrāntinimittasadbhāvāt | viṣādiśaktivan nāvadhāryanta iti ced āha – bhrāntinimittābhāvād iti | rūpasādharmyadarśanaṃ hi bhrāntinimittaṃ viṣādiṣu | navaṃ vaidikeṣu | kathaṅgamyata iti ced āha – bādhakābhāvāt bhrāntyasiddher iti | yadi vaidikānāṃ viśeṣe bhrāntyānapalakṣyamāṇe punar viśeṣāvalamvipramāṇam (p.72) utpadyate bhrānter bādhakan tadā bhrāntes tannimittasya ca bhavati niścayas tac ca nāsit | tasmāl laukikaiḥ śabdaiḥ vaidikānām aviśeṣe sādhye nāsti sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ |
 puruṣeṣu tarhi kiṃ bādhakaṃ yena sarvākāraguṇasāmyasādhane doṣa ity āha – puruṣeṣv ityādi | prajñādiviṣayasyātiśayasyābhyāsapūrvakasya yad darśanan tad eva bādhakaṃ | yady asambhavadvairāgyaṃ puruṣasya cittam bhavet | nābhyāsādheyaviśeṣam bhaved (|) bhavati ca (|) tato viśeṣadarśanasya bādhakatvād asamānaṃ | vedavākyānumāne yad uktaṃ pratyakṣāṇāṃ śabdānām apratyakṣasvabhāvābhāvād iti (|) syād ayandoṣo yadi viśeṣaḥ svabhāvabhūtaḥ syāt | kin tu parabhāvabhūta ity āha – parabhāvabhūtasyeti | parabhāvaṅgataḥ prabhāvabhūtaḥ | anyasvabhāva ity arthaḥ | atadviśeṣatvād ity avākyaviśeṣatvāt | yato nāsit viśeṣo vākyānān tat tasmād abhinnasvabhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyābhimatānāṃ puruṣakriyā | puruṣaiḥ karaṇaṃ | na vā kasya cid laukikasyāpi na puruṣakriyety arthaḥ ||
 evam ācāryīyasyādarśanamātreṇa vipakṣāddhetor vyatirekam icchataḥ granthavirodhaṃ pramāṇavirodhaṃ cokttvātīrthikānāṃ parasparavyādhātam āha – kiṃ cetyādi | mṛdaś cetanā etac ca lokāyata darśanaṃ | ātmā ca mṛcchetanā ceti dvandvaḥ | ādiśabdāt kṣīrādiṣu dravyādi | teṣām abhāvasya sādhanāyānupalambhaḥ pareṇokto 'pi yas tasyābhāvasyāprasādhaka iṣṭa ātmādivādibhir anupalambhamātrasyāpramāṇatvād iti | sa evānupalambha ātmādiniṣedhe pramāṇatvenāniṣṭaḥ kiṃ hetvabhāvasya hetovipakṣād vyatirekasya sādhakaḥ | hetvabhāve cānupalambhaṃ cāsya vaiśeṣkādeḥ pramāṇayataḥ ātmavādo nirālambo nirāśrayaḥ syāt | tatrānupalambhavsyābhāvasādhanasya sambhavāt | tathā hi na pratyakṣeṇātmana upalambho nityaparokṣatvābhyupagamāt | atha syād ātmanonumānam evopalambhostyevetyata āha – tatkāryetyādi | apratyakṣatvādevātmanas tatkāryasvabhāvarūpasya liṅgasyāniścayān nānumānam upalambhaḥ | (p.73)  yathā nityaparokṣāṇām apīndriyādīnām anumānan tathātmano bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – indriyāṇām ityādi | ādiśabdāt smṛtibījādīnāṃ | vijñānam eva kāryan tasya kādā cit katvāt | tathā hi satsv api rūpālokamanaskāreṣu nimīlitalocanādyavasthāsu vijñānasyābhāvāt | punaś conmīlitalocanāvasthāsu bhāvāt | vijñānakāryaṃ kāraṇāntarasāpikṣaṃ sidhyati tato 'sya sāpekṣyasiddhyā indriyādīnām prasiddhir ucyate |
 etad uktam bhavati | yatsāpekṣam idaṅ kādācit kaṃ | vijñānantatkam apy asya vijñānasya kāraṇam astīty anumīyate tad eva cendriyam iti vyavahriyate | na tv evaṃbhūtam iti na rūpaviśeṣeṇa mūrttatvādinā yuktam indriyamanumīyata ity arthaḥ | evam iti yathā kādācitkavijñānakāryānyathān upapattyendriyānumānaṃ | tathā sukhādikāryaṃ yasya sukhādikāryantatkim apy astīty anumānena tac cātmasvarūpam iti prasādhitaṃ kañcid arthaṃmātmavādino na puṣṇāti | yena kenacidanirdiṣṭaviśeṣeṇa kāraṇena kāraṇavattvābhyupagamāt sukhādīnāṃ | na caivaṃbhūta ātmā nityakrttṛbhoktṛtvādilakṣaṇatvenābhyupagamāt | yataś ca yathābhyupagatasyātmano nāsti kāryaliṅgaṃ | tathā ca satyanupalabbha evātmanaḥ syāt | tasmāt tamātmānantenānupalambhena pratyakṣānumānanivṛttilakṣaṇena pratyācakṣāṇaḥ kim iti prativyūḍhaḥ pratikṣīpta ātmavādinā | anupalambhamātrān nāsty asattvam ātmana iti katham asādhanaṃ sad vipakṣād dhetīḥ prāṇādimatvāder vyatirekaṃ sādhayet | bhūtānām eva śaktiścaitanyamiṣyate cārvākaiḥ (|) bhūtasbhavāvā ca mṛdityevaṃ mṛdaḥ khalv api caitanyamanupalabhyamānam apīcchan lokāyatikaḥ | yad āha (|) "tebhyo bhūtebhyaś catanyammadaśaktivadvijñānam" iti | punas tata evāpramāṇakād anupalambhāt | adarśanād vacanāder asarvajñatvādisādhanāya liṅgatvenopanītasya vipakṣād vyāvṛttim āha – dadhyādikaṃ kṣīrādiṣv anupalabhyamānam apīcchan | (p.74)  apara iti sāṃkhyaḥ punaḥ sa eva | parārthāś cakṣurādayaḥ saṅdhātatvād ity abhidāyāparārtheṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu saṅdhātatvasyādarśanād vyatirekam āha – evaṃ tāvad asya parasparavyādhātaḥ | na cādarśanamātreṇāsya hetor vyāptiḥ sidhyati | ko hy atra niyamaḥ saṅdhātair avaśyaṃ parārthair bhavitavyaṃ yataḥ saṃdhātatvāc cakṣurādīnāṃ pārārthyasiddhyātmārthatvaṃ sāṃkhyasyasidhyet | yad uktaṃ dadhyādikaṃ kṣīrādiṣv apy anupalabhyamānam apīti (|) tan na | yasmād asty evopalambho dadhyādīnāṃ kṣīrādiṣu (|) kosāvity āhānumānam iti | anumānaṃ cāhāśaktād anutpatter iti | yadi hi kṣīrādau dadhyādiśaktir na syāt tato śaktāt kṣīrāder dadhyādi notpadyata | prayogas tu yadyajjanane na śaktaṃ na tasya tata utpattir yathā śālivījād yavāṅkurasya (|) utpadyate ca dadhyādiḥ kṣīrādibhyas tasmād asti dadhyādiśaktitaḥ kṣīrādāv iti kāryahetupratirūpako vaidharmyaprayogaḥ | śakter eva ca dadhyādiḥ kāryakāraṇayor abhedād iti manyate |
 athetyādi siddhāntavādī | yo 'sau dadhyādiko bhāvaḥ paścād upalabhyate kiṃ sa eva bhāvaḥ śaktir utānyad eva kiñcid dadhyāder arthāntaraṃ | tathaiveti niṣpannarūpadadhyādivat kṣīrāv asthāyām upalabhyeta viśeṣābhāvāt | anyac ced iti | dadhyādibhyorthāntaraṃ cecchaktiḥ | tadā katham anyabhāvenyasya śaktyākhyāsya bhāve | taddadhyādikam asti | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | dadhyādijananasāmarthyāt kṣīrādau dadhyādīty upacāramātraṃ syāt | anupalambhamapramāṇīkṛtya punas tasyaiva pramāṇīkaraṇamayam parasparavyādhāta eṣām ātmādivādinām ity upasaṃhāraḥ ||
 yataś cādarśanamātrān nāsti vyatierkas tasmāt tanmātramambandhaḥ | hetusattāmātrasambaddhasvabhāvaḥ sādhyatvenābhimataḥ svayannivartamāno bhāvam evaṃ svabhāvabhūtam eva hetutvenopanītaṃ nivartayet | vāśabdo vakṣyamāṇavikalpāpekṣī | yathā vṛkṣo nivartamānaḥ śīṃśapān nivartayati | kasmāc chākhādimadviśeṣasyaiva tathā śiṃśapeti prasiddheḥ sa (p.75) vṛkṣas tasya śiṃśapākhyasya svabhāvaḥ | svañca svabhāvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ parityajya kathaṃ śiṃśapākhyo bhāvo bhavet | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvasyaiva vṛkṣasvātmana eva bhāvatvāc chaṃśapārūpatvāt | iti hetos tasyātmabhūtasya sādhanasya śiṃśapādeḥ svabhāvapratibandhād eva svabhāve sādhyābhimate vṛkṣādau yathoktena prakāreṇa pratibandhād evāvyabhicāraḥ | kāraṇaṃ vā nivartamānam ity adhyāhāraḥ | kāryan nivartayed iti prakṛtaṃ | kasmād (|) avyabhicārataḥ kāryasya kāraṇāvyabhicārād ity arthaḥ | kāraṇam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe |
 anyatheti | yadi kāraṇe nivartamāne kāryaṃ na vivartteta | tadā tatkāryābhimataṃ tasya kāraṇasya kāryam eva na syāt | tasmāt kāraṇaṃ nivartamānaṃ kāryam avaśyaṃ nivartayati | yady api vāsagṛhādāv agnikāraṇanivṛttāv api na dhūmasya nivṛttis tathāpi dṛṣṭakāraṇavyatirekeṇa nānyasmādasyotpattir abhipretety arthaḥ | ata evāha – siddhas tv ityādi | siddhas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kāryasya svabhāvaṃ kāraṇe niyamayati (|) sati tasmin bhavaty asati na bhavatīty evaṃ tadavyabhicāriṇaṃ karoti | ubhayatheti tādātmyena tadutpattyā vā yaḥ svabhāvapratibandhas tasmād eva | sādhyānivṛttyā hetor nivṛttiḥ |
 anyatheti yadi pratibandho niṣyate | ekasyāpratibandhakasya sādhyasya nivṛttyānyanivṛttiḥ | apratibaddhasya sādhanadharmasya nivṛtiḥ katham bhavet (|) naiva | yasmān nāśvavānityaśvarahita iti kṛtvā marttyena manuṣyeṇa na bhāvyaṃ gomatāpi kiṃ | sannidhānāt tathaikasyeti svabhāvenāsambaddhasya hetoḥ sannidhānāt katham anyasya sādhyasya sannidhir naiva sannidhānaṃ | yasmād (|)
 "gomān ity eva mattyena bhāvyamaśvavatāpi kiṃ | " (p.76)  yata evaṃ tasmāt svabhāvapratibandhād eva sādhyābhimate vastuni pratibadhatvād eva hetuḥ svasādhyaṅgamayati | na tu sambandhāt | kāryakāraṇayor asahabhāvena vyāpyavyāpakayoś caikatvena dviṣṭhasambandhābhāvāt | sa ceti svabhāvapratibandhaḥ | tadbhāvalakṣaṇa iti sādhyasvabhāvalakṣaṇas tadutpattilakṣaṇo vā | sa eva svabhāvapratibandho 'vinābhāvākhyaḥ sādharmyavaidharmyadṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ pradarśayate ||
 etad uktam bhavati | sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakam eva pramāṇaṃ vyāptigrāhakan tenaiva sādhanasya sādhyāyattatāgrahaṇāt sādhyābhāve 'bhāvo gṛhīta eva kevalan tadavinābhāvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ vismṛtatvād dṛṣṭāntābhyām upadarśyate (|) yataś ca pramāṇakhyāpanād evāvinābhāvasmṛtyā sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvo niścito bhavati (|)
 tasmād vaidharmyadṛṣṭānte | tadviṣaye 'vaśyaṃ niyamena iha hetau kāryasvabhāvalakṣaṇa āśrayo vastubhūto dharmī neṣṭaḥ svabhāvānupalambhe tv iṣṭa eva |
 tatra hi viparyayeṇopalambhaḥ khyāpanīyaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) āśrayo neṣṭa ity āha – tadabhāve cetyādi | tadabhāve vyāpakakāraṇayor abhāve tadvyāpyakāryākhyaṃ liṅgaṃ neti na bhavatīty evaṃ vaidharmyavacanād apy āśrayarahitāt tadgater vyatirekagateḥ (||28||)
 kiṅ kāraṇaṃ | yata ityādi | svabhāvahetau sādhyasya tadbhāvaḥ sādhanavyāpakatvaṃ | kāryahetau sādhyasya hetubhāvaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ khyāpyate | tadavedina iti tadbhāvahetubhāvāvedinaḥ puṃsaḥ |
 tad vyācaṣṭe – dṛṣṭān te hītyādi | sādhyadarmasya tadbhāvaḥ sādhanasvabhāvatvaṃ khyāpyate tanmātrānubandhena | sādhanamātrānubandhena | kṛtaka(tva)niṣpattāv eva niṣpannasyānityatvasya kṛtakamātrānubandhena yā tatsvabhāvatā sādhanasvabhāvatā tayā | evaṃbhūtayā tadbhāvaḥ khyāpyate | na tu nimittāntarāt paścād utpadyamānenānityatvena (p.77) | yathaike vipratipannā iti | tanmātravatvam eva darśayann āha – ya ityādi | yo hetuḥ kṛtakaṃ svabhāve janayait so 'nityarūpam eva santaṃ janayatīty arthaḥ | iti anena dvāreṇāvinābhāvaviṣayaṃ pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntena khyāpyate | na tu darśanārśanamātraṃ | anyatheti yady evaṃ pramāṇaṃ nopadarśayate | tadaikadharmasadbhāvāt sādhanadharmasadbhāvāt | tadanyenāpi sādhyadharmeṇāpi bhavitavyam iti niyamābhāvāt sādhansya sādhyavyabhicārāśaṃkā syāt |
 yadi nāma dṛṣṭāntena pramāṇam upadarśanīyantathāpi kiṃ siddham ity āha – tena ca pramāṇena tanmātrānubandha iti sādhanamātrānubandhaḥ | kathṃ khyāpyata ity āha – kṛtakasya yatkāraṇantasmād eva kṛtakas tathā jāto jāto yo naśvaraḥ kṣaṇasthitidharmā | kṣaṇikatvenaiva naśvaro na tu kālāntaraṃ sthitvety arthaḥ |
 kathaṃ punaḥ svahetor eva tathotpanna ity āha – anyata iti svahetor anyasmād vināśahetoḥ | tasya kṛtkasya tadbhāvaniṣedhād anityatāsvabhāvaniṣedhād vakṣyamāṇakāt | hetubhāvo vā tna ca pramāṇena khyāpyata iti sambandhaḥ | sādhyadharmasya sādhanaṃ prati hetu bhāvo vā kāraṇatvam vā khyāpyate tasmin saty eva sādhanasya bhāvād ity anena prakāreṇa pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntena pradarśayate | kasya punaḥ sādhyasya hetubhāvaḥ pradarśyata ity āha (|) arthāntarasya sādhanād vyatiriktasya | tathā dṛṣṭāntopadarśitena pramāṇena prasiddhe tadbhāvahetubhāve | svabhāvasya sādhyasya tadbhāve | sādhanasvabhāvatve | kāraṇasya hetubhāve prasiddhe sati | dahanābhāvve dhūmo na bhavatīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | sa ity anityasvabhāvo vahniś ca | tasyeit krtakatvasya dhūmasya ca yathākramaṃ svabhāvo hetur vā (|) śabdaḥ samucchaye | yata evaṃ katham asau kṛtako dhūmo vā svaṃ svabhāvam anityaṃ hetuṃ cāgnimantareṇa bhavet (|) naiva bhavedity evasm anuddiṣṭarūpe viṣaye vayatireke (p.78) kathyamāne āśrayamantareṇāpi vaidharmyadṛṣṭānte prasidhyati vyatirekaḥ |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ |
 "vyarirekopi liṅgasya vipakṣānn iva labhyate |
  abhāve sa na gamyeta kṛtayatnair abodhanād" iti (|)
 tan nirastaṃ |
  evan tāvat (|) tadbhāvahetubhāvakhyāpanāya tadavedinaḥ dṛṣṭānto vaktavyaḥ |
 yeṣāṃ punaḥ pūrvaṃ prasidhāv eva tadbhāvahetubhāvau yathā svaṃ pramāṇena prakṣadharmamātratvaṃ niścitan teṣān tadbhāvahetubhāvaṃ prati viduṣāṃ hetur eva | yad artham ity anvayavyatirekaniścayārthaṃ | pratipādyasya svayam eva sorthaṃ siddha iti kin tadvacanena | tad eti niścitānvayavyatirekakāle |
 yad api mūḍhaṃ prati dṛṣṭāntapradarśanaṃ kriyate tadā tatpradarśanepi dṛṣṭāntapradarśanepi vaidharmyaṃ | vināpy āśrayeṇa yathoktavidhinā sidhyaty eva vyatirekaḥ | tataḥ kim vaidharmyaṃ dṛṣṭāntāśrayeṇeti manyamāna ācārya āśrayaṃ pratikṣipati nyāyamukhādau | tathā hi tatraivaṃ coditaṃ "yadā tarhy ākāśādikaṃ nityan tā(vad a)bhyupaiti pratibādī (|) tadā kathan nityāt kṛtakatvasya vyatireka" iti (|) tatrā cārya āśrayaṃ prtikṣipann āha – tadā sandeha eva nāsti tadabhāvāttatrāvṛtter iti |
 etd uktam bhavati | gṛhītapratibandhasya tatrākāśādau vyāpakābhāvād vyāpyābhāvasiddheḥ | anityābhāvaś ca nityasyāsatvāt siddha iti yāvat | yasmād dṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ pratibandhaḥ kathyate | tena kāraṇena jñātasambandhe hetau sati dvayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmyadṛṣṭāntayor anyataroktitaḥ | dvitīyepi tābhyām evānyatarasminn anuktepi smṛtiḥ samupajāyate 'rthāpattyā | (p.79)  etadapy ācāryavacanena saṃsyandayann āha – yadāhetyādi (|) nyāyamukhe cāyaṃ granthaḥ | vāśabdas tatraiva pūrvavikalpāpekṣī | anyatareṇeti sādharmyadṛṣṭān tena vaidharmyadṛṣṭān tena vā | ubhayapradarśanād anvayavyatirekapradarśanāt | tatrāpi granthe | dṛṣṭān tena svabhāvahetau kāryaṃ hetau ca yathā kramantadbhāvahetubhāvapradarśanaṃ kriyata iti manyamāna ācāryo 'rthāpattyā ekasyānvayasya vyatirekasya vā vacanena dvitīyasy yathākramaṃ vyatirekasyānvayasya vā siddhim āha – etad evāha – tathā hīti | yatkiñcit kṛtakan tadnityam evety ukte vyaktam avaśyam ayam anityatvākhyo dharmosya kṛtakasya svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī kṛtakamātrānubandhī pramāṇadṛṣṭa iti pramāṇena niścitaḥ |
 nanu kāryepi kāraṇam avaśyam bhavati | na ca tat tasya svabhāva ity ata āha – anarthāntara iti | kathn tanmātrānubandhīty āha – tadbhāvaniyamād iti | kṛtakabhāve 'vaśyam anityatābhāvād ity arthaḥ |
 nanu na kṛtkamātrānubandhī svabhāvo nityatvasya pratyakṣaniścitaḥ kṣaṇiko 'yam ity aniścayāt tat katham ucyate pramāṇadṛṣṭa iti | atha kṛtako vināśaṃ praty anapekṣatvāt tadbhāvaniyata ity anumānadṛṣṭaḥ (|)
 tad ayuktaṃ (|) yato nirhetuke 'pi vināśe yadaiva ghaṭāder nāśaḥ pratīyeta tadaivāhetukaḥ syān nānyadā | tat kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ athaikakṣaṇasthāyitvena ghaṭasyotpatteḥ pūrvam api nāśaḥ (|)
 nanu yathaikakṣaṇasthāyitvenotpattiḥ svahetubhyas tathānekakṣaṇasthāyitvenāpy utpattiḥ syāt | vicitraśaktayo hi sāmagrayo dṛśyante | na ca yadi vināśaḥ kvacit kadācid bhavet (|) tatkāladravyāpekṣatvād asyānapekṣatvahāniḥ | vināśakahetvanapekṣatvād anyathā dvitīyepi kṣaṇe vināśo na syāt tatkālādyapekṣatvāt | atha kramayagapadyābhyāṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ vyāptaṃ nityeṣu ca kramākramanivṛttau sattvaṃ nivartamānaṃ kṣaṇikeṣv evāvatiṣṭhata iti sattvāyuktasya kṛtakasya gamakatvaṃ |
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | kṣaṇikatve sat kramāpratipatter yena hi jñānakṣaṇena pūrvakam vastu pratipannaṃ na tenottaraṃ yenottaraṃ na tena pūrvakam iti kathaṃ kramapratītiḥ | yo hi pūrvavastupratipatyanantaram (p.80) aparasya grāhakaḥ sa kramagrāhī syāt tathā vā kṣaṇikatvam asya syāt | yasya ca bau dva sya kāla eva nāsti tasya kathaṃ kramagrahaḥ | bhinnakālavastvagrahāt | kālābhāve cānekavasturūpa eva kramaḥ | tathā ca nityasyāpi kramakarttṛtvaṃ na virudhyate | yathā ca nityasya kramakarttṛtvās anekarūpatvan tathā kṣaṇasyāpi syāt | atha kṣaṇavad dvitīye kṣaṇe nityasyāpy abhāvaḥ syāt kāryābhāvāt |
 tadayuktaṃ kālābhāvāt | bhavatu vā kramagrahas tathāpi kathaṃ kramākramābhyāṃ sattvasya vyāptiḥ | kramayaugapadyavyatirekeṇānyena prakāreṇārthakriyāsam bhavāt | na ca prakārāntarasya dṛśyānupalambhād abhāvaniścayaḥ | evaṃ hi viśiṣṭadeśādāv evābhāvaniścayaḥ syān na sarvadā | nāpy adṛśyānupalambhād abhāvaniśvayaḥ sandehāt | tasmān nityeṣu kramākramāyaugepi sattvānivṛtteḥ kathaṃ sattvasya kṣaṇikasvabhāvatvam iti śaṃkara prabhṛtayaḥ |
 bhavatu vā prakārāntarābhāvāt kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ sattvasya vyāotis tathāpi nityeṣu na pratyakṣādinā kramākramāyogaḥ siddho nittyānāmatīndriyatvāt (|) tadasiddhau ca na teṣu sattvanivṛttisiddhis tadasiddhau ca na satvasya kṣaṇikasvabhāvatvasuddhiḥ |
 kiñca (|) sattvāt kramayaugapadyānumānaṃ syāt tenaiva vyāptatvān na tu kṣaṇikatvānumānan tatra kramakarttṛtvāsambhavād iti |
 atrocyate | kramayaugapadye pratyakṣasiddhe eva | sahabhāvo hi bhāvānāṃ yaugapadyaṃ kramas tu pūrvāparabhāvaḥ sa ca kramiṇāmabhinnas tatpratibhāsaś caikapratibhāsaḥ | sa tv ekapratibhāsan antaram aparasya pratibhāsaḥ | kramapratibhāso na tv ekasyasivātiprasaṅgāt |
 satyaṃ (|) tatrāpi yadaikasya pratibhāso na tagāparasya tadbhāve hi yaugapadyapratibhāsaḥ syāt | tasmāt kramiṇoḥ pūrvottarābhyāṃ jñānābhyāṃ grahe kramo gṛhīta eva tato 'bhedāt | kevalaṃ pūrvānubhūtavastvāhitasaṃskāraprabodhenedam asmād anantaram ityānupūrvīvikalpotpattyā kramagtaho vyavasthāpyate | kramiṇāṃ grahepi kathaṃ cid ānupūrvīvikalpānutpattau kramāgrahavyavasthāpanādata eva kramiṇām ekagrahepi na kramagraha ucyate |
 kiṃ ca kālābhyupagamavādinopi kathaṃ kramagrahaḥ | ekakālatvāt sarvakāryāṇāṃ | atha bhinnakālakāraṇopādhikramāt kāryakramas tadayuktaṃ kālasyaikatvāt | ata eva na nityasya bhāvaḥ |
 atha pūrvāpararūpatvāt kramavān kālaḥ |
 nanu tasyāpi kramo yadi aparakālāpekṣas tadānavasthā syāt | atha tasya svarūpeṇā kramas tathā sahāyarahitānāmbahūnāṃ kāryāṇām api kramaḥ syāt | asmākan tu pūrvādipratyayaviṣaye mahābhūtaviṣayaḥ kālo lokapratītostyeva | tasya ca bhedāt kramādipratītir yujyate eva | nāpi prakārāntareṇa nityasya kartatvaṃ sambhavati | yataḥ (p.81) prakārāntareṇaikadaikakāryakaraṇe 'nekakaraṇe vānyadā 'vastutvaṃ syāt kāryābhāvāt | punaḥ punaḥ kāryakaraṇe ca eva na prakārāntarasambhavaḥ | atha prakārāntareṇa naikadā kāryaṃ karoti punaḥ punaś ca na karoti tadāsyāvastutvaṃ syat | sarvadā 'karttṛtvāt |
 tasmāt kramākramābhyāṃ ghaṭādir arthakriyākārīpratyakṣasiddhaḥ sā evāyam iti jñānād akṣaṇikaś ca pratīyata eva | tasya ca yadaikakāryakaraṇaṃ prati sāmarthyantattadaiva na pūrvaṃ na paścāttatkāryābhāvāt | sāmarthyaṃ ca tadavyatiriktam evam uttarottarakāryotpattāv api draṣṭavyaṃ | sāmathyabhedena ca padārthabhedāt kṣaṇika eva kramākramayor niyamaḥ | tena yatra sattvan tatra kramākramapratītāv api kṣaṇikatvapraītir eva | ya eva kṣaṇike kramākramayor niyamoyam eva nityeṣu tayor ayogaḥ | tasmād yad etad ghaṭādau nityatvaṃ pratītaṃ tat sattvaviruddham iti nityasya kramayaugapadyābhyām arthakriyāvirodhaḥ siddha ucyate | yathā ca dṛṣṭe ghaṭādau sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvavyāptaṃ tathā 'dṛṣṭeṣv apy aviśeṣād iti vyāptiṃ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipadya yathā teṣu sattvaṃ niścīyate tathā tathā kṣaṇikatvānumānaṃ | sattvāniścaye tu śaśaviṣāṇvatteṣv asattāśaṃkayā kṣaṇikatvāpratītiḥ syāt (|) na ca tatrāpi bādhakapramāṇenaiva kṣaṇikatvasya siddhatvād anumānasya vaiyarthyaṃ | gṛhītavyāptikasya puṃsaḥ sattvaniścayamātreṇaiva sādhyārthāvagater bādhakotthānavaiyarthyāt | vistaratastvayaṃ vyāptigrahaṇaprakāro nairātmyasiddāv abhihita iti tatraivāvadhāryaḥ |
 ye tu sattvasya vipakṣād abhāvena sarvatra kṣaṇikatvavyāotiṃ pratipadya sattvāttatraiva kṣaṇikatvam anumāpayanti | teṣām anumānotthānam eva syāt | vyāptigrahaṇād eva pramāṇat sarvatra kṣaṇikatvasya siddhatvāt | na ca dharmī siddhaḥ sarvasya trailokyasya pratyakṣatvād dhetuś cāsiddhaḥ | pakṣīkṛte ca sarvasmin dharmiṇi bādhakavaśād yadi vipakṣābhāvaḥ siddhas tadā sādhyasyāpi siddhatvān nānumānasyotthānaṃ syāt |
 nānyaś ca dharmi siddha iti kathaṃ bādhakasya pravṛttir iti yat kiñcid etat (|) tasmāt sthitam etad asya sattvaviśiṣṭasya kṛtakatvasya kṣaṇikatvākhyo dharmaḥ svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī asya vā kṣaṇikatvasya svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī kṛtakamātrānubandhī pramāṇadṛṣṭa iti |
 yad vā sattvaviśeṣaṇarahitasyāpi kṛtakatvādeḥ kṣaṇikatve sādhye nānaikāntikatvaṃ | yatas tasya prathame kṣaṇe ya eva svabhāvaḥ sa eva cet dvitīye kṣaṇe tadā 'bhūtvā bhavanam eva syāt prathamakṣaṇavat | tataś ca kṣaṇikatvaṃ | atha prathamakṣaṇe kṛtakasya janmaiva na sthitir dvutīyr tu kṣaṇe sthitir eva na janma | evam api kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt | janmajanminor abhedāt | sthitisthitimatoś ca | na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā sthitir (p.82) yuktā | janma cen na tadā sthitis tasyādvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvitvāt | tatrāpy evam iti sarvatrotpattir eva na sthitir iti kṣaṇikatvam eva | utpattiś ca hetuk´teti tatraiva kṛtakatvaṃ | na sthitau | tasmāt kṛtakatvasyākṣaṇikatvavuruddhatvān nānaikāntikatvaṃ | vistareṇa cāsya kṛtakatvasya kṣaṇikatvavyāptir nai rā tmya si ddhā va1 bhihiteti tatraivāvagantavyā |
fn. 1: Pramāṇavārtika  1.224.
 tasmāt sattvānantarbhūtasyāpi kṛtakatvasya vyāptiḥ pramāṇadṛṣṭā | tadāhāsya svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī pramāṇadṛṣṭas tadbhāvaniyamāt | kṛtakabhāve 'vaśyam anityatābhāvaniyamād iti |
 evaṃ jñātatadbhāvasyān ity asvabhāvaṃ kṛtakaṃ jñānavataḥ puṃsorthāpattyā sādhyasyān ity atvasyābhāve kṛtakan na bhavatīty evaṃ niścayo bhavatīti | yasmān nahi svasyātmabhūtasyān ity atvasyābhāve bhāve bhavati | tadātmabhūtaṃ kṛtakatvambhvati | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) abhedāt sādhyasādhanayoḥ | anyatheti yady anityatvābhāve kṛtakatvanbhavet | tadā tadbhāve kṛtakatvābhāde 'vśyam anityatvambhavatīty eva na syāt | tatheti yathā sādharmyaprayoge vaidharmyagatis tathā vaidharmyaprayogenvayasmṛtir bhavātīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | tadabhāva iti nityatvābhāve kṛtakatvan na bhavaty avaśyam ity ukte | tata eva vaidharmyaprayogāt tadbhāvatāvedinaḥ | sadhanasya sādhyasvabhātāvedinaḥ puṃsaḥ | kathan tadbhāvatāṃ dettīti ced āha – tathā hītyādi | ayam anityatvākhyo dharmosya kṛtakatvasya svabhāvo yena tadabhāve krtakatvan na bhavati | anyatheti (|) anityatvaṃ yadi kṛtakasya svabhāvo na bhavet | tadā tadabhāve k´takatvan na bhaved ity asyāyogāt | iti hetos tatsvabhāvatāpratipattyā kṛtakasyān ity asvabhāvato pratipattyānvayasmṛtie bhavati |
 etad uktam bhavati | ya eva hetoḥ sādhya eva bhāvaḥ sa eva vipakṣe 'bhāva ityanvayavyatirekayos tādātmyamanyonyavyāptiś cāto hetāv anvayapratītyā vyatirekapratītir vyatirekapratītyā cānvayapratītir anumānam eva |
 tena yad ucyate |
(p.83)  "sāmarthyam icchataḥ kī rtte rna ṣṭaṃ dvitvāvadhāraṇam " iti (nyāyamṃjarī?) tadapās taṃ |
  yad vā naivaitat pramāṇaṃ kevalaṃ saṃketavaśād anvayamukhena vyatirekamukheṇa (?na) vā prayuktam ekaṃ vākyam ubhayaṃ gamayatīyt adoṣaḥ |
 svabhāvahetāvanyataraprayogād ubhayagatim uktvā kāryahetāv āha – tathetyādi | yatreti sarvanāmnā sarvopasaṃhāras tatrāgnir avaśyam ity ukte 'smād evānvayavacanāt kāryandhūmo dahanasyety evan niścayo bhavati | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yena dhūme 'vaśyam agnir bhavati | anyathā yadī na kāraṇam agnidhūrmasya tadārthāntarasyāgnes tadanubandhaniyamābhāvāt | dhūme yonubandho vyāpanatanniyamasyābhāvāt | tataś ca svātantryam bhāvasya dhūmasvabhāvasya syāt | ata iti svātantryāt tadabhāvepy agnyabhāvepi dhūmasvabhāvasya vaikalyān nābhāvaḥ syān na caivan tasmāt kāryo dhūma eṣṭavyaḥ | yataḥ kārye tu dhūmebhyupagate 'vaśyan tatra kāraṇam agnir bhavati | idam ity asyaiva samarthaṃ | arthāntarabhāva iti kāryābhimatasya bhāve svabhāvopadhānaṃ svarūpapratyupasthānaṃ | kāryasyāpi tadbhāva eva kāraṇabhāva eva bhāvaḥ kāryatvaṃ | tac ca kāraṇabhāva eva bhāvitvam asti dhūme | tasmāt kāryaṃ dhūma ity evam anvayena viditatatkāryatvasya puṃso dahanābhāve dhūmo na bhavatīty arthād bhavati |
 adhunā vaidharmyeṇānvayagatim āha – tathetyādi | asatyagnau dhūmo na bhavatīty ukte 'smād vyatirekavacanād viditatatkāryatvasya dhūme 'vaśyam agnir bhavatīty evam arthād anvayapratipattir bhavati | anyathā yadi vaidharmyavacanenāgneḥ kāryaṃ dhūma ity etan na kathyate tadabhāve 'gnyabhāve kin na bhaved dhūmo bhavedeveti vyatirekaniścaya eva na syāt | tasmāt sthitam etat (|) satyarthāntaratve yadabhāve yasvaśyan na bhavati tattasya kāryam ataś ca vyatirekakathanād anvayo gamyata iti |
(p.84) atra paro vyabhicāram āha – nanu cetyādi nityānityāethayoḥ kāryannityānityārthakāryantadbhāvastattvaṃ tasyābhāvepi | tathā hi śravaṇajñānaṃ śabdasyaiva dharmatvās asādhāraṇan tatra na jñāyate sataḥ śabdasya kāryaṃ śravaṇajñāṇamutānityasyeti | tataś ca na nityārthakāryatvaṃ śravaṇajñānasya nāpy anityārthakāryatvan tathāpi śravaṇajñānan na bhavati tadabhāvepi nityānityārthābhāve | tadvyatireke vyatiricyata iti yāvat | nityārthābhāve tāvan na bhavaty anityeṣu ghaṭādiṣv abhāvāt | anityābhāvepi na bhavati nityeṣvākāśādiṣv abhāvāt | na vai na bhavatīti si ddhā ntavādī | na vai tacchrāvaṇatvan nityābhave na bhavatīty evaṃ śakyam vijñātuṃ | yadi tu tadabhāvena bhavatīty evan niścayaḥ syāt tadā tatkāryatvaṃ nniyamena syāt kin tu tadabhāve na bhavatīty eva nāsti | kiṅkāraṇan tayor eva nityānityatvayos tataḥ śrāvaṇatvāt saṃśayāt | anyathā nityānitye vastunyabhāvena niścitāc chrāvaṇatvāt kathan tadbhāvaparāmarśena śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt | tasmān nityānityābhyāṃ vyāvattir eva nāsti śrāvaṇatvasya |
 kathan tarhy asādhāraṇatvāc chrāvaṇatvaṃ nityānityayor nāstīty ucyata ity āha – kevalantv ityādi | nityāniteṣu śrāvaṇatvasya bhāvaniścayābhāvāt | śrāvaṇatvaṃ nityānatyayor nāstīty ucyate |
 nanv anityādike sādhye yadi śrāvaṇatvaṃ sapakṣavipakṣayor dṛṣṭaṃ syāt | syāc chabde śrāvaṇatvāt sandehaḥ | prameyatvād iva | na caitat sapakṣāvipakṣayor dṛṣṭam ato 'pratipattir iti bhaṭṭodyotakarau | atha śabdavastu kadā cin nityam anityam vā vastu dharmaś ca śrāvaṇatvantenātaḥ sabdeha ucyate |
 tad ayuktaṃ | evaṃ hi vastudharmatvasyaiva sandehahetutvaṃ syān na śrāvaṇatvasyeti | atrocyate | yadi hi yatra yatra śrāvaṇatvan tatra tatra nityānityayor abhāva iti pratipannaṃ syāt tato nityānityayor apratipattiḥ syāt | na cānityādiyuktaṃ gjaṭādau śrāvaṇatvasyābhāva iti śabdaabhāvas tena śrāvaṇatvāt tatra sandeha eva |
 nanu śrāvaṇatvaṃ śravaṇajñānaṃ prati sāmarthyan na ca nityasya sāmarthyam asty arthakriyāvirodhāt (|) tatkatham ataḥ sandehaḥ (|) anityatvasyaiva niścayād iti |
 evam manyate | yadi sāmarthyamātraṃ hetus tadā sattvam eva tad iti na kācit kṣatiḥ (|) (|) tasya sapakṣasādhāraṇatvād evaṃ prameyatvādiṣv api draṣṭavyaṃ | atha śravaṇajñānaṃ prati yat sāmarthyan tad dhetus tac ca na kvacid anityatvavyāptaṃ siddham iti katham ato 'nityatvasiddhir asādhāraṇatvād ayaṃ śabda eva tadanityatvavyāptaṃ siddhaṃ | tenaiva hi bādhakena (p.85) pramāṇenānityatvasya tatra siddhatvāc chrāvaṇatvasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | evaṃ sa cāsādhāraṇahetunāmagamakatvaṃ boddhavyaṃ |
 tasmāt sthitam etat (|) kāryaheto dṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanayor hetuphalabhāvaḥ kathanīyo na tu darśanādarśanamātraṃ | evaṃ hy arthāpattyā 'nyatareṇa dvitīyapratītir bhavet | anyathā na syād ity āha – yadā punar ityādi | tadā yatra dhūmas tatrāgnir ity eva na syād ity anvaya eva na syāt pratibandhābhāvāt | yadā cānvaya eva na siddhas tadā kutognyabhāve dhūmo nāstīty arthād vyatirekasiddhiḥ | tathā vaidharmyeṇādarśanamātrasya khyāpanāt sādhyābhāve hetvabhāvāsiddheḥ kutas tadvāreṇānvayasmṛtiḥ | yathokta iti tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇaḥ | ekasadbhāve kāryasvabhāvaliṅgasya sadbhāve 'nyaprasiddhy arthaṃ kāraṇasya svabhāvasya ca liṅganaḥ prasiddhy arthaṃ | tadabhāve yathoktapratibandhābhāve satyekasadbhāve 'nyaprasiddher asanbhavāt || (30)
 hetusvabhāvābhāva iti hetvabhāvo vyāpakasvabhāvābhāvaś ca | ata ity anantaroktāt kāraṇāt kasyā sit kāryasya vyāpi asya ca pratiṣedhe | cakārāt pratiṣedhavyavahāre ca sādhye | hetur liṅgaṃ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmāt tāv eva hi kāraṇavyāpakauni varttamānau svapratibaddhaṃ kāryaṃ ca svabhāvaṃ nivartayata iti kasya cid arthasya kāryasya vyāpyasya vā pratiṣedham api sādhayitukāmena | apiśabdād vyavahāram api (|) hetoḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya nivṛttir hetutvenākhyeyā | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | apratibandhe hītyādi | na ca tābhyām anyaḥ pratibandhostīti bhāvaḥ | yukto nyāyya upalmbho yasya sa tathādaśyasyety arthaḥ | tasya (p.86) ceti svabhāvasyānupalambhanaṃ pratiṣrdhahetuḥ | nacāyaṃ pratiṣedhasyaiva hetuḥ kintu pratiṣedhaviṣayo vyavahāras tasya hetur iti kṛtvā tad dhetuḥ pratiṣedhahetur ityuktaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na pratiṣedhahetus tathābhūtānupalambhasya dṛśyāmupalambhasya svayaṃ pratiṣedharūpatvāt | hetur vyāpakānupalabdhir iti kāraṇānupalabdhir vyāpakānupalabdhiś ca | ubhayasyāpīti pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedhavyavahārasya ca || (31)
 iti evam iyam anupalabdhiḥ | saṃkṣipya tridhāpy uktā satī punar anekadhoktā | yathātraivā 'ṣṭadhā prāg vibhaktā | kena prakāreṇety āha – tattadviruddhetyādi | tacchabdena prakrāntaṃ svabhāvakāraṇavyāpakatrayaṃ gṛhyate | tena svabhāvaditrayeṇa viruddhanta dviruddhantrividham eva bhavati | svabhāvaviruddhakāraṇaviruddhavyāpakaviruddhabhedāḥ | tadviruddham ādir yasya tattadviruddhādi | ādiśabdena viruddhakāryasya kāraṇaviruddhakāryasya ca parigrahaḥ | tav va tadviruddhādi | tayor agatigatī | tadagatis tadviruddhādigatiś cety arthaḥ | tayor bhedas tena prayogas tasmāt prayogabhedatonekadhoktā | tatra tadagatyā tisronupalabdhayaḥ saṅgṛhītāḥ svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ vyāpakānupalabdhiś ca | tadviruddhagatyā tisra eva | svabhāvaviruddhopalabdhiḥ kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhiḥ vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiś ca | ādiśabdāt viruddhakāryopalabdhiḥ kāraṇaviruddhakāryopalabdhiā ceti | evam aṣṭavidhasya prāguktasyānupalambhasya saṅgraho bhavati |
 trividha eva hītyādinā kārikārtham āha – upalabhyasattvasyety upalambhayogyasya hetor anupalabdhir iti sambandhaḥ | vyāpakasya svātmanaś copalambhyasattvasyeti varttate | soyantrividhapratiṣedhahetuḥ prayogavaśenānekaprakāra ukta iti sambandhaḥ | kathaṃ prayoga baśenety āha – tattadviruddhādyagatigatibhedaprayogata iti | etad eva tasyāgatyetyādinā vibhajyate | tasyāgatyeti svabhāvakāraṇavyāpakānupalabdhyā | tadviruddhagatyeti svabhāvvakāraṇavyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā | viruddhakāryagattyeti viruddhakāryopalabdhyā | (p.87) ityādibhedaprayogair iti kāraṇaviruddhakāryopalabdhyādibhedaprayogaiḥ | yathoktaṃ prāganupalabdhiprabhedacintāyāṃ (1|6) || (32)
 yata evaṃ pratibandhavaśād gamakatvāttasmāt | kāryakāranabhāvād vā niyāmakāt sādhyasādhanayor avyabhicārasādhakāt svabhāvād vā tādātmyalakṣaṇān niyāmakāt | kāryasya svabhāvasya ca liṅgasyāvinābhāvaḥ sādhyadharmaṃ vinā na uty arthaḥ | na cāsādhāraṇasya sādhyāvinābhāvosti sandehahetutvāt | avinābhāve tu tanniśycāyakenaiva pramāṇena tatra dharmiṇi sādhyasya siddhatvāt katham asya gamakatvaṃ |
 tena bhaṭṭenayad ucyate ||
 avinābhāvaśabdopy ...... sakalārthabhāk |
 nānumā yogyasambandhapratipatti karoti naḥ ||
 yadi tāvad vinābhāvo na sa paścād viśiṣyate |
 tato 'sādhāraṇepy asti sa iti syād akāraṇaṃ ||
 yo hy asādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sa tenaivātmasātkṛtaḥ |
 vinā na bhavatīty eva jñāto hetuḥ prasajyata iti (|)
tadapāstaṃ | avinābhāva eva hi niyamaḥ | sādhyaṃ vinā na bhavatīti kṛtvā | yady evaṃ kim arthaṃ punar niyamagrahaṇaṃ (|) sattyaṃ (|) paramatanirāsārthaṃ | sa hy avinābhāvavyatirekeṇānyaṃ niyamam icchati | yadāha bhaṭṭaḥ ||
 evam anyoktasambandhapratyākhyāne kṛte sati |
 niyamo nāma sambandhaḥ svamatenocyate 'dhunā ||
 kāryakāraṇabhāvādisambandhānāṃ dvayī gatiḥ |
 niyamāniyamābhyāṃ syān niyamasyānumāṅgatā ||
 sarvepy aniyamā hy ete nānumotpattikāraṇaṃ |
 niyamāt kevalād evan na kiñcin nānumīyate ||
 tasmān niyama evaikaḥ sambandho 'trāvadhāryate |
 gamakasyaiva gamyena sa ceṣṭaḥ prāṅ nirupitaḥ ||
 niyamasmarataḥ samyag niyamyaikāṅgadarśanāt |
 niyāmakāṅgavijñānam anumānan tadaṅgiṣv iti (|) tadapāstaṃ ||
 (p.88) kāyakāraṇabhāvādisambandhābhāve niyama eva na syāt | apratibaddhānāṃ sahabhāvaniyamābhāvāt | pāṇḍutvādimātrasya cāgnyakāryatvāt | deśakālādyapekṣayā ca liṅgasya gamakatvān niyama eveti kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvādisambandhepi dvayī gatirucyate | atha syāt (|) kāryakāraṇabhāvādisambandham abhyupagacchatāpi yāvat sādhanasya sādhyeniyamo na niścitas tāvan na sādhyapratipattyaṅgatvantena kāryakāraṇabhāve saty api eva sambandhobhyupagamyate | tasyaiva pratipattyaṅgatvāt tadvaktuṃ sa evaikonumānāṅgaṃ śeṣās tadvyaktihetava iti | tadayuktaṃ (|) niyamo hi tadāyattataiva (|) sā ca tādātmyatadutpattisvabhāvaiva (|) tena tādātmyatadutpattiniścaya eva niyamaniścayo na punar darśanādarśanābhyān niyamaniścayo vyabhicārāt |
 nanu yathā darśanādarśanayor niyamaniācayaṃ prati vyabhicāras tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayepi syād iti |
 tad ayuktaṃ | viśiṣṭābhyām eva darśanādarśanābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayābhyupagamāt | etac cātraiva vakṣyati |
 yad apy umvekenocyate | śataśo yad agnau dhūmadarśanan tadanyathānupapattyā niyatoyaṃ dhūmognāv iti yan niyamajñānam utpadyate | tasyān agnau dhūmadarśanam bādhakaṃ (|) na ca tad astīti dhūmasyāgnau niyama iti |
 tad ayuktaṃ | agnikāryatvābhāve hy anagnau dhūmadarśanasyānupalabdhimātratvenāpramāṇasyābādhakatvād anagnau dhūmasya śaṃkyamānatvena kathaṃ agnau niyamaḥ (|) stasmāt sthitam etat (|)
 kāryakāraṇabhāvād vā svabhāvād vā niyāmakād (|)
 avinābhāvaniyamaḥ (|) kāryakāraṇabhāvādiniścayāc cāvinābhāvaniyamaniścayo 'darśanān na na darśanāt (|) sādhyābhāve hetor adarśanamātrān nāvinābhāvaniyamaniścayaḥ | na darśanāt | nāpi sādhyasādhanayoḥ sahabhāvadarśanāt |
 tasmāt tadutpattyaivārthāntarasyārthāntareṇāvinābhāvaḥ |
 anyathetyāsatyāntadutpattau paraiḥ sādhyābhimataiḥ parasyānātmābhūtasya ligasya ko 'vaśyambhāvaniyamaḥ | anarthantare tu liṅge tanmātrānubandhitvaṃ sādhyadharmasyeṣṭavyam anyathā kṛtakatvasya yan nimittan tasmād arthāntaram udgarādinimittaṃ yasyā nityatvasyeṣyate | (p.89) tasmin vā dharme 'vaśyambhāvaniyamaḥ kaḥ | kim iva vāsasi rāgavat | niṣpanne vāsasi kusumbhādinimitto yo rāgaḥ paścādbhāvī || (33,34)
 tatra yathā nāvaśyambhāvaniyamas tadvad anityatvasyārthāntarahetutva iṣyamāṇe na kevalamayandoṣo 'yamaparo doṣa ity āha – api cetyādi | arthāntar animitto nityatvākhyo dharmaḥ syād anya eva (|) tasmāt svabhāvabhūtāt kṛtakādes tathāhi sādhyadharmasyārthantaranimittatvābhyupagame dvayam iṣṭaṃ sādhananiṣpattāvaniṣpattibhinnahetukatvaṃ ca | etac ca nāntareṇa svabhāvabhedaṃ ghaṭate | yasmān na hi tasmin sādhanasvabhāve niṣpannepy aniśpanno bhinnahetuko vā sādhyadharmas tatsvabhāvo yuktaḥ | pūrvaniśpannasya bhinnnahetukasya ca liṅgasya svabhāve yukto yasmād ayam eva khalu lokapratīto bhedo bhāvānāṃ yo viruddhadharmādhyāso viruddhadharmayogaḥ | niṣpattyaniśpattī cātra viruddhau dharmau | tathāyam eva bhedahetur bhedasya janako yaḥ kāraṇabhedaḥ sāmagrībhedaś cātra kāraṇabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | etena bhedasvarūpabhedakāraṇañcoktaṃ ||
 bhedapratibhāsas tu bhedagrāhakaḥ | tau ced biruddhadharmādhyāsakāraṇabhedau na bhedakāviśye(?ṣye)te | tadā na kasya cid vastunaḥ kutaś cid arthād  bheda ityekandravyamviśvaṃ samastañjagat syāt | traiguṇyasyāviśeṣādaikyaṃ sarvasyeṣṭam eveti cedāha – tataś cety ekatvāt sahotpattivināśau | ekasyotpāde sarvasyotpādo vināśe ca vināśaḥ syād ity arthaḥ | sarvasya ca sarvatra kārya upayogaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ syād | sahotpatyādyanabhyupahame | sarvam vastv ekam ity eva na syāt | athopayogādibhedena parasparabhinnātmateṣyate bhedā(nāṃ) nāmāntaram vā syāt | bahūnām ekam iti saṃjñā kṛtā syāt | kiṅkāraṇam (|) arthaṃ parasparabhinnamabhyupagamya tathābhidhānāt | ekam ity abhidhānāt |
 (p.90) atha syāt prākpradhvaṃsābhāvāntar vartisattāsambandho 'nityatā | sā ca kṛtakaniṣpattikāle niṣpannaiva kevalaṃ pradhvaṃsennottarakālamabhivyajyata iti (|)
 tad apy ayuktaṃ | yato yāvat pradhvaṃ so notpadyate tāvat katham antarālavarttyanityatā | pradhvaṃsotpattāv api katham antarālavarttitvam asyāḥ (|) kṛtakasvabhāvatvam vā bhāvasyaivābhāvāt |
 nanv ityādi paraḥ | anarthāntarahetutvepi vināśakāraṇānapekṣatvepi tvanmatenān ity atāyāḥ | bhāvakāle 'nityatāniṣpatteḥ | njāvasya sattākāle tasyā anityatāyā aniṣpatte bhārvāduttarakālam anityatā bhavatīti manyate | tulyā 'tatsvabhāvā | yathārthāntarahetutvepi niṣpattiḥ syāt (|) tayor nānātvantarthā 'narthāntarahetutvepīti tulyā 'tatsvabhāvatā |
 netyādinā pratividhatte | apūrvasvabhāvalābho niṣpattir ucyate 'nityatā ca bhāvanivṛttirūpā tato niṣpatter evābhāvāt kathaṃ viruddhadharmasargaḥ | yadi tarhi nānityatā vastu satī kathaṃ sādhyasādhanayos tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandha ity āha – sa eva hi bhāva iti | kṣaṇe sthitir yā saiva yasyeti | nivṛttidharmā svabhāva evānityatocyate sa eva sādhyaḥ | tena tādātmyaṃ hetusādhyayor vyatiriktārthatvanityatā nīrūpā (|) tena bhāvasyānityatā bhavatītīty evam ādibhir vākyair bhāvasya na kiṃcidrupaṃ vidhīyate 'pi tu dṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ nāstīty ayam arthobhidhīyate dharmāntarābhidhāne bhāvanivṛttyapratipādanaprasaṅgāt |
 yadi bhāva evānityatā kathan tarhi śabdasya dharmiṇo nityatā dharma iti vacanabheda ity ata āha – vacanabhedepītyādi | dharmadharmitayā yo vacanabhedo vācakānyatvan tatrāpi nimittamuttar atra vakṣyāmaḥ |
 etena yad apy ucyate 'dhyayanāvidvakaṇṇordyotakarādibhiḥ | yadi tulāntayornāmonnāmavatkāryetpattikāla eva kāraṇavināśaḥ | yadi(?tadā) kāryakāraṇabhāve na syād yataḥ kāraṇasya vināśaḥ kāraṇotpāda(ḥ |) evaṃ bhāva eva nāśa iti vacanād evañ ca kāraṇena saha kāryam utpannam iti prāptaṃ | yadi ca bhāva eva nāśaḥ prathamepi kṣaṇe bhāvasya na sattā syāt | vināśād bhāvanivṛttiś ca bināśo lokapratīto (p.91) na bhāva eva | sarvakālaṃ ca nāśasadbhāvād bhāvasya satvaṃ syāt | atha kāraṇotpādāt kāraṇvināśo bhinnas tadā kṛtakasvabhāvatvam anityatvasya na syāt | vyatirikte ca nāśe jāte tasya kṣaṇasya na nivṛttir iti kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti (|)
 tadapāstaṃ (|) dvividho hi vināśa bhāvanivṛttirūpo bhāvaś ca (|) tenptpnnno bhāvaḥ kāryaṅgaroti kāryakāle ca kāraṇanivṛttirūpo vināśo lokapratīta eva (|) nāyam bhāvasvabhāva iṣyate (|) nāpi kāraṇotpādād abhinno bhinno vā nīrūpatvāt kevalamasya bhedābhrdapratiṣedha eva kriyate | tathā ca vakṣyati (|)

 aviddhakarṇṇas tv āha – avinābhāvitvaṃ ekaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyādidarśane satisidhyati(|) na ca kṣaṇikavādino draśṭurara(?)vasthānam asti | na cāntenānubhūterthenyasyāvinābhāvitvasmaraṇam asty atiprasaṅgād iti (|)

 nanv evam api kṣaṇānām aniścayena kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayo na ca santānena tanniścayas tasya santānibhyo bhinnasyābhāvāt kevalaṃ santānina eva pūrvāparakālabhāvinaḥ (|) tatra ca yadaikaḥ kṣaṇo na tadānya iti ekakṣaṇāvabhāsa eveti kathaṃ santānāvabhāsaḥ (|) tadabhāvāt kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva iti (|)

 atha dhūmasyānyatrāgnijanyatve na kiṃ cid bādhakam asti tad evedam iti ca pratītes tatsāmānyam pratipannam iṣyate 'smākam api tad evedam iti pratyayasyotpattes tatpratipannam iṣyata ity āvayoḥ kobheda iti (|)

 nirastaṃ | prathamasya hy agnijanyasya dhūmakṣaṇasyāparognijanya eva dhūmakṣaṇas tādṛśo dhūmakṣaṇajānyasya dhūmakṣaṇasya dvitīyasyānyo dhūmakṣaṇajanya eva dvitīyo dhūmakṣaṇas tādṛśo bhavati (|) tathā tṛtīyādikṣaṇeṣv apīti kṣaṇāpekṣayāpy avyabhicāras tādṛśasya | etam evāha – tādṛśād dhi bhavṃs tādṛśaḥ syāt | anyādṛśad apy avahnisadṛśād api yadi tādṛśo bhaved vahnijanitadhūmatulyasvabhāvo bhavet | tacchaktiniyamābhāvāt | sadaśāsadṛśayoḥ kāraṇayor yā śaktis tasyā yo niyamaḥ sadṛśī sadṛśam eva janayatyasadṛśī vilakṣaṇam iti tasyābhāvāt kāraṇān na hetubhedaḥ kāryasya bhedaka iti kutvā 'kāraṇam viśvasya vaiśvarūpyaṃ syāt | yataḥ kutaś cit kāraṇād utpatter nāhetukatvam iti ced āha – sarvaṃ vā sarvasmād ityādi | aśaktād api ced utpattiḥ sarvaṃ sarvasmājjāyeta (|) na caivaṃ | tasmād ityādi | tan na dhūma iti | tad iti tasmād yata utpadyamāno dhūmo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dṛṣṭākāro vahniḥ | tadvijātīyād avahner ity arthaḥ || (35,36)
 (p.102) tathā cety ahetukatve sati nityaṃ satvam asattvam vā dhūmasya syāt | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) ahetor bhāvasya svaniṣpattāvanyānpekṣaṇā(t) | kāraṇāntarānapekṣaṇāt | kāraṇāntarānapekṣayvepi kādācitkaṃ svabhāvato ced āha – apekṣāto hīti |
 etad uktam bhavati (|) aniṣpannasyāsattvād eva kathaṃ svabhāvato kādācitkatvaṃ niṣpannasya tv asti svabhāvaḥ kevalaṃ saiva niṣpattiḥ kathaṃ kvacid bhavatīti codyate | sa hītyādinaitad eva vyācaṣṭe | na kadācin na bhavet sarvakālam bhavet | kiṅkāraṇa tadbhāve dhūmasvabhāvasya bhāve | kāraṇānapekṣatvena vaikalyābhāvāt | iṣṭakālavat | tadāpi ceti dṛṣṭakālepi dhūmo na bhavet | dhūmābhāvakālāviśeṣāt |
 paścādarddhamvibhājann āha – apekṣayā hīti | yogyadeśakālāpekṣayā | yasmāt kāryasya yau bhāvābhāvakālau tayor yathākraman tadbhāvasya kāryotpādasya yo yogyatāyogyate tābhyāṃ yogāt | kālagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaparam evaṃ deśadravyayor api vācyaṃ | arthaivaṃ neṣyate | tadā tulye yogyatāyogyate yayoḥ kāryabhāvābhāvavator deśakālayos tayos tadvattetarayor niyamāyogāt | kāryakālasyaiva tadvttā | kāryavattā | tadanyasyetarā | akāryavattety asya niyanasyāyogāt | dvāv api tau kāryabhāvābhāvakālau kāryavantau syātāṃ yogyatā sādṛśyāt | na vā | tulyatvād ayogyatāyāḥ | tasmāt tadbhāvakālasyaiva yogyatā | tāṃ vāpekṣamāṇa(ā) bhāvāḥ kādācitkā bhavanti |
 bhavatu nāmeṣṭasya deśakālāderyogyatā | na tāvatā hetubhāva ity ata āha – sā cetyādi | yata evam ahetutve nityaṃ sattvāsattvaṃ syān na ca bhavati |
 tasmād ityādi | yat parihāreṇa pravartate tadanapekṣaḥ | yatra ca tatsāpekṣaḥ | yadi nāma kvacid deśādau vṛttas tathāpi kathan tatsāpekṣa iti ced āha – tathā hīti | tathā vṛttir ity ekaparihāreṇān yatra vṛttiḥ | deśādikam apekṣata eva bhāvaḥ (|) tena tu deśādinā na tasyopakāraḥ kriyata iti ced āha – tatkṛtopakāretyādi | tanniyayamāyogād (p.103) iti | tasmin naiva deśādau tena na bhāvyam iti niyamāyogāt (|) tad iti tasmād deśakālagrahaṇam uplakṣaṇaṃ dravyasyāpi parigrahaḥ | yatreti deśādau dṛṣṭaḥ sakṛd iti | yathoktena pratyakṣeṇa yeṣāṃ sannidhāne dṛṣṭas teṣām evānyataravaikalyaṃ ca punar na dṛṣṭaḥ | anyatheti yadi tajjñyosya svabhāvo na syāt sa iti dhūmas tatpratiniyatognyādikasāmagrī hi yataḥ | agner anyatra kathan bhaven naiva bhavet | bhavan vā na dhūmaḥ syāt | yasmāt tajjanito hy agnijanito hi svabhāvaviśeṣo dhūma iti | tathā hetur api vahnis tathābhūtakāryajananasvabhāvo dhūmajananayogyatāsvabhāvo dhūmarahitāvasthāyām apy asty eva yogyatā kāraṇabhūteti | tena nā 'yāpi lakṣaṇaṃ | evam agnidhūmayoḥ parasparāpekṣayā niyatasvabhāvatve pratyakṣavyavasthāpite |
 yadi tasya dhūmasyāgner anyatopi bhāva iṣyate tadā na sa dhūmajananaḥ svabhāvas tasyāvahneḥ | tathā hy anagner yadā dhūmasyotpattis tadānagner eva dhūmajananaḥ svabhāvo jātaḥ | yaś cānagneḥ svabhāvaḥ sa katham agneḥ syāt | tataś cādhūmajananasvabhāvatvād agneḥ sakṛd api na dhūmaṃ janayeta | dhūmasyāpi dhūmasvabhāvatā na syād ity āha – na cetyādi | agner anyato bhavan na vā sa dhūmaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) adhūmajananasvabhāvād anagner bhāvād utpatteḥ | tatsvabhāvatve cānagner api dhūmajananasvabhāvatve cābhyupagamyamāne |sa evāgnir dhūmajananakarūpatvād asya ity anena dvāreṇāvyabhicāro dhūmasya || (37)
 (p.104) agnisvabhāva iti dhūmajananasvabhāvo yadīty arthaḥ | agnir eva sa śakramūrddhā dhūmajananasvabhāvatvāt | athānagnisvabhāvosau śakramūrddhā | tatreti śakramūrddhanī | kasmān na bhaved ity āha – dhūmetyādi | hi yasmāt | dhāmahetusvabhāvo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | kuta etat tacchaktibhedavān | tathā dhūmajanikayā śaktyā karaṇabhūtayā vastvantarāt khadyotāder bhedavān visadṛśaḥ | adhūmahrtor ity avahnisvabhāvād dhūmasya bhāve utpāde 'bhyupagamyamāne sa dhūmaḥ syād ahetukaḥ | yathoktaṃ prāk |
 kayam ityādi paraḥ | idānīm ity ekasya dhūmāder vijātīyād utpattyanabhyupagame | katham bhinnāt parasparavijātīyāt | sahakāriṇaḥ sakāśād ekasya kāryasyotpattiḥ | katham ity āha – yathetyādi | ādiśabdād ālokamanaskārādayaḥ | evañ ca sati cakṣuḥ svabhāvād apy utpadyate vijñānam acakṣuḥsvabhāvād api rūpamanaskārāder na cedam ahetukaṃ | evaṃ dhūmopy agner etpadyatām anagneś ca śakramūrdhnaḥ | na cāgetuko bhaviṣyatīti codako manyate |
 na vai kiṃ cid ityādinā pratividhatte | cakṣur ādiṣu tatsvabhāvaṃ janakasvabhāvaṃ sadekaikaṃ parasparānapekṣaṃ na vai janakaṃ (|) yadi hi syāt tadā pratyekaṃ kāraṇavyabhicārād ahetukaṃ syāt | kin tu sāmagrī janikā | tatsvabhāvā janakasvabhāvā | sāmagrī janikety etān ataiva tatsvabhāvatvaṃ labdhamatatsvabhāvasyājanakatvāt tat kiṃ svabhāveti pṛthag ucyate | satyaṃ kintvavadhāraṇārtham uktaṃ | sāmagryavasthāyām eva tatsvabhāvatā | na pūrvan na paścān na pṛthag iti | svahetusāmarthyaniyatasannidhīty ekasmin kārye samastāv anye kāraṇāni hetur iti samudāyārthaḥ |
 kecit tu vā śabdaṃ paṭhanti (|) sānagrī janikā tatsvabhāvā veti | atra tu vāśabdasya na kiṃ sit prayojanam ity a(pa)pāṭha evāyaṃ | yadi sāmagrīty uktvā sāmagry antarād api cakṣur vijñānaṃ syāt tadā bhinnād utpāder ahetukatvam bhavet | saiva sāmgry anumīyate | kāryeṇa na pratyekaṃ kāraṇād anyato nāsti vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ |
 syād etad agnyādisāmagryā ādya eva dhūmakṣaṇo janito na ca tasya liṅgatvantasyāniścayāt | (p.105) yaś ca dhūmapratibandho gṛhyate pūrvadhūmahetur eva (|) kathan tatognyādisāmagryā anumānam ity ata āha – saiva cetyādi kāryaprabandhasya svabhāvasthiteḥ | āśraya ādyaṃ kāraṇaṃ | sāmagrīm antareṇa dhūmasantānasyaivābhāvāt | tato dhūmasantānam agnikāryatvenaikīkṛtya dahanādisantateḥ kāraṇabhūtāyā anumānaṃ | na hi kṣaṇavibhāgenārvāgdarśanasya |
 syād etad (|) atīva eva vahnir anumīyate | na ca tenārthakriyārthinaḥ kiṃcit prayojanam ity etad api codyamānenaiva parihṛtaṃ | tadā cāyam arthaḥ (|) saiva ca sāmagrī prabandhena pravarttamānā kāryasvabhāvasthiteḥ kāryaprabandhavṛtter hetuḥ pūrvapūrvam agnyādikṣaṇaṃ pratītyottarottarasya dhūmakṣaṇasyotpatteḥ | na hy ayaṃ niyamo yad eka eva dhūmakṣaṇogninā janyo nāpara iti | yāvadindhanasya na sarvathā bhasmībhavanantāvad dhūmakṣaṇānām utpattir viruddhā | tasmād uttarottaradahanakṣaṇajananam arthenaprabandhapravṛttenāgninā yathābhūto dhūmaprabandho janitaḥ pratyakṣāvadhāritas tathābhūtam anyatrāvadhāryārthakriyāsam arthadahanasantānasyānumānan tadarthino na viruddham (|) anya eva ca svabhāvo vicchinnadahanasantānasya dhūmasyānya eva vicchinnadahanasantater vāsagṛhādisthasya | aphuṭaś ca tayor bhedamavadhārayati loka iti kuto vyabhicāraḥ |
 athavā 'nyathā vyākhyāyate |
 nanu sāmagrī samagrebhyonyā | tasyāś caikatvād ekam eva kāryam utpadyate 'nyathā samagrāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ sāmarthyāt kāryabahutvam paryāyeṇa caikakāryajanakatvaṃ syān na ca bhavati | tasmāt katham ekajanakatvam ity āśaṃkyāha –
 saiva cetyādi | saiva ca sāmagrīti samagrā eva sāmagrī śabdenocyante | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | svabhāvasthityā svarūpasannidhānena kāryasyāśrayo bhavati yataḥ |
 evam manyate | yadi sāmagryā eva kāryotpattis tadā samagrāṇām akārakatvaṃ syāt | tathā ca pratītibādhā | samagrāṇām api kārakatve sutarāṃ kāryabahutvaṃ syāt | paryāyeṇa caikakāryajanakatvaṃ syāt | na ca sāmagrībalāt teṣām ekarūpatā | sāmagryā evābhāvaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt te samgrāḥ svahetubhya evaikakāryakaraṇe niyatā utpannāḥ sāmagrīśabdenocyante | na ca bahūnām ekakāryakaraṇe bādhakam asti | na cāsmākaṅ kāraṇam eva kāryo bhavatīti mataṃ yenānekasyaikakāryatvam virudhyeta | yathā caikakāryaṃ tyeprakasya prāgbhāva eva kāraṇatvan dṛṣṭatvāt tathānekasyāpi (|) yathā vā ta eva samagrāḥ saṃyogalakṣaṇām ekāṃ sāmagṛīñ janayanti | tathaikam api kāryaṃ kin na kurvantīti (|)
 (p.106) yat kiñcid etat | yataś ca sāmagrījanikā 'ta eva sahakāriṇām aparyāyeṇa jananaṃ | paripāṭyā jananaṃ nāstīty arthaḥ |
 yad apītyādinā vijātīyād utpattimāśaṃkya pariharati | nānyādṛśāttādṛ(śa)ntasyotpattir iti yad uktan tad evātra darśayatīty arthaḥ | ādiśabdād gauśṛṅgāccharo gosayād vṛścikaḥ (|) tatrāpīti vijātīyāt kāryotpattāv api | tathābhidhānepīti vjjātīyotpannasya śālūkādeḥ śālūkād ity abhidhānepi svavījācchālūkādilakṣaṇāt prabhava utpattir asya tasmāt svavījaprabhavācchālūkādeḥ sakaśād asty eva svabhāvabhedaḥ | bījāt kandāccodbhavo yasyāḥ kadalyāḥ sā tathā | sā ca hrtutvabhedāt parasparabhinnā |
 na cāyam bhedaḥ sādhanīya ity āha – sphuṭam ityādi | vivecayati bhede vā bhāvasyeti | suvicecitākāraṃ bhrāntir hetubhyaḥ sadṛśākārebhyo vibhāgena niścit ākāraṃ || (38,39)
 tadbhāva eva bhāvo 'nvayaḥ | tadabhāve cābhāva eva vyatirekaḥ | anvayo vyatirekaś cānvayavyatirekan tasmāt | yaḥ kāryasvabhāvo yasyānuvarttanīyasya kāraṇasyānuvarttako dṛṣṭas tasyānuvarttakasya svabhāvas tad dhetuḥ sonuvarttanīyaḥ kāraṇāt sā hetur yasyeti vigrahaḥ | yadā tu kāraṇāpekṣayocyate tadā svabhāvas tasyānuvarttanīyasyāgnyādes tad dhetus tasya kāryābhimatasya dhūmāder hetuḥ | yataś caivaṃ parasparāprkṣayā kāryakāraṇayo(ḥ) svabhāvaniyamaḥ | ataḥ kāraṇād bhinnād vijātīyān na sambhavaḥ |
tasmāt sakṛd api darśanādarśanābhyām iti yathoktābhyāṃ | pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddheḥ kāraṇād bhavati (|) tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhitaḥ tatpratipattir anvayaṃ vyatirekapratipattir nānyatheti kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayanty aktvā kevalābhyān (p.107) darśanādarśanābhyāṃ nānvayavyatirekayoḥ pratipattiḥ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) niḥśeṣidarśanādarśanāyattatvād darśanamātrapratibaddhāyā anvayavyatirekapratipatteḥ| evaṃ hi darśanam anvayaṃ sādhayati yadi niḥśeṣe sapakṣe hetor darśanaṃ syāt | evam adarśanam api vyatirekaṃ sādhayet | yadi niḥśeṣe sādhyavyatireke hetor adarśanaṃ syāt | yathaikatra dhūmavyakto sakṛd api kāryatvasiddhyā sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ (|) eva kvacit sapakṣāsapakṣayor darśanād adarśanāt sarvatrānvayavyatirekaniścayo bhaviṣyatīty api mithyā (|) yasmāt kvacid amūrtatve ākāśādigate nityatvasya darśane | paraprasiddhyā caitad ucyate | anyatra sukhādau| anyathety anityatve hetor amūrttatvasya dṛṣīeḥ kāraṇād ekatra darśanaṃ na sarvatra tathābhāvasādhanam ato darśanam avvaye vyabhicāri | tathā kvacid ghaṭādau nityatvābhāvepy adṛṣṭasyāmūrttatvasya punar nityatvābhāva eva sukhādao dṛṣṭer ato vipakṣaukadeśādarśanam asādhanaṃ vyatirekaniścaye tasmād dhetuphalabhāvaniścayād evānvayavyatirekayor niścayaḥ | (40)
 svabhāva ityādi paraḥ | idānīm iti kāryahetāvavinābhāve sādhite saṃprati svabhāvahetau kathaṃ sādhyenāvinābhāvaḥ |
 nanu svabhāve bhāvopi bhāvamātrānurodhini hetur ityādinā prāg eva svabhāvahetāvavinābhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ |
 satyaṃ | evaṃ tu manyate (|) yathābhūte svabhāve tanmātrabhāvinyavinābhāvo varṇṇitas tatra pratijñārthaikad eśatā prāptnotīti | siddhāntavādy apy anantareṇānyāpohaprasādhanena pratijñārthaikad eśatāparihāramm anyamānaḥ tanmātrānurodhint evāvinābhāvaṃ pūrvoktam anuvadati | svabhāvepy avinābhāva ityādi | svabhāvepi svabhāvahetāv apy avinābhāvaḥ (|) kasmin sādhye (|) bhāvamātrānurodhini | yo hītyādy asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | avinābhāvo bhāvasyeti kṛtakatvādeḥ | yasmāt tadabhāve bhāvamātrānurodhisādhyadharmābhāve bhāvasya hetutvenopāttasyābhāvaḥ syāt  | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) (p.108) sādhyasādhanayor abhedataḥ | abhedam eva ya evetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ya evān ityādiko bhāvaḥ kṛtakabhāvamātrānurodhī svabhāva ity ucyate sa eva svayam anyanimittānapekṣatayā vastutaḥ paramārthato bhāvaḥ k´takatvaṃ sa ca bhāva ātmānaṃ svabhāvabhūtam anityatvam parityajya katham bhavet |
 ya eva tarhīti paraḥ | pakṣanirdeśaḥ pratijñā 1| tasyā artho dharmadharmisamudāyas tasyaikadeśaḥ sādhyadharmātmako hetuḥ syāt | tathā hi yāvad uktam anityaḥ śabdo 'nityatvād iti tāvad anityaḥ kṛtakatvād iti tathā cāsiddho hetur iti bhāvaḥ | (41)
fn. 1: Nyāyasūtra. 1.1.33.
 naiṣa doṣa iti siddhāntavādī | yasmāt sarve bhāvā ityādi | atra prathamayā kārikayā dharmakalpanābījaṃ | dvitīyayā dharmakalpanā | tṛtīyayā pratijñārthaikadeśatāparihāraś ca kathyate iti samudāyārthaḥ | sarve svabhāvaparabhāvābhyāṃ vyāvṛttim bhajanta iti dhinuṇ | sarvabhāvāḥ svabhāvena svarūpeṇa na pararūpeṇa sajātīyād vijātīyāc ca vyāvṛttāḥ | svabhāvavyavasthiteḥ | svasmin svabhāve 'dasthānāt |
 nanv aśvādibhyogaur jātyā bhinnaḥ | śuklo gaurguṇena viṣāṇino govyaktyantarād bhinna iti | evamādiparamāṇv antobhedo jātyādiviśeṣaṇakṛtaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ na svabhāveneti |
 atrocyate (|) na jātyādinā tāvad bhāvānām abhinnānām bhedaḥ kriyate | bhinnābhinnabhedakaraṇe tatra tasyā kiñ cit karatvāt | nāpi bhinnānām vaiyarthyāt | nāpy eṣām bhedavyavahāraḥ kriyate svarūpabhinnānām pratyakṣe 'vabhāsād eva bhedavyavahārasiddheḥ |
 kiñ ca | jātyādīnām anyonyantadvataś ca sakāśād bhedo nānyato jātyāder (p.109) anavasthāprasaṅgāt | svarūpeṇa ca bhede bhāvānām evāsau kinnābhyupagamyate kiṃ jātyādikalpanayā |
 yopi digambaro manyate (|) sarvātmakam ekaṃ syād anyāpohavyatikrane | tasmād bheda evānyathā na syād janyonyābhāvo bhāvānāṃ yadi na bhaved iti |
 sopy anena nirastaḥ | abhāvena bhāvabhedasya karttum aśakyatvāt | nāpy abhinnānāṃ hetuto niṣpannānān anyonyābhāvaḥ sambhavati | bhinnāś cet niṣpannāḥ kathamanyonyābhāvaḥ sambhavati | bhinnāś cen niṣpannāḥ katham anyotyābhāvakalpanety uktaṃ |
 nanu sarve bhāvā bhinnā iti yady etad anumānavṛttantadāśrayāsiddho hetuḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ pratyakṣāviṣayatvād (|) ata eva naitat pratyakṣavṛttaṃ parāmṛśyate |
 anyas tv āha – yady api bhāvāḥ svabhāvena bhinnās teṣān tu jātyādayo dharmāssanty eva pratīyamānatvāt | tathāpi nirvikalpakan tu vijñānaṅgavādiṣu sattāmātraṃ gṛhvāti na bhedaṃ | anyasmād viśeṣagrahaṇam eva hi bhedagrahaṇam viśeṣaś ca nāvikalpya gṛhyata iti savikalpakasya viṣayo na nirvikalpakasya | tad uktaṃ ||
 viśeṣās tu pratīyante savikalpakabuddhibhiḥ |
 te ca kecit pratidravyaṃ kecit vahuṣu saṃsthitāḥ ||
 tānakalpayad utpannaṃ vyāvṛttānugamātmanā |
 gavāśve copajātan tu pratyakṣan na viśiṣyata iti |
 tasmān na nirvikalpake pratyakṣabhedāvabhāsa iti |
 yopy āha (|) savikalpakenāpi bhedo na gṛhyate 'nyonyābhāvagrahaṇanimittako hi bhāvānāṃ bhedagrahonyonyābhāvaś ca bhedo na cābhāvaḥ pratyakṣagrāhyo | na hi gavyaśvostīti pratyakṣaṃ paricchinattyataḥ sattāmātrasyaiva grāhakaṃ pratyakṣam iti |
 tad uktaṃ maṇḍanena ||
 āhur vidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhya vipaścitaḥ |
 naikatva āgamas tena pratyakṣeṇa virudhyate iti |
 tad etad ubhayam apy ayuktaṃ | sattāmātrasyāpratibhāsanāt | gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇaiva pratibhāsanāt | tad uktaṃ ||
 tattvayuktam pratidravyaṃ bhinnarūpopalambhanāt |
 na hy ākhyātum aśaktyatvād bhedo nāstīti gamyata iti |
 yopy āha (|) bhāvānām bheda eva nāsti | tathā hi goraśvānutpāde yāgṛśaṃ svarūpam aśvotpādepi tādṛśam eva nāparamadhikaṃ kiñcij jātim iti katham ato bhedaḥ | (p.110) bhavatu vā bhedo nāsau pratyakṣagrāhyo 'snād ayam bhinna iti | evaṃrūpasya vyāṃpārasya pratyakṣe 'bhāvāt | yad Aha | na hīdam iyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samartham iti (|)
 sopi nirastaḥ | gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇotpattir eva bhedaḥ | te ca svasvarūpeṇa pratyakṣevabhāsante | tathāvabhāsaś ca loke bhedāvabhāsa iti yat kiñcid etat | tasmāt purovasthiteṣu svasvabhāvavyavasthiter ity asya hetoḥ (|) pratyakṣeṇa bhedaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipadyate 'taḥ sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgni iti vyāptigrahaṇapramāṇaphalam iti | yataś ca jātyādayorthāntarabhūtā na santīti pratipādayiṣyate (|) ataḥ pāramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāstīty uktam bhavati |
 nanu sāmānyayogāt sajātīyā ucyate | yadi ca sāmānyan nāsti kathaṃ sajātīyād vyāvṛttir ity ucyate |
 naitad asti | na samānānām utpannānām bhāvānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā svahetubhya eva tathāniṣpannatvāt |
 tena yad udyotakareṇocyate | na gavi gotvaṃ yena gotvayogāt prāg gaur evāsāv iti vyarthaṃ gotvaṃ syād (|) api tu yadaiva vastu tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyate | gotvayogāt tu prāg vastu na vidyate | na cāvidyamānaṅ gaur iti vā 'gaur iti vā śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭum iti (|)
 tan nirastaṃ | yadaiva vastu tadaiva tasya gorūpatayā niṣpannatvāt kiṃ gotvayogena | nāpy asamānānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā | teṣāṃ sāmānyasyaivābhāvāt | samānānāṃ ca bhāvaḥ sāmānyam ity abhyupagamyate | sāmānyāc ca samānarūpatve bhāvānām abhyupagamyamāne yāvan na sāmānyayogas tāvan na samānā bhāvāḥ | yāvac ca na samānās tāvan na sāmānyayoga ity anyonyāśrayatvaṃ syāt | tasmāt svahetubhya eva samānāutpannāḥ (|) tena |
 śāvaleyāc ca bhinnatvaṃ vāhuleyāśvayossamaṃ |
 sāmānyaṃ nānyad iṣṭaṃ cet kvābopohaḥ prakalpyatām iti |
 nirastaṃ | sāmānyeṣv evāgopohaprakalpanāt | asamānānāṃ cāpohyātmatayā prakalpanāt |
 yad apy uccate (|) samānā iti pratibhāsād eva nirvikalpake jñāne sāmānyapratibhāsonyathā bāhuleyāśvavat | śāvaleyabāhuleyayoe api vailakṣaṇyapratītiḥ syāt sarvātmanā bhedād (|) bhavati ca samānā iti pratItis tasmād asyaiva sāmānyam iti |
 tad uktaṃ (|) nirvikalpakabodhuna dvyātmakasya vastuno grahaṇam iti | yad vā savikalpake na cet sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate | nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītam eva | savikalpābhinnapratibhāsatvāt | (p.111) tathā hi (|) ya eva śāvaleyādayo gaur iti jñānena gṛhyante | ta eva nirvikalpake jñāne pratibhāsante kevalam ekantānavikalpya gṛhṇātyanyad vikalpyeti tayoḥ svarūpabhedo na pratibhāsabhedaḥ | tasmān nirvikalpakepi jñāne sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsata iti (|)
 tad api nirastaṃ | svahetubhya eva keṣāñ cit samānānāṃ pratibhāsanāt | sāmānyasya ca vyaktiparatantraṃ svarūpaṃ na ca nirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ pāratantryam vastuno gṛhṇāti |
svātantreṇa vastugrāhitvāt tat kathaṃ sānābyagrāhakam ucyate | anugatasya ca rūpasya pratyekavad yugapad bahuṣvapratibhāsanāt | ata eva vikalpaḥ samāneṣv ekāntabhinneṣu nirvikalpakapratyakṣabādhitam anugatākāraṃ gṛhṇan bhrānto bhavati | nirvikalpakagṛhītasāmānyagrāhī vā 'pramāṇaṃ syād gṛhītagrāhitvāt | atha vikalpya grāhitvād agṛhītagrāhitvaṃ smṛtyāder api (tarhi) smaryamāṇaviṣayatā gṛhītagrāhitvan na syāt | atha jātyādiviśiṣṭavastugrāhitayā vikalpasyāgṛhītagrāhitvam evam api yadi jātyādiviśiṣṭatvam vastunaḥ pāramārthiko dharmas tadā nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītam eveti katham agṛhītagrāhitvam (|) atha kalpikas tadā tadgrāhakasya kathaṃ prāmāṇyamāropitārthatvāt |  tasmān nāsty eva jātyādir iti sthitaṃ |
 kathan tarhi bhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgni ity ucyate (|) kalpitadharmadvāreṇāyaṃ vyapadeśa ity adoṣaḥ | ataḥ (|)

 yadi paramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāsti kathan tarhi kṛtakaḥ śabdo nitya iti buddhīnām bhedaḥ śabdaikasvarūpaviṣayatvāt |
