 pratipattiḥ pravṛttiś ca bāhyertheṣu katham bhavet |
 atha vāhyādhyvasāyāt pravṛttir evam api k´takatvasya yovasāyaḥ sa evānityasyābhedād iti katham buddhibhedaḥ | kṛtakānityayor abhedād eva tadanubhavāhitavāsanābhedasyābhāvān na tattvato buddhibheda ity atrāha – (42)
 yasmād ityādi | yasmāt sarvasmāt sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttās tasmād yato yato nityākṛtakādeḥ śabdādinām arthānāṃ vyāvṛttis tannibandhanāḥ | vyāvṛttyāv adhivyāvṛttinibandhanā dharmabhedā anityakṛtakādayaḥ kalpyante vikalpair āropyante | kim vaśiṣṭās tadviśeṣāvagāhinaḥ | tasya svalakṣaṇasya ye viśeṣā ak´takādivyāvṛttirūpalakṣaṇās tadavagāhinaḥ | tadavagāhanaśīlās tadabhedāvabhāsanaśīlā ity arthaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati (|) akṛtako na bhavatīty anena dvāreṇa prabodhotāyā eva kṛtakavikalpavāsanāyā eṣā prakṛtir yatas tato vikalpa utpadyamānaḥ kṛtaka iti svākārābhinnaḥ sa kṛtakavyāvṛttam eva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tvanitya iti (|) tathā nityo na bhavatīty anenāpi dvāreṇa prabodhitāyā evānityavāsanāyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ yat tato vikalpa utpadyamāno 'nitya iti svākārābhinnaṃ nityavyāvṛttam eva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tu kṛtaka iti (|) tena buddhibhedo bhavati | yataś ca vādhyamānatvād vikalpapratibhāsyartho bāhyo na bhavat yato vāsanāvaśād eva bāhyāvabhāso vikalpas tena vikalpasya bāhyarūpa eva pratibhāsamānorthaḥ svākāra ucyate | na tu svākāre bāhyāropaḥ sādṛśyāt | yad āha – nāmanimittaprakaraṇe1 (|)
fn. 1: Pramāṇavārtika 3.12.
 sārūpyād bhrāntito vṛttir arthe syān na sarvadā |
 deśabhrāntiś ca na jñāne tulyam utpattito dhiyaḥ |
 tathāvidhāyā bāhyārthapratibhāsāyā iti |
 etena yad ucyate (|) yad vāhyātyantavisadṛśasya svākārasya tādrūpyagrahaṇan tadanyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyaparaṃ | yathā ghaṭavisadṛśopi paṭo vṛkṣābhāvaviśiṣṭo 'vadhāryamāṇo yam apy avṛkṣa iti ghaṭasadṛśovadhāryate | vṛkṣavyāvṛtter ghaṭapaṭayos tulyatvāt | tathā vikalpaviśayo 'tyantaṃ vāme visadṛāopi vāme 'vadhāryate 'nyanivṛttikṛtasārūpya grahaṇād iti (|)
 tad apāstaṃ | svahetuta eva bāhyābhāsāyā vikalpabuddher utpatteḥ | na cāsadṛśānām anyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate (|) tatra bhedābhedasādṛśyakaraṇe 'kiñ cit karatvāt | na cānyanivṛttiḥ sadṛśī vidyate | sadṛśānām api katham anyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate svarūpeṇaiva sādṛśyāt | nāpi pūrvaṃ svākārapratibhāsaḥ paścāt tatrānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyagrahaṇaparo bāhyāropaḥ pratibhāsate | na hi marīcikāyāṃ pūrvaṃ svarūpāpratibhāse (p.113) sati sādṛāyagrahaṇahetuko jalāropaḥ sanbhavati (|) bāhyāripāc ca pūrvaṃ na svākāro grāhyāroposti | vikalpasyaivābhāvāt | bhāve bodhaikarūpa evāsāv iti na bāhyāsadṛsaḥ | tataś cānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyābhāvāt katham bāhyarūpaḥ pratīyate | anumānasya tu nānyanivṛttigrāhaṇapūrvikā pravṛttir liṅgasya tayā saha sambandhāt siddheḥ | yadā ca tadviśeṣāv agāhitvam vikalpānāṃ pratīyate tadā vidhirūpeṇaiva pravṛttir vastusvarūpasya vidhīyamānatvenādhyavasāyād arthād anyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate | tena vidhir eva śabdārthosmākam api | bāhyatayā 'ropitasya ca vaidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ sambandhaḥ |
 nanu niyatarūpagrāhī vikalpaḥ pratibhāsate | tenetararūpaśūnyam eva vikalpayan niyatam arthaṃ vikalpayati | tasmād yan niyatarūpāvadhāraṇantadanyanivṛttiviṣayan tat katham ucyate vidhir eva śabdārthaṃ iti |
 tad ayuktaṃ | anyanivṛttim ahaṃ vikalpayāmīty apratīteḥ | na ca sa vikalpaviṣayo yo na vikalpya pratibhāsate | yadi cetararūpanivṛttim eva vikalpayan niyatam artham vikalpayati tadetaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ syāt | itararūpasyāpi niyatarūpatvenānyanivṛttidvāreṇa pratipattiprasaṅgāt | atha vidhirūpeṇetararūpaṃ vikalpayati na tarhi tadanyanivṛttyavadhāraṇapūrvakan niyatarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ |
 na ca yathā sāmānyavantam artham paśyāmīti nāsti jātitadvator viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve pratibhāsaḥ (|) atha ca viśiṣṭapratyayānurodhāt sāmānyaviśiṣṭavyaktidarśanan naiyāyikādayaḥ kalpitavantas tathā 'nye (?nyair) nivṛttim aham vikalpayāmīty apratītāv api bāhyasadṛśāropānyathānupapattyānyanivṛttiparaṃ vikalpākāre bāhyarūpam āropyata iti yuktaṃ | sādṛśyam antareṇa vāsanābalād evādhyavasitabāhyarūpasya vikalpasyotpatteḥ | yad āha – tadanubhavāhitavāsanāprabhavaprakrter adhyavasitatadbhāvasvarūpaṃ | tathā vikalpavāsanāyāś ca tādṛśī prakṛtir yad evam eṣā pratibhātīti |
 nāpi bāhyarūpāropakasya jñānasyānyavittikṛtasārūpyanimittatve 'py anyanivṛttiviṣayatvaṃ | na hi marīcikāyāṃ jalajñānasya sādṛśyaviṣayatvam āropitajalaviṣayatvāt | na ca niyataṃ rūpaṃ bhāvānām anyanivṛttyā kriyate | tasyā avastutvenākārakatvāt | svahetubhya eva ca tato (? tata u)tpatte |
 nāpi niyatarūpāvadhāraṇan tadanyanivṛttiviṣayaṃ niyatarūpaviṣayatvād asya (|) ata eva na tad anyanivṛttipurassaram eva dhāryate pratyakṣeṇaiva |
 na ca tadanyanivṛttir arthāntarabhātā yujyata iti vakṣyati | nāpi sa (|) tattvānyatvābhyam avācyā yujyate (|) evaṃ hy abhāva evāsyāḥ syācchaśaviṣāṇavat | na ca syāta pratyakṣagamyā nīrūpatvāt | nāpy anumānagamyā | sambandhāvena liṅgasyāsiddheḥ | (p.114) nāpi niyatarūpānyathānupapattyā tatkalpanā | aniyatarūpāṇām anyanivṛtter abhāvāt | niyatarūpāṇāṃ ca katham anyanivṛttyā niyatarūpatvaṃ svahetubhya eva niyatarūpāṇām utpatteḥ | tasmān niyatarūpāvadhāraṇapurassaraivānyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate | tathā hi ghaṭa ity ukto 'ghaṭo na bhvatīti sāmārthyāt pratīyate 'to vikalpakavikalpataiveṣā na paramārthatosti |
 tasmāt sthitam etac chadvaliṅgābhyām vidhirūpeṇa vastu pratipādyaterthādanyaniṣedhaḥ | tathā ca vakṣyati tadgatāv eva śabdebhyo gamyate 'nyanivartanam ityādi (1|128) |
 tena yad ucyate kumārilena ||
 na tvanyāpohakṛcchabdo yuṣmatpakṣenuvartiṇṇātaḥ |
 niṣedhamātran naiveha pratibhāseva gamyate ||
 kin tu gaur gavayo hastī vṛkṣa ityādi śabdataḥ |
 vidhirūpāvasāyena matiḥ śābdī pravartte ||
 tasmād yeṣv eva śabdeṣu nañyogas teṣu kevalaṃ |
 bhavedasyanivṛttyaṅgaḥ svātmevānyatra gamyata iti (|)
etat siddhaṃ | vidhirūpasyāpi śabdārthasyeṣṭatvāt (|) kathan tarhi paramatād bauddhamatasya bhedaḥ (|) kathaṃ vā śabdaliṅgayor apoho viṣaya ucyate || (43)
 nanv asty eva mahān bhedaḥ paraiḥ pāramārthikārthaviṣayatveneṣṭasya vikalpasya bauddhaiḥ kalpitaviṣayatvenaṣṭatvāt | alpitaś cākāro 'pohāśritatvād apoha ucyate | apohyate 'neneti vā | anyanivṛttimātraṃ tv arthādākṣiptam apohanam apoha ity ucyate (|) svalkṣaṇaṃ tv apohyatesminn ity apoha ucyate |
 tasmād anyānyavyāvarttyavastuvyapekṣayā dhrmaḥ kalpitabhedā vikalpair viṣayīkriyante (|) ato bhinnaviṣayā vikalpās tatsamānaviṣayāś ca śabdā apy aparyāyā iti darśayitum āha – tasmād ityādi | yataś caivaṃ dharmabhedāḥ kalpyante tasmād yaḥ svalakṣaṇaviśeṣo vyāvarttanīyanityavyapekṣayā vyavasthāpito 'nityalakṣaṇaḥ | yena dharmeṇa yena śabdena | yathā 'nityaśabdena | śabdopi dharmavācakatvād dharma ucyate | na sa śaktyas tatonyena | anityaśabdād anyena kṛtakādiśabdena | vyāvarttanīyāntaravastvadhikena pratyetuṃ | tena bhinnā vyavasthitiḥ | tena kāraṇena vikalpānāṃ naikaviṣayatvaṃ (p.115) | śabdānāṃ ca na paryāyatvaṃ |
 tena yad ucyate (|) yayos tādātmyan na tayor gamyagamakabhāvo yayoś ca vikalpitarūpayor gamyagamakabhāvo na tayoḥ sambandha iti (|)
 tad apāstaṃ | akṛtakavyāvṛttasyaiva svalakṣaṇasya jñāpakahetvadhikārāt | kṛtaka iti jñātasya gamakatvāt tasya ca nityavyāvṛttavasturūpatvāt tādātmyaṃ |
 sarva eva hītyādinā 'dvai ta vā daṃ nirākurvan kārikārtham āha – svarūpe svātmani sthitir yeṣānte tathā | sarva eva hi bhāvāḥ svarūpasthitayo nātmānaṃ pareṇa miśrayanti | ekīkurvanti | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tasya miśrīkriyamāṇasya parasyāparatvaprasaṅgāt | ātmatāpatteḥ |
 syānmataṃ (|)
 sarvavastuṣu buddhiś ca vyāvṛttānumātmikā |
 jāyate dvyātmakatvena vinā sā ca na yujyate ||
 ataḥ sāmānyātmakā viśeṣā viśeṣāymakañ ca sāmānyam ity ubhayarūpam vastv ity atrāpy ekasya vā rūpasya bhinnebhyo 'bhedo bhinnasya caikasmād abhedaḥ (|) tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃ nirākarttum āha – teṣām iti bhāvānām bhinnam ity ekātmabhūtam ity avyatiriktaṃ yad rūpaṃ svabhāvo na tat teṣām bhāvānām iti śakyam vaktuṃ | kasmāt tadānīntasyety apekṣyate | tasyābhinnasya rūpasya teṣām abhāvāg abhedād eva |
 atha punar ekasmād bhinnasyābhedas tatrāpy āha – tad eva hi syād abhinnasya bhāvāt | ekaṃ ced rūpaṃ pratipannābhāvas tad evābhinnaṃ rūpan teṣāṃ syān na bhinnaṃ | kuta etat | tasyaivābhinnasya rūpasya bhāvāt |
 atha syāt (|) teṣām bhedopīṣyata evety ātrāha – tasmād abhinnātmanorthāntarasya bhinnasya nānārūpasyābhāvāt |
 atha syād (|) viseṣasya yo bhedassa eva sāmānyasyābhedād | yad āha (|) sāmānyasya tu yo bhedaṃ brūte tasya viśeṣato darśayitvābhyupetavya ity atrāha – tasyaiva ca punar bhedavirodhāt | tasyaivaikasyānekatvāyogāt |
 atha ayād(|) viśeṣadvāreṇa sāmānyasya bhedo na svarūpas tadānugatavyāvṛttarūpayoḥ (p.116) parasparāsaṃśleṣād ekāntena bhedaḥ syāt | tad āha (|) tac caikarūpaṃ svātmani svasvabhāve vyavasthitam amiśram eva vyāktirūpeṇa | amiśre miśrarūpatayāpratīter mithyātvam eva |
 atha kathaṃ cit sāmānyasya vyaktyabhinnatvān naitan mithyātvaṃ | tad āha –
 naitad aśvādibuddhīnām adhyāropādyasambhavāt |
 sthitaṃ naiva hi jātyāderbhinnatvaṃ vyaktato hi na iti |
 tad ayuktam (|) ekatvena yenaiva rūpeṇa bhinnantenaivāsyābhedo virodhān na caikasmin pramāṇe bhedābhedaṃ pratibhāsate | ekena ca bhedagrahaṇe sati yady anyenābhedo gṛhyate kathan tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhrāntaṃ na syād (|) anyathā grahaṇāt tasya caikarūpatvāt |
 yad dvā 'miśraṇādevaikasya rūpasya sāmānyarūpatā na syād arthāntaratvād ghaṭavat | 
 udyotaka(ra)s tv āha – gavādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayaḥ piṇḍādivyatiriktanimittabhāvī | viśeṣattvān nīlāsipratyayavat | tac ca nimittaṃ samānavyaktikaraṇāta sāmānyam ity ucyate 1 (|)
fn. 1: Cf. Nyāyavārtika 2.2.65.
 atrāpi na tāvat samānānām arthāntareṇa samānarūpatā kriyate niṣpannatvā(d) apy asamānānām iti darśayann āha – arthāntaram iti sattā gotvādikaṃ na teṣāṃ vyaktibhedānāṃ sāmānyam atadrūpatvāt | teṣāṃ bhedānāmasamānarūpatvāt | samānānāṃ ca bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iṣyate |
 atha vā 'tadrūpatvād vyaktibhyorthāntaratvād ekatvavat | athārthāntaram api bahuṣu samavetam iti yadi tat teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ | tadā dvitvādikāryadravyeṣv api prasaṅgo dvitvam api hy anekadravyasamavetam (|) ādigrahṇād bahutvādiḥ | tathā saṃyogonekadravyasamavetaḥ | kāryadravyaṃ cāvayavisaṃjñitamārambhakadravyeṣu samavetamato dvitvādiṣu sāmānyarūpatāprasaṅgaḥ | yasmin nārthāntare sati samānā bhedā bhavanti tad eva sāmānyaṃ na sarvam ity atrāha – na hi | yasmāt sanbandhinān yenārthāntareṇaikatvalakṣaṇenānye 'samānā bhinnā na samānā naikīkriyante bhinnābhinnasamānabhāvakaraṇe tadanupayogāt | bhinnadeśādīnāṃ pratibhāsanāc ca kathaṃ samānā eva bhavanti | kevalaṃ tadvanta eka dharmavantaḥ syurbhedāḥ | bhūtāni grahanakṣṭrāṇi teṣāṃ kaṇṭhe dīrghā guṇorccanārthaṃ (p.117) nibadhyate | tenaikena kaṇṭhe yathā bhūtāni tadvanti na tvekībhavanti tadvadvyaktayopi |
 nanu guṇasya mūrttatvād tadvattā pratītir yuktā | na vyaktiṣu sāmānyasyāmurttatvād iti cet (|) na | tatsamavetatvasyeṣṭatvād arthāntarabhāvasya ca | yat aśvaikasambandhepi na samānā vyaktas tata eva nābhinnapratyayaviṣayāḥ ekākārajñānsyābhrāntasya na viṣayāḥ | bhūtavat | yathā bhūtānyaguṇasvabhāvāni naikaguṇākārapratyayaviṣayaḥ | tadvat | ekantāvad anekasambandhepy arthāntaraṃ na teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ dvitvādiṣu prasaṅgaditi sthitaṃ (|) pratīyante ca samānā iti (|) tasmāt tadātmānan eva hi tayor bhedayor ātmānam eva | ekarūpam idaṃ dvyam ity ekāśena saṃsṛjantī buddhiḥ sāmānyaviṣayā pratibhāsate | naikasambandhināv ity ekena sāmānyena sambandhināv etāv iti naivambuddhiḥ pratibhāsate yena sāmānyam arthāntaram pramāṇasiddhaṃ syāt | bhūtavad iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā buddhir bhūtānyekena guṇena sambaddhāni gṛhṇāti naivam ity arthaḥ |
 yad vā yathā bhūtānyehasambandhīni tathā bhinnāv ekasambandhināv iti sāmānyaviṣayā buddhiḥ pratibhāsata iti naivaṃ |
 atha syāt (|) sāmānyaṃ hi vyaktīnām viśeṣaṇaṃ | viśeṣaṇaṃ ca viśeṣe svānuraktāṃ buddhiṃ janayat yato nāsya vyāktibhyorthāntarabhāvena pratibhāsaḥ |
 nanu viśeṣaṇatvepi tasya na viśeṣyeṇa sahaikyaṃ gaṇḍasyeva daṇḍinā tat katham abhedapratibhāsaḥ | abhedāṃśenāpy ekatvān na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | tasmāt sāmānyasya vyaktyabhedapratītir bhrāntir eva |
 atha sarvadaivaṃ pratīter abhrāntiḥ | tad āha –
 yo hy anyarūpasaṃvedyaḥ samvedyetānyathā punaḥ |
 sa mithyā na tu tenaiva yo nityam avagamyata iti (|)
 tad ayuktaṃ | tasya vyaktyabhinnayvam eva syāt | gor gotvam iti pratītibhedābhyupagamāc ca | na ca lākṣāsphaṭikayor iva jātitadvatoḥ saṃsargāvagatir abhrāntiḥ | alākṣārūpasya sphaṭikasya lākṣārūpeṇa gater bhrāntatvāt | evaṃ jātitadvator ekatvagraho (p.118) bhrāntaḥ | sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ paśyatyeva buddhiḥ | tasmās tu taddarśinyāḥ samavāyasya sūkṣmatvāt sā bhrāntir yad etad vyaktīnāṃ sāmānyābhedena geahaṇam iti cet | taddarśinīti kutaḥ (|) pāramārthikasāmānyadarśinī sā buddhir iti kuto niścayaḥ sarvadāsyā vyaktyabhedaviṣayatvāt | nāsyā bījam astīti nirbījā tathā cāsau bhrāntiś ca tasyā ayogāt | na hi bhrāntair utpadyamānā nirnimittā ghaṭato | jalādibhrāntivat | bhrāntiś ceyam asaṃsṛṣṭān api bhāvān saṃsṛjantī buddhir atosyā nimittena bhavitavyaṃ (|) yat tannimittan tat sāmānyam ity atrāha – ta eva bhedās tatsāmānyajñānādy ekaṅkāryaṃ yeṣān te tadekāryā bījaṃ bhrānteḥ | etac ca pratipādayiṣyate |
 na ca sāmānyaṃ dṛśṭātadāropeṇa vyaktiṣv ekākārā bhrāntir yujyate | tathā hi (|) sādṛśyaṃ bhrāntikāraṇam atyantavilakṣaṇaṃ ca sāmānyaṃ vyaktibhyas tasyāvarṇṇasaṃsthānākāratvād vyaktīnāṃ ca varṇṇasaṃsthānākāratvāt |
 atha syāt (|) na sāmānyasya sādṛśyanimitto bhedeṣv āropopi tv ekāntena bhinneṣu sa evāyam ity ekatvāvasāyavibhramo brūmaḥ | yady evam ekena sambandhina ity eva vināpi bhrāntinimittena yady ekākārabhrāntiviṣayā bhavanti | tadā saṃkhyā ca saṃyogaś ca cādiśabdād vibhāgādi caikam vastu vidyate yeṣān te tadvantas teṣu caikaguṇena yukteṣu syād ekākārā bhrāntiḥ (|) na ca bhavati (|) ato vyaktīnām api naikatvanimittā bhrāntir iti | tad iti tasmād yathā vyaktibhyo bhedeneṣṭaqṃ sāmānyaṃ tathā sāmānyabuddhau niveśābhāvāt pratibhāsābhāvān na samānyam anyat | sati vā sāmānye tasyāpi sāmānyasya svātmani svasmin svabhāve 'vasthānād amiśraṇam anyena vyaktirūpeṇa | vyaktiṣv anavasthānān na dharmarūpatvan tasyety arthaḥ | tasmād iti svasvabhāvavyavasthānād ime bhāvā ghaṭāśyaḥ sajātīyābhimatāt tulyākāratvenābhimatād anyasmāc ceti vijātīyādivyatiriktāḥ pṛthagabhūtaḥ svabhāvena prakṛtyaikarūpatvāt | svasvabhāvavyavasthiter iti yāvat ||
 dvitīyakārikārtham āha – yato yato bhinnāste bhāvās tasmād bhedas tadbhedaḥ | tasmād bhinnāḥ svabhāvās tasya pratyāyanāya pratibhinnasvabhāvaṃ kṛtasanniveśaiḥ śabdaiḥ (p.119) kṛtasaṃketaiḥ śabdaiḥ karaṇabhūtair anekadharmānaḥ kṛtakatvādidharmmaṃ vantaḥ pratīyante svabhāvā bhedepi | na hy ekasya svalakṣaṇasya svabhāvanānātvam asti | kathan tarhy anekadharmatvam ity āha – tatas tato bhedam upādāyeti (|) yato yato vyāvṛttās tatas tato bhedam upādāyāśritya tepi śabdā ye tasya tasya bhedasya bhinnaskbhāvasya khyāpanāya kṛtasaṃketās teṣv asmin bhinne svabhāve vācakatvena niyatāḥ (|) tato naikaḥ śabdaḥ sarvān bhinnasvabhāvānākṣipatyatas tepi śabdāḥ pratyekantaiḥ sarvabhedānākṣepepi | ekabhedacodanād ekaikasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codanāt tatsvalakṣaṇaniṣṭhā eva bhavanti | yasya svalakṣaṇasya sa svabhāvonyasmād bhinno yaḥ śabdenādhyavasīyate | tac ca tatsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca | tanniṣṭhā eva tadviṣayā eva bhavanti |
 nanu bāhyatayādhyavasitorthaḥ śabdapratibhāsī sādhāraṇonya evānyac ca sādhāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇan tat kathan tanniṣṭhā ity atrāha – tadekasmād api yato yato vyāvṛttorthaḥ śabdair viṣayītriyate tasmāt tasmād atatkāraṇād atatkāryāc caikasmād api tasya svalakṣaṇasyānakavyāvṛttasya bhedostīti kṛtvā tadviṣayā ucyate na tu tadviṣayā eva | yad vā tasya vyāvṛttyāśrayasya dharmasya yat svalakṣaṇantanniṣṭhā eva tatprāptiparyavasānā eva bhavanti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadekasmād api tasya bhedostīti vyākhyātam eva |
 upasaṃharann āha – tasmād iti yasmāt sajātīyavijātīyād vyāvṛttis tasmād ekasya bhāvasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvat yas tadapekṣayā | pararūpapekṣayā | pararūpebhyo vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitā dharmabhedāḥ | vyāvarttate vijātīyamebhir iti kṛtvā (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasmin vyāvarttye 'vidhibhūte dharmiṇyasambhavi kāryaṃ ca yasya vivakṣitasya dharmiṇaḥ sa tadasambhavikāryakāraṇas tasya tadbhedāt | tasmād atatkāryād atatkāraṇāc ca bhedād vyāvṛttatvāt | yāvat yaś ca vyāvṛttayas tāvatyaḥ śrutayo niveśitā (p.120) atatkāryakāraṇaparihāreṇa vyavahārārthāḥ | tadvivakṣitaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca yasya sa tatkāryakāraṇaḥ | yathā śrotravijñānakāryaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnakāraṇaś ca sa tathā yo na bhavati so 'tatkāryakāraṇas tasya parihāreṇa vyavahārārthāḥ pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇo vyavahārorthaḥ phaṭaṃ yāsām iti vigrahaḥ |
 viṣayam āha – prayatnaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya sa prayatnānantarīyaka ucyate | tenā 'tatkāraṇasyā 'prayatnakāraṇasya vidyudādeḥ parihārārthaḥ prayatnānantarīyakadhvaniḥ | śrotrajñānaṃ kāryaṃ yasya tachrāvaṇantena śrāvaṇadhvanir atatkāryaparihārārthaḥ | sarvavyavahārāṇāṃ cārthakriyānimittatvāt | hetuphalabhāvalakṣaṇatvāc cārthakriyāyā ghaṭādiśabdeṣv api tad atatkāryakāraṇaparihārthatvaṃ yojyaṃ ||
 tasmād ityādinā tṛtīyaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe | yasmād bhinnā vyāvṛttibhedāḥ śrutayaś ca yathāsvambhede niyatās tasmād ekasya dharmiṇaḥ svabhāvā 'bhedepi | dharmiṇety asya vivaraṇaṃ nāmneti śabdenety arthaḥ | yo viśeṣa ity asyāethe bhedaḥ kṛtakādilakṣaṇo dharmaḥ kalpitaḥ pratīyate | na sa śakyas tatonyena | tasmād vivakṣitāt kṛtakādiśabdād anyenān ityādiśabdena pratyāyayitun tasmān na pratijñārthaikadeśo hetur anityakṛtakaśabdayor bhinnārthatvāt || (44)
 katham ityādi paraḥ | śabdaś ca liṅgaś ca tābhyāṃ | yady apīha liṅgaṃ prakṛtantathāpi śabdasyoppādānaṃ liṅgavat nirviṣayatvakhyāpanārthan tena vedasya prāmānyaṃ nirākṛtam bhavati |
 nanu vidhirūpeṇa śabdaliṅge arthaḥ pratipādyata ity uktan tat katham idam āśaṃkitaṃ vyavacchedaḥ pratipādyata iti kathaṃ gamyata iti |
 naitad asti | vyavacchidyateneneti vyavacchedo bāhyarūpatayāropita evākāra ucyate | tena sa eva śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ vidhinā pratipādyate na vasturūpam iti kuto gamyate | yad vā vyavacchidyatesminn iti vyavacchedaḥ | svalakṣaṇam ucyate | sa eva (p.121) śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ vidhinā vidhirūpeṇa pratipādyate 'dhyavasīyate na punar vastuno rūpaṃ pāramārthikadharmibhāvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyata iti kuto gamyate |
 pramāṇāntarasyetyādi prativacanaṃ | tenāyam artho yadi tāvat pāramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvaḥ sarvātmanā 'bhinnas tadaikena vādhigaterthe sarvātmanā paricchedādanyasya pramāṇāntarasya śabdāntarasya vā pravṛttiḥ syād gṛhītagrāhitvenāprāmāṇyāt | bhavati ca śabdāntarādeḥ pravṛttir ataḥ kalpita eva dharmadharmibhāvaḥ |
 yady api pūṛvasāmānyanirākaraṇād eva kalpito dharmadharmibhāvaḥ prasādhitas tathāpi prakārāntareṇānenāpi prasādhyata ity adoṣaḥ | etam eva pratipādayann āha – tathā hītyādi | ekasyeti dharmadharmivibhāgarahitatatvān niraṃśasyārthasvabhāvasyārthātmanaḥ svayaṃ svarūpeṇa pratyakṣasya sataḥ konyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syāt pratyakṣadṛsṭāt svabhāvāt konyaḥ svabhāvo na dṛṣṭaḥ syād yaḥ pramāṇair anumānasaṃjñakaiḥ (|) parīkΩyate (|) vyaktibhedād bahuvacanaṃ | sarva eva dṛṣṭo niraṃśatvād bhāvasya tasmān na pramāṇāntaraparīkṣyaḥ syād iti | eka ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | eko hy arthātmā niraṃśaḥ sa tāvat pratyakṣobhyupagantavyaḥ yatrānumānaṃ pravartate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pramāṇena prāg asiddhe dharmiṇi sādhanāsambhavāt | āśrayāsiddhatvena liṅgasyāsambhavāt tasmāt prasiddhena dharmiṇā bhāvyaṃ ||
 etad uktam bhavati | liṅgasyaiva pravṛttir na syāt kiṃ punar liṅginiścatā pramāṇāntarasya pravṛttir bhāviṣyati | yathā 'nitye sādhye śabdaḥ pratyakṣasiddhas tasya pratyakṣeṇaiva pramāṇena svarūpasiddheḥ kāraṇāt sarvākārasiddhiḥ | kasmāt tadanyasyāsiddhasya śabdasvabhāvād anyasya svabhāvasyāsiddhasyābhāvāt | bhāve vā 'siddhasya svabhāvasya atatsvabhāvatvam aśabdasvabhāvatvaṃ | siddhāsiddhayor ekasvabhāvatvavirodhāt |
 tad evāha – na hītyādi | alabdhadharmānuvṛttir yogaḥ | labdhadharmānuvṛttiḥ kṣemaḥ | eko yogaḥ kṣenaś ca yasya sa tathā | tulyadharmeti yāvat | yaḥ svabhāvo yena sadaikakayogakṣemī na bhavati sa bhinnatogakṣemaḥ | tatsvabhāvo yato bhinnayogakṣemas tasya (p.122) svabhāvo na yuktaḥ | tanmātranibandhanatvād bhedavyavahārasya nānātvaṃ vyavasthāyāḥ |
 anyatheti yady etad bhedakāraṇaṃ neṣyate tadābhedavyavaharasyābhāvaprasaṅgādityuktataṃ | eṣa hi bhedābhedahetur vety atra prastāve | yata evaṃ tasmāt pratyakṣe dharmiṇi śabdādau | tatsvabhāvasākalyaparicchedāt | dharmisvabhāvasya sākalyenāvagamāt tatra dharmiṇi | anavakāśā nirviṣayī pramāṇāntarasyānumānasya vṛttiḥ || (45)
 tavāpi tulko doṣa iti ced āha (|) no cetyādi | bhrāntinimittena sadṛśāparotpattyādinā kāraṇabhūtena vikalpabuddhyā saṃyojyate samāropyeta guṇāntaraṃ | sthiratvādi | vā śabda ivārthe | śuktāv iva rajatākāraḥ saṃyojyeta | kathaṃ | rajatarūpeṇa śuktikārūpasya yat sādharmya caikacikyādi | tasya darśanāt | anavadhāritaviśeṣaṃ śuktikārūpam eva sadṛśapratyayanibandhanatvād rūpasādharmyam uktaṃ na tu sādhrmyaṃ nāma dvayoḥ sādhāraṇam asti |
 etad uktam bhavati | yadi bhrāntinimittena guṇāntaran na saṃyojyeta bhavet mamāpi doṣaḥ kin tu samāropyeta | tataḥ samāropavyavacchedārtham pramāṇāntaraṃ pravartate | temśyam arthānubhūtaniścite pramāṇāntarasya gṛhītagrāhitvenāpravṛttiḥ syāt | samāropeṇa tv anubhūtāniścate tatsamāropavyavacchedārthaṃ pramāṇāntaram anumānaṃ pravarttata ity eke |
 tad ayuktaṃ | liṅgasya vyavacchedena saha sambandhāsiddheḥ | nāpi yāvad dhetunā pūrvaṃ pakṣavyavacchedo na kriyato tāvat sandigdhā sādhyapratītiḥ syād dhetoḥ sādhyena sambandhāt | yatra ca na sādhyaṃ na tatra tadvipaṣo virodhāt | tasmāl liṅgaṃ svavyāpakaṃ vidhirūpeṇa niścinvad arthādanyasamāropaṃ niṣedhati ||
 nanv evam api kathan tanniṣedhaḥ kṣaṇikatvānumānepi pravṛtte 'kṣaṇikāropāt |
 satyaṃ (|) kevalam anumānenākṣaṇikārthaniṣedhe kṛte nāyamakṣaṇikākāraḥ pratyayas tajjanyopi tu sadṛśāparotpattijanyatvenāropita iti pratipādyate | tasmāt tasyaivānubhūtāniścit asya kṣaṇikatvāder niścayānumānaṃ pravartate viparīta samāropo nāsty abhyāsāderabhāvāc ca nānubhavo miścayajananasamarthe na tatrāpi niścayārthā pramāṇāntaravṛttir ekāṃśaniścayena sarvātmanā niścitatvāt | na ca tad vastu pratibhāsate yasya na kaścid api svabhāvo niścitaḥ | tasmāt tatrāpy ekapramāṇapravṛttāvaparasyāpravṛttiḥ (p.123) syād eveti |
 yadītyādinā | vivaraṇaṃ | dṛṣṭaṃ sarvantattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | tathā niścayapratirodhinā yathādṛṣṭaniścayavibandhakena bhrāntinimittena sadṛśāparotpattilakṣaṇena | gṛṇāntarasthiratvādi | na saṃyojyeta | nāropyeta | yathā śuktau viśiṣṭarūpeṇa g´hītāyām api śuklasādharmyād rajatākāraḥ saṃyojyeta | tadā syād anavakāśā pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ (|)
 syān mataṃ (|) na śuktau viśiṣṭarūpagrahe rajatasamāropaḥ kin tu yad rajatarūpasāmānyan taddṛṣṭer evam adhyavasāya ity atrāha – na hīti | na hi śuktau dve rūpe sambhavataḥ | ekaṃ rajatena samānaṃ rūpaṃ aparam viśiṣṭam avadhāraṇaṃ ca | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tathā sāmānyaviśeṣarūpeṇa śavalābhāsāyāḥ pratipatteḥ sarvadā prasaṅgāt | apratipattau vā vivekeneti | idaṃ sāmānyam ayaṃ viśeṣa ity evam vivekena vibhāgenāpratipattau dvitvavikalpāyogāt | śuktau dve rūpe iti kalpanāyā ayogāt | pratibhāsabhedam antareṇa dvitvakalpanāyām atiprasaṅgāt | anyatrāpy ekatvābhimate dvitvaklpanā syāt | nedaṃ rajatam iti bādhakasyānutpādaprasaṅgāc ca | tasmāc chuktau rūpadvayāyogāt |
 paśyan śuktirūpaṃ puruṣo viśiṣṭam eva svalakṣaṇm eva paśyati na sāmānyaṃ | abhyāsādayo niścayapratyayās teṣām vaiphalyāt tvaniścinvan dviviśiṣṭaṃ śuktikārūpantatasāmānyaṃ rajatarūpasāmānyam paśyāmīti manyate | tata iti rajatarūpasāmānyagrahaṇābhimānā dasya draṣṭuḥ śuktau rajatasamāropaḥ | yad vā śuktikārajatayor yat sāmānyaṃ tulyaṃ rūpan tat paśyāmīti manyate (|) tato rUpadarśanād asya draṣṭū rajatasamāropaḥ | tathā hi yādṛśam eva mayā rajatasya rūpaṃ pratipannantādṛśam evāsyāpi rūpantasmāttad evedaṃ rajatam iti pratītiḥ | yathā rajatasamāropas tathā dṛṣṭe śabdādau dharmiṇi sadṛśāparāparotpattyā sadṛśasya dvitīyasya kṣaṇasyotpattyābhrāntinimittena pūrvottarakṣaṇayor alakṣitanānātv asya puṃsas tadbhāvasamāropāt sattāsamāropāt (p.124) sthitibhrāntiḥ | tasmād yāvantosya śabdeḥ kṣaṇikānātmādisvabhāvasya parabhāvā nityādayas tāvanta eva yathāsvanimittabhāvinaḥ yasya yad anurīpaṃ nimittan tadbhāvinaḥ samāropā iti | tadvyavacchedakāni tasya samāropasyārthād vyavacchedakāni bhavantīty utpadyamānāni pramāṇāny anumānasaṃjñitāni | vyaktibhedād bahuvacanaṃ | saphalāni syuḥ sārthakāni syuḥ | teṣān tu vyavacchedaphalānāṃ samāropapratiṣedhaphalānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ | nāpratītasya vastvaṃśasya vastubhāgasya pratyāyane prakāśane pravṛttiḥ | tasya vastvaṃśasya niraṃśe dharmiṇi dṛśyamāne dṛṣṭatvāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anaṃśasyekad eśena darśanāyogāt || (46)
 yata evaṃ tasmāt pratyakṣeṇa dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭa evākhilo guṇaḥ samastaḥ svabhāvas tathāpi bhrāntteḥ sadbhāvān niścīyate neti kṛtvā tanniśayārthaṃ saḥdhanam anumānaṃ vidhirūpeṇaiva pravarttata iti spaṣṭam evoktaṃ |
 tasmān nādṛṣṭagrahaṇārthā dṛṣṭe pratyakṣeṇa pramāṇāntarasya (|) kin tarhi dṛṣṭaniścayā caiva pravṛttir ity anenāpi vidhyarthaḥ | spaṣṭa evoktonyaniṣedhastv arthāt || (47)
 vastugraha ityādi | cakāraḥ pratyakṣāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ | anumānena ca vastugraheṅgīkriyamāṇe | śabdādidharmiṇo dharmasyaikasya kṛtakatvādilakṣaṇasya niścayena niraṃśatvād dharmiṇaḥ sarvadharmaniścayas tadā nityatvādyanumānāntaravaiphalyam ity ākūtaṃ |
 apoho bāhyātayā āropita ākāropohyate 'neneti kṛtvā | tasminn anumānena pratipādyeṅgīkriyamāṇe yad vāpohyatesmin nityapohaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ (|) tasmin svākārābhinnatayā 'numānagrāhye 'bhyupagamyamāne nāyam anantarokto doṣaḥ prasajyate |
 na kevalam ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | kvacit pratyakṣadrṣṭe dharmiṇīti sambandhaḥ | kasmiṃś cit pratyakṣadṛṣṭe dharmiṇīty arthaḥ | na sarvo dharmī pratyakṣo bhavantīti kvacid grahaṇaṃ | anantaroktena nyāyena pramāṇāntarāvṛttiḥ |
 tadānumānam api vastu śabdādikaṃ vidhanā pratyāyatīṣyate vastvadhyavasāyo nārthān na samāropavyavacched akṛt | tadeti vidhirūpeṇa vastusvarūpagrahaṇe | ekadharmaniścaye sati tadavyatirekān niścitadharmāvyatirekāt sarvadharmaniścaya iti pramānāntarāvṛttir anumānāntarāpravṛttiḥ | saty apy avyatireke | na sarvadharmaniścaya iti ced āha – na hītyādi | tasminn iti prathamānumānaniścite dharme | tadātmeti | niścitadharmātmā sannaniścito na hi yuktaḥ |
 apohe nāyandoṣaḥ prasajyata ity etad vivṛṇvann āha – yadā punar ityādi | yadā punar anumānena vastvadhyavasāyaṃ kurvatā 'rthāt samāropavyavacchedaḥ kriyate na tu sākṣājjñāpakatvād asya | tenaitan nirastaṃ samāropavyavaccheda eva vyavahārādanyārthapravṛttir na syād anumānenāniścitatvād iti | tavaikena kṛtakānumānenaikasyākṛtakasamāropasya vyavacchedād anyasya nityasamāropasya vyavacchedaḥ kṛto na bhavantīti kṛtvā | tadartham anyasamāropavyavacchedārtham anyad ity anityatvādyanumānaṃ pravartate | tasmān na vikalpānāṃ svarūpeṇa bāhyo grāhyo 'pi tu svākāreṇa sahaikīkṛta eva bāhyo viṣayaḥ (|) sa cāsatyo 'pohyate 'nyad aneneti apoha ucyate ||
sthite caivaṃ paro 'navagatābhiprāyaḥ prāha – nanv ityādi. pūrvaṃ tadviparītākārasamāropī viparyasaḥ pravartate. tatas tadviparyāsapūrvako 'pratītasyārthasya liṅgān niścayo bhavatīti nāyaṃ niyamo viparyāsarahite 'py anumānasambhavāt. tad āha – yathetyādi. (p.126) akasmād ity atarkitopasthitāt. sahasaiva kvacit pradeśe dhūmād agnipratipattiḥ. na hi tatrety akasmād agnipratipattāv anagnisamāropaḥ sambhāvyate. tad iti tasmān na sarvatra vyavacchedaḥ kriyate 'rthād ity anumānena.
uktam ity ācāryaḥ. atra hi vastusvarūpagrāhakatvenānumānasya pravṛttāv uktam uttaram. pratyakṣeṇa dharmipratipattau taddharmāṇāṃ dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād abhedāt sarvapratipatter anumānavaiphalyam iti. dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād dharmasya bhede vābhyupagamyamāne dharmiṇā saha na tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ, bhedābhyupagamāt. na cānityatvādīnāṃ dharmisvarupād utpattir, na cānityatvādibhyo dharmiṇa utpattiḥ. tataś cāsambaddhasya dharmasya tatra dharmiṇy apratipattir ity etad apy uktam. ahetuphalabhūtasya tatrānumānāsambhavād ity atrāntare. yata evam, tasmāt tatrāpy akasmād dhūmadarśanād agnipratipattau taddarśinaḥ pradeśadarsinaḥ puṃsas tatsvabhāvāniścayo 'gnimattvasvabhāvāniścayo 'sty eva. sa cāniyataḥ kṛto viparyāsād evānagnimatā pradesena tulyatvagrahaṇād eva.
etad evāha – sa cetādi.
yad vā tatsvabhāvāniścayaḥ kutaḥ, kiṃ tu niścaya eva syād aviparyāsāt. bhavati cāniścayaḥ. tasmān na dharmipratipattir vastusvarūpagrāhiṇīty apohaviṣayā.
kiṃ ca – sa cetyādi. sa ceti puruṣas tadvivikteneti vahnivivekena taṃ pradeśam agnimantam api tadviviktena rūpena niścinvan buddhyā – kimbhūtayā – agnisattābhāvanāvimuktayāgnisattāsambhāvanārahitayā katham aviparyasto nāma. viparyasta evātasmiṃs tadgrahāt. tatha hi – yāvat tatra pradeśe dhūman na paśyati tāvad anyenāgnirahitena pradeśena sadṛśantam apy adhyavasyati | yadi kvacid anubhava yoge sati yadīha niścayasthāpi tatra saṃśayena bhāvyaṃ saṃśayaścobhayāṃśāvalambī| sa ca pakṣe tadviparītaṃ saṃspṛśatyevātaḥ saṃśayavyudāsepy anyavyavacchedaḥ kuto bhavaty eva liṅgena | avaśyaṃ ca liṅgād evānumeyaṃ pratipadyamānas tatrānumeye viparyāsasaṃśayābhyāṃ yakto bhavati | yasmāt tadākārasamāropasaṃśayarahitaś ca | anagnyākārasamāropeṇa (p.127) saṃśayena ca rahitaś ca puruṣas tatpratipattau agnipratipattau na liṅgamanusaret | na pakṣadharmaṃ samāśrayet | tathā na tasya liṅgasyānvayavyatirekayor ādriyeta || yāvatānusaredādriyate ca | tasmāt tadākārasamāropasaṃśyavān pratipatā liṅgabalena samāropam apanayati kvacitsaṃśayamataḥ sarvatra svavyāpakapratipattidvāreṇa samāropavyavacchedaḥ kriyate | (48)
tasmād apohaviṣayam anyavyavacchedaviṣayaṃ | ity ukteṇa na tu sākṣāt | anyatheti yadi samāropam antareṇānumānasya pratipattir iṣyate | tadā kena cit pramāṇena dharmiṇaḥ siddhau kim asiddhantasya dharmiṇo rūpamataḥ siddhāt svabhāvāt paramanyd asti yasya pratyāyanāya liṅgaṃ pravartteta ||
nanu saṃśayaviparyayotpāde sati bhāvaḥ syāt | yad āha – na cemāḥ kalpanā apratisaṃviditā evodayane vyayante ceti | nāpi tatpratipattau liṅgānusaraṇena tadākārasamāropasaṃśayaḥ śakyate kalpayitun niścayānutpattipakṣepi (|) sādhyaniścayārthaṃ liṅgānusaraṇasya sambhavāt |

 bhavatu tāvat samārope tadvyavacchedāya svaviṣaye pravarttamānaṃ liṅgam anyāpohakṛt | yat punar idaṃ pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvi vikalpavijñānan tad asati samārope bhavat katham anyāpohakṛt | avaśyaṃ ca tadanyāpohaviṣayam eṣṭavyaṃ sāmānyaviṣayatvād anyāpohalakṣaṇātvāc ca sāmānyasya bhavatāndarśaneneti (|) (49)

 nanu copādhyupādhimadbhāva āśrayāśrayibhāva evocyate | sa ca samānakālabhāvinor eva (|) na ca tayor upakāryopakārakabhāvo bhinnakālatvād asya (|) tat katham ucyate | ekopādhiviśiṣṭagrahe sarvagraha iti |

 yady apītyādinā kārikārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | śabdāntarāṇāṃ jñānāntarāṇām artha upādhimati pratipattau pratinimittaṃ bhinnā evopādhayo yady apy abhyupagamyante (|) sa tu tadvānupādhimān arthaḥ śabdajñānair upalīyate viṣayīkriyate | tasya tadvato nānopādhīnām upakārāśrayā yāḥ śaktayas tatsvabhāvasya svātmani svarūpe bhedo nāsti | tataś caikopādhidvāreṇāpi (p.134) grahe sarvātmanā grahaṇan tasmin sati ka evopādhibhedas tasyāniścitaḥ kintu sarva eva niścitaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvopādhyupakārakatvena grahaṇāt |
 ekopādhidvāreṇopādhimataḥ svarūpam eva grahītaṃ na tūpādhyupakārakatvam iti ced āha – na hītyādi | na hy upādhyupakārakatvam anyad evāgṛhītam ity anena sambandhaḥ | tasyety upādhimataḥ svena rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇasya svarūpād upakārakatvasyābhedāt | yata evam ataḥ kāraṇād asyety upādhimataḥ | yad eva svabhāvena svarūpeṇa grahaṇan tad evopakārakatvenāpi grahaṇam iti |
 bhavatv ekopādhidvāreṇopādhimataḥ sarvopādhyupakārakatvasya svabhāvabhūtasya grahaḥ | upādhīnān tu tasmād vyatiriktānāṃ kathaṃ grahaṇam ity ata āha – tayor ityādi | upādhikalāpasyopādhimataś ca upakāryopakārakabhūtayor ātmani svabhāvenyonyasambandho sambandhād upakāryopakārakasambandhasyātmabhūtatvād iti yāvat | tataś copakārakasvabhāvasyaikasya jñāne sati sambandhād dvayagrahaḥ | upādhyupādhimator grahaḥ |
 stadvyācaśṭe | ātmabhūtasyetyādi | tathā hy upādhimati gṛhīte tasyātmabhūta upakārakabhāvas tāvad gṛhītas tasmin gṛhīte upādhīnām apy ukāryabhāva ātmabhūto gṛhītas tadgrahaṇanāntarīyakatvād upakārakabhāvagrahaṇasya (|) ataḥ kāraṇād ekajñāne dvayor apy upādhyupādhimator grahaṇam iti kṛtvā ekopādhiviśiṣṭe 'pi tasminn upādhimati gṛhyamāṇe sarvopādhīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇanāntarīyakatvād ity upādhigrahaṇanāntarīyakatvāt | anyathety upādhīnām agrahe tathāpi na gṛhyeta | upādhīnām upakāraka upādhimān ity evam api na gṛhyeta |
 ya eva tadānīṃ jñānaśabdapravṛttinimittam upādhis taṃ pratyevopakārakatvam upādhimato gṛhītaṃ na tūpādhyantaropakārakatvam iti ced āha – na hy anya evetyādi | anyopakāraka ity anyasyopādher upakārakaḥ svabhāvo yo na gṛhītaḥ kintu sarva eva gṛhīto niraṃśatvād avastunaḥ |
(p.135) syān matam (|) upādhimatonapekṣitasambandhina upakāraka ity eva grahaṇaṃ na tv asyopakāraka iti tato nopādhīnāṃ grahaṇam ity ata āha – na cāpītyādi | tathā gṛhīta ity upakāraka ity evaṃ gṛhīte upakārakāryasyopādher agrahaṇaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyāpy ukārakasya upakāraka ity evam agrahaṇa prasaṅgāt | etat kathayati (|) sambandhitvād upakārakasyāntareṇa dvitīyasambandhigrahaṇam upakāraka ity api grahaṇaṃ nāstīti |tathābhūtañ ca dṛṣṭāntam āha – svasvāmitvavad iti | na hi svagrahaṇam antareṇāsti svāmitvasya grahaṇaṃ | yata evam ekopādhidvāreṇa pravṛttepy ekasmin jñāne śabde ca sarvopādhīnāṃ grahaṇam upādhimataś ca sarvātmanā | tasmād arthāntaropādhivādepi arthāntarabhūtā upādhaya ity evaṃvādepi samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | śabdajñānāntarānāṃ paryāyatā prāpnotīti |(| 55 ||)

 athāpītyādinā paramāśaṅkate | yābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktimān upādhīn upakaroti tāḥ śaktayaḥ śaktimataḥ sakāśād bhinnāḥ | tata iti bhedāt | nāyaṃ prasaṅga iti | ekopādhyupakārakaśaktyabhedagrahe sarvaśaktīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇāc ca sarvopādhīnām ity ayaṃ prasaṅgo nāsti |
 uttaram āha – dharmopakāretyādi | dharmā upādḥayas teṣām upakārasya yāḥ śaktayas tāsāṃ śaktimataḥ sakāśād bhede 'bhyupagamyamāne tāḥ śaktayas tasya śaktimataḥ kim bhavanti | na kiṃcid bhavanti na tatsambandhinya ity arthaḥ | yadā yadi nopakāras tataḥ | śaktimatas tāsāṃ śaktīnāṃ | atha sambandhasiddhyartham upakāra iṣyate | tadā śaktyupakāriṇyo parā vyatiriktāḥ śaktayo 'ṅgīkarttavyāḥ | yābhiḥ śaktīr upakaroti (|) tāsāṃ ca sambandhatvasiddhyartham upakāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ | tatrāparā śaktikalpaneti tathā syād anavasthitiḥ |
(p.136)  tad vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi | upādhim upādhim prati pratyupādhi | upakārakatvāni śaktayas tasyopādhimataḥ na svātmabhūtāni | na svabhāvabhūtāni | kintu vyatiriktāni | nāpi tata upādhimataḥ upakāram anubhavanti | ātmasātkurvanti | kin tasya tā ucyante | upādhimataḥ śaktaya iti kasmād ucyante | sambandhābhāvāt | sambandhasiddhyartham upādhimataḥ sakāśāt tāsām upādhyupakāriṇīnāṃ śaktīnām upakārevāṅgīkriyamāṇe yābhiḥ śaktibhir upādhyupakāriṇīḥ śaktīr upakaroty ayam upādhimān | yadi tās tasyātmabhūtā iṣyante tadā svātmabhūtābhiḥ śaktibhir ayam upādhimān eka ity anaṃśaḥ | upādhyupakāriṇīḥ śaktīr upakurvan |
 tathā hītyādinā sarvātmanā grahaṇaṃ sādhayati | ekopādhigrahaṇe tadupakāriṇyo upādhyupakāriṇyo vyatiriktāyāḥ śakter grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇa iti | upādhyupakāriśaktigrahe | tadupakārī upādhyupakāriśaktyupakārī | kiṃbhūtaḥ svātmabhūtasakalaśaktyapakāraḥ svātmabhūtāḥ sakalā upādhyupakāriṇīnāṃ śaktīnām upakārāḥ śaktayo yasya sa tathābhūto bhāvo gṛhītaḥ sarvā upādhyupakārikāḥ śaktīr grāhayati | tāś cemāḥ śaktayo gṛhītāḥ svopakāryānupādhīn grāhayantīti tad avasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ko bhedaḥ syād aniścita iti ya uktaḥ ||
 atha mābhūd eṣa doṣa iti tā api śaktyupakāriṇyaḥ śaktayo bhinnā evopādhimato bhāvād iṣyante | tadā tadupakāriṇyo 'pi śaktayo vyatiriktāḥ kalpanīyās tathā tadupakāriṇya ity evam anavasthānāt | upādhīnāṃ tacchaktīnāṃ ca | upādhyupakāraśaktīnāṃ cāparāparāsv eva śaktiṣv aparyavasānenāniṣṭhayā yad ghaṭanantasyodghaṭanāt sambandhanāt | tathā hy upādhayo vyatiriktāsu śaktiṣu sambandhās tā api vyatiriktāsv eva | evam uttarottarā śaktiḥ pūrvapūrvāsu śaktiṣu vyatiriktāsv evānavasthānena sambaddhā | na tūpādhimati | tataś ca sa eka upādhimān | tābhir upādhyupakārikābhiḥ (p.137) śaktibhis saha kadācid apy agṛhītas tadupakārātmā | śaktyupakārātmā | upādhyupakārikāṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ yāḥ śaktayas tadātmeti yāvat | śaktīnān tato vyatirekāt | tadvattvena upādhyupakāraśaktimattvena | tadgrahād upādhimattvenāpy ato vyarthaivopādhikalpaneti bhāvaḥ |
 evan tāvad yadopādhimati jñānaśabdayor vṛttis tadokto doṣaḥ | yadopādhiṣv eva tadānyo doṣo vaktavyaḥ tadabhidhānāyopādhipakṣam upanyasyati | yadi punar ityādi | kevalānityāśrayarahitān upādhīn viśeṣaṇabhedān śabdajñānānyupalīyeran | pratyāyakatvena samāśrayeyuḥ | tasyopādhimataḥ śabdajñānair asamāveśād aviṣayīkaraṇāt | tatpratipattimukhenopādhimatpratipattimukhena | ekenāpi śabdajñānena sarvasyopādheḥ pratipattiḥ (|)
 atrāpi doṣam āha – tadāpītyādi | tasyopādhimataḥ | anākṣepād ity apratipādanāt | tatrety upādhimati (|) kathaṃ vyartha ity āha – arthakriyetyādi | arthakriyāṃ purodhāya pravṛtter arthakriyā āśraya ālambanaṃ yasya vyavahārasya sa tathā | sarvo yāvān kaścit prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāṃ vyavahāro hitāhitaviṣayaḥ | sa ca dvābhyāṃ prakārābhyāṃ vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ tṛtīyaprakārābhāvāt | itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā (pāṇiniḥ) ceyaṃ tṛtīyā | upādhyo(?dhya)ś ca gotvādayas tatrārthakriyāyām asamarthāḥ | samarthaś ca vyaktibhedaḥ śabdenaivocyata iti kim phalaiḥ śabdaprayogaiḥ | yataś caivam arthakriyāsamartho vyaktibhedo na cocyate śabdaiḥ | tataś cābhimatā upādhayo gotvādaya upādhayo na syur na viśeṣaṇāni syuḥ | yasmāt kvacid upādhimatyupādhidvāreṇa śabdasya jñānasya vā pravṛttau satyāṃ | kasyacid upādhimataḥ | pradhānasyeti viśeṣyasyāṅgābhāvād viśeṣaṇabhāvāt tadapekṣayā pradhānāpekṣayā | tathocyante | upādhaya ity ucyante | iyaṃ nyāyopādhivyavasthā | yadā tūpādhaya eva śabdenocyante | tadā tasyopādhimataḥ (p.138) śabdenānākṣepād apratipādanān na te upādhayaḥ kasyacit pradhānasyāṅgabhūtā iti kim upādhayo naiveti yāvat | yady upādhimātraṃ codyate tathāpi śabdair lakṣitā ye upādhayas tair upādhimato lakṣaṇāt paricchedād adoṣaḥ | śabdaprayogavaiyarthyadoṣo neti cet | sa samānaḥ sarvopādhigrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | tam evāha – sa tāvad ityādi | sa ity upādhimān | nāntarīyakatayety upādhyupādhimator avyabhicāreṇa upalakṣyamāṇa ekenāpy upādhinā niraṃśatvāt sarvātmanopalakṣita iti tadavasthaḥ sarvopādhigrahaprasaṅgaḥ |
 syān mataṃ (|) yatra śabdena sākṣād upādhimataś codanan tatrāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ | na tu yatrārthavaśād ity ata āha – ko hy atra viśeṣa iti | śabdā vā enam upādhimantaṃ sākṣāt pratipādayeyuḥ | tallakṣitā vā śabdalakṣitā vopādhaya upādhimantaṃ lakṣayeyur iti ko viśeṣo na kaścit (|) tathā hi (|) sa tāvad upādhimān tadānīm upādhibalena lakṣaṇakāle niścīyate | sarvopakārakaḥ sarveṣām upādhīnām upakāraka iti | tathā ca pūrvavat sarvopādhigrahaṇaprasaṅgo 'to lakṣitalakṣaṇād iti yad uktam etan na kiñcit pūrvoktadoṣaduṣṭatvāt | yasmād upādhyupakārikāṇāṃ śaktīnām vyatireke 'navasthāsyād ato na vyatiriktāḥ śaktayaḥ || (56 ||)

 tasmād ekasyopādher upakārake tasminn upādhimati grāhyebhyupagamyamāne upādhyantarāṇām upakārakāḥ śaktibhedāḥ | tata ekopādhyupakārakasvabhāvād apare 'nye na bhavanti (p.139) ye dṛṣṭe tasminn upādhimaty adṛṣṭā bhavanti | kin tv ananye | ataḥ kāraṇāt tadgrāhye | tasyopādhimato grahe sakalopādhyupakāraka svabhāvasya grahaḥ |
 yo 'pi bhaṭṭo manyate (|) bhinnā bhinnā eva dharmās tenaikadharmeṇa dharmiṇyavadhāryamāṇena sarvadharmāvadhāraṇaṃ bhedāt | tad āha –
 "āvirbhāvatirobhāvadharmakeṣv anuyāyi yat |
 taddharmi yatra vā jñānaṃ prāgdharmagrahaṇād bhavet || (152)
 anantadharmake dharmiṇy ekadharmāvadhāraṇe |
 śabdobhyupāyamātraṃ syān na tu sarvāvadhāraṇa" (178) iti |1*
sopy ubhayapakṣabhāvidoṣaprasaṅgād eva nirastaḥ || (57 ||)
fn. 1*: Ślokavārttika, Pratyakṣaparicchedha.

 yadītyādinā parābhiprāyam āśaṃkate | ekena niścayajñānena sarvātmanā gṛhītepi vastuni bhrāntinivṛttyarthaṃ | anyad iti pramāṇāntaraṃ |
 syād etad ityādinaitad eva vyācaṣṭe | nirbhāgasya niraṃśasya vastuno grahaṇe sati ko 'nyo bhāgaḥ tadā nirbhāgavastugrahaṇakāle | na gṛhīto nāma sarva eva gṛhītaḥ (|) sa tu gṛhīto 'pi bhrāntyā nāvadhāryata iti pramāṇāntaraṃ pravartate |
 yady evam ityādinā siddhāntavādī | yat tad bhrāntinivṛttyartham uttaram pramāṇam iṣyate tadvyavacchedaviṣayam anyāpohaviṣayaṃ siddhaṃ pūrvoktena nyāyena | tadvad uttarapramāṇavat | tata uttarakālabhāvi pramāṇād aparam api pūrvakālabhāviniścayajñānan tad api vyavacchedaviṣayaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) asamāropaviṣaye vṛtteḥ |
(p.140)  tat tarhītyādinā ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe. anyasyākārasya yaḥ samāropas tadvyavacchedaphalam iti kṛtvā siddham anyāpohaviṣayam utpitsusamāropaniṣedhadvāreṇa | tadvad anyad api pūrvam api niścayajñānam anyāpohaviṣayaṃ (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) avidyamānasamārope viṣaye vṛtteḥ | etad evāha – yatrākāre 'sya pratipatteḥ | iti hetoḥ samāropābhāve varttamānaḥ paurastyo niścayo 'nyāpohaviṣayaḥ siddhaḥ ||
 kiṇ ca (|) viścayagṛhīte 'py arthe bhrāntinivṛttyarthaṃ pramāṇāntaram icchatā niścayaviṣayaś ca na ca niścita ity abhyupagataṃ syād (|) anyathā bhrānter ayogāt (|) tac cāyuktam ity āha – api cetyādi. yad rūpaṃ niścayair na niścīyate tad rūpaṃ teṣāṃ niścayānāṃ viṣayaḥ katham, naiva. kiṃ kāraṇam? yasmād iyam eva niścayānāṃ svārthapratipattiḥ, yat tasyārthasya niścayanam. tac ced niścayaviṣayābhimatam ākārāntaravad aniścitam, yan niścayaviṣayatvenānabhimataṃ tadvat tair niścaye gṛhītaṃ ||
 katham ityādi paraḥ. pratyakṣagṛhīte samāropavyavacchedārthaṃ pramāṇāntaram icchatānyāpohavādināpy aniścīyamāna ākāraḥ pratyakṣagṛhītatveneṣṭo yadi vā niścayavaśād eva grahaṇaṃ | katham idānīm aniścīyamānaṃ rūpaṃ pratyakṣeṇāpi gṛhītam iti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ.
 netyādinā pariharati. kalpanāviviktatvād ity abhiprāyaḥ. tad iti pratyakṣam. yam api nīlādyākāraṃ gṛhṇātīty ucyate. tad grahaṇaṃ na niścayena, kiṃ tarhi pratibhāsena. niraṃśasya vastunaḥ sarvathā pratibhāsanam iti sarvathā (p.141) grahaṇaṃ (|) tad iti tasmāt. na niścayāniścayavaśād yathākramaṃ pratyakṣasya grahaṇāgrahaṇe, kiṃ tu pratibhāsanāpratibhāsanavaśāt. tasmād aniścaye sati pratibhāsanamātreṇa pratyakṣagṛhītavyavasthāpanaṃ na virudhyate. naivaṃ niścayānāṃ pratyakṣavad aniścitasyāpy ākārasya pratibhāsanamātreṇa grahaṇam. apratibhāsamātreṇāgrahaṇam iti sambandhaḥ. kasmād iti ced āha – kiñcid ityādi. yathā puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣatvaṃ niścinvato 'py anyatra taskarādāv aniścayena pravṛttibhedād vyavahārabhedāt. tathā hi – puruṣatvaniścayena puruṣānurūpo viśvāsādivyavahāro dṛśyate | cauratvāniścayāc ca tadanurūpo bhayādivyavahāro na dṛśyate. tataś ca yanniścayānurūpaḥ pravṛttibhedas, tasya niścayena grahaṇam. yadaniścayānurūpaś cāpravṛttibhedas, tasyāgrahaṇam iti. yata evaṃ tasmād ityādi. asyety ākārasya. anyatheti yadi niścayavaśāt tasya grahaṇaṃ na vyavasthāpyate | tadaikākāre 'pi niścitatvenābhimate 'py ākāre tad iti niścayena grahaṇaṃ na syāt. |(| 58, 59 ||)

kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam iti paraḥ. sarvato bhinna iti sajātīyavijātīyād vyāvṛtteḥ. tathaiveti yathānubhavaṃ sarveṣv eva bhedeṣu na smārto niścayo bhavati | yato bhedāntare 'nyākāravyavacchedārtham anyāpohavādinā pramāṇāntaravṛttir iṣyate |
sahakārivaikalyād iti siddhāntavādī | na hy anubhavamātraniścayahetuḥ kin tv abhyāsādayo 'pi sahakāriṇaḥ (|) te yatraiva santi tatraivākāre niścayo nānyatra |
 nanu kṣaṇikākāre 'pi sarvadā darśanād abhyāso 'sty eveti niścayaḥ syāt | nānubhūtaniścitaviṣayo 'trābhyāso 'bhipreto na ca kṣaṇikaṃ bhrāntinimittasambhavād anubhūtaniścitam iti kathan tatrābhyāsaḥ | tasmāt sthitam etat yatraivākāre 'bhyāsas tatraiva niścaya iti ||

yad evāha – tataś cetyādi. viśeṣe sarvato vyāvṛtte nīlādilakṣaṇe 'ṃśavivarjite nirvibhāge sarvātmanā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhīte 'pi sati yasya viśeṣasyāvasāye niścaye 'sti sahakāripratyayaḥ sa pratīyate niścīyate |
p.142 [PVSV 32,3]yady apītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sarvabhedeṣu kṣaṇikatvādiṣu tāvatety anubhāvamātreṇa | niścayotpādanaṃ pratyanubhavajñānasya kāraṇantarāpekṣatvāt. tad evāha – anubhavo hītyādi. yathāvikalpābhyāsam iti yasya yādṛśo vikalpābhyāsas tena sahakāriṇā janayatīty arthaḥ. udāharaṇam āha – yathetyādi. mṛtastrīrūpadarśanāviśeṣe 'pi parivrāṭkāmukaśunāṃ yathākramaṃ kuṇapakāminībhakṣyavikalpā yathāvikalpābhyāsañ jāyante | na ca vikalpābhyāsa eva sahakārī, kiṃ tv anyo 'py astīty āha – tatretyādi. tatrāpi rūpadarśanāviśeṣe 'pi | buddheḥ pāṭavantīkṣṇatā | yathā yogināṃ buddhipāṭavād darśanamātreṇa kṣaṇikatvādiniścayaḥ | ādiśabdād arthitvasāmarthyādiparigrahaḥ | ityādaya ity evamādayaḥ | anubhavāt pratyakṣād upādānakāraṇāt sakāśād bhedaniścayasyotpattau sahakāriṇaḥ | yadā tarhi bahuṣu niścayeṣu yathoktāni kāraṇāni na bhavanti tadā teṣāṃ niścayānāṃ kathaṃ kramabhāva ity āha – teṣām eva cetyādi (|) teṣām iti niścayakāraṇānāṃ pratyāsattitāratamyabhedāt | yasya niścayasya pratyāsannatamanniścayakāraṇan tat tāvadādāv utpadyate | ādiśabdād adhimātratāratamyasya bhedān niścayānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ | yathetyādinodāharaṇam āha – piteva yadopādhyāyo bhavati | tadaikasya puruṣasya janakatvādhyāpakatvāviśeṣe 'pi | pitaram āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā me āgacchatīti niścinoti nopādhyāya iti | pitṛtvaniścaye kāraṇasya pratyāsannatamatvāt ||
 nanu saty api kṣaṇikatvanairātmyavikalpābhyāse sahakāriṇī tattvādarśināṃ na pratyakṣāt kṣaṇikatvādiniścayo bhavatīty ata āha – so 'pītyādi | asati bhrāntikāraṇe bhavati na tu niścayapratyayamātrāt | yata evam asati bhrāntikāraṇe sahakāripratyasākalye ca sati pratyakṣān niścaya utpadyate na kevalāt | tasmān nānubhūta ityādi |
(p.143) tataś ca sthitam etad (|) anyavyavacchedaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ pratipadyata iti |
 nanu vyavacchedo 'pi yadi padārthād abhinnas tadaikena pramāṇena śabdena vāsya viṣayīkaraṇe 'nyasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt sarvātmanā niścitatvāt | atha bhinnas tadāpi tasyāśritatvād ekavyavacchedopādhike padārthe pramāṇenaikena niścīyamāne pūrvoktena nyāyena sarveṣāṃ vyavacchedānāṃ niścitatvād anyeṣāṃ pramāṇādīnām apravṛttiḥ syād (|) ataḥ samānaḥ prasaṅga iti |
 tan na | yato na bhāvānām anyonyavyavacchedo 'bhinno bhinno vāsti | kevalaṃ svahetubhya eva bhinnāḥ samutpannā ity uktam vakṣyati ca || (60 ||)

 kathan tarhy anyavyāvṛttir ityādi vyapadeśo buddhiś ca pravṛttata ity atrāha – tatrāpītyādi | tatrāpi cānyāpohe śabdārthe | anyasmād vyāvṛttir anyasmād vyāvṛtto 'yam ity api (|) ye śabdā dharmadharmivācanāḥ niścayāś cobhayaviṣayās te saṃketam anurundhate | saṃketānuvidhānenaiṣāṃ dharmadharmiviṣayavibhāgaḥ kalpitaḥ paramārthatas tu vyāvṛttir eva nāstīty arthaḥ |
 tad vyācaṣṭe – tatrānyāpoha ityādinā. gor aśvād vyāvṛttir anyā dharmabhūtā anya evāśvād vyāvṛtto dharmī | vyāvṛttyā viśiṣṭo gaur ity etan nāsti | kin tu yaiva vyāvṛttiḥ sa eva vyāvṛtta iti vakṣyati |
 yadi cāśvād vyāvṛttir anaśvatā godravyasyānyā syāt tadāśvavyāvṛtter api godravyeṇa nivarttitavyambhedāt | tataś ca tadvyāvṛtter anaśvatāyāḥ sakāśān nivartamānasya gos tadbhāvaprasaṅgāt | aśvabhāvaprasaṅgād aśvavat | evaṃ hy aśvavyāvṛtter anaśvatvalakṣaṇāyā gaur vyāvṛtto bhavati yady asyāśvatvaṃ syāt | tathā ca gor aśvabhāvāpatteḥ | aśvād gor vyāvṛttis tasyā abhāvaḥ | gavāśvayor ekatvāt |
 tena yad uktañ jainajaiminīyaiḥ (|)
 "sarvātmakam ekaṃ syād anyāpohavyatikrama" iti |1*
tān pratīdam uktaṃ | yady anyavyāvṛttir arthāntaraṃ syād gavāśvādīnām ekatvaṃ syād iti |

(p.144) nāpi gor abhinnāśvavyāvṛttir aśvavyāvṛttau gaur ity apratītiprasaṅgāt | govināśe cāśvasyotpattiprasaṅgād aśvanivṛtter vinaṣṭatvāt | tasmān nāsty eva vyāvṛttiḥ |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ | "yo 'yam agophaḥ sa kiṃ gavi bhinne 'rtho bhinnaḥ | yadi bhinnaḥ kimāśrito 'thānāśritaḥ (|) yady āśritas tadāśritatvād guṇa iti gośabdena tadā guṇyabhidhīyate na godravyam iti | gaus tiṣṭhatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt | athānāśritaḥ kenārthena ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | gor apoha iti | athābhinno gaur eva syād iti na kiñcid aniṣṭhaṃ | ayaṃ cāpohaḥ prativastu yady eko 'nekasambandhī ca tad eva gotvam" iti (|)
 tan nirastaṃ | anyavyāvṛtter evābhāvāt kevalaṃ svahetutaḥ svakīyena rūpeṇotpanno bhāvo 'nyasmād vyāvṛttas tasya cānyasmād vyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate | yataś ca na paramārthato vyāvṛttir asti | tasmād yaiva vyāvṛttiḥ sa eva vyāvṛttaḥ | dvābhyām aikasyaiva viṣayīkaraṇāt | tasyaiva cānyavyāvṛttasya liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ sambandho vikalpaviṣayatvañ ca (|) vikalpo hy anyavyāvṛttaṃ svākārābhinnamadhyasya puruṣan tatra pravarttayatītyatyarthakāritvād (|) ataḥ sa eva bāhyaḥ śabdārtho 'nyavyāvṛttaḥ |
 yad apy ucyate kumārilena (|) kadācid ekasmād eva bhāvasyāpohaḥ syāt | sarvāsmād vā | yady ekasmād eva tadā yathāśvāpohadvāreṇa godravyasya gaur ity abhidhānanantathā siṃhāder api syād aśvāpohasya gośabdapravṛttinimittasya bhāvāt | tad āha –

 tannimittam agopohaṃ vibhrad ucyata gaur iti" iti |1*

 "tato gaur iti sāmānyaṃ vācyam ekaṃ na sidhyati |"2*
nāpi te samudāyarūpeṇa sarve 'pohyāḥ sambhavanti | samudāyo hy ekadeśatvena vā syān na cāpohyānām ekadeśāditvaṃ sambhavati | nāpi teṣāṃ samudāyo vyatirikto 'sty avyatireke cānantyaṃ tadavasthaṃ | na cāpi sāmānyarūpeṇa te 'pohyāḥ sāmānyasyāvastutvāt (p.145) | apohyatve ca vastutvaṃ syād iti |

 tad ayuktaṃ yataḥ (|) sarvabhāvānāṃ svenaiva svenaiva rūpeṇotpadyamānānāṃ sarvasmād apohaḥ svahetubhyaḥ siddha eva |
 atha katham asau jñāyata iti codyate | tat kiṅ gaur atītānāgatavarttamānāśvādisvabhāvaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate | neti cet | kathaṃ na tatra sarvāpohaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ | na hi pramāṇaṃ hastābhyāṅgṛhītvānyadapohaty api tu niyatarūpārthaprakāśanam evāsyānyāpohaṃ |tasmān niyatarūpārthapratibhāsa eva pratyakṣasya sarvasmād apohagrahaḥ | tac ca svaviṣayan niścāya yad yad evaṃ na bhavati tatsarvam anyatvena niścāyayaty ato yugapat sarvasyānyasya sāmānyenāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ kriyate | sāmānyasyānirddhāritaviśeṣarūpatvāt | tad uktam (|)

tenāpohyasya kasyacid vastutvam iṣyata eva |
 na cāpohyatvād vastutvam ity atra kiñcid pramāṇam asty abhāvasyāpy apohyatvān na cāsya vastutvam ity uktaṃ | tasmād yugapat sarvāpohalakṣaṇenāgopohenaikasminn api piṇḍe gotvaṃ | pratyekāśvādyapohenānaśvatvāsiṃhatvāmahiṣatvādayo jātibhedāḥ kalpitās taddvāreṇa ca tadabhidhāyakāḥ pravarttanta iti yat kiñcid etat |
 yadi vyavṛttivyāvṛttābhidheyārthasya na bhedaḥ | kathaṃ vyāvṛttivyāvṛtta iti śabdajñānabhedaḥ | tathā hi vyāvṛttir ity anyaḥ śabdo vyāvṛtta ity anya eva śabdaḥ | tathā jñānabhedo 'pi (|) vyāvṛttir ity ukte dharmamātram pratīyate | vyāvṛtta iti dharkīti | tata āha (|) śabdetyādi | śabdād dharmadharmivācino yā pratītiḥ | sā śabdapratipattiḥ | śabdaś ca śabdapratipattiś ceti virūpaikaśeṣaḥ | śabdabhedaḥ śabdāc ca yā pratipattis tasyābheda ity arthaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhikaraṇaṃ saṃketas tasya bhedāt | saṃketabhedaṃ cānantaram eva (1.63) bhedāntarapratikṣepetyādinā pratipādayiṣyate | na vācyabhedo 'sti dharmadharmiśabdayor vastuta ity adhyāhāraḥ || (61 ||)

 nanu cetyādi paraḥ | kiṃ punar vācyāviśeṣe saṃketabhedo na yukta iti ced āha – dvayor ityādi | karttari ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtīti ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti (p.146) niyamasya śeṣe vibhāṣeti1* vikalpanāt | dvābhyāṃ dharmadharmiśabdābhyām ekasyārthasyābhidhānād ity arthaḥ | ekaṃ ced dvābhyām abhidheyan tato vyarthaḥ saṃketaḥ | tathā ceti dharmadharmiṇor abhede vyatirekiṇyā iti vyatirekābhidhāyinyā gor gotvam iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ | tasyā iti vyatirekavibhakter bhedāśrayatvād vastubhedam āśritya pravṛtteḥ | yathā devadattasya kamaṇḍalur iti | evaṃ saṃketābhāve vyatirekavibhaktyabhāve ca codite |

 vibhaktyabhāvadoṣan tāvat pariharann āha – dvayor ityādi | dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor ekasyārthasyābhidhāne 'pi vibhaktir vyatirekiṇī | vyatirekasya vācikā ṣaṣṭhī | iva śabdo bhinnakramaḥ | bhinnam ivārtham anveti darśayati | vācye saṃketabhedakṛtena leśena mātrayā yo viśeṣas tataḥ kāraṇān na tu paramārthato vastubhedāt |
 yad vyācaṣṭe | na vai śabdānām ityādinā | viṣayasvabhāvāyatteti | bāhyasvalakṣaṇāyattā (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) icchātaḥ puruṣecchāvaśād abhāveṣv api vṛttyabhāvaprasaṅgāt | ta iti | icchāpratibaddhavṛttayaḥ śabdā yathā yena prakāreṇa bhedapratipādanena vyatirikte yathā rājñaḥ puruṣa iti | avyatirikte yathātmaiva hy ātmano draṣṭeti | tathā niyuktā ity abhinne 'py arthe bhedam ivopādāya prayuktās tam artham apratibandhena bhinnam iva prakāśayanti | vastutaḥ svalakṣaṇasyābhede 'pi yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena | gaur iti dharmivācinam āha – gotvam iti dharmavācinaṃ | ābhyām ekābhidhāne 'py agovyāvṛttasya gor abhidhāne 'pi kasyacid viṣayasya pratyāyanārtham iti | agovyāvṛttinimittasya gotvasya prakāśanārthaṃ | agovyāvṛttimātraṃ gotvaśabdena pratipādyam ity evaṃkṛte saṃkete bhede | vyatiriktārthā na vibhaktir asya gotvam iti bhavati ṣaṣṭhī | vyatirikto 'rtho 'syā iti vigrahaḥ | dharmiṇas sakāśād dharmam arthāntaram ivādarśayantī pratibhāti | anarthantare (p.147) 'pīty avyatirikte 'pi dharme (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathā prayogadarśanābhyāsāt | vastubhede sati ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prayogadarśanābhyāsād devadattasya kamaṇḍalur ityādau |
 etad uktam bhavati | vastubhinnam bhavatu mā vā bhūt sarvathā vyatirekavibhaktir icchāmātrānurodhinī kevalaṃ prayogadarśanābhyāsāc chabdārtham bhinnam iva darśayatīti | tāvateti vibhaktiprayogamātrāt | sarvatrety arthābhede 'pi | gaur gotvam ityādau na dharmadharmiṇoḥ paramārthato bhedaḥ | tasmād anyatrāpy arthābhede 'pi puruṣecchāvaśāāt pravṛttasya vyatirekābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya pratibandhābhāvāt | dṛṣṭā ca puruṣecchāvaśāc chabdānāṃ pravṛttir asaty api tathābhūte bāhye vācya ity āha – yathetyādi | ekam vastu kvacit prakaraṇe ekavacanena khyāpyate | yathā tvam iti | tadaviśeṣe 'pi ekatvāviśeṣe 'pi tad eva vastu bahuvacanena yūyam iti | ataś caikasminn api bahuvacanadarśanān na yathāvastu śabdānām pravṛttir iti gamyate | yuṣmadi gurāv ekeṣām1* ity atideśavākyād ekasminn api bahuvacanam iti cet | cintyam etat | kim atideśavākyenaikasya bahutvaṃ kriyate kim vā bahuvacanamātram aprāptaṃ vidhīyata iti (|) na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣo vacanamātreṇa vastūnām vidhānāsambhavāt | dvitīye 'pi pakṣe siddhaivecchāmātreṇa śabdānāṃ pravṛttir iti | evaṃ tāvad vibhaktyabhāvadoṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ (|| 62 ||)

 saṃketābhāvadoṣan tu pariharttun tam evopanyasyati (|) prayojanābhāvāt tv ityādi | dharmidharmaśabdābhyām ekasyābhidhānāt prayojanābhāvaḥ | tad api prayojanam asty eva | gotvāpekṣayā bhedāntarāṇi dravyatvapārthivatvādīni | teṣāṃ pratikṣepo 'svīkāraḥ | tau pratikṣepāpratikṣepau yathākraman tayor dvayor dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor yaḥ saṃketabhedas tasya (|) kim viśiṣṭasya jñātṛvāñchānurodhinaḥ pratipattricchānuvidhāyinaḥ padaṃ prayojanaṃ ||
 etad uktam bhavati | yadānyavyāvattarūpanirākākṣaḥ pratipattāśvād evaikasmād (p.148) vyāvṛttaṃ gopiṇḍaṃ jijñāsate tadā yāvad aśvād vyāvṛttim arthāntarabhūtām āropya tathaiva saṃketapūrvakaṃ laukikena dharmavācakena śabdena na kathayati (|) tāvan na parasya jijñāsito 'rthaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyate (|) atas taṃ praty anaśvatvam asyety ucyate | evaṃ hi dharmiṇo 'prādhānyād anyavyāvṛttarūpānākṣepaḥ kṛto bhavaty aśvād evaikasmād vyāvṛttiś ca | na tadaivam ucyate 'naśva ity anena hy anyavyāvṛttasyāpi rūpasyākṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt (|) na caivam pareṇa jijñāsitam ajijñāsitaṃ ca kathayan kathan nonmattaḥ syāt |
 yadā punar anyavyāvṛttarūpasākāṃkṣe 'śvād vyāvṛttaṃ gopiṇḍaṃ jijñāsate | tadāpi yāvad aśvavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ piṇḍaṃ dharmisvabhāvatayā 'ropya tathaiva saṃketapūrvakaṃ laukikena dharmivācakena na kathayati tāvan na parasya jijñāsito 'rthaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyate 'tas taṃ pratyanaśvo 'yam ity ucyate | evaṃ hi dharmiṇaḥ prādhānyād anyavyāvṛttarūpākṣepaḥ kṛto bhavaty aśvavyāvṛttaś ca gopiṇḍaḥ kathito bhavati | na tadaivaṃ khyāpyate 'naśvatvam asyeti parajijñāsitānyavyāvṛttarūpānākṣepaprasaṅgāt | ajijñāsitaṃ cārthaṃ kathayan kathan nonmattaḥ | sarvaś ca śābdo vyavahāraḥ saṃketapūrvakaḥ saṃketaś ca vikalpakalpitārthapūrvaka eveti vikalpair apy anenaiva dvāreṇa dharmadharmibhāvapratītir yuktā |
 tena yad ucyate (|) bhavatu dharmadharmivācakānāṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepārthapravṛttiḥ | dharmidharmavikalpānān tu kathaṃ pratipattir ity apāstaṃ |
 etad eva vṛttyā spaṣṭayann āha – yadāyam ityādi | pratipatteti śrotā | tasmād aśvādyo 'nyo mahiṣādis tasmād vyavacchedo mahiṣādivyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvas tasya bhāvānapekṣaḥ sattānapekṣaḥ | piṇḍaviśeṣe gavi | aśvavyavacchedamātraṃ jijñāsate | kim asyāśvād vyāvṛttaṃ rūpam astīti | tathābhūtajñāpanārtham iti yathā pratipattrā jñātum iṣṭan tadanurodhena tathābhūtasyāśvād bhedamātrasya jñāpanārthan tathākṛtasaṃketenety aśvavyavacchedamātre pratikṣiptabhedāntare kṛtasaṃketenānaśvatvaṃ śabdena prabodhyate prakāśyate 'naśatvam asya piṇḍasyāstīti | aśvādyo vyavacchedas tadapekṣayā mahiṣādibhyo vyāvṛttayo(r) vyavacchedāntarāṇi | teṣv anirākāṃkṣaḥ pratipattā | tam iti piṇḍaṃ | apratikṣiptabhedāntareṇāśavyavacchedena yuktaṅ godravyaṃ jñātum icchatīti yāvat | aparityaktāni mahiṣādivyavacchedāntarāṇi yena | tasminn aparityaktabhedāntare | tatraiva vāśvavyavacchede | dharmivācinaṃ śabdaṃ prayuñjate vaktāro 'naśvo 'yam iti | kathaṃ prayuñjata ity āha – tathā prakāśanāyeti | apratikṣiptabhedāntarasyāśvavyavacchedasya (p.149) prakāśanāya | apratikṣiptabhedāntaram evāśvavyavacchedan tathā prakāśanāyety anye paṭhanti | tadāpy ayam arthaḥ | apratikṣiptabhedāntaran tam evāśvavyavacchedam aśvavyāvṛttirūpaṃ prayuñjate abhidadhaty anaśvo 'yam ity anena dharmivacanena śabdena | kim artham (|) tathāprakāśanāyāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasya prakāśanāyeti | yenaiva dharmavācī śabdaḥ pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ | ata eva pūrvatreti dharmavācini śabde pratikṣiptam bhedāntaraṃ yeneti | sāmānyenānyapadārthaṃ kṛtvā bhāvapratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ | paścāc chabdavṛtter ity anena sambandhaḥ | anyathā pratikṣiptaṃ bhedāntaratvād iti syāt | evam anyatrāpy evaṃjātīyeṣu śabdeṣu vyutpattir draṣṭavyā |
 bhinnanimittayoḥ śabdayor ekasminn adhikaraṇe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ | viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo vyavacchedyavyavacchedakabhāvaḥ | udāharaṇaṅ gotvam asya śuklam iti | guṇaśabdasyābhidheyavalliṅgavattvena napuṃsakatvaṃ (|) śukla ity anye paṭhanti | evaṃ cācakṣate (|) guṇaśabdo hi pratikṣiptabhedāntareṇa guṇamātre varttamāna upātto guṇamātravṛttīnāṃ śuklādiśabdānāṃ pulliṅgatvaṃ | tadvati tu varttamānānām abhidheyavalliṅgatā | evaṃ cānayor dharmamātravṛttyor na sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāpi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti |
 kasmān na sāmānādhikaraṇyam ity āha – tanmātretyādi | etat kathayati buddhipratibhāsiny evārthasāmānādhikaraṇyādi | na bāhye svalakṣaṇe tasyāvācyatvāt (|) kevalam adhyavasāyād bāhye 'py ucyate | yadi ca dharmadvayayuktaikadharmipratibhāsinī śabdadvayajanitā buddhir ekārthotpadyata bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ | iha tu tanmātraviśeṣeṇa pratikṣiptabhedāntareṇa gotvamātraviśeṣaṇoparaktāyā buddhes tadāśrayabhūtāyā iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāśrayabhūtāyā ekatvena dharmyabhedenāpratibhāsanāt | gotvaśuklatvābhyāṃ yuktam ekan dharmiṇaṃ gṛhītvā buddher apratibhāsanād ity arthaḥ |
 yad vā tadāśrayabhūtāyā iti tad eva gotvam āśrayabhūtaṃ yasyās tasyā buddhes tanmātraviśeṣeṇa pratikṣiptadharmāntareṇa gotvamātreṇa viṣe(?śe)ṣeṇa saha gopiṇḍasyaikatvenāpratibhāsanāt | tathā hy asya gotvam iti prayoge niṣkṛṣṭarūpaṃ dharmaṃ pratiyatī (p.150) buddhir utpadyate | tato na sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti | dharmāntarapratikṣepād eva tadanyeṣu bhedeṣu nirākāṃkṣatvāc ca buddher na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
 dvitīye tu dharmivāciśabdapakṣe bhavati sāmānādhikaraṇyam viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo vā śuklo gaur iti | sāmānādhikaraṇye kāraṇam āha – tathetyādi. tathā saṃketānusāreṇety apratikṣiptabhedāntare vastuni dharmiśabdasya saṃketānusāreṇa hetunā | ekasmin dharmiṇi yojanaṃ saṃhāraḥ | vyavacchedahetukā dharmā vyavacchedadharmāḥ saṃhṛtāś ca te sakalavyavacchedadharmāś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tair dharmaiḥ karaṇabhūtair vibhāgavataḥ | vibhaktānekadharmavato dharmiṇa ekasyeva śabdasandarśanena pradarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | anekadharmavantandhdarmiṇam ekam iva sandarśayantī buddhiḥ pratibhāsata iti yāvat | na tu buddhipratibhāsasandarśito dharmī vastuta ekaḥ (|) vikalpanirmitasya dharmadharmivibhāgasyālīkatvāt | ekasyaivety api paṭhanti | tatrāpi pratipattradhyavasāyavaśad eva yuktam iti boddhavyaṃ | tataḥ siddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ (|) yataś ca bhedāntarāpratikṣepeṇa dharmmiśabdaḥ pravṛttas tata eva tajjanitāyā buddher apratikṣiptabhedāntarāpekṣatvād bhavati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo yad gauḥ śuklo nīlo veti | caśabdaś ca pūrvavad atītahetvapekṣaḥ ||
 idam eva vyāpakaṃ sarvavyavahārasya nāparasparaparikalpitaṃ sāmānyaguṇādikāntasya pramāṇabādhitatvād ity āha – bhedo 'yam evetyādi | dravyabhāvābhidhāyinoḥ śabdayor ayam eva bhedo dharmāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇaḥ | sarvatreti | sāmānyasāmānyavati | guṇaguṇavati | kriyākriyāvati | sarvasmin viṣaye dharmivacano dravyābhidhāryā | dharmavacano bhāvābhidhāyī | yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena na tayor dravyabhāvaśabdayor vācye viśeṣaḥ paramārthataḥ kaścanāsti |
 tadvyācaṣṭe | tasmād ityādi | niścayapratyayaviṣayatvena karaṇena | na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | tathā hi yathā gotvam ity ukte tatraivāgovyavacchede niścayas tathā gaur ity ukte yady apy apratikṣiptabhedāntarasyāgovyavacchinnasyābhidhānan tathāpy agovyavacchedamātre (p.151) niścayo 'nyeṣān tu bhedānām apratikṣepamātraṃ | sa eva ca śabdārtho yatra śābdo niścayo bhavatīti nāsti bhāvadravyābhidhāyiṇoḥ śabdayor vācye viśeṣo bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepamātran tu bhidyate | tad evāha – ekas tam evetyādi | eka iti dharmaśabdas tam ity agovyavacchinnaṃ | pratikṣiptaṃ bhedāntaraṃ yena dharmaśabdena sa tathoktaḥ | anya iti dharmiśabdo 'pratikṣepeṇa tam eva piṇḍaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena gamyatīti nāsti dravyaniścayam prati bhedaḥ pratikṣepāpratikṣepamātran tu bhidyate | evaṃ gamanan devadattasya gacchati devadatta iti na kaścana bheda ity anyatrāpy evaṃ yojyaṃ || (63, 64 ||)

 yāpi jātiguṇakriyāsambandhabhedena catuṣṭhayī śabdānāṃ vṛttiḥ sāpy anenaiva vastugatadharmabhedena saṅgṛhītety āha – jijñāpayiṣur ityādi | jñāpayitum icchurathantam bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇaṃ | taddhitena taddhitapratyayāntena | kṛtāpi vā | kṛtsaṃjñakapratyayāntena vā | anyena vā kṛttaddhitavyatiriktena tiṅantenāvyutpannena vā śabdena śuklādinā yadi brūyāt | tato bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇād viśeṣād aparo bhedo nāsti |
 tad vyācaṣṭe | etāvantam ityādinā | etāvantam iti pratikṣiptabhedāntaralakṣaṇaṃ | kṛtāpi vā | darśayed iti sambandhaḥ |
 yadā vādhiśrayaṇādikriyāyāṃ karttṛsthāyām pacir varttate | tatraiva ca ghañpratyayas tadā pāakatvaśabdena kriyākārakayoḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyo 'bhidhīyata iti pācakatvaśabdena samānārthaḥ pākaśabdaḥ | dvāv apy etau pratikṣiptabhedāntaram apācakavyavacchhinnam arthaṃ pratipādayataḥ | yadā tu karmasthaiva kriyā vikĺttiḥ pacer arthas tadā pācakatvaśabdasya kathaṃ sambandhābhidhāyitvaṃ | pācakatvapākayor bhinnārthatvāt | anyena vā kṛttaddhitavyatiriktena tiṅādinā | tathābhūtajñāpanāya | pratikṣiptabhedāntarajñāpanāya (p.152) svayaṃ kṛtena samayena darśayed iti sambandhaḥ | yathā devadattena śayyate paṭasya śuklatvam iti | atrāpi śāyakaśabdasya ya evārthaḥ sa eva pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ | śayyata ity asyāpi | tathā śuklaḥ paṭa iti ya evācuklavyavacchinno pratikṣiptabhedāntaro 'rthaḥ sa eva pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ paṭasya śukla ity asyāpi | tathābhichānamātreṇeti pratikṣiptāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasyaikadharmigatasya vyavacchedasyābhidhānamātreṇa tad eva vastvarthāntaram eva paramārthato dharmadharmirūpeṇa vibhaktam eva | na punar bhavatīti sambandhaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtasyaiva pratikṣiptāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasyaivaikasya jñāpanāya dharmadharmiśabdasya kṛtasaṃketatvāt |
 yad vā tathābhidhānamātreṇeti | arthāntarabhūtadharmābhidhānamātreṇa taddharmasvarūpam paramārthato 'rthāntaram eva bhavati | tathābhūtasyaiva bhedāntaranirapekṣasyaiva tasyaikavyāvṛttasya jñāpanāya dharmaśabdasya kṛtasaṃketatvāt ||
 nanu cetyādi paraḥ | sambandha ucyata iti pākakriyāyāḥ pācakasya ca karttuḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyalakṣaṇaḥ | tathā hi kṛdantād bhāvapratyayaḥ sambandhasyābhidhāyako 'dṛṣṭo yathāha – samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam iti | kṛdantaś ca pācakaśabdaḥ (|) na pāka eva kriyātmakaḥ pācakatvaśabdenocyate |
 etad uktam bhavati (|) anyaiva karttṛvyatiriktā kriyānyaś ca tayoś ca sambandho 'nya eva | tataś ca karttṛsthakriyābhidhāne saty api pacater na pākapācakatvaśabdayos tulyo 'rtha iti | na vai pākenetyādinā pariharati | pākena kartṛsthena vastubhūtena vyāpāreṇa yukto 'nya eva pākakriyā vyatiriktaḥ pācako nāma karttābhidhīyate pācakaśabdena (|) yādṛśo varṇṇyate vaiśeṣikādibhiḥ kriyā vyatiriktaḥ svatantraḥ kartā yatra kriyākārakasambandho vastubhūtaḥ syāt | tasya svatantrasya kartuḥ kriyāvyatiriktasya niṣetsyamānatvāt | na ced vyatiriktā kriyā karttā vā kutas sambandhaḥ yasya bhāvapratyayenābhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ | yat punar asyeti pācakaśabdasyāsyābhidheyam apācake vyavacchinnam apratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ vastumātran tad eva pācakaśabdābhidheyaṃ (p.153) pācakatvenāpy abhidhīyata ity adhyāhāryaḥ | tasyaiva pratikṣiptabhedāntarasyābhidhānāt | na tu sambandho 'bhidhīyate | tasyāsattvāt | tad eva yathoktaṃ pācakaśabdābhidheyaṃ pākaśabdenāpīty apiśabdāt |
 aparaṃ vyākhyānaṃ | na vai pākeneti pākaśabdenānyāpohavādipakṣe anya eva vyatiriktaḥ kriyāśrayabhūtaḥ pācako 'bhidhīyate | yādṛśo varṇṇyate pareṇa (|) yaḥ kriyākārakasambandhasyāśrayaḥ syāt | tasyāsiddhatvāt (|) kin tv apācakavyāvṛttir bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇābhidhīyate | tad evāha – yat punar ityādi | yad ity apācakavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ pratikṣiptabhedāntaram abhidheyaṃ | asyeti pākaśabdasyānantaram eva karśitaṃ tad eva pākaśabdābhidheyam pācakatvaśabdenāpy abhidhīyate (|) na sambandhaḥ | tasyāsiddhatvāt | apratiṣṭhitair avastubalāyātair ata eva mithyāvikalpāḥ || (65 ||)

 katham punar gamyate kriyā vyatiriktā nāsti tatsamavāyo vety ata āha – yathetyādi | tatsamavāyo veti kriyākārakasamavāyaḥ | yataś ca vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator abhedas tena kāraṇenānyāpohaviṣayo jātimān śabdair abhidhīyata iti (|) tadvatpakṣas tatra yo doṣaḥ so 'nyāpohe 'pi syād iti tadvatpakṣopavarṇṇṇanaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ | yasmāt pṛthaktve hi jātitadvator abhyupagamyamāne syāt tadvatpakṣodito doṣaḥ |
 tadviśiṣṭasyety anyāpohaviśiṣṭasyārthasya śabdair abhidhānāt tadvatpakṣodita iti tadvatpakṣe ya uktaḥ | yathā kula sāmānyam abhidhāya tadvati varttamānaḥ śabdo 'svatantraḥ syāt tataś ca śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtena sāmānyena vaśīkṛtasya śabdasya vyaktigataparasparabhedānākṣepāt taiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt | upacaritā ca tadvati śabdapravṛttir ityādiko doṣa ity evaṃ vyāvṛttim abhidhāya tadvati varttamāno 'svatantro dhvanir iti sarvaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt | tad api tadvatpakṣopavarṇṇanaṃ | aneneti vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator ananyatvena prativyūḍhaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ | yasmāt tatra hi tadvatpakṣe | arthāntaram upādāyeti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam upādāyānyatrārthāntare tadvati | sākṣāt sāmānyavato 'nabhidhānād asvātantryaṃ | ādiśabdād asamānādhikaraṇyopacāradoṣaparigrahaḥ |
 anyāpohapakṣe tu vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator aikyān nārthāntaram upādāyārthāntare śabdapravṛttis (p.154) tato nāsty asvātantrā(?ntryā)didoṣa ity āha – na cetyādi | anyasmād vastunoryā vyāvṛttiḥ sā vyāvṛttān nānyā | dvayor dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor ekasya vyāvṛttibhedasyābhidhānād ity uktam anantaram eva |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | idānīm iti vyāvṛttitadvator aikye | ekasya vyāvṛttasya svalakṣaṇasyānanugamāt | arthāntarāsaṃsargāt | kathan tasya svalakṣaṇasyātmabhūtā vyāvṛttiḥ svalakṣaṇavad ananvayinī sāmānyaṃ syāt | naiva | dṛṣṭā ca sāmānyaṃ |
 tadbuddhāv ityādinā siddhāntavādī | sāmānyabuddhau vikalpakāyāṃ tathaikākāreṇa pratibhāsanād ekākāra eva vyāvartyate 'neneti vyāvṛttiḥ | sāmānyam ucyate | etad āha (|) na vyāvṛtteṣu svalakṣaṇeṣv ātmabhūtā vyāvṛttir ekā sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ vyāvṛttasvalakṣaṇānubhavottarakālabhāvī vikalpaḥ prakṛtyā | ekakāryeṣu bhāveṣv ekam ākāram ādarśayann ivotpadyate | tadvikalpavaśāt sāmānyam āsthīyate (|) niḥsāmānyeṣv apy anena ca sākṣāc chabdādiviṣayo darśitaḥ |
 etad eva sphuṭayann āha – na vai kiṃcid ityādi | vastubhūtam ity abhiprāyaḥ | kathan tarhi sāmānyasāmānādhikaraṇyādivyavahāra ity āha – śabdetyādi | śabda āśrayaḥ sahakārikāraṇatvena yasyāḥ sā vikalpikā buddhir anādivāsanāsāmarthyāt | dharmān asaṃsṛṣṭān api saṃsṛjantī ekākārān iva kurvāṇā jāyate | tasyā buddher ekākārapratibhāsavaśena sāmānyaṃ | dharmadvayayuktaikadharmipratibhāsavaśena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca vyavasthāpyate | ayaṃ ca sāmānyādivyavahāro 'sadvyāpi vyavasthāpyate | katham asadartha ity āha – arthānām ityādi | svalakṣaṇānāṃ saṃsargābhāvāt sāmānyavyavahāro 'sadarthaḥ | ekasya ca svalakṣaṇasya bhedābhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāro 'sadarthaḥ |
 nanu virūpatayāyaṃ sarvavyavahāraḥ pravṛtta iti katham anyāpohaviṣaya ity ata āha – tasya sarvasya sāmānyādivyavahārasyārthāḥ samāśraya ity anena sambandhaḥ | tatkāryan tacchakāraṇam (p.155) anurūpam yeṣān teṣām bhāvas tayā | karaṇabhūtayā | anyebhya ity atatkāryakāraṇebhyo bhidyamānā arthāḥ sarvasya sāmānyādivyavahārasyāśrayo bhavanty ataḥ kāraṇād anyāpohaviṣaya uktaḥ (|) na tv anyāpohas tatra pratibhāsate bāhyasyaivaikākārasya vidhirūpatayā pratibhāsanāt | yasmāc ca niścayaprayuktaḥ puruṣam aniṣṭaparihāreṇāniṣṭād vyāvṛtte svalakṣaṇe pravarttayat yato 'pi kāraṇād anyāpohaviṣaya ukto na tu pratibhāsāpekṣo vidheḥ pratibhāsanāt |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakārābhyāṃ (|)1* gośabdasyārthaḥ kim bhāvothābhāvaḥ | yadi bhāvo kiṃ gaur athāgauḥ | yadi gaur nāsti vivādaḥ | athāgaur gośabdasyāgaur artha iti atiśabdakauśalaṃ | athābhāvas tad ayuktaṃ | na hi gośabdaśravaṇād abhāve preṣyasaṃpratipattiḥ | śabdārthaś ca pratipattyā pratīyate na ca gośabdād abhāvaṃ kaścit pratipadyate tathāgaur na bhavatīty ayam apohaḥ kiṃ goviṣayo 'thāgoviṣayaḥ | yadi goviṣayaḥ kathaṃ gor gavy evābhāvaḥ athāgoviṣayaḥ (|) katham anyaviṣayād apohād anyatra pratipattiḥ | na hi khadirecchidyamāne palāśecchidā bhavati | athā gaur gavi pratiṣedho 'gaur na bhavatīti | kena gaur agotvaṃ prasaktaṃ yat pratiṣidhyata iti (|)
fn. 1*: cf. Ślokavārttika. Apoha, Nyāyavārttika2.2.71.
 apāstaṃ (|) goviṣayatvād gośabdasya kevalaṃ kalpitaviṣayatvād vivādaḥ | yathā vā gopratiṣedho 'saty api samārope tathoktaṃ prāg iti yat kiñcid etat |
 tasmāt sthitam etad vidhir eva śabdārtha iti ||
 etad eva darśayann āha – tatretyādi | anapekṣitaṃ svarūpeṇa bāhyatattvaṃ yena vikalpabuddhipratibhāsinā dharmiṇā sa tathoktaḥ | buddhipratibhāsavaśād eko 'nekavyāvṛtta iti |anekasmād vyāvṛttasyaikasya dharmiṇaḥ sandarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | tadvaśenaiko dharmī anekavyāvṛtto vyavasthāpyate | yaś cānekasmād vyāvṛttas tasmāt tatra vyāvṛttayo dharmabhedāḥ kalpyanta iti bhāvaḥ | sa eva bhūto dharmī śabdair viṣayīkriyate | tathābhūtavikalpapratibhāsajananāya vaktṛbhiḥ śabdasyoccāraṇāt | yataś cānyavyāvṛtto vikalpapratibhāsaḥ śabdair viṣayīkriyate | tato vidhiviṣayatvaṃ siddham iti bhāvaḥ |
(p.156) na kevalaṃ śabdair vikalpair api viṣayīkriyata ity āha – tadanubhavetyādi | tasya tasya svalakṣaṇasyānubhavas tadanubhavas tenāhitā vāsanā śaktis tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādānugaṇyantato janma yeṣāṃ vikalpānāntair viṣayīkriyata iti sambandhaḥ | ki viśiṣṭair adhyavasitatadbhāvārthaḥ | adhyavasitas tadbhāvo bāhyabhāvo yasmin vikalpapratibhāse sodhyasavitatadbhāva evaṃ bhūto 'rtho viṣayo yeṣām vikalpānān te tathā | dṛśyavikalpāv ekīkṛtya pravṛtter iti yāvat |
 adhyavasitatadbhāvārtha iti pāṭhāntaran tadādhyavasitatadbhāvaś cāsāv arthaś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | eko 'py anekavyāvṛtto 'dhyavasitatadbhāvārtha iti sambandhaḥ | tasmād buddhipratibhāsavaśāt | sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ | tatraiva ca buddhipratibhāse 'yam iti bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇe | vyavahriyata iti vyavahāraḥ karmasādhanaḥ | dharmadharmiṇāv eva vyavahāraḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati (|) buddhipratibhāse yau dharmadharmiṇo vyavasthāpyete | tau parasparan tattvānyatvābhyām avācyād iti pratanyate (|) paramārthatas tena pāramārthikadharmadharmitattvānyatvapakṣe yo doṣaḥ pramāṇāntarādivaiyarthyaṃ svātantryādilakṣaṇa uktaḥ sa iha na bhavatīty uktam bhavati |
 tattvānyatvapakṣayor doṣāntaram apy āha – na hītyādi | dharmiṇaḥ sakāśān nānyodharmaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) anarthāntarābhidhānāt | dharmadharmiśabdābhyām ekasmād eva vyavacchinnasyābhidhānāt | nāpi ya eva dharmī sa eva dharmaḥ | kasmāt | tadvācinām iva | dharmavācinām iva śabdānāṃ | dharmavācinām api vyavacchedāntarākṣepaprasaṅgāt | tathā ceṣṭāpratyāyanāt | dharmaśabdeneṣṭasya pratikṣiptabhedāntarasya bhedasyāpratyāyanāt | saṃketabhedākaraṇaṃ | pratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ vyavacchedaṃ pratyāyayati dharmaśabda ity asya saṃketabhedasyākaraṇaṃ | etad anantaroktan tattvānyatvābhyām avācyatvaṃ dharmadharmiṇoḥ śabdārthe buddhipratibhāsiny arthe uktaṃ | vastunīti bāhyasvalakṣaṇe | avidyamānatvād eva tattvānyatvābhyām avācyaṃ yathāpratibhāsan tu śabdādiviṣayo vyavasthāpyate |
(p.157) nanu cetyādi paraḥ | dṛṣṭā pra;yogeṣūpalabdhā | gor gotvam iti ṣaṣṭhī | ādiśabdād gavi vyavasthitaṃ gotvaṃ | gotvena nimittena gavi gośabdo varttata ityādi vibhaktiparigrahaḥ | gotvadravyatvādīnāṃ a dharmāṇāṃ bahutvāt | tatra bahuṣu dharmeṣu | gotvadravyatvapārthivatvānīti dṛṣṭo yo vacanabhedaḥ sa na syād (|) dharmadharmiṇor abhede pāramārthikabhedābhāve dharmāṇāṃ ca paraspararam (|)
 uktam atreti siddhāntavādī | va vai śabdānāṃ kācid viṣayasvabhāvāyattā vṛttir ityādinoktatvāt ||
 bhūyaś cādhikāryavidhānena pratipādayitum āha – api cetyādi | yeṣāṃ vādināṃ vastuvaśā vāco vastvāyattāḥ | na vivakṣāparāśrayāḥ | vivakṣaiva paraḥ pradhānam āśrayo yāsāṃ vācāntā vivakṣāparāśrayāḥ ṣaṣṭhī na syād vacanabhedādayaś ca na syur ity evaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvacanabhedādiṣu codyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvacanabhedādi codyaṃ | ādiśabdāt | gor bhāvo gotvam ityādi | taddhitapratyayābhāvacodyaṃ | tān vastuvādinaḥ prati | yuktimat | ete śabdāḥ ṣaṣṭhyādayaḥ kvacid iti vastvabhede 'pi praṇinīṣitāḥ praṇetum iṣṭāḥ | vastupratibandhāt | vastvāyattatvāt | dhūmādivat | na hy agnipratibaddho dhūmo vahnipratyāyanasamarthas tadvaiparītyena jalapratyāyane niyoktuṃ pāryate | tadā vastupratibaddhatve śabdānām ayam upālambhaḥ syād asati vyatireke kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhyādaya iti || (66, 67 ||)

 etad eva nāstīty āha – yadā punar ityādi | yad vaco yathā yena prakāreṇa bhedasyābhedasya vā pratipādanāya | kiṃ viśiṣṭam anapekṣitabāhyārthaṃ vācakatvena rūpeṇa vaktṛbhir (p.158) viniyamyate | tat tatheti tadvacanaṃ yathāyogaṃ vācakaṃ |
 tad vyācaṣṭe | (|) na hītyādi | vyatireke vastubhede sati ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktir bāhulye jasādayo bahuvacanapratyayā bhavantīti vaiyākaraṇānāṃ vyavasthānam etad api puruṣābhiprāyanirapekṣam vastusannidhimātreṇa na svayaṃ pravṛttaṃ | saṃketabalenaiva pravṛttam iti yāvat | etad evāha – te tu tatretyādi | te tu vaiyākaraṇādayas tatra vyatireke bāhulye ca tatheti | ṣaṣṭhī bahuvacanaṃ ca yathāsaṃketaṃ prayuñjata iti kṛtvā tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyādes tathā pratītir bhavati | vyatirekādipratītir anyeṣām api bhavati | tathābhūtavyavahāropalambhāt | na tu tāvatā vastubalena vyatirekabāhulye ca ṣaṣṭhyādīnāṃ niyamaḥ | evam anyatrāpīti | dharmadharmiṇor avyatireke 'pi ekatve ca vastunaḥ kṛta katvānityatvādīnāṃ kathaṃcid itibhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇaṃ dharmadharmiṇor bhedam upādāya | kṛtakatvādiṣu vyāvṛttibhedopalakṣitanānātvam upādāya | yathākramaṃ ṣaṣṭhī bahuvacanādayas te prayoktṛbhiḥ prayuktās tathaiva yathāyogaṃ pratītihetavo bhavanti | tatraivam icchāmātranibandhanatve śabdānāṃ sthite sati | puruṣāyattavṛttīnān tadicchāvaśena pravṛtter avastusandarśināṃ śabdebhyaḥ svalakṣaṇasyāpratibhāsanāt | yathābhyāsaṃ yasya yathā saṃketābhyāsas tathā vikalpaprabodho vikalpodayas tasya hetūnāṃ | saṃketānurūpasya śrotṛsantāne vikalpasya kāraṇānām ity arthaḥ | evaṃ bhūtānāṃ śabdānāṃ vācyeṣv artheṣu yeyam pravṛtticintā vyatireke ṣaṣṭhyādaya ityādikā | naiyāyikādīnān tadvaśād iti śabdavaśād vastuvyavasthānaṃ | vyatiriktasya vastuno 'ṅgīkaraṇaṃ | gor gotvam iti yasmāt ṣaṣṭhī tasmāt sāmānyaṃ vyatiriktam ityādi | jāḍyakhyāpanaṃ śabdārthavyavasthānabhijñatvakhyāpanam eva kevalaṃ |
 tathetyādi paraḥ | tathākṛtavyavasthā dharmadharmyādiṣv iti dharme dharmiṇi ca bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepābhyāṃ dharmadharmiśabdāḥ kṛtavyavasthāḥ | ādiśabdād dravyatvapārthivatvānītyādibahuvacanaśabdā vyāvṛttibhedena kṛtavyavasthāḥ | na punar vāstavād eva dharmadharmiṇor vyatirekāt ṣaṣṭhīvastubhedād dravyatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ paramārthata eva bhedād bahuvacanam iti | kuta etat (|) tathetyādi prativacanaṃ | tathā vyavahārāyogād (p.159) iti | vyavahāraviṣayayor dharmadharmiṇor vāstave vyatireke | dharmāṇāṃ ca parasparaṃ paraparamārthato bhede sāmānyādivyavahārāyogāt |(| 68 ||)

 etad evagrahaṇakavākyaṃ na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | vyavahāraviṣayayor dharmadharmiṇor vastutve parasparam tattvam anyatvaṃ vābhyupagantavyaṃ vastunaḥ prakārāntarābhāvād iti dvayam upanyastaṃ | bhede tattvarūpatve ceti pakṣadvaye 'pi doṣodbhāvanārtham anyathā pareṇa vyatirekavastubhedād iti bhedapakṣe 'valambite tattvapakṣopanyāso na prakaraṇānurūpaḥ syāt | tatsambaddha iti sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandhaḥ | śabdānām vā yathāvastu pravṛttāv abhyupagamyamānāyāṃ sāmānyādayo yujyante | etac cāntaram eva vakṣyāmaḥ | vastukṛtam iti vastūnām ekānekatvādikaṃ śabdapravṛttibhedam ekavacanabahuvacanādīnāṃ pravṛttibhedaṃ | dārāḥ śabdo nityabahuvacanāntaḥ pulliṅgaś ceṣyate | yatra yad aikastrīviṣayo dārā iti śabdas tadā bhedavyavasthiteḥ | ṣaṇṇagarīti bahūnān nagarāṇām ekavacanenābhidhānād abhedavyavasthiteḥ kinnibandhanaṃ (|) bāhyaṃ naiva kiṃcit | ādiśabdātmikatā prasādamāletyādau bhedābhedavyavasthiteḥ | khasya svabhāvaḥ khatvaṃ ceti khasya svabhāva ity atra vyatirekaṣaṣṭhyāḥ kinnibandhanaṃ | atha tattvam ity anenoktena kiṃ yadi khasya svabhāva ity asya vākyasya khatvam itīyan taddhitavṛttir bhavatītyet kathyate tan nāsti | na hi svabhāva ity asminn arthe bhāvapratyayaḥ kin tarhi bhāvārtha | na ca taddhitavṛttipradarśanena kiñcit prayojanam asty anyatareṇa vyatirekapradarśanāt |
 atraike vṛttivākyābhyāṃ sarvo vyavahāro vyāpta iti tadvyāptipradarśanārthaṃ dvayam uktam iti |
 anye 'nyathā vyācakṣate | khasya svabhāva iti vyatireke kinnibandhanaṃ | tathā khatvam iti vyatirekābhidhāyino bhāvapratyayasya kinnibandhanam iti |
(p.160) yad etyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadā yasmin kāle | yacchabdam anye paṭhanti yasmād ity arthaḥ | yenaivam bhavatīti dārā ityādi bahuvacanam bhavati | ekatvād ekavacanam eva prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ekasyā api striyaḥ sikatānāṃ ca bahvyaḥ śaktayas tataḥ śaktibhedo bahuvacanakāraṇam iti | sarvatreti yatrāpy ekavacanam iṣṭam bṛkṣa ityādau | ekaśakter arthasyābhāvāt | sarvasya nānā śaktitvāt | evaṃ saty ekasminn ekavacanam1* ity ayaṃ yatnaś ca vyarthaḥ syāt | saty api śaktibhede vastvabhedāt | śaktyāśrayasyābhedāt | anyatraikavacanaviṣaye 'rthe vṛkṣaḥ paṭa ityādāv ekavacanam iti cet | ihāpi dārādāv ekavacanam ekasyāḥ striyā vastvabhedāt | yata evaṃ na vastvaśaktyāśrayo vā śabdapravṛttibhedaḥ | tasmād ayaṃ śabdapravṛttiniyamo nirvastuko bāhyavastvanāśrayaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ puruṣecchāyāḥ svātantryaṃ śabdaprayoge khyāpayati |
fn. 1*:rims.
 ṣaṇṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ samāhāraḥ kriyātmako guṇātmako vā | eko 'sti tata ekavacanam iti ced āha – na hi nagarāṇy eva kiṃcid iti nagarāvayavidravyasyānabhyupagamāt kutas teṣān nagarāṇāṃ samāhāraḥ kriyātmako guṇātmako vā yata evam abhidhīyata kriyāguṇayor dravyāśritatvāt | kiṃ punar dravyam ity āha – prāsādetyādi | gṛhādisamudāyo nagaraṃ | vijātīyānāṃ ca prāsādīdānāṃ dravyārambhānabhyupagamāt kutas tatsamudāyaḥ prāsādādisamudāyo nagaraṃ dravyaṃ syāt | yāvatā prāsādatoraṇapuruṣādīnāṃ samudāyo nagaram iṣyate | teṣāṃ prāsādādīnāṃ samastānām asaṃyogāc ca kāraṇān nagaran dravyaṃ | saṃyogasahāyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dravyārambhakatvam iṣyate | na prāsādapuruṣakuḍyādīnāṃ viśliṣṭānāṃ saṃyogo 'sti | yena prāsādādijanyaṃ nagaran dravyaṃ syāt |
  syān mataṃ (|) yady api sākalyena prāsādādīnāṃ nāsti saṃyogas tathāpi yeṣāṃ tāvat prāsādapuruṣādīnāṃ parasparaṃ saṃyogas tatsaṃyogātmakaṃ nagaram bhaviṣyaty evam api (p.161) vastutvaṃ nagarasyāsiddhaṃ saṃyogasya guṇapadārthatvād ity ata āha – na saṃyoga ityādi | na saṃyogasvabhāvan nagaraṃ | tathā kāṣṭheṣṭakādīnām vijātīyānāṃ kāryadravyānārambhāt prāsādo 'pi na dravyātmakaḥ kintu saṃyogasvabhāva iṣyate (|) saṃyogaś ca guṇo nirguṇaś ca guṇā iti kutaḥ prāsādasya saṃyogo yena tatsaṃyogātmakaṃ nagaraṃ syāt |
 etad evāha – prāsādasyetyādi | pareṇetyarthāntareṇāsaṃyogāc ca na saṃyogo nagaraṃ | cakāreṇānantaranirdiṣṭāt prāsādādīnāṃ viśliṣṭānām asaṃyogāc ca na saṃyogo nagaram ity etat samuccīyate | tad evaṃ prāsādādīnām ubhayathā saṃyogābhāvena | nagarasya saṃyogasvabhāvatā nirastā |
 prāsādādīnāṃ yā saṃkhyā tadātmakaṃ nagaram bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – tata eva saṃkhyābhāva iti | yasmāt saṃyogātmakaprāsādas tata eva kāraṇāt prāsādasya saṃkhyāyā abhāvo nirguṇatvād guṇānāṃ | saṃkhyāpi hi guṇasvabhāvā | sa cāsau saṃyogaś ca tatsaṃyogaḥ | prāsādātmakaḥ saṃyoga ity arthaḥ | tatsaṃyogena puruṣaiś ca viśiṣṭā yā sattā sā nagaram iti cet | kim asyāḥ sattāyā ekatvān nityatvāc ca niratiśayāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ | na hi prāsādapuruṣādayas sattāṃ viśiṃṣanti | anādheyātiśayatvāt | tasmāt sattā nirviśeṣaṇā | tasyā nagaratve sarvatra nagaratvaṃ syād ity abhiprāyaḥ | sattāyāś caikatvād iti | dravyaguṇakarmasvekaiva sattā vyāpinī | nagarabahutve 'pi nagaravyavasthāśrayāṇāṃ prāsādādisamudāyānāṃ bahutve 'pīty arthaḥ | anyathā sattātmake nagare prakṛte nagarabahutvaṃ kathaṃ syāt | dravyasyeti prāsādapuruṣādeḥ sattāyāś ca yā parasparasahitatā sā nagaram iti cet | evaṃ hi sati na sarvatra nagarabuddhiḥ | prāsādādīnāṃ sarvatrābhāvāt | prāsādādibahutvād bahuvacanaṃ ca siddham iti paro manyate |
