 uttaram āha – anupakāryetyādi | anupakāryopakārakayoḥ sattāprāsādayoḥ kas sahāyībhāvaḥ (|) tathā hi dvividhaḥ sahakārārthaḥ parasparātiśayādhānena santāne viśiṣṭakṣaṇotpādanalakṣaṇaḥ | pūrvasvahetor eva samarthānām utpannānām ekakāryakriyālakṣaṇaś ca | (p.162) na tāvat pūrvaḥ sattāyā anādheyātiśayatvāt | nāpi dvitīyo yasmād yathā sattā kevalā nagarabuddhijananaṃ pratyasamarthā tathā prāsādādisahitāpi sāmarthye vā kevalāpi janayet | yadi ca dvayasya parasparasahitatā nagaraṃ | tadaikam api nagaram anekātmakaṃ prāsādādyātmakatvāt | tataḥ puruṣasaṃyogasattānām bahutvāt | nagaram ity ekavacanaṃ syāt | saṃyogaśabdena prāsādātmakaḥ saṃyoga uktaḥ | tathābhūtānām iti parasparasahitānāṃ puruṣasaṃyogasattānāṃ kvacid artha iti nagaram iti vijñāne | śabde ca niṣpādye | abhinnaikā śaktir asti | setyabhinnā śaktir nimittam ekavacanasyeti cet | na | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) śakter vastu svarūpāvyatirekāt | puruṣādibhyo vasturūpebhyo 'vyatirekāt | tadvad evānekatvam iti kutas tadāśrayam ekavacanaṃ | vastusvarūpād vyatireke vā śakter abhyupamyamagāne(sic.? abhyupagamyamāne) puruṣasaṃyogasattābhir anupakāryasya śaktirūpasya puruṣādipāratantryan na syāt | tataś ca puruṣādīnāṃ śaktir iti sambandho na syād iti bhāvaḥ |
 atha vyatiriktāyā api śakteḥ puruṣādipāratantryasiddhyarthaṃ puruṣādikṛta upakāra iṣyate | tadā śakter upakāre vā puruṣādikṛte iṣyamāṇe | yayā śaktyā puruṣādayaḥ prathamaṃ śaktim upakurvate | tasyāḥ prathamaśaktyupakāriṇyā api śakte śakter vyatirekenavasthā syād avyatireke vā | ādyāyām apy ekavacananibandhanatveneṣṭāyāṃ śaktāva vyatirekaprasaṅgaḥ | avyatireke ca vastuvad eva bāhulyam iti tadavastho bahuṣu bahuvacana1* prasaṅga iti yat kiñcid etat (|) śaktiparikalpane khasya svabhāva iti vyatirekāśrayā ṣaṣṭhī na syāt | ṣaṣṭhīkāraṇatvād bhāvapratyayo 'py upacārāt | ṣaṣṭhīśabdenoktaḥ | tenāyam aparo 'rthaḥ khatvam iti vyatirekāśrayā taddhitotpattir na syād iti khasya svabhāvaḥ khatvam ity anayā vyutpattyā bhāvapratyayasyotpatter vyatirekāśrayatvaṃ |
fn. 1*: Pāṇini1.4.21.
 atha vā yathāyogaṃ sambandho granthacchedaś ca kāryaḥ (|) khatvam iti vyatirekāśrayā (p.163) na syāt tatthitotpattir ity adhyāhāraḥ | khasya svabhāva iti ṣaṣṭhī na syād iti | na hi khaśabdavācyād arthād anyaḥ svabhāvo 'sti bhāvo vā | yo yathākramaṃ vyatirekaṣaṣṭhyās taddhitasya vā nibandhanaṃ syāt | khatvaṃ nāma sāmānyam asti tadvyatirekanibandhanam iti ced āha – na tatretyādi | ekātmakatvāt khasya nāsmin khatvasāmānyaṃ (|) yady api sattvaṃ dravyatvaṃ cākāśe 'sti | tathāpi na tat khasya svabhāvaḥ | ghaṭādisādhāraṇatvāt | nāpi sattvadravyatve khatvam ity atra bhāvapratyayasya nibandhanaṃ | tayoḥ śa (?) śabdapratyayākāraṇatvāt | svānurūpajñānābhidhānanibandhanasvabhāvapratyayasya kāraṇam iṣṭaṃ | nāpi vibhutvādayo guṇā iti | ādiśabdād ekatvaparatvādiparigrahaḥ | tathocyata iti khasya svabhāva iti | dravyād arthāntarasya vibhūtvāder guṇasya tatsvabhāvatvāyogād ākāśasvabhāvatvāyogāt | na hy arthāntaram arthāntarasya svabhāvo yuktaḥ | yadi ca vibhutvādaya ākāśasvabhāvāḥ | tadā teṣāṃ ca vibhutvādīnām ākāśasvabhāvatve niḥsvabhāvatvaprasaṅgāt | tathā hi yas teṣāṃ guṇasvabhāvaḥ saty ākāśam eva jātaṃ na cāparasvabhāvo 'stīti niḥsvabhāvatā syāt | teṣāṃ ca niḥsvabhāvatve ākāśasya vyatiriktaḥ svabhāvo na syād iti bhāvaḥ | vibhutvāder apy arthāntarasvabhāvatvam iti ced āha – tasyāpītyādi | tasyeti vibhutvāder arthāntaraṃ svabhāvo 'syeti vigrahaḥ | atiprasaṅga iti yattadarthāntaraṃ vibhatvādeḥ(sic.? vibhutvādeḥ) svabhāvatveneṣṭan tasyāpy arthāntarasvabhāvatvena bhāvyaṃ | anyathā tasyāpi vibhutvāvyatirekāt tadvad eva niḥsvabhāvatā syāt | tathā cāparāparasvabhāvaparimārgaṇenānavasthānād ekasyāpi pratiṣṭhitasvabhāvasyābhāvāt | ādyasyākāśasvabhāvasyāpratipattis tataś ca sa eva vyatirekābhāva ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 evaṃ "dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānāṃ"1* ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ vargaḥ | ādiśabdāt prāsādamāletyādayo vācyāḥ |
fn. 1*: Vaiśeṣikasūtra1.4.
 katham asati vyatireke ṣaṣṭhīti | na hi tatra ṣaṭpadārtheṣu sāmānyaṃ sambhavati | (p.164) yad vargaśabdenocyate | dravyaguṇakarmasv eva sāmānyābhyupagamāt | tathā saṃkhyā saṃyogo vā na sambhavati tayor guṇapadārthatvena dravya eva bhāvāt |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | idānīm ity arthāntarasvabhāvānabhyupagame khaśabdavācyasya bhāvaśabdavācyasya cārthasyāsaty aniścaye kathaṃ svabhāva iti bhedena nirdeśaḥ | na punaḥ kham ity eva | bhedanibandhābhāvād abhedenaiva nirdeśo nyāyya ity arthaḥ |
 khasyetyādinā pariharati | khasyeti khaśabdavācyasyārthasyārthāntaratayeti pṛthivyāder yat sādhāraṇaṃ rūpam anupāttaviśeṣāntarasyāparāmarśena | tyāgena | khaśabdapravṛttinibandhanaṃ rūpam anyadravyāsādhāraṇaṃ tathā jijñāsāyā atrārthāntarāsaṃsargi............m evam ucyate khasya svabhāva iti | tathā khatvam iti | yathā gamyeta khasyāyaṃ svabhāvo nānyasyeti |
 anena bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇaikavyāvṛttarūpānabhidhānād anyad eva vyatirekābhidhānanimittam uktaṃ | tena ghaṭasyābhāva ityādivyapadeśaḥ siddho bhavati |
 anye punar āhuḥ | khasya svabhāvaṃ pratipādayan svabhāvaśabdo svabhāvavyāvṛttimātreṇa pratipādayati na tu svabhāvāntarāpratikṣepeṇa | khaśabdas tu tam eva rūpāntarāpratikṣepeṇa | tataḥ svabhāvāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇena bhedaleśena khasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ kha(tva)m iti bhedena nirddiśyata iti tad etan nātiśliṣṭaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratipatteḥ |
 arthāntarasādhāraṇarūpāparāmarśena khaśabdapravṛttinibandhanaṃ rūpam evam ucyata iti bruvatā svalakṣaṇam eva vācyam uktam iti matvā paro brūte ityādi | na tu sarva ityādi |
netyādi siddhāntavādī. yat sarvasmād vyāvṛttaṃ svalakṣaṇātmakam, tad eva rūpaṃ śabdotthāyāṃ buddhau śabdaiḥ samarpyate. neti sambandhaḥ. kasmāt tasya svalakṣaṇasyendriyabuddhāv iva | śābde vijñāne pratyavabhāsane saty anatīndriyatvaprasaṅgāt | pratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt, kiṃ tarhi śabdena kriyata iti ced āha – kevalam ityādi. ayam iti pratipādakaḥ. dṛśyavikalpayor ekatvādhyavasāyavipralabdhas tathābhūtam asādhāraṇam arthaṃ pratyāyayiṣyāmīty evam abhiprāyaḥ śabdena karaṇabhūtena śrotari yo vikalpas tasya pratibimbabāhyatayādhyastam (p.165) ākāram arpayati (|) kiṃ bhūtam asaṃsṛṣṭatatsvabhāvaṃ | agṛhītavasturūpaṃ | ācāryadiṅnāgasyāpy etad abhimatam ity āha – yad āhetyādi | adṛṣṭārthe svargādiśabde uccarite 'rthavikalpamātraṃ śrotur bhavaty adhyavasitabāhyārthasvabhāvo vikalpo bhavati na tu bāhyasvarūpagrāhakaṃ |
anena cācāryeṇāpi vidhyarthaḥ śabdārtho 'bhipreta iti darśayati | naivaṃ vikalpapratibimbe śabdena śrotari janite pratipādyapratipādakābhyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ pratipannaṃ pratipāditaṃ vā bhavati.
yadi hi śabdena svalakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyate, tadā svargādiśabdaśravaṇe 'pi | tadanubhavinām iva | svargādipratyakṣavedinām iva pratibhāsābhedaḥ syāt | śrotur api svargādisvalakṣaṇākārapratipattiḥ syāt | yataś ca na śabdāt svalakṣaṇapratipattis tasmād ayaṃ śrotā śabdād apratipadyamāno 'pi bhāvasvabhāvaṃ tathābhūta evāsaṃsṛṣṭavastusvabhāva eva vikalpapratibimbe tadadhyavasāyī svalakṣaṇādhyavasāyī svalakṣaṇam eva mayā pratipannam iti santuṣyati (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtatvād eva. svalakṣaṇasyāgrahe 'py adhyavasitasvalakṣaṇarūpatvād eva śabdārthapratipatteḥ | yataś ca svalakṣaṇādhyavasāyena śabdārthasya pratītis tenaitad evam ucyate śabdaḥ svarūpam āheti | arthāntarasādhāraṇarūpāparāmarśena khaśabdapravṛttinibandham asādhāraṇaṃ rūpam ucyata iti vacanāt | na punaḥ svarūpapratibhāsasyaiva vijñānasya jananāt |
tasmāt sthitam etad vidhyarthaḥ śabdārtholīkatvāt paramatād bheda iti |
katham ityādi paraḥ. ekāntavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | teṣām bhāvānām asaṃsargād anyasya ceti bhāvebhyo vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya |
uktam iti siddhāntavādī. kīdṛśam uktam ity āha – asaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ parasparavyāvṛttānām (p.166) ekena vijātīyenāsaṃsargaḥ | yathā govyaktīnām ekenāgosvabhāvenāsaṃsargaḥ sa evāsaṃsargaḥ | tadvyatirekiṇān tasmād agosvabhāvād vyāvṛttānāṃ gobhedānāṃ samānatā gotvaṃ | evam anyad api sāmānyaṃ boddhavyaṃ |
 etad uktam bhavati | samānām iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī tena samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vijātīyavyāvṛttāḥ samānākārotpannā bhāvāḥ sāmānyam ity arthaḥ | asyaiva ca sāmānyasya liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvan tatsambandhaś ca vastutvāt | arthakriyākāritvāc ca pravṛttiviṣayatvaṃ vikalpaviṣayatvaṃ ca yathādhyavasāyaṃ na tu jñānākārasya | etadviparītatvāt ||( 69 ||)

 tad evaṃ samāropapakṣe parokṣaṃ dūṣaṇam parihṛtyānyavyāvṛttipakṣe parokṣaṃ dūṣaṇam anyavyāvṛttyanabhyupagamād eva nirasyānyavyāvṛttā eva bhāvā ekatvenādhyavasīyamānāḥ sāmānyam iti ca pratipādya buddhyākāre 'pi sāmānye paroktaṃ dūṣaṇam apanetum āha – api cetyādi | bhāvānāśritya bhedina iti vyāvṛttāni svalakṣaṇam vāśritya dhīrekārthapratibhāsiny utpadyate | yayā svarūpeṇa svākāreṇaikena rūpeṇa | pararūpaṃ | parasparavyāvṛttaṃ valakṣaṇaṃ samvriyate pracchādyate | diti | dhi | kim viśiṣṭayā yā (|) saṃvṛtyā | saṃvriyate 'nayā svalakṣaṇam iti kṛtvā | samvṛtanānārthā(ḥ) sthagitanānārthaḥ svayambhedino 'pi kenacid rūpeṇa vijātīyavyāvṛttyupakalpitena gotvādirūpeṇābhedina ivābhānti saṃsṛṣṭa iva | tena (|)
 "buddhyākāraś ca buddhistho nārthabuddhyantarānugaḥ |
 nābhipretārthakārī ca sopi vācyo na tatvata" ityādi nirastaṃ ||
 tasmād buddher abhiprāyavaśāt | ekakārādhyāropavaśāt sāmānyaṃsa kesnaprakīrtitaṃ | buddhyāropita evākāraḥ sāmānyam uktam iti yāvat | yathā tayā saṃkalpitam (p.167) āropitaṃ tathā tat sāmānyam asat paramārthena |
 nanu yady abhinnaḥ pratibhāso 'bhyupagamyate | kathaṃ sāmānyam asad ity ucyate | na (|) vyaktibhyo bhinnasyābhimatasyābhedena pratibhāsanāt | sarvātmanā cābhede vyaktivad ananvayād anugatasya pratītir bhrāntir eva | bhedābhede ca tathaivobhayarūpatayā pratibhāsaḥ syāt (|) na ca yatra pratyaye yadaiva gaur iti pratibhāsaḥ tadaiva tatra gotvam asyeti pratibhāsaḥ |
 atha syād (|) yad ananugame yasyānugamas tat tato bhinnaṃ yathā nīlād anīlaṃ | śāvaleyānanugame ca gotvasyānugamo vyaktyantare (|) tasmāt tato bhinnaṃ śāvaleyābhinnagotvagrāhakan tarhi pratyakṣaṃ bhrāntaṃ syād bhinnasyānyapramāṇagṛhītasyābhedena grahaṇāt | na caikasya yenaiva rūpeṇa bhedas tenaivābhedo virodhāt | nāpi vastūnāṃ viśeṣarūpatayā bhedaḥ | sāmānyarūpatayā 'bhedaḥ | evaṃ hi viśeṣānām ekadeśāditvaṃ syān na ca syāt | sāmānyaviśeṣayoś ca pratibhāsabhedo na syāt sarvātmanā 'bhinnatvād | bhede vānugatavyāvṛttarūpayoḥ parasparāsaṃśleṣeṇaikāntabhinnatvaprasaṅgāt |
 yadi ca prativyakti tadabhinnan tadaikaṃ sāmānyam astīti kutaḥ | na ca tatra prathamavyaktitadarśane 'gṛhītam api dvitīyādivyaktau sa evāyam iti pratīter ekaṃ sāmānyam astīti yuktaṃ (|) sa iti smaraṇāṃśasyānubhūtasāmānyaviṣayābhāvenotpattyasambhavāt | tataś ca yathā prathamavyaktau na gṛhītan tathā dvitīyādivyaktāv api pratyekaṃ gṛhītam iti kathaṃ sa evāyam iti jñānasyotpattiḥ syāt | na ca sa iti smaraṇānyathānupapattyā prathamavyaktau nirvikalpakenānyena vā jñānena sāmānyagrahaṇakalpanā yuktānugatarūpapratibhāsābhāvāt | nāpi dharmarūpatayā tatrāsya grahaṇaṃ yuktam anugataikarūpatvāt sāmānyasya | nāpi pūrvāparavyaktisambandhitayāsya pratibhijñāpratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam iti śakyate vaktuṃ | idam evety evaṃ pratyakṣasyotpattiprasaṅgāt | pūrvavyakter asannihitatvāc ca sannihitārthaniścayalakṣaṇaṃ ca pratyakṣam iṣyate |
 tasmād agovyāvṛttaikaviśeṣānubhavapūrvakam anyasminn agovyāvṛtte 'nubhūtayāne sati sa evāyam ity ekākārasya bhrāntasya pratyayasya vāsanāsāmarthyenotpattes tadevāsya nimittaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktan nānyad (|) bhrāntatvāc ca buddher ayaṃ sāmānyam ucyate |
 buddhir ityādinā kārikārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | buddhir vikalpikety anena sambandhaḥ | tebhyaḥ sajātīyebhyo 'nyas tasmād vyatirekaḥ sa yeṣām asti | te tadanyavyatirekiṇaḥ | vijātīyavyāvṛttān ity arthaḥ | svavāsanāprakṛtiṃ vikalpavāsanāsvabhāvam bhinneṣv abhinnapratyayajananasāmarthyan (p.168) tadanuvidadhatī | anukurvatī | evaṃ hi tayā svakāraṇam anukṛtam bhavati (|) yadi bhinneṣv apy ekākārotpadyate | eṣām iti padārthānāṃ | adhyasyeti padārtheṣv āropya bhāvānām evaikaṃ rūpam iti | tān bhāvān sṛjanti | abhinnān iva kurvāṇā sandarśayati | ekarūpān iva darśayatīti yāvat |
 nanu vikalpasyānubhūtārthāhitavāsanābalotpattāv iṣyamāṇāyāṃ kathaṃ sāmānyākārasya vikalpasyotpattiḥ sāmānyasyānanubhūtatvād ity ata āha – sā cetyādi | ekaṃ sadṛśaṃ sādhyaṃ sādhanañ ca yeṣām bhāvānāṃ | yathā dhaṭādīnām ekam udakādidhāraṇādi sādhyaṃ | sādhanaṃ ca mṛtpiṇḍādi | te ekasādhyasādhanas tadbhāvas tayā | karaṇabhūtayā | anyebhyo 'tatsādhyasādhanebhyo vivekināṃ bhāvānāṃ sā prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ | bhinnānām api prakṛtyā ekākāravikalpajananalakṣaṇaḥ | tathābhūtasya vikalpasya hetur yā vāsanā | tasyāś ca sā tādṛśī prakṛtir yad evaṃ svarūpaṃ paratrāropayantī | eṣā buddhiḥ pratibhāti | vyaktyabhinnasāmānyagrāhiṇī pratibhāsata iti yāvat |
 tena yad ucyate |
 "smārttam etad abhedena vijñānam iti yo vadet |
 nūnam bandhyāsute 'py asti tasya smaraṇaśakyatā (||)"1*
 iti nirastaṃ | bhinnānām evānubhūtānām ekakāryakarttṛtvena svaviṣayābhinnākārapratyayajanane sāmarthyād anubhūtaspaṣṭākārasyārthasya svaviṣayospaṣṭasmaraṇajananasāmarthyavat | tadudbhaveti varṇṇavikalpavāsanāyā vivekibhyaḥ svabhāvebhyo yathāsaṃkhyaṃ sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa codbhavo yasyāḥ sā tathā | sā ceyam iti buddhiḥ saṃvṛttir ity ucyate | samvriyate 'nayā buddhyā svarūpeṇa svapratibhāsena pararūpam vasturūpam iti karaṇasādhanaṃ ktinaṃ vidhāya | te ca bhāvās tayeti buddhyā | saṃvṛtabhedāḥ pracchāditanānātvāḥ | kenacid rūpeṇeti vikalpabuddhyāropitena | pratibhānti vikalpabuddhau |
fn. 1*:Ślokavārttika, Anumānapariccheda 160.
(p.169) tad eṣām ityadi | buddhipratibhāsaṃ vikalpabuddhyākāraṃ | anurundhānaiḥ puruṣais tadbuddhyupasthāpitam ekaṃ rūpaṃ sāmānyam ucyata ity anena sambandhaḥ | keṣāṃ sāmānyam ucyate | buddhiparivarttinām eva | eṣāṃ buddhiparivarttinām iti sambandhaḥ | svalakṣaṇāny anubhūya yathānubhavam asau śuklo ghaṭaḥ kṛṣṇo 'nyo vety evaṃ vikalpabuddhiṣv aspaṣṭāḥ ghaṭākārās te buddhiparivarttino bhāvā ye teṣām eva sāmānyaṃ sambandhi | na svalakṣaṇānāṃ sāmānyabuddhāv apratibhāvanād asambandhitvāc ca | buddhiparivarttinām eva viśeṣaṇāṃ bahir iva parisphuratām iti bahir iva pratibhāsamānānām ity arthaḥ | bahiḥsphuraṇe ca kāraṇam āha – ākāraviśeṣaparigrahād iti (|)
 bāhyārthavikalpasaṃsthānasya spaṣṭasyānukārād bāhyādhyavasāya ity eke |
 etac cāyuktaṃ | na hi sādṛśyanimitto bāhyatvāropa iti niveditam etat | tasmād ākāraviśeṣo ghaṭādyākāras tasya parigraho 'nubhavas tasmād bahir iva parisphuraṇaṃ |
 etad uktam bhavati | ghaṭādyanubhavāhitavāsanāsāmarthyena vikalpa utpadyamāṇaḥ svākāraṃ bāhyaghaṭādyabhedenādhyavasyati na tu gṛhṇāti (|) tena śabdavihite 'rthe kvacit saṃśayo bhavaty agrahaṇāt | tatra tu vikalpaḥ svahetuta eva bāhyābhinnaṃ svākāram(adhya)vasyati | na tu sādṛśyāt sadṛśasyārthasyābhāvād agrahaṇāc ca |
 nanu buddhiparivarttinām api svarūpe vyatirekeṇa ko 'nya eva ākāraḥ pratibhāsate yatsāmānyaṃ syāt |
 satyaṃ | tatra tāvat kecid āhur ekajñānāvyatirekād ekatvan teṣām iti | anye tv āhuḥ pratyekan teṣāṃ svavyaktyapekṣayā sāmānyarūpateti (|) tad etad ubhayam apy ayuktam ekapratibhāsābhāvāt | kevalam ekarūpatayā teṣām adhyavasāyāt paraiḥ sāmānyam iṣṭam iti tad abhiprāyād evam ucyate | ācāryasya tu samānā iti pratibhāso 'bhipreto naika iti tathā ca vakṣyati |(| 70, 71, 72 ||)

 atha vā (|) astu "pratibhāso dhiyām bhinnaḥ samānā iti tadgrahaṇād"(1.109) iti | yadi buddhiparivarttinām eva vikalpabuddhisandarśitaṃ rūpaṃ sāmānyan tasya ca vidhirūpatvāt katham idānīm anyāpohaḥ sāmānyam ity ucyate |
(p.170) sa eveti siddhāntavādī | sa eva vikalpabuddhivyavasthāpitaḥ pratibhāsamāno 'nyāpoha ucyate | anyaviviktapadārthadarśanadvārāyātatvāt |
 yadi vikalpākāraḥ sāmānyaṃ kathaṃ bāhyānāṃ samānarūpatayā pratītiḥ | yad āha (|)
 "atha nirviṣayā etā vāsanāmātrabhāvataḥ |
 pratipattiḥ pravṛttiś ca bāhyārtheṣu katham bhaved" (|)
 ity ata āha – tam evetyādi | tam iti vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaṃ gṛhṇatī sa vikalpikā buddhir vastugrāhiṇīva pratibhāti | kasmād vikalpānāṃ prakṛtivibhramāt svabhāvenaiva svākārābhedenārthagrahaṇavibhramāt |
 kathan tarhy apohaviṣayety ucyata ity āha – sā hi vikalpikā buddhir adhyavasāyavaśāt tadanyavivekiṣu bhāveṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu bhavantī vivekaviṣayeti gamyate | kāryato na tu vivekasvabhāvaviṣayīkaraṇāt |
 parastvaviditābhiprāyaḥ prāha – nanv ityadi | sāmānyād bāhyāḥ svalakṣaṇānīty arthaḥ | evaṃ hi bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ saṅgrahaḥ kṛto bhavati | vivekinaḥ parasparavilakṣaṇā (|) na ca teṣv iti svalakṣeṇeṣu (|) kahtan teṣu vikalpabuddhir bhavatīty ucyate | vyākhyātāra ityādinā pariharati | te hi yathāvasthitam vastu vyavasthāpayanta evam iva vecayanti | anyo vikalpabuddhipratibhāso nyatsvalakṣaṇam iti | na vyavaharttāra evaṃ vivecayanti | te tu vyavaharttāraḥ svālambanam eveti vikalpapratibhāsam evārthakriyāyogyaṃ bāhyasvalakṣaṇarūpam manyamānāḥ | etad eva spaṣṭayati (|) dṛśyo 'rthaḥ svalakṣaṇam vikalpyo 'rthaḥ | sāmānyapratibhāsas tāv ekīkṛtya svalakṣaṇam evedam vikalpabuddhyā viṣayīkriyate śabdena codyata ity evam adhimucyārthakriyākāriṇyarthe pravarttante | tadabhiprāyavaśād vyavaharttṛṇām abhiprāyavaśād evam ucyate vivekiṣu bhāveṣu vikalpabuddhir bhavatīti dṛśyavikalpyāv ekīkṛtya pravṛtter iti vadatā (|) na svākāre bāhyāropa ity uktam bhavaty anyathā svākāra eva pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | marīcikāyāṃ jalāropād iva | nāpi bāhye svākārāropaḥ | āropyamāṇaphalārthitvenaiva pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | jalārthina iva jalabhrāntau |
(p.171) nanu dṛśyavilpayor ekīkaraṇaṃ kim ucyate | yadi dṛśyasya vikalpyād abhedaḥ bāhye 'rthe pravṛttir na syāt | vikalpyasya dṛśyād abhedaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdārthaḥ syāt | na ca dṛśyavikalpyayor ekīkaraṇaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tasya vikalpyāviṣayatvāt (|) nāpi vikalpena tasya dṛśyāviṣayatvāt | atītādau ca dṛśyābhāvāt kathan tayor ekīkaraṇaṃ |
 atrocyate | arthānubhave sati tatsaṃskāraprabodhena tadākāra utpadyamāno vikalpaḥ svākāram bāhyābhinnam adhyavasyati na tv abhinnaṃ karoti | tena vikalpaviṣayasya dṛśyātmatayādhyavasāyād dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇam ucyate (|) darśanārho dṛśyaḥ śakyate vā draṣṭum iti vikalpakadarśanasyāpi yo viṣayaḥ sa dṛśyas tenānāgatasyāpy arthasyāgamopadarśitasya dṛśyatvaṃ siddhantathā 'bhāvasyāpi | ata evābhāvaḥ pratyayaḥ svākāram bhāvarūpam api padārthābhāvāvyatirekeṇādhyasya pratyetīty abhāvaviṣaya ucyate na tv abhāvaṃ gṛhṇāti (|) sarvavikalpānāṃ nirviṣayatvāt |
 tatkāritayetyādi | na kevalan tadabhiprāyavaśād vikalpabuddhiḥ svalakṣaṇeṣu vivekeṣu bhavatīty ucyate | tathā tatkāritayā karaṇenātatkāribhyo bhinnānarthān śabdena vaktāraḥ pratipādayantīty ucyate | vyākhyātāro 'pi dṛśyavikalpayor aikyaṃ kim iti na pratipadyanta iti ced āha – pratibhāsabhedādibhya iti dṛśyasya hi spaṣṭaḥ pratibhāso na vikalpasya | vikalpānubaddhasya spaṣṭatvāyogāt | ādiśabdān niruddhe 'pi dṛśye vikalpasyānirodhāt | arthakriyāyāḥ karaṇād akaraṇāc ca | tattvacintakā nyāyānusāriṇaḥ vyākhyātāraḥ (|) śeṣaṣaṣṭhī ceyan tattvasya cintakā iti | tattvasya te cintakā nātattvasyeti sambandhyantaravyavacchedamātrāpekṣāyāṃ kriyākākarabhāvasyāvivakṣitatvāt | (|) cintayater vā pacācyajantasya tattvaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā svārthikaḥ kanpratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ | tato 'tra tṛjakābhyām1* ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho nāśaṃkyaḥ | nābhedam anusandhate | dṛśyavikalpayor iti prakṛte |
fn. 1*:Pāṇini2.2.15.
 yadītyādi codakaḥ | pratipattrabhiprāyo 'nuvidhīyate bāhyeṣu sāmānyavyavasthānaṃ | tadānyāpoho 'pi sāmānyaṃ mā bhūt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na hy evam iti | anyāpohaḥ śabdena codyata ity evaṃ vyavaharttṛṇāṃ nāsti pratipattiḥ | ācāryo 'pi tulyatāṃ (p.172) khyāpayann āha – na vai kevalam ityādi | evam apratipattir ity anyāpoharūpeṇa | tvayā yathā vyaktivyatiriktādibhir ākārair iṣṭaṃ sāmānyan tathāpi naiva pratipattiḥ | āśrayād vyatiriktaṃ vaiśeṣikādīnām avyatiriktaṃ sāṃkhyādīnām ādiśabdāt pratyekaparisamāptatvādiparigrahaḥ | tatra bhedas tāvat sāmānyasya na pratibhāsata eva | iha sāmānyam iti buddhyanutpatteḥ abhede 'pi vyaktīnām eva pratibhāsaḥ syān na sāmānyasya | bhedābhede cobhayapakṣabhāvī doṣaḥ syāt | nāpi tatpratyekaparisamāptaṃ yujyate | yata ekavyaktāv ekasambandhy eva tat syān nānekasambandhi | na caivaṃ sāmānyam anekasambandhitvād asya samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vacanāt |
 atha vyaktyantareṣu tasya pratyabhijñānāt tatsambandhitvam evam api bhūtaguṇavedakam anekasambandhi syān na pratyekaparisamāptaṃ | ekaikasyāṃ vyaktāv anekasambandhitvenāpratīteḥ | pratītau vā tatrānekavyaktipratibhāsaḥ syāt | atha vyaktyantarāle 'pratibhāsanāt pratyekaparisamāptan tad ucyate | tat kim etāvatā tasyānekasambandhitvam ekatra sidhyati | na ca sāmānye pratyabhijñānaṃ yujyata ity apy uktaṃ | tasmān na tasya pratyekaparisamāptir nāpi nityatvam ekatvaṃ vyāpitvaṃ ca pratibhāsata iti sthitaṃ |
 yadi vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyāpohasya ca tulyaḥ pratipattyabhāvo vyavahāre | kas tarhy asyā āśraya ity ata āha – kevalam ityādi | svalakṣaṇānāṃ vijātīyarahitatvam anyāpohaḥ so 'bhinnākārāyā buddher nimittatvenocyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya vijātīyavirahalakṣaṇasyānyāpohasya bhinneṣv api sarvatra vastuṣu bhāvāt tathābhūtasya cānyāpohasya sāmānyabuddhihetutvam pratyavirodhāt | tathā hi yathaikam vṛkṣam avṛkṣād vyāvṛttaṃ paśyaty evamanyam apy atas tatraikākārā buddhir utpadyate | na cātra bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti |
 tṛtīyakāraṇam āha – vyavahārasya cetyādi | tathā darśanād iti | anyāpohanibandhanatvena darśanāt | etac ca tadanyaparihāreṇa pravartate(?ta i)ti ca dhvanir ucyata ityādinā pratipādayiṣyate | yathety ekākārā iyaṃ vikalpabuddhiḥ pratibhāti (|) (p.173) tathā bāhyantatsāmānyan nāstīti vākyārthaḥ | tato na vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ vikalpadarśanāśraya ity abhiprāyaḥ ||
 sāmānyābhāve ca kāraṇam āha – yasmād ityādi | vyaktayaḥ svalakṣaṇāni | nānuyanti na miśrībhavanti | etenāvyatiriktasāmānyābhyupagamo nirastaḥ |
 vyatiriktanirākaraṇārtham āha – anyad anuyāyīti | anuyāyi yad iṣṭaṃ bhedebhyo 'nyat sāmānyarūpantatpratyakṣabuddhau na bhāsate |
 nanu vikalpapratibhāse 'pi sāmānye bhedābhedapakṣayor ayam ananvayādidoṣas tulya eveti | kathaṃ sāmānyam iṣyate | sāmānākāras tāvat pratibhāsata eva | yāvad asau na budhyate bhedābhedarahita iti tāvad asyālaṅkāra evāvastutvapratipādanād (|) ata eva yathāpratibhāsaṃ tv asāv astīty ucyate |
 anvāviśanti miśrībhavanti | yadi parasparam anvāveśaḥ syāt tadaikarūpāpatter bhedābhāvaḥ | tena kāraṇena sāmānyasyaivābhāvaprasaṅgāt | tena bhedānāṃ samānānām ekākārapratyayanibandhanatvaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ | tadbhedābhāvena bhaved ity arthaḥ | anyac ceti vyaktibhyaḥ anyad ity asya vivaraṇaṃ vyatiriktam iti | tathā tena rūpeṇa sāmānyabuddhau (|) anenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya sāmānyasyābhāvavyavahāre sādhye svabhāvānupalambhauktaḥ | na cānupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sāmānyam abhyupeyaṃ | yasmād apratibhāsamānaṃ ca sāmānyaṃ katham ātmanā svena sāmānyarūpeṇa | anyam iti sāmānyavantaṃ grāhayet | vyapadeśayed vā | svena rūpeṇa katham anyam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | sāmānyabalād vyaktiṣv abhinnābhidhānajñānavṛttir iṣṭā | tasmāt sāmānyam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam eveṣṭam iti samudāyārthaḥ | evaṃ tāvad grāhyalakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalambhān nāsty ekam anekasambandhi (|)
 bhavatu nāmaikam anekasambaddhan tathāpi sāmānyarūpatā na yuktety āha – na cetyādi | tair iti vyaktibhedaiḥ uktam iti dvitvādi | saṃyogakāryadravyeṣv api sāmānyasvabhāvatvaṃ prāpnotīty aprasaṅgasyoktatvāt | ekam anekasambaddham ity eva kṛtvā na sāmānyaṃ kin tv abhinnābhidhānapratyayanimittam (p.174) ekasāmānyaṃ na sarva dvitvādy api | tasya yathoktaśabdajñānānimittatvād iti cet | katham anyataḥ sāmānyād anyatra vyaktibhede sāmānyenaikarūpatām anāpādite | pratyayavṛttir ekākārajñānavṛttiḥ |
 tatsambandhād iti paraḥ | tābhir vyaktibhiḥ sambandhād anyato 'pi sāmānyād anyatra pratyayavṛttiḥ |
 saṃkhyety ācāryaḥ | bhāvalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ saptamī | saṃkhyāṃ satyāṃ kāryadravye 'vayavini sati | ādiśabdāt saṃyogādiṣu sannapratyayavṛttes te 'pi sāmānyaṃ prāpnuvantīti samudāyārthaḥ | asāmānyātmakatvāt saṃkhyādīnāntadvalena dravye naikākārapratyayavṛttir iti cet |
 nanu sa evāyaṃ sāmānyātmā vicāryate (|) ko 'yaṃ sāmānyātmeti | saṃkhyādibhyo vivekena sāmānyalakṣaṇasyaivāpratītatvāt | naitad vyaktam iti yāvat | tad evāha – tatretyādi | tatra ko 'yaṃ sāmānyātmeti pṛṣṭe tvayoktam ekasyānekena sati sambandhe vyaktiṣv abhinnapratyayavṛttiḥ | tata iti pratyayavṛtteḥ kāraṇād anekasambaddham ekaṃ sāmānyam iti sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ |
 atra sāmānyalakṣaṇe 'smābhir ucyate | anekasambandhino vidyante yeṣāṃ kāryadravyādīnāṃ | ādiśabdāt dvitvādiparigrahaḥ | tebhyo 'pi tadāśrayadravyeṣv ekākārapratyayotpattiḥ syāt | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) nimittasambhavāt | tathā hy anekasambandhād eva nimittāt sāmānyād ekapratyayotpattir iṣyate (|) asti cānekasambandhitvam ekapratyayanimittandravyādiṣv api | tataś cety ekapratyayapravṛtteḥ saṃkhyādīnāṃ sāmānyātmatā | anyatheti | yathoktasāmānyalakṣaṇayoge 'pi saṃkhyādiṣu sāmānyātmatā yadi neṣyate | anyatrāpi sāmānyābhimate mā bhūt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | viśeṣābhāvāt | tathā ca dravyādīnām api sāmānyarūpatāpattau dravyaguṇādīnāṃ rūpasaṃkaraḥ | buddher eva pratibhāsa (p.175) iti vikalpabuddher ekākārapratibhāsaḥ sāmānyam iti sambandhaḥ | sa ca jñānarūpatvāt | jñānavat sann eva | tad uktaṃ (|)
 "sāmānyaṃ vastu rūpaṃ hi buddhyākāro bhaviṣyati |
 vasturūpā ca sā buddhiḥ śabdārtheṣūpajāyate |
 tena vastv eva kalpyeta vācyaṃ buddhyanapohakam" iti |
 tan netyādinā pratiṣedhati | yat taj jñānarūpaṃ sāmānyam iṣyate | tajjñānād avyatiriktaṃ jñānasvalakṣaṇavat katham athantaram bāhyaṃ brajet | na teṣāṃ sāmānyam iti yāvat (|)
 tad vyācaṣṭe (|) jñānasyetyādi | tasya jñānarūpasya teṣv artheṣv abhāvāt |
 satyaṃ (|) na jñānarūpasya vyaktiṣv anvayaḥ kin tu tasmin buddhipratibhāse tad bhāvādhyavasāyāt | bāhyabhāvādhyavasāyāt | tathā bhrāntyā sāmānavyavahāra iti cet |
 etac ceṣṭam eva siddhāntavādinaḥ | kevalaṃ prakṛtyaikakāryāḥ vyaktayo 'tatkāryād vyāvṛttāḥ | tathābhūtāyā vikalpabuddher nimittam ity anyāpohāśrayā sā buddhir ity abhimataṃ śāstrakārasya |
 paras tv evaṃbhūtaṃ nimittaṃ necchati | ata eva siddhāntavādī nimittam eva paryanuyuṃkte (|) tatretyādi | tatra vyaktibhedeṣv avastubhūteṣu vyaktīnāṃ ca prakṛtyā vijātīyavyāvṛttānām ekakāryatvānicchataco(?to) jñānotpatteḥ kin nibandhanaṃ | naiva kiñcit | tathā hi paro vijātīyavyāvṛttānāṃ bhedānām ekapratyayahetutvan necchati | na cāsti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ | anāśrayasyety animittasya sāmānyajñānasyotpattau sarvatra syād iti gaur ity ekākāraḥ pratyayo vṛkṣeṣv api syāt |
 jñānād avyatiriktam ityāder aparam artham āha – atha vetyādi | pūrvam arthāntaraśabdena (p.176) bāhyam uktam adhunā jñānāntaraṃ nirdiśyate | ata evāha (|) katham anyasya punarjñānasyeti | kimviśiṣṭasya jñānasya (|) vyaktyantarabhāvinaḥ | ekasyāṃ govyaktau yadvikalpavijñānan tatonyatra govyaktyantareṇa samutpannasya vikalpajñānasyety arthaḥ | tathā hy anekajñānavyāpanādvā sāmānyam bhavet | bāhyavyaktivyāpanādvā | jñānapratibhāsasya tu dvayam apy asat | tad āha – tataś cetyādi | vyaktyantaram iti bāhyaṃ ||

 tasmād ity upasaṃhāraḥ |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kenacid iti sāmānyarūpeṇa | tathaiṣāṃ grahaṇam ity arthānāṃ samānā iti grahaṇaṃ ||

 nanu siddhāntavādināpy asya vikalpasya nibandhanaṃ vācyam anāśrayotpattau sarvatra prasaṅgād ity āha – itaretarabheda ityādi | saṃjñā saṃketakriyā yadarthikā (|) ya itaretarabhedaḥ | arthaḥ phalaṃ pratyāyyatvena yasya iti kṛtvā sa evambhūta itaretarabhedo bhāvānām anyonyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇosya mithyāvikalpasya bījaṃ saṃjñā saṃketakriyā | yadarthikā | yasyetaretarabhedasya pratyāyanaphalā |
 yasyetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yasyetaretarabhedasya pratyāyanārthaṃ saṃketaḥ kriyate | atas sādhyebhya ity atatkāryebhyo bhinnāsādhyān bhāvān bhedena jñātvā tatparihāreṇety etat kāryaparihāreṇa tatkāryeṣu pravartteteti kṛtvā saṃketaḥ kriyate | soyaṃ yathokta itaretarabhedas tasyaikātmatāpratibhāsina ekākārasya mithyāvikalpasya bījaṃ kāraṇaṃ | tam eva gṛhṇann iti bhedaṃ bhinnam ity arthaḥ | etac cādhyavasāyavaśād ucyate | na punar vikalpasya vastugṛhaṇam asti (|) eṣa vikalpa iti sāmānyākāro vikalpaḥ svavāsanāprakṛter iti vikalpavāsanāsvabhāvāt | evam ity ekākāratayā pratibhāti | (|74||)

 kathaṃ punar bhinnānāṃ svalakṣaṇānām abhinnaṃ kāryam ekākāravikalpātmakaṃ | (p.177) yenety ekakāryatvena | tadanyebhyo 'tatkāryabhyo bhedād dhetor vyaktīnām abheda ity ucyate | ekāsaṃsargas tadvyatirekiṇāṃ samānateti vacanāt |
 prakṛtir ityādinā pariharati | prakṛtiḥ svabhāva ekākāraṃ pratyabhijñānam ekapratyavamarśaḥ | anubhavajñānam arthajñānaṃ | ekapratyavamarśaś cārthājñānaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ | pūrvanipātalakṣaṇasya vyabhicāritvāt | alpājtaratve1*py arthajñānaśabdasya na pūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ | te ādī yasyeti vigrahaḥ | ādiśabdād dahanagṛhādikāryagrahaṇaṃ | ekapratyavamarśādir evaiko rtha iti karmadhārayaḥ | tasya sādhane siddhau bhedepi nānātvepi niyatāḥ kecit | svabhāvena prakṛtyā | indriyādivat | athavaikāntena bhedepi svahetubhyaḥ kecit samānā utpannāḥ kecidasamānā ity etac coktan tatra ye samānā utpannās te tena svabhāvenaikākāraṃ pratyayañ janayanti vināpi sāmānyenendriyādivat | tatraikapratyavamarśajñānasādhane niyatā ity etad dārṣṭāntikatvenopanyastam arthajñānādyekārthasādhana ity etat tu dṛṣṭāntatvenobhyasiddhatvāt |
fn. 1: Pāṇini 2:2:34.
 ata evādau vibhajyate | yathendriyetyādi | yathendriyālokamanaskārā rūpavijñānam ekaṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ | etad vastubalasiddham udāharati | ātmetyādi parasiddhāntāśrayeṇa | nityam aṇumanaḥ śīghraṃ cety aṇusvarūpam manaḥ | tatsannikarṣā ityātmendriyamanorthasannikarṣāḥ | "ātmā manasā saṃyujyate mana indriyeṇendriyam arthene"ti vacanāt1* | ātmendriyamanorthaś ca tatsannikarṣāś ceti dvandvaḥ | ātmendriyamanorthāḥ | yathāsvaṃ sannikarṣasahāyā vijñānaṃ janayantīti parābhyupagamaḥ | asaty api tadbhāvaniyata ity ekakāryatvaniyate | na hi cakṣurādīnāṃ cakṣurvijñānajanakatvaṃ nāma sāmānyam pareṇeṣṭaṃ |
fn. 1: Nyāya-bhāṣya 1:1:4.
 (p.178) adhunā dārṣṭāntikam vyācaṣṭe | śiṃśapādaya iti śiṃśapākhadiranyagrodhādayaḥ parasparānanvayepi | vṛkṣatvasāmānyavirahepi vṛkṣa ity ekākāraṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ janayanti | pratyabhijñānād anyām vā dahanagṛhādikāṃ kāṣṭhasādhyām arthakriyāṃ śiṃśapādayo janayantīti prakṛtaṃ | yathāpratyayam iti yāvad (|) agnisahakāripratyayalābhas tadā dahanaṃ janayanti | gṛhānukūlapratyayasaṃpāte gṛhaṃ | ādiśabdād rathādikāryaparigrahaḥ | na tu bhedāviśeṣepi jalādayaḥ kāṣṭhasādhyārthakriyāsamarthāḥ prakṛtyā teṣām atatkāryatvāt | atrāpi dṛṣṭāntam āha – śrotrādivad rūpajñāna iti | yathā śrotraśabdādayo rūpavijñāne karttavye na samarthāḥ | ādiśabdād rasādivijñāne ||

 syād etad (|) bahūnāṃ pratyekam ekakāryakarttṛtvaṃ sāmānyam antareṇa na sidhyatīty ata āha – jvarādityādi | saheti vyaktyantarasahitāḥ | pratyekam ity ekaikarūpā jvarādiśamane ekasmin kārye dṛṣṭā yathaiṣadhayaḥ | vāśabdaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭāntāpekṣayā | na cāparā dadhitrapusā(?ṣā)dayaḥ |
 yathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na tatra jvarādiśamane karttavye sāmānyamoṣadhitvaṃ nāmāpekṣante (?) | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) bhedepi tatprakṛtikatvāt | jvarādiśamanakāryasvabhāvatvāt | yadi bhedānām asāmarthyaṃ syāt | bhavet sāmānyāpekṣā | na tadaviśeṣepi bhedāviśeṣepi dadhitrapusādayaḥ | dadhy eva mandajātandadhitrapusaṃ | dadhi ca trapusaś ceti dvandvam anye vyācakṣate ||

 tāsu guḍūcīvyaktyādiṣu tathābhūtāsvekakāryakāriṇīṣu | kiṃcid iti vyatiriktam avyatiriktaṃ ca | tad uktaṃ (|)
 (p.179) "nirvarttyamānaṃ yatkarma jātis tatrāpi sādhanaṃ |
 svāśrayasyābhiniṣpattyai sā kriyāyāḥ prayojike"ti |
 tata eva sāmānyāt tadekaṃ jvarādiśamanalakṣaṇaṃ kāryan tataś cāsiddho dṛṣṭānta iti bhāvaḥ |
 tad ayuktam iti siddhāntavādī | aviśeṣāt sāmānyasyeti | ekatvān nityatvāc ca aviśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyan (na) tatkāryakṛd iti śamanakāryakṛt | anyathā sāmānyasyāviśeṣāt tāsāṃ gūḍūcyādivyaktīnāṃ kṣetrādibhedepi tadyāpi jvarādiśamanakāryasyāviśeṣaprasaṅgataḥ | viraśīghretyādi | viśiṣṭakṣetrotpannānāṃ śīghrapraśamanaṃ viparītānāṃ cirapraśamanaṃ | ādiśabdāc cirataraśīghratarādiparigrahaḥ | kṣetrasaṃskārādibhinnānāṃ gūḍūcyādīnām upayogād dehe ārogyādilakṣaṇasya guṇasya tāratamyaṃ ca na syāt | sāmānyasyaikyāt | atha kṣetrādibhedena sāmānyasya viśeṣa iṣyate | tadā viśeṣe vā sāmānyasyeṣyamāṇe svabhāvabhedaḥ syād viśeṣalakṣaṇatvād bhedasya | tataś ca svarūpahānaṃ | sāmānyasvarūpam ekaṃ hīyate | ghrauvyāc ca kāraṇāt sāmānyasya vyaktibhyonupakārato na sāmānyaṃ kāryakṛd iti varttate | yadi hi sāmānyam upakuryāt tadā nityatvāt sahakāribhir anādheyaviśeṣasyānyānapekṣaṇatvāt sahakāryanapekṣaṇāt tat sāmānyaṃ svakāryaṃ sakṛjjanayet | atha na janayet tadā tajjananasvabhāvaṃ na bhavati | ajananāvasthāyā aviśeṣāt kāryakālepi na janayed iti yāvat | vyaktīnāṃ tv anityānāṃ kāryakṛttve nāyaṃ doṣa ity āha – vyaktayas tv ityādi (|) saṃskāro jalāvasekādi | viśiṣṭā utpattir yāṃsāntās tathā | viśeṣosyāstīti (p.180) viśeṣavat kāryaṃ jvarādiśamanalakṣaṇaṃ | na ca tāsu vyaktiṣu yacchīghrakāritvādilakṣaṇamavāntarasāmānyam avasthin tad eva viśeṣavat kāryakārīti yuktam vaktuṃ | oṣadhyan upayogepi puṃsaḥ tatkāryodayaprasaṅgāt | tadvad iti viśiṣṭavyaktivat | kecid iti sajātīyā ekapratyabhijñānādikaṃ | ādiśabdād ekodakādyāharaṇādi | tadakāribhya iti | pratyabhijñānādykāribhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyante | na tv ekasāmānyayogāt |
 kāryadvāreṇābhedaṃ pratipādya kāraṇadvāreṇāha – ekena vetyādi | yathā prayatnena ghaṭabhedā atajjanyebhya ity aprayatnajanyebhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyante | yady api pratighaṭaṃ prayatnasya bhedas tathāpy ekapratyabhijñānahetutvena tasyāpy ekatvaṃ | etac cottaratra niścāyayiṣyate |
 kim punar ityādi paraḥ | bhedo vyāvṛttir lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tena sāmānyenātatkāryebhyo 'tatkāraṇebhyaś ca vyāvṛttaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ samānam iti pratyeyaṃ | anyathānyad eveti svalakṣaṇād anyad vikalpabuddhiparivarttirūpam anarthakriyākāri | tena bhedalakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānam iti pratyeyaṃ |
 nanu tad eṣāṃ buddhipratibhāsam anurundhānair buddhiviparivarttinām eva bhāvānām ākāraviśeṣaparigrahād bahir eva parisphuratāṃ sāmānyam ucyata iti pūrvam uktatvāt sandehānuvṛttir eva |
 satyaṃ | kin tv adhikasya doṣasya vidhānārthaṃ upanyāsaḥ | doṣavijñānārtham āha – kiṃcāta iti | itare yadītyādinā praśnābhiprāyam āha – yadi svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyeyaṃ kathaṃ vikalpaviṣayaḥ | tathā hi vikalpabuddhyabhiprāyavaśād bhedalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyavasthāpyate tasyā abhiprāyavaśāt | sāmānyaṃ satprakīrtitam iti vacanāt | tathābhūtena cet sāmānyena svalakṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ pratyeyaṃ | tadā vikalpasya viṣayaḥ syāt | na caitad yuktam athānyad eva buddhiparivartti rūpaṃ samānam iti pratyeyaṃ | atrāpi doṣam āha – anyato vā katham arthakriyā (|) na hi buddhipratibhāsirūpād arthakriyā sambhavati | (p.181) tataś cātatkāribhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyanta iti kāryadvāreṇa sāmānyavyavasthā na ghaṭate | yataś ca buddhiparivartti rūpaṃ samānan tataḥ svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādisāmānyasyāpratīter atādrūpyam anityādirūpatvaṃ svalakṣaṇasya na bhavet | svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādīnām apratītes teṣāṃ cānityatvādīnām avastudharmatā |
 netyādinā pariharati | buddhipratibhāsiny eva rūpe sāmānyādivyavahāra ity ayaṃ pakṣo gṛhītaḥ | tad āha – jñānapratibhāsiny artha ityādi |
 etac ca grahaṇakavākyaṃ | asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | yad etajjñānaṃ vikalpakam ity anena sambandhaḥ | atadviṣayam api vastusvabhāvaviṣayam api tadviṣayam iva svalakṣaṇaviṣayam iva | adhyavasitatadbhāvam āropitabāhyabhāvaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathā | yataś cādhyavasitatadbhāvamataḥ svalakṣaṇaviṣayam eveti manyate | adhyavasitatadbhāvasvarūpatvam eva katham iti ced āha – tadanubhavāhitavāsanāprabhavaprakṛter iti (|) tasya svalakṣaṇasya yonubhavas tenāhitā vāsanā tataḥ prabhava utpādas tasya sāmānyasya sā prakṛtiḥ svabhāvo yenādhyavasitabhāvasvarūpam bhavatīty arthaḥ | abhinnakāryā ye padārthā ghaṭādayaḥ | ekākārapratyayajñānahetavas tebhyaḥ paramparayā prasūter abhinnārthagrāhīva pratibhāti | na tu sāmānyavastubhūtaṃ kiṃcid vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā 'sti yad tad gṛhṇīyāt | paramārthas tu tadanyabhedasamākāraṃ tebhyaḥ sajātīyābhimatebhyo 'nye vijātīyās tebhyo bhedaḥ bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa eva paramārthena samāna ākāro yasyeti vigrahaḥ | tata eva tasyotpattes tannivartanatvāc ca tadanyabhedas tasya samāna ākāra ity ucyate |
 tatrānantarokte jñāne eka iveti sarvavyaktyanugata iva | tatkārīvety arthakriyākārīva | kiṃ punas tathā pratibhātīti ced āha – vyavahāriṇām ityādi | tathādhyavasāyeti vikalpāṃśam eva bāhyatvenaikatvenārthakriyākāritvenādhyavasāyavyavahāriṇāṃ (p.182) pravṛtteḥ | vyavahāribhir ity anye paṭhanti | vyavahāribhir ity adhyavasāyety anena pūrvasambandhāt tṛtīyaiva kṛtā | na tu ṣaṣṭhī | na lokāvyayaniṣṭhetiṣaṣṭhī pratiṣedhāt | anyatheti yadi vikalpāṃśe bāhyādhyavasāyo na bhavet tadā tathā bhūte vikalpe jātepy arthakriyākāriṇī pravṛttir na syāt | tad api vikalpapratibimbakaṃ vyavaharttṛpuruṣādhyavasāyavaśād arthakriyākāritayā pratibhāsate | tataś ca tadatatkāribhyo bhinnam iva | vikalpaprativimbakam eva tattvaṃ kasmān neti ced āha – na cetyādi | tadvikalpaprativimbakan na tattvaṃ na vastu | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) anarthakriyākāritvena parīkṣāyā vyabhicārasyānaṅgatvāt | etac cānantaram eva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ |
 tatra ye svalakṣa(ṇa)dvārā yātā arthākārā vikalpabuddhau pratibhānti te 'rthā vikalpabuddhipratibhāsinas tena bhedalakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānā iti gṛhyante | kutaścid vyāvṛttā (i)ti vijātīyavyāvṛttyā | tathā hi (|) vikalpapratibhāsinopi vṛkṣabhedā adhyavasitabāhyarūpatvād avṛkṣebhyo vyāvṛttā iva bhāsante | tathānyeti | na svalakṣaṇan tena samānam iti gṛhyata iti liṅgavacana(vi)pariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatra sāmānyapratibhāsini vikalpe svalakṣaṇāpratibhāsanāt |
 etan tāvad buddhipratibhāsiny arthe sāmānyavyavahāra uktaḥ | saṃprati sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāram āha – ta evetyādi | ta eva vikalpapratibhāsinorthāḥ | kutaścid vyāvṛttā iva santo yathānutpalād vyāvṛttā utpalabhedās ta eva puanr anyatopy anīlād vyāvṛttimantaḥ pratibhānti (|) tataś ca vyāvṛttidvayānugatasyaikasyaiva dharmiṇaḥ pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
 ayaṃ cānantarānukrānto buddhipratibhāsiṣvrtheṣu sāmānyasāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāro mithyārtha eva kriyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svayam asatām api vikalpākārāṇān tathā ekākārānugatatvena | vyāvṛttidvayānugatena dharmmasvarūpeṇa | vikalpabuddhyopadarśanāt | (p.183) ekākāreṇapratibhāsanāt sāmānyavyavahāraḥ | anekākāreṇa caikasya pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāraḥ |
 yadi mithyārtha eva sarvo vikalpaḥ kasmāt kṛtakatvādidvārāyātā anityānātmādivikalpāḥ pramāṇaṃ nityā vikalpās tu nety ata āha – sarvaś cāyam ityādi | sarvo viplava iti sambandhaḥ | viplavo bhrāntiḥ | ayam iti sāmānyādirūpaḥ | svalakṣaṇānām eva yaddarśanan tenāhitā yā vāsanā tatkṛtaḥ | paramparayā sarvavikalpānām vastudarśanadvārāyātatvāt | tathā hi nityādivikalpā api vastudarśanenaivotpannāḥ sadṛśāparāparotpattidarśanāyātatvāt | tatra tulye sarvavikalpānām vastudarśanadvārāyātatve | tatpratibaddhajanmanām anityādivikalpānām atatpratibhāsitvepi svalakṣaṇāpratibhāsitvepi vastuny avisamvādaḥ | adhyastasyānityādirūpasya vastuni vidyamānatvāt kevalaṃ svalakṣaṇarūpeṇa na pratibhāsata iti vikalpo vibhrama ucyate | maṇiprabhāyām iva maṇibhrānter maṇisvarūpāgrahepy avisamvādo maṇiprabhāyā maṇau pratibaddhatvāt | prabhāśrayeṇa ca maṇibhrānter utpatteḥ |
 na tv evan nityādivikalpās teṣām vastudarśanadvārāyātatvepi vastuny avidyamānasyaivākārasya samāropāt | tad āha – nānyeṣām ityādi | anyeṣāṃ nityādivikalpānāṃ vastuni samvāda ity anena sambandhaḥ | tadbhedaprabhave saty apīti | arthābhedād utpādepi satīty arthaḥ | yathā dṛṣṭo yo viśeṣaḥ kṣaṇikatvādilakṣaṇas tasyānusaraṇaṃ niścayaṃ parityajya kiñcitsāmānyam iti vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya vā sāmānyasya grahaṇena viśeṣāt tasya sthiratvādeḥ samāropāt | dīpaprabhāyām iva bhāsuratvādisāmyāt pravṛttāyā maṇibuddher na maṇivastusamvādaḥ | pāramparyeṇāpy adhyavasite maṇāvapratibaddhatvāt | yataś ca mithyārthā eva vikalpās tena na vikalpaviśayeṣv arthakriyākāritvaṃ (|) tataś ca yaduktam anyato vā katham arthakriyeti tatsiddhaṃ sādhyate |
 kathan tarhy atatkārivyavacchedalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ vikalpaviṣayeṣv artheṣu vyavasthāpyata iti cet | na | bahir iva parisphuratām ekārthakriyākāritayā tadakāribhyo bhinnānām iva (p.184) pratibhāsanāt | yac coktaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādyapratīter atādrūpyam iti tatparihārārtham āha – nāpītyādi | calād vastuno yasmān nānityatvan nāma kiñcid asti | yenāsambaddhāt svalakṣaṇasyānityatvenāyogaḥ syāt | kin tu calam eva vastu nityaṃ svalakṣaṇasyaivānityarūpatvād evamanātmādy api draṣṭavyaṃ | tena pratyakṣeṇa svalakṣaṇe gṛhyamāṇe 'nityatvaṃ gṛhītam eva kevalaṃ bhrāntinimittasadbhāvād aniścitam (|) atas tanniścayamātre 'numānavyāpāras tena tanniścaya eva svalakṣaṇe 'nityatvapratītir iti siddhaṃ |
 yadi svalakṣaṇam evānityaṃ katham anityoyam artho 'nityatvam asyeti vā dharmidharmarūpatayā pratītir ity ata āha – kṣaṇetyādi | svalakṣaṇasya tathābhūtasyeti calarūpasya kṣaṇāpratyupasthānatayā | ekakṣaṇasthāyitvena grahaṇād uttarakālamantyakṣaṇadarśinām etad evambhavaty anityoyam ityādi | bhedāntarāpratikṣepavivakṣāyām anityoyam iti bhedāntarapratikṣepavivakṣāyām anityatvam asyetyevaṃ dharmidharmabhāvapratītir bhavati |
 vikalpakalpitatvāt kathaṃ bāhye dharmadharmibhāva ity ata āha – taddharmatām ityādi | taddharmatāṃ svalakṣaṇadharmatām evāvatarantaḥ svalakṣaṇam adhyavasyanto vikalpā ity arthaḥ | vyāvṛttibhede kṛtasaṃketaśabdānusāreṇa nānārūpā ekarūpāś ca dharmās te ca vyatirekāś ceti dvandvaḥ | nānādharmān anityakṛtakatvādīn | ekaṃ dharmaṃ bahūnāṃ ghaṭādīnām anityatvaṃ vyatirekaś ca ghaṭādīnām anityatvam iti darśayanti | vastunīty adhyāhāraḥ | na ca vikalpavyavasthāpitannānaikadharmādikan tattvam vikalpasyāvastugrāhitvād (|) ata evāha (|) darśayantīti |
 avastugrāhitvāt tarhi te nirāśrayāḥ prāpnuvantīti ced āha – na ca ta iti | na iti nānādharmādidarśakā vikalpavastubhedasyānityādirūpasya svalakṣaṇasya yad darśanam anubhavas tadāśrayatvād vikalpānāṃ | tathā hi paramārtho 'nityādirūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā darśanasāmarthyabhāvino vikalpā dṛṣṭākārādhyavasāyena pravarttante | yataś ca yathāḍṛṣṭasyaivābhilapanena pravarttante vikalpā anityākārā nārthāntaran nityatvādivikalpavad anusaranti | tato yad uktaṃ (|) teṣāṃ cāvastu dharmateti parihṛtam bhavatīty āha – neti | teṣām anityatvādīnāṃ nāvastudharmatā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tatsvabhāvasyaiva tathānityādidharmatayā khyāteḥ pratibhāsanād adhyavasāyād iti yāvat | yadi (p.185) vastudharma evānityatvādikaṃ khyāti | kas tarhi vikalpakṛto vibhrama ity āha – vastunas tv ityādi | ekasya vastuno nānārūpeṇa grahaḥ | bahūnāṃ caikatvena | dharmadharmiṇoś ca vyatirekeṇa graho vibhramo bhrānta ity arthaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ekatvādigraho vibhrama ity āha – tasyaikāneketyādi | ekakāraykāriṇo ghaṭādibhedasyaikodakādyāharaṇādikāryakāriṇaḥ | tathā bhāvijijñāsāsu | ekakāryakarttṛtvajijñāsāsu | tathābhāvakhyāpanāyaikakāryakāritvakhyāpanāya | tathākṛtasthititvāt | ghaṭādinā ekarūpeṇa vyavahāralāghavārtham vyavasthāpitatvāt | tathakasyāpyanekāryakāriṇaḥ | yathā ghaṭasya cakṣurvijñānodakadhāraṇakādācitkajñānādikāryakāriṇas tathābhāvajijñāsāsu tathābhāvakhyāpanāya | anekakāryatvakhyāpanāya tathākṛtasthitatvāt | cākṣuṣapārthivānityādirūpeṇa vyavasthāpitatvāt | evam anyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ | na vastubhedād ekasmin padārthe 'nekadharmavyavasthāpanaṃ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyaivaikasya vastuno 'nekatvāyogāt (|) tataś caikasyānekatvagrāho vibhrama ity ākhyātaṃ | tathānekasyāpy ekatvavyavasthāpanan tadakāryavyāvṛttidvāreṇaiva na vastvabhedād ity āha – anekasya caikatvāyogād iti | tathā cānekasyaikatvagraho vibhramaḥ | evaṃ dharmadharmiṇor vyatirekagrahopi bhrānta eva | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) vyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasya prāg eva niṣedhāt | vyaktayo nānuyanty anyad ityādinā |
 dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād vyatiriktā eva dharmās tataś ca yathāvastu śabdārtho bhaviṣyatīty āha – teṣām ityādi | teṣām anityatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ prakṛteḥ svabhāvasya bhedāt kāraṇād yathāvastu śabdārthābhyupagame nīlotpalam anityaḥ śabda ityādi sāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt | nīlādiguṇānām utpalādijātīnāñ ca parasparaṃ svabhāvabhedāt | tadvācināṃ śabdānām ekasminn adhikaraṇe vṛttir nāstīti sāmānādhikaraṇyāyogaḥ | tasmān na yathāvastu śabdārthavyavastheti bhāvaḥ |
 (p.186) tadupādher ityādinā parābhiprāyam āśaṃkate | te nīlādayo dharmā upādhir yasya dravyasya tasyaikasya dvābhyāṃ guṇajātibhyām abhidhānād adoṣaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvadoṣo nāsti | uttaram āha (|) anupakāriṇītyādi | upādhitvenābhimatānāṃ nīlādīnāṃ dharmāṇām anupakārakandravyaṃ | na hi nīlaguṇasyotpalatvajāter vā dravyeṇopakāraḥ kaścid kriyate (|) tataś cānupakāriṇi dravye tadanādheyavṛttīnāṃ nīlādīnāṃ pāratantryāyogāt | nīlādayo dharmā anupādhiḥ | pāratantryābhāvāt | anyathāsyāyam upādhir ity eva na syāt | atheṣyate dravyaviṣayaṃ pāratantryaṃ dharmāṇān tadā pāratantryepi dravyajanyatvam aṅgīkarttavyam anyathā dravyapāratantryāyogāt | janakaṃ ca kṣaṇikam eṣṭavyam kṣaṇikasyārthakriyāyogāt | tataś ca kāryābhimatānām upādhīnāṃ kāraṇābhimatasya ca dravyasya sahānavasthiteḥ kāraṇāt | dvayor viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayor vasturūpayor yugapadanabhidhānaṃ (|) kāraṇābhimatasya viśeṣasya tadānīṃ nirodhāt | ekasyeti viśiṣṭasyāpy upādhimataḥ | adhyāhāra upadarśanan tadā na vastuviṣayaḥ śabdārthaḥ syāt | buddhyāropitasyaiva viśeṣasya śabdenābhidhānāt |
 syan mataṃ (|) yadvinaṣṭaṃ viśeṣyan tadviṣayasya śabdasya bhavatu buddhipratibhāsaviṣayatvaṃ (|) yaḥ punaḥ sann evopādhis tadācinaḥ śabdasya vastuviṣayatvam evāstv iti ced āha – buddhipratibhāsetyādi | buddhipratibhāso viṣayo yasyābhidhānasya tat tathā (|) tadbhāvas tasmin sati sarvaṃ viśeṣaṇaviṣayābhimatam apy abhidhānan tathaiva vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaviṣayam evāstu | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathā bhinnopādhimato nānāviśeṣaṇavata ekasya grahaṇe buddhāv abhāsanāt | tathā hy apādhimato vinaṣṭasyādhyāhārikā vikalpabuddhir aṅgīkarttavyā (|) tadā copādhimato 'bhāve upādher apy abhāvaḥ pāratantryābhāvāt (|) bhinnopādhimata ekasyāpratibhāsane kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
 yadā tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayor dvayor api vikalpabuddhipratibhāsitvam iṣṭan tadā kalpita dharmadvayagṛhītaikadharmipratibhāsiny ekaiva buddhir jāyata ity aviruddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
 upakāryetyādinā parābhiprāyam āśaṃkate | adoṣo yoyam ekasya buddhyādhyāhāra ityādinoktaḥ | upādhimatā samakālasya niṣpannarūpasyopādheḥ pāratantryābhāvād anupādhitvaṃ | prāk pāratantryan tadevopādhitvam iti ced āha – netyādi | na hy aniṣpannasya (p.187) śaśaviṣāṇatulyasya pāratantryam upādhitvam vā (|) sarvathā sato 'sataś cāsatpāratantryam iti hetoḥ kalpanāropitam upādhīnām pāratantryaṃ kṛtvā pāratantryavyavahāre | sarvatheti sarveṇa prakāreṇa yathā pāratantryavyavahāre buddhir anuvidhīyate tathā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavyavahāre saivāropikā buddhiḥ kin nānuvidhīyate | tadanuvidhānaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ buddhisandarśatārthapratibhāsamanāśritya vyavaharttum aśakyatvāt | vastuna ekena śabdena pramānena ca viṣayīkaraṇe vastubalād vastusvabhāvabhūtāśeṣadharmākṣepāt tadanyasya śabdāder vaiyarthya ca yatprāguktam ekasyārthasvabhāvasya pratyakṣasyetyādi |
 vastuvādipakṣe tadbuddhipratibhāsānurodhena syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddhipratibhāsasya nirvastukatvād vastusāmarthyabhāvinān doṣānām aprasaṅgaḥ | bahuvacanenaitad āha – na kevalaṃ tadanyavaiyarthyadoṣasyāprasaṅgas tathā vyatiriktasya sāmānyasyābhāva upādhīnāṃ ca paratantryāyogāt |
 viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvābhāvaḥ bhinnotpādhimata ekasya buddhāv apratibhāsanāt (|) sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaś ca ya uktas teṣām apy atra sambhavo nāstīti tad evāha – tadabhinnam ityādi | tathā hi tadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpam abhinnam pratibhāti | tasmāt sāmānyaṃ yathā pratītir na virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | nīlam ity ukte 'nīlavyāvṛttyā nīlatvasyaikasyākārasya viṣayīkaraṇepi vikalpabuddhyā tatraiva nīlākāre saṃśayavyāvṛttir nākārāntare (|) tatas tadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpam aniścitādyākāram anutpalavyāvṛttotpalākārasyāniścayāt | yasminn ākāre niścayo notpannas tadākārāntaran tatra sākāṃkṣayotpalaśabdaprayogād utpannayā buddhyā grāhyaṃ pratibhātīti sambandhaḥ |
 etena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya nimittam uktaṃ (|) sāmānādhikaraṇasyāha – bhinnetyādi | bhinnasya śabdārthasya nīlotpalalakṣaṇasyopasaṃhāre pratipādanepi | (p.188) dharmadvayopagṛhītamabhinnam ekadharmitayā buddhipratibhāsarūpaṃ vikalpabuddhau pratibhātīti kṛtvā sāmānyādīni yathāpratīti na virudhyante |
 tena yad ucyate bha ṭṭe na (|) anyanivṛttimātram apohaṃ gṛhītvā anīlādivyāvṛttāv anutpalādivyāvṛtter abhāvād anutpalādivyāvṛttau cānīlādivyāvṛtter abhāvāc ca na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvas tayor dharmayos tadabhāvāc ca na tadābhidhāyakayoḥ śabdayoḥ śabdayor api viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | nāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śabdavācyayor bhinnatvāt (|) nāpi yatrārthe 'pohayor bhāvas taddvārakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam avastutvenāpohasyādheyatvābhāvāt (|) na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaviṣayonyac cādhikaraṇaṃ neṣyate | na ca svalakṣaṇepohayor bhāvepi śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ekaviṣayatvasyāpratīter ity apāstaṃ |
 bāhyabhinnasya svākārasya śabdādiviṣayatveneṣṭatvāt tena nīlotpalādiśabdeṣu śabdārthābhidhāyitvam iṣyata eveti sarvaṃ susthaṃ |
 dharmadharmibhedopy asya buddhipratibhāsasya yathā pratītir na virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | tam evāneketyādināha – anekasmādarthād buddhipratibhāsasyālokatvāt | kutonekārthabhedaḥ kevalaṃ puruṣādhyavasāyavaśād evam ucyate | tasya buddhipratibhāsasyaikasmād arthād yo bhedas tasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ | kimanityaḥ śabdo cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tad eva buddhipratibhāsabhūtamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ (|) kena prakāreṇety āha – pratikṣiptetyādi |
 yad vā dharmadharmibhedopy asya vastuno na virudhyata iti sambandhaḥ | kuta ity āha – anekasmād arthād bāhyasya bhedasambhave sati tasyaikasmād yo bhedas tasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ kimanityaḥ śabdo bhavati cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tad eva bāhyamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ | kena pradarśyata ity āha – pratikṣiptetyādi | dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmam iva vyavasthāpyeti sambandhaḥ | tathā hy anityatvan na cākṣuṣatvam iti dharmaśabdena codane kṛte vyatirikta ivānityatvādiko dharmo vyavasthāpito bhavati | kiṅkāraṇam ity āha – tathā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | dharmaśabdena (p.189) codane vyatiriktasyaiva dharmasya grāhiṇyā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | aviśeṣeṇeti sarvabhedāpratikṣepeṇāparamasya bāhyasyāpratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya śabdena pradarśyate |
 etad uktam bhavati | dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmam iva pradarśya punarddhamiśabdena saṃcodyāparaṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya tad eva bāhyaṃ vastu pradarśyate | anityatvaṃ śabdasya na cākṣuṣatvam (|) anityo na cākṣuṣaḥ śabda iti | bhāvabhāvāṅśeneti | bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepeṇa dharmar dharmiṇor bhedād bhedavatīva buddhir iva kalpikā pratibhāti bhinnākār eva | na tu vastuno bhedaḥ | na vastubhedād bhedavatī buddhiḥ (|) kutaḥ (|) yathoktadoṣād anupakāriṇi dharmiṇi dharmāṇāṃ pāratantryāyogāt |
 tathā sādhyam anityatvaṃ sādhanaṃ kṛtakatvam iti (|) sādhyasādhanabhedaś cety ata āha – tathābhūtetyādi | tathābhūtānām pratikṣiptabhedāntarāṇāṃ dharmabhedānām bāhulyacodanayā vacanabhevaḥ sādhyasādhanabhedaś ca kriyata iti sambandhaḥ |
 tasya tatas tato vyāvṛttasya svabhāvaḥ samāśrayo yeṣān tair ddharmapratibhāsabhedair vikalpabuddhiprati(vi)mbair ddharmātmakaiḥ kimarthaṃ kriyata ity āha – tatsvabhāvetyādi | tasyaiva vyāvṛttasya vastusvabhāvasya pratipattaye prāptaye vā ||
 praṇālikayā teṣām vastupratibandhāt prakṛtasyaivārthasya sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ saṅgrahaślokam āha – tatsvabhāvetyādi | tasya vastusvabhāvasyānubhavād ūrddhvaṃ yā dhīḥ prajñāyate vikalpikā | apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | anarthikāpi tadartheva | vastuviṣayeva adhyavasāyavaśādatatkāryebhyo yo bhedastanniṣṭhā | tadanubhavabalotpatter vyāvṛttasya ca vastunaḥ samvādāt tanniṣṭhety ucyate ||
 tasyām itthaṃ bhūtāyām buddhau yorthākāraḥ dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇād bāhyam iva | sajātīyāsu vyaktiṣu samampratibhāsamānam ekam ivānyato vijātīyād vyāvṛttim ivābhāti | tattu vyāvṛttam eva buddhirūpasyālokatvāt | tadbuddhirūpaṃ nistattvaṃ (p.190) niḥsvabhāvaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) parīkṣānaṅgabhāvataḥ | arthakriyāsamartham eva parīkṣāṅgamataḥ parīkṣānaṅgabhāvenārthakriyāṃ pratyasamarthatvād ity uktam bhavati | yataś ca buddhipratibhāsi rūpannistattvam atas tadviṣayo vyavahāro mithyārtha eva pravartate ity āha –|
 arthā ityādi | jñānaviśiṣṭā iti vikalpabuddhyārūḍhāste jñānaviśiṣṭās santaḥ yato vijātīyād vyāvṛttirūpiṇo vyāvṛttirūpavantaḥ | yathānutpalād vyāvṛttirūpiṇa utpalārthāḥ | tenety antato vyāvṛttirūpeṇotpalatvenābhinnā ivābhānti na paramārthato buddhirūpasyālīkatvāt | etena sāmānyavyavahārasya nimittam uktaṃ | vyāvṛttāḥ punar anyatasta eveti (|) ta eva jñānaviśiṣṭā arthā anyato vyāvṛttirūpiṇaḥ santaḥ punar anyataḥ sajātīyād api vyāvṛttā bhānti | yathā ta eva nīlabhedā anīlāt | ataś ca vyāvṛttidvayopagṛhītasyaikasyārthasya bhāsanāt ||
 sāmānādhikaraṇyabījam uktaṃ | tad evāha – teṣām ityādi | teṣām iti buddhipratibhāsinām arthānāṃ vyavahāraḥ pratanyata iti sambandhaḥ | teṣām iti vyavahārāpekṣā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | kiṃviśiṣṭo mithyārthaḥ | karaṇabhūtair ity āha – sāmānyetyādi | samānādhāratvaṃ samānādhāraḥ | bhāvapradhānatvān nirdeśasya | sāmānyaviṣayaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaviṣayaiś ca jñānābhidhānaiḥ sāmānyagocaraiḥ sāmānyavyavahāraḥ pratanyate | itaraiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavahāraḥ ||
 yady api śabdajñānātmaka eveha vyavahāras tathāpi savyāpāratāmupādāya jñānaśabdayoḥ karaṇarūpatā | tayor evārthaprakāśalakṣaṇā kriyā vyavahāratvena vivakṣitety adoṣaḥ | yathā jñānasya pramāṇatvaṃ phalatvaṃ veti | sa ca sarvaḥ jñānābhidhānalakṣaṇo vyavahāraḥ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ yonyonyābhāvaḥ parasparavyacchedas tatsaṃśrayaḥ | vyāvṛttapadārthān ubhavadvāreṇotpatteḥ | tenetyanyonyābhāvasaṃśrayatvena sa vyavahāronyāpohaviṣaya ucyate na tvanyavyāvṛttiviṣayatvāt | vidhiviṣayatvād asya vyavahārasya ||
 (p.191) vastulābhasya ca vastuprāpteś cāśrayo na bhavati vyavahāraḥ | na ca sarvaḥ kintu yatra vyavahāre 'sti pāramparyeṇa tathābhūtavastusambandhaḥ | udāharaṇam āha – yathoktānumitai yatheti | yathoktānumitiḥ pūrvoktānumānavikalpaḥ | nānyatra sthirādivikalpe tatra pāram paryeṇāpi vastusambandhābhāvāt | vastuno 'sthirādirūpatvāt | anumānavikalpasyetarasya ca svapratibhāsenarthe 'rthādhyavasātad bhrāntisāmyepi | dīpatejo maṇai yatheti | yathā maṇitejasi maṇibuddhir bhrāntā | tathā dīpatejasyapitulyepi bhrāntatve maṇiprabhā maṇitvena gṛhītā maṇāvadhigantavye samvādikā | na tu dīpatejaḥ | tadvat sthirādivikalpo samvādaka ity arthaḥ ||
 yadi jñānaniviṣṭānām evārthānāṃ sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ bāhyeṣv artheṣu tarhi sāmānyādivyavahārābhāvāt pravṛttir na syād ity ata āha – tatretyādi | tatra śabdo vākyopanyāse | nirddhāraṇe vā | tatra vyaktiṣv ekakāryā vyaktayo nirddhāyante | anekopyekakāryo yathā ghaṭabhedā evodakāharaṇādikāryās tadakāryāya tathābhūtakāryanukurvate | tebhyonyatāvyāvṛttiḥ sā āśrayo yeṣāṃ jñānābhidhānāttair anekopi padārtha ekatvena vyavahāram pratāryate | sāmānyavyavahāraṃ prāpyata iti yāvat ||
 tathetyanantarasāmānyavyapekṣayā | ekopy anekakāryakṛt | yathā ghaṭaś ca cakṣurvijñānodakāharaṇādikāryakṛt | tadbhāvadīpane | anekakāryakarttṛtvaprakāśane | atatkāryebhyo bhedena hetunā | nānādharmā ghaṭaś cākṣuṣaḥ pārthiva ityādi | tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyavahāraś ca bāhyeṣv eva darśitaḥ ||
 yadi bāhyeṣu sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ pāramārthikastarhi prāpta ity āha – yathāpratītikathitaḥ iti | vikalpabuddhyanurodhena śabdārthaḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇaḥ paramārthatosāvasannapi yathāpratītikathitaṃ | yasmād vastunyasya śabdārthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca na sambhavaḥ ||
 (p.192) dharmadharmivyavahāraś ca jñānapratibhāsinyartha iti yat prakṛtantatsaṅgrahārtham āha – dharmetyādi | ayaṃ dharmo 'yaṃ dharmīti vyavasthānantayoś ca bhedo 'syāyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtakatvādilakṣaṇaḥ | abhedaḥ kṛtakoyam iti yādṛṣaḥ | ayaṃ ca vikalpāropitatvāt | asamīkṣitatattvārthaḥ | anapekṣitastattvārtho vastvartho yeneti vigrahaḥ | yathā loke buddhyārūḍhopyadhyavasitatadbhāvatayā pratīyate ||
 taṃ dharmādivibhāgantathaiveti yathālokapratītiḥ sādhyasādhanasaṃsthitirvidvadibharavakalpyata iti sambandhaḥ | kimarthaṃ | paramārthāvatārāya | anityādivastusvabhāvasyāvagāhanāya ||
 kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ekatvādivyavahārasya vastunyasambhava ity āha – saṃsṛjyanta ityādi | pāramārthikā arthāḥ svato na saṃsṛjyante | tato na sāmānyavyavahāro vastuni | na bhidyante kṛtakatvād dharmaiḥ pratyekaṃ tasya vastunomekatvāyogāt | ataś ca teṣv artheṣu bahṛṣu rūpam ekam ekasminn arthe 'nekaṃ rūpaṃ yadadhyavasīyate tadbuddher vikalpakāyā upaplavo bhrāntiḥ | yataś ca saṃsṛjyante na bhijyante na bhidyante pāramārthikā arthāḥ ||
 tataḥ kāraṇāt sāmānyam idaṃ bahūnāṃ | tathā dharmāṇāṃ dharmiṇāṃ ca bheda ity api yoyambhedo nānātvavyavahāraḥ sa bauddherthe | na bāhye svalakṣaṇe | buddhipratibhāsasyālikatvāt (|) kathan tarhi tatra svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvādidharmabheda iti ced āha – tasyaiva cetyādi | tasyaiva svalakṣaṇasyānyavyāvṛttyā dharmabhedaḥ prakalpyate ||
 kasmāt kalpitadharmabhedadvāreṇa gamyagamakabhāvo na vastudarśanamātreṇety ata āha – sādhayetyādi | idaṃ sādhyam idaṃ sādhanam ity asmin saṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ | yadvā pratyakṣavadanumānena sāmānyaviśiṣṭaṃ svalakṣaṇam eva kasmān na gṛhyata ity ata āha – (p.193) sādhyetyādi | sādhyasādhanasaṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ | kutaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ | bhedaḥ sāmānyasamsṛṣṭo grāhya ity ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhiḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭasya svalakṣaṇasya grahaṇaṃ pratijñātam ity āśaṅkāmapanayann āha – bheda ityādi bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭaḥ pratīyata ity atrāpi vacane grāhyaṃ na svalakṣaṇam eva nirdiṣṭam iti naivam boddhavyam ity arthaḥ | kintu bāhyā eva bhedāstenānyāpohalakṣaṇena sāmānyena saṃsṛṣṭā adhyavasīyante na tu gṛhyanta iti tatrāpi boddhavyaṃ |
 anye tu bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya iti pulliṅgena paṭhanti | tatrāyam artho bhedaḥ | sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya ity atrāpi vacane | na svalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ ||
 kimpunaḥ kāraṇantatraiva boddhavyam iti ced āha – samānetyādi | anekasminnekākāraḥ samānākāraḥ | ekasminn anekadharmatvam bhinnākāraḥ | ādiśabdād dharmadharmyākāraparigrahaḥ | na tat svalakṣaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ kathaṃ cana | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatraikasmin svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvānityatvādirūpeṇa bahubhedānāndharmāṇāṃ kim viśiṣṭānām bhedānām vasturūpāṇāntaraikasmin svalakṣaṇe 'yogāt | na hy ekasya vasturūpāṇi bahūni yujyante niraṃśatvāt svalakṣaṇasya ||
 upasaṃharann āha – tadrūpam ityādi | tattasmād rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ sarvato bhinnamasādhāraṇantathā tenāsādhāraṇena tasya svalakṣaṇasya na pratipādikā śrutiḥ śabdo nāsti | kalpanā vāsti | neti prakṛtaṃ | asādhāraṇena svarūpeṇa svalakṣaṇasya grāhako nāstīty arthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sāmānyenaiva śabdasya kalpanāyāś ca vṛttitaḥ ||
 tatpratipādikā na śrutir astīti bruvatā svalakṣaṇe śabdā na niyujyanta ity uktam ataś codayati |
 kimpunar ityādi | saṃketena viṣayīkṛtāḥ saṃketinaḥ | tasmāhuḥ śabdā (ḥ |) vyavahārāya saṃketaḥ smṛtaḥ | tadā vyavahārakāle tatsvalakṣaṇannāsti yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ | (p.194) ekasyāpi svalakṣaṇasya kṣaṇikatvāt kālāntare tenaiva rūpeṇānugamo nāsty akṣaṇikatve vā saṃketaḥ jñānābhāvād eva tadviṣayatvasya kālāntarenugamo nāsti kimuta deśakālabhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu | tena kāraṇena tatra svalakṣaṇe saṃketo na kriyata ity adhyāhāraḥ |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe |
 api nāmeti kathannu nāma | prāg iti saṃketakālakṛtasambandhasya śabdasyeti sambandhaḥ | ekatraikassiman svalakṣaṇe paścād iti vyavahārakāle | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) na yuktam ity āha – tasyetyādi | tasyeti saṃketakāladṛṣṭasya vyavahārāvasthānādiṣu deśakālabhedeṣvanāskandanāt | anugamāt | na hy ekatra dṛṣṭo bhedonyatra sambhavati ||(94)

 vyatiriktam iti vaiśeṣika darśanenāvyatiriktaṃ sāṃkhya darśanena | samānajātīyavyaktivyāpanād vyāpi sāmānyaṃ | tattasmān na vyavahārakālābhāvadoṣaḥ | vyavahārakāle śabdārthasyābhāvadoṣo nāsti | sāmānyasya śabdārthatvāt tasyaivaikatvena saṃketavyavahārakālayor vidyamānatvāt |
 kathaṃ nāmety asminn arthe apiśabdaḥ (|) vyavahārakāle śabdād uccaritād arthakriyākṣamān arthān vijñāya tatsādhanāyārthakriyāsādhanāya kathan nāma pravarttata pumānityanenābhiprāyeṇārtheṣu saṃyojyante 'bhidhāyakāḥ śabdāḥ |
 na khalv ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | phalanir apekṣaṃ kvacit tātparyaṃ vyasanaṃ | yad ayaṃ loko saṃketayan saṃketam akurvāṇaḥ saṃketiterthe śabdān prayuñjāno vā | sarva eveti (p.195) śābdonyo vāvadheyo grahaṇārha ārambho vyavahāraḥ phalārthaḥ | na tu niṣphalaḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇa (|) niṣphalārambhasya prekṣāpūrvakāribhir upekṣaṇītyatvād agrāhyatvāt | tad iti tasmāt | ayaṃ pratipattā kvacidabhimaterthe niyuñjānaḥ saṃketayan phalam evehituṃ yukta iti prayojanam evāpekṣitum arhatiti yāvat | tac ceti phalam iṣṭasyāptilakṣaṇam aniṣṭasya ca tyāgalakṣaṇam iti yathāyogaṃ sambandhaḥ | yeneṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārarūpa eva puruṣārthobhipretastenāyaṃ puruṣas tayor iṣṭayoḥ phalayoḥ sādhanam asādhanaṃ cārtha jñātvā tatreṣṭasādhane pravṛttim aniṣṭasādhane ca nivṛttiṃ kuryāṃ kārayeyam vā parānityanenābhiprāyeṇa śabdānniyuñjīta prayoktā śrotāpi niyoge vādriyeta |
 yuktantāvat paraṃ vyavahārayeyam iti śabdaniyogaḥ | śabdaniyogasya parāṅgatvāt | svayantu pravṛttinivṛttikāraṇe kaḥ śabdasyopayogaḥ |
 satyaṃ (|) kevalaṃ śabdaprayogābhyāsāt svayam api pratipadyamānaḥ kadācid evaṃ pratipadyata ity upanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ | anyathopekṣaṇīyatvād iti phalam antareṇa śabdaniyogasyopekṣaṇīyatvāt | tatraivaṃ vyavasthite nyāye jātir anarthakriyāyogyā 'to na śabdaviṣayā |
 tadvyācaṣṭe na hītyādi | na jātirvāhadohādikaṃ karttuṃ samarthā (|) tataśca vāhadohādyarthino jāticodanā niṣphaleti na tadarthaḥ śabdaprayogaḥ |
 yāpi svapratipattilakṣaṇārthakriyā jāter upavarṇṇyate | na tadartham puruṣaḥ pravartate śabdaprayogād eva tasyāḥ siddhatvāt | jātimātrapratipattyarthaṃ śabdaprayogo bhaviṣyatīti cedata āha – na veptyādi | tādṛśam iti vāhadohādiprakaraṇaṃ niṣphalasya śabdaprayogasyopekṣaṇīyatvād ity uktatvāt | jātau ca vācyāyāṃ satyāṃ | gāmānayety atra vākyena vākyārthapratītiḥ syāt | gotvasya kriyātvenvayābhāvāt | nāpi lakṣitalakṣaṇayā vākyārthapratītir apratīter na hi padebhyasyāvat sāmānyānāṃ pratītiḥ (|) punas tebhyo viśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣebhyaścānvayasyety evaṃ vilambitarūpā vākyārthapratītiḥ | nanv apohepi vācye kathaṃ bāhyārthapratītir nīrūpatvād apohasya (|) na ca jñānāṃśe (p.196) śabdaniveśo yukto 'narthakriyākāritvāt (|)
 sattyaṃ (|) kevalam arthakriyākāritvenaiva pratibhāsanāt tatra śabdaniveśo yukta iti pratipādayiṣyate |
 na tv evam api tasya jñānāñśasya svalakṣaṇatvāt kathaṃ śabdavācyatvaṃ |
 atrecyate | bāhyābhinnastāvat svāṅśo vikalpe pratibhāsata eva (|) na tāvadasya vikalpagrāhyatvāt pratibhāsaḥ sarvātmanā niścayaprasaṅgādanabhyupagamāc ca |
 nāpi vikalpena bāhyātmatayābhyavasāya evāsya grahaṇaṃ yathābasthitena svarūpeṇāgrahaṇād agrahaṇe ca kathantatra pratibhāsaḥ | jñānasvalakṣaṇatve tu svāṃśasya samvitsvabhāvatvāt pratibhāso yuktaḥ | tenāvidyārūpasya svāṃśasya vikalpasya ca yadi jñānasvalakṣaṇatvaṃ neṣyate tadā pratibhāsa eva na syād evam ajñānarūpeṇa ca vikalpena kathaṃ svāṃśasya paricchedosya jñānadharmatvāt | tasmāj jñānasvalakṣaṇatvād eva svāṃśasya vikalpe pratibhāsaḥ sa bāhyābhinno vikalpaviṣayo vyavasthāpyate | tasya samviditarūpasyaiva bāhyābhedena vikalpenādhyavasīyamānatvād ata eva vikalpaḥ sāmānyaviṣaya ucyate na svalakṣaṇaviṣayo 'rthasvāṃśayor ekasyāpi svarūpeṇāgrahaṇāt | tena svāṃśasya jñānasvalakṣaṇasyāpi bāhyātmatayādhyastasya sāmānyarūpatvaṃ | tathā ca vakṣyati |
 jñānarūpatayārthatve sāmānye cet prasajyate |
 tatheṣṭatvād apohyartharūpatvena samānateti | (pra. vā. 3|9)
 tasya ca śabdavācyatvaṃ yuktam eva |
 lakṣitalakṣaṇetyādi paraḥ | satyaṃ na sāmānyam arthakriyākāri kintu vyaktir eva kevalaṃ vyakter aśakyacodanatvāt kāraṇāt sāmānye niyuktaḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyaṃ lakṣayati (|) tena sāmānyena śabdalakṣitena sambandhād vyaktir api lakṣayata iti |
 tadetadapratītikaṃ | na hi gośabdād uccaritād gotvaṃ pratīyate gaur api tu gaur evāvasīyate | na nāmaivantathāpy ucyate | aśabdacoditetyādi |
 yadi nāma jātitadvatossambandhas tathāpy aśabdacodite vyaktiviśeṣe kathaṃ pravartate (|) naiva | daṇḍadaṇḍinossatyapi sambandhe na hi kaścit prekṣāpūrvakārī daṇḍañchindhīty ukte daṇḍaniñchinatti | aśabdacoditatvāt tathā jātau coditāyāṃ vyaktau pravṛttir na yuktety arthaḥ |
 jātau vāhadohādīnām asambhavād aśabdacoditāyām api vyaktau pravṛttir bhaviṣyatīti (p.197) ced āha – nāpītyādi | kevalam arthāntarasambhavi kāryam asambhavinyarthe codayan vaktā pratipādyasyāsambaddhapralāpī syāt | na punastatosamarthāc coditāt samarthe pravṛttir balīvardadohacodanāvat (|) na hi kenacid balīvardandogdhīty ukte tatra dohāsambhavāt | balīvardādanyatra sambhavāyāṃ gavi dogdhuṃ pravartate śrotā (|) kevalantasyaivam bhavatya(saṃ)baddhapralāpyayaṃ vakteti |
 syānmataṃ (|) valīvardacodane sambandhābhāvāt mā bhūt strīgavyāṃ pravṛttiḥ | jātau tu coditāyāṃ tadvyaktau pravṛttir bhaviṣyatīty āha – na cetyādi | arthāntarasya sāmānyasya sambandhasyāpi codanenārthānta(ra)syeti vyakteḥ |
 nanv aśabdacodite saty api sambandha ityādinokta evāyam arthaḥ |
 satyam (|) adhikavidhānārthan tu punaḥ prastāvaḥ | tad eva pūrvapakṣayati | aniyatetyādi | aniyataḥ sambandho yasya daṇḍasya sa tathoktaḥ | tathā hi daṇḍinamantareṇāpi daṇḍe vidyate tadbhāvastasmāt | tatreti daṇḍini | neti ced iti daṇḍe codite pravṛttir na bhavatīty arthaḥ | jātau tu coditāyāṃ niyatasambandhād vyaktau pratītir bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
 tad ityādi siddhāntavādī | tad ity aniyatasambaddhatvaṃ tulyaṃ jātāv api |
 katham iti ced āha – vyaktīnām ityādi | syād etad (|) yathā bhrātrādiśabdāḥ svārtham abhidadhānā dvitīyam ākṣipanti tathā jātiśabdā ity ata āha – bhrātrādiśabdāstv ityādi | ādiśabdāt putrādiśabdāḥ | sambandhiśabdavācyatvāt sambandhyantarāpekṣaiva teṣāṃ vyavasthāpitatvād iti yāvat | ākṣipeyuḥ param iti dvitīyaṃ bhrātrādikaṃ | ākṣepaś ca dvitīyasambandhākāravikalpajananaṃ | na tūpasthāpanam eva vinaṣṭepi sambandhini vikalpotpatteḥ | na tathepi vaidharmyakathanaṃ | yadi sambandhivācinyaḥ syustadāyandoṣaḥ syād ity āha – apetetyādi | apetā vinaṣṭā vyaktayas sambandhitvena yāsāṃ pāṇḍavādi jātīnāntāsām api tacchutibhyo jātivācakebhyaḥ śabdebhyo nityam apetavyaktisambandhitvenāpy anugamaprasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ hy apetavyaktisambandhitvena tāsām anugamo yady apetānām api vyaktīnām anugamaḥ syāt | yad vā jātīnāṃ sambandhibhyo yā apetā vyaktayastāsāṃ tacchabdebhyo nityam anugamanaprasaṅgāt |
 (p.198) sarvadetyādi paraḥ | sarvadeti vyaktyapāyānapāyakālayos tatsambandhayogyatāpratīter iṣṭam eva vyaktyanugamanam iti cet | etatkathayati (|) yathā bhrātrādiśabdāḥ svārtham abhidadhānāḥ sambandhinam aviśeṣaṇāt kṣipanti tathā jātiśabdā apīti |
 uttaram āha – sarvadeti | sarvadeti vyaktyapāyā'napāyakālayor gośabdād apravṛttir vāhadodādiyogye vyaktiviśeṣe | kiṅkāraṇaṃ iti ced āha – sahitetyādi | saptamīdvivicanam etat | jāter vyaktisahitāsahitāvasthayor viśeṣeṇārthakriyākṣam asya viśeṣasyānākṣepāt | etad uktam bhavati | yathā 'tītānāgatavyakteḥ śabdārtharūpatayā jātiśabdenākṣepas tathā varttamānāyā vyakter abhyatra śabdārtharūpatayā pratibhāsanasyāviśeṣaṇād iti |
 vyaktisambandhinyā jāteś codanād vyaktau pratītir na prāpnotīty ayam adoṣa iti cet ||
 bhavatv evaṃ kintu sāpi vyaktis tadviśeṣaṇatvena jātiviśeṣaṇatvena jāticodanāyām ākṣiptaiveti na jātiḥ kevalābhidheyā | kintu tadvānabhidheyaḥ syād iti pakṣāntaraparigrahaḥ syāt | tatra cānantaram eva doṣam vakṣyāma ity ākūtaṃ || (95?)

 jātitadvatoḥ sambandhamabhyupagamyaitaduktaṃ (|) sambandha eva tu nāstīty āha – na cetyādi | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyonyam parasparamajanyajanakatvenānupakārāt | tata iti sambandhābhāvāj jāticodanayā vyakter lakṣaṇam apy uktaṃ | phalābhāvād ity arthakriyāyā abhāvāt |
 vyaktyabhinnasāmānyavādinopi pratyakṣavacchābde jñāne vyaktipratibhāsaḥ syāt | bhedāṃśena tu tasyāpi lakṣaṇam ayuktaṃ | evam ityādinā pakṣāntaramāśaṅkate | tadvāniti jātimān | alam iti samarthaḥ | tatreti tadvati | sa ceti siddhāntavādī |
 ayaiva vyākhyānaṃ sa ca śabda ityādi | tatreti vyaktau kimanyena sāmānyena (p.199) vyavadhinā vyavadhāyakena kalpitena |
 ānantyāc ceti paraḥ |
 idamānantyaṃ samam ity uttaraṃ |
 etad eva vyācaṣṭe | syād etad ityādinā | tadvatyapīti jātimatyapi | yasmāj jātyādiviśiṣṭāḥ satyo vyaktaya eva vaktavyā iti hetor acaśyantatreti vyaktiṣu śabdasya sambandhaḥ karaṇīyaḥ (|) kasmād (|) akṛtasambandhasyānabhidhānāt | karttari ṣaṣṭhī | kṛtaḥ sambandho yasya śabdasya | tenānabhidhānād ity arthaḥ | karmaṇi vā ṣaṣṭhī | akṛtasambandhasya vārthasya śabdenānabhidhānāt | sa ceti sambandhaḥ | tadvatā saha na śakyaṃ karttumānantyāt | tasmād ayuktoyampakṣaḥ |
 tatsambandhini | vyaktisambandhini sāmānye śabdasya sambandhakaraṇādvetos tatrāpi jātisambandhibhyāṃ vyaktau sambandhaḥ kṛta eveti cet |
 uktam atrottaraṃ (|) sāmānyasya saty api sambandhe ekatra jātau kṛtāt saṃketādanyatra vyaktāvapratītir na ca jātitadvatoḥ sambandhostīty etaccoktaṃ | na hi saty api sambandhe daṇḍaśabdād daṇḍini pratipattiḥ (|) tathā na ca jātitadvatoḥ kaścit sambandhostīti sampratyuktatvāt || (96)

 evantāvat sarvabhāvā ityādinā vārtikakāraḥ svābhimataṃ vidhiśabdaliṅgaviṣayamākhyāya saṃprati yenābhiprāyeṇācārya dignāgena bhedalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyamuktantaddarśayituṃ (p.200) pṛcchati | api cetyādi evammanyate | yathā gośabdād apratīyamāne gotve gośabdaḥ saṃketyate tathā | tatkāriṇāṃ vivakṣitārthakriyākāriṇām atatkāribhyo ye vivakṣitārthakriyākāriṇo na bhavanti tebhyo yo bhedas tena sāmānyaṃ sarveṣān tatkāriṇām atatkāribhyo bhinnatvād atas tasminbhedasāmye anyāpohalakṣaṇe kinna kṛtaḥ kasmāt saṃketo na kṛta iti pṛcchati paraṃ | etad vāha – yām arthakriyām ityādi | dāhapākādilakṣaṇasyārthasya kriyāṃ niṣpattim adhikṛtyābhipretyāyaṃ puruṣortheṣv abhipretārthakriyākāriṣa śabdānniyuṅkte prayuṅkte | tatkāriṇām abhipretārthakriyākāriṇām anyebhyo 'tatkāribhyo bhedāt kāraṇāt tatkāriṇaḥ sarvaṃvijātīyavyāvṛttā abhinnā bhavati | tata eṣām arthānān tatraivābheda iti anyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇe kinna śabdaḥ prayujyate | vyāvṛttiviśiṣṭasyāpi samketavaśāt pratītiḥ syād iti praśnābhiprāyaḥ |
 tadvad ityādi | jātimatpakṣe yo doṣa ācārya dignāgenokta stadvato nāsvatantrarvād ityādinā yastadvaddoṣas tasya sāmyāt tasya doṣasyāvatārād bhedenyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇe śabdo na niyujyate | asatvayandoṣa ity abhyupagacchati | naivāyandoṣostīti pratipāditam abhyugamya tvevam uktaṃ | jātiralamparā | jātistvanyā na yuktety arthaḥ |
 syād ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | anyasmād atatkāriṇo vyāvṛttepi vastuni śabdārthebhyupagamyamāne | tadvata iti vyāvṛttimataḥ | na tadvatpakṣād asya vyāvṛttimatpakṣasya viśeṣaḥ | etad evāha – ko hītyādi | tvayā vyāvṛttir ity uktaṃ pareṇa jātir ityādi | atra vācye ko viśeṣaḥ (|) naiva kaścid anyatra śabdabhedāt ||
 astu nāmeti siddhāntavādī | jātir anyeti vastubhūtā | kimpunas tulye doṣe vyāvṛttir aṅgīkriyate na vastubhūtā jātir ity āha – jātim api hītyādi | tadabhāva (p.201) iti vyāvṛttyabhāve asyā apīti vastubhūtāyā jāteḥ | bhāvānāṃ bhedābhāve satyanekārthasamavetarūpāyā jāter abhāvāt | na ca jātyābhedaḥ kriyata ity uktaṃ | tasmād avaśyam bhedobhyupagantavyaḥ (|) sa caikasmād atatkāryā(t?) bhedas tadanyeṣāntasmād atatkāryād anyeṣāntatkāryāṇām abhedas tadviṣiṣṭeṣv abhedaviśiṣṭeṣu pratipattir astu | pratipattyālambantvāt pratipattir ity uktaḥ | na punaḥ sa eva pratipattiḥ | karaṇasādhano vā pratipattiśabdaḥ pratipadyante 'nayā vyāvṛttyā karaṇabhūtayā bhāvāniti kṛtvā |
 svartheti | yadi vyāvṛttiviśiṣṭo jātiviśiṣṭo vārtho vācyas tadvatpakṣodito yathānantyādidoṣastatparihārasya karttum aśakyatvāt | tulyaś ceddoṣo jātir eva kasmān nābhyupagamyata iti ced āha – arthāntaretyādi | arthāntaram vastubhūtā jātiḥ | bhinneṣv abhinnapratyayajananaṃ jāteḥ prayojanam iti ced āha – tadarthasyeti jātisādhyasya | anyenetyatatkāryavyāvṛttilakṣaṇenābhedena (|) jātyāpi hi sorthaḥ sādhyata iti kasmāj jātityāge vyāvṛttyabhyupagama ityata āha – tad ityādi | tadabhyupagamasyeti vyāvṛttyabhyupagamasya (|) tadanabhyupagame hi jātikalpanaiva na syād ity uktaṃ || (97)

 adhunā śabdenāvaśyaṃ vyāvṛttiś codanīyetyata āha – api cetyādi | vivakṣitādarthād anyas tasya parihāreṇa śrotā pravartateti kṛtvā dhvanirucyate pratipādakena | cakāra evaśabdasyārthe bhinnakramaś ca tadanyaparihāreṇety asyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | teneti dhvaninā | tebhya ity anabhimatebhyas tasyābhimatasyārthasyā vyavacchede 'vyavacchedenābhidhīyamāna ity arthaḥ (|) kathaṃ śrotā pravartteteti |
 śabdam ityādinaitad eva vyācaṣṭe | eṣa vaktārtheṣv abhimatārthakriyākāriṣv aniṣṭaparihāreṇānabhimatārthavyavacchedena pravartteta kathaṃ nāma śrotety anenābhiprāyeṇa prayuñkte |
 yadi śabdenānyavyavacchedo na codyeta tadā tatra pratyāyyābhimate 'nyatra cety anabhimate (p.202) pravṛttir anujñātā bhavati | tasyāṃ ca satyāntasyābhimatasyārthasya yannāma abhidhānantasya grahaṇavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | tathā hyānayety ukte vastumātramākṣiptantatrānabhimatavyavacchedāyāgniśabdaḥ prayujyate 'gnimānayeti | yadi tu tasminnapi prayukte 'nagyānayanaṃ na vyavacchinnantadāgniśabdenoccāritena na kiṃcit prayojanaṃ | ānayetyanenāpyanānayanasya pratikṣepādānayanamanānayanaṃ cānujñātaṃ syād ataḥ pravṛttinivṛttyānujñāyāṃ ca satyāntannāmagrahaṇavaiyarthyaprasaṅgād iti pūrveṇaiva sambandhaḥ | evaṃ ekasyābhimatasyāgnyāder ekasya cānayanādilakṣaṇasyānuṣṭhānasya yā codanā tasyā anādarādavacanam eva śabdānāṃ syāt | anyavyāvṛttyanabhidhāne sati |
 atha vā pravṛttinivṛttyanujñāyām iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhanīyaṃ | yathoktavidhinā pravṛttinivṛttyanujñāyāṃ caikacodanā 'nādarāt | ekasya pravṛttilakṣaṇasya nivṛttilakṣaṇasya vā vyāpārasya codanā 'nādarād iti (|) śeṣaṃ pūrvavad vyākhyeyaṃ |
 evaṃ ca śabdavyavahārocchedaḥ syān na caivantasmād avaśyam ityādi | sa cety anyavyavacchedaḥ | tadanyeṣv iti tasmād atatkāryād anyeṣv ekakāryeṣv abhinnaḥ | sarveṣām atatkāryād vyāvṛttatvāt | iti kṛtvānekārthavyāvṛttitvaṃ jātidharmopy asti vyavacchedasya | tam iti vyavacchedaṅkimviśiṣṭaṃ niyatam abhyupagamo yasya sa tathā | tadanabhyupagame jāter abhāvaprasaṅgāt | niyataṃ codanam abhidhānaṃ yasya tattathā | tadacodane śabdaprayogasya naiṣphalyaṃ syāt | vyaktiṣu buddhiśabdayor anugamalakṣaṇo jātyarthas tasya prasā(dha)naṃ prasādhyate 'neneti kṛtvā | evaṃ bhūtaṃ vyavacchedaṃ parityajyārthāntarasya sāmānyasya kalpanaṃ kevalam anarthanirbandha evāvastvabhiniveṣa eva kevalaṃ nānyat kiñcita kāraṇam astīty arthaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | (|) yathā kalpanaṃ nityavyāpitādyakārair asya sāmānyasyāyogād ity anyavyāvṛttyabhidhāne 'yam abhiprāya ācārya dignāgasya || (98)

 netyādi paraḥ | na vai na kriyata eva śabdena vyavacchedaḥ kintu kriyata eva | kimarthantarhi jātir uktetyata āha – pravṛttītyādi arthakriyārthino hi yā pravrttis tasyā viṣayo jātiḥ | taṃ kathayadbhir asmābhir jātir uktā |
 vyavacchedetyādi siddhāntavādī | asya śabdasyābhidheyo vyavacchedosti cet | (p.203) asya vā jātimato vyavacchedaḥ śabdavācyosti cet | nanv etāvadanyavyavacchedeneṣṭapravarttanaṃ prayojanaṃ śabdānām iti kṛtvā | tatreti vyavacchedeneṣṭapravarttane karttavye | tatra vā pravṛttiviṣaye kiṃ sāmānyenāpareṇa vaḥ prayojanaṃ ||
 nanv ityādi paraḥ | uktam ity ācāryaḥ | tathā hīty ayuktatvapratipādanaṃ | seti jātiḥ | arthakriyāṃ pratyasāmarthyān na pravṛttiyogyā jātiḥ | nāpi gośabdāj jātiḥ pratīyate | niveditam etad iti tatrānarthakriyāyogyā jātir iti (pra. sa.) tyādinā | jātidvāreṇa ca dravye 'thekriyāsamarthe puruṣasya pravṛttir bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – taddvāreṇetyādi | aśabdacodite saty api sambandhe kathaṃ pravarttertetyādinā | jātidvāreṇa tadvān eva codyata iti ced āha – tadvaccodana ityādi | vyavadhānam uktam iti liṅgapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | sāmānyena tatra vyavadhānam ity uktaṃ | sa ca sākṣān na yojyate kasmāt (|) kintatrānyena vyavadhānetyādinā |
 syānmataṃ (|) na jātiḥ kevalā vyaktir vā śabdāśrayāḥ pravṛtter āsrayaḥ kevalāyā jātarerthakriyāyāmasāmarthyaṃ | vyakteś ca kevalāyā aśakyacodanatvāt | tasmāj jātitadvantau sahitau pravṛttiviṣayas tayor eva samastayoḥ śabdārthatvam ity ata āha – jātitadvator ityādi | pravṛttiviṣayatva iti śabdāśrayāyāḥ pravṛtter viṣayatvebhyupagamyamāne | vyāvṛttitadvantau kinneṣyete pravṛttiviṣayatvenety adhyāhāraḥ | pramāṇasiddhau hi vyāvṛttitadvantāv iti bhāvaḥ | vyāvṛtteḥ śabdabhūtāyāḥ buddhiparikalpatatvād avastutvamato vāhadohādyarthakriyāṃ pratyasādhanatvān na pravṛttiviṣayatvam iti cet | tadetadasādhanatvaṃ jātes tulyaṃ sāpi vāhadohādāvasamarthā |
 tadvad iti jātimatorthakriyāsādhanāt pravṛttyabhāvalakṣaṇo doṣo na bhavatīti cet |
 (p.204) tulyam ityādi siddhāntavādī | tad iti arthakriyāsādhanatvaṃ |
 evantāvatpratibandhakanyāyenāvidyamānāyā api vyāvṛtteḥ sadbhāvam abhyupagamya śabdārthatvam uktam ācāryadignāgeneti vyākhyāya punar vidhim eva śabdārtham āha – avasrugrāho cetyādi | yady avastuviṣayaḥ katham arthakriyārthinaṃ puruṣaṃ pravṛttayatīti ced āha – sa vibhrametyādi | sa iti śābdapratyayaḥ | vibhramavaśāt puruṣaṃ pravṛttayati | vibhrama eva katham ity āha (|) akārakepi svapratibhāserthakriyāyogyatvāt kārako bāhyorthas tadadhyavasāyī yataḥ | kathan tarhyanumānāder vastusāmvāda ity ata āha – vastusamvāda ityādi | tasmin sādhye pratibandhe sati (|) pratibandha eva kutaḥ | vastūtpattyā sādhyavastūtpattyā hetubhūtayā anyathetyasati pratibandhe | naivāsti samvādaḥ śabdādeḥ pratyayasya | vastūtpatter abhrāntir iti cet | syād etad yadi vastunaś cotpadyate vastusamvādi śābdādijñānam iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhim manyate | naitad evaṃ | saty api vastūtpattāvatatpratibhāsino vasturūpāpratibhāsinastadadhyavasāyād vastvadhyavasāyād bhrāntitatvaṃ | tato vasturūpotpattibhrāntyor virodhābhāvāt sandigdhavyatir ekitā hetor iti bhāvaḥ | maṇiprabhāyām maṇibhrāntir maṇiṃ samvādayatyeva | vyabhicāram eva samarthayan nāha – vitathetyādi | etad āha(|) yadi bhrānteḥ samvādasya ca virodhaḥ syāt tadā bhrānter avastusamvādanaṃ sādhyaṃ pratyavyabhicāraḥ syāt | sa ca nāsti | yasmād vitathapratibhāso bhrāntilakṣaṇaṃ na visamvādane | tannāntaroyakatayeti vastunāntarīyakatayā tata utpatter iti yāvat | ayaṃ samvādo na pratibhāsāpekṣī | na vastugatam pratibhāsam apekṣate | vastupratibaddhatvenaivātatpratibhāsasyāpi samvādāt |
 tasmāt sthitam etad vitathapratibhāsyapi śābdaḥ pratyayaḥ sati vastupratibandhe tasya samvādaka iti |
 (p.205) atha punaryathāvastveva śābdaḥ pratyaya iṣyate | tadā vastuni bāhye | yathābhāvaṃ yathāvastu arpitacetasaḥ āropitajñānasya śabdalādyanyathā vastūtpannajñānasyeti yāvat | evaṃ pravṛttāvabhyupagamyamānāyāntasya śābdasya jñānasya sāmānyaṃ grāhyameṣṭavyaṃ svalakṣaṇe śabdena codanābhāvāt (|) tasya ca grāhyasya sāmānyasyānarthakriyāyogyatvād vetor apravṛttis tasmin vikalpavijñānaviṣaye sāmānye | anyatreti sāmānyādanyatra vyaktāvaśabdacoditāyām api pravṛttāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | gośabdādaśvavyaktāv api pravṛttiḥ syād gotvasāmānyasyāśvavyakteś ca sambandhābhāvānnaivam iti cennāśabdacodite saty api sambandhe pravṛttyayogād ityādyuktaṃ |
 atha na kevalā śabdena coditeti kintu tadvān iti (|) tadā tadvadgrahaṇe cābhyupagamyamāne sāmānyavaiyarthyādayaḥ proktāḥ | vyaktiṣv eva sākṣācchabdo niyujyatāṃ kiṃ sāmānyeneti sāmānyaivayarthyam uktaṃ | ādiśabdād ānantyādidoṣaparigrahaḥ | jātir eva śabdena codyate | sā tu jātir vyaktisamavetatvān na śakyate kevalā gṛhītum ato vyaktirūpeṇaikībhūtā gṛhyate (|) tadevāśaṅkate | jātītyādi | śilaṣṭābhāseti svasāmānyalakṣaṇābhyāṃ sambhinnābhāsā buddhir arthakriyākāriṇyām vyaktau pravarttayatīti cet | tadā na jātir na tadvān | svena rūpeṇa gṛhyata itvadhyāhāraḥ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) ekasyāpi sāmānyasya vā yā svabhāvasthitirasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ tasya śilaṣṭābhāsayā bhrāntayā buddhyā | agrahaṇāt | tataś ca bhrāntāyā buddheḥ pravṛttyabhyupagamagāt paravāda evānyāpohavādidarśanam eva || (99)

 evam ityādi paraḥ | anvayina ity anekavyaktigamyasya sāmānyasya |
 naiṣa doṣa iti siddhāntavādī | ādiśabdād udakāharaṇāntāntām bhedepi parasparavyāvṛttatvepi vastudharmatayā tāṃ tāṃ jñānādikāṃ sadṛśīm arthakriyāṃ kurvato dṛṣṭvā tadanyebhyotatkāryebhyo yo viśleṣo vicchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa viṣayo yeṣāṃ dhvanīnāntair dhvanibhir (p.206) antarjalparūpaiḥ saha saṃyojyārthān sa evāyam iti kuryād api pumān | api śabdo bhinnakramonyadarśanapīty arthaḥ | pūrvadṛṣṭād arthādanyasya vilakṣaṇasya darśanepi sadṛśārthakriyākāritvena vipralambhādekatvamāropya pratyabhijñānaṃ kuryād iti samudāyārthaḥ |
 kathaṃ punar bhinnā abhinnām arthakriyāṃ kurvantīty ata āha – uktam etad ityādi |
 ekapratyavamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhane (1|75)
 ityādinā prāguktatvāt | ekām iti sadṛśīnteṣv iti bhinneṣv anyeṣu paśyataḥ puṃsaḥ | anyebhya ity atatkāribhyo vyāvarttamānā bhāvā vastudharmatayaiva vastus bhāvenaiva | tad evedam ity evam ākāraṃ mithyāpratyayaṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭam ity āha – tad ityādi tebhyo 'tatkāryebhyo yā vyāvṛttir ekārthakriyākāriṇām arthānāṃ sā viṣayo yasya dhvanes tena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ saṃsaktaṃ sābhilāpam iti yāvat |
 yadi vastudharmatayā janayanti kinna sarvadety āha – svānubhavetyādi | teṣām bhāvānāṃ yaḥ svonubhavaḥ pūrvam utpannas tena yā pratyabhijñānotpattaye vāsanā śaktilakṣaṇāditā | tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādanaṃ pratyābhimukhyantasyāś ca prabodhaḥ punas tajjātīyapadārthānubhavāt | evaṃ lakṣaṇaś ca prabodho na sarvakālam ato na sadā pratyabhijñānasambhava iti | saṃsṛṣṭabhedam iti pūrvapaścād dṛṣṭayor vyaktyor bhedaḥ saṃsṛṣṭa ekīkṛto yena sa tathā | anyatheti yady ekakāryatvena sādṛśyenaikatvamāropya bhinneṣv api bhrāntaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ neṣyate (|) api tvekasāmānyayogāt tadā na bhedasaṃsargavatī | bhedānāṃ saṃsarga ekarūpatāpādanantadvatī buddhir na syāt | bahuṣv ekarūpā buddhir na syād ity arthaḥ |
 na hyekena daṇḍena yuktā api daṇdina ekatvena gṛhyante | tad evāha (|) yathā daṇḍiṣvati | na hīty etad eva vyanakti | tatreti daṇḍiṣu | anyatreti ekasmād daṇḍinonyasmin daṇḍini | taddaṇḍadravyaṃ yad ekadaṇḍini dṛṣṭantadiha dvitīye daṇḍinīty evaṃ syāt | na tu taddvāreṇa sa evāyandaṇḍīti | yadvā yathā bahuṣvekadaṇḍayogāt | pratyekam ayam api daṇḍas tathā sa evāyandaṇḍa iti na bhavati pratītistadvat | vyaktīnām (p.207) apy ekasāmānyayogān na sa evāyam iti pratītiḥ syād api tu tadiheti |
