 bhavatv evam iti ced āha – naivam ityādi | tad ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | ekam iti samānamanekatra vyaktiṣu paśyato 'pi puṃso bhedasaṃsargavat | bhedānāṃ saṃsarga ekākāratā tadvajjñānaṃ na yuktaṃ | anyāpohavādinastvayamadoṣa ity āha – vibhrametyādi | bhrāntisāmarthyād ity arthaḥ | tathety ekarūpatayā vastubhūtam ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ pratyabhijñānasya nimittantasyābhāvād vibhramo na yuktam iti cet | ta eveti vyāvṛttā bhāvās tasya jñānāderekasyārthasya kāriṇaḥ karaṇaśīlāḥ | anubhava eva dvāraṃ hetus tena prakṛtyā svabhāvena vibhramaphalāyā bhrāntiphalāyā hetutvānnimittaṃ |
 nanu marīcikādiṣu jalādibhrāṃteḥ sādṛśyam antareṇotpattāv atiprasaṅgaḥ | sādṛśyaṃ ced iṣyate sāmānyam api kasmān neṣyata ity āha – marīcikādiṣv ityādi | prathamenādiśabdena rajvādiparigrahaḥ | dvitīyena sarpādibhrānteḥ | tāv eveti jalamarīcikārūpau bhāvo abhinnākārasya tad evedaṃ jalam ity evaṃ rūpam parāmarśapratyayasya nimittabhūto yonubhavas tasya janakau kāraṇaṃ bhinnāv api |
 etad uktam bhavaty asadṛśānāntāvanna sādṛśyam asti | sadṛśānām api sadṛśam eva svarūpaṃ bhrāntinimittaṃ | na tu sādṛśyaṃ | tathā hi jalānubhavajñānantāva(t)jalākāraparāmarśavāsanāmādhatte | sā ca vāsanā yathā punar jalasvalakĪṇānubhavena prabodhyate | tathā marīcikākhyapadārthānubhavenāpi prakṛtyā | tasya tatsvabhāvatvāt | tato yathā jalānubhavāj jalākāraparāmarśapratyaya ucyate | tathā marīcikānubhavād api ataś ca tai jalamarīcikākhyau bhāvānubhavadvāreṇa jalabhrānter nimittaṃ bhavataḥ | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ | tulyepyajalarūpatve marīcikāsvarūpasya svahetubhya eva sādṛśyotpannatvān na tu sādṛśyayogāt sadṛśo bhavatīti sāmānyaprastāve nyāyasyoktatvāt |
 evantāvad udyotakarādimataṃ nirākṛtya mīmāṃsakamataṃ nirākarttum āha – na hītyādi | tathā hi jalajñāne dvayaṃ pratibhāsate jalasāmānyantasya ca deśādisambandhitvantato (p.208) neti bādhake pratyaye na deśādisambandhitvaṃ bādhyate na jalasāmānyamato jalajñānaṃ sāmānyālambanam evety ata ucyate | na tatra marīcikāsu anyad eveti bhinnaṃ kiṃcit sāmānyaṃ jalasāmānyantatheti jalarūpeṇa | sattve vā jalasāmānyasyābhyupagamyamāne vastubhūtasāmānyagrāhitvena sadarthagrahiṇī buddhiḥ |
 atha syād (|) anyadeśādyavasthitajalasāmānyālambikaiva jalabuddhir na bhrāntistad uktaṃ (|)
 sarvatrālambanaṃ bāhyaṃ deśakālānyathātmakam iti |1.

 kathantarhi marīcikāyāṃ jalapratītir bhrāntiranyadeśādyavasthitasya jalasāmānyasya tatra samāropād iti cet | etad vāha – abhūtetyādi | marīcikāsvavidyamānasya jalākārasya samāropād bhrāntiḥ |
 netyādi siddhāntavādī | tatsāmānyagrāhiṇī anyadeśāvadthitajalasāmānyagrāhiṇī sā jalabuddhir na bhavati | kasmād ity āha – yam eva cetyādi | yam evākāram ity abhūtaṃ jalākāram iyaṃ jalabuddhis tatra marīcikāsvāropayati | āropyamāṇasyāpi kasmād viṣayatvam ity ata āha – aviṣayīkṛtasyetyādi | etad āha (|) vikalpotoattikāle yatsāmānyaṃ na viṣayīkṛtantena na tasya samāropaḥ | ākārāntaravat | na hyākārāntaramagnyādi tatra samāropyate tasya tadānīmaviṣayatvāt | yaś cākāro bāhyābhedenāropyate tasyaiva viṣayatvena pratibhāsanaṃ | sa cety āropyamāṇo jalākāras tatra marīcikāsu nāsti bādhyamānatvād ato sāmānyaṃ jalajñānanna vidyate sāmānyamasyeti kṛtvā | tathā marīcikāvat sattyajaleṣv api jalākārādhyāropakaṃ jalajñānamasāmānyaṃ |
 satītyādi paraḥ | anyad eva jalasāmānyaṃ sati tasya grahe tadāropo jalāropaḥ nānyathā (|) yadi jalasāmānyamantareṇa satyajale jalāropaḥ syāt tadātiprasaṅgaḥ agnyādāvapi jalāropaḥ syāt |
 (p.209) satīti siddhāntavādī | ekaṃ kāryaṃ pānāvagāhanādi tatkaraṇaśīlānāṃ sattyajalānāṃ grahe sati kinneṣyate jalāropaḥ | sāmānyamantareṇa bhinnānām ekakāryakaraṇaśaktir eva nāstīti ced āha – avaśyaṃ cetyādi | pratipāditaṃ caitad (|)
 ekapratyavamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhana (3|72)
 ity atrāntare |
 anye tu na hi tatrānyad eva kiṃcit sāmānyam astītyādikaṃ granthaṃ sāmānyaśabdaṃ sādṛśyārthaṃ kṛtvā vyācakṣate | tatteṣāṃ vyākhyānannātiśliṣṭaṃ yattathā pratīyata ityāder avācakatvāt | na hi sādṛśyaṃ jalarūpatayā pratīyata iti |
 tata ityekakāraṇaśakteḥ | ta eveti yathoktaśaktiṣu yuktā vyaktaya eva na tu sāmānyaṃ | anyebhya ity atatkāryebhyaḥ | tādṛśam ity ekākāraṃ | yathābhāvam iti padārthānativṛttāvanvayībhāvaḥ | yathā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyavirahi sthitaṃ | tadativṛttyā kinna pratyeti vikalpapratyayaḥ (|) kasmāt tatrābhūtaṃ sāmānyamāropayati | yathābhāvam ity asyaivārthosaṃsṛṣṭetyādi | asaṃsṛṣṭa ekarūpatāmanāpannaḥ | bhedaḥ parasparaḥ viśeṣo yasya bhāvasya sa tathā | aśaktir eṣā | yathāvasthitagrahaṇaṃprati vikalpānāṃ kasmāt avidyāprabhavāt | bhūtārthagrahaṇaṃ vidyā | tadvirodhād vikalpa evāvidyā | prabhāva eva prabhavaśabdenoktaḥ | vikalpasāmarthyād ity arthaḥ | yathāsthitavastvagrahaṇaṃ hi vikalpasya svabhāvaḥ | prakṛtyā bhrāntatvāt tasya vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ vināśa eva vikalpasya vibhramo na yukta iti ced āha – na cetyādi | vikalpasvarūpam evātrāntaro viplava uktaḥ | vikalpasyaiva tatsvarūpaṃ yenāsau bāhyasādharmyamanapekṣya vibhramo bhavatīty arthaḥ | keśādyākārā bhrāntiḥ keśādivibhramaḥ (|) sa yathā bāhyārthānapekṣaḥ sannabhūtākāropagrahaṇamāntaram viplavamāśritya bhrānto bhavati | tadvad vikalpopyabhūtasāmānyākāragrahaṇād ity ayam atrārthobhipretaḥ | bhrāntibījamāntaro viplavas tasmād utpatter ity ayantāvadarthotra (p.210) nābhipretaḥ | etac cottar atra vyaktīkariṣyate |
 codakastvavidyāprabhavād ity atrāvidyāśabdenāprahīṇāvaraṇasantatau dvayanirbhāsabījam evoktaṃ | tataś codbhava utpattis tathā āntaropi viplavastadaiva bījam evaṃ bhūtaṃ cāvidyodbhavatvaṃ sarvavijñānānām astīty ata āha – avidyodbhavād viplavatva ityādi | avidyāyā udbhavād utpādād viplavatve bhrāntatve cakṣurvijñānādiṣvapi viplavaprasaṅgaḥ | netyādinā svābhiprāyam āha – tasyā ity avidyāyāḥ sāmānyākārāropakaṃ jñānam vikalpas tallakṣaṇatvāt | tadāha – vikalpa eva hītyādi | sety avidyā | svabhāveti prakrtyā | naivam ityādinā prasaṅgaṃ pariharati | teṣāṃ svalakṣaṇākāratvenāvikalpakatvāt | tasmān na tāni vikalpavat svabhāvena viparyastāni indriyādivikāreṇa tu keṣāṃcid bhavati bhrāntatā |
 bāhyārthanayenoktādhunāntarjñeyanayenāha – na cetyādi | etad āha – bhavatunāma yādṛśaścodyākāreṇāvidyāśabdasyārthaḥ kalpitas tathāpyatiprasaṅgadoṣo nāstīṣṭatvād iti | na vā teṣv api cakṣurādijñāneṣveṣa bhrāntatvadoṣas teṣām api viplutatvāt | tad evāha – advayānām ityādi | cakṣurādivijñānānāmātmasamvedanamevādvayannātra dvayam astīti kṛtvā | tathā hi vijñānasamānakālamvicchannapratibhāsi | grāhyatvenābhimataṃ nīlādi | ekānekavicārākṣamatayā na paramārthaṃ sat | tadapekṣayā ca yadvijñānasya grāhakatvaṃ karttṛrūpantadapyasat | na tu samvedanantasya pratyakṣatvāt | bhrāntagrāhakākārāvyatiriktatvātsvasamvitter api bhrāntatvam iti cen na tasyāḥ svarūpeṇāsattve pratibhāsa eva na syācchaśaviṣāṇavat | bhrānter api ca svarūpeṇa sattyatvam anyathā bhrāntitvāyogāt | svarūpavijñānaikarūpaṃ jñānañ ca svasamvidrūpam eveti kathan na ( saṃvitteḥ sattyatvaṃ | yadvā dvayapratibhāso bhrāntir bhrāntiś ca tattvādhiṣṭhānā | dvicandrādibhrāntivat | tattvaṃ ca dvayaviparītamadvayantac ca svasamvidrūpam eva (|) na tu dvayābhāvatāsyāsattvād iti kathaṃ na sā samvitteḥ.........tadevaṃ yathoktacodya..............................yāni ca ................syād grāhyagrāhakarūpeṇa pratibhāsanāt tāny api bhrāntānoti ) vakṣyāmaḥ tṛtīye paricchede (p.211) (|) ata eva dvayanirbhāsavatāṃ svasaṃvitteḥ pratyakṣatvepi na tattvadarśitvaṃ vyavasthāpyate pramāṇāpramāṇavibhāgaḥ | katham iti ced āha – sarveṣām ityādi | viplavo bhrāntatvaṃ | tadābhāsaḥ | pramāṇābhāsaḥ | tayor vyavasthāvibhāgaḥ | āśrayo bhrāntibījamālayavijñānantasya parāvṛttirāvaraṇavigamaḥ | āṅ maryādāyām (|) āśrayaparāvṛtteḥ sarvadārthakriyāyogyābhimatasamvādanāt prāmāṇyavastheti sambandhaḥ | arthakriyā dāhapākādinirbhāsavijñaptilakṣaṇā | tasyāṃ yogyaṃ ca tadabhimataṃ puruṣasyeṣṭatvāt | tasya samvādanād iti vigrahaḥ | abhimatasyeva samvādanād ity avadhāraṇaṃ na punas samvādanād eveti pramāṇād api kadācit pratyayavaikalyena samvādāsambhavāt | arthakriyāyogyābhimatasamvādanād ity upalakṣaṇaṃ (|) tathābhimatāsamvādanād ity api draṣṭavyaṃ |
evaṃ hi pramāṇābhāsavyavasthāyāḥ kāraṇam uktambhavet | vijñānavāde bāhyābhāvāt katham arthakriyāyogyābhimatasamvādanaṃ | nāyandoṣognirjalanirbhrāsasyaiva jñānasya dāhapākādinirbhāsajñānotpādanasamarthasya yogyaśabdenābhidhānāt | evantāvaccakṣurādivijñānasya dhūmādliṅgajanyasya cāgnyādinirbhāsinaḥ pramāṇavyavasthoktā | kṛtakādiliṅgajanyasya tvanātmādijñānasyāha – mithyetyādi | sāmānyākārāropapravṛttatvād anātmādijñānasya mithyātvam | tathāpi praśamānukūlatvāt prāmāṇyaṃ praśamo rāgādiprahāṇaṃ | anātmādisāmānyākāreṇa vastu gṛhītvā bhāvayatām bhāvanāniṣpattāvanātmādisvalakṣaṇapratyakṣīkāreṇa rāgādiprahāṇāt | kasya punarmithyātvepi praśamānukūlatvaṃ dṛṣṭam ity ata āha – mātṛsaṃjñetyādi | amātari mātṛsaṃjñā mithyāpi satī | rāgānutpattikāraṇaṃ | ityatā ca sādharmyeṇāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ | na tu mātṛsaṃjñādikaṃ pramāṇaṃ | ādiśabdād bhaginyādisaṃjñāparigrahaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyarthe cāyamvatiḥ |
 bāhyārthadarśanepi vastubhūtasāmānyābhāvād yadi sarvo vikalpo bhrāntas tatra yathā jalasāmānyarahitāt (ma)rīcisvalakṣaṇād utpanno jalavikalpo bhrāntas (p.212) tathā sattyajalād api jalatvaśūnyājñāto jalavikalpastasyāpyatasmiṃstadgrahapravṛttatvād bhrāntatvaṃ | tatkuta etad ekasyārthasamvādo parasya nety āha – marīciketyādi | anyasya ceti sattyajale jalajñānasya jalatvasāmānyasyābhāvānmarīcayo jalaṃ ca bhinno bhāvas tata utpattis tasyā aviśeṣepīti sambandhaḥ | vibhrasmayacāviśeṣepīti jalarahite marīcidravye yathā jalasāmānyādhyāropājjalavikalpo vibhramas tathā sattyajalepi tasyāpy atasmiṃl stadgraharūpatvādnabhipretārthakriyā pānādiḥ | tasyāṃ yogyaṃ jalasya svalakṣaṇam ayogyaṃ marīcikānāṃ | tata utpatter hetoḥ sattyajale marīcikāsu ca jalavikalpasya | yathākramaṃ samvādetarau itara ity asamvādaḥ | ayogyamarīcikāsvalakṣaṇāt | na hyajalarūpaṃ jalākārasya yogyam iti manyeta |
 vikalpetyādinā parihāraḥ | arthapratibaddhorthākārānuvidhānenotpattiḥ | tad eva vyācaṣṭe | na hītyādi yathārtham iti padārthānativṛttāvavyayībhāvaḥ | evakāraś ca bhinnakramaḥ | naiva hi padārthānurūpaṃ grāhakamautpadyata ity arthaḥ ||
 kathan tarhi jalajñānasya marīcikābhya utpattir ukteti ced āha – satītyādi | marīcikāsu cakṣurvijñānādau bhrāntamupajāyate tasmin satyanubhūtākārādhyāropiṇī jalabhrāntir iti pāramparyeṇa tadudbhavā marīcikodbhavety ucyate | yathāsvabhāvam iti pūrvavadavyayībhāvaḥ | jalabhrāntijananāsamarthaṃ ghaṭādyajalam ity uktaṃ | tato vivekiṃnā jalabhrāntijananasamartheneti yāvat | evaṃbhūtena marīcikākhyenārthena | na yathāsvabhāvaṃ jananāt tadudbhavety ucyate iti sambandhaḥ | yathā svabhāvam ity asyaivārthaḥ (|) svabhāvānukāretyādi | svabhāvam anukarotīti svabhāvānukāraḥ | svalakṣaṇānurūpaṃ prativimbakantasyārpaṇena jñāne samāropaṇena | sā punaḥ kena sākṣāj janyata ity āha – sā tvityādi | seti jalabhrāntir jalāt marīcikāyā yo viśeṣas tasya lakṣaṇam bhedenāvadhāraṇantatrāpāṭavāddhetoḥ | svavāsanā | jalabhrāntibījantasyāḥ prabodha ānuguṇyaṃ tena janyate | kimviśiṣṭena pratyayāpekṣiṇā pratyayo marīcikādarśanaṃ jalasādharmyasmaraṇaṃ ca | tasmād ity upasaṃhāraḥ | vijātīyād bhinno bhāvaḥ (p.213) svalakṣaṇamātrantato janma yasya vikalpavibhramasya sa tathā vikalpa eva vibhrama iti vigrahaḥ | na vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya darśanāt | iheti pratītiprasaṅgāt | nāvyatiriktasya sāmānyasya darśanāt pratyabhijñānam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | vyaktivadanavyād iti | vyaktyātmake tadvadeva tasyānanvayāt sāmānyarūpam eva nāstīti ||
 parasyeti sāmānyavādinaḥ | seti sāmānyākārā | kevalād iti vyaktinirapekṣatvāt |(| 101||)

 na hiītyādi vivaraṇaṃ |
 kasmān nāhetīty āha – nityam ityādi | tanmātravijñāna iti sāmānyamātragrahe | yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | anyeti sāmānyākārayā | anena jñāneneti sāmānyālambinā |
 tadeti vyakter agrahe | sambaddhasya sāmānyayuktasya tadvataḥ sāmānyavataḥ ||
 tadvattā sāmānyavattā | yadi sāmānyantadāśrayaś ca tena jñānena gṛhyeta tadobhyagrahaṇapūrvakas tadvattāniścayo (na) bhavet | tataḥ sāmānyagrahād vyavahāro vyaktau pravṛttiḥ kathan naiva |
 yadetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na tāviti sāmānyatadvantau | idam asya bhedasya sāmānyaṃ | tathā ceti sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandhāpratipattau | tatpratipattyā sāmānyapratipattyā | tadvati sāmānyavati | arthāntaravaditi na hyaśvapratipattikāle tadrapeṇāgṛhīte (p.214) godravye 'śvapratipattyā pratipattir asti | ekavastusahāyā iti sāmānyasahāyāḥ |
 syād etad ity etasyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | tasyeti jñānasya | ekaṃ sahakāryastīti sāmānyaṃ sahakāri bhavatīty arthaḥ | tadā tatsahitāḥ sāmānyasahitāḥ | evaṃ ca sāmānyatadvator dvayor grahaṇāt sāmānyapratipattyā tadvati pratipattiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ ||
 tad ity ācāryaḥ | ekamvastu sāmānyantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ nānātvaṃ samapohatyapanayati | kiṃ punas tāsāṃ nānātvāpoha iṣyata ity āha – nānātvāc cetyādi | hyarthaḥ ca śabdaḥ | tāsviti vyaktiṣu | kim ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tenaikena sāmānyena | bhedeṣu yannānātvantadekavijñānākāraṇatve bhedānāṃ kāraṇam ucyate | nānātvādvyaktayo naikaṃ vijñānaṃ janayantīti | ekasāmānyasambandhepi yadi bhedānānnānātvādapracyutirna teṣvekākāraṃ vijñānam iti pūrvavadvyaktīnāmagrahaṇaṃ ||
 anekam api vyaktirūpaṃ | ekam iti sāmānyaṃ | netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi bhedājananavirodhīsyāt tadā saty api sāmānye bhedān na janayaṃtyevaikaṃ vijñānaṃ |
 tābhir iti vyaktibhiḥ (|) kiṃ punaḥ samastābhir eva vinā | nety āha – pratyekam iti | tathā hi śāvaleyābhāve bāhuleye gobuddhis tathā tadabhāvenyatrāpyevampratyekaṃ sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāmabhāvepi | tenaikena sāmānyena kriyamāṇāṃ dhiyaṃ (p.215) pratyabhijñānātmikāṃ prati sāmarthyantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ nāsti | iti hetor agraho dhiyā sāmānyajñānena tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ |
 tad evāha (|) katham ityādi | tatra jñāne sāmānyākāre | tadbhāvād iti sāmānyapratyayasya bhāvāt | etena vyatirekābhāva uktaḥ | prayogas tu yo yadabhāvepi bhavati na tattannimittaṃ yathā śālibījābhāvepi bhavan yavāṅkuraḥ | bhavati ca pratyekaṃ śāvaleyādyabhāvepi bāhuleyādau gobuddhir iti vyāpakaviruddhaḥ | tannimittatāyāstadabhāvena vyāptatvāt | sāmānyasya tu tatra śaktir ity āha – asatītyādi | asati sāmānye sāmānyabuddher abhāvāt | anena vyatir eka uktaḥ | itarathā ceti sati sāmānye sāmānyabuddher bhāvāt | anenānvaya uktaḥ ||
 yadi sāmānyasahitānām eva vyaktīnāṃ sāmānyabuddhiṃ prati sāmarthyamiṣyate | tadā tathoktanyāyena sāmānyasyaiva śaktir na vyaktīnām iti |
 naiṣa doṣa ity āha paraḥ | ekāpāyepītyekaikasyāpāyepīty arthaḥ | tathā hi yathā nīlādisamudāyālambanaṃ cakṣurvijñānam utpadyate | tatra caikaikasmin nīlādāvapanīte bhavaty eva pariśiṣṭe ca varṇṇasasamūhe cakṣurbuddhir na ceyatā nīlādīnāmasāmarthya samūhe kintu sāmarthyam eva | pratyekaṃ nīlādīnāṃ samūhajñāne | tathehāpi vyaktiṣvekaikāpāyepi bhavati sāmānyavijñānam iti | neyatā pratyekaṃ sarvadā vyaktīnāmasāmarthyam iti sambandhaḥ | tataś ca yo yadabhāvepi bhavatītyādi prayoge 'nekānta iti |
 viṣama ity ācāryaḥ | upanyasyata ityupanyāso nīlādidṛṣṭāntas tasya prakrāntena sāmyannāstīty arthaḥ | naivaṃ vyakteḥ kathaṃcaneti | na pratyekaṃ samastānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmarthyam ity arthaḥ |
 (p.216) tadvyācaṣṭe | nīlādīnām ityādi | pratyekam api sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam iti | nīlādayo hi yathā svena rūpeṇa bhinnāstadvaccakṣurvijñānāny api | svākārabheāt | tatra nīlasahitena samuhena yajjanyate cakṣurvijñānanna tattadvikalena yac ca tadvikalena na janyate tadanyad eva | tasmāt samūhākāroparaktasya vijñānasya pratyekanna nīlādīnpratyanvayavyatirekānuvidhānād gamyate teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ sāmarthyam iti samūhepi śaktiraviruddhā | tatheti nīlādivat | na kadācid iti pratyekaṃ saṃhatā vā |
 etad āha – yadi śāvaleyasahitasāmānyajanyaṃ gojñānamanyadanyac ca bāhuleyasahāyajanyaṃ syāt (|) tadā vyaktīnāṃ pratyekaṃ svāśrayadvārabhāvijñāne śaktir gamyeta | kintvekameva sarvāsu vyaktiṣu pratyabhijñānantasya sarvatraikākāratvāt | pratyekaṃ vyaktīnāṃ cābhāvepi sāmānyādevāsyotpatteḥ | tasmādasamarthā eva vyaktayas tatra sāmānyajñāne | iti hetos tena sāmānyajñānena na gṛhyeran ||
 tāsāmvyaktīnāmmadhye 'nyatamāpekṣam iti kāṃcid vyaktimapekṣyety arthaḥ | tad iti sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ vyaktinirapekṣaṃ |
 athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kuvindastantuvāyaḥ | bahūnāṃ vemānāmmadhye pratyekaṃ vemābhāvepyekenānyatamena paṭaṃ karotīti (|) yady api sarveṣāṃ vyabhicāras tathāpi na tata eva kuvindādeva vemarahitāt paṭotpattiḥ śakyā vaktuṃ | yasmān na vemarahitaḥ kuvindaḥ paṭaṃ karoti kevalasya paṭakaraṇāśakteḥ | tathā ca na sāmānyaṃ kevalantaddher tu vijñānahetuḥ |
 evam ity ācāryaḥ | tāsāmanyatamāpekṣaṃ sāmānyaṃ śaktam iti bravatā vyaktyupakāryaṃ sāmānyam iṣṭam anupakāriṇyapekṣāyogāt ||
 (p.217) evaṃ cettad ekaṃ sāmānyamuoakuryustā vyaktayaḥ katham ekāṃ dhiyaṃ ca na | evaśabdārthe caśabdaḥ | ekāṃ pratyabhijñānātmikāndhiyam eva kathaṃ nopakuryastām evopakuryur iti yāvat |
 bhinnetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | bhinnānāṃ vilakṣaṇānām ekārthopakriyā | pratyabhijñādyekāryāvirodhinyasati sāmānya iti sarvoyaṃ sāmānyasiddhyarthaṃ ārambhaḥ | āsām iti vyaktīnāṃ vijñānena pratyabhijñānākhyenāparādhaḥ kṛtvo yat tadvijñānanna kurvanti (|) na kaścit kutas tasmāt tad eva kurvantīti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca kimatrāntargaḍunā | ghaṭāmastakayorantarālavarttī māmsapiṇḍontargaḍustena tulyas tathoktaḥ | tadvanniṣphalenety arthaḥ ||
 syān mataṃ (|) bhinnānāmekasāmānyopakāraśāktirastyataste sāmānyam eva sākṣādupakurvate na tu vijñānam ity ata āha – yathetyādi | evantadekam iti sāmānyajanyaṃ yadvijñānantad eva kurvantu | kiṃ sāmānyopakāreṇa niṣphalena | evam manyate (|) vijñāne vyaktayo na svākāropadhānena vyāpriyante (|) sāmānyajñāne svalakwaṇasyāpratibhāsanāt | kiṃtvādhipatyamātreṇa (|) tac ca yathā sāmānye tathā tadvijñānepi tulyam iti |
 kiṃ ca yadi vyaktayaḥ sāmānyam upakurvate tadā tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ kāryaś cāsau sāmānyātmā prāptaḥ | yasmāj jananamevopakriyā ||
 tad eva sphuṭayannāha – na hītyādi | atiśayo viśeṣas tadabhāvād anatiśayamātmānaṃ svabhāvam asya | sāmānyasyopakārakāsannidheḥ pūrvavadupakārakasannidhānepi (p.218) vibhrataḥ kaścidupakārako na hīti sambandhaḥ | atiprasaṅgāt | evaṃ hi sarvaḥ sarvasyopakārakaḥ syāt | tasmād upakāreṇaivopakāryasyātiśayo janyata ity abhyupeyaṃ | sa cātiśaya upakāryasyātmabhūta iti jananam evopakriyā | sāmānyādarthāntarabhūta evātiśayo vyaktibhirnānyata ity āha – arthāntaraityādi | tasyopakāryasya sāmānyasya kintenārthāntareṇopakāreṇa kriyate | tasya copakārasyārthāntarasya kintena sāmānyena yena tasya sāmānyasyāsāvupakārasambandhī syāt | sāmānyasya sambandhina upakārasya karaṇād vyaktayopy upakāriṇyaḥ syuḥ | upakārasya sāmānyam āśrayas tata āśrayāśrayibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhas tayor ity ata āha – tasyetyādi | tasyopakārasya tadāśrayatve | tatsāmānyamāśrayo yasyeti kṛtvā | tasya vā sāmānyasya tadāśrayatve | tasyopakārasyāśraya iti kṛtvā | upakarotīty upakāro tadabhāvādanupakāri sāmānyam upakāraḥ sāmānyakṛto 'styasyopakārasyety upakārī | tatpratiṣedhād anupakārī | anupakārya ity arthaḥ | caitattantreṇopāttam (|) tenāyam arthaḥ (|) anupakārakasya sāmānyasyānupakāryasya copakārasya yathākramaṃ ka āśratāśrayibhāva iti | atiprasaṅgo veti | anupakāriṇa āśrayāśrayibhāve sarvatra tatprasaṅgāt | upakāre vā sāmānyakṛte upakārasyābhyupagamyamāne | tatraiva sāmānye tasyopakārasya pratibandha iti kim anyo vyaktibhedas tasyopakārasya karaṇāt tasya sāmānyasyopakārī naiveti cet | tadapekṣasyeti vyaktyapekṣasyāśrayasyeti sāmānyasya | upakāraṃ pratyāśrayatvāt | tadupayoge tasminn upakāre | upayoge kalpyamāne nityatvād anupakāryatve sāmānyasya keyaṃ vyaktiṃ pratyapekṣā nāma | naiva | kastarhyapekṣata ity ata āha – tadupattītyādi | tasmādapekṣaṇīyād utpattiḥ sā dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya sa tadutpattidharmmabhāvaḥ | svabhāvasya prativandhādāyattatvād apekṣate nāma upakāriṇaṃ (|) nāmaśabdaḥ prasiddher dyotakaḥ | anutpattidharmakam api sāmānyam apekṣata iti ced āha – anādheyetyādi | yattairupakārakairanādheyonutpādya ātmātiśayo yasya sa tathā | evaṃbhūta ātmiyasyeti punar bahuvrīhir evambhūtatve (?) sāmānyapadārthaḥ (p.219) apekṣate ca parān iti vyāhatam etat | vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā | tathā hy apekṣādheyātiśayatvena vyāptā | tadviruddhamanādheyātiśatvam iti |
 yaḥ kaścid bhāvaḥ kasyacid vastunaḥ kvacid āśraye sa sarvo janyatāyāṃ kāryatāyām evodbhavati āśrayeṇāḍritasyānātmabhūta evopakāraḥ kriyata iti ced āha – parabhāvetyādi | tadanupakārāttasyopakāryasyānupakārāt | na hy anyasminnupakṛtenya upakṛto nāma | tasya tadāśrayatve 'nupakāriṇaḥ koyamāśrayāśrayibhāva iti sarvam vācyaṃ |
 na ca paunaruktyadoṣaḥ | pūrvaṃ sāmānyatadvator upakāryopakārakabhāvadvāreṇoktamadhunā sarvaviṣayaṃ vāstavaṃ sambandhamupādāyeti | tasmād arthāntarakaraṇād āśrayābhimatokiṃcitkaraḥ (|) tathābhūtopyauoakāraka iti ced āha – akiñcitkarasyetyādi | yata evantasmād vijñānajanana ity anvayivijñānajanane | vyaktam avaśyam asya sāmānyasya | tatkāryatā vyaktikāryatā (|)
 yathoktadoṣabhayāt kevalasya vyaktyanapekṣastānvayivijñānajananaṃ prati sāmarthyebhyupagamyamāne vyaktīnāṃ kvacid api kāle | atretyanvayivijñāne samarthyāsiddheḥkāraṇād agrāhyatvaṃ vyaktīnāṃ | akāraṇasya viṣayatvāyogāt | vijñāne pratibhāsanād iti | na hyasamarthasya śaśaviṣāṇāderanvayivijñāne pratibhāsanam asti | vyaktayastu pratibhāsanteḥ (|) tasmāt sāmānyavattā api samarthā iti | asiddhaḥ sāmānyavijñāne upakāro yāsāṃ vyaktīnāntā asiddhopakārāstāsāṃ kathaṃ sāmānyavijñāne pratibhāsaḥ (|) naiva | upakāra eva katham asiddha iti ced āha – sa evetyādi | sa ity upakāraḥ sāmānyābhyupagame hi tasyaiva tatra sāmarthyanna vyaktīnāṃ | yathoktaṃ |
 tābhirvināpi pratyekaṃ kriyamāṇāṃ dhiyaṃ pratītyādi (1|105) |
 mābhūd vyaktīnām upakāraḥ sāmānyavijñāne pratibhāsastu kasmānna bhavatīty āha – yasmād ityādi | atiprasaṅgād iti anupakārakasya viṣayatve sarvasya vijñānasya (p.220) sarvo viṣayaḥ syāt | mābhūd viṣayaḥ pratibhā(sa)stukasmānneti ced āha – nāviṣayasyetyādi | anupakārakasyetyādi | anupakārasyeti pāṭhāntaraṃ | tatra na vidyate vijñānakāryasyopakāro yasmād arthāt sonupakāra iti vyākhyeyaṃ | tasyāviṣayatve 'tītānāgatādīnāṃ | ādiśabdāt pradhāneśvarādīnāṃ yathāgamakaṃ kalpitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ | asatāmityasāmānyahetuḥ | bhavantv ityādinā siddhasādhyatām āha – tadviṣayāṇītyatītaviṣayāṇi (|) nirviṣayatve kathanteṣvantarbhaviṣyati cety evamādyarthānukārī pratibhāsa ity ata āha – nirviṣayatvepītyādi | tadanupakārīti yosāvarthonubhūto 'tītaś ca tadanu(pa)kārī | aspaṣṭena rūpeṇātītasyaivārthasyānukārānnātītādikannāma kiñcid asti yasya rūpam anukuryāt | sa ca pratibhāso vijñānasyātmabhūta evāspaṣṭarūpasya bahiravidyamānatvāt | tadrūpānukāritve kāraṇam āha – tadrūpānubhavetyādi | yadrūpo varttamānārthānubhavo jātas tena yā vāsanā āhitā tata utpadyamānaṃ jñānamanubhūtārthākāreṇotpadyata ity arthaḥ | yuktamatīti tadrūpārthānubhavotpattir vartamānāvasthāyām arthasyānubhūtatvād anāgatādau kathaṃ | na hi tatrānubhavosti | tatrāpyevambhūtortho bhaviṣyatīty evaṃbhūtācchabdād yobhilāpasaṃsṛṣṭo vikalpaḥ sa eva svasaṃviditatvāt tadrūponubhavastenāhitavāsanotpatter adoṣaḥ |
 evaṃ pradhānādivikalpeṣv api yathāgamaḥ śabdārthākāravikalpānubhavavāsanotpattir vyākhyeyā | evamatītādīnāmaviṣayatve prasaṅgādanupakārako viṣaya iti yaduktantaikāntikam eva | tathā vyaktīnāmasiddhopakārāṇāmaviṣayatvān nāsti sāmānyajñāne pratibhāsaḥ | tataś ca yaduktaṃ (|) samarthā vyaktayo vijñāne pratibhāsanād iti (|) tasyāsiddhatvam uktaṃ |
 adhunā pratibhāsamaṅgīkṛtyānaikāntikatvam āha – bhāvābhāvetyādi | arthabhāve bhāvas tadabhāve cābhāvo vijñānasya bhāvābhāvānuvidhānaṃ | tasmāddhetor arthasya vijñāne sāmarthyaṃ gamyate | na tu pratibhāsanāt | yasmād vastusthityā sāmānyasyāsatyapi pratibhāsane vikalpavijñāne sāmarthyābhyupagamāt | tad evāha (|) apratibhāsinopītyādi | na hi vyaktivyatir ekeṇa sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsate | yady api sāmānyapratibhāsi (p.221) vikalpavijñānantadapi varṇṇasaṃsthānādyākāram eva | na hi tatrāpi varṇṇādyākāraviviktonyaḥ sāmānyākāro lakṣyate | na ca varṇṇasaṃsthānādyātmakaṃ sāmānyaṃ | tasmān na vastusthityā sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsate (|) tathāpi tasyāpratibhāsino bhavanmatena bhāvāt | vijñāne sāmarthyāt | bhāvyate janyate kāryam aneneti bhāvaḥ sāmarthyam ucyate | saty api ca pratibhāsane nāsti sāmarthyam iti darśayannāha – pratibhāsinām ityādi | viplebante vastutvādapagacchantīti viplavāḥ keśādaya eva (|) viplavā iti vigrahaḥ | te hi taimirikādidarśane pratibhāsante tathāpi teṣām abhāvāt | pūrvavad bhāvaśabdavyutpatter asāmarthyamabhāvaśabdenocyate | vijñānajananaṃ pratyasāmarthyam ity arthaḥ | tad eva sāmarthyepi pratibhāsadarśanāt pratibhāsanāt sāmarthyam ity asyānekānta ukto bhavati |
 tadaikam upakuryustāḥ katham ekāndhiyaṃ ca neti (1|107)
 yaduktantatra parasyottaramāśaṃkate | abhinnetyādinā | abhinnapratibhāsā ekākārā | bhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu | teṣāṃ svalakṣaṇānāmākārastadākāraḥ sorpitaāhito yasyām buddhau sā tathā (|) evaṃbhūtā cāsāvabhinnapratibhāsinī ca na hi syād yadi vilakṣaṇebhya evotpadyeta | bhavati cābhinnapratibhāsinī | tasmān na vilakṣaṇebhya evotpadyate kintu sāmānyapadārthād iti |
 netyādinā pratividhatte | etatkathayati (|) yadi svalakṣaṇāni svākārā vā (?)tena sāmānyākārāṇāṃ buddhīnāṃ janakānīṣyante tad etad yujyate | bhinneṣu katham abhinnapratibhāsā buddhir iti | tac ca nāsti yato na sāmānyapratibhāsinīṣu buddhiṣu svalakṣaṇapratibhāsaḥ | yasmāt sāmānyagrāhiṇīṣu buddhiṣu svalakṣaṇapratibhāsābhyupagame tisraḥ kalpanāḥ | (1) yena rūpeṇa cakṣurādibuddhiṣu vyaktayo bhāsante tenaiva sāmānyabuddhiṣv api | (2) sānābyabuddhau vā yadrūoamābhāti tad eva svalakṣaṇānāṃ | (3) rūpadvayaṃ vā ekasya bhedasyābhyupagantavyaṃ | yena kena cakṣurādibuddhiṣu bhāsate 'nyena vikalpabuddhiṣvati |
 (1) tatrādye pakṣe cakṣurādibuddhivat svalakṣaṇābhāve sāmānyubuddhīnāmapyabhāvaḥ syān na caivaṃ | tadabhāvepi tasya svalakṣaṇasyābhāvepi tāsāṃ sāmānyabuddhīnāṃ (p.222) bhāvāt | dvitīyasya pakṣasyābhāvam āha – ākārāntaretyādi | sāmānyākārādākārāntareṇāsādhāraṇena svajñāne cakṣurādijñāne pratibhāsanān na sāmānyākāra eva rūpaṃ vyaktīnāṃ | (3) tṛtīyampakṣaṃ nirākarttym āha – anekākārāyogād iti | ekasyānekatvam ayuktam ekānekatvayor virodhāt | atiprasaṅgāc cety ekasyānekatvakalpanāyāṃ na kvacid ekatvaṃ syād ity arthaḥ | svalakṣaṇaṃ ca sāmānyabuddhau na pratibhāsate |
 yata evantasmānneyaṃ sāmānyākārā buddhiḥ | bhinnārthagrāhiṇī (|) āhitasvalakṣaṇākārā satyabhinnākārā bhāti | tadudbhavā bhinnapadārthodbhavā | kintu svalakṣaṇagrāhiṇonubhavenāhitāṃ vāsanāmāśritya prakṛtyā bhrāntaivayam utpadyate | pāramparyeca vyaktayas tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ kathyante |
 yadi sāmānyabuddhir na svalakṣaṇapratibhāsinī kathaṃ svalakṣaṇe lokaṃ pravarttayatīti ced āha – atatpratibhāsinyapītyādi | asvalakṣaṇapratibhāsinyapi svapratibhāse 'narthe 'larthādhyavasāyavibhramād dhetor vyavahārayati lokaṃ dṣśyavikalpyāvekīkṛtya pravarttayatīti yāvat | yadi sāmānyabuddhiḥ sāmānyākārā sa eva pāramārthikantarhi sāmānyambhaviṣyatīty āha – sa tu tasyām ityādi | sa pratibhāsamānaḥ sāmānyākāro nārtheṣv asti | tasya vyatiriktasya vyatirekeṇānupalambhanāt | avyatiriktasya ca vyaktivadananvayāt |
 kathan tarhi vyaktiṣvabhinnākārapratibhāsa ity āha – anyatra bhedādabhedina iti | bhedonyāpohaḥ sa eva prativyaktyabhedī | tathā hi yathaikā govyaktiragovyāvṛttā tathānyāpi | tad anena prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇāny eva vijātīyavyāvṛttānyabhedīni bheda ity ucyante | anyatra śabdaś cāyamvibhaktyantapratirūpako bipātaḥ | anyaśabdasamānārthaḥ | na tvayatralpratyayāntaḥ saptamyarthasyāvivakṣitatvāt | tenāyam artho yathoktena prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇātmakād bhedādabhedinonyaḥ pratibhāsamāna ākārortheṣu nāsti kintu svalakṣaṇātmaka eva bhedo vijātīyavyāvṛtter abhedī sarvatra vidyate 'bhedādhyavasāyāt | abhedādhyavasāyasya ca sa eva bhedaḥ pāramparyeṇa nimittaṃ |
 nanu buddhāvabhinnākāraḥ pratibhāsate katham artheṣu nāstīty ucyata ity āha – sa cārūpa iti (|) hyarthe ca śabdaḥ | sa hi vikalpapratibhasyākāro niḥsvabhāvastattvānyatvena (p.223) paramārthato vyavasthāpayitum aśakyatvād iti saṃpratyevoktatvāt | tam evākāraṅgṛhītabuddhistadākārotpattir evāsyāḥ grahaṇantathetyarūpasyākārasya grahaṇād viplavate bhrāntā bhavatīty uktamprāk | aśaktir eṣā vikalpānām avidyāprabhavatvādinoktatvāt |
 doṣasya parihāramuktvādhunāṃ tulyadoṣatāmāpādayannāha – api cetyādi | na tulyam iti paraḥ | tatreti bhinnāsu vyaktiṣu tata eva sāmānyāttulyākārād buddhir iti na tulyaṃ codyaṃ |
 nanv ityādi siddhāntavādī | tatra vyaktiṣu tasya sāmānyasya satoṣyā(?pyā) bhāsa ākāro na lakṣyate | yadvā tatreti vikalpikāvikalpikāyāṃ buddhau | syād etad (|) vikalpikāyāntasyābhāsostīty āha – sā hītyādi | sā hi vikalpikā buddhir varṇṇasaṃsthānavatī vibhāvyate 'nubhūyate | varṇṇādyākāram eva sāmānyam iti ced āha – na cetyādi | īdṛśam iti varṇṇasaṃsthānākāraṃ guṇatvād varṇṇasaṃsthānādeḥ sāmānyasya ca guṇavyatir ekāt | na ca tata iti varṇṇasaṃsthānādeḥ |
 evaṃ tāvad bhinnaṃ sāmānyaṃ nirākṛtyābhinnaṃ nirācikīrṣann āha – ākṛtītyādi | svalakṣaṇānāmātmabhūtam eva sādṛśyamākṛtis tad eva sāmānyantasya vādaḥ sa yasyāsti | tadvā vadituṃ śīlaṃ yasya sāṃkhyasya sa tathā | viśeṣavat svalakṣaṇavat tasya sāmānyasya svalakṣaṇādavyatirekāddhetor arthāntare dvitīyādivyaktiṣvavṛttiḥ | iti hetos tad api sāmānyaṃ svalakṣaṇam eva jātantato bhedāddhetorvidyamānasya nābhinnaḥ pratibhāso yujyate vyaktiṣvity adhyāhāraḥ |
 tadevam udyotakarā dyabhihitamabhinnapratibhāsamabhyupagamya vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasyāyogād bhrāntir evāyaṃ vyaktiṣvekākārapratibhāsa ity uktaṃ |
 (p.224) adhunāstyekapratibhāso vyaktiṣv ity āha – athavāstv ityādi | yad uktam (|) abhinnapratibhāsā dhīrna bhinneṣvity etad astu | iṣṭam evaitad ity arthaḥ | yataḥ pratibhāso dhiyāṃ sāmānyabuddhīnāṃ bhinnaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) samānā iti tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ grahaṇāt |
 naivetyādinā vyācaṣṭe tādviti sāmānyabuddhiṣu abhinna ity eka(ḥ) pratibhāsosti (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ samānā iti grahaṇāt |
 nanu samānā iti grahe satyekapratibhāsaḥ kasmān na yujyata evetyata āha – na hītyādi | kintarhi tad eveti yatpūrvadṛṣṭantadevedandṛśyata ity evaṃ syān na tu pūrveṇedaṃ samānam iti bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt samānavyavahārasya | dvayasyetyādi | yadi sāmānyam eva kevalantābhirbuddhibhirgṛhyate tadā bhavedayaṃ doṣaḥ | kin tu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaś ca dvayam api sāmānyabuddhyā gṛhyate | tato dvayasya grahaṇādadoṣaḥ | yatas tenaiva sāmānyena yuktā viśeṣāḥ samānā iti gṛhyanta iti |
 tathāpītyācāryaḥ | dvayasya grahaṇepi kalpyamāne tad iheti syāt | tat sāmānyaṃ yatpūrvaṃ vyaktau dṛṣṭantadiha vyaktyantare dṛśyata ity evaṃ syān na tu samāna iti vyaktibhya ekāntabhinnatvāt sāmānyasya | tad evetya rthāntarabhūtaṃ gotvādikaṃ tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmyaṃ yena tāssamānā iti cet | anyaḥ sāmānyāt sānyasya svalakwaṇasya kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa sāmyaṃ | na kenacid ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi vyaktirūpānukārāt sāmānyaṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmyaṃ kalpyeta (|) tac ca nāsti vyaktibhyo 'tyantaṃvilakṣaṇatvāt sāmānyasya | nāpy anenānye samāmyaṃ syāt | na hi vyaktirūpānukārādinā sāmyaṃ kintu tatsambandhāt | vyaktibhiḥ sambandhāt | sāmānyaṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmānyam iti cen naitad evaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) apratibaddhasya vyaktāvanāyattasya (p.225) tābhiranupakṛttasyety arthaḥ | samavāyalakṣaṇena sambandhena sambandhāt sāmānyasya sāmyebhyupagamyamāne 'tiprasaṅgaḥ saṃkhyāsaṃyogakāryadravyāṇām api sāmānyarūpatā syāt | tataś ca tatsambandhāt saṃkhyeyādiṣu samānapratibhāsaḥ syāt |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | samānā iti grahaṇād vyaktiṣu pratibhāsabhedaḥ sādhyate (|) tac caitad viruddhaṃ | yasmāt samāś cetā vyaktayaḥ katham bhinnadhīgrāhyā evetisāvadhāraṇaṃ | abhinnadhīgrāhyā api prāpnuvantīty arthaḥ | tathā hi yatra kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kaścic ca viśwṣas tatra samānā iti grahaṇaṃ yuktam anyathā ghaṭapaṭādivadabhedapratibhāsaḥ syān na samānā iti |
 tadvyācaṣṭe | nanv ityādi | āsu vyaktiṣv ity anena viśeṣarūpam āha – abhinnaḥ pratibhāsaḥ siddha ity adhyāhāryaḥ |
 anena ca sāmānyasya rūpam uktaṃ |
 tadevaṃ sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇād vyaktayaḥ samānā gṛhyanta iti samudāyārthaḥ | tat kiṃ samāneṣv ekānekapratibhāso vidyate yenaivam ucyate | yadi syād iheti buddhiḥ syād ity uktaṃ | sāmānyātmakatvād viśeṣāṇāṃ samānā iti pratibhāsa iti cet | nanv anugatapratibhāsābhāve sāmānyamastīti kutaḥ | na ca samānarūpānyathānupapattyā sāmānyakalpanā yuktā | svahetubhya evaṃ keṣāṃ cit samānām evotpatteḥ keṣāṃ cid asamānāṃ | na ca sāmānyāt teṣāṃ samānarūpatā yujyata ity uktaṃ |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭena ||
 na cāprasiddhasārūpyānapohaviṣayātmanā |
 śaktaḥ kaścid api jñātuṃ gavādīnaviśeṣataḥ ||
 athāsaty api sārūpye syād apohasya kalpanā |
 gavāśvayor ayaṃ kasmādagopaho na kalpyate ||
 śāvaleyāc ca bhinnatvaṃ bāhuleyāśvayossamaṃ |
 sāmānyaṃ nānyadiṣṭaṃ ca kvāgopohapravarttanaṃ ||
 apohyān api cāśvādīnekadharmānvayādṛte |

 apāstaṃ | sāmānyamantareṇāpi svahetubhya eva gavādīnāṃ samānāmutpatter yadi nāma sārūpyam arthāntarabhūtaṃ neṣīate sarūpāstviṣyanta eva te | evaṃrūpāś ca yena bhavantyaśvādayaste sarve 'viśeṣeṇāgorūpatayā niṣidhyanta iti na kācit kṣatiḥ |
 ācāryas tu na nāma svahetubhyaḥ samānā utpannāstathāpi na sāmānyabalāt samānā iti pratītir iti darśayann āha – netyādi | taddarśana iti vyaktigrāhiṇi jñāne | sāmānyajñāne vā | bhinnābhinnayer iti viśeṣasāmānyayoḥ | ekakāryatāsādṛśyam iti | ekakāryataiva sādṛśyaṃ sāmyaṃ tenaiva samānā vyaktayaḥ pratīyanta ity arthaḥ | na tu pāramārthikena sāmānyena | tenaikakāryatā sādṛśyaṃ yeṣānta evāpohaviṣayā yeṣāṃ tvekakāryatā nāsti te 'pohyā iti siddhaṃ | yathā caikāntabhinnā apy ekakāryaṃ kurvanti tathoktaṃ prāk |
 kasmān na sāmānyena samānā pratīyanta ity āha – na hītyādi | arthajñāna ity anubhavajñāne dvāvākārau bhinnau | arthadvayakalpanena samānāsamānakalpena | kalpanāviṣayatām ity ekatvāropavikalpaviṣayatāṃ | tatheti samānarūpatayā | anayā vikalpabuddhyā |
 nanv ityādi paraḥ |
 tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ dhīḥ kāryaṃ sā ca vibhidyata ity etāvān kārikābhāgaḥ | pratibhāvam ity etad apekṣya paṭhitaḥ | evambhāvaṃ prati | tadvad ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | tatpratibhāsinopi vyaktipratibhāsinopi jñānasya | tadvadvyaktibhedāt | katham ekakāryā vyaktayo naiva |(|110||)
 syād etat (|) nānubhavajñānenaikakāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ kintu yattadvikalpakam ekarūpādhyāropeṇa (p.227) tadapekṣayety ata āha – taddhītyādi | taddhyanubhavajñānantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ kāryaṃ na vikalpavijñānantasya vyaktyabhāvepi bhāvāt | tasyaiva ca vikalpasya samānā ity ebam utpadyamānasya vyaktiṣu kiṃ sāmyaṃ | paṭādīnāṃ śītāpanayanam ity evamādiparigrahaḥ | pratidravyam ity avyayībhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyā ambhāvaḥ | dravyasya dravyasya yo bhedastasmād bhedāt kāraṇabhedād bhidyata iti yāvat |
 nety ācāryaḥ | ekapratyavamarśasyeti svaviṣayasyaikākārapratyayasya hetutvād dhīr nirvikalpikā vābhedinī bhāti | ekadhīhetubhāvenety adhyavasitaikarūpāyā buddher hetutvena vyaktīnāmabhinnatā bhāti |
 etad uktam bhavati | pratyekaṃ yady api vyaktisvarūpagrāhiṇyo dhiyo bhinnāstathāpi pratyabhijñayā tāsām ekatvam adhyavasīyate | anena caikakāryatāsādṛśyena vyaktīnām ekatvaṃ | na tvekaparāmarśahetutvenānubhavajñānānām ekatvam upacaryate | nāpi tathābhūtānubhavajñānahetutvena vyaktīnām ekatvam upacaryate | skhalitapratyayaviṣayatvābhāvād upacaritopacārābhāvāc ca | vṛttyarthānurūpaś ca kārikārtho na vyākhyātaḥ syāt |(|111||)
 nanu yadyekakāryatāsādṛśyena vyaktīnām ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ kathantarhi buddhīnām ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ | ekakāryatvābhāvāt | atha tāḥ svabhāvata ekatvāvasāyaṃ janayanti vyaktayipyevambhaviṣyantīti kimekakāryatāsādṛśyena |
 sattyam (|) ācārya dignāgā bhiprāyeṇaivam uktam ity adoṣaḥ | tasmād ekatvādhyavasād ekatvam iṣyate | na paramārthata ity ata āha – niveditam ityādi | sarvabhāvāḥ svabhāvena vyāvṛttibhāgina (pra. vā. 1|42) ity atroktatvāt | tatretyasaṃsargiṣu bhedeṣu . ekākārā buddhiratasmiṃstadgrahād bhrāntir eva |
 atha syāt (|) sāmānyamantareṇa bhrāntarevāyoga ity ata āha – tāntv ityādi | tāmbhrāntimbhedinaḥ padārthā vyāvṛttāni svalakṣaṇāni krameṇa janayanti na sākṣāt | (p.228) svabhāva(ta) iti prakṛtyā | cakāro niveditam ity āsyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ | etad api tatraiva pastāve niveditaṃ | krameṇeti yaduktantasya vyākhyānaṃ nikalpahetavo bhavanta iti | vikalpakāraṇatvād anubhavajñānamvikalpaḥ | vikalpahetor anubhavajñānasya hetavo bhavanta ity arthaḥ | vyaktayonubhavajñānaṃ yanayanti taccaikākārāṃ bhrāntimityayaṃ kramārthaḥ |
 sa tveṣām ityādinā kārikārtham āha – sarveṣām bhāvānāmbhedonyāpohaḥ | kiṃ svabhāvo 'tatkārivivekaḥ sa eṣāmabhinna ity ucyate | kasmād (|) jñānāder arthasyendriyasyodakāharaṇādeś ca kasyacid ity ātmānurūpasyaikasya karaṇāt |
 yadvā (|) nanu budder avāyamabhinnākāraḥ kathaṃ vyaktīnām ity ata āha – sa tvākāra eṣāṃ bāhyānāmabhinnastathaiva pratīteḥ (|) pratītir eva kutaḥ | jñānādeḥ kasyacid ekasya karaṇāt (|) sa cākāro bhedonyāpoha ity ucyate na sāmānyaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) atatkāsisvabhāviveko yataḥ |
 etad uktambhavati | prativyaktir gaur gaur iti pratyayenātatkārisvabhāvivekotatkārisvabhāvavivikta eva svabhāvo viṣayīkrite | na tvarthāntarabhūtaṃ sāmānyantena bheda ity ucyate | etatpaścārddhasya vyākhyānaṃ ||111|||
 nanu kathaṃ jñānāder ekatvam ity āha – tadapotyādi | pūrvārddhasyaitad vyākhyānaṃ | tad pi jñānādikāryam abhinnaṃ khyātīti sambandhaḥ | prakṛtyeti svabhāvena | abhedāvaskandina ity abhedādhyavasāyinaḥ | tathābhūtetyādinā vyaktīnām api vikalpaṃ prati pāramparyeṇa kāraṇatvam āha – abhedāvasāyo vidyate yasmiṃs tasya jñānāderity anubhavajñānasyodakādyāharaṇādeścārthasya hetutvāt kāraṇāt krameṇa vyaktayopyekaṃ pratyayaṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭam ity āha – saṃsṛṣṭākāram ityādi | saṃsṛṣṭo vyaktiṣvāropita eka ākāro yena sa tathā | svabhāvabhedonyavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ sa eva paramārthonupacarito 'styeti vigrahaḥ | pāramparyeṇa vyāvṛttasvalakṣaṅadvārāyātatvād vikalpasya |
 nanu ca tāntu bhedinaḥ padārthā ityādināyamartho 'nantaram evoktaṃ |
 (p.229) sattyaṃ (|) kintu krameṇa vikalpahetavo bhavanta ityādyasyaivārtho 'nena sphuṭīkṛtaḥ | ekakāryabhedavastubhūtaṃ sāmānyambhaviṣyatīty ata āha – sācetyādi | sā caikakāryatā | atatkāryebhyo viśleṣo vyāvṛtta eva svabhāvo na vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇantadanyasya svalakṣaṇādanyānurvattinonvayino vastuno vyaktivyatirekeṇādṛṣṭeḥ pratiṣedhāc ca pūrvoktāt |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | dṛśyamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ vibhāyena vyaktibhyo bhedena | sati vā sāmānye nityatvādanādheyātiṣa(?śa)yatvena kvacid vyaktyantare anāśritaṃ kathaṃ jñānahetuḥ | naiva | āśrayavyaṅgyasya tasya jñānahetutvam iṣṭam ity abhiprāyaḥ | etad apy uktam ity anena sambandhanīyaṃ | asyāpi prāguktatvāt |

 (p.230) yoyam ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | anyonyaṃ vivekonyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvo hāvānānta tpratītaye tanniścayārthaṃ svapratibhāse 'dhyavasitabāhyarūpe saṃketopi kriyamāṇaḥ obheta yuktiyuktatvāt (|) kimartha kriyata ity ata āha – atatkārītyādi | vivakṣitārthakriyākāriṇo ye na havanti teṣāṃ viekena parihāreṇa pravṛttyarthatayā | atatkāriṣupravṛttirmāthūd ity arthaḥ |
 amumevārthaṃ vyatirekamukheṇa(?na) draḍhayann āha – yadītyādi. tasyānyaparihārasya pratīty artho yadi na saṃketastatkāriṇī tadanyaparihārasya vyavahārakālepyasaṃsparśāt | yadvā yadi na tatpratīty arthaḥ saṃketa iti vijātīyavyāvṛttasvabhāvapratīty arthaḥ saṃketaḥ (|) tadā tasyānyavyavṛttasya svabhāvasya vyavahārakālepi na kevalaṃ saṃketakāle 'saṃsparśācchabdenāviṣayīkaraṇānnānyaparihāreṇa pravartteta |
 etad uktam bhavati | yadā vidhirūpeṇānyavyāvṛtortho viṣayīkṛtastadānyavyavacchedaḥ pratīyeta | etad evāha – na hītyādi | viveka iti viviktaḥ svabhāvaḥ | teṣāntatkāriṇāntebhya ity atatkāryebhyaḥ | yadi hi tasya viviktasya svabhāvasya pratītaye saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ syād evaṃ vyavahārepi śabdena codyeta (|) tathā cānyaparihāreṇa pravartteteti saṃketopi tadvirdathika eva yuktaḥ |
 nanu ca śabdajanitā buddhiḥ svākāram eva bāhyatayādhyasya grahaṇādalīkā | tataś ca tajjanakasya śabdasya katham vastusamvādaḥ kathaṃ cānyāpohaviṣayatvam ity ata āha –
 sā cetyādi | anyāpohapratipattyartha yā saṃketikā | sā ca śrutiḥ | dhiyaṃ janayantyapīti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭām (|) akāryakṛti | avāhyarūpe svākāre | tatkāri tulyarūpeṇārthakriyākāri bāhyaikarūpeṇāvabhāsodhyavasāya iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ sa yasyā vidyata iti paścāt matvarthīyaḥ |
 (p.231) etaduktambhavati | svālāramabāhyaṃ bāhyamivādhyavasyantīm iti yāvat |
 etena pravṛtty(rtha)tvaṃ śrutorākhyātaṃ |
 vastubhūtasāmānyam antareṇa kutastasyā utpattir iti ced āha – vastv ityādi | vastūnāmpṛthagbhāva itaretarabhedastanmātraṃ bījaṅkāraṇaṃ pāramparyeṇa yasyāḥ sā tathoktā | yataś cānugataṃ rūpaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ caikīkṛtya gṛhṇātyatonarthikāṃ janayatyapi śrūtirarthe na visamvādikā | kasmād (|) atatkāriparihārāṅgabhāvataḥ | vijātīyāvyavacchedahetubhāvataḥ |
 etad uktambhavati yady anyavyāvṛttavastvadhyavasāyināṃ buddhiṃ janayecchutistadā tadanyavyāvṛtta eva svalakṣaṇe eva svalakṣaṇe puruṣaṃ pravarttayatīti samvādikā syāt | saṃketakāle ca śruteritaretarabhinna eva svabhāva āśrayas tatrāsyāḥ saṃketitatvāt | tadevampāramparyeṇā vastubhedāśrayāc ca kāraṇādarthe | na visamvādikā matā | vyavahārakālepyanyavyāvṛttasyaiva vastunaḥ prāpaṇāt |
 nanu vidhirūpeṇa vastvadhyavasāyātkathaṃ śruteranyāpohaviṣayatvam ity ata āha – tata ityādi | yataścātatkāriparihārāṅgabhāvataḥ śruter vastubhedāśrayatvaṃ ca tataḥ kāraṇādanyāpohaviṣayā | etad eva dvayam āha – tatkartrāśritabhāvata iti | tasmin napohe karttṛ bhāvataḥ | āśritabhāvaś ca svārthābhidhānadvāreṇārthādatatkāriparihārāṅgabhāvatastasmin napohe karttṛ bhāvaḥ śrateḥ | vyavahārakāle saṃketakāle ca vastubhedāśrayadvāreṇa pravṛttes tasmin napohe ḍruterāśritabhāvaḥ |
 eketyādinā kārikārtham āha – tamityekamākāraṃ svapratibhāsinamāropyārtheṣvadhyasyotpadyamānāṃ | sa ca svapratibhāso mithyāvabhāsitvādakāryakārī | tam evaṃ bhūtam api kāryakāriṇam ivādhyavasyantīṃ | anenākāryakṛtātyādi vyākhyātaṃ | vastupṛthagbhāvamātramanyavyavacchedamātraṃ yasyā buddhet iti vigrahah | mithyābuddhiṃ janayantyapi śrutiḥ (|) kasmān mithyābuddhir ity ata āha – samānādhyavasāyām ekākārādhyavasāyāṃ (p.232) | tadanyaparihārāṅgabhāvāt | vivakṣitādarthādanyasya parihārāṅgabhāvatayā vyavacchedāśrayabhāvataḥ | paramārthato vastutaḥ | tadvyatirekiṣvatatkāryatirekiṣu na visamvādikety ucyate | tathā hyanityakṛtakādiśrutayo yathābhūtasya nityādivyāvṛttasya vastuno vyāvṛttimupādāya saṃketitatvād vyavahārepi tathā bhūtasyānyaparihārāṅgabhāvena prāptihetavo bhavanti | tena yathārthadarśanānyāyātatvācchūter api samvādaḥ |
 yad vā yathābhūte vyavacchede sā śrutiḥ saṃketitā tasya paramārthatosti vastuṣu sadbhāva itīyatā lebhenāvisamvāditvaṃ na tu dhūmādivacchabdānāmāvaśyako vastunipratibandhasteṣām icchāmātrapratibaddhatvāt |
 avisamvāditvam eva samarthayann āha – tathā hītyādi | teṣu bhāveṣu sa vyatireko vyavacchedo bhūtaḥ satyaḥ (|) kutaḥ (|) sarvathā sāmānyābhyupagamepyavaśyaṃ vyavacchedasyābhyupagamanīyatvādanyathā vyavacchinnasvabhāvābhāve sāmānyasyaivābhāvaprasaṅgād ity uktaṃ | sāmānyoktāpi tatra bhūta iti ced āha – naika ityādi ekaḥ sāmānyapadārtho vyakter vyatirikto vaiśeṣikā dīnāmavyatiriktaḥ sāṃkhyānāṃ na teṣu bhūta iti sambandhaḥ | kasmāt (|) sarvathā vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya ca pramāṇabādhitatvenāyogād asambhavāt | bādhakampramāṇaṃ prāg uktaṃ vakṣyate ca |
 yadi punaryathā pratibhāsam api sāmānyaṃ śabdena codyate tadā tasya sāmānyasya vastunyavidyamānasya samāveśane śabdena viṣayīkaraṇe | tasya vā sāmānyasya pramāṇabādhitasya vastuni bāhye niveśane 'bhyupagamyamāne dūtotsṛṣṭam evātyantaviprakṛṣṭam eva vastu syāt | kutaḥ (|) śabdajñānābhyāṃ śabdāt taduktāc ca jñānād ity arthaḥ | yad vā śabdajñānābhyāṃ dūramutsṛṣṭaṃ tyaktaṃ syāt | kutaḥ (|) tadviṣayābhimatasya śabdādiviṣayābhimatasya | tasyeti sāmānyasya vastusvabhāvāt | anyasya sāmānyavyatiriktasya vastudharmasya vastusvabhāvasya svalakṣaṇasyāsaṃsparśādagrahaṇāt | yataś ca svalakṣaṇan na gṛ hṇātyatha ca svākārābhinnamadhyavasyati | tata eva sā śrutiranyāpohaviṣayety ucyate |
 (p.233) nanu vidhirūpeṇa bāhyasyaivādhyavasāyāt kathamanyāpohaviṣayety ucyata ity āha – anyetyādi | vijātīvyāvṛtteṣvartheṣu vyāvṛttibhedamvijātīyavyacchinnasvabhāvam viśeṣeṇopādāya vijātīyavyāvṛttamātraṃ rūpamāḍritya sajātīyavyaktiṣu śabdasya niveśanāt saṃketakaraṇād ity arthaḥ | anenānyāpohāśritatvaṃ śruter ākhyātaṃ | anyaparihāreṇa pravṛttanād ity anyāpohaṃ prati karttṛ bhāvaḥ śruter uktaḥ |(|115||)
 avṛkṣetyādinā parasya codyamāśaṃkate (|) anyāpohavādinaḥ kila na vidhirūpeṇa vṛkṣārthasya grahaṇaṃ nāpyavṛkṣārthasya | kintvanyonyavyavacchedena (|) tatra (|)avṛkṣavyatirekeṇa vṛkṣārthagrahaṇe vṛkṣārthagrahaṇe vṛkṣaśabdasya yorthas tasya grahaṇe 'bhyupagamyamāne | dvayaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkwagrahaṇam anyonyāśrayaṃ | tathā hy avṛkṣārthavyavacchedena vṛkṣārthagrahaṇe saty avṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ vṛkṣagrahaṇamaṅgīkṛtaṃ | agṛhītasyāvṛkṣasya vyavacchetumaśakyatvāt | avṛkṣasyāpi grahaṇaṃ vṛkṣārthavyavacchedeneti tatrāpi vṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakam avṛkṣagrahaṇamāpatitaṃ | vṛkṣamagṛhītvā tadvyavacchedenāvṛkṣārthasya vyashāpayitum aśakyatvāt | evaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣayor madhye ekasya vṛkṣasyāvṛkṣasya vā grahābhāve dvayāgrahaḥ |
 yataś ca dvorapyagrahas tasmāt kāraṇād anyavyavicchinnerthe śabdasya yaḥ saṃketa uktas tasyāsambhava iti kecidācakṣate | tathā cāhodyotakaraḥ | sa yāvac cāgān na pratipadyate tāvadagaviṃ pratipattir na yuktā | yāvac ca gānna pratipadyate tāvad gavītyubhayapratipattyabhāva iti |
 etam evārtham bhaṭṭopy āha –
 siddhścāgaurapohyeta goniṣedhātmakaś ca saḥ |
 tatra naur eva vaktavyonanyo yaḥ pratiṣidhyate |
 sa cedagonivṛttyātmā bhavedanyonyasaṃśrayaḥ |
 siddhaś ced gaur apohyārthaṃ vṛthāpohapravarttanaṃ |
 gavyasiddhe tvagaur nāsti tadabhāvepi gauḥ kuta1. iti |
 fn. 1.: prakalpanāma also
 tasmād vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyameṣṭavyaṃ | tatra vidhirūpeṇaiva saṃketa iti te manyante |
 (p.234) yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasyety avṛkṣabhedalakṣaṇasya vṛkṣasya | evantāvan na vṛkṣasya grahaṇaṃ bāpyavṛkṣasyety āha (|) avijñātetyādi | avijñāto vṛkṣo yasya puṃsastena tadvyavacchedarūpasyeti vṛkṣavyavacchedarūpasya buddhāvanārūḍhertha iti (|) yadi vṛkṣāvṛkṣau buddhāvārūḍhau syātāṃ tadāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa vṛkṣe saṃketaḥ syāt | anārūḍhe na vṛkṣe 'vṛkṣe cārthe kathaṃ saṃketaḥ (|)
 teṣām ityādinā parasyāpyayandoṣastulya ity āha – tataś ca yas tasya parihāro mamāpi sa eteti bhāvaḥ |(|116||)
 ya ekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | anyavyavacchedena saṃkete kriyamāṇe ye vādina ekam vastu sāmānyam bhyugamyetaretarāśrayadoṣaṃ codayanti | teṣān tatrāpi vastubhūte sāmānye vṛkṣatvalakṣaṇe saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvayī kalpanā avṛkṣā vyavacchinna na veti |(|117||)
 yadi vyavacchinnāstadā te jñātā aṅgīkarttavyā | ajñātānāṃ vyavacchedābhāvāt | tac ca jñānanteṣu na yujyate | tad āha – katham ityādi | kathaṃ jñātā vṛkṣārthagrahaṇād ṛte | ityetāvān kārikābhāgaḥ | prākchabdas tu miśrakavyākhyānenopāttaḥ | vṛkṣārthagrahaṇam vinā prāg vṛkṣārthagrahaṇād avṛkṣāḥ | kathaṃ jñātā ity arthaḥ | ye tu prākśabdaṃ kārikāyāṃ paṭhanti tair arthaśabdo na paṭhitavyaḥ | na hy avṛkṣaniścayakāle vṛkṣārthagrahaṇam asty avṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt vṛkṣagrahaṇasya (|) na ca vṛkṣaniścayamantareṇa vṛkṣārthagraho yuktas tasyāpi vṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt | etad vāha – na hītyādi | tadeti saṃketakāle pratipattā | yasmai saṃketaḥ kriyate | kasmān na vettīty āha – tad ityādi | tasya vṛkṣāvṛkṣasya jñānāyaiva tadarthitayā saṃketārthitayopagamād upasthitatvāt | kathaṃ nāma saṃketottarakālaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñāsyāmīti | yadvā tadarthitayopagamād iti saṃketārthitayā pravṛtteḥ | ato nāsti saṃketakāle vṛkṣāvṛkṣajñānaṃ pratipattuḥ | sa ca vṛkṣāvṛkṣamajānānaḥ (p.235) katham avṛkṣavyavacchedaṃ pratipadyeta saṃkete | naiva pratipadyata | avṛkṣavyavacchedāpratipattau ca satyāmaparihṛto na vyavacchinnastadanyas tasmād vṛkṣād anyo yasmin vṛkṣārthe so parihṛtatadanyas tasmin niveśas saṃketaḥ | saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samasaḥ | sa yasmin śabdestīti matvarthīya iti | aparihṛtatadanyannirdeṣṭuṃ śīlam asyeti ṇinircā | avṛkṣādavyavacchinnerthe saṃpramugdharūpe saṃketitād iti yāvat |
 aparaḥ prakāraḥ | vṛkṣādanyastadanyastasminniveśaḥ saṃketaḥ | aparihṛtaś cāsau tadanyaniveśaś ceti kamadhārayaḥ | sa yasyāsti vṛkṣaśabdasyeti pūrvavat | avṛkṣād avyavacchinnatvād vṛkṣārthasya | tatra saṃkety amānasya śabdasyāvṛkṣepi viveśaḥ prasaktaḥ | vṛkṣabhedeṣv iveti samudāyārthaḥ |(|118)
 tasmād evaṃbhūd vṛkṣāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ vyavahārakāle tatparihāreṇāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa niyate śākhādimati pravṛttir na syāt | kintvaviśeṣaṇa vṛkṣāvṛkṣayoḥ pravṛttir bhavet | kimvat | vṛkṣabhedavat | na hi vṛkṣaśabdāt prakaraṇādirahitād vṛkṣaviśeṣe khadirādau tadanyavṛkṣaparihāreṇa pravṛttir bhavati | saṃketakāle teṣāmavyavacchedāt |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | saṃketakālaḥ saṃketaśabdenoktaḥ parārthavyavacchedeneti parasmād avṛkṣād vṛkṣād vṛkṣārthasyāvyavacchedena | dvitīye tu vyākhyāne (|) parisminnavṛkṣe vṛkṣaśabdasya saṃketāvyavacchedeneti vyākhyeyaṃ | niveśitād iti saṃketitāt | tatparihāreṇāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa vṛkṣavad ity asya vyākhyānaṃ śiṃśapādibhedavad iti | śiśapādaya eva bhedā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ vatiḥ saptamyarthe | sūtre tu vṛkṣabhedā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | śiṃśapādayo hi bhedā vṛkṣasya bhedā bhavantīty anurūpaiva vṛttiḥ teṣu ca yathā vṛkṣaśabdān na parasparavyacchedena pravṛttis tathā sūtravibhāga eva  vyākhyātaṃ |
 athetyādinā parābhiprāyamāśaṃkate | avidhāyāniṣidhyānyad iti pratiṣedhadvayaṃ (p.236) kecit paṭhanti | saṃkete viṣayamabhidhāyātonyavvāniṣidhyeti | taccāyuktam iva dṛśyate vidhipratiśedgau muktvā śabdapravṛttyasambhavāt | ekasya hi pradarśanam abhidadhatā vidheraṅgīkṛtaḥ | tataś cāvidhāya padarśyetipadadvayaṃ vyāhatam syāt | tasmād avidhāyety atraiva nañ draṣṭavyaḥ | avidhāya niṣidhyānyad iti pāṭhaḥ | niṣidhyānyat pūrvantadvyavacchedenāparaṃ saṃketaviṣayam avidhāya | pratiṣedhapūrvakaṃ vidhim akṛtvā vidhimātram eva kevalaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ ata | eva pradarśyaikam iti vṛttāv api na kasyācid vyavacchedena kiṃcid vidhīyata ity anyaniṣedhapūrvakam eva vidhānaṃ pratiṣedhati | kevalas tu vidhiraṅgīkṛta eva | ekam iti sāmānyaṃ | etena sāmānye saṃketakaraṇāt sarvavyaktiṣu kṛta iityācaṣṭe (|119||)
 vṛkṣoyam iti saṃketasvarūpandarśayati | yadvastu pradarśya saṃketaḥ kṛtastat pratipadyate vyavahārepi (|) tena kāranenāyamanantarokto vastusāmānyavādino 'doṣaḥ | tathā dṛṣṭam evārtham iti sāmānyaṃ yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ | tatsambandhinaṃ veti sāmānyasambandhinamāśrayaṃ | tatrāpīti vidhinā kevalenāpi saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvau vikalpau vṛkṣoyam iti saṃketaṃ kurvāṇaḥ tarurayam apīti vidadhīta | tarurayam eveti vā | ādye pakṣe tarutvamanyasyāpyaniṣiddham iti vyavahāre niyamena pravṛttir na syād iti sa eva prasaṅgaḥ | atha tarurayam eveti tadā sa evātaruravyavacchedoṅgīkṛtaḥ | tataś ca saṃketakāle pratipadyamānena kathaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñātāv iti tadavasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | tadāha (|) prasaṅgo na nivartata iti |
 ekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ayam api vṛkṣo 'yam eva vṛkṣa iti | gatim iti prakāraṃ | tayoś ceti dvayor api prakārayoḥ | na doṣa ityādi paraḥ | dṛṣṭopaṭākāronubhūtas tadviparītasya tato vilakṣaṇasya sujñānatvāt |
 (p.237) etad eva grahaṇakavākyam ekaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ekaṃ hi kiṃcit sāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvādikampaśyatonyatra tatsāmānyarahite lakṣaṇe vastuni tadvākāravivekinī yathā paridṛṣṭākāravilakṣaṇākārāmbuddhim anubhāvataḥ puṃso yathānubhavantato yathā paridṛṣṭādanyad ity evaṃrūpo vaidharmyaniścayo vailakṣaṇyaniścayaḥ |
 etena vaidharmyaniścayasya svabhāva uktaḥ |(|120||)
 tadvivecana iti vyāpāraḥ (pūrvadṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthavivecanaḥ) pṛthagbhāvasya vyavasthāpayati | tatonyad ity anenaiva tadvivecane siddhe yat punas tadvivecanagrahaṇantatspaṣṭārthaṃ | tatraitasmin krame sati yathānubhavamvaidharmyaniścayavān sa pratipattā | yaṃ śākhādimantam artham viśiṣṭasāmānyavantamākārāntarād vivecayati | taṃ purodhāyāyam eva vṛkṣaiti pradarśya vyutpāditaḥ saṃketaṃ grāhito | yatraiva taṃ saṃketānurūpaṃ sāmānyātmānan na paśyati | tam evāvṛkṣaṃ svayam eva śabdavyāpāramvinā pratipadyate | tad evam ākārāntarāt svayam eva vivekenāvadhāritaṃ sāmānyātmānamupādāya saṃkete kṛte sarvāsu sajātīyavyaktiṣu kṛto bhavati | sāmānyasya sarvatrānvayāt | ayam eveti cāvadhāraṇāt saṃkete kṛte dṛṣṭaviparītasya sujñānatvāt | tatonyatrāvṛkṣa iti niścayo bhavatīti na yathoktadoṣaḥ |
 anyāpohavādinopy evam iti ced āha – nedam ityādi | ekatra saṃketakāle dṛṣṭasyāsādhāraṇasya rūpasya kvacid vyaktyantare 'nanvayādananugamāt | tataś ca saṃketakāle yo vṛkṣa ity eva gṛhīto bhedas tasyānyatra darśanannāsti | tatra saṃketakāle dṛṣṭe paścād dṛṣyamāne ca svalakwane yad bhinnapratibhāsi darśanam utpannante hetunā | vṛkṣāvṛkṣayoḥ pratipattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ vyaktyantarepyanyasmin vṛkṣabhedepi ba syāt tayā vṛkṣa iti pratītiḥ | tathā hi yo vṛkṣabhedaḥ saṃketakāle dṛṣṭas tasmād ghaṭādayo vilakṣaṇās tathānyopi vṛkṣabhedaḥ | tatra yathā ghaṭādiṣu vṛkṣa iti pratipattir na bhavati tathā vṛkṣabhedepi na syāt kintvavṛkṣa ity eva pratioattir bhaved ity arthaḥ |
 evantarhīty ācāryaḥ tatrāpīti vikalpākāropi sāmānye saṃkete kriyamāṇe (p.238) tulyam etad itītaretarāśrayapratividhānaṃ |
 etad uktam bhavati | sarvabhāvāḥ svahetuto bhinnā iti pūrvam eva pratipāditaṃ | tena vṛkṣā avṛkṣāś ca bhinnā eva nirvikalpake jñāne pratibhāsante (|) vṛkṣeṣu ca vidhirūpenaiva vṛkṣavikalpa ucyate | tathāvṛkṣeṣu vṛkṣaniṣedhenāvṛkṣavikalpa utpadyata iti kuta itaretarāśrayatvam |
 nanu yady api vidhirūpeṇa vṛkṣavikalpasya pratipattis tathāpy avṛkṣādivyāvṛttidvāreṇotpadyamānatvād avṛkṣādipratipattyapekṣatvantataś ca sa evetaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ |
 naitad asti | yato 'vṛkṣādivyāvṛttir vṛkṣādisvarūpam eva tadanubhavadvāreṇaiva vṛkṣādivikalpa utpadyate na tvavṛkṣādipratipattyapekṣa iti kuta itaretarāśrayatvaṃ | tatra vṛkṣavikalpe pratyekaṃ śiṃśapādyabhedena vṛkṣākāro 'bhinnaḥ pratibhāsate | sa ca saṃketāt pūrvam svasamvedanapratyakṣasiddhaḥ jñānarūpatvād atas tatraiva śabdaḥ saṃketyate |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭena ||
 saṃketāt pūrvam indriyairanyāpoho na gamyate |
 nānyatra śabdasaṃketaḥ kin dṛṣṭvā sa prayujyatāṃ ||
 anvayena vimuktatvān nānumāoyatra vidyate |
 sambandhānubhavopyasya tena naivopadyata iti1.
fn. 1.:Ślokavārtika.
 nirastaṃ |
 kasmād itaretarāśrayapratividhānantulyam ity āha – yasmād ityādi | sajātīyavyaktiṣvekākārampratyabhijñānam ekapratyavamarśastathākhyā saṃjñā yasya jñānasya tattathā | anena bhinnāsvapi vyaktiṣvekākāraṃ pratyabhijñānam ekatvamāropayatīty uktaṃ | tataś ca vikalpavijñānāropataikatvāsu vyaktiṣu yatra kvacit saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ sarvatra kṛto bhavatīty asya bījam ākhyātam | ekatra hīty anena vijātīyapadārthaparāmarśaśūnyākārantena parāmarśasya pratiniyatākāratvam āha – vijātīyapadārthākāravyāvṛttyā sajātīyeṣu sarveṣu yadekapratyavamarśajñānantatra sthita ity arthaḥ | etenāpi sajātīyāsajātīyāvastuvibhāgabījam uktaṃ | ata evāha – tad ity anenaikaḥ parāmarśo gṛhyate 'tacchabdena tadviparītaḥ | sa cāsaś ca tadatau | tayor hetavastadataddhetavaḥ | tān vibhajate | ekaśākhādimadākāraparāmarśahetūn (p.239) tadviparītāṃś ca pṛthak karoti svayam eva saṃketāt (|) prāg api niveditam etad (|) ekapratyavamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhanaṃ (1|75) ity atrāntare | vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasya niṣedhānniṣetsyamānatvāc ca | bhāvāḥ prakṛtibhedinaḥ svabhāvenaiva vilakṣaṇāḥ (|) jjānādikam ityādiśabdād udakādyāharaṇādikaṃ kecid eva kurvanti nānye (||121||)
 prakṛtyā tadatajjananasvabhāvatvātteṣāṃ | tānbhāvānayaṃ pratipattā svayam eva sabdavyāpāraṃ vinā vibhajya vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā tadvetūnataddhetūṃlś ca pratyeti | tena kuta itaretarāśrayatvadoṣaḥ | yo hi taddhetūnataddetūṃlś ca bhāvātsvayam eva pratipadyate | tasya pratioattustadbuddhiparivartina ityādi karmapadaṃ pratipadyetety etat kriyāpadāpekṣaṃ | ataddhetubhyastaddhetūn vibhajya sthāpayati yā buddhiḥ sā (|) tad buddhis tatparivartittanastadārūḍhān | nikalpikāyā dhiyo hetutayā bhāto bhāsamānāt |
 iva śabdasya vakṣyamāṇasya sambandhāddhetutayeveti draṣṭavyaṃ na tu te vikalpapratibhāsino hetavasteṣāṃ bahirasatvāt | kevalam pratipattus tathādhyavasāyād evan ucyate | aheturūpavikalān bhāta ity atrābhisambandhaḥ | iva śabdayogaś ca pūrvavat | ekākāraparāmarśabuddherye na hetavasteṣaṃ rūpeṇa vikalāniva | dṛśyavikalpayorekīkaraṇād bāhyena sahaikarūpān iva bhāta ity atrābhisambandhaḥ | svayaṃ saṃketāduttarakālam api | atatkāribhyo bhedena tān bhāvān pratipadyeteti kṛtvā | uktiḥ śabdo bhede vijātīyavyāvṛtte svabhāve vikalpena svākārābhedenādhyaste niyujyate saṃketyate | tambhedaṃ yathoktaṃ | tasyāḥ śruteḥ sakāśād vyavahāre pratiyatī pratipadyamānā paridhīrbhrāntyā ekamvastvivekṣate | sajātīyavyaktiṣu tam iva jātīyavyāvṛttaṃ svabhāvaṃ svākārābhedena pratiyatī dhīrekam iva vastu prekṣata ity arthaḥ |
 tataḥ sarveṣv ekaparāmarśahetuṣu vṛkṣa iti pratipattir ato yad uktaṃ darśanena pratipattau vyaktyantarepi na syād iti tadapāstaṃ |

 apāstaṃ | yata ekasminn anyavyāvṛtte svalakṣaṇe śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ sambandham pratipadyamānopy anyatrāpy evaṃ rūpeṣu sambandhaṃ pratipadyata evaikatvādhyavasāyād iti kṛtonvayarahitatvādidoṣa iti | vastubhūtantu sāmānyam āśritya vṛkṣāvṛkṣavibhāgo na ghaṭate | tadāha (|) na punar ityādi | ekam vastu sāmānyaṃ dṛśyam upalabdilakṣaṇaprāptan tatra svalakṣaṇeṣv asti | yathā vṛkṣabhedebhyo ghaṭādayo bhinnās tathā dhavādayopi (|) parasparanteṣāmbhinnānāndarśanepi yasya sāmānyasya darśanādarśanābhyāṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣavibhāgaṃ kurvīta yatredaṃ sāmānyaṃ dṛśyate sa vṛkṣo yatra na dṛśyate so 'vṛkṣa iti |

 anyāpohe śabdārthaparairavyāpitvaṃ coditaṃ tatparijihīrṣavān pūrvapakṣadigmātrantāvat (p.243) karoti | bhavatu nāmetyādi | kasmāt tatrārthāntaravyavacchedo nāstīty āha – na hy ajñeyam ityādi | yata ity ajñeyāt | ajñeyaṃ kasmān nāstīti ced āha – tata ityādi | ajñeyād vijñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇam aṅgīkarttavyam anyavyavacchedavādinā 'nyathā katham ajñeyāt jñeyasya vyavacchedaḥ | tataś cājñeyāt jñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇe saty eva tasyājñeyābhimatasya jñeyatvāt | na hyaviṣayīkṛtād vyavacchedaḥ śakyo darśayituṃ | ādiśabdāt sarvasamudāyadvyādiśabdānāṃ grahaṇaṃ |
 taduktambha ṭṭo dyo ta ka rā bhyāṃ | anyāpohaś ca śabdārtha ityayuktam avyāpakatvāt | yatra dvairāśyam bhavati tatretarapratiṣedhāditaraḥ pratīyate yathā gaur iti pade 'goḥ pratiṣedhena gauḥ pratīyate |

 etad eva sādhayannāha – yathetyādi | "atra ṭṭayudakamānaye"ty ukte śrotuḥ karaṇaviśeṣe 'vaśyamākāṃkṣā bhavati tatra ca niyamārthaṃ "ghaṭene"ty ucyate | soyaṃ ghaṭo neti śabdaḥ svārthābhidhānapurassaram eva karaṇāntaravyavacchedākṣepāt phalavān bhavaty anyathā saty api ghaṭaśabdaprayoge yadi nāñjalinā tathānyenāpi karaṇenodakānayanaṃ yathā kathaṃ cid iti | alpapramāṇaṃ bahupramāṇaṃ vā jalānayanasabhipretam ity arthaḥ | udakaśabdopi karmāntaravyavacchedena yadi viśiṣṭe karmaṇi na pravarttakas tadā  tasyāpi prayogonarthaka ity āha – tathe tyādi | ānayety eva kevalam vacanaṃ syāt (|) kiṃ bhūtam anākṣiptakaraṇakarmakaṃ | anākṣiptaviśeṣaṇānāśritaṃ karaṇaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ karma codanākhyaṃ yasminn ānayetyetāvati vacane tattathoktaṃ | tathānayety asmin vyāpārebhimukhī bhūtaḥ pumān | ānayety anena yady ānayanādanyasmād vyāpārān na vyavacchidyeta tadā 'nayety api na vācyaṃ syāt |
 ( p.245) etad eva āha – evamānayanam ityādi | anyad vā kiñ cid anuṣṭhānam iti | ānayanādanyat | kim (|) bhojanādyanuṣṭhānaṃ | ananuṣṭhānaṃ ceti vyāpārākaraṇamanānayanaṃ ca yady abhimataṃ syāt tadā kriyāpadamānayety api na brūyāt | nayanam anyad veti kva cit pustake pāṭhaḥ sa ttba(?tva) yuktaḥ | ānayanaśabdasya prakrāntatvāt | tasmād vyavahāropanītānāṃ ghaṭādiśabdānām asti vyavacchedyo yathā teṣāntathā vyavahāropanītānāṃ jñeyādiśabdānāṃ kena cid vyavacchedyenājñeyādinā |
 ananyāsaṅkāyām ityajñeyatvāder āśaṅkā 'nyāśaṅkā | tadabhāvonanyā śaṅkā | asatyām ajñeyatvādyāśaṅkāyām ity arthaḥ | tathā hy anityādirūpeṇājñeyaḥ śabda ity āśaṃkāyām idaṃ prayujyate 'nityādinākāreṇa jñeya iti | tatrānityādyākāreṇa yadajñeyatvam āśaṃkitaṃ tadeva vyavacchidyate | evaṃ jñeyāssarvapadārthāssarva (jña) jñānasyety atrāpi sa rva jña jñānāpekṣayā yadajñeyatvam āśaṃkitantad eva vyavacchedyaṃ | tathā kaś cid āha – nirupākhyānām abhāvā tatra jñānasya vṛttirnāsti tasmād ajñeyāsta iti | atrāpy ajñeyatvam āropitan tad eva vyavacchedyaṃ | sarvābhāvo na bhavatīty evam abhāvasyāpi viṣayīkaraṇāt | evam anyatrāpi jñeyaśabdaprayoge vācyaṃ | tathā prameyaśabde | tathā "kṣaṇikāssarve saṃskārā" ity atrāpi sarvasya dīpāder eva kṣaṇikatvaṃ kaiś cit kalpitan na sarvasya (|) tadvyavacchedena sarvasaṃskārāṇām anityatvaṃ | evaṃ kaś cid āgataḥ kim vā sarva evety āśaṅkāyāṃ sarvo grāma āgataḥ | iti kasya cid eva yadā gamanam āśakitan tad eva vyavacchedyaṃ | tathā samudāyālambanaḥ pañca vijñānakāyā iti caikadeśālambanā ity ekadeśālambanatvaṃ niṣidhyate | evam anyeṣv api dvyādiśabdeṣu vyavahāropanīteṣu prakaraṇavaśād yathāyogaṃ vyavacchedo vaktavyaḥ |

 bhavatu nāma vākyasthānāṃ vyavahārārtham upanītānāṃ jñeyādiśabdānāṃ yathoktaṃ vyavacchedyaṃ | ye tv avyavahāropanītāḥ kevalā eva jñeyādiśabdās teṣu kathaṃ | na hi tatra pratipattur āśaṅkāsthānam astīty ata āha – avyavahāropanītāś cetyādi | vā kyeṣvanantarbhūto vācakaḥ śabdo nāstīty arthaḥ | yato vaktā phalārthī prathamantāvadimamartham viśiṣṭakriyāsambaddham anena śabdenāsmai pratipādayāmīty abhiprāyeṇa "devadatta gāmānaye"ty evaṃ prayukte | tena kriyānvitānām eva padārthānām abhidhānaṃ | na tv abhihitānām padārthānām paścādanvayaḥ | gām ityādau karmādivibhakter anutpādaprasaṅgāt | tasmād vākyasthānām eva prayogaḥ | tadevāha – vākyagatasyetyādi | tasyaivārthapratipādakatvād iti bhāvaḥ |
 ye tu vaiyākaraṇaiḥ sarvaviśvetyādigaṇeṣu paṭhyante | prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena vā saṃskṛyante | tathā niruktakāraiḥ (|) tepi rekhāgavayasthānīyā vākyasthānām eva pratipattyupāyā draṣṭavyā na tu teṣāṃ laukikaḥ kaś cid arthosti | tasmāt vākyasthānām eva padānām arthavattā | tatraiva cāvasthitānām arthacintā kriyate | tadāha – kva punar ityādi | eta iti ye vākyasthāḥ prayogaviṣayacintāyāṃ pravarttamānāyām anyāpohaḥ śabdārtha udyate | anyo 'pohyate 'neneti kṛtvā | ye tv aprayogasthā jñeyādiśabdāsteṣāmarthāsambhavāc cintaiva nāstīty āha – anirdiṣṭaprayogam ityādi | nirdiṣṭa upāttas tathā cosau prayogaś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | paścān nañā sahābhāvārthe 'vyayaṃ bhivaktītyādinā 'vyayībhāvaḥ | tataś ca saptamyāstṛtīyā saptamyorbahulam 1* ity ambhāvaḥ | upāttaprayogābhāve sati vākyenupanītasya kevalasya jñeyaśabdasya kortha iti praśna ity arthaḥ | (p.247) kriyāviśeṣaṇam etad ity apare | praśnakriyā hi viśeṣyā | kriyāviśeṣaṇānāñ ca karmatvam iti | atra ca yadi karmmadhārayasamāsastasya svapadārthavṛttitvāt kathan tena praśnakriyāviśeṣiteti vaktavyaṃ |

 athānirdiṣṭaḥ prayogo yasmin jñeyaśabda iti bahuvrīhis tadāpi śabdo viśeṣito na kriyā | yadā tvevamvigraho 'nirdiṣṭaḥ prayogo yasmin praśna iti tadā bhavati kriyāviśeṣāt tadāpi praśnaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt saptamy eva yuktā 'nirdiṣṭaprayoge praśna iti | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ kevalasya jñeyaśabdasyārtho neti ced āha – tata iti (|) tato jñeyaśabdāt kva cid (api na) vastupratipatteḥ | vidhioratiṣedhaphale vyavahāre ca kevalasya jñeyaśabdasya prayogābhāvāt kutorthapratipattiḥ | yadādiśabdo 'nityādirūpeṇa kiṃ jñeyo bhavaty athājñeya ity evaṃ prakrānte jñeya iti kevalaḥ prayujyate | tadāpi yārthapratipattiḥ sā prakṛtaṃ śabdād apadam apekṣya bhavantī vākyād eva jāyate | padāntarasahitasya padasya vākyatvāt | tasmān nāsti padāntaranirapekṣāt padārthapratipattiḥ | yathā jñeyādipadānāṃ kevalānāṃ na kiṃ cid vācyaṃ tathā ghaṭādiśabdānām api kevalānāṃ |
 nanu ca kiṃ ghaṭodakamānayāmyathāñjalineti prastāve | ghaṭeneti prayukte | tatra ca yaḥ prakaraṇaṃ na jñātavān tasyāpi pratipatturghaṭeneti kevalaśabdaśravaṇād ghaṭākārā pratipattir utpadyata eveti katham ucyate kevalāc chabdād na pratipattir ity āha – yāpītyādi | aparisamāptaḥ sa jijñāsitortho yasyāṃ pratipattau sā 'parisamāptatadarthā | katham aparisamāptatadarthatety āha – dṛṣṭaprayogānusāreṇeti | yāvatsu nayanānayanādikriyācodanāpravṛtteṣu | tena ghaṭaśabdasya prayogo dṛṣṭas tadanusāreṇa tāvatsu pūrvavākyeṣv ākāṃkṣāvatī pratītir bhavati kimayamartho vivakṣitaḥ kimvāyam ityevaṃ sākāṃkṣatvād upaplavamānaṃ rūpatvenāsamāptārthā viplavabhrāntir eva | etat kathayati (|) naiva kevalaśabdamātraśravaṇād arthapratipattir asti kin tu vākyeṣūpalabdhasyārthavataḥ padasya sādṛśyenopahṛtabuddheḥ kevalaśabdaśravaṇād arthapratipattyabhimāna iti | yathā dṛṣṭaprayogānusāreṇa kevalaghaṭādipadaśravaṇād arthapratipattirviplavastādṛśo jñeyādiśabdeṣv api (|) yathā darśanaṃ | yathā prayogopalambhaṃ | yāvatsu vākyeṣu jñeyaśabdaḥ prayujyamāno dṛṣṭas tadanusāreṇa kevalajñeyaśabdaśravaṇād asty evārthapratipattiviplavaḥ | anena sarvathā ghaṭādiśabdair jñeyādiśabdānāntulyatām āha –
 yac cāpy uktam (|) "ekādivyudāsena pravarttamānaḥ saravaśabdāṅge pratiṣedhād aṅgavyatiriktasya (p.248) cāṅginonabhyupagamād anarthakaḥ syād iti |
 tadayuktaṃ | yatonya evaikādibuddhiviṣayābhāvā anye ca samudāyādibuddhiviṣayāḥ pratibhāsante | ye ca viśiṣṭāvasthāḥ samudāyādibuddhiviṣayāsta evāṅgina ucyantenyasyāṅgino niṣedhāt | yādṛgbhūtāś ca te pareṇa samudāyādidharmārambhakā iṣyante tādṛgbhūtā evāsmābhiḥ samudāyabuddhijanakatvena tadālambanā iṣyante virodhābhāvāt | tena sarvasamudāyadvitvādiśabdānām ekādiniṣedho ghaṭata eva |
 tasmād ityādi | yataḥ sarvaṃ vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇam vākyasthānam eva padānām arthavattā | tasmāt sarvaśabdaprayoga ity upasaṃhāraḥ | tatsāphalyāt tasya śabdaprayogasya sāphalyāt | evaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ yathoktavidhinā 'nyāpohe vācye |

 "anyāpohaś ca kim vācyaḥ kim vā 'vācyoyam iṣyate |
 vācyopi vidhirūpeṇa yadi vānyaniṣedhataḥ ||
 vidhyātmanāsya vācyatve tyājyam ekāntadarśanaṃ |
 sarvatrānyaniṣedhoyaṃ śabdārtha iti varṇṇitaṃ ||
 anapohavyudāsena yadyopohobhidhīyate |
 tatra tatraivam icchāyām anavasthā bhavettava ||
 athāpy avācya evāyamanyāpohastvayeṣyate |
 tenānyāpohakṛcchabda iti bādhyate te vacaḥ ||
 yasmād yeṣveva śabdeṣu nañ yogasteṣu kevalaḥ |
 bhaved anyanivṛttyaṃśassvātmaivānyatra gamyata" iti ||
 tadayukataṃ | vidheḥ śabdārthasyārthādanyaniṣedhasyābhyupagamāt |
 yadi tarhi vidhir eva śabdārthorthādanyaniṣedhaḥ (|) kathan tahyācārya diṅnāgena "śabdorthāntaravyāvṛttiviśiṣṭān eva bhāvānāhe"tyādy uktaṃ (|) (|124-25||)
 na virudhyata ityata āha – niveśanaṃ cetyādi | anena caitad darśayati (|) saṃketepi tāvad vidhirūpeṇa śabdaḥ pravartate kiṃ punar vyavahāra iti | yo vṛkṣārtho yasmād (p.249) avṛkṣād ghaṭāder bhidyate vinivarttyeta sa vṛkṣantyaktvety arthaḥ | niveśanaṃ saṃketakaraṇaṃ vakṣaśabdasya draṣṭavyaṃ | tamvinivṛttyety anenāvṛkṣe vṛkṣaśabdo na saṃkety ata ity uktam bhavati | kva punas tanniveśanam ity āha – bhedee bhidyamānānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ yas tadbhedas tasmād avṛkṣād bhedaḥ | avṛkṣād bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ | yathaiva hyoko vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasmād vṛkṣād bhinnas tathā sarve vṛkṣabhedāḥ |
 tatas tesv asau tadbhedo vikalpabyddhyā sarve≈v ekatvenāropyata iti samānākārabhāsṇī bhavati | tasmān samānākārabhāsini tadbhede bhinnasv abhāve niveśanaṃ śabdasya | sa cāyam iti caaśabdovadhāraṇārthaḥ | sa evāyamvikalpapratibhāsyākāro bāhyābhinnaḥ |
 yadvā sa eva tadbhedo 'vṛkṣād bhinnasv abhāvalakṣaṇaḥ prokta ācārya diṅnāgena | kathaṃ prokta ity āha – anyavyāvṛttyā gamyate tasya vastunaḥ kaś cid bhāga ityanena | asya cārthamvṛttau vyaktīkariṣyāmaḥ |
 nanv anyavyāvṛttyā viśiṣṭo vastubhāgaḥ paramārthata eva kasmān na gṛhyata ity āha – rūpaṃ svabhāvo nāsyāpi bhedasya kiñ cana nivṛttirūpasya bhedasyāsattvāt | vikalpapratibhāsinaś ca buddhivibhramāt |
 yadi bhedasya na rūpaṃ kiñ cana kathan tarhi śabdonyavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭān eva bhāvānāhety ucyata ityata āha – tadgatāv ityādi | tasya yathoktasya bhedasya vijātīyavyāvṛttasya svabhāvasya vidhirūpeṇa gatāv eva śabdebhyo gamyatenyanivartanaṃ | (|127|)
 tathā hi vṛkṣa ity ukte 'rthād avṛkṣanivartanaṃ pratīyate | etāvanmātreṇa cānyavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭatvam uktaṃ | na tu paramārthato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | tad āha – netyādi | tatretyanyāpohe śabdārthe ācāryagranthe vā | kaś cit para ity anyasmād vyāvṛttorthaḥ | kenacidanyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇena viśiṣṭo na gamyata iti |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭena |
 "na cāsādhāraṇam vastu gamyate 'pohavattayā |
 kathaṃ vā parikalpyeta sambandho vastv avastunoḥ ||
 svarūpasattvamātreṇa na syāt kiñ cid viśeṣaṇaṃ |
 (p.250)svabuddhyā rajyate yena viśeṣyantadviśeṣaṇaṃ ||
 na cāpy aśvādiśabdebhyo jāyate 'pohabodhanaṃ |
 viśeṣyabuddhiriṣṭeha na cājñātaviśeṣaṇā ||
 na cānyarūpamanyādṛk kuryājjñānaviśeṣaṇaṃ |
 kathaṃ cānyādṛśe jñāne tad ucyeta viśeṣaṇaṃ |
 abhāvagamyarūpe ca na viśeṣyesti vastutā |
 viśeṣitamapohena vastu vācyaṃ na testyata( ḥ || )" 1*

 nanv ekasya śabdasya kathaṃ vidhipratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ vyāpāradvayam (|) āha –
 na cāpi śabdo dvayakṛt | svārthābhidhānam anyavyāvarttanaṃ ca dvayaṃ karoti (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) anyonyābhāva iti | itiśabdo hetau | yasmād avṛkṣabhedābhāvo vṛkṣārthastadabhāvaś cāvṛkṣārtha itaretarābhāvatvena | tasmād vṛkṣaśabdād vṛkṣārthapratipattyaivārthād avṛkṣanivṛttipratipattir api bhavatīti na dvau vyāpārau sākṣāc chabdasya | tena |
 "yadi gaur ity ayaṃ śabdaḥ samarthonyanivartane |
 janako gavi gobuddher mṛgyatāmaparo dhvaniḥ ||
 na ca jñānaphalāḥ śabdā na caikasya phaladvayaṃ |
 apavādavidhijñānaṃ phalam ekasya vaḥ katham (|)"
iti nirastaṃ | yadi śabdavācyo bhedassarvatrānuyāyo tad eva tarhi pāramārthikaṃ sāmānyam bhaviṣyatīty ata āha – asāv iti śabdaviṣayonuyāyī bhedaḥ arūpo niḥsvabhāvaḥ | tasminn arūpe dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkṛtya vaktuśrotroryadrūpavattvena darśanantadbuddhiviplavo bhrāntir ity arthaḥ |
 niveśyamāna ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yasmād bhidyate vṛkṣādikorthastannivarttya (p.251) tattyaktvā niveśyata iti sambandhaḥ | kutrety āha – bhidyamānānām ityādi | etac ca kārikā vyākhyāne vibhaktārthaṃ | ākṣiptā tadanyavyāvṛttieyena śabdeneti vigrahaḥ | sa eva cāyaṃ samānarūpapratibhāsī bhedo nirddiṣṭa ācāryadiṅnāgena | katham ityāha – arthāntaravyāvṛttyā tasya vastunaḥ kaś cid bhāgo gamyata iti | tathā śabdorthāntaranivṛttiviśiṣṭān eva bhāvānāhetyādinā | ādigrahaṇāc chabdārthāntarāpohaṃ kurvatī śrutir abhidhatta ityādi parigrahaḥ |
 sa hītyādyasyaiva samarthanaṃ | sa hi vṛkṣaśabdastambhedam avṛkṣavyāvṛttaṃ svabhāvaṃ kathayannārthāntarasyāvṛkṣārthasya vyavacchedam ākṣipann eva varttate | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) ekagatabhedasyetyādi | yathā hi vṛkṣabhedā eva khadirādayaḥ svabhāvenaivāvṛkṣebhyo bhinnā evam avṛkṣā api vṛkṣebhyaḥ bhedasya dviṣṭatvāt | tatra vṛkṣaśabdenaikagatasya vṛkṣārthagatasya bhedasya bhinnasya svabhāvaasyaikākārapratibhāsino yā codanā tasyāstadanyavyāvṛtti nāntarīyakatvāt | tasmād vṛkṣārthādanyasyāvṛkṣasya yā vyāvṛttis tannāntarīyakatvāt | evaṃ hyavṛkṣād vyāvṛttarūpo vṛkṣārtho 'bhihitaḥ syād yady avṛkṣārthasya tatra nivṛttir gamyeta | sa evānyasmād bhidyamānasya vikalpabuddhipratibhāsī bhedo bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ | tadvyāvṛttyā 'rthāntaravyāvṛttyā yathoktanyāyenārthād gamyamānayā | gato ca buddho bhāgo vastuna ityukta ity adhyāhāraḥ | vyāvṛttavastudarśanadvārāyātatvād vasturūpatvenādhyavasāyāc ca vastubhāgo gata ity ucyata ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 etaduktam bhavati (|) atatparāmarśajananebhyo vyāvṛttarūpantatparāmarśajananeṣvāropitaikatvaṃ vikalpabuddhipratibhāsanam evākāramavibhaktabāhyādhyātmikabhedaṃ śabdaḥ pratipādayati śābde jñāne tasyaiva pratibhāsanāt | tañ ca pratipādayann anyavyāvṛttim arthād ākṣipati (|) atonenābhiprāyeṇoktam ācāryeṇānyavyāvṛttyā gamyate tasya vastunaḥ kaś cid bhāga iti | na punar anyavyāvṛttyā śabdārthabhūtayā viśeṣaṇarūpayā bāhyasya vastunaḥ kaś cid bhāgo gṛhyate 'nyavyāvṛtter evābhāvād iti | evantāvadanyavyāvṛttyā gamyate tasya vastunaḥ kaś cid bhāga ity etatsamarthitaṃ |
 adhunā śabdārthāntaranivṛttiviśiṣṭān eva bhāvānāhety etatsamarthayann āha – tadgater ityādi | tadgater anyanivṛttigates tadupādhitvād asti bhedopādhitvāt (|) sa eva (p.252) bhedas tadviśiṣṭo ity ucyate | ācāryeṇeti |
 yad vā (|) tasya yathoktasya vastubhedasya śabdād gateḥ pratipatteḥ sāvadhāraṇatvena tadupādhitvāt | sā tadanyanivṛttir upādhir arthākṣepād yasyās tadgateḥ sā tathoktā | tadanyanivṛttināntarīyakatvam eva tadupādhitvaṃ |
 etaduktam bhavati | yārthāntaravyāvṛttir arthād gamyate tannāntarīyakatvāt sa eva bhedaḥ śabdād gamyamānonyavyāvṛttyā viśiṣṭo gata ity ucyata ācāryeṇeti |
 nanv arthāntaravyāvṛttḥ śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtā | yayā viśiṣṭā bāhyā arthā gavādiśabdaiś codyante apratīteḥ | daṇḍivad iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā daṇḍadvāreṇa tadvān daṇḍīty ucyate | naivaṃ vyāvṛttidvāreṇa vyāvṛttimān iti | kasmād vyāvṛttirarthāntarabhūtā nety āha – dvayorhītyādi | yasmād dvayorvṛkṣāvṛkṣayoḥ parasparam bhidyamānayor yo bhedas tasyobhayagatatvāt | vṛkṣāvṛkṣagatatvād vṛkṣāvṛkṣabhinnasv abhāvatvād ity arthaḥ | tenaikagatabhedābhidhānepi | avṛkṣāpekṣayā vṛkṣagato yo bhedaḥ | bhinnaḥ svabhāvas tasya śabdenābhidhānepi nāntarīyakas tadanyākṣepo bhavati | avṛkṣāpekṣayā vṛkṣagatasya bhedasyāvṛkṣanivṛttilakṣaṇasya vṛkṣāpakṣayāpy avṛkṣagatasya vṛkṣanivṛttilakṣaṇasyākṣepo bhavati | itiśabdo hetau | asmādd hetos tadupādhitvāt tadviśiṣṭo gata ity uktam ity adhyāhāraḥ | na tayor ity ekagatasya bhedasya tadanyavyāvṛtteś ca na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
 kaḥ punar ayam ekaagato bhedaḥ kā ca tadanyavyāvṛttir yenānyavyāvṛttināntarīyakasyaikagatabhedasya śabdāt pratyayo bhavatīti cet |
 ucyate | vṛkṣaśabdavācyas tāvad vikalpabuddhipratibhāsī śākhādimadākāraḥ sarvavṛkṣeṣv abhinnarūpa ivātadrūpebhyo bhinna iva bhāsamāna eva gato bhedo bhinnaḥ svabhāva ity arthaḥ | evaṃ ghaṭādiśabdavācyopy ekagato bhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | tambhedaṃ ca pratipādayan  śabdo vijātīyanivṛttiṃ prasajyapratiṣedhalakṣaṇārthād gamayati sā tadanyavyāvṛttiḥ |
 nanu yady anyavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭo vastubhāgo na gamyate kim arthantarhy anyavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭa ityādyuktam ity āha – ekabhedābhidhāna ityādi | yaś cāyaṃ yathā vibhakta ekagato bhedaḥ sa eva śabdena codyate (|) tatpratītir evānvayagatiḥ (|) yā tvarthād (p.253) anyavyāvṛttigatiḥ sā vyatirekagatiḥ (|) evam anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdorthavān bhavati (|) tenānvayavyatirekacodanayānvayasya sākṣādarthāt tu vyatirekasya codanā draṣṭavyā | tayā codanayā vyavahārāṅgatāṃ śabdānāṃ darśayannācārya diṅnāga āha "tadvyāvṛttyā gamyate vastubhāga" iti | tathā tadviśiṣṭo vetyāha – vyāvṛttiśabdena vyatireka uktaḥ | vastubhāgaśabdenānvayaḥ | anenaitad api vyākhyātaṃ śabdāntarāpohaṃ kuruvantī śrutiḥ svārtham abhidhatta ity arthaḥ | tatra yosāvekagato bhego vikalpabuddhipratibhāsī vyākhyātaḥ sa eva svārthas tatrārthāntaravyāvṛttir arthāntarāpohaḥ prasajyapratiṣedhalakṣaṇastaṃ kurvatītyarthād gamayantīty arthaḥ |
 yadi cānyanivṛttipurassaraiva vṛkṣādiśabdapravṛttistadānvayavyatirekacodanayetyādivyākhyānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt |
 tasmād vidhir eva śabdārthaḥ |
 yata evaikabhedābhidhāne 'rthād anyavyāvṛttigatir ata evetyādi | svārthasya bhedarūpatvād iti | yo vṛkṣaśabdasyārthaḥ śākhādimadākāraḥ | vikalpapratibhāsī sa bhedarūpaḥ | bhinnasvabhāvo 'bhedākāravyāvṛttatvāt svayaṃ | ato bhedarūpasya svārthasyābhidhānād evārthād anyavyāvṛttigatir evaṃ hyavṛkṣād bhedarūpasyaiva vṛkṣārthasya gatir bhavet |
 yady arthāt tatra vṛkṣanivṛttir bhavatīti | tasmāt svārthābhidhānam eva śabdasya vyāpāronyavyāvarttanantvarthād iti na śabdasya vyāpāradvayaṃ |
 nanu vidhāyakena vākyenānvayamātram pratipādyate nānyasya vidhānaṃ pratiṣedho vā | niṣedhakenāpi niṣedhamātram eva kevalaṃ pratīyate nānyasya vidhānaṃ pratiṣedho vetyata āha –
 na hy anvaya ityādi | pratiniyatasyārthasya vidhānam anvayo yathā vṛkṣaṃ cchindhīti | tatrāvṛkṣasyārthān nivṛttir vyatirekaḥ | sa yatra na vidyate sovyatireka evaṃ bhūtonvayo na me sti | kin tu sarva eva sa vyatirekaḥ |
 tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ (|)

 na bhaved vyatirekopi tasya tatpūrvako hyasāv" iti 1*

 (p.254) nirastam iṣṭatvāt | ananvayo vānvayarahito vā vyatireko na hīti sambhandhaḥ | tatra viśeṣasya pratiṣedho vayatirekaḥ | tatrārthāc cheṣagatr anvayaḥ | ekānvaya ityādinaitad eva samarthyate | ekānvayasyety ekasya vidhānasya parihāryābhāve vyavacchedyābhāve niṣphalacodanatvāt |
 yadi vṛkṣañ chindhīty ukterthādavṛkṣasya na tatra vyavacchedas tadā vṛkṣaśabdaprayogo niṣphalaḥ syāt | yad vā kimvṛkṣañchinaṭmi utānyam iti śrotur jijñāsāyāṃ satyāṃ vṛkṣañchindhītyuktenyanuṣedhaḥ pratīyata evānyathā parihāryābhāve niṣphalam abhidhānaṃ syāt | tathā yadāpy ākāṃkṣārahitaḥ śrotā vṛkṣañ chindhīti śabdena codyate tadāpi vṛkṣa eva pravartate nānyatra (|) vaktā hi vṛkṣa evāyaṃ pravartate nānyatratyanenābhiprāyeṇa śabdaṃ prayuṅkte | vivakṣānugamanaṃ ca dhvaneḥ | tasmān nāsti vyatirekarahitonvayas tathaikaparihārasyety ekapratiṣedhasya pratiśedhasyaivaikasyety arthaḥ | kva cid iti pratiṣedhena viṣayīkṛte vastuni sthityabhāve niṣphalacodanatvāt | tathā hi surāviṣayasya pānasya pratiśedhe | yadi surāyā anyatrāpi pānasya nāvasthānaṃ syāt | tadā sarvasmin viṣaye niṣidvasya pānasya viśeṣe pratiṣedhonarthakaḥ | tatra surā (')peyeti surāpānamātrasya pratiśedhe caritārthatvāt vākyasya yady apy udakādipānaṃ śabdena na vidhīyate | tathāpi surāyā anyatra pānasyāvasthānan na nivāryeta ity arthād anvayagatir anyathā surāgrahaṇam anarthakaṃ syāt | yad vā kim udakādivat surā pātavyā kim vā neti praśne surā na pātavyety ukte suraiveti pratīter nādakādipānavidhānaṃ prakṛtan niṣedhyate (|) tena sarvatra vidhipratiṣedharūpasyaiva śabdārthatvaṃ |
 kas tarhi vidhipratiṣedhaparyudāsavākyānām bhedaḥ | mahānbhedaḥ | vidhāyakaṃ hi vākyam vidhiṃ prādhānyenābhidhāyānyaniṣedhakam arthāt | niṣedhakaṃ ca niṣedhaṃ prādhānyenābhidhāyārthād anyavidhānam āha – paryudāsapratipādakan tu vākyaṃ pratiṣedhapūrvakam anyavidhānaṃ prādhānyenāhety asty eva viśeṣa iti |
 nanu yady anyanivṛttir arthāt pratīyate saiva tarhi pāramārthikī bhāvānām asti yayā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta ity evaṃ kasmān neṣyate (|) kiṃ purar evaṃ tadgates tadupādhitvāt tadviśiṣṭo gata iti vyākhyāyata ity ata āha – sa cāyam ityādi (|) yo bhedo vyāvṛttilakṣaṇa ācārya diṅnāgena viśeṣaṇatvanābhimataḥ sa cāyam rūpo niḥsvabhāvaḥ | (p.255) nāsya vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā rūpam astīti kṛtvā | kathan tarhi bhāvānāṃ vijātīyād bheda iti pratītir iti ced āha – rūpavattvena bhāvasaṃbandhitvena tasya bhedasya kevalan darśanam pratītir vipravo bhrāntiḥ (|) kevalam iti tathābhūtabāhyanirapekṣaṃ (|) kārikāyām apy evaṃ vyākhyānaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | (|126-29||)
 nanu yadi rūpavattvena darśanaṃ kathaṃ buddhiviplava ity ata āha – tenaivety ādi | rūpavattvena bhāvasambandhitvena yaddarśanam bhedasya tenaivāparamārtho na vastubhūto 'sattvāt | asāv iti bhedaḥ prasajyarūpaḥ | anyathety evam aniṣyamāṇe | na hi vastunaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sambandhinī vyāvṛttir vastu bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) bhedosyāsmāditīraṇāt |
 etad uktam bhavati | yadi hi sā vastubhūtā syāt tadā vṛkṣebhyo 'vṛkṣavyāvṛttir abhinnā bhinnā vā syāt | yady abhinnā | asmād avṛkṣād vṛkṣasya bheda iti vyatirekapratītir na syāt | palāśāc caikasmād avṛkṣavyāvṛtter abhinnatvāt | dhavādīnāmavṛkṣavyāvṛttir na syāt | palāśavat tatsvabhāvāyā vyāvṛttes teṣv ananugamāt | atha palaśād bhinnā sā | tatrāpy avṛkṣavyāvṛtteḥ sakāśāt palāśasya vyāvṛttiḥ syād avṛkṣavyāvṛtteś ca vyāvarttamānsya palāśasyāvṛkṣarūpatā syād avṛkṣavat | tataś cāsmād avṛkṣādasya vṛkṣasya bheda iti pratītir na syād iṣyate ca | tasmāt tadvyāvṛttir na vastu | bhedosyāsmāditīraṇād uccāraṇād ity arthaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat pratīter api grahaṇaṃ |
 rūpaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | hi yasmāt | rūpaṃ kim ucyate paramārthaḥ | vastusvabhāvaḥ | bhedonyavyāvṛttir yadi rūpaṃ syād yadi svabhāvo bhavet | tad ity avṛkṣād vyāvṛttirūpaṃ | tadrūpam iti yat tadvyāvṛttaṃ palāśasvalakṣaṇaṃ tadātmakaṃ | atadrūpaṃ veti tatonyad ity arthaḥ | vastunas tattvānyattvān atikramād ity arthaḥ |
 tādrūpya ityādinā prathamapakṣe doṣam āha – tādrūpye palāśād anyetve yayā vyāvṛttyā sāmānyabhūtayā sarve vṛkṣabhedāḥ vyāvṛttā dṛṣṭās tasyās tādrūpye palāśād ananyatvebhyupagamyamāne tadeva palāśasvalakṣaṇam eva vyāvṛttir iti kṛtvā palāśa evāvṛkṣād bhinnaḥ prāpnoti nānyo dhavādiḥ | tata ity avṛkṣād bhidyeta | kiṅ kāraṇam ity āha – na hītyādi | avṛkṣāddhi vyāvṛttiḥ palāśasyaiva rūpaṃ | na ca tasya rūpam anyasya dhavādeḥ (p.256) syāt |
 na tad evetyādinā dvitīyapakṣopanyāsaḥ | na tad eva palāśasvalakṣaṇam eva tasya bhedasya rūpaṃ (|) rūpaṃ ca svabhāvaś cāsau bheda iṣyate | tatonyad eva palāśād vyāvṛttirūpaṃ syāt | yad vā rūpaṃ cānyad eva bhedasya syāt | tataś cānyattvāt kāraṇāt | bhāvaḥ palāśātmakas tasmād avṛkṣavyāvṛttirūpād vyāvartteta | tataḥ kāraṇāt | ūṣmādity avṛkṣāt tasya palāśasya bheda iti na syāt | yasmād yat khalu vastu | yato bhedo yadbhedas tasmād vyāvarttate | tattad eva bhavati | avṛkṣavyāvṛtter bhavati | avṛkṣavyāvṛtter avṛkṣanivṛttirūpāyā nivartamānam palāśasvalakṣaṇam avṛkṣam iva syād avṛkṣavat | mā vā bhūd vṛkṣāvṛkṣayor ekatvan tathāpi sosya bheda iti ca na syāt |
 yadi cāyam avṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśād anyaḥ syāt tad ayam avṛkṣād bhedosya palāśasya sambandhīti na syāt | na hītyādy asyeva samarthanaṃ | anyaḥ svatantronyasya sambandhī bhedo dharmarūpo bhavati | sati veti sambandhitvebhyupagamyamāne vā | sambandhaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvoṅgīkarttavyaḥ | bhinnayoḥ kāryakāraṇam antareṇa sambandhāyogāt | tatra vyāvṛttimān kāraṇaṃ vyāvṛttiḥ kāryaṃ | iti heto rūpaṃ vastvantaram eva tajjanitantena vyāvṛttimatā svalakṣaṇena janitaṃ bheda iti | pādā(?padā)rthāntarasya nāma kṛtantasmāt kāryatvenābhimatād bhedākhyāt padārthād aviśeṣād anyatrāpi kāraṇānāṃ yāni kāryāṇi tāni sarvāṇi vyāvṛttayo bhedāḥ syuḥ | na caivaṃ | tadānyatrāpi bhedābhimate bheda iti vyapadeśo mā bhūt |
 atha kāryaṃ bheda iti noṣyate kin tu bhedaḥ kārya ity ucyate | tadāpy āha – arthāntaratve ca bhedasyābhyupagamyamāne | tatopi vyāvṛttimatopyasya bhedasya bhedosti | anyathā bhedasyārthāntaratvam eva na syāt | tataś ca palāśasyāvṛkṣād yo bhedas tasya bhedasya palāśād bheda iti kṛtvā sa bhedo bhedopādhiḥ sa palāśād bhedaḥ | upādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ yasya bhedasya sa bhedopādhis tadbhāvas tasmād asāv avṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśasya na bhedaḥ syāt | dravyāntaravat | yathā hi dravyāntaraṃ ghaṭādikam (p.257) apy aghaṭāpekṣayā yo bhedas tadupādhitvān na palāśasya bhedas tadvat | svatantratvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
