 nanu yadi bhedopādhir bhedas tathāpi kim iti palāśasya bhedo na bhavatīty ata āha – na hītyādi | ayam ata iti viśeṣanirdeśāt | ayam avṛkṣād bhedaḥ | ata ity avṛkṣāt | asyety etad apekṣaṇīyaṃ | asya palāśasyāyaṃ bhedo 'smād avṛkṣād ity evaṃ viśeṣanirdeśāt pāratantryeṇa nirdeśāt palāśasya sambandhī bhedo dharmaḥ sidhyati | pāratantryeṇa ca nirdeśo bhedasyābhede sati sidhyati bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa | na tvarthāntaratve bhedasya | arthāntaratve hi bhedopādhitvād ghaṭavan na palāśasya bhedaḥ syāt | tataś cāsmādasya bheda iti viśeṣanirdeśo na syāt | tad evaṃ vyatirekapakṣe 'vṛkṣād bhedasyāpi palāśād yo bhedaḥ sopi rūpavān iti tasyāpi svāśrayād bhedena bhavitavyaṃ | tathā ca sarvabhedānāṃ bhinnasvabhāvatayā bhedopādhitvena svayan na rūpabhedateti na kaś cid bhedaḥ syāt |
 etad evāha – tataś cetyādi | upādhyabhāva iti vyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya dharmabhūtasyopādher abhāve sarvasya svabhāvāntaratvena dharmitvād bhedasyaivābhāvaḥ syāt tasya dharmirūpatvāt |
 yopi manyate (|) yadi rūpavatī vyāvṛttiḥ syāt syāt tattvānyatvapakṣabhāvī doṣo yāvatā nīrūpā sāsti tayā ca bhāvā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta iti |
 tadayuktaṃ |
 "tadgatāv eva śabdebhyo gamyate 'nyanivartanaṃ |
 na tatra gamyate kiś cid viśiṣṭaḥ kena cit para(ḥ"|| pra. vā. 1.128)
iti granthavirodhāt | nīrūpasya cāstitvavirodhāc chaśaviṣāṇavat | nīrūpatvād eva ca na tasyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ grāhakaṃ nāpy anumānaṃ | sambandhābhāvāt |
 nāpi niyatarūpānyathānupapattyā tatkalpanā sambandhābhāvād eva | svahetubhya eva ca niyatarūpāṇām utpannatvād iti "sarvabhāvā svabhāvena vyāvṛttibhāgina" (1|42) ity atrāntare 'bhihitatvāt |
 nāpi ca sā 'pratipannā viśeṣaṇam bhavitum arhati | na hi daṇḍāpratītau daṇḍīti pratītir bhavati | nāpi sā kva cid āśritā nīrūpatvāt | na cāsambaddham viśeṣaṇam bhavati | nāpyanyanivṛttigrahaṇapurassaraṃ vṛkṣādiṣu vṛkṣaśabdaḥ pravartate 'pratītir ity uktatvāt | nivṛtter nīrūpatayā 'pratipannatvena saṃketasyāpravṛtteś ca | kathaṃ śabdaviṣayatvan tasmād (p.258) anubhavadvāreṇa vṛkṣo 'yaṃ nāvṛkṣa ity evaṃ niścaya utpadyate | tenānyanivṛttiḥ pratiṣedhavikalpena kalpitā | yathā saṃketaṃ ca vṛkṣādau śabdaḥ pravarttamānorthād anyanivṛttim ākṣiti | anyanivṛttivikalpam ākṣipatīty arthaḥ | tenānyanivṛttyā viśiṣṭo | vastubhāgo gamyata ity ucyata iti |
 yadi vyāvṛttayaḥ sāmānyabhūtā bahir vastutvena neṣyante | nāpi paraparikalpitaṃ sāmānyam evaṃ sati bāhyam vastv eva vācyam āpatitaṃ | tatra ca doṣa ity āha – kathan tarhīti | abhinnasya niraṃśasya vastunaḥ śabdena codane upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat liṅgena pratipādane | tasyaivābhinnasya vastuna ekasmād bhinnasya punar anyatopi bhedāt | tathā hi yena svabhāvena na śabdo 'kṛtakād bhinnas tenaiva mūrttānityatvāc ca | tasyānaṃśatvāt | anaṃśasya ca vastunaḥ kṛtakaśabdenaikasyākṛtakād bhedasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codane | tathā liṅgena pratipādane sarvabhedagates sarvabhyo bhinnasya svabhāvasya pratipatteḥ | tatrānaṃśe vastuni kathaṃ śabdapramāṇāntarāṇi vyarthāni na syuḥ | ekena śabdena codane śabdāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | ekena liṅgena pratipādane pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt |
 yasmād ityādinā pariharati | tasmād yo yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyata (1|44) ityādinā prāgevedaṃ codyam parihṛtamadhikavidhānārthan tu punar upanyāsaḥ | artheṣvākārāntarasamāroporthaślaṣaḥ (|) sa ca pratipattibhedenānekaḥ | tatreti buddhipratibhāsini dharmiṇi bāhyabhinnatayā 'khyeyāste | bāhyatayādhyas tasyaiva buddhyākārasya śabdavācyatvāt | na punar bāhyam buddhyākāro vā kevalaḥ śabdavācyaḥ svalakṣaṇatvāt | tatra dharmiṇi vidhirūpatayā svārthapratipattidvāreṇaikārthaśleṣavicchede 'panayana eko dhvanir vyāpriyate | (|130||)
 liṅgaṃ caikārthaśleṣavicchede vyāpriyate | tatra svārthābhidhānarvāreṇa samāropavyāvacchede śabdapramāṇāntarāṇāṃ sāphalyam iti yāvat | na punar jñānād vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu svalakṣaṇaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇād vā vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu sāmānyalakṣaṇam vācyaṃ kiñvanāsti | yasya vastuno 'bhidhānato 'khile vastusvabhāve gatir bhavet | (p.259) vastusāmarthyād vastuvaśāt | yataś ca śabdaḥ svābhidhānadvāreṇa vyavacchedaṃ karoti tataḥ kāraṇāt taṃ taṃ vyavacchedaṃ kurvannānāphalaḥ śabdo bhavaty ekādhāraś ca | kathaṃ | arthakriyāyogyam adhyavasāya | anarthakriyākāriṇāpi svābhāsam arthakriyākāritvena svalakṣaṇarūpattvenādhyasyety arthaḥ | tatraiveti buddhipratibhāse bāhyatayādhyaste | kiṃ bhūte | tais tair bhrāntikāraṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭarūpa iva bhavati | (|131||)
 sadṛśāparotpattyādibhir bhrāntihetubhir nityādyākāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭarūpa iva pratibhāsamāne | te 'nityādiśabdāḥ yathā saṃketaṃ yasya yasya samāropasya vyavacchedārthaṃ | svapratibhāse saṃketaḥ kutaḥ | tasya tasya pratiyogino vyavacchedāya vyāpriyante | saṃketānurūpam eva pratipādayannāha – na cetyādi | hyarthe caśabdaḥ | yato yathā saṃketaṃ vyāpāras tato na hy ekaśabdasādhyaṃ vyavacchedam anyaḥ śabdaḥ karoti | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) saṃketapratiniyamāt | ekaikavyavacchedārtham buddhyākāro 'vibhaktabāhyarūpe śabdaniveśanāt | vyavahārakālepi svārthābhidhānadvāreṇa tantam eva vyavacchedaṃ pratyāyayatīty arthaḥ | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ liṅgam apīti draṣṭavyaṃ |
 nanv adhyavasitabāhyarūpatvāc chabdārthasya tataś ca śabdenanyalakṣaṇasya sarvātmanā viṣayīkaraṇāt kathaṃ na śabdāntarāṇām vaiyarthyam ity āha na cetyādi | avadhāraṇaś ca śabdaḥ | naiva vicchinnaṃ jñānāṃśād bhinnaṃ kiñ cid vastu | svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇād vyatiriktaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam anyanivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vākṣipyate gṛhyate śabdena liṅgena vā | yasyābhidhānād vastubaleneti vastugrahe niraṃśatvād vastunaḥ sarvathā gatiḥ syāt | dharmāṇāntato vyatirekāt | vyatirekepy upādhīnāṃ nānopādhyupakārāṅgaśaktyabhinnātmano graha (1|54) ityādinā sarvathāgrahaṇasyoktatvāt | kasmāc chabdair vicchinnam vastunākṣipyata ity ata āha – śabdānām ityādi |
 etaduktam bhavati | yato buddhyākāramabāhyam bāhyam adhyavasyanti śabdās tato (p.260) vicchinnavastugrāhakā iva bhavantīty arthaḥ | buddher viplavaś ca buddhyākārasya bahīrūpatayā grahaḥ | tadviṣayatvāc chabdānāṃ | biddhiviplavepi vācyavastusāmarthyād akhile gatiḥ | kinneti ced āha – tatra cetyādi | tatra buddhiviplave 'vastuni | vastusāmarthyābhāvāt |
 yadyapi buddhyākāro jñānasvalakṣaṅatvād vastu | tathāpy asau śabdair vikalpair vā bāhyābhinnatayādhyasto 'vastv eva | tena śabdo vikalpo vā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayo yathāvadekasyāpi bāhyasya jñānākārasya vā 'grahaṇād iti |
 yadi buddhiviplavaviṣayā eva sarvaśabdāḥ kathaṃ kṛtakānityādiśabdānān tathābhūte vastunyavyabhicāra ity ata  āha – tathā bhūtetyādi | tatas tato 'kṛtakanityāder bhinnasyārthasyānubhavadvāreṇety arthaḥ | ayaṃ vyavahāra iti sanbandhaḥ | kim bhūtaḥ (|) nānaiketyādi. nānā ekaś ca nānaikam. | tac ca dharmaś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tato bhedābhedaśabdābhyāntripado dvandvaḥ | nānaikadharmabhedābhedā eva buddhau pratibhāsanta iti pratibhāsāsta eva viplavo bhrāntatvāt | tadanusārī tenākāreṇa pravṛttaḥ | iti hetos tasya vyavahārasya tatpratibandhe tarmiṃs tathābhūte svalakṣaṇe pāramparyeṇotpattiprativandhe sati tadavyabhicāraḥ | vastvavyabhicāraḥ | yathā hi kṛtakādyākārāḥ śabdā viplavās tathāvastūnām api kṛtakādirūpeṇa paramārthatovasthānam ityanenākāreṇāvyabhicāro draṣṭavyaḥ |
 etad evāha – tatopītyādi | tato buddhiviplavaviṣayāc chabdād vyavahārāt parārthānumānalakṣaṇād vitathād iti bhrāntāt | pravṛttasyānte pravṛttiparisamāptau tathābhūta eva kṛtakādirūpa eva vastuni natvakṛtakādirūpe | anenāvyabhicārasvarūpam uktaṃ | jñānasamvādāt svalakṣaṇagrāhijñānotpatteḥ śabdasya vā jñānasya samvādāt |
 asminn evānyāpohe śabdārthe sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sidhyati na tu vastunīty āha – na punar bhinnetyādi | bhinnā ākārā jātiguṇādayaḥ śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtāḥ | tadgrāhiṇāṃ jñānaśabdānām ekavastuviṣayatvāt | śabda ekādhāra iti sambandhaḥ | yadi hi bhinnākāraṃ jñānam ekavastuviṣayam pravartteta tatas tadanusāreṇa śabdopi tathā syāt | tathā ca nānāphalaḥ śabda ekādhāra iti bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tac ca nāsti vyāghātāt | tathā hi nīlotpalaśabdayorekaṃ vā vastuvācyaṃ syād anekam vā | ādye pakṣe ekenaiva śabdena niraṃśasya vastunaḥ sarvātmanābhidhānāt | dvitīyasya śabdasyāpravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttau vā paryāyateti na nānāphalatvaṃ | dvitīye pakṣa ekādhāratā nāsti | (p.261) ghaṭapaṭādiśabdavan nānāviṣayatvāt |
 atha mataṃ (|) nīlaśabdo nīlaguṇaviśiṣṭandravyam āha – utpalaśabdopy utpalajātiviśiṣṭantadeva dravyam āha – ato viśeṣaṇayor bhedān nānāphalaḥ śabdo viśeṣyābhedād ekādhāra iti |
 tad apy asat | yato nīlaguṇena viśiṣṭadravyan nīlaśabdenābhidhīyamānaṃ sarvātmanābhidhīyate niraṃśatvāt | tataḥ koparo dravyasyotpalajātiviśiṣṭa ātmānabhihitosti yadutpalaśabdenābhidhīyeteti (|) tathaiva paryāyatā syād atha viśeṣaṇabhedād viśeṣyadravyasya bhedas tadāpy ekādhāratā na syāt | apohavādinas tv ayam doṣa ity āha – yathāvarṇṇita ityādi | buddhipratibhāsa āśrayo yasya śabdārthasya sa tathoktaḥ |
 yathā ca na doṣas tathā pratipādayannāha – vicchedam ityādi | eko nīlaśabda ekaṃ vyavacchedam anīlavyavacchinnaṃ nīlasvabhāvaṃ sūcayannanyam anutpalavyavacchinnam utpalasvabhāvam apratikṣipya varttate na nirākārotīty arthaḥ | (|132||)
 sa ity anutpalavyavacchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ | tena nīlaśabdena vyāpta ākrāntaḥ ākṣiptaḥ sann utpalaśabdaprayoge buddhāv ekatvena pratibhāsate | ekasyaiva dharmiṇaḥ vyavacchedadvayāyātanīlotpaladharmadvayayuktasya vikalpabuddhau pratibhāsanāt | yadā caivan tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syād buddhyanurodhataḥ |
 etaduktam bhavati (|) nīlaśabdaprayogād buddhipratibhāsī dharmī nīlarūpa eva pratibhāsate | tatrārthād anīlaṃ vyāvarttyate na tv anutpalavyavacchinnaḥ svabhāva utpalaśabdaprayogād apy utpalarūpatayā pratīyamānonutpalaṃ vyāvarttyate na tv anīlavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ | śabdadvayaprayoge tu nīlotpaladharmadvayatuktaikadharmipratibhāsinī vikalpabuddhir utpadyate tato nāṇāphalaḥ śabda ekādhāro bhavatīti bhaved bu(d)dhyanurodhena sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti |
 tena yad udyotakareṇocyate (|) "yasya cānyāpohaḥ śabdārthas tenānīlānutpalavyudāsau kathaṃ samānādhikaraṇāv iti vaktavyaṃ | yasya punar vidhīyamānaḥ śabdārthasya jātiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ dravyam abhidhīyate jātiguṇau ca dravye varttete | (p.262) na punar anīlānutpalavyudāsau | tasmāt samānādhikaraṇārtho nāstī"1* ti nirastaṃ | vidhīyamānasya śabdārthasyābhyupagamāt | (|133||)
fn.1*: Nyāyavārttika.
 kiṃ ca punaḥ (|) śabdasya svārthābhidhānarvāreṇa samāropavyavacchedakaraṇebhyupagamyamāne | yad vā vyavacchedakaraṇe vyavacchinnasvabhāvaviṣayīkaraṇe | leśato vastudharmasya vastusvabhāvasya vijātīyavyāvṛttasya saṃsparśaḥ syāt prāptilakṣaṇaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sattyam iti vidyamānaḥ sa hy adhyavasīyamānaḥ vyavacchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ | tatra vastunīti kṛtvā naikavastv abhidhāyini śabdebhyupagamyamāne vastudharmasya sāmānyasyaiva vastuno 'bhāvāt |
 katham iti cet | buddhāv ityādi | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalam bhādasattvam iti yāvat | yata evam vastuni śabdārthe doṣas tena kāraṇenānyāpohaviṣayā vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaviṣayāḥ śabdā buddhayaś ca proktā ācāryadiṅnāgena | kimbhūtā buddhayaḥ sāmānyagocarā vikalpikā ity arthaḥ | buddhīnām evaitad viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu śabdānāntepāṃ sāmānyaviṣayavyabhicārāt | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ | vastuny eṣāṃ śabdānāṃ vikalpānāṃ ca sambhavāt |
 yadi hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | vastveva yadi viṣayīkriyeta gṛhyeta na tu vidhirūpeṇādhyavasīyeta | soyam ity anantaroktaḥ sarvārthānāṃ sarveṇākāreṇa vastusāmarthyāt pratīti prasaṅgaḥ | ādiśabdād aviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapramāṇāntarāpravṛttyādiparigrahaḥ | praṇetā ācāryadiṅnāgaḥ | etāv iti biddhiśabdau | anyopohyateneneti vikalpākāra ucyate tadviṣayau | tathā bhinnākārābhir buddhibhir ekam vastu yadi viṣayīkriyeta | tathaiva śabdena cābhidhīyeta | tadā bhinnaphalayoḥ śabdayor ekatra dravye vṛttatvāt syāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam etat tu na sambhavati | tathā hi tacchabdavācyaṃ sāmānyaṃ svalakṣaṇād (p.263) abhinnaṃ bhinnam vā syāt | tatrādye pakṣe | ekatvād vasturūpasya bhinnarūpā sāmānyaviśeṣākārā bhinnā matiḥ kutaḥ | (|136||)
 svalakṣaṇāc ca sāmānyasyāvyatireke | śavaleyātmako bhedo yato bāhuleyātmakād bhedād vyāvarttate | bāhuleye śāvaleyātmakaṃ gotvam anvetīty ekasyārthasyaikādhikaraṇāvanvayavyatirekau prāpnutaḥ | tac cāyuktam ity āha – anvayavyatirekāv ityādi | ekortho gocaro viṣayo yayor anvayavyatirekayos tau tathoktau |
 tadekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ekatvād evānaṃśam ekasyāṃśābhāvāt | ākriyata ityākāro biddhipratibhāsaḥ | tasya bhedas tadāśrayād bhedasya | vastunānātvasya | yadi bhinnākārābhir buddhibhir gṛhyeta bhinnaṃ syāt | na caivantasya cābhāvād vastunaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakatvād vastuna ekasyāpi bhinnākārabuddhigrāhyatvam iti ced āha – tadātmanopītyādi | svalakṣaṇātmanas tadekayogakṣematvāt | svalakṣaṇenaikayogakṣematvāt tadvadevābhinnatvaṃ | taditi tasmād ayaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyādir na syād iti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyonyārthaparihāreṇa parasparārthaparihāreṇa bhinnapravṛttinimittatveneti yāvat | śabdayor ekaviṣayayor ekadravyādhārayor vṛttyasambhavāt |
 anvayetyādi ślokabhāgaṃ na cetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadaika eva vastvātmā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ ca tadā śāvaleyasvalakṣaṇasya gotvasāmānyātmakatvāt | tatraiva bāhuleye vṛttiḥ punaḥ svalakṣaṇātmakatvāt tatraivāvṛttis tasmin kāle prayuktā | sā cāyuktā | vyāghātāt | pramāṇabādhitatvāt | svalakṣaṇād abhinnatvān naiva sāṃānyamanyatra varttate | tato naikasyaikatra vṛttyavṛttī iti ced āha – na cetyādi | sāmānyasyetyādi | tato naikasya vṛttyavṛttī ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 nety ācāryaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ sāṃkhyādidarśanena bhedābhāvāt | tadityādy asyaiva (p.264) samarthanaṃ | tadd hi vastvekarūpam ekātmakaṃ sat | sāmānyam vā bhaved viśeṣo veti | sāmānyād viśeṣasyāvyatirekāt sāmānyam eva syāt | viśeṣa eva vā viśeṣād avyatirekāt sāmānyasya | na tvekaṃ dvirūpaṃ | yato na hy asati rūpabhede 'yaṃ pravibhāga iti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣa iti ca | sati vā pravibhāge sāmānyaviśeṣayor avyatireko na syād ity uktaṃ prāk | taditi tasmād ayam vastvātmā | avibhāga ity anaṃśaḥ |
 yadi sāmānyam eva tadānviyād vyaktyantaraṅgacchet | atha viśeṣātmaka eva | tadā na vānviyāt | ekasya tu viruddhadharmadvayāsambhava iti yāvat | tadevāha (|) na punar ityādi |
 yo 'pīti vaiśeṣikādiḥ | dravyād bhinnam eva sāmānyaṃ śabdavācyam āha – vyakteḥ sāmānyānām bhede 'bhyupagamyamāne 'bhedavyavahārāḥ sāmānādhikaraṅyādivyavahārāḥ syur anibandhanāḥ | yathāsvam iti | vīpsāyām avyayībhāvaḥ | tathā hi nīlotpalādiśabdā yathā svannīlotpalādim parasparabhinnaṃ sāmānyam āhuḥ | yadāpi nīlaśabdo nīlaguṇābhidhāyīṣyate tadāpi bhinnārthābhidhānam asty eva | eko dharmī artho viṣayo yasyā buddhes sā (|) ekārthā cāsau buddhiś ceti karmadhārayaḥ pumvadbhāvaś ca | asyā āśrayāḥ kāraṇaṃ kathaṃ syuḥ | tataś ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syād iti bhāvaḥ |
 yadi nīlotpalādiśabdā viśeṣaṇadvayuktaikadharmiviṣayāṃ buddhiṃ janayayuḥ | tadaikārthapratipād anena syāt sāmānādhikaraṇyan tac ca nāsti | vyakter arthāntaraṃ sāmānyan tadabhidhāyinaś cānākṣepakās tadgatānāṃ bhedānān tadaparityāgena vṛttir ākṣepaḥ na tathā | kasmāt (|) nirākāṃkṣatvāt | yadā vṛkṣaśabdo vṛkṣatvam evābhidhatte | tadā tasya nirviśeṣaṇatvāt tāvataivāsau nirākāṃkṣa iti kathan dhavādīnākṣipet | anākṣiptāś ca kathaṃ vṛkṣaśabdārthasya bhedā dhavādayo 'tadbhedatvāc ca kathaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | tadāha – katham ityādi | sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya dravyasyābhidhānān na (p.265) yathokto doṣaḥ iti cen na | uktottaratvāt | viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyāpi dravyasyābhidhāne vastusāmarthyād ekasmād api śabdād akhilagateḥ śabdāntarasya tatrāpravṛttiḥ pravṛttau cāparyāyateti | tad evaṃ vastuśabdārthavādino na kathaṃ cit sāmānādhikaraṇyādisambhavaḥ |
 sāmānyam api teṣāṃ na sambhavatīty uktaṃ | tathā hi yadā tāvat svalakṣaṇād avyatiririktaṃ sāmānyantadā svalakṣaṇavad vyaktyantarānanugamādasāmānyaṃ (|) vyatirekepi katham anyasya samānyam atiprasaṅgād ityādi prāg uktaṃ | (|137|)
 vyāvṛttivādinas tvayam adoṣa ity āha – sarvatrety ādi | ete doṣā iti sāmānyasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādayaḥ | yathā hītyādi | eko gobhedaḥ śāvaleyas tasmād agosvabhāvād bhinnas tathānyopi bāhuleyādiḥ (|) ato vijātīyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ sarvatra tulya iti bhedasya vijātīyabhinnasya svabhāvasya vikalpabuddhyā sarvatra svākārābhedenādhyas tasyāsāmānyadoṣo nāsti | pariśiṣṭābhāva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyādyabhāvaḥ prāgevoktaḥ | "vicchedaṃ sucayann ekam apratikṣipya varttata" (1|133) ityādinā |
 evan tāvad vijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ svabhāvaṃ buddhyā svākārābhedenādhyas tam ekaṃ śandābhidheyaṃ pratipādyādhunā 'bhinnākāram antareṇāpy ekakāryeṣu bhāveṣv ekaḥ śabdo niyujyata ity āha – api cetyādi | tatkāryaparicodane ekakāryatāparicodanārthaṃ | yadvaikakāryāṇāṃ paricodanārthaṃ | ekakāryeṣu bhedeṣv ekasya bhāvarahiteṣv api samā ekā śrutiḥ | kṛtā saṃketitā | buddhair vyavahārajñaiḥ | tatkāryāṇām bhedānām atatkāryebhyo yā yāvṛttis tannibandhanā vijātīyavyāvṛttatayaikakāryeṣv ekā śrutir nibadhyata ity arthaḥ | (|138||)
 nanu yadi na sāmānye śabdaniveśaḥ svalakṣaṇe tarhi śabdaniveśaḥ syād anyasyābhāvāt | na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdavācyaṃ |
 naitad asti | yataḥ pratipādakas tāvat trikālasthān bhāvān ekakāryāt saṃketakaraṇābhiprāyeṇa viṣayīkṛtya teṣv eva saṃketaṃ karoti vyavahārakāle paricodanārthaṃ | (p.267) kāryatvaṃ codyate | tadā naikā śrutis teṣu saṃkety ata ity arthaḥ | sakṛdekakālaṃ sarvasya kāraṇakalāpasya pratīty arthaṃ | ṝtepītyādi | teṣāṃ cakṣurādīnāntadrūpasāmānyasyety ekakāryatvalakṣaṇasya sāmānyasya vyatiriktasyābhāvepīty arthaḥ | sattaivaṃ teṣāṃ sāmānyam iti cen na tasyā aviśeṣāt sarvadā sarvatra cakṣurvijñānaprasaṅgāt | abhinnam artham antareṇeti sāmānyam vastubhūtam vinā | bahuṣu śāvaleyādiṣu | teṣām iti śāvaleyādibhedānāṃ | yadi teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ syāt tadā tatra sāmānye śabdaniveśāt sarvatra bhede niveśitaḥ syāt | ekan tu sāmānyaṃ vinā bahuṣv ekaśabdasanniveśo na yuktaḥ | tataś cāsau śabdaḥ saṃketyamāna ekatraiva bhede saṃketitaḥ syāt | tathā caikavṛtter ekatra bhede kṛtasanniveśasyānyatra bhede vilakṣaṇe pratyayājananāt | dvitīyā govyaktis tataḥ śabdād gaur ity evaṃ na pratīyeta | tatra pratyāsattinibandhanasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt | svabhāvānugamābhavepi śāvaleye niveśito 'pratyāsanne bāhuleye pratyayaṃ janayiṣyatīti ced āha – apratyāsattike cetyādi | atiprasaṅgāt | gośabdād aśvepi pratītiḥ syāt | evantāvad ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ vinā bahuṣv ekaśabdaniveśābhāva uktaḥ |
 abhyupagamya vaiphalyam āha – teṣu cetyādi | tathā hi bahuṣv ekā śrutir niveśyate 'nekavṛttim ekam arthaṃ pratipādayituṃ | tāneva vā bhedān asaṃkareṇa | tatrādyasyābhāvam āha – ekārthaniyogābhāvād iti | yady ekasminn arthe śabdasya niyogaḥ syāt tadā bhaved ekārthapratipādanaṃ | dvitīyābhāvam āha – bhinnetyādi | bhinnasvabhāvānām asaṃkīrṇṇānāṃ śāvaleyādīnāṃ pratipattaya ity adhyāhāraḥ | pṛthagity ekaikasmin bhede | ekasya śabdasya niyoge | saṃkete kṛte | paścād vyavahārakāle | yathā coditānām ity asaṃkareṇa pratipattyarthaṃ coditānāṃ vibhāgāparijñānāt tasmān na teṣu śabdaniyogaḥ phalavān | evaṃ hi svalakṣaṇeṣu pṛthak pṛthakchabdaniyogaḥ phalavān bhavati |
 yadi tasmāc chabdād asaṃkareṇa svalakṣaṇāni pratīyerann iti (|) kriyate ca bahuṣv ekaśabdaniyogas tasmād vastubhūtena sāmānyena bhāvyam ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 tasyāpīty ācāryaḥ | ekam vastu sāmānyam astīty eva kṛtvānyareṇāpi prayojanaṃ | lokena śabdo niveśanīya ity eko vikalpaḥ | dvitīyam āha – tadvetyādi | taditi (p.268) sāmānyaṃ vastuśaktyaiveti | puruṣavyāpāram anapekṣya | ekāṃ śrutiṃ dhvanayatyutthāpayati | nāsty eva tad dvayam api | antareṇa pratojanaṃ puruṣavyāpārañ ca prayogābhāvāt | tadeva kin tarhītyādināha – kena cit prayojananeti | ebhyaḥ śabdebhyo vyavahāre | tadatatsādhanam arthaṃ jñānatvā pratipadyeteti | anena prathamavikalpābhāvam āha –
 nirdeśyanta ity anena dvitīyasya | nirdeśyante saṃketyante vyavaharttukāmair ity adhyāhāraḥ | tatraitasmin nyāye 'nekaṃ kāraṇav ekatra kārye upayujyeta vyāpriyeta | tadity anekaṃ | kutaḥ kāraṇakalāpāt tadutpadyata ity eva | tatraitasmin kārye vyavaharttukāmair avaśyantac cānekaṅkāraṇamatatkāryavyāvṛttilakṣaṇam ekakāryatām āśrityaikenaiva śabdena codayituṃ yuktaṃ | anekena codane doṣam āha – tasyetyādi | pṛthak pṛthag iti bhinnaiḥ śabdaiḥ | etac ca svalakṣaṇaśabdaniveśam abhyupagamyoktam (|)
 etad eva na sambhavatīty āha – na cetyādi | asya vastunaḥ | ananyasādhāraṇaṃ rūpam iti | nānyasādhāraṇam ananyasādhāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ | nāpyasyety anekaśabdaniveśanasya |
 etac ca gaur avāśāktivaiphalyād ity asya yathākramaṃ vivaraṇaṃ | kasmād vaiphalyam iti ced āha – kevalam ityādi | anena prayoktrā tatraitasmin kārye | terthāḥ kāraṇabhūtāś codanīyā ity etāvat prayojanaṃ | te tu kāraṇabhūtāḥ padārthā ekena vā śabdena codyeran bahubhir veti svātantryam atra codane vaktuḥ | yata evaṃ taditi tasmād iyam ekā śrutir bahuṣu vācyeṣu vaktur abhiprāyavaśād hetoḥ pravarttamānā nopa(ā)lambhamarhati | bahuṣv ekā śrutir na śakyā pravarttayitum iti ced āha – na ceyam ityādi | iyam ekā śrutiḥ | aśakyaṃ pravarttanamayasyā iti vigrahaḥ | kasmānnāśakyapravarttanety āha – icchādhīnatvād icchāyā | adhīnam aśakyapravarttanaṃ | yadi hy ekatrāpītyādi | tathā hīcchayaiva tatra paraparikalpite sāmānye na vastusthityaiva ekasyāḥ śruteḥ pravattiḥ (|) kin tarhi (p.269) vaktur icchāvaśāt | tathā na yadi prayoktur icchā bhavet | katham iyam ekā śrutir ekatrāpi pravartteta | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | tathaikatrāpi pravarttayitum icchaiva kāraṇaṃ | na vastuśakti(ḥ|) tadā bahuṣv api na kaś cid vyāghāta ity āha – icchāyāṃ vetyādi | ekatrāpi pravarttayitum icchāyāṃ kāraṇatvena kalpyamānāyāṃ | enām ekāṃ śrutiṃ | prayojanābhāvād ityādi | na hy ekamvastuvinā bahuṣv ekaśabdaniveśanaṃ phalavat | uktaṃ prāk | kim uktam ity āha – bhinneṣv ityādi | bhinneṣu śāvaleyādibhedeṣv ekasmād gośabdāt pratītiratatprayojanebhyo bhedena | tadgobhedasādhyaṃ vāhadohādikaṃ kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ na bhavati yeṣām aśvādīnān tebhyo bhedeneti | kiṃ punar vastubhūtam evaikatvaṃ na codyata ity ata āha – na punaḥ svabhāvasyaikatvān na punar vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyaikatvād bhinneṣv ekāśrutiḥ | tasyaiva sāmānyavyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya cāyogāt | (|139||)
 bhavatu nāma sāmānyaṃ vyatiriktan tadapi tasmin svabhāve vyavasthitam amiśram eva | tad evāha – yathāsvam ityādi | yasya yallakṣaṇantena vyavasthitasv abhāvānām anyonyarūpasaṃśleṣāt katham ekanimittiḥ sāmānyanibandhanaḥ śabdo bhinneṣu bhavet | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | na hy anyenānye samānā bhavanti | etac coktaṃ prāk | sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena svasvabhāvavyavasthiter ity atra (1|42) prastāve |
 anyāpohavādinas tvayam adoṣa ity āha – atatorayojanetyādi | atatprayojanebhyo vyāvṛttis tu bhinnānām apy aviruddheti kṛtvā sa evātatprayojanebhyo bhedas tatprayojanānām abhedas tadvyāvṛtteḥ sarvatra bhāvāt | śabdābhedasya kāraṇam bhavatu | yataś ca na kathaṃ cid vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ ghaṭate | teneme gobhedās tatprayojanā vāhadohaprayojanā iti yaduktan tat | atatprayojanebhyo 'śvādibhyo bhinnā evoktāḥ | (|140||)
 na punar eṣām anyā tatkāryatānyatrānyato bhedāt | anyavyāvṛtta eva svabhāva (p.270) eṣām abheda iti yāvat | etena tatkāryatāpītyādi kārikābhāgo vyākhyātaḥ | (|141||)
 yathetyādinā cakṣurādau yathā rūoavijñānaikaphala ityādi vyācaṣṭe | ātmendriyamanorthasannikarṣeṣv iti paraprasiddhyoktaṃ | rūpavijñānam ekaṃ kāryaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | (|142||) tadrūpavijñānaṃ kāryaṃ yoṣāntāni tatkāryāṇi teṣāṃ sāmānyam aviśeṣeṇaikakāryakaraṇasāmarthyantasya codanā prakāśanā | tasyāḥ sambhave sati (|) kena punaḥ prastāvena codanāsambhava ity āha – kuto rūpavijñānam ity aviśeṣeṇa sāmagrīgate praśne satīty arthaḥ | vyavahāralāghavārtham ekena śabdena bahūnāṃ pratipādanārthaṃ rūpavijñānasya hetuś cakṣirādikalāpaḥ saraḥ śaro vety evaṃ śrutinniveśayed iti sambandhaḥ |
 api nāmetyādinā vyavahāralāghavam eva vyācaṣṭe | taddhetūnāṃ cakṣurvijñānahetunāṃ | na cātreti cakṣurādau | yenānugāminā rūpeṇaikaṃ cakṣurvijñānaṃ janayanti | tathābhūtaṃ sāmānyañcakṣurādīnān nāsti (|) sattā vidyata iti cet | tasyās tarhi sarvatrāviśeṣāt sarvatra cakṣurādivijñānaṃ syāt | na ca sambandhibhedāt sattāyā bhedo nityatvenānādheyātiśayatvāt | kevalan tadarthatayā rūpavijñānaikakāryatayā bhāvāś cakṣurādayaḥ | atadarthebhyo rūpavijñānājanakebhyo bhinnā iti kṛtvā bheda evātatkāryebhyo vyāvṛttir eva | eṣāṃ cakṣurādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām atatkāryavyāvṛttes tulyatvāt | yathā cakṣurādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām atatkāryavyāvṛttes tulyatvāt | yathā cakṣūrūpādiṣv ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ vināpy ekakāryatvakhyāpanāyaikaḥ śabdo niveśyate | evaṃ jātīyāḥ sarva ityādi | samūhasya santānasyāvasthāviśeṣasya ca vācakāḥ samūhasantānāvasthāviśeṣaśabdāḥ | tatra samūhābhidhāyinaṃ śabdam adhikṛtyāha – ye samastā ityādi | ye rūparasagandhādayassamastāḥ kiñ cid ekam udakādyāharaṇādi kāryaṃ | teṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ | tatra kārye kāraṇatayā viśeṣābhāvāt | sarveṣāṃ hy ekaṃ kāryam iti kṛtvā tenaikakāryatvena viśeṣābhāva ucyate | na tu svalakṣaṇasyāviśeṣāt |
 teṣām ekakāryakaraṇaśaktikhyāpanamātre karttavye 'pārthikā viśeṣacodanā | pratirūpādibhinnena (p.271) śabdena codanāniṣphaleti kṛtvā sakṛdekakālaṃ sarveṣāṃ kvacit kārye niyojanārthaṃ rūpādiviśeṣeṣūdakadhāraṇādikāryasameṣu ghaṭa ity ekaṃ śabdaṃ prayukte 'yaṃ loka iti vyavaharttā | (|143||)
 nanu bhinnā eva rūpādayaḥ katham ekasmād ghaṭaśabdād abhedena pratīyanta iti ced āha – tepītyādi | sajātīyād rūpād anyataś ca rasāder bhedāviśeṣepi | tatprayonāṅgatayā | viśiṣṭodakādyāharaṇakāryāṅgatayā | tadanyebhya iti tatkāryakaraṇāsamarthebhyaḥ paṭādibhyo bhidyanta iti bheda evaiṣām abhedas tato 'bhedāt | tasmād abhedād aviśeṣeṇaiva sāmānyenaivaikasmād ghaṭaśabdāt sarve rūpādayaḥ pratīyante |
 yadi rūpādaya eva kevalā ghaṭo na tu tadvyatiriktaṃ dravyaṃ (|) kathan tarhi ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti vyatireka iti ced āha – tatretyādi | ghaṭasya rūpādaya ityapi yo vyatirekas tasyāyamartho ghaṭasvabhāvā rūpādayo na paṭādisvabhāvā iti |
 etadeva vyācaṣṭe | udaketyādi | udakāhāraṇasya viśeṣo ghaṭād anyenāsādhyatvaṃ | ādiśabdād anyasyāpi ghaṭasādhyasya kāryasya parigrahaḥ | tasmin kārye samarthāḥ saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | ayam atrārthaḥ (|) rūpādiśabdā rūpādīn rūpasādhyakāryamātraśaktiyuktānaviśeṣeṇa pratipādayanti | ghaṭaśabdas tu viśiṣṭakāryaśaktiyogena paṭādisvabhāvebhyopi rūpādibhyo bhedena viśiṣṭān rūpādīn āha – ato ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti śabdadvayavyāpāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣākārabuddhyutpatteḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo vyatirekavimatiś ca prayujyata iti | etam eva sāmānyetyādināha – sāmānyakāryaṃ rūpādimātrasādhyan tasya siddhiḥ sādhanan tasmin prasiddhenātmanā svabhāvena | itthaṃ bhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā | hetau vā | itthaṃ bhūtena rūpeṇa hetunā vā rūpādiśabdaiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ prasiddhāssantaḥ viśiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭasādhyaṃ ghaṭasādhyam evodakāharaṇādi | tasya sādhanaṃ sādhyateneneti kṛtvā | tathābhūtā ākhyā saṃjñā yasya sa tathā tena viśiṣṭāḥ | ta iti rūpādaya evam ucyanta iti |
 na punar atra rūpādisaṃhatau hy atra vā ghaṭa iti vyavahāre yathāvarṇṇitalakṣaṇam iti (p.272) rūpādivyatiriktandravyaṃ | tasyāvayavinas tādṛśasyeti rūpādivyatiriktasya | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaś cāvayavī parair iṣṭo darśanaṃ spārśanaṃ dravyam iti vacanāt | tenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvenābhyupagatasya rūpādivyatirekeṇānupalambhād iti vākyārthaḥ | yathāvāntareṇāpy avayavinaṃ paramāṇava eva pratyakṣasya viṣayas tathā dvitīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate |
 yadi rūpādaya eva saṃhatā ghaṭaḥ kathan tarhi bahuṣu ghaṭa ity ekavacanam iti ced āha – ekavacanam ityādi | yathā bahuṣv ekaḥ śabda ekaśaktisūcanārthas tathaikavacanam api | teṣāṃ rūpādīnām ekasminn udakāharaṇakārye yā śaktis tasyāḥ sūcanārthaṃ | ekakāryakarttṛtvena teṣv ekatvam āropyaikavacanam ity arthaḥ | na punas teṣv ekā śaktir vidyate | anapekṣitabāhyārtham akavacanaṃ saṃketaparatantram vā | etac ca "yeṣāṃ vastuvaśā vāca"(1|66) ityādinā pratipāditaṃ | santānābhidhāyinaḥ śabdānadhikṛtyāha – tathetyādi | hetuś ca phalaṃ ca hetuphale | tayor viśeṣa upādānopādeyabhāvenaikasantāna ......nāśrayatvaṃ | tam bhūtāḥ prāptāḥ prāptivacano bhavatiḥ sakarmakaḥ | sādhanaṃ kṛteti dvitīyātatpuruṣaḥ | hetuphalaviśeṣo vā bhūto niṣpanno yeṣām iti bahuvrīhiḥ | āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvād bhūtaśabdasya paranipātaḥ | kiṃ cid ekaṃ sādhayantīti | yathāṃkuranāḍapatrādayaḥ phalam ekaṃ | sādhyante caikena | yathā ta evopādānabhūtena bījena | tepy akurādayo naikakṣaṇātmakāḥ sakṛtpratītyarthaḥ | tenaikakāryatvenaikakāraṇatvena vā sāmyena brīhyādiśabdaiḥ santānābhidhāyibhiḥ kṛtasaṃketāḥ saṃketakāle | paścād vyavahārakāle kathyante vyavahāralāghavārthaṃ | abhedena prabandhajijñāsāyāṃ bījāṃkurādibhedenānekaśabdaprayogasya vaiphalyāt | ādigrahaṇena manuṣyādiśabdagrahaṇaṃ | tair api bālakumārādibhedabhinnasya prabandhasyābhidhānāt |
 nanu brīhyādiśabdā api samudāyaśabdā eva rūpādisamudāyabhidhāyitvāt |
 satyaṃ | kin tu hetuphalaviśeṣaphalaprabandhābhidhānād evam ucyate (|) tathā samudāyaśabdonekasamudāyāpekṣayā jātiśabdo bhavaty evam avasthāśabdopi (|) kevalaṃ viśiṣṭārthavivakṣayā kaś cic chabda ity ucyata ity adoṣaḥ | yathā ca ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ ghaṭa iti caikavacanaṃ yena nibandhanenoktaṃ | tathā brīhe rūpādayo brīhir iti naikavacanaṃ draṣṭavyam ata evāha – pūrvavadvācyam iti | avasthāśabdān adhikṛtyāha – yepītyādi | yepi nīlādiparamāṇavaḥ (p.273) pṛthag iti nīlapītādayaḥ parasparānapekṣāḥ samastā veti parasparasahitāḥ | kva cid iti cakṣurvijñāne savedeśe parasyotpattipratibandhe vā sakṛd eva pratyāyanārthaṃ | ekasmāc chabdād bahunāṃ niścayārthaṃ | tatra ye cakṣurvijñāne upayujyante | tevasthāviśeṣavācinaḥ sanidarśanā ity ucyante | ye svadeśe parasyotpattiṃ pratidhnanti | te sapratighā iti |
 nanu nīlapītādayo 'tyantabhinnās te katham ekena sanidarśanādiśabdenocyanta ity ata āha –
 tadanyebhyo bhedasāmānyeneti | tadanyebhyo 'nidarśanāpratighebhyo yo bhedassa eva teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ sarveṣān tato vyāvṛttatvāt | tena hetunā | sanidarśanādiśabdā api paramāṇusamudayā 'bhidhānāt samudāyaśabdā eveti cet (|) na | ekasyāpi paramāṇoḥ sapratighādiśabdair abhidhānāt |
 kāryadvāreṇa śabdapravṛttim uktvā kāraṇadvāreṇāha – yathaikakāryā rūpādayas tatkāryaṃ codanāyāṃ | tadudakadhāraṇādy ekaṃ kāryaṃ yasya rūpādisāmarthyasya tasya codanāyām ekaśakticodanāyām ity arthaḥ | tadanyasmāt ghaṭāder bhedena ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ | ādigrahaṇād brīhyādiparigrahaḥ | kṛtasamayāḥ khyāpy anta iti prakṛtaṃ | tathā kāraṇāpekṣayāpy anekorthaḥ ekena śabdena kṛtasamayaḥ khyāpy ata iti vacanapariṇāmena sanbandhaḥ vyavahārārtham eva lāghavenety arthād | yathā śavalāyā gorapatyāni sarvāṇyevaikakāraṇatvena śāvaleyaśabdenocyante bahulāyāś cāpatyāni bāhuleyaśabdena | yāvāṃś ca puruśaprayatnena kāraṅena janitaḥ ṣabdaḥ sarvaḥ samānakāraṇajanyatvena prayatnānantarīyakaḥ kthyate | kariṣyām iti cetanā prayatnaḥ | tasyānantaram avyavadhānan tatra bhava iti grahāderākṛtigaṇatvācchaḥ | deśagrahaṇan tatra na smaryate | tasya svārthikaḥ kan | etac ca kāraṇaviśeṣāpekṣayoktaṃ |
 kāraṇamātraśrayeṇāha – kṛtako veti | kāraṇāyattajanmanaḥ prayatnānantarīyakasyānyasya ca sarvasya kṛtaka ity abhidhānāt |
 evantāv advidhimukhenoktaṃ |
 (p.274) pratiṣedhamukhenāha – tathetyādi | tasya cākṣuṣasya nīlāderyat kāryañcakṣurvijñānantasya pratiṣedhenācākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ | na samarthañcakṣurvijñānaṃ prtīty evama cākṣuṣaśabdena sāmānyenocyate | anityaśabdopi nityavyavacchedena vyavasthāpy amānaḥ | tatkāryapratiṣedhenaiva | tathā hi nityaṃ parair vastveveṣṭan tac cāsādhyasādhanabhūtaṃ vyavahārapathaṃ nāvataratīti sādhyasādhanaṃ cāṅgīkartavyaṃ | nityakāryapratiṣedhenānityaḥ | ātmaśabdopi kvacit kārye svatantrasya khyāpanāya kṛta ity anātmaśabdo 'tatkāryavyavacchedena syāt |
 evaṃ kāryapratiṣedhenābhidhāya kāraṇapratiṣedhenāha – tadityādi | tasya sasvāmikasyāśūnyasya ca yatkāraṇan tasya pratiṣedhenāyaṃ śabdādiko bhavosvāmikaḥ śūnya iti vyavahārārthaṃ khyāpy ata iti sambandhaḥ | tathā hi svatantreṇātmādinā yodhiṣṭitassa sasvāmikaḥ parair iṣyate | evam aśūnyopi tathābhūtenādhiṣṭitatvād evādhiṣṭitā cādhiṣṭātavyasvīkaraṇam anyathādhiṣṭātṛtvāyogāt | tasmāt sasvāmikādiśabdāḥ kāraṇadvārapravṛttāḥ pareṣāṃ | na pratikṣaṇaviṣarāruṣu bhāveṣu sāmagrīmātrapratibaddheṣu vyavasthitasvabhāvaḥ kaś cid adhiṣṭātāsti yatpratibaddhāssaṃskārāḥ pravarrtante | tato svamikāḥ śūnyaś ca yathoktakāraṇapratiṣedhena vyavasthāpy ata iti | evam anyad apīti | duḥkhāśūnyānāthāpratiśaraṇādikam api | yathāyogam iti kiṃ cit kāryapratiṣedhena kiṃ cit kāraṇapratiṣedhenety arthaḥ | duḥkhāśūnyādikāryapratiṣedhena sukhaśūnyādīnām aprātikūlyakāryatvena vyavasthāpy amanatvāt | sarvasya ca saṃskṛtasya vipariṇām dharmitvena pratikūlatvāt | anāthāpratiśaraṇādi | kāryapratiṣedhena svatantrasya nāthāder abhāvāt | tadevaṃ kāryakāraṇayor vidhipratiṣedhamukhena catuṣṭayī śabdānām pravṛttur ākhyātā bhavati |
 nanu cāśūnyanityāder vyavacchedyasyābhāvāt kathaṃ śūnyādiśabdeṣv anyavyavacchedābhidhānam iti ced āha – yathākathitam iti yasya yādṛśī siddhāntāśrayaṇakalpanā tayā samīhito racito śūnyanityādīnāṃ ya ākāras taṃ vikalpya buddhāvāropya tadvyavacchedena paraparikalpitā 'śūnyādyākāravyavacchedena śūnyādivyapadeśaḥ kriyate | kasmiād ity āha – buddhītyādi | buddhessamīhā imam artham āropayām iti saṃkalpaḥ | tathā sa (rvvaṃ......) sāṃkaryaṃ yasya śabdasya sa tathā tadbhāvastamāt | sarvagrahaṇād etad āha – yatrāpi vastubhūte ............īti |
 etad uktam bhavati | na vastusvalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaiḥ svarūpeṇa vidhīyate 'panīyate vā (|) (p.275) kevalaṃ vikalpabiddhisandarśita eva sarvo vidhipratiṣedhavyavahāraḥ | tataś cānityādiśabdeṣv anityādipratipakṣo nityādir vyavacchedyo nāstīty apratipakṣadoṣas tasyopakṣepa udbhāvanaṃ | ādiśandānnāstyātmeti pratiṣedhe cāpratiṣedhadoṣa ity evam ādyupakṣepaś ca (|) durmatīnām udyotakaraprabhṛtīnāṃ vispanditāni vijṛmbhitānyasambaddhānīti yāvat | na hi vyāyānugatabiddhir asambaddham udbhāvayet | ataś ca te doṣopakṣepā upekṣaṇīyā nāvadhānārhā ity arthaḥ |
 athetyādi paraḥ | apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | ekasya vastunaḥ sāmānyasya vṛtter api kāraṇādaneko vyaktibhedaḥ | ekā śrutir ekaśrutiḥ | sā cādhikā asyānekasyāstīty ekaśrutimān | ekaśabdavācyo yadi bhaved ity arthaḥ | ekakāryatvenaikaḥ śabdabahuṣv ekena vā sāmānyeneti na kaś cid viśeṣa iti manyate | ata eva vyācaṣṭe | na kevalam ityādi | tadanyasmād atatkāryād yo bhedassa eva sarveṣāṃ tatkāryāṇām aviśeṣas tasmād ekaśabdenocyante | api tvekavṛttyāpy ekasya sāmānyasya varttanenāpy anekaḥ padārtha ekaśabdenocyeta ko virodhaḥ syāt | tathaikakāryatvena bahuṣv ekaśabdapravṛttau nāsti virodhas tathā vastubhūtenāpi sāmānyena | tasmād vastubhūtasāmānyakalpanāpi yuktaiveti bhāvaḥ |
 uktam ity ācāryaḥ | tasya vastubhūtasya sāmānyasya upalabhyate rūpeṇābhimataṃ | abhimatatve upalabhyatvaṃ karaṇatvena vivakṣitam iti karttṛkaraṇe kṛtety eva samāsaḥ | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya vyaktivyatirekeṇānupalabdher abhāvaḥ sāmānyasyeti vākyārthaḥ | anupalambhyamānatāyāmvā 'ṅgīkriyamāṇāyāntaddarśanāśrayā iti sāmānyadarśanāśrayā vyapadeśapratyabhijñānādayo na bhaveyar iti | uktam iti sambhandhaḥ | bahuṣv ekaśabdo vyavadeśas tulyākāraṃ jñānaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ | ādiśabdāt sāmānyāśrayā vyaktau pravṛttir na bhaved ityādeḥ parigrahaḥ |
 na hi svayam anupalabhyamānam upalambhanibandhanaṃ vyapadeśapratyabhijñānam anyatra pravarttayati (p.276) | na bhaveyur ityādīnyanena cādiśabdenānyasyāpi pūrvoktasya doṣasya grahaṇaṃ | na hy anyenānye  samānānāmatadvanto nāma syuḥ (|) tathā na jātir vāhadohādāv upayujyata ityādi | anenaitad āha (|) jātikalpanāyām bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti | tato na tannibandhano vyapadeśādiḥ | ekakāryatve tu virodhābhāvāt tatkṛtam eva vyapadeśapratyabhijñānādikaṃ yuktam iti | dūṣaṇāntaram apy āha – api cedādi | vastubhūte sāmānyam icchatā svāśraye naikasmiṃs tasya pravṛttireṣṭavyā | na hi tatrāvarttamānamāśraye vyapadeśādikāraṇaṃ yuktaṃ | sā ca sāmānyasya svāśraye pravṛttir ādheyatā vā bhvet | tadbalenāvasthānāt | āśrayabalenopalabdhir vyaktiḥ sā vā vṛttir bhavet | etad dvayam api tasmin sāmānye na yujyate | (|144-45||)
 yadetad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadetad ekam iti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam anekatrāśraye varttamānam ekāṃ śrutiṃ varttayati (|) tasya sāmānyasya svaśraye keyaṃ vṛttir iti praśnayitvā svayam eva vikalpadvayam āha – ādheyatā cetyādi | atha vā kiṃ śabdaḥ pratikṣepe (|) keyaṃ vṛttir na kā cid ity arthaḥ | tathā hi vṛtteḥ svāśraye ādheyatā vā syāt | yathā kuṇḍe ādhāre badarāṇi varttanta iti | vyaktir vā tasya sāmānyasyāśraye vṛttiḥ syāt tair āśrayair vyakteḥ prakāśanāt | tatra yady ādheyatā vṛttir iṣyate | tadā vyaktayas tadādhāratvenaiṣṭavyāḥ | nityaṃ ca sāmānyam abhyupagataṃ vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvvan tadanādheyan tato nityasyāśrayair anupakāryatvād dhetor āśrayābhimatā vyaktayo nādhāraḥ |
 nityaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | atha nityaṃ neṣyate tadāpy anityatve 'parāparotpatter anyasyānyasyotpatter anekaṃ sāmānyam anekatvāt kāraṇād bhedeṣv iva bhedavat tasmin sāmānye ekapratyayāyogād ekasya jñānasyāyogāt kāraṇāt | nityaṃ sāmānyam iṣyata ity anena sambandhaḥ | nityasya ca sāmānyasya kiṃ kurvāṇa āśraya ādhāraḥ syān naivety abhiprāyaḥ |
 (p.277) nopakārakatvād ādhāraḥ kin tu tasya sāmānyasya tatrāśraye samavāyāt | yadā hodyotakaraḥ | "kathaṃ tarhi gotvaṃ goṣu pravartate | āśrayāśrayibhāvena (|) kaḥ punar āśrayāśrayibhāvaḥ samavāyaḥ | tatra vṛttimad gotvaṃ | vṛttiḥ samavāya iha pratyayahetutvād iti | " 1* upakāryokārakatvābhāve samavāyam asambhāvayannāha – koyam ityādi |
fn.1*: Nyāyavārttika.
 apṛthag ityādi paraḥ | abhinnadeśatvena siddhā apṛthaksiddhāḥ | teṣāṃ yoyam āśrayāśrayibhāvassamavāyaḥ |
 tadityādi siddhāntavādī | tadevedamāśrayatvam anupakārakasyāśrayasya na sambhāvayāmaḥ | kasmād (|) atiprasaṅgāt | yady anupakārakasyāśrayatvam iṣyate | tadā sarvaḥ sarvasyāśrayaḥ syāt | na bhavati (|) sarvasya sarvāsamavetatayā pratīter iti cet | nanupakārakābhāve gotvavat sarvasyaiva sarvasamavetatvenaikasmān na pratītir bhavatītīdam eva codyate |
 athopakāryopakārakabhāvāder anya evāyaṃ samavāyalakṣaṇassambandhaḥ | sa ca na sarvatrāstīti katham atiprasaṅgaḥ |
 ucyate | satyaṃ (|) kevalaṃ kva cit samavetasya sanavāyo bhavati | tatsamavetatvaṃ ca tadāyattatayā (|) tadāyattatvañ cārthāntarasya tadutpattir eva | tenoparyuparibhāvenotpattir eveha buddher nibandhanan na samvāya ity arthāpattikṣayaḥ | uparyuparibhāve (......i.........) syāt | nāpy asamavetānāṃ samavāyosti yena samavetatvaṃ syāt sarveṣāṃ sarvatra samavetatvaprasaṅgāt |
 upasaṃharannāha – tasmād ityādi | apṛthaksiddhayoḥ samavāyo yathārabhyārambhakayor dravyayoḥ pṛthaksiddhānāṃ saṃyogaḥ | yathāgnidhūmayor ekasminn arthe samavāya ekārthasamavāyaḥ | yathā rūparasayor ekasmin dravye | ādiśabdāt saṃyuktasamaveta(sya) parigrahaḥ | vastubhūtāḥ sambandhā vastūnāṃ vā sambandhā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ ṣaṣṭīsamāso vā | vastugrahaṇaṃ kalpanākṛtanivṛttyarthaṃ | kāryakāraṇabhāvān na vyatiricyante na vathā (p.278) bhavanti | etad eva sādhayannāha – parasparam ityādi | parasparam anyonyam upakāriṇām anyato vā 'śrayābhimatād anupakāriṇām apratibandhād anāyattatvāt | apratibadhannasya cāsambandhāt kāraṇāt sarvavastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvān na vyatiricyanta iti prakṛtena saṃbandhaḥ |
 nanu cāśrayāt saty upakāre āśritayoḥ parasparam upakāryopakārakabhāvo naivāstīti kim artham anyato vety asyopanyāsaḥ |
 satyam etat | kin tu yady api sākṣād anyonyaṃ nopakāras tathāpy ekakāraṇāyattatayā pāram paryeṇāpi sambandhaṃ kalpayed ity upanyāsaḥ | ekārthasamavāyinaḥ parasparam upakāryopakārakabhāvo naiveṣyata iti ced āha – yady apītyādi | tata ekasmād āśrayād upakārasyābhāve yathoktadoṣaprasaṅgāt | atiprasaṅgabhayād ity ukto doṣaḥ yataś ca svāśrayād ekārthasamavāyinor avaśyam upakāro 'taḥ svāśrayakṛtaḥ samavāyinoryaḥ svopakāra ātnopakāras tena dvāreṇa param api dvitīyam api samavāyinaṃ saṅghaṭayya pratipādayitrā khyāpyate samavāyināv āha sambaddhāv iti |
 etad uktam bhavati | yathā parasyaikārthasamavāyinoḥ parasparāsambaddhepy ekārthasamavāyāt sambandhas tathāsmākam ekakāryatvena tayoḥ sambandhaḥ | yata evaṃ tasmāt tatrāpy ekārthasamavāyini kāryakāraṇabhāvakṛta evāśrayeṇa saha yaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvas tatkṛta eva yaddvāreṇāorpita eva sambandhaḥ | yasmād upakāradvāreṇaivādhārādibhāvaḥ | tasmād ayam āśrayaḥ śāvaleyādi | svātmani sāmānyasvabhāvenupakurvāṇaḥ sāmānyasyānapekṣasyādhāra iti yācitakamaṇḍanam etat | maṇḍanamalaṅkāro maṇḍyateneneti kṛtvā (|) tasya yācitakaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ | kasmāt parasmād yācitakam maṇḍanandaridrasyātmanyavidyamānaṃ | tadvat sāmānyāśrayasyāpi sāmānyaṃ pratyādhāratvaṃ | bhāvasādhano vā tṛtīyāsamāsaś ca | yathā yācitakenālaṅkāreṇa maṇḍanakriyā | tathā sāmānyāśrayasya parasmāt prārthitenādhārabhāvenādhāravyapadeśo na vastusthityā tata upakārābhāvād iti |
 1--katham ityādiparaḥ | na hi kuṇḍaṃ badarāṇāṃ janakaṃ | teṣāṃ svahetor eva (p.279) niṣpatteḥ (|) tataś ca yaduktaṃ "sarvatra vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvān na vyatiricyanta" iti tadanekāntikam iti manyate | pravisarppato deśāntaravisarppaṇaśīlasya badarādes taddeśajananam upādānabhūtasya pūrvakasya badaralakṣaṇasya yo deśaḥ kuṇḍasambaddhas tasminn eva deśe jananam anyatrāgamanāt | iyaṃ śaktiḥ kuṇḍāderādhārābhimatasya badarādiṣv ādheyeṣu |
 prakṛtyevetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | prakṛtyā svabhāvenaivāsamāno deśe yasya tattathoktaṃ | prakṛtiśabdam apekṣamāṇasyāpi gamakatvād bahuvrīhiḥ | tathābhūtaṃ ca tatkāryaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ | kāryaṃ ca badarādikam evottarottarakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītaṃ | tasyotpādanaṃ tadeva dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya guruṇo dravyasya badarādeḥ pūrvakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītasya | samānadeśakāryotpādanabhāva ādhārakṛtaḥ | ātmanā tulyadeśasyotpādakatvam ādhārakṛtam ity arthaḥ | yata evaṃ tasmāt pāścāt yasya badarakāryasya yaḥ pūrvakṣaṇaḥ upādānabhūtas tasya sahakāri kuṇḍaṃ | tatraivopādānakṣaṇadeśa eva badarakārya janayat kuṇḍamādhāra ity ucyate |
 anena naikasāmagryadhīnayoḥ kuṇḍabadarakṣaṇayor ādhārādheyabhāva ity uktam bhavati | anyathā yadi kuṇḍena vadarāṇāṃ yathokta upakāro na kriyate tadeha kuṇḍe badarāṇoty evaṃ vyāpadeśo na syāt | niyatādhārasya vyapadeśasya nimittam antareṇāyogāt | tadupakārakṛta ity ādhāropakārakṛtāyaṃ vyāpadeśa iha kuṇḍe badarāṇīti | kin tarhi kuṇḍabadarayor yaḥ saṃyogas tatkṛtaḥ |
 kim punar ityādi siddhāntavādī | pṛcchataś cāyam abhiprāyo kṣaṇikatve sati saṃyogādīnām bhavadbhiḥ kalpaneṣyate | akṣaṇikatvaṃ ced bhāvānām abhyupagamyate saṃyogādīnām evotpattir na syād ity arthaḥ | tayor iti kuṇḍabadarayoḥ saṃyoga ity api vyapadeśanimittaṃ nāsty upakāryopakārakatvābhāvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 (p.280)tābhyām ityādi paraḥ | tābhyāṃ kuṇḍabadarābhyāṃ saṃyogasya jananāttayoḥ saṃyoga iṣyate | dvābhyām eva saṃyogasya jananam ubhayatra samavāyaḥ | pareṇokta ity a(va)mṛśya siddhāntavādy āha – sa ityādi | sa saṃyoga ekatraiva kuṇḍe badare vā kin na samavaiti janyate vā | ekena kuṇḍena badareṇa vā pṛcchataś cāyaṃ bhāvo yadi tau kuṇḍabadarākhyau bhāvau saṃyogajanane | ādhārabhāvopagamane vā | pratyekaṃ samarthasvabhāvau tadā kim ity anyonyam apekṣata iti | pṛthagarthan tadubhayaṃ parasparasahitam eva samartham iti ced āha – tad ityādi | yatkuṇḍabadaravastupṛthagasamartham tatparasparasahitam api tādṛśam evāsamartham evākṣaṇikatvād iti bhāvaḥ | kṣaṇikāstu pratyekaṃ pṛthagasamarthāḥ paścāt sahakārikṛtaviśeṣāssahitāssamarthā ity aviruddhaṃ | tataś ca saṃyogaṃ pratyanupakārakatvāt | kuṇḍabadarākhyam vastu | na saṃyogena taddharmyāt |
 sahitasyetyādi paraḥ | sahitasya kuṇḍasya badarasya ca tadanyopakārāt | tasmāt kuṇḍād yo yo badarātmā tasmāt kuṇḍasyopakārāt | tasmād vā badarād yad anyat kuṇḍan tasmād badarasyopakārāt | viśeṣotpatter hetoḥ kuṇḍabadarayoḥ saṃyogasya janane | ādhārabhāvopagamane vā sāmarthya na kevalayor iti |
 koyam ity ācāryaḥ | badarāṇāṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ cājanyajanakabhūtānāṃ koyam upakāraḥ (|) naivāsti | ajanyajanakatvam eva katham iti ced āha – svarūpetyādi | badarasvarūpasyānyataḥ hetor eva siddher ākāryatvān na badarāṇāṃ janyatvaṃ nāpi janakatvaṃ kuṇḍasyeti bhāvaḥ | na hi paro badarādīnāṃ kuṇḍādeḥ sakāśāt svarūpotpattim vāñchati | svahetor eva teṣān niṣpatteḥ | na kuṇḍena badararūpam eva kriyate kin tu tatonyadrūpam ity ata āha – pararūpetyādi | tatrety ādheye | na hy arthāntare kṛterthāntaram upakṛtaṃ syāt | ubhayartheti svarūpapararūpakriyābhyāṃ | anantaroktena vidhinānupakārakasya kuṇḍāder akiñcit karatvāt |
 etac coktaprāyaṃ | prāyaśabdo bāhulyavacanaḥ | prāyeṇoktam uktaprāyaṃ | rājadantāder ākṛtigaṇatvāt prāyaśabdasya paranipātaḥ | ayaṃ cārthaḥ "kāryaś ca tāsāṃ prāptosau jananaṃ yad upakriye"(1|108)tyādi vistareṇokotaḥ | prāyaśabdaṃ sadṛśārtham anyeprāhuḥ | uktena sadṛśam uktaprāyaṃ | prāguktenāśrayakṛtena sāmānyasya svarūpopakāreṇedaṃ kuṇḍādikṛtam ādheyasyopakārakaraṇan tulyam ity arthaḥ | sarva evetyādinopasaṃhāraḥ | sarva eva vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvād dhetor vyavasthāpy ata iti sambandhaḥ | vibhāgas teṣāṃ na syād iti ced āha – janakasyaivetyādi | yad vā kāryakāraṇabhāvāt sakāśāt pravibhāgena bhedena vyavasthāpy ante | katham bheda ity āha – janakasyaivetyādi | kāraṇakṛtaḥ kāryasya ya upakāraviśeṣas tasya balād ity arthaḥ | tathā hi pravisarppaṇadharmaṇo badarādeḥ svopādānadeśotpādanalakṣaṇenopayogenādhārādheya bhāvaḥ | pradīpakṛtena ca vijñānajananasamarthasvarūpotpādena ghaṭapradīpādīnāṃ vyaṅgyavyañjakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandha ity evam anyasminn api sambandhe yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ |
 nanu sarva eva vastusambandhā ityādinā na saṃyogalakṣaṇasya sambandhasya kāryakāraṇabhāventar bhāvaḥ samānakālabhāvinor evāsya sattvāt | athākṣaṇikapakṣe saṃyogotpattir na yujyate (|) aṇike tarhi bhaviṣyati saṃyuktāsaṃyuktāvasthayoś ca kuṇḍabadarayor na savarūpabhedaḥ pratīyate | tenākṣaṇikepi saṃyogosty eva pratīteḥ |
 yad āhodyotakaraḥ | "yadi saṃyogo na nārthāntaram bhavet tadā kṣetrabījodakādayo nirviśiṣṭatvāt sarvadaivāṃkurādikāryaṃ kuryur na caivaṃ | tasmāt sarvadā kāryānārambhāt kṣetrādīnyaṅkurotpattau kāraṇāntarasāpekṣāṇi | yathā mṛtpiṇḍādisāmagrī ghaṭādikaraṇe kulālādisāpekṣā | yosau kṣetrādinirapekṣaḥ sa samyoga iti siddhaṃ | kiṃ cāsau saṃyogo dravyayor viśeṣaṇabhāvena pratīyamānatvāt tatorthāntaratvena pratyakṣasiddha eva | tathā hi kaś cit kena cit saṃyukte dravye āharety ukto yayor eva dravyayoḥ saṃyogam upalabhate te evāharati | na dravyamātraṃ | kiṃ ca dūrataravarttinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntarepi vane nirantararūpāvasāyinī seyaṃ buddhir udayam āsādayati mithyābuddhir mukhyapadārthānubhavam antareṇa na kva cid upajāyate | na hy ananubhūtagodarśanasya gavaye gaur iti vibhramo bhavati tasmād avaśyaṃ saṃyogo mukhyobhyupagantavyaḥ | tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalīty anena pratiṣedhavākyena na kuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate tasyānyatra deśādau sattvāt | tasmāc caitrasya kuṇḍalasaṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate | tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalīty anenāpi vidhivākyena na caitrakuṇḍalayor anyataravidhānantayoḥ siddhatvāt | pāriśeṣyāt saṃyogavidhānaṃ | tasmād asty eva saṃyoga" iti | 1*
fn.1*: Nyāyavārttika.
 atrocyate | (1) yathā śretrādināṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāpratilambhena saṃyogārambhakatvam (p.282) iṣyate tathā saṃyogam aṃtareṇa kāryārambhakatvam eva kin neṣyate | anyathā sarvadā saṃyogārambhakatvaṃ syāt | (2) nāpi nirvikalpakena  pratyakṣeṇa saṃyukte dravye savarūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇe tṛtīyaḥ saṃyogaḥ pratibhāsate | (3) nāpi savikalpake jñāne saṃyukte dravye muktvā saṃyogaśabdaṃ cāparaḥ saṃyogo viśeṣaṇabhāvena pratibhāsate | (4) nāpi saṃyuktapratyayānyathānupapattyā saṃyogakalpanā | utpannanirantarāvasthayor eva bhavayoḥ saṃyuktapratyayahetutvāt | yāvac ca tasyām avasthāyāṃ saṃyogajanakatvena saṃyuktapratyayaviṣayau tāviṣyate tāvat saṃyogam antareṇa saṃyuktapratyayahetutvena tadviṣayau kiṃ neṣyete | kim pāram paryeṇa | (5) nāpi sāntare vane nirantarāvabhāsinī buddhir mukhyapadārthānubhavapūrvikā skhalatpratyayaviṣayatvenānupacaritatvāt | (6) tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyādau caitrasambandhikuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate vidhīyate vā | na saṃyogaḥ | tasmād ekasāmagryadhīnayor eva saṃyutāv iti pratītiḥ | yathā kuṇḍabadasyostasmāt saṃyogasyāpi kāryakāraṇabhāva evāntarbhāvaḥ | kevalaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa saṃyuktāvetau saṃyogasyeti vā pratītir na punar vastubhūtasaṃyogabalāt | yataś ca nāsti kāryakāraṇabhāvam antareṇa vāstavaḥ sambandhaḥ |
 tadayam ityādi | badarādiṣu janataśaktir eva kuṇḍādīnām ādhāra iti sambandhaḥ sāmānyasyāśrayo jananaśaktyaivādhārostv iti ced āha – netyādi | sati jananaśaktiḥ | atreti sāmānye |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svopādānadeśa eva jananaṃ jananaviśeṣaḥ sa lakṣaṇaṃ yasyādhārabhāvasya sa tathā | tasyājanyatvād iti sāmānyasya nityatvenājanyatvāt | tadabhāvetyāśrayābhāvepi sāmānyasyāvasthiter hetor āśrayavaśena na sthitiḥ sāmānyasya |
 athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasyeti sāmānyasya tadabhāvepīti vyaktyabhāvepi vyaktiśanye deśe sāmānyasya sthānāt | yadi hi vyaktiśūnye deśe sāmānyaṃ na bhavet tadā tatrāpūrvavyaktyutpāde sāmānyasambandho na bhavet | na hi tasyānyata āgamanaṃ niṣkriyatvāt (p.283) | na ca bhinnadeśāvasthitā vyaktis tasya sāmānyasyādhāro bhinnadeśatvāt | ekatvāt sāmānyasya nāsti bhinnadeśateti cet | sarvās tarhi vyaktaya ekajātimatya ekadeśāḥ prāpnuvanti | na ca sarvā jātimatyaḥ syuḥ | ekasya katham bhinnadeśāvasthitatvam iti ced ayam aparosya doṣostu |
 patanadharmetyādinopacayahetum āha – hi śabdaś cārthe | apiśabdobhyupagamasūcanārthaḥ | abhyupagamyāpy ayaṃ prakāraḥ sāmānye vyavasthāpayitum aśakyaḥ | sāmānyasyāpatanadharmmatvādity evam artham upanyāsaḥ | na tvajanakasya sthāpakatvaṃ sambhavati | ata evāha – atrāpītyādi | atrāpi pātapratibandhāt sthāpakābhyupagame yadi nyāyavādī kaś cit pātapratibandhaṃ na paryanuyuñjīta | tadā bhaved ajanakopi sthāpakaḥ | svasamayānurodhenety ākūtaṃ | atrāpy ayaṃ paryanuyogaḥ sambhavati | yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyate pātapratibandhaḥ sa sthāpy asyātmabhūto vā syāt tatorthāntaraṃ vā pātābhāvamātram vā | na tāvad ātmabhūtas tatsvabhāvasyānyato niṣpattyabhyupagamāt nāpy arthāntaram ity āha – arthāntaratvebhyupagamyamāne tatraiva pratibandherthāntarabhūte 'syādhārasyopayoga iti kaḥ patato badarādeḥ pratibandho vighātaḥ (|) naiva kaś cit | tataś ca kuṇḍādistham api badarādi patedeveti bhāvaḥ | ādhārakṛtenārthāntareṇa pātapratibandhena badarāder apātaḥ kriyata iti ced āha – pratibandhād apātepītyādi | pratibandhākhyāt yadārthād badarāder apātebhyupagamyamāne tulyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ | yoyaṃ pratibandhākhyena padārthenāpātaḥ kriyate sa kiṃ badarāder ātmabhūtorthāntaram vā | arthāntaratve tatraivāsya pratibandhasyopayoga ityādi | sarvamanantaroktaṃ tulyaṃ |
 atha tenāpy apātākhyenārthena badarāder apātaḥ kriyate tatrāpi tulyaḥ paryanuyoga ity āha – anavasthā ceti |
 tasmād ityādinā tṛtīyapakṣopanyāsaḥ | sa pātābhāvaḥ kathaṃ kena cit kriyate | (p.284) naiva kena cit | abhāvasyākāryatvād iti bhāvaḥ | kathan tarhy abhāvaṃ karotīti vyapadeśa iti ced āha – abhāvam ityādi | abhāvaṅkarotīti vyapadeśe nābhāvo nāma kaś cit kārya iṣyate | kasmād ity āha – tasyetyādi | tasyety abhāvasya kāryatvād bhāva eva syād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 nanu yathā ghaṭavat kāryatvāt paṭasya na ghaṭarūpatā | tathā bhāvavannābhāvasya kāryatvād abhāvarūpatā bhaviṣyatīti cet (|) na | ghaṭāder api hi bhāvarūpatvam bhavanadharmatvād eva (|) taccābhāvety astīti kathaṃ na bhāvarūpatvam abhāvarūpatvena pratibhāsanān na bhāvarūpateti cet (|) na (|) abhāvasya pratibhāsābhāvāt | abhāvānām parasparavibhāgapratīter ghaṭābhāvaḥ paṭābhāva ity atra paṭādīnām bhedo nābhāvānām ekatvena pratibhāsanād ity uktaṃ | yata evaṃ tasmād bhāvasya yā kriyā tasyāḥ pratiṣedhanirdeśo 'bhāvaṃ karotīti |
 ata eva spaṣṭayati | bhāvaṃ na karotīti yāvad iti | yāvānevāsya vākyasyārthas tāvānevābhāvaṃ karotīty asyāpīty arthaḥ | tathā ceti (|) pātapratibandhasyābhāvamātratvenākāryatve | ayam iti kuṇḍādiḥ | tena kāraṇenāyam iti badarādiḥ | kena citkuṅḍādinādhāreṇa pratibaddhaḥ | pātād anivārito na kadā citt iṣṭhet | sadaiva pated ity arthaḥ | tasmād ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | apiśabdād ādheya ity anenāpi vyapadeśena kṣaṇikānāṃ pūrvakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītenopādānena samānadeśasyottarakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītasya kāryasyotpādanam ucyate | tasmād sāmānye 'yam api prakāro na sambhavatīti khyāpanāyābhyupagamyaietad uktaṃ pātapratibandhād ajanakepi sthāpaka iti |
 tamevāsambhavan darśayitum āha – astu nāmetyādi | pātināgbadarādīnān tatpratibandhaḥ pātapratibandhostu nāmājananasvabhāvaḥ | tatkaraṇād iti pātapratibandhakaraṇāt | gatimato dravyasyeti sakriyasya sāmānyasya punar amūrttatvād akriyasya kiṃ lakṣaṇām sthitiṃ karvāṇa āśrayaḥ sthāpakaḥ syāt | na hi sāmānyasya pāto 'sti yena tatpratibandhaḥ (p.285) sthitir bhavet | kin tu sthitir hi tasya sāmānyasya svarūpāpracyutir evocyate | sā ca svarūpāpracyutir nāśrayāyattā sāmānyasya nityatvāt | abhyupagamyāpy ucyate | sāpy āśrayāyattā sāmānyasya sthitir ayuktaiva | sāmānyāt tasyāḥ sthiter bhedābhedavivecane | anyattvānanyattvavicāre kriyamāṇe |
 astu nāmetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | āśrayahetukety āśrayāyattā | seti sthitiḥ | tām evāśrayādanyāṃ sthitiṃ sa āśrayaḥ karoti na sāmānyaṃ | sā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddhā tataḥ sambandhasambaddhāt sāmānyam upakṛtam evety ata āha – sā cetyādi | sety arthāntarabhūtā sthitiḥ | na hi tasyāḥ sāmānye pratibandhakāraṇaṃ kiṃ cid asti kiṃ sāmānyasyāśrayeṇa kṛtam bhavatīty adhyāhāraḥ |
 abhyupagamyata eva sthiteḥ sāmānye pratibandha iti ced āha – pratibandhe cetyādi | pratibandhe vābhyupagamyamāne | sthitakaraṇaṃ cet | āśrayeṇa janitā yā sthitis tasyāḥ  sthiteḥ sthitiḥ sāmānyena kriyate | tataḥ sāśrayajanitā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddheti | tatrāpi sthiteḥ sthitikaraṇe tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | yā sā cāśrayapratibaddhāyāḥ sthiteḥ sāmānyena sthitiḥ kriyate sā āśrayahetukāyāḥ sthiter ātmabhūtā vā bhaved vyatiriktā vā | ātmabhūtatve āśrayeṇaiva sā kṛteti kathaṃ sāmānyena kriyate | vyatiriktatve ca saiva sthitiḥ sāmānyena kṛtā āśrayajanitāyā ādyāyāḥ sthiteḥ kiṃ sāmānyena kṛtaṃ syāt | atha sāṃānyena dvitīyā sthitiḥ kriyate | sā āśrayeṇa janitāyāṃ sthitau pratibaddhā | tadā kaḥ pratibandha iti vācyaṃ | sāmānyajanutāyāḥ sthiter āśrayajanitayā sthityā 'parā tṛtīyā sthitiḥ yata iti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ity anavasthā syāt | tatonavasthānād āśrayajanitāyāṃ sthitau sāmānyakṛtasyopakārasyānavadhāraṇād asya sāmānyasya sambandhinīyam āśrayeṇa janitā sthitir ity apratītiḥ jananaṃ cet pratibandha iti prakṛtaṃ | na sāmānyenāśrayajanitāyā sthiter aparā sthitiḥ kriyate | kin tu saivādyā sthitir janyata iti | tadā kevalaṃ sāmānyaṃ samarthaṃ sthitiṃ (p.286) karotu kim āśrayeṇa śāvaleyādinā sthitikaraṇāyāpekṣitena | na hy anupakārariṇyapekṣā yuktā | tasmād apekṣeti hi tatpratibandhaḥ | asmin vastunyasyāpekṣeti yeyam apekṣā sā tasminn apekṣye pratibandhas tadāyattatā | sa ca pratibandho nityatvād anādheyātiśayasyāyukta iti kevalaṃ sāmānyaṃ | sthitiṃ janayed iti nāsty asya āśrayaḥ sthitihetuḥ | tataś ca sthitikaraṇād āśrayassāmānyasyādhāra ity etad ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ | evam bhedābhedavivecana iti yaduktan tato bhedapakṣas tāvad apanītaḥ |
 dvitīyapakṣam āśrity āha – abheda ityādi | sāmānyād abhede vā sthiter abhyupagamyamāne svarūpam eva tatsthitirūpaṃ sāmānyasya (|) tac ca svarūpaṃ sāmānyasya nityam astīti na sthitir asya sāmānyasya kena cidāśrayeṇa kriyate | yata evaṃ tasmād ityādi | tadityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | taditi tasmād asyeti sāmānyasya |
 tadevaṃ vṛttir ādheyatā vyaktir iti yatpakṣadvayam uktan tata ādyasya nirāsaḥ kṛtaḥ (|)
 2--dvitīyapakṣam āśrity āha – atha punar ityādi | avyaktasyety aprakāśitasya | vyaktety āśrayeṇa jñānasyākāraṇatvāt tadvyaktes tenāśrayeṇa prakāśanaṃ yat | tadeva tatrāśraye sāmānyasya vṛttiḥ syāt | (|146-47||)
 nety ācāryaḥ | ātmani svaviṣaye vijñānotpādanaṃ | tatra yogyatvaṃ sāmānyan tadartham anyānurodhi | kāraṇantarasāpekṣaṃ yat tad astu vyaṅgyaṃ pratītaṃ | tasyāś ca svaviṣayajñānajananayogyatāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ yatpradīpādi tadvyaṅgyasya kārakam eva janakam eva | pūrvam ayogyasya paścād vijñānajananayogyasya ghaṭāder utpādanāt |
 yadi punaḥ pradīpādisannidhānāt prāg api ghaṭādi svākārajñānajananayogyan tadā prāg evāsya ca ghaṭāder yogyatve tadapekṣeti pradīpāpekṣā | sāmānyasya nityatvād avikāryasya (p.287) | taditi yathoktalakṣaṇaṃ vyaṅgyatvaṃ sāmānyavata ity āśrayāt sakāśāt kuto naivety arthaḥ | aparam iti svasantānād anyam bhāvam eva janayan vyañjaka ucyate | kim bhūtaṃ svaviṣayasya vijñānotpādanasamarthaṃ | sajātīyopādānāpekṣam iti svasantānasaṅgṛhītapūrvakṣaṇasāpekṣaṃ | yathāndhakārāvasthitaghaṭādikṣaṇasāpekṣam vijñānajananasamartham uttaraṃ ghaṭakṣaṇañ janayat prakāśakaḥ |
 nanu pradīpakāryatve ghaṭasya pradīpoyacayepi ghaṭasyopacayopi syād iti cet (|) na | upādānagatād vibhedāt kāryasya bhedo na sahakārigatāt | sahakārikāraṇaṃ ca pradīpādir vyaṅgyasya ghaṭasyeti kuto mahatvādiprasaṅgosya (|) yad vā 'bhivyaktāv api kriyamāṇāyāṃ tulyoyaṃ prasaṇga iti yat kiñ cid etat | na ca vyaṅgyakṣaṇasadṛśasya kṣaṇasya mṛtpiṇḍād utpattir api tu pradīpādeveti kutonyādṛśāt tādṛśasyotpattiḥ | anapekṣaṃ ceti | yathā sajātīyopādānāpekṣaṃ svaviṣayavijñānajananasamarthaṃ śabdaṃ janayann abhighātaḥ | na hy abhighātāt prāk chabdosti yena samānajātīyāpekṣaḥ śabdo bhavet | śbdopi hi vyaṅgyaḥ parair iṣyata ity evam uktaṃ |
 yadi tarhi kāraka eva vyañjakaḥ kas tarhi kārakavyañjakayor hetvor viśeṣa ity ata āha – paratretyādi | vyañjakādanyasmin kārakatvenābhimata ity arthaḥ | jñānajananaśaktir anākṣiptā janyasya | na hi svaviṣayavijñānajananasamartham eva kāryaṃ kārakeṇa bījādinā janyate | tato jananamātreṇa kārakatvaṃ svaviṣayavijñānajananasamarthakāryotpādanalakṣaṇena tu viśeṣeṇa vyaṅjakatvam iti | (147-48||)
 yady api vyañjakād vyaṅgyo vijñānotpādanayogyatāṃ pratilabhate tathāpi na janyata iti ced āha – yadi hītyādi | yata iti vyañjakāt | sa cet vyaṅgyaḥ | tasyeti vyañjakasya sā yokyatā 'sya vyaṅgyasya vyañjakasannidhānāt prāg evāsti | yato (p.288) vyaṅgyasya svabhāvabhūtā sā | yathāvyaṅgyaḥ prāg evāsti tathā tatsvabhāvabhūtāpi yogyatā | tam apekṣata iti vyañjakaṃ | vyaṅgyād vyatiriktaiva yogyatā vyañjakena kriyata iti ced āha – paretyādi | asyām iti yogyatāyāṃ | saiva yogyatā | tata iti vyañjakāt sthitivatprasaṅgaḥ | yaduktam (|) anyā cet sthitis tām evāśrayaḥ karotītyādi tad ihāpi prasajyeta | tam iti vyaṅgyaṃ | nāpi vyaṅgyād anyat tatkaraṇe vyaṅgyasya na kiñ cid iti kṛtvā 'pekṣyata ity anenopakāritvam uktaṃ | akiṃ cit karatvena tatpratiṣedhas tato vyāhatam etat |
 yaduktaṃ (|) janaka eva vyañjaka iti tasya tat tv ityādinā vyabhicāram āha – na hi dhūmogner janako 'tha ca kāryatvāt tasya vyañjakaḥ | ādiśabdād balājādiḥ salilasya (|) sattyam ityādinā pariharati | na tu dhūmaṃ liṅgam apekṣyāgnir ātmani svalakṣaṇe jñānaṃ janayati | kasmāt (|) tathābhūtasyānumeyatvenābhimatasyāgneḥ sākṣād ajanakatvāt | anyathāgnisvalakṣaṇākāratvāt pratyakṣāt pratibhāsāviśeṣaḥ syāt | kevalam ityādinopādānakāraṇam eva tasya sākṣāj janakam ity ādarśayati | liṅgajñānam upādānaṃ | na viṣayabalenāgnisvalakṣaṇabalena (|) kiṅ kāraṇam (|) asaty api tasmin vahnau pūrvadhvas tepi bhāvād agnijñānasya | katham ity āha – paramparayetyādi | liṅgānusārī liṅgānusmaraṇavikalpas tena | tathā hi kasya cit puruṣasya kva cid dhūmandṛṣṭavato dhvas te dhūme vahnau ca katham api tatra dhūmānusmaraṇavikalpa utpanne paścād anvayavyatirekānusmaraṇād abhūd atra dhūmas tasmād vahnir apy atrāsīd ityevaṃ paramparayāgnijanyadhūmād agnijñānam utpadyata eva |
 nāpītyādinā pūrvoktam atraiva yojayati | sāmānyākārāvabhāsi cānumānajñānaṃ | na sannihitaviṣayatā | vinaṣṭepi hi viṣaye anutpanne ca sambhavāt | yadāpi sannihito viṣayas tadāpi na viṣayabalenotpattir iti niveditaṃ prāk na hi vikalpā (p.289) yathābhāvam eva pravarttanta ityādinā | bhāvābhāvānavidhānāc ca sāmarthyann pratibhāsād ityādinā tṛtīye paricchede   (   ) pratipādayiṣyate ca | sākṣād upayogena svarūpānukārivijñānajananasāmarthyena | tatreti svaviṣayajñānajanane | param iti pradīpādikaṃ | tata ity apekṣyāt pradīpadeḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | na sarvo vyañjako janaka ity ucyate (|) kin tu svākārajñānajanakasya parasya sāhāyyaṃ yaḥ pratipadyate sa eva | tato nāsti vyabhicāra iti | sāmānyam api svākārajñānajananāśrayam apekṣata iti vyaṅgyam iṣṭan tatas tenāśrayād upalambhayogya ātmā labdhavyaḥ (|) na cāyamātmapratilambhaḥ sāmānyasya kutaś cit sambhavati | nityatvenābhyupagatatvāt | taditi sāmānyaṃ |
 naivetyādi paraḥ | svāśrayasamavāyavyaktiṃ brūma iti sambandhaḥ | svāśrayasamavāyaḥ kathaṃ vyaktir iti ced āha – svāśrayetyādi | tad iti sāmānyaṃ | anyatreti svāśraye |
 uktam ity ācāryaḥ | "tadevedam anupakārakasyāśrayatvaṃ ba sambhāvayāma" ityādinoktatvāt | svāśrayasamavetaṃ hi tadātmanyanyatra vā vijñānahetur iti brūvāṇena svāśrayasāvāyāpekṣaḥ sāmānyapadārthaḥ vijñānahetur iṣṭaḥ | tataś ca tena svāśrayasamavāyena sāmānyātmā janyasya syāt | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) taddhetor jñānahetoḥ svabhāvasya svāśrayasamavāyāt prāgbhāvāt | svāśrayasamavāye sati paścāc ca tataḥ svāśrayasamavāyād vijñānahetoḥ svabhāvasya bhāvāt | nityaṃ sāmānyasya vijñānajananasvabhāvatvād asiddham etad iti ced āha – nityam ityādi | tatsvabhāvasadbhāva iti vijñānajananasvabhāve prāg api svāśrayasamavāyād vyaktiśūnyepi deśe kevalāt sāmānyād ity arthaḥ | sāmānyākāravijñānodayaprasaṅgāt | (|148-49||)
 netyādiparaḥ | vyaktir āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya saṃskāro yogyatādhānan tasmād dhetor na (p.290) vyañjikā sāmānyasya | yena tayā janyaṃ syāt sāmānyaṃ | kin tarhi tadgrāhiṇa iti sāmānyagrāhiṇaḥ saṃskārād vyañjaketi prakṛtaṃ |
 yopītyādy ācāryaḥ | añjanāder iveti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | añjanādeḥ sakāśād yathendriyasaṃskāro yukto naivaṃ vyakteḥ sakāśāt | kasmāt pratipatter jñānasya vyañjakatvenābhimatāyā vyakter bhāvābhāvakālayoḥ saptamīdvivacanam etat |
 saṃskṛtam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | añjanādibhiḥ saṃskṛtam indriyaṃ kaṃ cid tiśayamātmabhūtamāsādayati | pratipattau pratipattinimittaṃ | viśiṣṭajñānotpādanāyeti yāvat | nimittāt karmasaṃyoga ity anenātra saptamī | kuta etad iti ced āha – spaṣṭetyādi | pratipatter iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | tathā hi timirādyupahatam indriyam aspaṣṭaṃ vijñānañ janayati | tadevāñjanādisaṃskṛtaṃ spaṣṭato 'vasīyate (|) saṃskṛtam indriyaṃ pratipattyartham atiśayamāsādayatīti |
 athāñjanādeḥ sakāśān na pratipattibhedas tadā | tadakāriṇaś ca pratipattibhedākāriṇaś cāñjanāder atatsaṃskāra(ka)tvād indriyāsaṃskārakatvāt | yathāñjanādeḥ sakāśād indriyasya saṃskāro naivaṃ vyakteḥ sakāśāt (|) kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadbhāvābhāvakālayor ityādi | tathā hi vyañjikāyā govyakter abhāvakāle yādṛśaṃ cakṣurvijñānaṃ vṛkṣādāv utpannan tasyā govyakteḥ (a)bhāvepi vṛkṣādau tādṛśam eva | yadi tadabhāvakāle pūrvam aspaṣṭaṃ vijñānaṃ vṛkṣādiṣūtpannaṃ paścād govyaktikṛta indrayasaṃskāro gamyeta |
 viṣayasaṃskārepi sati viṣayāntare naiva pratipattibhedo 'sty ataḥ sopi na yukta iti ced āha – viṣayetyādi | viṣayasya gandhāder yaḥ kena cit saṃskārassa indriyāviśeṣepi | yadi nāmānyatra  viṣayāntare indriyasya pratipattiṃ prati viśeṣo nāsti | tathāpi tadviveṣādhānantasya saṃskṛtaviṣayagrāhakasya jñānasya viśeṣādhānād upakārī syāt | (p.291) nendriyasaṃskāra upakārī syād iti sambandhaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | viṣayā hi viniyatās te svākārasyaiva vijñānasya sādhanaṃ nākārāntarayuktasya (|) tato viṣayasaṃskāraḥ pratiniyatatvāt svaviṣayam eva viśiṣṭāṃ pratipattiñ janayan na virudhyate | indriyaṃ tu svagrāhye viṣayabhede tulyaṃ sādhanamatas tatsaṃskāraḥ sarvasmiṃs tadgrāhye pratipatter bhedakaḥ prāpnotīti | nendriyasya vyaktibhedas tadindriyagrāhye sarvasmin dṛśye viṣaye spaṣṭākārajñānajananāya saṃskāram ādhatte | kin tarhi vyaktyutpatteḥ prāg adṛśya sāmānye indriyasya darśanaśaktyādhānāt kāraṇād vyaktibheda upakārakaṃ iti cet | atondriyadarśanād eva ca spaṣṭam indriyasya saṃskāro gamyate | vyaktisannidhānāt pūrvam asamartham paścāt tatsannidhāne samartham iti sa vyaktibhedotīndriyaṃ sāmānyākhyam arthandarśayan kathaṃ pratipatteḥ sarvatra na bhedako bhedaka evety arthaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | dṛśyepi tāvad aspaṣṭe spaṣṭākāradarśanaśaktyādhānād añjanādikṛtaḥ indriyasaṃskāraḥ sarvatra tadindriyagrāhye viṣaye pratipatter bhedako dṛṣṭaḥ (|) kiṃ punar yotīndriyasyārthasya darśakas tathā cānyasyāpy atīndriyasya paramāṇvāder darśakaḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ | sāmānyasyaiva darśanāyendriyasya saṃskāram ādhatte vyaktibhedaḥ tato nāsty atiprasaṇga iti ced āha – eketyādi | ekasmin sāmānye draṣṭavye indriyasaṃskārasya pratiniyamas tasminn abhyupagamyamāne tasminn eva vyaktibhede śāvaleyādikesamavetaṃ yatsāmānyāntaraṃ sattādravyatvādi | tasya darśaka indriyasaṃskāro na syāt | iṣyate ca | ātmasamavetānām eva sarvasāmānyānān darśanāyendriyasaṃskāro naikasyaiveti ced āha – vyaktyā cetyādi | taddarśana iti teṣāṃ vyaktisamavetānāṃ sāmānyānān darśane | tadvyaṅgyeṣu tayā vyaktyā vyaṅgiyeṣu | dṛṣṭaṣ ca dūrād dravyamātradarśane dravyatvam arthatvayor niścayepi sati gotvādāv aniścayaḥ | yasminn aniścayas tasya darśanāya nāhitaḥ saṃskārabheda iti ced āha – ekaniścayo veti na syād iti sambandhaḥ | ekaśabdonyārtho 'niścitād anyasyāpi niścitābhimatasya dravyatvāder (p.292) niścayo na syāt | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tasyā vyakter avibhāgamayās teṣu svātmasamaveteṣu sāmānyeṣu viśeṣābhāvāt | na hi sā vyaktiḥ kva cit pratyāsannā kva cin na | tataḥ sarvasya vā niścayaḥ sāmānyasya na vā kasya cid apīty evaṃ tāvad vyakter indriyasaṃskāro na ghaṭata ity ākhyātam (|)
 adhūnābhyupagamyāpy  ucyate | vyakter ityādi | vyaktessakāśāt pakśadvayepi sāmānyasya vijñānajananasvabhāva iti kṛtvā (|) tasmād vijñānajananāt svabhāvāt pracyuteḥ kāraṇān na hi samarthasya sahakāryapekṣā yuktā | saṃskṛtam indriyaṃ sahakāri yasya sāmānyasya tattathoktan tadbhāvas tasmāt | nityatvād anādheyātiśayasya sāmānyasya keyaṃ sahakārārthaḥ (|) naiva kaś cit |
 anittyā hītyādinā vyatirekam āha – sahakāriṇaḥ sakāśād viśiṣṭasyātmano lābhāt | tam iti sahakāriṇaṃ (|) kasmād (|) yo hy eṣāṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ janaka ātmā sahakārisannidheḥ prāṅnāsīt | taraiva sahakārisannidhikāle | tataḥ sahakāriṅaḥ sakāśād bhavatīti kṛtvā | eṣām iti kṣaṇikānāṃ |
 nanu kṣaṇikānām api kathaṃ sahakāriṇo viśiṣṭātmalābhāpekṣā | sahabhāvinām parasparam anupakāryopakārakatvāt | yaś ca kṣaṇo jāyate na tasya sadasattvakālayossahakāryapekṣeti (|)
 ayuktam uktam upakārī hy apekṣatā iti naiṣa doṣaḥ | sattāpekṣayaitad ucyate | ata evāha – janyataivaiṣāṃ parasparatopekṣeti | anasādya param iti sahakāriṇaṃ | tatsvabhāvaṃ samarthasvabhāvaṃ | na hi tasya sāmānyasya kevalasya sahakārivikalasya prāg yo na vijñānajananasvabhāvaḥ sa punaḥ kathaṃ cid bhāvī | na hīti sambandhaḥ | nityatvād iti bhāvaḥ |
 (p.293) kiñ ca (|) vyakteḥ sāmānyasaṃskāre sati tajjanyaṃ sāmānyaṃ syād iti pareṇendriyasaṃskāroṅgīkṛtaḥ (vyakteḥ sakāśāt) | tathāpi vyaktijanyatvaṃ prasajyata ity āha – vyaktir ityādi | tatsahakāri | vyaktisaṃskṛtendriyasahakāri sāmānyam vijñānahetur ity abhyupagamyamāne | vyaktikāryasyendriyasya kāryatvāt sāmānyaṃ vyakteḥ pāram paryeṇa kāryam uktaṃ syāt | (|149-50||)
 bhavatu nāma sāmānyasya vyañjikā vyaktiḥ tāvad asyā jātimattvaṃ na yuktam atiprasaṅgād ity āha – api cetyādi | jātīnāṃ sāmānyānāṃ vyañjakasya vyaktibhedasya jātimattā yadīṣyate | tadā gotvādeḥ prakāśakaḥ vya(?pra)dīpādi(ḥ) vyañjakatvāt tena gotvādinā tadvān gotvādimān prāptaḥ | śāvaleyādivat | gotvādhāraḥ prāpta ity arthaḥ |
 yo hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | gotvādiṣu vyaṅgyeṣu vijñānahetutvaṃ pradīpāder apy asti | katham iti ced āha – teja ityādi | yasmād asty ālokasya vijñānam prati hetutvaṃ | tata iti jñānahetutvāt | pradīpādaya iti (|) ādiśabdād indriyasaṃskārādiparigrahaḥ | teṣām api jñānahetutvāt | vyakteḥ sakāśād viśiṣṭasyaivābhivyaktiḥ sāmānyasya bhavati na tathā pradīpāder iti ced āha – na hītyādi | vyakter api sakāśāt sāmānyasyābhivyaktir jñānahetutāṃ muktvā na hy anyā kā cit | yadi hi sāmānyasyātiśayādhānaṃ vyaktyā kriyate na pradīpādinā | tadā bhaved viśeṣas tac ca nāsti | svabhāvātiśayasyādhātum aśakyatvāt | nityatvāt sāmānyasyeti bhāvaḥ | samavāya ityādi | vyaktau ca samavetaṃ gotvaṃ na pradīpādau | tasyeti sāmānyasya | ajanyajanakayoḥ (p.294) koyaṃ samavāya ity uktatvāt |
 bhavatu nāma samavāyas tathāpy asya sāmānyasya samavāyamātraṃ vyaktyā saha jātaṃ nānyaḥ kaś cid viśeṣo vijñānajananalakṣaṇaḥ | pūrvavad iti vyaktisamavāyāt prāgvat paścād api vyaktisamavāyepi yady api sāmānyasya na kaś cid viśeṣas tathāpi samavāyabalād eva svaviṣayajñānajananam iti ced āha – samavāyāvevetyādi | jñānahetutvena sāmānyasyābhyupagamyamāne | svāśrayo yo yatra samavetas tatsamanāyinaṃ | sāmānyasyābhyupagamyamāne | svāśrayo yo yatra samavetas tatsamavāyinaṃ | sāmānyād anyeṣām api paramāṇusamavetānāṃ rūpādīnām api dṛśyatāpattiḥ syāt | samavāyasyaikatvena sarvatrāviśeṣāt | yathā hi sāmānyamatīndryam api kevalassamavāyo darśayaty evaṃ pramāṇugatān api rūpādīn kin na darśayet | yataś ca samavāyapakṣe 'yan doṣas tasmāt jñānahetutaiva sāmānye vyaktervyañjakatvaṃ | tac cetthaṃ bhūtaṃ vyañjakatvan tulyam pradīpādāv apīti sa eva prasaṅaḥ prāpto gotvādinā tadvān ityādikaḥ | (|150-51||)
 taditi tasmānnādheyatā sāmānyasya svāśraye vṛttir nāpi svāśrayeṇa vyaktir abhivyaktiḥ svāśraye sāmānyasya vṛttiḥ | ataś cāvṛtteḥ kāraṇāt sāmānyan nānekatra vyaktibhede ekākārajñānahetuḥ | na hi yo yatra na varttate sa tatrātmavṛttidvāreṇa jñānahetur yuktaḥ |
 ata evānekatra ekasya sāmānyasyāvṛtteḥ kāraṇāt | vyakteḥ sakāśād anyā yadi jātir athavānanyā | yeṣāṃ vādināṃ | vyaktiṣv apūrvāsu saṃpratyutpannāsu paścād vā dṛśyamānāsu | tu śabdo vidyate śabdātpareṇa draṣṭavyovadhāraṇārthaḥ | ata evāha – vidyata evetyādi | vastusatī yeṣāṃ jātir iti yāvat | svasānarthye sati svapratipattidvāreṇa | anyatreti vyaktibhede buddhiñ janayan | kiṃ viśiṣṭāṃ svarūpānukāriṇīm ekarūpānugatāṃ (p.295) yatra buddhiñ janayati tena sambandham apekṣate | sambandham antareṇa svākārabuddhijanane 'tiprasaṅgāt | (|151-52||)
 sa ceti sambandho vyaktyantareṇa sāmānyasya sato vidyamānasya | tattvapakṣe 'nyattvapakṣe ca na sambhavati (|) kasmād (|) ekatra vyaktibhedasyārthāntarabhūtasyānarthāntarasya cānyatra vyaktyantare darśanāsambhavāt | sā hītyādi naitad eva sādhayati | sā hi buddhir bhūtagrāhiṇī vastubhūtasāmānyagrāhiṇyekabhāvinī | ekatra vyaktibhede utpannā vyaktyantaram eva sā skandet gacched (|) vyaktyantaram api sāmānyākāreṇa gṛhṇīyād iti yāvat | yadi tatraikasmin vyaktibhede dṛṣṭaṃ kiñ cid vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam anyatreti yatra vyaktibhede tayā skanditavyaṃ | tac cānyatra darśanaṃ | sata iti vastubhūtasya sāmānyasya na sambhavatīti sambandhaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) āśrayād anyatvebhyupagamyamānenvayābhāvāt | na hy ekasmād avyatiriktas tadātmabhūtonyadanveti | āśrayād amyattvepi sāmānyasya vyaktāvanapāśrayāt | anantaroktenādhārādheyādibhāvaniṣedhenāśrayabhāvasya niṣiddhatvāt | yadi vyatiriktasya sāmānyasyāsambandhān na vyaktyantare svākārajñānajananam (|) evaṃ tarhy ādyāyām api vyaktau tattulyam iti kim ucyate vyaktiṣv apūrvāsv iti vyaktiṣv ity eva vaktavyaṃ | tathaikatra dṛṣṭasyānyatra darśanāsambhavād ity api vaktavyaṃ | ekatrāpi vyaktibhede sambandham antareṇa darśanāsambhavāt |
 satyam etat | abhyupagamyaitad uktam ity adoṣaḥ |
 yopi manyate (|) tattvānyattvapakṣe sāmānyasyānyadarśanaṃ na sambhavaty asmākan tu bhinnābhinnam eva sāmānyaṃ | tathā hi (|)
 "nirviśeṣaṃ na sāmānyaṃ bhavec chaśaviṣāṇavat |
 kena cic cātmanaikatvaṃ nānātvaṃ cāsya kenacit |
 yadā ca śabalam vastu yugapat pratibhāsate |
(p.296) tadānyānanyabhedādi sarvam eva pralīyata" iti |1*
fn.1: Ślokavārtika, Ākṛti 10.
 tanniṣedhārtham āha – svabhāvo hītyādi | svabhāvāt tattvam evānyattvam eva vā na laṅghayatīti sambandhaḥ |
 nanu deśakālasvabhāvābhedepi sāmānyaviśeṣayor anugatavyāvṛttirūpābhyāṃ bhedopīṣyata ity ata āha – rūpasyānugatasya svabhāvasyātadbhūtasya vyavṛttarūpasvabhāvasyānyattvāvyatikramāt | vyāvṛttebhyo viśeṣarūpebhyo bhinnasyānugatarūpasya sāmānyasyānyattvam eva syād ity arthaḥ | asty atadrūpatvam anyattvam eva (|) katham ity ata āha – idam evetyādi | yan na tadity atadrūpam ity arthaḥ | etāvad evānyattvalakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ | ākārāntaravat | ṣaṣṭhyarthe vatiḥ | tathā hi sukhād duḥkhasyāpy anyattvam asukharūpaṃ duḥkham iti kṛtvā | iyatā cātadrūpasyānyattvalakṣaṇena vyāptir uktā | asya cānyattvalakṣaṇasyāviśeṣād abhimatepi sāmānye |
 etena pakṣadharma uktaḥ | prayogas tu | yadvastutve satyatadrūpan tasya tatonyattvam eva tadyathā sukhād duḥkhasya | vastutve satyavyaktirūpaṃ ceṣyate sāmānyam ity atadrūpatvenānyattve vyavahārasya sādhyatvāt svabhāvahetuḥ | evaṃ tāvad atadrūpatve sāmānyasyānyattvam evāpāditam (|) athānyattvaṃ neṣyate tadā tattvaṃ prāpnotīty āha – tac cetyādi | vyākter anyat tadā tad eva vyaktirūpam eva tat sāmānyam bhavati | atattve ity avyaktirūpatve tastvantaravad anyattvaprasaṅgāt | etac cānantaram evoktaṃ |
 astv anyattvaṃ sāmānyasya tathāpi vyaktyantaram anuyāsyatīty ata āha – na caiketyādi | ekavyaktisvabhāvasya vyaktyantarānvāveśonugamo vyaktyantarasvabhāvam iti yāvat | kasmāt tasyāvagamyamānasyāvyaktyantaratvaprasaṅgāt | yadi śābaleyātmakaṃ sāmānyaṃ bāhuleyasyātmabhūtaṃ bhavet tadā bāhuleyaḥ śābaleya eva jātaḥ śābaleyātmakāt sāmānyād avyaktirekācchābaleyavad iti kutosya vyaktyantaratvaṃ | tata iti tasmād vyakter avyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyāt sakāśād anvayinīty anugāminī | (p.297) nāpi vyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyād anvayinī buddhir iti prakṛtaṃ | kasmāt (|) tasya vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya kvacid bhede 'nāśrayād apravṛtteḥ (|) sanbandham antareṇa pravṛttyayogāt | "vṛttir ādheyatā vyaktir iti tasmin na yujyata" ityādinā ca vyaṅgyavyañjakasyādhārādheyabhāvasya ca sambandhasya niṣiddhatvāt | anyas tarhi sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandho bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – anyasyāpītyādi | vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvāder iti pañcamī | ādiśabdād ādhārādheyabhāvaparigrahaḥ | etasmāt pūrvaniṣiddhāt sanbandhadvayād anyasyāpi yasya kasyacit sambandhasya vyaktiṃ prati sāmānyasyābhāvāt | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) nityatvāt kenacid vyaktibhedenānupakāryasya sāmānyasyāpratibandhena | na hy apratibandhasya kaścit sambandhostīty uktaṃ |
 etena cānyattve 'pāśrayād iti ślokabhāgo vyākhyātaḥ | (|152-53||)
 asatsambandham api sāmānyaṃ vyaktiṣu svarūpānukāriṇīṃ pratītiṃ janayatīti ced āha – sambandhād ityādi | nāsya sambandhostīti vigrahaḥ | sarvasmāt sarvatra pratītiḥ syād ity arthaḥ | tad iti tasmād ayam iti sāmānyavādī | ekasya sāmānyasya darśanena hetunā | ekasmin śābaleye vyaktibhede vṛttir asya tasyānyatra vyaktyantare vṛttimanvicchin vastutveneṣṭasya sāmānyasya vyakteḥ sakāśād ye tattvānyattve | te nākramati vastuno gatyantarābhāvāt | cokto doṣa ity yuktam etadvastubhūtāt sāmānyād anuyāyijñānam iti |
 yata evaṃ tasmādartheṣu parasparavivekiṣv iyam ekarūpaikākārā pratītir bhrāntir eva (|) bhinneṣv abhedādhyāropeṇa vṛtteḥ | kutas tarhi sotpannety āha – vikalpetyādi | vijātīyavyāvṛttapadārthānubhavena yā tathābhūtavikalpasya prakṛtyā janikā vāsanāhitā tataḥ samuthitāḥ | etac ca prāg evoktam ity āha – bhāvabheda ityādi | bhāvānān tatkāryāṇām atatkāryebhyo bhedaḥ | tathābhūtānāṃ cānubhāvenāhitā yā vāsanā tasyāḥ prakṛtiś ca svabhāvaś cāsyā āśraya iti nirṇītam etat prāk tatra bhāvabhedaḥ pāramparyeṇa kāraṇaṃ (p.298) vāsanā prakṛtiḥ sākṣād iti dvayam upanyastaṃ | yady anyāpoha eva śabdavācyaḥ kathan tarhīdānīm ityādi | pradhāneśvarādikāryaśabdā iti pradhānakāryamīśvarakāryañjagad iti | ādiśabdāc chabdabrahmapariṇāma ity ādiśabdānāṃ parigrahaḥ |
 bhaveṣvādhyātmikabāhyeṣu | atadbhūto 'pradhānādikāryātmako bhedo yeṣānte tathoktāḥ | yady apy apradhānakāryāt teṣāṃ bhedaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pradhānādikāryātmako bhedaḥ (|) sa eva ca sarveṣām abhedaḥ | tenābhedenānimittena sarvatra varttante | sa ca nāsti bhāvānām anyāpohavādino matenāpradhānādikāryātmakatvāt | tataś ca katham evaṃbhūteṣv abhedena varttante | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | tataś cāvyāpinyapohavyavastheti bhāvaḥ |
 tepītyādinā pariharati | tepi pradhānādikāryaśabdā vikalpavijñānapratibhāsinyarthe pravarttante iti sambandhaḥ | katham ity āha (|) saṃketetyādi | vastuny tathābhūte | icchāvaśād yaḥ saṃketaḥ pradhānakāryaṃ jagad iti | tenāhitā yā vāsanāśaktis tayottarottarakṣaṇavipariṇāmenopaskṛtatvād vijñānasantateḥ sarveṣāṃ bāhyādhyatmikānām arthānāṃ darśaneṣv anubhaveṣu satsv apy anapekṣya tadbhedam apradhānakāryād bhedam vastugataṃ | yadi nāmārthānām apradhānakāryāṇām eva darśanam vastudharmeṇa tathāpi vastusvabhāvam anapekṣyety arthaḥ (|) tathādhyavasāyād yathāsaṃketam apradhānakāryān api bhāvān pradhānakāryatvenādhyavasānāt | atathābhūtakalpitapradhānakāryatvena kalpitaṃ caitanyaṃ sāṃkhyena tasya vyavacchedena pradhānakāryābhāvā iti yad vikalpavijñānan tapratibhāsiny arthe | sa eva vijātīyavyavacchedenānyāpoha iti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ bhūtās te śabdā ity āha – upādānetyādi | vikalpahetor vāsanāyā dārḍhyam upādānabalan tasmāt prabhava utpādo yasya vikalpasya tasmāt samutthitāḥ
 etad uktam bhavati | yadi nāma vastuni tathābhūtabhedābhāvas tathāpi vikalpāropita evānyāpohaḥ śabdānāṃ pravṛtter aṅgan tato nāsyāvyāpitādoṣa iti | pradhānādikāryaśabdānām abhedena pravṛttau teṣu bhāveṣu sāmānyam eva vastubhūtaṃ kin neṣyata iti ced āha – na hītyādi | teṣu pradhānakāryatvenādhyāropiteṣu | atathābhūteṣu pradhānakāryeṣu vyaktyabhāvāt sāmānyasyābhāva iti bhāvaḥ |
 (p.299) anyāpohavādinas tu na doṣa ity āha – tathetyādi | pradhānādikāryatvakalpanayety arthaḥ | tadanyasyāpradhānādikāryasya bhedo vyavacchedaḥ pradhānādikāryatvenāropitānām bhāvānāṃ pratipattṛṇāṃ adhyavasāyavaśāt syāt |
 tadadhyavasāyavaśād eva pratipattradhyavasāyavaśād eva śāvaleyādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayanimittaṃ sāmānyaṃ kin neti cet |
 naitad asti | yasmāt tena sāmānyavādinā sāmānyaṃ kalpayatāpy avaśyaṃ tatra śābaleyādiṣu vijātīyād bhedo nāntarīyakatayeṣṭavyonyathā gotvāder asiddhiḥ syāt | sa eva bhedaḥ sāmānyakārye 'bhinnaśabdapravṛttyādilakṣaṇe paryāntaḥ śaktaḥ | ityevaṃ niṣprayojanā sāmānyakalpanā |
 tad uktam bhavati | yathā pradhānakāryeṣv api bhāveṣu sāmānyam antareṇa pradhānādikāryaśabdas tadbuddhayaś caikākārāḥ pravarttante | tathā gavādiṣu gavādiśabdās tadbuddhayaś caikākārāḥ kin neṣyante kiṃ sāmānyena pāramārthikena kalpitena | dṛṣṭā ca parair api sāmānyam antareṇa bahuṣu sāmānyeṣv abhinnābhidhānapratyayavṛttiḥ |
 tad uktam bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ
 "tasmād ekasya bhinneṣu yā vṛttis tannibandhanaḥ |
 sāmānyaśabdaḥ sattādāv ekadhīkaraṇena veti |" śloka vā° ākṛ° 24
 tenāyam arthaḥ (|) yathā pratyekam anekārthasamavāyitvena sattvadravyatvādau sāmānyaśabdas tadbuddhiś ca sāmānyam antareṇa pravarttete (|) na cānekārthasamavāyitvaṃ sāmānyaṃ yad eva sattve tad eva dravyatvādav asti | niḥsāmānyāni sāmānyānīti vacanāt | na copacārāttayoḥ (śabdajñānayoḥ) vṛttiraskhaladbuddhigrāhyatvāt | tasmād yathā sāmānyaṃ vinā tayoḥ sattādau vṛttis tathā śābaleyādiṣu sāmānyam antareṇa (|) yathā śābaleyo 'govyāvṛttas tathā bāhuleyo 'govyāvṛttas tathā khaṇḍo 'govyāvṛtta ity abhinnābhidhānapratyayavṛttiḥ kin neṣyata ity arthaḥ |
 syād etat (|) sarvatra sāmānyabuddhir nirviṣayeṣṭaiva kevalaṃ sāmānyam antareṇa kvacidasamvādo na syād ity ata āha – yadītyādi | yadiśabdobhyupagamadyotanārthaḥ | yady asyās sarvatra nirviṣayatvam abhyupagamyate | satsv iti vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣv agovyāvṛtteṣu | asatsv iti paramārthataḥ pradhāneśvarādikāryatayā 'vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣu | neyam (p.300) arthavatī sāmānyabuddhiḥ | tayā yathāropitasyābhinnākārasya bāhyeṣv abhāvabhā(?)vādataś cābhūtagrahād | viplavo bhrāntir eveti kṛtvā | nāsyās sāmānyabuddher nirviṣayāyā viṣayanirūpaṇaṃ prati kaścidādaraḥ | yadi sarvaiva sāmānyabuddhir bhrāntā kathan tarhy anumānād vastusamvāda ity āha – kvacid ityādi | kvacid vastunyasya buddheḥ sakāśād avisamvādo yasm(ād) kāryakāraṇasambaddhād yathoktāt | etac ca niveditaṃ prāk | "yatrāsti vastusambandho yathoktānumitau yathe"tyādinā (1|83) | na tathābhūtasyābhinnarūpasyānumānagrāhyasya vastuni samāveśād vidyamānatvād anumānavikalpasya vastuvisamvādaḥ | pratyakṣavad iti | vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) atathābhāvepīti vyatītepi vastuni paramparayā liṅgānusāreṇa bhāvāt | yadvā 'tathābhāvepi sāmānyarahite 'pi vastuny abhinnākārāyā buddher bhāvāt | iti evaṃ | nivedayiṣyāmaḥ | niveditaṃ ca prāk | bhāvābhāvānuvidhānāt sāmarthyam ity antare (|)
 yadi sāmānyabuddhiḥ svākārābhedena bhinnāna bhāvānabhinnānadhyasya vidhirūpatayā pratipadyate katham asyā anyāpohaviṣayatvam uktam ity ata āha – bhedetyādi | asyāḥ sāmānyabuddher bhinnapadārthadarśanabaleneti vijātīyavyāvṛttasvalakṣaṇānubhavasāmarthyena | utpatter ity adhyāhāraḥ | bahulagrahaṇam vastvabhāvepi śaśaviṣāṇādau vikalpabuddheḥ pravṛttikhyāpanārthaṃ | teṣu bhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu bhāvādhyavasāyāt svākārābhedena svarūpādhyavasāyāt | dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkṛtya pravṛtter ity arthaḥ | yasmād bhinnavastudarśanabalenotpadyate buddhir utpannā ca tāny eva bhinnavastūni svākārābhedena pratipadyate (|) tasmād bhedaviṣayatvam bhinnaviṣayatvam ity arthaḥ | yuktantāvadvastudarśanadvārāyāteṣv anityādivikalpeṣu vastudarśanabalotpatter bhedaviṣayatvaṃ | yatra tu na tathābhūtam bhinnam vastu | yathā nityādivikalpeṣu | śaśaviṣāṇādivikalpeṣu ca (|) tatra katham bhedaviṣayatvaṃ teṣām iti ced āha – tathā bhāvetyādi | yathaiva bhinnavastusvabhāvagrāhyānubhavabalenotpannā anityādibuddhayaḥ svapratibhāse bhinnabhāvādhyavasāyena pravarttamānā bhedaviṣayāḥ | evaṃ tathā bhāvakalpanāyām eva svapratibhāsa eva bhinnabāhyabhāvādhyavasāyakalpanāyāṃ satyāṃ bhinnaviṣayatve satyaparatreti avidyamāneṣu nityapradhānakāryādiṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu ca (p.301) nityapradhānādikāryaśaśaviṣāṇādivikalpānām bhedaviṣayatvasya bhāvāt | svāśrayamātragatavyaktibheda eva sthitaṃ | na tu vyaktiśūnye deśe | tad uktaṃ bhaṭṭena |
 "piṇḍeṣv eva sāmānyaṃ nāntarā gṛhyate yataḥ |
 na hy ākāśavad icchanti sāmānyan nāma kecana || (ākṛ° 25)
 pratyekasamavetatvan dṛṣṭatvān na nirotsyate |
 tathā ca sati nānātvan naikabuddher bhaviṣyati || (vana° 30)
 yathā ca vyaktir ekaiva dṛśyamānā punaḥ punaḥ |
 kālabhedepy abhinneva jātir bhinnāśrayā satī"ti ||1* (vana° 33)
fn.1: Ślokavārtika.
 udyotakaropy āha –2* "kena sarvagatatvaṃ jāter abhyupagamyate yena (mṛtpiṇḍe) mṛdgavake gotvaṃ syād api tu svaviṣaye sarvatra vṛttir varttata iti sarvagatety ucyate | kaḥ punar gotvasya svo viṣayaḥ | yatra gotvam bhavati | kva punar gotvam varttate | yatra gotvanimittonuvṛttipratyayo bhavati | kva punar anuvṛttipratyayaṃ gotvaṃ karoti (|) yat tasya sādhanaṃ | kaḥ punar nitye gotve gossādhanārthaḥ | yat tena vyajyate | na hi kakudād idam arthavyatirekeṇa gotvasya vyaktir iti | na piṇḍebhyorthāntaraṃ gotvam piṇḍāntarāleṣv agrahaṇād iti bauddo bruvāṇaḥ piṇḍāntarālamparyanuyojyaḥ | kim idam paṇḍāntarālaṃ | kimākāśamāhosvidabhāva uta dravyāntaram iti | yady ākāśaṃ na tatra gotvaṃ na hy ākāśaṃ gaur iti pratīyate | etenābhāve dravyāntaraṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ |
fn.2: Nyāyavārtika.
