 "viśeṣapratyayānām ākasmikatvāc ca | ayaṃ piṇḍapratyayavyatirekabhāk pratyaya upajāyamāno nimittāntarād bhavati | dṛṣṭā khalu piṇḍavyaitrekabhājāṃ pratyayānāṃ nimittāntarād utpattir yathā carmavastrakambaleṣu nīlapratyayas tac ca nimittāntaraṃ sāmānyam iti (|) tasmād vyaktisarvagataṃ sāmānyaṃ | vyaktiśūnyepi deśe vidyamānatvāt | na ca tatra sāmānyasya pratītir vyañjakāyā vyakter abhāvāt | yatraiva ca vyaktau sāmānyaṃ pratīyate saiva sāmānyābhivyaktau samarthā sāmānyapratipattyanyathānupattyā gamyate nānye"ti |2*
fn.2: Nyāyavārtika.
 tad āha bhaṭṭaḥ |
 "yadvā sarvagatatvepi vyaktiḥ śaktyanurodhataḥ |
 śaktiḥ kāryānumeyādivyaktir darśanahetukā |
 (p.302) tena yatraiva dṛśyeta vyaktiḥ śaktan tad eva tu |
 tenaiva ca na sarvāsu vyaktiṣv etat pratīyate |
 bhinnatvepi hi kāsāṃcicchaktiḥ kāścidaśaktikāḥ |
 na ca paryanuyogosti vastuśakteḥ kadācana |
 vahnir dahati rnā(?nā)kāśaṃ kotra paryanuyujyatām" iti |1*
fn.1: Ślokavārtika. Akṛtī. 25-29.
 tatra tayoḥ pakṣayor madhye yadi svāśrayamātragataṃ apūrvaghaṭādyutpattau ghaṭatvādiśūnye pradeśe paścādutpannād ghaṭāder bhinnadeśaṃ yad dravyan tadvarttinaḥ sāmānyasya | kathan teṣu paścādutpanneṣu ghaṭādiṣu sambhavo naivety abhiprāyaḥ | bhavet sambhavo yadi tasmāt pūrvadravyāt tatsāmānyam paścādutpadyamānan dravyaṃ yāti | tac ca nāstīty āha – yasmād ityādi | tad iti sāmānyaṃ pūrvadravyād iti yatra tatpūrvaṃ samavetaṃ tasmād utpitsu dravyam utpattum icchu pūrvaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ na yāti | amūrttatvena niṣkriyatvāt sāmānyasya (|) pūrvadravyādacalatopi bhinnadeśena yogo bhaviṣyati vimbasyādarśa iveti ced āha – na hītyādi | anyadravyavṛtter ity utpitsudravyād bhinnadeśadravyavṛtter bhāvasya sāmānyākhyasya tataḥ pūrvakādāśrayādacalatas tadubhayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ pūrvapaścādutpannadvayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ svāśrayād bhinnadeśena dravyeṇa yogo na hi yukta iti sambandhaḥ | bimbasya tu bhinnadeśe nādarśena yogostīti bruvāṇaḥ kathan nonmataḥ syāt | sāmagrībalād bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ pratibimbānugatādarśapratibhāsi tatra jāyate | yathoktaṃ (|)
 "viruddhapariṇāmeṣu vajrādarśatalādiṣu (|)
 parvatādisvabhāvānāṃ bhāvānāṃ nāsti sambhava" iti |
 yepi tatra bhāvāntarotpattim icchanti (|) teṣām api na bimbena yogostīti yatkiñcid etat | utpitsudravyāt prāk sāmānyātmā na ca tatrotpitsudeśe āsīt | vyaktiśūnye deśe tasya tathānānabhyupagamāt | asti paścāt tatsāmānyaṃ (p.303) vyaktāv utpannāyāṃ | sāmānyaśūnyāyā vyakter anabhyupagamāt | na ca tatra deśe vyaktyā sahotpannaṃ nityatvāt | na ca vyaktyutpāda eva sāmānyasyotpādo bhinnatvāt | abhinnatve vā tato na sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ syāt | na ca kutaścit pūrvakād vyaktiviśeṣād āgataṃ | etan na yātīti yaduktan tasyaivopasaṃhāradvāreṇopanyāsaḥ |
 yāvadbhiḥ prakāraiḥ sāmānyasya vyaktyantare sambhavas te prakārā neṣyante tatra ca sāmānyam iṣyata iti vyāghātaḥ | sa ca prājñānān duḥsahatvād bhāraḥ | ata evāha – ka imam ityādi | prājño hi katham ayuktaṃ sahate | jaḍastvajñānād yuktāyuktavicāraṇākṣamaḥ sahetāpi | yadāhānyatra jāḍyād iti |
 nanu cotpitsudravye sāmānyasyotpattāv api samavetatvaṃ pratibhāsād evāvagantavyaṃ (|) sa ca vyaktisamvetatvapratibhāsonutpādepi sāmānyasya vidyata eveti kim utpādena vyaktisamavetañ ca sāmānyasya rūpam iṣyate | tena tatpūrvadravyasamavetam api tato 'vicaladutpitsudravyasamavetaṃ ca pratibhāsata iti kathan na yātītyādi dūṣaṇayocyatebhīṣṭatvāt |
 sattyaṃ | yo hi sāmānyasya pratibhāsaṃ necchati tasyedaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ syāt pratibhāsata iti | yas tu sāmānyapratibhāsolīka iti manyate tasya kathaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ | alīkatvaṃ cotpitsu dravyaṃ na yāti na ca tatrāsīn na cotpannam ityādinā granthena sāmānyābhāvepi sāmānyāvabhāsino jñānasyotpatteḥ pratipāditam ācāryeṇa (|) na ca pratibhāsanād eva satyatvaṃ | dvicandrāder api satyatvaprasaṅgāt |
 nāpi pratyakṣabādhaikā bādhā | anumānabādhāyā api bādhātvāt (|) yadi tadaṃśavat syāt tadaikenāṃśena pūrvam bhinnādhāre sthitam aṃśāntareṇotpitsu dravyaṃ vyāpnuyāt | anaṃśam vā pūrvamādhāraṃ hityā | dravyam apy etan nāstīty āha – na cetyādi | pūrvamādhāram iti sūtrabhāgaṃ | utpitsudeśād bhinnadeśam iti miśrakeṇa spaṣṭayati | tayoś ceti pūrvapaścādutpannayor dravyayoḥ |
 bhinnetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | dvidhā bhaved iti | nānāvayavātmatayā | pūrvādhāratyāgena (p.304) vā | prathaman tāvat pakṣam āha – nānetyādi | etac ca parapratisaddhyocyate | na tv ekam anekāvayavātmakam iṣyata ity uktaṃ | anyānyobhyām avayavābhyām parasparabhinnābhyām aṃśākhyān tatsambandhāt | tābhyām bhinnadeśābhyāṃ sambandhāt | āloko hi sāvayavatvād anyenāvayavena ghaṭena sambadhyate | anyena ghaṭādibhiḥ | evaṃ rajjuvaṃśadaṇḍādāv api svasambandhibhiḥ |
 na hītyādy asyaiva samarthanaṃ | atha sāvayavatvena sāmānyam anekavṛttīṣyeta | tathāpi katham ekam anekatra vartteta | yasmād ekadeśāḥ sāmānyasya varttanta iti (|) ye ca tadaikadeśāḥ sāmānyasya pratyekam piṇḍeṣu varttante | te kiṃ sāmānyātmakā uta neti (|) yadi sāmānyātmakā evam ekatra varttata iti prāptaṃ | na caikam ekatra varttamānaṃ sāmānyam iti yuktam vaktuṃ | atha na sāmānyātmakās te | kathaṃ sāmānyam anekatra varttata ity ucyate | ekadeśeṣu ca sāmānyasya yady ekadeśāntareṇa vṛttis tadānavasthā syāt | na ca sāvayavatvam antareṇaikasyānekatra vṛttir yuktā | athānavayavaṃ pratipiṇḍaṃ parisamāptyā piṇḍavadasādhāraṇatvān na sāmānyam bhavitum arhati | kiṃ kāraṇan tasyānavayavasya sāmānyasyaikena dravyeṇa sambandho ya ātmā | tadvyatirekeṇa dvitīyātmābhāvāt | ekātmanaś ca tasya sāmānyasya tatpradeśavarttasambandharūpatvāt | utpitsughaṭadeśāt | pūrvadeśavartti yad ghaṭadravyan tatsambandhirūpatvāt | nāsti bhinnadeśena yugapadyogaḥ | anyathety utpitsudeśadravyasambandharūpatve tatsambandhāyogāt | tena pūrvadravyeṇa sambandhāyogāt | tasmād ekavyaktiniyatātmanaḥ sāmānyasya nāsti tasminn neva kāle bhinnadeśena dravyeṇa sambandhaḥ | sambandhe vā pūrvavyaktiniyataikātmakatvena sāmānyasya pūrvavyaktau sthitas tasminn neva kāle bhinnadeśavyaktisambandhenāsthitir etac ca viruddham ity āha – ekasyādheyasyetyādi | tatra sthānam iti pūrvavyaktau | tadaiva tasminn eva kāle vyaktyantare tvayābhyapagamāt | pūrvavyaktityāgam antareṇaikasya cānyatrānvayāyogāt | tatra pūrvasyāṃ vyaktau | tenaiva pūrvavyaktiniyatenātmanā | tasya sāmānyasyāsthānam ity ayuktam etat | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | tatsthitetyādi | tasyām eva vyaktau sthitāsthitātmanoḥ svabhāvayor ekasya sāmānyasya yugapad virodhāt |
 (p.305) nanu yathaikatyāgenāpatra vṛttir evamaparāparāvayavair bahuṣu ca vṛttir dṛṣṭatvād iti dvividhābhyupagamyate | tathā sāmānyaṃ yadā yenaiva rūpeṇaikatra vṛttan tadaiva tenaiva rūpeṇānyatra varttate dṛṣṭatvād iti sāpi tṛtīyā vṛttiḥ kin nābhyupagamyate | tad uktam bhaṭṭena ||
 "na hi dvaividhyam eveti vṛtter asti niyāmakaṃ |
 traividhāpi hi dṛṣṭatvāt sambhaved dvividhā yathe"ti |1*
fn.1: Ślokavārtika.
 udyotakaropy āha – "na gotvam avayavī na ca samudāyas tasmān na tatra kṛtsnaikadeśaśabdau staḥ | na cet tatraitau śabdau staḥ tasmād gotvaṃ kiṃ kṛtsnam varttate utaikadeśeneti na yuktaḥ praśnaḥ | kathan tarhi gotvaṃ goṣu varttate | āśrayāśrayibhāvena | kaḥ punar āśrayāśrayibhāvaḥ (|) samavāyaḥ | tatra vṛttimad gotvaṃ | vattiḥ samavāya iha pratyayahetutvāt tena sarvatra pūrvadravya utpitsudravye ca samavāya eva vṛttir ataḥ kathaṃ ucyate (|) sthitāsthitātmanor ekatra virodhād ayuktam etad" iti |2*
fn.2: Nyāyavārtika.
 etad evāha – sarvatretyādi | sarvatra pūrvavyaktāv utpitsudravye ca | sarvadevotyatsudravyotpādepi yadā varttate tadāpi dravyan na jahāti | tena sthitāsthitātmanor naikatra virodho sthitātmano 'bhāvād iti | tad ayuktaṃ | na hy ekasamavetatvam evānyavyaktisamavetatvam anyasyās tatra pratibhāsanaprasaṅgāt (|) tasmād ekasamavetatvānyasamavetatvayoḥ parasparaṃ bheda eva | tac cābhinnaṃ sāmānyād ekasamavetatvād ananugamavadanyatra sāmānyasyāpy anugamaprasaṅgaḥ | yadvaikavyaktikālādisambandhena jñānajananaśaktir yāsāmanyasya | na sā 'nyavyaktyādisambandhatvena | tenaikasyāṃ vyaktau sāmānyasya jñānajananaśaktir anyasyāṃ jñānajananaśaktivirodhinī | śaktiś ca śaktim ato 'bhinnā | śaktilakṣaṇatvāc ca vastunaḥ | tena yadvas tv ekan tadekavṛtty eveti vyāptisiddhiḥ | vastu caikaṃ sāmānyaṃ yadi katham anyatrāpi vartteta | tathābhūtasya pratibhāsād iti cet (|) na | pratibhāso hy apratibhāsasya bādhako nāvastunas tasyāpi pratibhāsanāt | asya tu vastupratibhāso bādhako na cānugataṃ vastv astīty uktaṃ | ata eva na pratijñāyāḥ pratyakṣabādhā | sāmānyajñānasya pratyakṣatvābhāsā(?) c ca |
 nanu yāvad asyāprāmāṇyaṃ na tāvad anumānasya prabṛttir yāvac ca nānumānasya pravṛttis tāvan nāsya pratyakṣābhāsatety anyonyāśrayatvaṃ syād iti cet (|) na | yatonumānaṃ pratibhāsamānasya vastutvasandehamātreṇaiva pravartate | nāpy asyāprāmāṇyanimittam anumānam pravartatepi (p.306) tu svasādhyapratibaddhaliṅganimittam (|) ataḥ sāmānyajñānasya bādhakan tasmān nāsti paramārthata ekam vastv ekadā 'nekavṛttiḥ | vṛttau tu tatsthitāsthitātmanor virodha eva | ācāryas tv abhyupagamyāpi doṣam āha – tatsvabhāvetyādi || sāmānyasvabhāvasya darśanam āśrayo yasya pratyayasya sa sarvatra bhinnajātīyepi dravye sarvākāraḥ syāt | tathā ca sati gāmapyaśva ityādi | kiṅkāraṇam (|) ity āha – aśve sthita ātmā yasya dravyatvasyeti vigrahaḥ | gamakatvād vyadhikaraṇasyāpi bahuvrīhiḥ1* | aśve sthita iti vā sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ | paścādātmaśabdena dvipado bahuvrīhiḥ | tatsvabhāvapratipattyā cāśvasthitasvabhāvadravyatvapratipattyā ca tathā niścayād gaur dravyam iti niścayāt |
fn.1: Pāṇini 2.2.
 syād etat (|) nāśvasamavetadravyatvapratipattyā dravyam iti pratītiḥ (|) kin tarhi (|) dravyatvamātrapratipattyety ata āha – tasya cetyādi | tasya cāśve dravyatvasyaikasyādṛṣṭasyāpratipannasyāśvasamavetatvavyatirekeṇākārāntarasyāśvāsa(ḥ sa)mavetatvalakṣaṇasyābhāvāt | tasmād aśvasamavetenaiva dravyatvena viśiṣṭāṃ gāṃ dravyam iti pratipadyamānośva iti pratīyāt | yasya tv aśvavyatiriktam eva dravyatvasāmānyatvena ca viśiṣṭam asau gāṃ pratipadyamāno niyamenāśva iti pratīyāt |
 tasmād ity upasaṃhāraḥ | anavayavaṃ sāmānyam anekadeśe 'neko deśo 'syeti tasmin ghaṭādau yugapannādhīyate | nādheyatāṃ pratipadyate | iyatā ca na cāṃśavad ity etad vyākhyātaṃ |
 jahāti pūrvan nādhāram ity etat pūrvetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sa ceti pūrvādhāratyāgaḥ sāmānyasya nābhimataḥ | (154-55)

 anyatreti pūrvavyaktau varttamānasya sāmānyasya svasmāt pūrvādhāradeśād acalatas tataḥ pūrvādhāradeśād anyatra sthāne janma yasya dravyasya tasmin vṛttir ity atiyuktim ity upahasati (156)

 (p.307) pūrvavyaktideśād avicalad api sāmānyan tatonyadeśan dravyaṃ vyāpnotīti ced āha – yatretyādi | yatra deśe 'sau paścātkālabhāvī bhāvo varttate | tena deśena sāmānyaṃ na sambandhyate svavyaktisarvagatatvābhyupagamāt | yatra deśe sāmānyaṃ na varttate taddeśinaṃ ca paścāt kālabhāvinam bhāvaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyātikrāntatvāt kim apy etan mahādbhutam iti prakārāntareṇopahasati | na hi yo yatra deśe na varttate sa taddeśaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyānusāriṇā śakyam avasātuṃ (157)

 sarvagatatvakalpanām api nirācikīrṣann āha – yasyetyādi | tasyāpi sarvagatasāmānyavādinaḥ sarvatragā yadi jātis tadaikatra śāvaleyādau yā tasyāvyaktir abhivyaktis tayā karaṇabhūtayā | sā jātis sarvatra vyaktiśūnyepi deśe | vijātīyavyaktibhede ca vyaktaiva prakāsitaivābhedād ekatvāt sarvatra vyaktiśūnyepi deśe dṛśyeta |
 etad uktam bhavati | yady api vyaktiśūnye pradeśe vijātīyavyaktau ca svavyakter vyañjakāyā abhāvas tathāpi svavyaktyabhivyaktenaiva rūpeṇa tatrāvasthānāj jāter upalambhaḥ syān no cet svabhāvanānātvaṃ prāpnotīty ekarūpā ceṣyata iti bhāvaḥ | na jāter nityāyā anādheyātiśatvena kadācidabhivyaktir iti niṣiddham etat |" vṛttirādheyatā vyaktir iti tasmin na yujyata" (1|146) ity atrāntare | yata evaṃ tasmāt sā jātir nityam anapekṣitaparopaskārānādheyātiśayā | evambhūtā yadi svabhāvena svavijñānajananayogyā | tadā nityan dṛśyeta vyakteḥ prāk paścāc ca | atha na yogyā tadā kadācid daśyeta | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasmin vijñānajananayogyasvabhāve tadviparīte cāvasthānāt | sarvakālam ekarūpatvād ity arthaḥ | asamarthā vyaktyasannidhāne tatsannidhāne tu samarthā bhavati | (p.308) tato na nityan darśanam adarśanam vā jāter ity ata āha – svabhāve ityādi | nityatvenānādheyātiśayatvād iti bhāvaḥ || (157-58)

 yadi jāter nāsti vyaktis tat kiṃ vyaktyaivaikatra sā vyaktetyādy ucyata ity ata āha – abhyupagamyāpītyādi | vyāpinyāpi jātiḥ | ekatrāśraye vyaktā bhedābhāvād ekatvāj jāter vyaktaiva prakāśitaiva sarvatra vyaktiśūnye deśe | vijātīye ca vyaktibhede | vyaktiśūnyeṣv apīty api śabdād vijātīyepi vyaktibhede | api ca na ca sā jātir vyaktyapekṣiṇī | vyañjakā vyaktir nnāpekṣyeta | vyakter jātivyañjakatvābhāvād iti bhāvaḥ | yadi hi vyañjikāṃ vyaktim apekṣeta | tadā vyañjakāpratipattau na vyaṅgyasya pratītiḥ syān na hi pradīpādyapratītau ghaṭādeḥ pratītir bhavati | tathehāpi vyaktyapratītau na jātipratītiḥ syāt | sāmānyatadvatos tu vyaṅgyavyañjakayor viparyayaḥ punaḥ kasmād iṣṭaḥ | tathā hi nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇāviśeṣye buddhir varttata iti niyamāt | prāg eva sāmānyagrahaṇam iṣṭan taddvāreṇa tu vyakteḥ | tato vyañjikāyā vyakter grahaṇam antareṇāpi vyaṅgyābhimatasya sāmānyasya pratipattir iṣṭeti viparyayaḥ |
 yo hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svāśrayo yatra samavetaṃ sāmānyaṃ | sāmānyagrāhakam indriyaṃ ca tayos saṃyogas tadapekṣā pratītir yasya sāmānyasya tatthoktaṃ | āśrayaśūnyāḥ pradeśā vijātīyavyaktyadhyāsitā vyaktiśūnyāś ca | teṣu na dṛśyate | yathoktasaṃyogābhāvāt | tasyāpy evaṃ vādinaḥ | kvacid vyaktir darśane saty asty evāśrayendriyasaṃyogo jāteḥ sarvatra sthitāyā upakāraka iti | tata āśrayendriyasaṃyogād dhetos taddarśī kvacid vyaktibhede jātidarśī yathāsthitāṃ sarvadeśavyāpinīñ jātim paśyeta | yatraiva vyañjikā vyaktis tatraiva jāteḥ svarūpaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyatreti ced āha – na hītyādi | tasyām iti jātau | kvacid vyaktau dṛśyamānāyāntadīyām iti sāmānyasambandhi | ekasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavirodhāt | evaṃ tāvad vyakter vyañjikātvam abhyupagamya ca śabdopāttortho vyākhyātaḥ |
 (p.309) adhunā na sā vyaktyapekṣiṇītyādi vyākhyātum āha – vyaktivyaṅgyatvād ityādi | tasya ca mithyātvam anantaroktenaiva pratipāditaṃ | na hy ekasya dṭṣṭādṛṣṭam asty ato 'pūrvapakṣa evāyaṃ kevalan doṣāntarābhidhānārthaṃ gajanimīlanaṃ kṛtvopanyastaṃ | tathābhūtasyeti nyāyyasya | tatreti jātitadvati | nyāyyasya vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvasyābhāvāt | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | svetyādi | hi yasmāt | svarūpaśūnye deśe pradīpādir ahito deśe | svavyaṅgyaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ | naivaṃ yathoktena nyāyena vyaktir vyañjikā sāmānyasya | kiṅkāraṇam (|) viparyayāt | yasmād agṛhītvāpi vyaktiṃ sāmānyam ādau gṛhyata itīṣyate pareṇa | sāmānyagrahaṇadvāreṇaiva vyakter grahaṇābhyupagamād ataś ca vyañjakāpratipattyāpi vyaṅgyasya grahaṇāt | vyañjakadharmātikramo vyakteḥ |
 tad evāha – kathaṃ hītyādi | seti vyaktiḥ sāmānyasya vyañjikā ca syād iti sambandhaḥ | tatpratipattidvāreṇeti sāmānyadarśanabalena | vyakter darśanebhyupagamyamāne | vyaṅgyā sā vyaktiḥ prasajyate sāmānyañ cety adhyāhāraḥ | pradīpena ghaṭavad iti | tṛtīyeti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | supsupeti vā samāsaḥ | yathā pradīpena ghaṭo vyaṅgyas tadvat sāmānyena vyaktir vyaṅgyā prāpterthaḥ | tatpratipattim antareṇa sāmānyapratipattim vinā vyakter adṛśyarūpatvāt | anye tv āhuḥ | vyaṅgyā ca saivaṃ prasajyata ity atra caśabdena sāmānyavyañjakam ity etad upāttaṃ | tataḥ pradīpaghaṭābhyāṃ tulyam iti dvandvād eva vatir draṣṭavyaḥ | pūrvanipātalakṣaṇasya vyabhicāritvād ghaṭaśabdasyāpūrvanipātaḥ | pradīpavat sāmānyaṃ vyañjakaṃ | ghaṭavac ca vyaktivyaṅgyā | prasajyata iti vākyārtha iti | aneneti sāmānyavādinā | sāmānyam vinā kim asambhavatkāryam abhisamīkṣya | evam ity uktividhinā | bahvāyāsaḥ | aśakyasādhanatayā bahuduḥkhahetuḥ | (158-59)

 parasparetyādi paraḥ | bhedādilakṣaṇatvād dhetor vyatirekiṇīṣv ananvayinīṣu | anvayina ekākārasya pratyayasya pratyayagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ śabdasya | sāmānyam antareṇāyogāt | sāmānyavāda āśrita iti sambandhaḥ |
 katham ity ācāryaḥ | ye pācakādiśabdā na kriyānimittān icchanti tān praty etad (p.310) uktaṃ | abhinnena sāmānyākhyenārthena vinā pācakādiṣu katham ekaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ | vācakagrahaṇena pratyayonvayī gṛhīta eva tena vinā śabdasyāpravṛtteḥ | ata eva vṛttau śabdapratyayānuvṛttir astīty āha –
 udyotakareṇāpi gavādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayaḥ piṇḍādivyatiriktanimittād bhavati viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvān nīlādipratyayavat | yattannimittan tatsāmānyam iti sāmānyasiddhau pramāṇe kṛte svayam evāṃśakitam (|)
 atha manyase yathā pācakādiśabdā anuvṛttāś ca bhavanti na ca pācakatvan nāma sāmānyam asti (|) yadi syāt | bhāvotpattikāla evābhivyaktaṃ syāt tathā gavādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayā iti | na (|) hetvarthāparijñānāt | viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvād ity asya hetoḥ piṇḍapratyayavyatiriktasya pratyayasya nimittāntarād utpāda ity ayam arthaḥ | na punaḥ sarvānuvṛttipratyayaḥ sāmānyād eva bhavatīti | evañ ca sati pacanakriyāyā yatpradhānaṃ sādhanan tatpācakaśabdenocyate | tac ca pradhānyaṃ pācakāntareṣv apy astīti na doṣa iti vadatā pācakatvādisāmānyam vinā pācakādiśabdānāṃ vṛttir iṣṭaivodyotakareṇety anenābhiprāyeṇācāryeṇāpy uktaṃ katham ityādi |
 na ca pacanakriyāyāṃ prādhānyanimittāyāṃ pācakādiśabdapravṛttir yuktā | tannimittatve hi pradhānaṃ pradhānam ity anugāmī śabdaḥ syān na pācaka iti | ata evāha (|) na hītyādi | teṣv iti pācakādiṣu | anyad iti dravyād vyatiriktaṃ | evaṃ sarvaśaktiṣv abhinnaṃ yenaikena te pācakādayo bhinnās santopi tathetyabhedena pratīyeran jñānena | upalakṣaṇam etat tathābhidhīyeran | pācakeṣv adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇaṃ | pāṭhakeṣv adhyayanātmakam evamanyeṣv api yathāyogyaṃ | karmaikapratyayādinimittam astīti cet | sa ity anvayī | pratyayagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ śabdopi | anyena veti karmaṇo hetunā prayatnādinā | bhinnam ityādinaitad eva samarthayate | tad iti bāhyopanyāse | tatkarmeti (p.311) vā sambandhanīyaṃ | pratipācakaṃ karmaṇo bhedāt | yenāparādhena tā vyaktayas tathety abhinnapratyayahetutvena |
 sattyaṃ (|) na kaścidaparādhaḥ kintu tāsāṃ vyaktīnām ekarūpatvāt | tathā hi dravyam ekarūpam anaṃśatvāt | etad eva ced abhinnapratyayanibandhanaṃ na tu tato vyatiriktaṃ dharmāntaran tadā pācakasya pācakatvam iti vyatirekapratītir na syāt | na hi tasyaiva tato vyatireko yuktaḥ | tasyāvyakter ākāras tadākāras tasmād anyo 'bhedākāras tasya viśeṣaḥ sosti yasyāṃ sā atadākāraviśeṣavatī | dravyākārād anyākārety arthaḥ |
 tad uktam bhavati | dravyebhya eva pratyayo dravyam ityevamākāraḥ | tatonyenaivākāreṇa pācakapratyaya[ḥ pratiṣedhapratyaya]s sa yadi dravyanimittam eva syāt tadā dravyamātrapratyayāviśiṣṭaḥ syāt | atha kimartham tadākāraviśeṣavatīty ubhayam uktam atadākārety eva vaktavyaṃ | viśeṣavatīty eva vā | ucyate 'bhedākārety ukte dravyasyābhāva iti pratiṣedhaprayayopy atadākāra iti śakyeta vyapadeṣṭuṃ na cāsau vastvantaranibandhanaḥ pareṇeṣṭaḥ | viśeṣapratyayānām eva dharmāntaranibandhanatvāt | viśeṣagrahaṇe ca kevale kriyamāṇe | caitrapratyayo maitrāpekṣayā bhavati viśeṣavān | na tv atadākāraḥ | caitrādyabhidhānena dravyasyaiva pratipādanāt | ubhayopādānāttvayam artho bhavaty adravyākāraś cāsau pratyayo vastusparśād viśeṣavāṃśceti | tasmāt tatra dravyavyatirikte na nimittāntareṇa bhāvyam iti |
 uktam ityācāryaḥ | yathā vyatireko gorgotvaṃ pācakasya pācakatvam ityādiko yathā ca viśeṣapratyayā anantaroktās tathoktam iti sambandhaḥ | katham uktam ity āha – yathāsvam ityādi | arthāntaravivekorthāntaravyavacchedaḥ | yathāsvam iti yasya śabdasya yathāsaṃketaṃ yo vyavacchedas tasmād ity arthaḥ | tathā hi pācakaśabdo 'pācakavyavacchinnam apratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ pratipādayan dharmivacanaḥ (|) pācakatvaśabdas tu tam eva vyavacchinnaṃ pratikṣiptabhedāntaram āheti dharmavacanaḥ | tato dharmadharmibhedakalpanayā pācakasya pācakatvam iti vyatirekavibhaktiḥ prayujyate | evaṃ dravyaśabdasyāpy adravyavyavacchinne svabhāve saṃketitatvāt tadanusāreṇādravyāvyavacchedānusāreṇādravyavyavacchedānukāriṇī buddhir (p.312) utpadyate | pācakaśabdāt tv apācakavyavacchinnānukāriṇy eva buddhir ato yathāvyavacchedaṃ saṃketānusāreṇa viśeṣavatī buddhir ekatrāpy aviruddhā | etac ca bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepetyādiṣu pratipāditaṃ |
 tasmād ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | yathā vyaktīnāṃ bhedas tadvat karmaṇopi bhedād dhetor asya pācakādyabhepratyayasya na hetuḥ karmeti sambandhaḥ | teṣāṃ pācakānāṃ yāni karmāṇi pākākhyāni teṣu karmasu yā pācakatvajātiḥ samavetā saivābhedād dhetuḥ pācakābhedapratyayasya | netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na jātir hetur iti prakṛtaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) karmasaṃśrayāt | karmaṇi samavetatvāt | dravyād arthāntaraṃ karma tatsambandhinī | arthāntara iti dravye | gotvam iveti nidarśanaṃ | na hi gotvaṃ śābaleyādisambandhi | karkkādiṣv aśvabhedeṣu gopratyayahetuḥ | pācakakarmasu pākākhyeṣu karmajātis samavetā | na ca tāni karmāṇīti pākākhyāni | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ | tathā pācakapratyayena paricchidyante | tasya pākākhyasya karmaṇa āśrayo dravyaṃ pācakaśabdenocyate | na ca tatra dravye karmajātisamavetā |
 evan tāvad arthāntarasambandhitvaṃ karmajāter āśritya dravyaviṣayaṃ pācakābhidhānapratyayaṃ pratyayanimittatvam uktam (|) (159-60)

 adhunā prakārāntareṇāha – tasyetyādi | pācakaśruter anyā śrutiḥ śruyantaraṃ | śrutigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ jñānāntaranimittatvāt | śrutyantaram evāha – pāka ityādi | tata iti karmajāteḥ karmaviṣayasyābhidhānasya pratyayasya ca hetutvāt karmajāter ity abhiprāyaḥ |
 syān mataṃ (|) na karmajātiḥ pācakapratyayaṃ janayati kintu karmajātisamāśrayāt karmaivety ata āha – tasyetyādi | tasyeti pācakādyabhedapratyayasya | karmanimittaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | proktaṃ vyaktivad bhedān na hetuḥ karmāsyetyādi |
 nanūktaṃ jātisamāśrayād bhinnam api karmābhinnapratyayahetur iti |
 (p.313) uktam idam ayuktan tūktaṃ | jātisambandhepi karmaṇas tathaiva bhinnatvāt | kiñcetyādinopacayahetum āha – tasya pācakādyabhedapratyayasya karmanimittatve 'bhyupagamyamāne | niruddhe karmaṇi punuṣaḥ pācaka iti nocyeta | ucyate ca yogyatāmātreṇa (|) tato na vastubhūtakriyānimittoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ | atītasyāpi karmaṇostitvād adoṣa iti ced āha pācata evetyādi (|) yady atītasya sattvaṃ syād varttamānavadupalabhyetopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ ca karmeṣyate |
 syān mataṃ (|) karmajātiḥ karmaṇi samavetā karmāpi dravye samavetan tataḥ sambaddhasanbandhāt karmajātir dravyaviṣayasya pācakapratyayasya hetur iti ced āha – tata evetyādi | tata eveti karmaṇo vinaṣṭatvād eva na sāmānyasya karmaṇā sambandhaḥ sākṣāt | nāpi karmadvāreṇa pāramparyeṇa dravyasambandhosyāsambandhāt kāraṇān na sāmānyaṃ pācakādyabhidhānapratyayasya hetuḥ | asambaddham api hetur iti ced āha – netyādi | ayuktam ity asambaddhaṃ | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam asambaddhaṃ sāmānyaṃ na jñānaśabdakāraṇam ity arthaḥ | kutaḥ (|) atiprasaṅgāt | gotvam apy aśvajñānasya hetuḥ syāt | (160-61)

 vinaṣṭe hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tata sāmānyam iti karmasāmānyan na karmaṇi samavetan tasyāsattvāt | karmābhāvād eva karttari pācake pāramparyeṇāpi samavetam (|) ataḥ sambaddhasambandhopy asya sāmānyasya dravyeṇa saha nāsti (|) tama(?da)tītetyādinā pakṣāntaram āśaṃkte | atītaṃ yadvinaṣṭaṃ | anāgataṃ yad bhaviṣyati karma | tayor iti śabdajñānayoḥ (|) karmāpy atītānāgatam asat | jñānābhidhānayor nimittam iti (p.314) sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tayor ityādi | tayor jñānābhidhānayoḥ |
 astītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | upākhyāyate prakāśyate vastvanayety upākhyārthakriyāśaktiḥ | sā nirgatā yasmād asatas tattathoktaṃ | asad yasmādarthakriyāśaktivikalaṃ | tadevaṃbhūtaṃ kathaṃ śabdajñānayor nimittaṃ syād ity arthaḥ |'
 athāsatopi hetutvam iṣyate tadā tasya tastutvam eva syān nāsattvaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam ity āha – kāryetyādi | lakṣaṇaśabda svabhāvavacanaḥ | tad iti tasmāt | atītaṃ pracyutarūpaṃ | anāgatam asaṃprāptarūpaṃ | karmaṇaḥ sakāśādanyac ca vyaktyādikaṃ jñānābhidhānayor nimittatvena neṣṭaṃ sāmānyavādinā |
 "vyaktiḥ karmāśrayo dravyaṃ |"
 ādiśabdāt saṃketavāsanā tatparipākayor grahaṇaṃ | te iti śabdajñāne | tathā cety anvayinoḥ pācakādiśabdajñānayor animittatve sati na jātisiddhiḥ | caśabdāt nityaṃ sattvam asattvam vā śabdajñānayoḥ syāt | kasmān na jātisiddhir ity āha – tasyā ityādi | tasyā jāter abhinnasya jñānasyābhidhānasya ca nimittatveneṣṭatvāt | yathā ca pācakādiviṣaye | te animitte pravarttete tathā gavādāv apīti kena nibandhanena jātiḥ kalpyeta |
 śaktir ityādinā pakṣāntaram āśaṃkate | karmāśrayasya dravyasya śaktiḥ | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ (|) pācakādi jñānasyāpi śaktir nimittaṃ | netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na pācakādiśaktiḥ pācakādiśabdanimittaṃ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) śakter dravyāvyatirekeṇa dravyavad evānanvayādananvayinaś cārthasyānvayijñānābhidhānaṃ prati nimittatvānabhyupagamāt | abhyupagame vā jātikalpanāyā nirnibandhanatvaprasaṅgāt | (p.315) bhinnaiva śaktir iti ced āha – na hītyādi | na hi dravyād anyaiva śaktir yadi syāt tadā tasyā ekaśakteḥ pākādyarthakriyāsūpayogena kāraṇena dravyasya śaktyādhārasyānupayogitvaprasaṅgāt | tasyāṃ pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau tasya dravyasyopayogaḥ | evam api pāramparyeṇa pākādau dravyam upayuktaṃ syād iti bhāvaḥ |
 kim ityādi siddhāntavādī | arthāntarabhūtayā śaktyā na kiñcit prayojanaṃ | tathā hi pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ śaktau dravyaṃ yayā śaktyopayujyeta | sāpi śaktir yadi vyatiriktābhyupagamyeta tadā pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau dravyasyopayogāya śaktyantarasya dravyād vyatirekaṇo 'bhyupagame 'tiprasaṅgāt | tasyām api śaktāv upayogāyāparā vyatiriktā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatrāpy aparetyanavasthā syād ity arthaḥ | tasmād antareṇa vyatiriktaṃ śaktiṃ dravyam eva prathamāyāṃ pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktāv upayujyata iti vācyaṃ | evaṃ ca dravyasyopayoge śaktāv iṣyamāṇe | taddravyam arthakriyāyāṃ pākādilakṣaṇāyām evopayujyata iti kin neṣyate | dravyasyārthakriyāyāś cāntarāle kim anarthikayā śaktyā kalpitayā |
 yata evaṃ tasmāt pākādyarthakriyāśaktir ity anena dravyam evocyate | kimbhūtan tatkāryaṃ tatpākādi kāryaṃ yasya | tac ca dravyaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ nānvetīti kṛtvā | tato dravyāt pācakaḥ pācaka ity anvayī śabdo na syāj jñānañ ca | śabdagrahaṇaṃ tūpalakṣaṇaṃ | (161-62)

 pācakādiṣu dravyeṣu pācakatvādisāmānyam asti tadanvayi śabdajñānanibandhanam iti ced āha – sāmānyam ityādi | sāmānyaṃ pācakatvādi yadīṣyate | tadā pākādinirvarttanaśaktyavasthāyāḥ prāg eva dravyasyotpattisamakāla eva dravyasamavetan tad bhaved ity arthaḥ | tathā ca tadaharjātopi bālaḥ pācakādijñānābhidhānaviṣayaḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ | no cet prāg eva bhavet tadā paścād api na bhavet | tasyā dravyasyāviśeṣāt | asty eva sarvakālaṃ (p.316) dravye pācakatvādi | kintu prāganabhivyaktam ato na śabdajñānayor nimittam ity ata āha – vyaktam iti | prāg evābhivyaktam bhaved ity arthaḥ | sattādivat | yathā sattādravyatvādi | yāvaddravyabhāvi | arthakriyāyāś ca prāg eva yogyadeśāvasthitaṃ dravyaṃ |
 athāpītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | satyarthe jātyāśraye tatsamavāyasya sāmānyasamavāyasyākādācitkatvāt sarvakālabhāvitvāt | etad eva draḍhayann āha – yāvanti hītyādi | arthe jātyāśraye | samavāyadharmāṇi sambandhayogyāni tāni sāmānyāni | asyārthasya ya utpādaḥ | tena saha samavayanti | asmin sāmānyāśraya iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | utpādasamakālam eva dravyeṇa saha sambandhyata iti yāvat | iti samayaḥ | sāmānyavādinaḥ siddhāntaḥ | yadāhodyotakaraḥ (|) "prāggotvān nāsau gaur nāpy agaur iti | kiṅkāraṇam (|) abhāve tau viśeṣaṇapratyayau na ca viśeṣaṇapratyayau viśeṣyasambandham antareṇa bhavato na ca prāg gotvayogād vastu vidyate | na cāvidyamānaṃ gaur iti vā 'gaur iti vā śakyate vyapadeṣṭuṃ | yadaiva vastūtpadyate tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyata iti | tathā na satas sattāsambandho nāsataḥ | yadiava ca vastu tadaiva sattayā sambadhyata" iti |1*
fn.1: Nyāyavārtika.
 atha siddhāntam atikramya paścād bhāvitvaṃ sāmānyasya kalpyate | tadā tadvyatikrame siddhāntavyatikrame | tasya sāmānyasyāśrayasya dravyasya paścād apy aviśeṣān na tatsamavāyaḥ syāt | tena sāmānyena samavāyo na syāt |
 yathā phalaikasvabhāvasyāpi raktatā prāṅ na bhavati | paścāc ca bhavati | tadvatpuruṣasya pācakatvādisāmānyam ity ata āha – tatsambandhītyādi | tatsambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt | pācakatvādisāmānyasambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt | sa iti sāmānyasamavāyaḥ | tasyeti puṃsaḥ | na hy aviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya tatsambandho na bhavet | tatraiva ca sāmānyasamavāyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya dravyasya paścāt sāmānyasamavāyo bhaviṣyatīti duranvayandurbodham etat | phalasyāpyāmrādeḥ pūrvaṃ paścāc ca yady ekasvabhāvatā | tatrāpi tulyaṃ codyaṃ | sāmānyasambaddham eva tadā dravyaṃ kriyopakārāpekṣan tu sāmānyaṃ vyanakti | (162-63)

 sā ca prāṅ nāstīti na prāk sāmānyābhivyaktir ity ata āha – kriyopakāretyādi | pākādilakṣaṇā kriyā | tatkṛto ya upakāras tadapekṣasya sāmānyaṃ prati vyañjakatve 'bhyupagamyamāne | tasya dravyasyākṣaṇikatvād avikāriṇonapekṣā sahakāriṇaṃ prati |
 atha vikriyeta tadāpy atiśayesya dravyasya kṣaṇikatvam āpadyate | kṣaṇikatvāc cotpādānantaraṃ dhvaṃsinaḥ kutaḥ kriyā | yena tadupakārāpekṣaṃ jāter vyañjakaṃ syāt |
 karmopakāretyādinā vyācaṣṭe | adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ karma | tatkṛta upakārotiśayas tam apekṣya sthirasvabhāvasya pūrvasvabhāvādacalatonatiśayāt svabhāvāntarānupādānāt | aviśeṣādhāyini karmaṇi | kāpekṣā | naiva | atiśaye vā dravyasya kriyākṛtebhyupagamyamāne 'tiśayādhāyakasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇikatvāta tasyāpy upakāryasya dravyasya svabhāvabhūtenānyenātiśayenotpttavyaṃ |
 yadi kriyākṛto 'tiśayo na svabhāvabhūto dravyasya tadarthāntarasya karaṇād dravyaṃ naivopakṛtaṃ syāt | tasmād yathākriyākṣaṇaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ svabhāvabhūtasyānyānyasyātiśaotpattes tad api dravyaṃ devadattādi kṣaṇikaṃ syāt | tata iti kṣaṇikatvāt | svotpattisthānavināśinaḥ svasminn evotpattideśe vināśinaḥ puṃsaḥ kṛtaḥ pākalakṣaṇā kriyā | yadapekṣan tat kriyāsāpekṣaṃ pācakādidravyasāmānyasya vyañjakaṃ syat |
 nanu ca prathamādikriyākṣaṇadvāreṇa dravyasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ kriyā 'bhāve ca kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti cet (|) na | yataḥ kriyāsambandhotpannānāṃ kṣaṇānām anyasyāḥ kriyāyās sāmānyābhivyañjakāyā abhāvād ity arthaḥ |
 tasmāt sthitam etad yathā vastubhūtā jātir nāstīti | (163-64)

 kathan tarhītyādi paraḥ |
 yathetyādi siddhāntavādī | yathā pācakādiṣu pācakatvādisāmānyan nāsti tathā (p.318) prasādhitamatha ca tatra pravarttete anvayinau jñānaśabdau | tathānyatrāpy antareṇa sāmānyantau bhivaṣyataḥ |
 tadvad ityādi paraḥ | teṣv iti pācakādiṣu sāmānyam vinā katham anvayinor jñānaśabdayor vṛttir iti | tatonvayajñānaśabdavṛtteḥ pācakādiṣv api pācakatvādisāmānyam astīti cintitam etad anantaraṃ | tathā teṣu pācakatvādi sāmānyaṃ sa na sambhavatīti |
 yady anvayi rūpan nāsti tat kim idānīm animitte te śabdajñāne syātāṃ | netyādi siddhāntavādī | asty eva tayor nimittaṃ yat pareṇeṣyate tasya pratikṣepaḥ | tad evāha – kin tarhītyādi | vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam bāhyatatvaṃ nimitte te na bhavataḥ | kin tarhi tayor nimittam ity ata āha – yathāsvam ityādi | yo ya ātmīyo vāsanāprabodhas tasmād anvayino vikalpasyotpattiḥ | tato vikalpotpatteḥ sakāśād yathāvikalpaṃ śabdā bhavanti | na punar vikalpābhidhānayor vastusattā | anvayipadārthasattāsamāśraya ity uktaprāyam etat | avaśyaṃ caitad eṣṭavyaṃ | tathā hi yathāsvaṃ samavāyavāsanāvaśāt siddhāntāśrayeṇa jñānavāsanānurodhād virīdhirūpasamāveśena parasparaviruddharūpādhyāropeṇa pradhānakāryamīśvarakāryam ahetukaṃ samvṛttimātraṃ jagad ityevaṃ sarvabhedeṣv anvayinos tayor iti jñānābhidhānayoḥ | aparāparadarśanepīti parasparabhinnānām arthānān darśanepi | na ca tatreti pradhānādikāryatvena parasparaviruddhena rūpeṇa kalpiteṣv artheṣu | tannibandhanaḥ śabdajñānayor nibandhanaḥ | kasmān nāstīty āha – parasparavirodhinor ityādi |
 aniyamenetyādi paraḥ | sarvaṃ sarvatrānvayi jñānam abhidhānaṃ ca syāt |
 etad eva sādhayann āha – na hy animittam ityādi |
 nanu yathāsvaṃ vāsanāprabodhād vikalpotpatter ityādinā tayor animittatvaṃ pratiṣiddham ity anavakāśam eva codyaṃ | evam manyate | āntaram eva nimittan tayor iṣyate tasya ca nimittasya kenacidāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt | sarvatra sarvavikalpahetutvaṃ syād iti | (p.319) na hy animitte bhavad ity atra bāhyanimittābhāvād animittam iti draṣṭavyaṃ |
 nānimitte iti siddhāntavādī | aviśiṣṭanimitte | na bhavata ity arthaḥ | ata evāha – vāsanāviśeṣanimittatvād iti | yathābhūtadarśanadvārāyātā vāsanā sā tatraivādhyavasitatadbhāvam vikalpaṃ janayati | na sarvatreti samudāyārthaḥ | tathābhūtam ity anvayi rūpaṃ | na cāsati tasminn anvayini bāhye nimitte vikalpena na bhavitavyam bhavitavyam eva |
 tad eva suptetyādinā sādhayati | suptaś ca taimirikaś ca tābhyām upalabdheṣv artheṣu gavādiṣu keśamakṣikādiṣu ca yathākramaṃ | abhāveṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu | samavāyavāsanā | yathā svaṃ siddhāntaṃ saṃketavāsanā tadbalenāropitarūpaviśeṣe pradhānakāryādiṣu | tathā vikalpotpatter anvayino vikalpasyotpatteḥ | na hy eteṣu yathokteṣu bāhyam anvayi rūpam asti | svapnatimiropalabdhānām evāsattvāt | teṣāṃ cāsattvaṃ tṛtīye paricchede (3|85) pratipādayiṣyate | siddhāntasamāropitasya tu parasparavirodhinor yugapadekatretyādinā pratipāditam evāsattvaṃ | sa ca te vikalpāḥ svapnādyupalabdheṣv asatsu vastubhūtānvayirūpam antareṇāpy utpadyaṃta iti sarvatrārthāḥ sarvākārā bhavanty api tu pratiniyatā eva | niyamahetuṃ cāha – vibhāgenaivetyādi | tathaivopalabdhānām iti vibhāgenopalabdhānāṃ | vibhāgenaiva vikalpanāt | suptatimirāvasthāyān tāvad bhrāntajñānarūḍhānām arthānāṃ vibhāgenopalambhaḥ | siddhāntāropitānām api yathāsvaṃ siddhāntaśravaṇakāle | śaśaviṣāṇam ityādiṣv api | śaśaviṣāṇaṃ bandhyāsuta iti vyavahāravyutpattikāle 'nāditvād vyavahāravāsanāyāḥ | uktaṃ cātretyādi |
 "ekapratyamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhana" (1|75) ity atra |
 api ca yathā dhavakhadirādayaḥ parasparabhinnās tathā gavādayaḥ | tatra tulye bhede (p.320) kasmād vṛkṣatvaṃ dhavādiṣv eva varttate na gavādiṣv iti pṛṣṭena pareṇaitad eva vaktavyaṃ bhāvaśaktir eva sā dhavādīnāṃ yena na eva vṛkṣatvam prati pratyāsannā na gavādaya iti | tadā tulye bhedye yayā pratyāsattyā bhāvaśaktilakṣaṇayā jātiḥ kvacit svāśrayābhimate 'rtharāśau | prasarppati | vyāpya varttate | saiva bhāvaśaktir anvayiśabdajñānanibandhanam astu | kiṃ sāmānyena kalpitena (|)
 yena yad ucyate |
 "viṣayeṇa hi buddhīnāṃ vinā notpattir iṣyate |
 viśeṣād anyad icchanti sāmānyan tena tad dhruvaṃ |
 tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syur viṣayādṛte |
 na tv anyena vinā vṛttis sāmānyasyeha duṣyatī"ti |
 tadapāstaṃ | na hi yathā sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucit sāmānyavṛttir iṣyate | tathā sāmānyam vinā sāmānyabuddhir iṣyatām iti parobhyupagamaṃ kāryate | yena tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syur iti parasyottaraṃ syāt | kevalaṃ yathā parasya sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucit padārtheṣu yayā pratyāsattyā sāmānyavṛttiḥ saiva bhrāntānvayijñānaśabdanimittam astu kiṃ sāmānyenety ayam arthotra vivakṣita iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
 tasmāt sthitam etad (|) vyāvṛtter evaikatvādhyavasāyād bhāveṣv anvayo nānyasyeti | (|164-65||)

 atra sāṃkhyaḥ prāha – na nivṛttim ityādi | bhāvānvayo bhāvānām ekarūpatvaṃ | apara iti vastubhūtaḥ | tadekasya bījasya yatkāryan tadanyasya pṛthivyāder na syāt | kasmāt (|) tayor bījapṛthivyor atyantabhedataḥ | (|165-66)

 yadyeta ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | eṣām iti bhāvānāṃ yathā bījādekādīnām ekaṃ akurākhyaṃ kāryaṃ | yo hītyādinā tadeva sādhayati | yo hi tasya bījasyāṃkurajananasvabhāvo (p.321) na hi sonyasya pṛthivyāder asti | yosti buddhyāropito vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo na sa janakaḥ | kasmād | vyatirekasyānyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya niḥsvabhāvatvāt | tasmād bījasvalakṣaṇam eva janakaṃ yac ca janakarūpan tad eva vastu | tajjanakaṃ cety aṅkurajanakaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ | aparatreti pṛthivyādau | aparaṃ pṛthivyādikam aṃkuraṃ janayet | sa hītyādi | hiśabda evākārārthaḥ | tasyeti bījasya | anyasya pṛthivyādeḥ (|) sa pṛthivyādis tenāṃkurajananena bījasvabhāvena tato bījād abhinnaḥ syāt | ity asti svabhāvānvayaḥ | tena kecit svabhāvabhedepi prakṛtyaikakāryakāriṇa indriyādivad ity ayuktam uktam iti |
 yadītyādinā siddhāntavādī | ātmaikatrāpīti | kāraṇakalāpasya yenābhinnenātmanā janakatvam iṣyate | sa ātmā teṣāṃ kāraṇānām madhye ekatrāpi kāraṇestīti | tenaikena kāryaṃ kṛtam iti kṛtvā vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ |
 nanu vyāvṛttivādinopy antyāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ janakatvāt kāraṇāntaravaiyarthyaṃ |
 naitad asti | samuditānām eva teṣān tādṛśaṃ sāmarthyaṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ | hetupratyayāyattasannidhitvāt | parasya tu nityavādinaḥ sadā tad rūpam astīti bhavet kāraṇāntarāṇāmānarthakyaṃ | ata evoktam ekatrāpi sostīti kāraṇāntaravikalāvasthāyām apīty arthaḥ |
 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | anekaḥ padārtho yady ekasvabhāvatvād ekasya kāryasya kārakaḥ janakaḥ sa teṣāṃ kāraṇābhimatānām abhinno janakaḥ svabhāva ekakāraṇasannidhānepy asti | tataś ca sarvasyām avasthāyām avaikalyāt kāraṇasya yatra tatrāvasthitir ekopi janakaḥ syāt | (|166-67)

 etad eva draḍhayann āha – yasmād ityādi | ekasminn api bījādau sannihite nāpaityabhinnaṃ tatkāryajananaṃ | viśeṣā vyaktibhedā apāyinaḥ | na hi tasyābhinnasya (p.322) kāryajananasvabhāvasya bījād arthāntarepi pṛthivyādau viśeṣosti | kiṅkāraṇam (|) viśeṣe satyabhedahāneḥ | sa hy abhinno janakābhimataḥ svabhāvas tatrāpi bījepi kevalestīti | naikasya sthitāv api tasyety abhinnasya rūpasya janakābhimatasyāpāyo vināśosti | traiguṇyasya sarvātmanā sarvatra sarvadā sattvāt | ye viśeṣā avasthābhedās teṣāṃ sahasthitiniyamābhāvāt syād apāyaḥ |
 etac cābhyupagamyoktaṃ | anyathā nityād avasthāntaravyatiriktānāṃ veśeṣāṇām api katham apāyaḥ | na ca te janakā iti viśeṣāḥ kasmān neṣṭā ity āha – sahakāriṇām ityādi | tasmād ekasminn api bījādau sthite janakasyātmanaḥ sthānāt | asthāyina iti viśeṣasya | ekasthitāv apīti bījāder anyatamasya sthitāv api kāryotpattiḥ syāt | na ca bhavati kāryotpattiḥ | tataḥ sāmānyasthitepi sahakāriṇām madhye | ekasya viśeṣasyāpāye | phalābhāvād viśeṣebhyas tadudbhavaḥ kāryodbhavaḥ | na sāmānyāt | tatkāryam aṅkurādikaṃ | kiṃ bhūtaṃ | anekam ityādi | anekasya sahakāriṇaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ | anekasahakārijanyam ity arthaḥ | ekaviśeṣāpāyepīti sahakāriṇām anyatamabhedāpāyepi | anena vyatirekam āha –
 punar ityādinānvayaṃ | tasmād viśeṣeṣv evānvayavyatirekau kāryasya na tu sāmānye | tad āha (|) nanv avikala iti | ekaviśeṣasthitāv avikalepy abhinne rūpe tatkāryan na bhavati | kāryaṃ hītyādinaitad eva vibhajate | kutaścid bhāva utpādaḥ sa eva dharmaḥ | sa yasyāsti tat tadbhāvadharmi | kadācit yatra bhavati tattasya janakasya vaikalyān na cābhinnasya rūpasya janakābhimatasya sahakāriṇāṃ madhye | ekasya sthitāv api vaikalyam asti | avikale tasmin sāmānyarūpe kāryamabhata tasya sāmānyasyājanakātmatāṃ (p.323) sacayati | (|167-68||)

 nanu na sāmānyam eva janakam iṣyate yenānyadoṣaḥ syād api tu anekātmatayā janaka ity uktam ity atrāha – yatsākalyetyādi | yeṣāṃ ca viśeṣāṇāṃ sākalyavaikalyābhyāṃ kāryam bhāvābhāvavat | tata eva viśeṣebhyaḥ kāryasyotpattiḥ | tasmin satīti hetubhāvayogye viśeṣe sati bhavataḥ kāryasya | tadanyasmād iti | viśeṣād anyasmāt sāmānyād atiprasaṅgāt sarvaḥ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ syāt | yata evaṃ tasmād viśeṣā eva janakāḥ | na sāmānyaṃ janakaṃ | tato 'janakatvāt ta eva viśeṣā vastu | paramārthasanta ity arthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmāt pāramārthiko bhāvaḥ paramārthasann ity arthaḥ | sa evārthakriyākṣamaḥ |
 idam eva hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | arthakriyāyogyatā vastuno lakṣaṇaṃ | ayogyatā tv avastuno lakṣaṇaṃ | vakṣyāma iti sambandhaḥ (|)
 arthakriyākṣamaṃ yattad atra paramārthasad (3|3) ityādinā | sarvārthakriyāyogyortho viśeṣātmako nāveti | viśeṣasya vyaktyantarānanuyāyitvāt | yonveti sāmānyātmā | tasmāt sāmānyātmano na kāryasya sambhavaḥ |
 tasmād ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | anarthakriyāyogyatvād ity arthakriyāyām ayogyatvād ity arthaḥ | tata eveti viśeṣād eva tanniṣpatter arthakriyāyā niṣpatteḥ |
 tad evam paraiḥ kalpitasyājanakatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ | (268-69)

 adhunā yatpareṇoktaṃ "ekasya kāryam anyasya na syād atyantabhedata" iti tatpariharttuṃ tadeva codyam āvarttayati | svabhāvānanvayāttarhītyādinā |
 "jvarādiśamane kaścit saha pratyekam eva vā (1|76)" (p.324) ityādinā prāg apy etat parihṛtan tathāpy adhikavidhānārthaḥ punar upanyāsaḥ | ekasya bījāder yajjanakaṃ rūpan tadanyasya pṛthivyāder nāstīti kṛtvānyaḥ sahakārī ajanakaḥ syāt | janakasvabhāvād bhinnasvabhāvasya janakatve cābhyupagamyamāne bhedāviśeṣāt sarvo yavabījādir api śālyaṅkurasya janakaḥ syāt |
 naitad ityādinā pariharati | śālibījasyaikasya janakasya ya ātmā tenātmanā pṛthivyādeḥ yavabījādeś cātyantabhedepi hetuḥ kaścit pṛthivyādiḥ śālyaṃkurasya nāparo yavabījādiḥ | caśabdaḥ ślokapūraṇārthaḥ | evakārārtho vā | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvoyaṃ bhāvānāṃ ekasya yo janaka ātmā tasmād ātmanaḥ svabhāvād bhidyamānāḥ sarve samantulyaṃ janakāḥ prāpnuvanti (|) bhedāviśeṣān na vā kaścijjanaka iti (|)
 syād etac codyaṃ | yady eṣām ekasmāj janakādātmano bhinnānān tadatatkāryajananaṃ prati niyamalakṣaṇo viśeṣo na sambhavet | kintu sambhaved eva | tata iti viśeṣāsambhavāt | bhedāviśeṣepi kutaścid ātmātiśayād viśiṣṭakāryapratiniyatalakṣaṇāt kaścijjanakaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ śālyaṃkurasya nāparo yavabījādiḥ (|) kasmāc chālyaṅkurajananāviśeṣas tasya pṛthivyādeḥ sahakāriṇaḥ svabhāvo nāparasya yavabījādeḥ | ayam eva vibhāgaḥ kiṃkuta iti ced āha – na hītyādi | kimagnir dahatyuṣṇo vā nodakandahatyuṣṇaṃ ceti na paryanuyogam arhati pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhatvāt | etāvat tu praṣṭuṃ yuktaṃ syāt (|) kuto hetor ayaṃ yathoktasvabhāva iti | avaśyaṃ hi svabhāvabhedasya hetunā bhāvyaṃ | yato hirhetukatve 'napekṣiṇo deśādiniyamenātiprasaṅgāt | sarvatra sarvadā sarvātmanā bhāvaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt svabhāvosya kāraṇādibhimatasya svahetoḥ sakāśād bhavatīty ucyate | tasyāpi svahetos tajjananātmatā tathābhūtakāraṇasvabhāvajananātmatā tadanyasmāt svahetor ity anādirhetuparamparā |
 (p.325) na hi bhinnānām bhāvānāṃ hetupravibhāge bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti | tad evāha – bhinnetyādi | svabhāvād iti vastusthiteḥ | ekatve tu bādhakam astīty āha – abhedo tv ityādi | parasparam abhedād ekasya nāśe sarvasya yugapannāśaḥ utpāde sarvasyotpādaḥ syād ity arthaḥ |
 abhedād ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | viśvasya sarvasya padārtharāśeḥ svabhāvenābhedāt | vibhāgotpattītyādi | ekasyotpattir anyasyānutpattir ekasya sthitir anyasya nirodha ityevamvibhāgenotpattyādayo na syuḥ | svātmavad iti | yathaikasyāvasthāviśeṣasya vibhāgena notpattyādayas tadvad ity arthaḥ | ādiśabdād ekasya grahaṇam anyasyāgrahaṇam ityādi | sūtre tu nāśotpādagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ | tathā tenaiva vibhāgotpattyādinā upalakṣaṇān niścayād abhedasya | anyathā bhedābhedau kena lakṣyeta | ekākārasyāpīti tulyākārasyāpi vyatireko vibhāgaḥ pṛthagutpattyādimattvaṃ | tad bhedasya lakṣaṇaṃ | avyatireko 'vibhāgaḥ pṛthagutpattyādimattvābhāvaḥ | tadabhedasya lakṣaṇaṃ | saty api vibhāgotpattyādimattve kasmād bheda ity āha – virodhinor tiyādi | virodhinor utpādānutpādaprabhṛtikayor yugapadekātmani virodhāt | nābhede evārthānāṃ kintu bhedopy asti | tad uktaṃ |
 sarvaṃ hi vasturūpeṇa bhidyate na parasparaṃ |
 svarūpāpekṣayā caiṣāṃ parasparavibhinnateti |
 tena kāraṇena | naivaṃ (|) na sakṛdutpādādiprasaṅga iti ced āha – netyādy asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | na vai sarveṇākāreṇāvyatirekam abhedaṃ brūmaḥ | yenaivaṃ syāt | sakṛnnāśotpādādi syāt | kintv asya bāhyādhyātmikasya bhedasya kaścidātmā ghaṭādyavasthāviśeṣalakṣaṇo bhinno nānyas traiguṇyātmakaḥ sukhaduḥkhamohātmatāyā vastu rūpatāyā dravyarūpatāyā sattārūpatāyāś ca sarvatrānugamāt | tenāyam arthovasthātadvatoḥ (p.326) parasparam abhedopy avasthānān tu parasparambheda eva | iti yathoktādavasthādilakṣaṇād bhedāt | (169-70)

 evaṃ tarhi sāmānyasya nityatvāt sarvatra sthānaṃ | viśeṣāṇān tu vināśa ity etad aṅgīkṛtaṃ | tataś caikasmin viśeṣe vinaśyati sati yas tiṣṭhati sāmānyātmā na sa tasya viśeṣasya sambhavaḥ | viruddhadharmādhyāsāt sāmānyaviśeṣayor bheda eva syāt | anyathā sthānāsthānayor ekātmāśrayatvebhyupagamyamāne viruddhāv api dharmāvekātmanyaṅgīkṛtau bhavataś ca (|) konyo dharmo bhedako naiva kaścit | naiva viruddhau dharmāvekatrāṅgīkriyete tayor lakṣaṇabhedād bhinnatvāt | tathā hi viśeṣāḥ pṛthagutpādādinā sarvākāravivekinaḥ sāmānyan tu pṛthagutpattyādyabhāvāt sarvatrāvivekīty ata āha – sarvakāretyādi | sarvākāravivekāvivekinor yathākramam bhedasāmānyayor arthayor abhyupagamāt | nāma kevalam iti bhedasāmānye bhinne ity etad abhidhānamātraṃ neṣṭaṃ syān na tu vastu | nāmāntaraṃ vārthabhedam abhyupagamya tathābhidhānādityādinā |
 tad iti tasmāt | ime bhāvā iti viśeṣāḥ sāmānyam vā parasparaṃbhinnā eva | kiṃbhūtā naikayogakṣemā viruddhadharmādhyāsitā iti yāvat | ataḥ kāraṇān na syāt sāmānyabhedadhīḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ parasparam asambadhnantī buddhir na syād ity arthaḥ | buddhyabhāvāc ca vyapadeśopi pratikṣipta eva | buddhinibandhanatvāt tasyā | tena |
 "anyonyāpekṣitā nityaṃ syāt sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ |
 viśeṣāṇān tu sāmānyan te ca tasya bhavanti hi (ākṛ° 9)"
 --- iti nirastaṃ | tad iti tasmāt | idaṃ sāmānyam bhedebhyorthāntaraṃ | bhedeṣv anāyattaṃ | kasmat (|) tair bhedais tasya sāmānyasyājanyatvāt |
 (p.327) dvitīyorthaḥ (|) tad idaṃ bhedātmakaṃ vastu sāmānyād arthāntaran tasmin sāmānye anāyattantenājanyatvāt | nityasyārthakriyā 'sāmarthyāt | asya bhedasyedaṃ sāmānyam iti vyapadeśaṃ nārhati | bhedo vāsya sāmānyasyeti ||
 anyāpohepi sāmānye eṣa prasaṅga iti | ya ekasmin vinaśyati tiṣṭhatyātmetyādikaḥ | tathā hi dhave khadire vā vinaśyaty avṛkṣavyāvṛttis tiṣṭhaty eva vṛkṣāntare |
 netyādinā pariharati | ayam atrārthā dvividhonyāpoha eko vijātīyavyāvṛttau bāhyaḥ svākārabhedenādhyasto vikalpabuddhyā yo viṣayīkriyate śabdena ca | tasyaivārthakriyākāritvena ca pravṛttiviṣayatvān na buddhipratibhāsamātrasyārthakāritvābhāvāt | aparorthād yat pratīyate 'nyanivṛttimātraṃ | (170-71)

 yac caitad anyanivṛttimātrasya niḥsvabhāvatvān naitac codyaṃ | ācāryeṇa vā yadabhimatan tasya niḥsvabhāvatvād abhāvād ity arthaḥ | tad āha (|) nivṛtter niḥsvabhāvatvād iti na sthānāsthānakalpanā |
 viśeṣe vinaśyati kimanyāpohas tiṣṭhati | kim vā nivartata iti | iyaṃ sthānāsthānakalpanā yuktā | tasyety anyāpohasya | svabhāvānuṣaṅgiṇyo vastvanupātinyaḥ | vikalpabuddhyāyopitaṃ yas sāmānyan tatra tarhi svarūpasthitipracyutikalpanā bhaviṣyatīty ata āha – upaplavaś cetyādi | yaḥ sāmānyākāro 'nekapadārthābhinnaḥ pratibhāsate (|) sāmānyadhiya upaplavo bhrānto 'taḥ sopi bahir nāsty eva (|) yata evaṃ tenāpi viplavatvena kāraṇena sāmānyadhīḥ | adūṣaṇā | nāsyāṃ yathoktaṃ dūṣaṇam astīti vigrahaḥ |
 idam ekākāraṃ vikalpavijñānaṃ nirviṣayaṃ | yasmān mithyājñānam mithyārtham eva katham iti ced āha – yad ityādi | yasmād anekatraikākāraṃ | tadviṣayasya vikalpavijñānaviṣayasya sāmānyasya na sthitir asthitir vā | kasmāt (|) tasya mithyājñānaviṣayasyābhāvāt | (171-72)

 (p.328) samānadoṣatāmapanīya punaḥ prakārāntareṇa prakrāntañ codyaṃ pariharttum āha – yat punar ityādi | tajjanako hi tasya śālyaṅkurasya janako hi sa tasya śālibījasya svabhāvaḥ | yac ca tasya śālibījasya śālyaṅkurajanakaṃ rūpaṃ | tato janakād rūpād anyaḥ pṛthivyādir janakaḥ katham iti | tatrety upanyāse | tatra vā codyo pratividhīyate | śālibījād anyasya pṛthivyādes tajjanakam aṅkurajanakaṃ rūpaṃ nāstīti na brūmaḥ | kin tarhi yad ekasya śālibījasya janakaṃ rūpan tadanyasya pṛthivyāder neti brūmaḥ | bhāvānāṃ parasparam ananvayāt | anyopīti | pṛthivyādiḥ | na pararūpeṇeti na śālibījarūpeṇa | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) atatvād astv abhāvatvāt | na cātra bādhakaṃ pramāṇam astīty āha – te pṛthivyādayo yathāsvam iti (|) yasya yatsvalakṣaṇaṃ tena bhinnāś ca parasparam ekasya kāryasya janakāś ca svabhāveneti ketra virodho na kaścid bādhakapramāṇābhāvāt | na tu śālyaṅkurajanakābhimatena śālibījarūpeṇa vikalasya pṛthivyādeḥ śālyaṅkurakāryatvam viruddham ity ata āha – ekarūpetyādi | ekasya śālibījasya janakaṃ yadrūpan tena vikalaḥ pṛthivyādis tadrūpaḥ śālibījādisvabhāvo na syāt | nātatkāryaḥ kintu tatkārya eva | sa śālyaṅkuraḥ kāryam asyeti vigrahaḥ | yadi tu bījasyaivāṅkurajanakatvaṃ syāt syād virodhas tac ca nāsti | tad āha – tenaivetyādi | śālibījenaiva tatkāryam aṅkurākhyaṃ |
 api cetyādinā pūrvoktaṃ smārayati |
 "ekāpāye phalābhāvād viśeṣebhyas tadudbhava" iti (|) pramāṇabalena viśeṣājanakā ity uktaṃ prāk | tenātmaneti tena janakarūpeṇa | yad ekasya bījasya janakaṃ (p.329) rūpam anyasya pṛthivyādes tan nāsti | na tāvateti śālybījarūpavaikalyamātreṇā janakaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ | apy abheda ityādi | teṣu bhedeṣv abhedopy astīty arthaḥ |
 syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tena sāmānyarūpeṇa te viśeṣā ajanakāḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tasya sāmānyarūpasya nityatvenānapāyat | etac ca "nāpaityabhinnan tadrūpam viśeṣāḥ khalv apāyina" (1|167) ityādinā prāguktaṃ | (172-73)

 "syātāṃ nāśodbhavau sakṛd" (1|170) ityādinā viruddhadharmādhyāsād bhedam prasādhya pratibhāsabhedenāpi sādhayitum āha – kiṃ cetyādi | kimviśiṣṭaḥ pratibhāsabhedaḥ (|) ananyabhāk | prativyakta bhinnaḥ | apiśabdād utpattyādibhedaś ca bhedakaḥ | etac ca pūrvoktam eva samuccīyate |
 yopi vedāntavādy āha – abhāvagrahaṇanimittako hi bhedagrāho na cābhāvaḥ pratyakṣagrāhyaḥ | tena pratyakṣeṇa sattāmātraṅgṛhyate na bhedaḥ | tad uktaṃ |
 "gavyaś ca vopajātan tu pratyakṣaṃ na viśiṣyate" (|)
 ity ata āha – nāyam ityādi | tasyety abhedavādinaḥ | buddhipratibhāsabhedo buddher ākārabhedaḥ | viruddhadharmādhyāsaś ceti pṛthagutpattivināśādikaḥ | sati vā tasmin pratibhāsādibhede bhāvānām abhedebhyupagamyamāne na kvacid bhedaḥ syāt | lokapratītaś ca bhedaḥ | tathā cetyabhede sati ayaṃ pratibhāga iti pratibhāsādiprabhāgaḥ | ekātmavat | yathaikasmin sukhātmani na pratibhāsādibhedas tadvat | tasmād ayaṃ bāhyādhyātmiko bhedo viśeṣa eva parasparavilakṣaṇa eva | kiṃbhūtaḥ (|) bhinnapratibhāsādiḥ (p.330) | bhinnaḥ pratibhāsādir yeti vigrahaḥ |
 nirvikalpakabodhena dvayātmakasyāpi vastuno grahaṇād abhedepīti ced āha – na cātretyādi | atreti bhedeṣu | aparam iti dvitīyaṃ | yadvalenābhinnapratibhāsabalena | tato viśeṣa eva bheda eva | na tv abhedosti | sa eva viśeṣo vastu |
 ye tv apare sāmānyadharmā vastutvādayas tasyaiva vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitāḥ | (173-74)

 tatkāryam ityādi | kāryādipadasāmānyādhikaraṇyān napuṃsakaṃ | anyathā viśeśasya prakrāntatvāt sa iti syāt | tad eva viśeṣarūpaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ coktan tad eva svalakṣaṇam ucyate (|) tattyāgāptiphalā iti tasyaiva viśeṣasya heyasyopādeyasya vā yathākramaṃ tyāga āptiś ca phalaṃ yāsāmpravṛttīnāntāsthoktāḥ | sa cārthakriyākārī viśeṣa eva | tasyaiveti viśeṣasyāparasmād vijātīyād bhedo vyāvṛttimātraṃ | na tu vastubhūtaṃ kiñcit sāmānyaṃ nāma | (174-75)

 yadi hi syāt tadupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam bhedavyatirekiṇopalabhyeta | hi yasmāt | na hi tasya sāmānyasyārthatve vastutve sati dṛśyasya sataḥ | rūpānupalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ | kasmāt | tadupalakṣaṇakṛtatvāt sāmānyopalakṣaṇakṛtatvād bhedeṣu bhedapratyayasya | na hi svayam agṛhītam paratra jñanahetuḥ |
 evan tāvat mīmāṃsakādimatena prātibhāsikaṃ sāmānyaṃ nirākṛtyānumānikam api pūrvoktaṃ sāṃkhyamatena nirākarttum āha – api cetyādi | yathā sāṃkhyasya bhedāviśeṣepi na sarvaṃ sarvasādhanaṃ | tathā bauddhasya bhedāviśeṣepi na sarvaṃ sarvasādhanaṃ | kasya punaś codyasyāyaṃ samādhir ity āha – yad uktam ityādi | tajjanakasvabhāvād iti (|) (p.331) śālyaṅkurajananasvabhāvād bhinnaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ | asyety aṅkurasya | janakatve vābhyupagamyamāne bhedasyāviśeṣāt sarvo janakaḥ syād iti | atra codye uktam evottaraṃ | idan tu dvitīyam ucyate | kiṃ punaruktam ityāha – yadītyādi | pratiniyatakāryajanakājanakatvalakṣaṇo viśeṣo na syāt (175-76)

 syād etac codyam iti |
 yathetyādinā ślokārtham āha – tathā viśeṣepi bhaviṣyati | na sarvaḥ sarvajanaka iti sambandhaḥ | vastudharmatayeti vastuśaktyā | bhāvānām abhede tv abhyupagamyamāne | tasya sarvatrābhinnatvenābhyupagatasyaikatra kriyākriye virudhyete | (176-77)

 bhedamātretyādinā vyācaṣṭe | hetur upādānakāraṇaṃ | pratyayās sahakāriṇaḥ (|) svehetupratyayāḥ svahetupratyayās tair niyamito viśiṣṭakāryanirvarttanasamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ svabhāvo yeṣān te tathoktāḥ | tadbhāvas tasmāt | nānya ity akārakābhimatā na kārakā syuḥ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) atatsvabhāvatvāt | atatkāryajananasvabhāvatvāt | tasyety ekasya traiguṇyasya | tatravety ekasminn neva kārye | tatheti tenaivābhinnena prakāreṇa | tathāpi yadā śālibījaṃ śālyaṅkuraṃ janayati tadaiva na yavavījaṃ śālyaṅkuraṃ janayati | yaś ca śālybījasyātmā | sa eva yavabījasyety ekatraikasya kriyākriye prasajyete | (p.332) traiguṇyasya tena tena śālivījādisanniveśena bhedopy asti | ato bhedāt kasyacid kriyā cet | "bhedaś ced akriyāhetur na kuryuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ |" teṣām api parasparaṃ bhedāt |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sarvākārā dhiyaḥ kin tasyaikasya vastunaḥ | naivety arthaḥ | bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt | paryāyasyeti bhāvaḥ |
 athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sarveṣām bhedānāṃ sarvatra kārye paryāyeṇa krameṇopayogāt | etac ca yadā pradhānaśaktyādhiṣṭhānām eva bhedānām aparāparapariṇāmena kāryakarttṛtvam iti darśanan tadoktaṃ | yadā tv idaṃ darśanam pradhānaśaktir evāparāpararūpeṇa pariṇāmārthakriyāyām upayujyate tadedam ucyate (|) śakter vetyādi | trauguṇyalakṣaṇāyās tanniveśinyāḥ pūrvamakārābhimatapadārthaniveśinyāḥ paścād rūpāntareṇa kārakābhimatarūpeṇa pariṇatāyā upayogān naiva kaścidakārakestīty anena sambandhaḥ | bhedo nānātvam āśrayo yasya paryāyasya sa tathoktaḥ | ekasyābhedasya kathan naiva | śālibījasyaikasya yavabījādirūpatayā pariṇāmo na yukta ity arthaḥ |
 etena sa kin tasyaiva vastuna ity etad vivṛtaṃ | (177-78)

 śakter veti yaduktan tatrāha – pariṇāmo veti | avyatirekiṇyā iti nirvibhāgāyāḥ śakteḥ pariṇāmo vāvasthānāntaraprāptir vā kathaṃ | atheṣyate 'vasthāntarāṇāṃ prāptir ātmabhūtaiva traiguṇyasya | tato viśeṣe vā kathaṃcid abhyupagamyate | pradhānasyaikatvahānir iti |
 evan tāvat pariṇāmapakṣaṃ nirākṛtyādhunā 'bhinnam vā bhinnābhinnam vā bhinnam vā sarvāsu cottarottarāvasthāsvanuyāyitvād ūrddha(?rdhva)vṛtti vā | samaṃ sarvāsu vyaktiṣv anuyāyitvāt tiryagvṛtti vā sāmānyam abhyupagamya sāṃkhyamīmāṃsakanaiyāyikādyabhimataṃ dūṣayitum āha – kiṃcetyādi |
 tena yopi digambaro manyate (|) nāsty ābhirghaṭapaṭādiṣv ekaṃ sāmānyam iṣyate teṣām ekāntabhedāt | kintv aparāpareṇa paryāyeṇāvasthāsaṃjñitena pariṇāmi dravyam etad eva ca sarvaparyāyānuyāyitvāt sāmānyam ucyate | tathā hi suvarṇātmakaṃ ghaṭaṃ bhaṅkttvā (p.333) maulinirvarttate ted eva suvarṇṇadravyaṃ ghaṭarūpatayā vinaśya maulirūpatayotpadyamānaṃ suvarṇasvabhāvena tiṣṭhatīty aparāparāvasthāyāḥ pariṇāmi | tatsāmānyam ity ucyate | pariṇāmitvād eva cāvasthātadvator abhedonyathāvasthātuḥ sakāśād avasthāyā bhede pariṇāmāyogāt | ghaṭātmayayā ca suvarṇṇadravyasya vināśupaṭārthī śokaṃ pratipadyate | maulirūpatayotpāde padārthī prāmodyaṃ pratipadyate (|) suvarṇṇatayā ca vināśotpādābhāve suvarṇṇārthī mādhyasthyaṃ pratipadyate (|) tena yugapadutpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sad iti vastuno lakṣaṇam iti | tad āha –
 "ghaṭamaulisuvarṇṇārthī vi(?)nāśotpādasthitiṣv ayaṃ |
 śokapramodamādhyasthaṃ jano yāti sahetukaṃ |
 na nāśena vinā śoko notpādena vinā sukhaṃ |
 sthityā vinā na mādhyasthan tasmād vastu trayātmakaṃ |
 payovrato na dadhyatti na payotti dadhivrataḥ |
 agorasavrato nobho tasmād vastu trayātmakaṃ |
 na sāmānyātmanodeti na vyeti vyaktam anvayāt |
 ve(vye)tyudeti viśeṣeṇa sahaikatrodayādi sad" iti |
 sopy atra nirākṛta eva draṣṭavyaḥ | tadvati sāmānyaviśeṣavati vastuny abhyupagamyamāno | atyantam abhedābhedau syātāṃ | viśeṣebhyo ghaṭapaṭādibhyaḥ sāmānyatraiguṇyādilakṣaṇasyāvyatirekāt sāmānyam api viśeṣātmakam ity atyantabhedaḥ syāt | sāmānyasyābhāvāt | sāmānyād viśeṣāṇām avyaktir ekādaikyam ity atyantabhedo viśeṣāṇām abhāvāt | ekam bhedasāmānyātmakaṃ nāstīti yāvat |
 atha sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ kathaṃcid bheda iṣayte | atrāpyāha – anyonyam ityādi | sadṛśāsadṛśātmanos sāmānyaviśeṣayor yadi kathaṃcid anyonyam parasparam bhedas tadaikān tena tayor bheda eva syāt | ghaṭapaṭavat | na cārthāntaraṃ sāmānyaṃ pratīyate | tasmān naikaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakaṃ vastu vidyate | digambarasyāpi tadvati vastuny abhyupagamyamāne 'tyantabhedābhedau syātāṃ | yadā ghaṭādyavasthābhedebhyaḥ suvarṇṇatvasāmānyasyābhedas tadātyantam ekāntena bhedaḥ syād ghaṭamaulyādeḥ | suvarṇṇatvasāmānyasyābhāvāt | atha suvarṇṇatvasāmānyād ghaṭamaulyādyavasthā bhedānām abhedas tadātyantam abheda ekāntenaikatvaṃ suvarṇṇarūpataiva syād ity arthaḥ | athāvasthātadvatoḥ svabhāvābhede saty api lakṣaṇabhedād bheda iṣyate | tathā hi suvarṇṇatvasāmānyasya svarūpaṃ sarvāvasthānuyāyi pratīyate (|) (p.334) ghaṭādyavasthānāṃ svarūpaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ pratīyate | tenāvasthātadvator lakṣaṇabhedād bhedosty evety atrāha – anyonyam ityādi | sadṛśāsadṛśātmanor ity avasthātadvator yadi bhedas tadā tayor anyonyam bhedaḥ parasparam ekāntena bhedaḥ syāt | anugatavyāvṛttirūpayoḥ parasparāsaṃśloṣāt | na cāparaḥ svabhāvosti yena tayor abhedaḥ syād anantadharmātmakasya dharmaṇo 'pratīte(ḥ) | bhāvāś ced bhedina iti sambandhaḥ | abhinnenātmanā pradhānākhyenānyena vā | vastutvādinā suvarṇṇatvena vā teṣām eva ghaṭādīnām bhedānāṃ svātmabhūtenāvyatiriktena tadvantaḥ syur abhinnasvabhāvavantaḥ syuḥ | teṣāṃ pradhānādīnām abhinnaḥ svabhāvas tadabhinnasvabhāvaḥ ātmā rūpaṃ yasya bhedasya ghaṭādilakṣaṇasya sa tadabhinnasvabhāvātmā | tadbhāvas tasmād (|) bhedasyāpi kuto bhedaḥ parasparaṃ | naiva | anenātyantābhedo vyākhyātaḥ |
 atha tasya bhedasya ghaṭādilakṣaṇasya samāna eka ātmā na bhavati | bhedasya ghaṭādirūpeṇānekātmakatvāt | tathā sati tadātmanā bhedasvabhāvena tenāpi sāmānyapadārthena traiguṇyādinā tatheti sāmānyātmanā bhavatun na yuktaṃ | bhedād avyatiriktatvāt sāmānyasya samānatā na prāpnotīty arthaḥ | etenātyantabhedo vyākhyātaḥ |
 tathābhāve hīti sāmānyātmakatve pradhānāder iṣyamāṇe pradhānādyātmā 'taddharmā bhedadharmā na syāt | avyatirekiṇāvasthākhyena dharmeṇa tadvān na syād ity arthaḥ | avasthātadvatoḥ parasparato bhedaḥ syād iti yāvat | tam eva sādhayan nāha – na hy ayam ityādi | ayam ekaḥ svabhāvaḥ pravṛttinivṛttimānna yukta iti sambandhaḥ | sthānaṃ pravṛttiḥ | vigamo nivṛttiḥ | tathā hi pradhānaśaktau sthitāyāṃ suvarṇṇadravyatvādau na sthite 'vasthānān nivṛttir iṣyate | etenānyonyam vā tayor bheda ityādi vyākhyātaṃ |
 netyādinā parābhipramāśaṃkate | na srvātmanā sāmānyaviśeṣayor abheda eva kintu tayor api bhedasāmānyayor bhedo bhavedyadi | na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kvacid dravye sāmānyaviśeṣasya parasparam bhedo 'bhedo vaikāntiko na hīti sambandhaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) vivekinetyādi | sāmānyaṃ śaktiḥ suvarṇṇatvan dravyatvañ cāviśeṣā ghaṭādaya ityevaṃbhedena vyavasthāpanāt |
 yenetyācāryaḥ | tayor bhedasāmānyayor ayaṃ bheda idaṃ sāmānyam ity etad yenātmanā vyāvṛttenānugatena ca svabhāvena bhedo vyavasthāpyate | yadi tenātmanā sāmānyaviśeṣayor bhedas tadā evātyntaṃ | (179)

 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yamātmanam ity anugataṃ vyāvṛttañ ca | tenātmanā sāmānyaviśeṣayor yadi bheda iti sambandhaḥ | etad eva sphuṭayann āha – yasmād ityādi | tau bhedavyavasthāpakāvātmanau tayor iti sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ | svātma(ā)nau svabhāvabhūtau | tau ced anugatavyāvṛttāv ātmānau vyatirekiṇau parasparavyāvṛttau tadā vyatireka eva bheda eva | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvabhedāt | (179-80)

 syān matam (|) avasthā 'vasthātrorbhedavyavasthāpako hi svabhāva eva bhidyate na bhāva ity āha – svabhāvo hītyādi | svabhāva eva bhāva ity arthaḥ | tathā ceti (|) bhedasāmānyayor atyantabhede sati | bhedasya nissāmānyatā | sāmānyasya ca nirviśeṣaatā syād iti sambandhaḥ (|) sāmānyasya bhedavattvaṃ bhedānāṃ ca sāmānyavattvaṃ na syāt sambandhābhāvād iti yāvat | yadvad ghaṭādīnāṃ bhedānāṃ sambandhābhāvāt parasprantadvattā nāsti | (181)

 vyatireke cetyādinārtham āha – bhedasāmānyayor ajanyajanakatvena sambandhābhāvāt | bhavati ca tayos sambandhitayā pratītis tasmād bhrāntatvam uktam iti "na syāt sāmānyabhedadhīr" ity atrāntare (1|171) | (180-81)

 (p.336) evamūrdhvasāmānyavādaṃ digambarādyabhimataṃ | tiryakisāmānyavādañ ca sāṃkhyādyabhimataṃ sādhāraṇadūṣaṇena nirākṛtya punastiryaksāmānyavadām eva dūṣayitum āha – api cetyādi |
 etad uktam bhavati (|) arthakriyārthinaḥ sāmānyaviṣayabhedābhedacintayā na kiñcit prayojanam arthakriyārahitatvāt | kintu | yamātmānam arthakriyāyogyaṃ punaskṛtyālambanīkṛtya | tatsādhyaphalavāñ chāvān | tenātmanā yatsādhyam phalan tadabhilāpāṣāt | ayaṃ puruṣaḥ pravartate | tadāśrayāv arthakriyāsamarthādhiṣṭhānau bhedābhedau ciṃtyete | tasya cārthakriyāyogyasya svātmanā svena rūpeṇa bheda ātyantakosty eva | vyāvṛttyā ca vijātīyavyāvṛttena rūpeṇa sāmānyatāsty evādhyavasitaikatvarūpayā | iyataivārthakriyārthino bhedābhedacintā samāptā | tatorthakriyākāriṇaḥ sāmānyasya kim svalakṣaṇe bhedābhedacintayeti | (181-82)

 nanu cārthakriyārthinaḥ puruṣasya vyāvṛttyāpi samānatāyāḥ kimprayojanam arthakriyārahitatvāt |
 sattyaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇāny eva vyāvṛttyā sāmānyam ucyate śabdāt tatraikatvādhyavasāyena pravṛttir yathāsyādity adoṣaḥ |
 atha syāt svalakṣaṇam eva svalakṣaṇāntarānuyāyīti kiṃ parikalpitayā vyāvṛttyety āha – svalakṣaṇānām parasparam bhedāt | yadi ghaṭārūpam paṭe syād udakāharaṇārthī paṭepi pravartteta | tad āha – pravṛttyādītyādi | ādiśabdāt tulyotpattinirodhādiprasaṅgaḥ |
 sarva evetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | viśeṣam evārthakriyāyogyaṃ svabhāvākhyam ātmabhūtam ity arthaḥ | kasya bhavasya vastunodhikṛtya pravartate | sa eva hīty arthakriyākārī viśeṣaḥ | tatheti | gaur ityādiśabdaiḥ | arthakriyārthī hi svalakṣaṇapratipādanābhiprāya eva śabdaṃ prayuṅkto dṛśyavikalpyayor ekīkṛtya | pratipattāpi tathaiva pratipadyate (p.337) | tato vyavaharttṛṇāmadhyavasāyavaśāc chabdavyāpārāpekṣayaitad uktaṃ | śabdo tu jñāna svalakṣaṇapratibhāso nāstīti svalakṣaṇam avācyam uktam ity adoṣaḥ |
 dravyādayas tu na tatreti | gaur ityādiśabdair gavādicodanāyāṃ | kasmāt yathāsvaṃ dravyatvādiśabdais teṣāṅ gavādeḥ pṛthagabhidhānāt godravyam ityādiṇā | kathan tarhi gaur ityādipadaprayoge sattādravyatvādayaḥ pratīyanta ity āha – arthasyetyādi | arthasya gavādeḥ | tena sattvadravyatvādinā 'vyabhicārāt | tatorthād gatiḥ sāmānyānāṃ syāt | na tu viśeṣaśabdaḥ sāmānye vyāpriyate | nirloṭhitaṃ caitadācāryadiṅnāgena sāmānyaparīkṣādau yathā na viśeṣaśabdānāṃ sāmānye vṛttir iti |
 atra codyate | kasya punaḥ sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇāvyabhicāraḥ | yattāvat paraparikalpitan nāsty eva | yac cānyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ prasajyamātran tad api nāsty eva | nāpi vikalpabuddhipratibhāsino bāhyenāvyabhicārosti tasya svatantratvāt |
 ucyate | svalakṣaṇam eva sajātīyavyāvṛttam viśeṣaḥ | tad eva vijātīyavyāvṛttim apekṣābhedenopāttaṃ sāmānyam ity ucyate | tataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayor vastuta ekatvāt | kṛtakatvānityatvayor ivāvyabhicāraḥ | śabdavyāpārabhedāt tu kevalaṃ kvacicchābdī pratipattiḥ kvacidārthīty ucyate | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ puruṣaḥ | gavādiśabdapratyupasthāpitaṅ gavādiśabdasannidhāpitam artham arthakriyāśrayaṃ | arthāntarasya sāmānyasyopanyāsena bhedasāmānyākāratayā dvimukhā buddhir yasya sa tathoktaḥ | yosya gavāder ātmā svabhāvaḥ | ananyabhāvasādhāraṇas sa eva svabhāvaḥ śabdacodita iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | yam arthaṃ sāsnādimanttaṃ puraskṛtyālambanīkṛtya viśiṣṭārthakriyārthī | tam evāha – yathetyādi | yathā gorvāhadehādāvarthī ggāmadhikṛtya pravartate | anyasambavina iti goranyasmin naśve sambhavinorthārthī gāṃ puraskṛtya na pravarttata iti vākyārthaḥ samarthanīyaḥ | korthonyasambhavīty āha – yathā yuddhapraveśa iti | yathāsvam iti yasya yaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ | na dravyatvādi sāmānyaṃ | coditam iti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | taccodanayā gavādīnāṃ gavādiśabdaiś codanayā | tadety arthakriyārthinaḥ (p.338) pravṛttikāle | prāptum anabhipretatvād dravyatvādisāmānyasyeti | vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | kasmāt punargavādiśabdena dravyatvādisāmānyaṃ codayituṃ nābhipretam ity āha – gavādisamāveśād gavādiśabdasya gavādau loke saṃketitatvāt | gavādisvabhāvatvād dravyatvādisāmānyasya gavādicodanayā 'bhidhānam iti ced āha – tadātmabhūtānāṃ ceti | gavādisvabhāvānāṃ dravyatvādisāmānyānāṃ gavādivedivānanvyayena hetunā tatreti tasya gavādibhedasya | anubhayarūpatvād asāmānyaviśeṣarūpatvād eveti yāvat | tataś ca viśeṣa eva codyate |
 tad evāha – tam evetyādi | tam eva cānanyasādhāraṇam bhāvam arthakriyārthī puruṣo bhedābhedaprakāraiḥ paryanuyuṅkte | anyāpohavādinopi vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo dravyatvādyabhedaḥ svalakṣaṇām iṣṭas tato 'tyantabhedo viśeṣāṇāṃ viruddha ity ata āha – tasyetyādi | tasyārthakriyākāriṇorthasya bhede prakṛtyā sthite sati vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo dravyatvādyabhedosya viśeṣasyābādhaka eva | tasya kalpitatvāt | tasmāt pāramārthiko bhedaḥ | svalakṣaṇānām upakalpitam ekatvam anena ca prakāreṇa bhedābhedāviśiṣṭāv asmākaṃ (|) tad eva darśayann āha – sarvatretyādi | svabhāvena bhedaḥ svajātīyavijātīyāt | sāmānyasya ca vyāvṛttilakṣaṇasyābhyupagamād iti sambandhaḥ |
 na vyāvṛttirūpeṇa sāmānyenābhedaḥ kintu vastubhūtenaiveti ced āha – svabhāvabhūtasyetyādi | vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyābheda iti vyaktibhyonarthāntaratve | uktam iti sāmānyād avyatirekād bhedānāmaikyaṃ | bhedavad eva vā sāmānyasyāpy anekatvam ity uktaṃ prāk | na sāmānyadvāreṇa bhedānām aikyam ity ucyate | kintu yosau viśeṣastenaivābheda ity āha – svātmanaivetyādi | svenaiva viśeṣarūpeṇa gavāśvādīnām abhede tad godravyaṃ nibandhanaṃ yasyā arthakriyāyā vāhadohādilakṣaṇāyās tayārthī puruṣaḥ (|) samam ity ubhayatrāpy avasitagavādibhāvaḥ | dvayor apīti gavi cāśve caiva | yasmād ekopi hi kāraṇatvenābhimato gopadārthas tām arthakriyām vāhadohādisvabhāvāṃ | (p.339) tatsvabhāvatvāt tadarthakriyākaraṇasvabhāvatvād eva karoti | tadanyasyāpi tasmād godravyād anyasyāpy aśvasya tadvāhadehādikaraṇasvabhāvatvan tulyam iti sopy aśvaḥ gosādhyām arthakriyāṃ kin na karoti ||0|| (182-83)

 etenaiveti sarvasyārthasya bhedasādhanena | ahrīkā nagnatayā nirlajjāḥ kṣapaṇakāḥ | ayuktābhidhānasya kutsitatvāt kim apīty āha – aślīlaṅgrāmyaṃ | sarvaḥ sarvasvabhāvo na ca sarvaḥ sarvasvabhāva iti yat pralapanti pratikṣiptan tad api tasmād ekāntasambhavāt | ekasyaivāntasyātyantabhedaprakārasya sambhavāt | (183-84)

 nanu digamvarāṇāṃ sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvātmakam iti naitaddarśanan tatkimartham idam ācāryeṇocyate |
 sattyaṃ (|) yathā darśanan tv "atyantabhedābhedau ca syātām" (1|178) ityādinā pūrvam eva dūṣītaṃ |
 yatpuranaretad uktaṃ (|) tad yathā kaṭakeyūrādiṣu suvarṇṇapratyayasyānuyāyinas sadbhāvās suvarṇṇatvasāmānyaṃ kalpyate | tathā ghaṭapaṭādiṣu dravyatvādipratyayasyānvayinaḥ sadbhāvād dravyatvasāmānyam ekaṃ kinneṣyate | na ceṣyate 'bhinnapratyayasadbhāvepi tathā kaṭakakeyūrādiṣu sāmānyakalpanā mābhūd ity evamparametat |
 syād uṣṭro dadhi | dravyādirūpatayaikatvāt | syān na dadhi uṣṭrāvasthāto dadhyavasthāyā bhinnatvāt | aślīlam ity asya vyākhyānam ayuktam iti | tasyāyuktatvāt | vidvajjanāyogyatayā grāmyam iti bhāvaḥ | aślīlam ity asya grāmyaparyāyatvāt | aheyopādeyam iti | atyājyam agrāhyañ ca | kasmād apariniṣṭhānāt | yadi hi kiṃcitsukhasādhanatvena niścitamanyac ca duḥkhasādhanatvena tadā yathākramaṃ heyam upādeyaṃ vā syāt | tac ca nāsti yataḥ sarvasya sarvasvabhāvatvaṃ (|) na ca sarvasya sarvasvabhāvatvaṃ | ata evākulamekasyāpi svabhāvabhedasya gṛhītum aśakyatvāt |
 (p.340) etad uktam bhavati | yadāvasthātadvatos sarvātmano 'bhedovasthānāt tu parasparam bhedas tadāyan doṣas tadāha – tadanye veti | tasya svabhāvabhedasya parasparānvaye vā | dadhyādisvabhāvasya dravyasyoṣṭrādiṣu tādātmyenānugamād iti yāvat |
 sarvasyobhayarūpatvaṃ | ubhayagrahaṇam anekatvopalakṣaṇārthan tasmin sati tadviśaṣasya uṣṭra uṣṭra eva na dadhi | dadhi dadhyeva noṣṭra ityevaṃ lakṣaṇasya nirākṛteḥ | dadhi khādetyevaṃ coditaḥ puruṣaḥ kimuṣṭraṃ khādituṃ nābhidhāvati | uṣṭropi dadhyabhinnād dravyatvād avyatirekāt syād dadhi | nāpi sa eveti | uṣṭra evoṣṭra ityekāntavādaḥ | yenānyopi dadhyādikaḥ syād uṣṭraḥ tathā dadhyapi syād uṣṭraḥ | uṣṭrābhinnena dravyatvena dadhnas tādātmyenābhisambandhāt | nāpi tadeveti dadhyeva dadhi | yenānyad apy uṣṭrādikaṃ syād dadhi | etena sarvasyobhayarūpatvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ |
 tadviśeṣanirākṛter ity etadanayor ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ubhayathāpi dadhyuṣṭraviśeṣaḥ syāt | dadhirūpābhāvo veṣṭre syāt | uṣṭrarūpaṃ vā dadhyasambhavi yady uṣṭrasvarūpa eva niyatam bhavet | evaṃ dadhnopi vācyaṃ |
 ādyasya tāvadasambhavas tad ityādinā kathyate | tadevamanekayor dhadhyuṣṭrayor na kaścid viśeṣa iti sambandhaḥ | ekasyāpīti dadhna uṣṭrasya vā kasyacit tadrūpābhāvasyeti | uṣṭrarūpābhāvasya dadhirūpābhāvasya cābhāvāt |
 dvitīyasyāpi prakārābhāvam āha – svarūpasyetyāpi | atadbhāvino dadhyabhāvina uṣṭrasvarūpasya | uṣṭrābhāvino vā dadhisvarūpasya | svaniyatasya uṣṭrasvabhāvaniyatasya | dadhisvabhāvaniyatasya cābhāvāt (184-85)

 athāsti dadhyuṣṭrayor atiśayaḥ kaścid yenātiśayena dadhi khādeti coditaḥ puruṣo bhedena varttate | uṣṭraparihāreṇa dadhnyeva pravartatte |
 etad uktam bhavati | yathā dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ parasparaṃ svarūpam bhinnan tathā dravyaparyāyayor (p.341) lakṣaṇabhedād bhedo yadīṣyate tadā sa eva rūpātiśayo dadhi | sa conyatroṣṭre nāsti | nāpi dravyatvaṃ dadhyādivyatiriktaṃ pratibhāsate | ity anena dvāreṇānubhayaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarahitaṃ sarvam vastu | paraṃ kevalaṃ | ekatvan tu kalpitaṃ | anayor iti dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ | tathā codita iti dadhi khādeti coditaḥ | kṣīravikāro dadhi | nānyatrety uṣṭre | sa evātiśayo dadhi | kimbhūtaḥ (|) arthakriyārthipravṛttiviṣayaḥ | dadhisādhyārthakriyā tayā yorthī puruṣas tasya pravṛttiviṣayaḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tatphaletyādi | dadhisādhyaṃ phalaṃ tad eva viśiṣyatenyasmād iti viśeṣaḥ | tasyopādānabhāvo hetubhāvas tena lakṣitaḥ svabhāvo yasya vastunaḥ | tad eva dadhīti kṛtvā | sa ca tādṛśa ity anantarokto dadhisvabhāvaḥ | anyatrety uṣṭre | kasmād (|) dadhyarthinas tatroṣṭre pravṛttyabhāvāt | (185-86)

 sarvātmatva ity ekarūpatve satīty arthaḥ | bhinno niyatārthau | dhīdhvanī | jñānaṃ śabdasya | tadbhāvād bhinnabuddhiśabdābhāvāt | bhedānāṃ saṃhāravādasya | ekīkaraṇavādasyāsambhavaḥ | bhedena gṛhītayoḥ śrutayor vā | ekatvenopasaṃhāro nirdeśaḥ | syād uṣṭro dadhītyādi |
 soyam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kvacid api dadhnyuṣṭre vā pratiniyatam ekam ākāram apaśyan kathaṃ buddhyādhim ucyetārthān iti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭayā buddhyety āha – asaṃsṛṣṭetyādi | saṃsṛṣṭonyākāro yasminn arthe sa tathoktaḥ | sa yasyā buddher asti sā saṃsṛṣṭānyākāravatī | vibhaktārthagrāhiṇy eveti yāvat | abhilaped vā kathaṃ | pratyarthaṃ prati(ni)yatasaṃketena dhvaninetyākṛtaṃ | kasmān nādhimucyetety āha – (p.342) vibhāgābhāvād bhāvānām iti | tatsaṃhāravāda iti bhedasaṃhāravādo na syāt (|) syād uṣṭraḥ syād dadhītyādikaḥ |
 atha punarasaṃsṛṣṭau dadhyuṣṭrau pratipadya saṃharet | syād uṣṭraḥ syād dadhīti | tadāpy ekarūpasaṃsargiṇyā | uṣṭrarūpaṇaiva dadhirūpeṇaiva vā saṃsargiṇyā buddher asaṃsṛṣṭākāragrāhiṇyā kvaciduṣṭre dadhani ca | pratiniyamāt tatpratibhāsabhedakṛta eva tayor dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ svabhāvabhedopi | ekāneketyādi | pratibhāsabhedasyānekavyavasthitir viṣayaḥ | ekavyavasthitiḥ pratibhāsabhedasyeti yojyaṃ | bhinnapratibhāsaviṣayau ca dadhyuṣṭrau tathā ca sati naika uṣṭro dadhi vā tadubhayarūpaḥ tadubhayan dadhyuṣṭrātmakaṃ rūpaṃ yadyeti vigrahaḥ | mithyāvāda eva syādvādaḥ ||0|| (186-87)

 bhedalakṣaṇam iti vyāvṛttikṣaṇam vijātīyavyāvṛttāny eva svalakṣaṇāni sāmānyam ity ucyante | prakṛtyā svabhāvena | ādiśabdād udkādyāharaṇādyekaphalāḥ |
 bhavatu nāmetyādinā cācāryaḥ parābhipram āśaṃkate | bhāvānām vastūnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ svabhāve naivānyasmād vyāvṛttiḥ | tatreti nirupākhyeṣu (|) kathaṃ svabhāvabhedaviṣayā vyāvṛttiviṣayāḥ śabdāḥ |
 nanu nirupākhyeṣu śabdānāṃ pravṛttir eva nāsti tatkimartham idam āśaṃkatam iti kadācit paro brūte | tannirākaraṇārtham ācāryaḥ prāha – teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyaṃ | ya tu na cānyāpohāvādinā śakyam vaktun naiva nirupākhyeṣu śabdānāṃ pravṛttir iti | yatas teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyam iti codako brūta iti vyācakṣate | teṣām anena krameṇa deśakālaniṣedha eva sarvabhāveṣu kriyate | tathā sambandhasya svarūpaṇān abhidhānam uktaṃ | (p.343) evaṃ yatpunar etat tadarthaniṣedhe 'narthakaśabdāprayogāt | nirviṣayasya naño 'prayoga ity artottaram vakṣyata ityādi grantho vakṣyamāṇaś codakābhiprāyeṇāvācakaḥ syāt |
 tasmād ācārya eva nirupākhyeṣu śabdapravṛttiṃ samarthayate "teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyam" ityādinā granthena | kasmād (|) kathaṃcijjñānaśabdatvenāvyavasthāpiteṣu nirupākhyeṣu sarvatrārtha vidhipratiṣedhe vāyogāt | yadi kvacid asata ākārasya viṣedhe jñānābhidhāne syātāṃ | tadā niṣiddhākāraparihṛterthe vidhiḥ syāt | tathā ceti vidhipratiṣedhāve | anvayavyatirekau vidhipratiṣedhau āśrayo yasya vyavahārasya sa tathoktaḥ | tam eva vyavahārabhāvam uṣṇetyādinā 'ha | uṣṇasvabhāvognir ity anvayāśrayo vyavahāraḥ | nānuṣṇa iti vyatirekāśrayaḥ | ayam apy atiprasiddho lokavyavahāro na syād ity apiśabdenāha – uṣṇavyavasthā hy anuṣṇavyavacchedena (|)
 tasya cānaṣṇasyoṣṇābhāvalakṣaṇasya kathañcid vyavasthānāt kathan tadvyavacchedeṇoṣṇaṃ vyavasthāpyeta | tadāha – svabhāvāntaretyādi | uṣṇābhāva evoṣṇasvabhāvād antaram vilakṣaṇan tadviraharūpeṇeti svabhāvāntaram uktaṃ | ata evāsata ity etad ghaṭate |
 nanu svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ svabhāvāntaran tasya kathaṃcid api vikalpabuddheḥ śabdasya ca viṣayatvenāvyavasthāpanāt | sarvasthānuṣṇasyāpratipatter aniścayāt tadvyavacchedalakṣaṇasyāgnisvabhāvasyāpratipattir aniścayaḥ | yathāgnisvabhāvasyaivaṃ sarvasya padārthasya | tato vyāmūḍhaam aniścitarūpaṃ jagat syāt |
 syād etat (|) na tatra vahnyādau kasyacidasato niṣedho yenābhāvepy avaśyaṃ pravṛttyā bhāvyam iti codyate | kintv anuṣṇaṃ sparśākhyaṃ sad eva vastv eva | agneś cārthāntaraṃ niṣidhyata iti |
 katham ityādyācāryaḥ | sad eveti vacanāt sattvam iṣṭaṃ | niṣidhyata iti vacanād asattvam ekaṃ ca kathaṃ sadasannāma | netyādinā paraḥ pariharati | tatrāgnāvanuṣṇaṃ nāstīy anena sarvatrānuṣṇam asad iti brūmaḥ | evaṃ hy ucyamāne sattvaṃ pratijñāya punaḥ sarvatra sattvaniṣedhesadasattvam ekatra pratijñātam bhavet | kevalan tatra tv agnāv anuṣṇān nāstīti brūmaḥ | tataś cānyatra satonyatrāsattvam aviruddhaṃ | ayam eva ca deśaha(?) ity āha – iha nāstīti deśasya niṣedhaḥ | idānīn nāstīti kālasya | anena prakāreṇa nāstīti dharmasya | dharmino niṣedhaḥ | kasmāt (|) tanniṣedhe dharmiṇo niṣedhe | tadviṣayasya dharmiviṣayasya śabdasya nirviṣayatayā pravṛttyabhāvāt | tataś ca dharmaśabdāpravṛtter anirdiṣṭo viṣayo (p.344) yasya nañs tasyāprayogāt | idam iha nāstīty avaśyam idam ādipadair viṣayaḥ pratiṣedhasyopasthāpyonyathā kimviṣayoyaṃ pratiṣedha ityevaṃ sa na jñāyate | etac ca sarvam udyotakarādīnām mantam upanyastaṃ |
 sopītyācāryaḥ | tatrāpītyācāryaḥ | tatrāpītyādideśakāladharmaniṣedhena deśādīnāṃ niṣedhaḥ sattvāt | ādiśabdāt kālasya parigrahaḥ | vyaktibhedād bahuvacanaṃ | nārthasyeti dharmasya | kvacit sattvād eva | na tv arthaśabdena dharmiṇo nirdeśaḥ | pareṇāpi dharminiṣedhasyāniṣṭatvāt |
 syād etan na deśādiniṣedhaḥ kriyate nāpy uṣṇasya niṣedhaḥ | kin tv anuṣṇena sahāgner yaḥ sambandhas sa niṣidhyate |
 na tv ityādyācāryaḥ | tanniṣedhepīti sambandhaniṣedhepi tulyo doṣaḥ | dharmmavat sambandhasyāpy aniṣedhāt | tad evāsa sa(?)tītyādinā sādhayati | asati sambandhe śabdāpravṛttiḥ | ādiśabdād anirdiṣṭaviṣayasya naño 'prayogāt | atha vā tulyo doṣaḥ (|) kathaṃ | niṣedhādasati yo niṣedhas tasya tvayaiva niṣedhād iti vyākhyeyaṃ | kathaṃ niṣedha ity āha – astītyādi | asato vāsyeti sambandhasya niṣedhe | tadvat sambandhavat | dharmiṇopi niṣedhaḥ |
 netyādi paraḥ | sambandho nāstīty eva svaśabdena na vai sambandhasya niṣedhaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | yathā sambandhasya svaśabdena svarūpeṇābhidhānan nāsti tathā niṣedhepi | tad evāha – kin tarhi neha pradeśe ghaṭo (|) nedānīṃ kāla ityevaṃ pratiṣedhoktau satyāṃ | nānena deśena vāsya ghaṭasya sambandhostīti pratītiḥ | tathā naivan nā'nena prakāreṇa ghaṭostīty uktau naitad dharmā ghaṭa iti pratītiḥ | tathetyevaṃ pratītau satyāṃ |
 tathāpītyācāryaḥ | nedānīm ityādināpi kathaṃ sambandho niṣiddho yāvad asya puṃsaḥ sambandho dharmo vā nāstīti matir bhavati | neha nedānīm iti pratiṣedhe sambandho nāstīti matiḥ | naivam iti pratiṣedhe dharmo nāstīti matiḥ |
 nanu dharmaniṣedho 'pi sambandhaniṣedha eva | dharmadharmiṇoḥ sambandhaniṣedhāt | sattyaṃ | saṃyogasamavāyalakṣaṇasambandhabhedāt tu sambandho dharmo veti bhedenoktaṃ | na cāsyās sambandho nāstīti mateḥ kathaṃcid bhāve sambandhādisattāyāṃ sambhavaḥ | kasmād abhāveṣv ityādi | tathāśabdo yathāśabdārtham ākṣipati | yat tadornityābhisambandhāt | satsu deśādiṣu yathā nāstīti buddher abhāvaḥ | satsv abhāvabuddher virodhāt | tadvadabhāveṣu | asati buddhipravṛtter anabhyupagamāt | tasmāt sambandhābhāvapratīteḥ sakāśān nāyam ihetyādyā pratītiḥ | sā tadabhāve sambandhābhāvapratītyabhāve na syāt (p.345) yad vā seti smbandhābhāvapratītiḥ | tadabhāva iti sambandhābhāve | pratītau vā tadabhāvasya sambandhābhāvasya | tādṛśī sambandhābhāvapratītis sā vidyate yasya puṃsaḥ | tasya yathāpratītimataḥ | tatprabhāvas sambandhābhāvapratītijanmānas sambandhābhāvaviṣayaḥ śabdo kena vāryante | vikalpānām viṣayaḥ sambandhābhāvo na śabdānām iti ced āha – sa eva hītyādi | yo na vitarkāṇām viṣayaḥ sa eva na śabdānām viṣayaḥ | vikalpaviṣayas tv avaśyaṃ śabdaviṣaya ity arthaḥ | te cet pravṛttā iti vitarkāḥ |
 nanu purovasthite nīlādau nīlam ityādivikalpaḥ | svalakṣaṇaviṣayo na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdavācyam ity āha – na hītyādi | avācyam artham iti svalakṣaṇaṃ | vikalpādhikārād vikalpabuddhayo gṛhyante | samīhanta ity ālambante | sāmānyākāraiva sadā vikalpabuddhir yāpi sannihite svalakṣaṇe | savikalpanirvikalpayos tu yaugapadyād abhimāna eṣa mandamatīnāṃ vikalpaḥ svalakṣaṇakāra iti (|) vicāritaṃ caitat pramāṇaviniścaye śāstrakāreṇeti neha pratanyate |
 nanu yadi vikalpabuddhyā viṣayīkṛtatvāt sambandhābhāvo vācyaḥ | evaṃ tarhi sambandopi vācyaḥ syād vikalpabuddyā viṣayīkṛtatvād (|) atheṣyata eva | kathan tarhy ācāryadiṅnāgena tasyāvācyatvam uktam ity āha – sambandhasyetyādi | svena rūpeṇeti sambandharūpeṇa (|) sambandhinaṃ sambandha iti parasparāpekṣālakṣaṇam bhāvamātram adravyabhūtaḥ sambandhasya svabhāvaḥ | tena ca rūpeṇa tasyābhidhāyakaḥ śabdo nāsti | sambandhaśabdo hi tasyābhidhāyaka eṣaṣṭavya sa ca prayuktaḥ kayor ity ākṣipati | tatra rājapuruṣayoḥ sambandha ity ucyamāne rājapuruṣayor ity asya vyatirekasya hetuḥ sambandhas tadā sa sambandhaḥ sambandhirūpeṇa pratīyate | tadāha – abhidhānena sambandhitvenetyādi | rājapuruṣayoḥ sambandha ity abhidhāne rājapuruṣābhyāṃ parasparasāpekṣābhyāṃ niṣkṛṣṭarūpasyaiva sambandhasya sambandhitvena buddhāv upasthānāt | yathābhiprāyam apratītaḥ | rājaḥ puruṣa iti parasparāpekṣālakṣaṇas sambandho yathā jñātum iṣṭas tena rūpeṇāpratītiḥ | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ sambandhaḥ pratīyamānopi sambandhaśabdāt | yathoktavidhinā sambandhirūpa eveti na sambandhenābhidhīyate | tasmān nābhāvavat sambandhepi prasaṅga iti sambandhābhāvo yathā buddhyā viṣayīkriyata iti vācyaḥ prasakto naivaṃ sambandhepi vācyatvam ity arthaḥ | sambandhābhāvo hi svena rūpeṇa buddhyā viṣayīkriyate | śabdenāpi tatheivābhidhīyate | sambandhas tu svarūpeṇa gṛhyate | nāpy abhidhīyate | sambandhirūpāpannasyaiva viṣayīkaraṇād abhidhānāc ca | tathā cāha –
 asattvabhūtas sambandho rūpan tasya na gṛhyate |
(p.346)
 nābhidhānaṃ svarūpeṇa sambandhasya kathañcaneti |
 tasmāt sthitam etad vikalpaviṣayovaśyam vācya iti | tataś ca yadi nāsti sambandha iti matis tadā tatprabhavopi śabdaḥ pravarttata eva | tathācābhāvaviṣayaḥ śabda āpatita eva |
 atha mābhūd ayan doṣa iti sambandhasya nāstīti buddhyā viṣayīkaraṇaṃ neṣyate | neha ghaṭa ity atra kasya niṣedho (|) na tāvad deśādes tasya sattvāt (|) na sambandhasya tadbhāvasyāgrahaṇād iti yat kiñcid etat |
 api cābhāvam abhidheyaṃ yo brūte taṃ bruvāṇaṃ prati ayam abhāvān abhidhānavādī abhāvo na vācya iti pratividadhan pratikṣipannabruvāṇaḥ kathaṃ pratividadhyāt | na hy abhāvaśabdam uccārayatā abhāvasya vācyatvaṃ śakyaṃ pratipādayituṃ | athecchaty abhāvasya vacanan tadā vacanaṃ vāsyābhāvasyābhyupagamyamāne katham abhāvonuktaḥ (|) ukta eva | abhāvo na vācya ity anenaivābhāvaśabdena tasyokteḥ | atha pareṇābhāvasya vācyatvaṃ yad ucyate tadanuvādena niṣedhaḥ kriyate (|)
 nābhāvo vācyas tenādoṣa iti cet |
 nanv anuvādepi kim abhāvasya vācyatā na bhavati yenaivam ucyate | tasmād iṣṭasyaivābhāvasya vācyatā | svabhāvo naivāsti tenāsattvād avacanam abhāvasyeti ced āha – athābhāvam evetyādi | tenetyabhāvasyāsattvena | idānīm ity abhāvasyāsattve tadevābhāvo nāstīti vacanaṃ kathaṃ | abhāvo nāstīty asyaivābhāvaśabdasya prayogo na syāt (|) kathañ ca na syād abhāvasyaivānabhyupagamāt | abhāvo hy asya vācyaḥ sa ca nābhyupagamyate | paraparikalpitasyābhāvasya pratiṣedha iti ced iṣṭas tāvad abhāvaviṣayaḥ śabdaḥ | tasmāt kathaṃcid abhāvavyavahāraṃ pravarttayatā 'vaśyam abhāvaviṣayā jñānaśabdā eṣṭavyāḥ |
 yat punar etad uktam (|) arthaniṣedhe satyan arthakaśabdāprayogāt kāraṇān nirviṣayasya nañoprayoga ity atrottaram vakṣyate |
 "anādivāsanāsanodbhūtavikalpapariniṣṭhata" (1|207) ityādinā |
 tasmād ity upasaṃhāraḥ | iyatā ca granthena yad uktan teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyam iti tad evācāryeṇa samarthitaṃ |
 atra paraḥ prāha – yady abhāveṣv api śabdās santi teṣv abhāveṣu kathaṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ śabdapravattihetur ynāpohaviṣayatvam abhāvapratipādakānāṃ syāt |
 (p.347) atrottaram āhācāryaḥ | tatrāpītyādi | rūpābhāvād iti svarūpābhāvād abhāvasya | rūpābhidhāyinaḥ svabhāvagrāhakāḥ śabdā nāśaṃkyā eva | yatas te śabdā abhāvaviṣayā vyavacchedasyānyāpohasya vācakāḥ siddhā eva |
