 etad uktam bhavati (|) abhāvaviṣayāṇāṃ śabdānāṃ bhāvasvarūpāgrāhakatvād apohaviṣayatvan tathā bhāvaviṣayāṇām api śābdānām bhāvasvarūpāgrāhakatvād apohaviṣayatvam eva (|) kevalaṃ kecic chabdā bhāvādhyavasāyād bhāvaviṣayāḥ kecidabhāvādhyavasāyād abhāvaviṣayā ucyante | vastuni vṛttir vyāpāro yeṣāṃ śabdānān teṣāṃ kiṃ rūpam abhidheyaṃ vidhirūpeṇa vastugrāhyamāhosvid bhedo 'nyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvodhyavasīyata iti śaṅkā syāt | abhāvas tu vivekalakṣaṇa iti svabhāvavirahalakṣaṇaḥ kasmān nimittīkarttavyasya rūpasya vastusvabhāvasya | tadbhāve tasya rūpasya sattayā hy abhāvayogāt | tasya rūpasya bhāvas tadbhāvaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇe yasya bhāvasya sa tathoktaḥ | ayam eva sa mukhyo vivekonyāpohaḥ | anyas tu gavādiśabdaviṣayopohanimittatvād apoha ity upacaritaḥ sarvabhāvavirahalakṣaṇaḥ | tasya vivekasya tathābhāvakhyāpina iti vivekarūpābhidhāyinaḥ || vivekaviṣayā ity anyāpohaviṣayā vikalpāś ca vivekaviṣayā iti sambandhaḥ | te śabdā vikalpāś ca | ekaṃ vyāvṛttisamāśrayabhūtam vastu | pratisa(?śa)raṇam adhiṣṭhānaṃ yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ vikalpānāñ ca | te tathoktāḥ | tathā hy akṛtakavyavacchedena yad eva kṛtakaśabdasya vikalpasya vādhiṣṭhānan tad evānityānātmādiśabdānām vikalpānāṃ ca | te tathābhūtā api bhinnaviṣayā eveti sambandhaḥ | kasmād yathāsvam ityādi | yā vyāvṛttir yato vyavasthāpyate sā tasyā avadhiḥ | yathā kṛtakākhyasya vyavacchedasyākṛtakaḥ | evam anityatvalakṣaṇasya vyavacchedasya nitya ityādi | teṣāṃ yathāsvam avadhīnāṃ bhedās tair bhedair upakalpitā racitā anityatvādīnāṃ (p.348) vivekināṃ bhedāḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣāḥ | tair bhedair bhinneṣv iva vikalpabuddhau pratibhātsu pratibhāsamāneṣu dharmiṣu | teṣāṃ śabdānām vivekeṣu bhedeṣu vikalpānāṃ copasthāpanāt | yathākramaṃ vacakatvena grāhakatvena copaśleṣāt |
nanu ca kṛtakānityatvayor naivāvadhibhedo 'sti, akṛtakasyeva nityarūpatvāt. tataś ca pratijñārthaikadeśa eva hetuḥ. naiṣa doṣaḥ. yasmād? akṛtakasyāpi prāgbhāvasyānityatvāt. kṛtakatvāpi pradhvaṃsābhāvasya nityatvād asty evāvadhibhedaḥ | yad vā kāraṇena kṛtaḥ śabdo na bhavatīty asya samāropasya vyavacchedena kṛtako dvitīyādikṣaṇe sthāyitvasamāropavyavacchedenānitya ity ucyata ity asyevāvadhibhedaḥ | teneti yathoktena vyāvṛttibhedena svabhāvahetau svabhāvasyaiva sādhyasādhanabhāvepi na sādhyāsādhanayoḥ saṃsarga ekatvaṃ | tataś ca yad uktaṃ svabhāvo sādhye pratijñārthaikadeśo hetuḥ syād iti sa doṣo nāstīty āha – tan neti. tad iti tasmād. sa cāyaṃ svabhāva iti sambandhaḥ. svabhāva ity avyatirikto dharmaḥ. sa kadācit sattvam anyo vā | yady api sattvam asti satsu ca kṛtakatvan tathāpi hetukṛtoyaṃ svabhāva ity etāvanmātravivākṣāyāṃ kṛtako hetur ucyate | na tu sāmarthyavivakṣāyām, prameyatvādivat. sāmarthyam asty etāvanmātravivakṣāyāñ ca sattvaṃ hetur ucyate tena tu hetukṛtatvavivakṣāyāṃ | (187-88)

 tena yad ucyate – kṛtake sattvaṃ vidyate na tasyānityatve vyabhicārosti (|) tatkim ity upādhibhedena viśeṣyata iti tadapāstaṃ | kṛtakatvādau sāmarthyasyāvivakṣitatvād iti | hetutvenāpadiśyamāna ucyamānaḥ | upādhibhedāpekṣo viśeṣaṇabhedāpekṣaḥ | kevalo vety upādhyanapekṣaḥ | sādhyasiddhyartham ucyate | anityatve sādhye kṛtakatvam upādhibhedopekṣan tadanapekṣan tu sattvaṃ | apekṣatetyādinopādhibhedāpekṣatvaṃ kṛtakatvasyāha – parasyāhetvabhimatasya jananaśaktir eva vyāpāraḥ | anvayavyatirekānuvidhānam eva cāpekṣā | svabhāvaniṣpattau svabhāvaniṣpattinimittam apekṣitaḥ paravyāpāro yena bhāvena sa kṛtakaḥ | saṃjñāyāṃ kano vidhānāt saṃjñāśabdoyaṃ kṛtaka iti | yata (p.349) evaṃ teneyaṃ kṛtakaśrutiḥ svabhāvābhidhāyiny api satī paropādhim atyantaviśeṣaṇamena svabhāvam ākṣipati | eteneti kṛtakatvasyopadhibhedāpekṣatvapratipādanena | pratyayānāṃ kāraṇanāmbhedas tena bhettuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathoktas tadabhāvas tattvaṃ | tathānakaraṇādibhedād bhidyate śabdaḥ | ādiśabdāt prayatnānantarīyakatvādayo vyākhyātāḥ |
evam ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | kvacit prayoge upādhibhedaṃ pratyanapekṣaḥ | ata evāha – sāmānyena anitya eva sādhye yathā sattvaṃ | svabhāvabhūtaś cāsau dharmaś ca tasya parigraheṇa kvacitsvabhāvo hetur ucyate iti prakṛtaṃ | yathā tatraivety anityatve sādhya utpattiḥ | na cotpattir utpattim atonyābhāvasyājanyatvenotpattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt | kevalam arthāntarabhūtevakalpitāviśeṣaṇatvena tenotpatter ity utpattimatvād ity arthaḥ | ayam upādhyapekṣa eva svabhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ | kṛtakatvādau parabhūta upādhirahitatvātmabhūta eva dharmaviśeṣa ity etāvān viśeṣaḥ |
 anayā diśeti | upādhyapekṣānapekṣahetupravibhāgādiśā | (189)
 yadi sattvākhyaḥ svabhāvo hetuḥ sattvam iti yāvat | pradhānādisattā kathaṃ na sādhyate | atha sattā sāmānye sādhye siddhasādhyatā syād ataḥ sattaviśeṣas sādhyas tasmiṃś ca sādhye viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhyaśunyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syād ato na sattā sādhyate | tadā hetāv api sattve viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhanaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt | tadāha (|) ananvayo hītyādi | bhedānām viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāhato duṣṭo hetusādhyayoḥ | hetau sādhye cety arthaḥ | anyatra cety anātmādau | tad iti sattvaṃ | kilaśabdonabhimatārthe eva prasādhyamānam iti | (189-90)
 asti pradhānam ityādinā pradhānalakṣaṇayogena viśeṣībhavati na ca viśeṣaḥ (p.350) sādhayituṃ śakyate tasyānanvayāt | yathā 'hetyācārya dignāgaḥ | "asti pradhānam ity anena pradhānasvalakṣaṇam eva sādhyata" iti yat sānkhye  noktaṃ tatpramāṇasyānumānasya viṣayājñānāt sāmānyaviṣayaṃ hy anumānaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ | vyāhanyate duṣyati | kintarhi (|) hetāv api tulyadoṣatvāt | tadevāha (|) na hi hetur ityādi | na vidyate 'nvayosyetyananvayaḥ siddheḥ sādhyasādhanasya nāṅgam | kuta ity asādhāraṇāddhetoḥ | bhāvaḥ satto sa(ā) upādānam iva śeṣaṇaṃ yasya dharmiṇastanmātre | tanmātratvādeva sāmānyarūpe dharmiṇi sādhye | sāṃkhyasya na kaścid arthaḥ siddhaḥ syāt | traiguṇyādilakṣaṇasyāsiddheḥ | aniṣiddhañ ca tādṛśaṃ | tādṛśam iti sāmānyamātraṃ | anena siddhasādhyatām āha – (190-91)
 na sarvathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sattāsādhana iti sattāsiddhau | bhāvamātraviśeṣaṇa iti sattāmātraviśeṣaṇaḥ | anirdiṣṭaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | neheti vastumātrasādhane | sattāsādhanapratiṣedhaḥ | kintu sa vādī tathā sāmānye nāsti kaścid iti kañcanāsya dharmiṇo bhedaṃ viśeṣaṃ nityatvādikamaparāmṛśannasaṃspṛśan | aneneti vādinā | apāttabheda ity upāttaviśeṣaḥ | triguṇātmako nitya ityādi nopāttabhede sādhyesmin pradhānādike dharmiṇi | bhaveddheturananvayaḥ | nāsya sādhyadharmaviśeṣaṇadṛṣṭāntenvayostītyananvayaḥ | yata evaṃ (|)
 sattāyāntena sādhyāyāmviśeṣaḥ sādhito bhavet |
 anye tu sattāyāmityādi paścād dharmādau vyākhyāya | pūrvārddhamupāttabhedam ityādi paścād vyācakṣate |
 (p.351) sa hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | eko mūlaprakṛterbhedābhāvāt | nityo niranvayavināśābhāvāt | triguṇatvātmakatvāt sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaḥ | anyo veti karttṛtvādiyuktaḥ | yathākathaṃcidapīti | yathoktairddharmaiḥ samastair vyatair vā viśeṣitaḥ | tatsvabhāva iti yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasvabhāvaḥ (|) sa ca dharmī tatheti viśiṣṭena svabhāvena nānveti sapakṣe | tathā bhūtasya dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇosiddheḥ | na tena siddheneti sattāmātreṇa | sattāmātre vivādābhāvāt | (191-92)
 nanvityādi paraḥ | evaṃ prasaṅga iti yaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavikalpena sattāyām uktaḥ | taduktaṃ (|)
 "viśeṣānugamābhāvaḥ sāmānye siddhasādhyate"ti |
 yasmāt tatrāpy agnyādiṣu sādhyeṣu nāgnisāttāyāṃ kaścidvivādostyagnimātrasya siddhatvāt | na ca tena siddhena kiñcit tasyāpravṛttyaṅgatvāt | deśādiviśiṣṭo hy agniḥ pravṛttyaṅgaṃ nāgnimātraṃ | sa eva tarhi sādhya ity āha – viśiṣṭa ādhāro yatrāgnyādikaṃ sādhyate sa viśeṣaṇaṃ yasyāgnyādikasya sa viśiṣṭādhāraviśeṣaṇaṃ (|) tasya | sādhyatvenābhimatasya | sapakṣe 'nanvayādasiddhiḥ |
 netyācāryaḥ | na vai sa ādhāro viśeṣaṇabhāvena gṛhītopi tam agnim viśeṣīkaroti | yenānvayaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tadayoga ityādi | tasya dharmasya tasmin dharmiṇyayogo ya āśaṃkitastasya vyavacchadena viśeṣaṇāt | etac ca pakṣadharma (1|3) ity atroktaṃ | vakṣyate ca caturthe paricchede (4|149) |
 nanu ca vyāptigrahaṇakāle pradeśāyogavyavacchinno vahnirasiddhaḥ | tatsiddhau vā kim arthonvayānugamaḥ | katham (|) asiddho yasmāt | yatra yatra dhūmastatra tatrāgnir iti vyāptiṃ pratiyatā sāmānyenābhimatadeśāyogavyavacchinnopi bahnirākṣipta eva | kevalam idānīm asmin deśe bahnir ity evaṃ viśeṣapratīty artham anvayānugamanam iṣyate |
(p.352)  tasmād ity upasaṃhāraḥ | tatreti pradeśādau | tadayogavyavacchedeneti tasmin pradeśādau dharmiṇi sādhyadharmasyāyogavyavacchedena sāmānyasyāgnimātrasya sādhanāt nāstyanvayadoṣaḥ | nāpi siddhasādhyatā pradeśāyogavyavacchedasyāsiddhatvāt | pradhānādike dharmiṇyayogavyavacchedena sattāmātraṃ sādhyam iti ced āha – na tathetyādi | kvacid iti pradhānādike dharmiṇi | kasmāt (|) pradhānādiśabdavācyasyaivārthasya traiguṇyādilakṣaṇasyaivābhāvāt | nirviśeṣeṇaiva sā sattā | viśeṣaṇabhūtasyādhārasyābhāvāt (|)

tena yad ucyate – pramāṇena cen niyamaḥ prasādhitaḥ, kiṃ niṣphalena nivṛttivacanena? kathaṃ vā niyamaṃ na pratipadyate, na tu tannivṛttau nivṛttim iti tadapāstam.
anye tv anyathā vyācakṣate – prasādhya śabdārthādākṣepavacanastenāyamartho niyamaṃ prasādhya niyamamarthādākṣipya nivṛttir vaktavyeti. tathābhūtena vacanena nivṛttir vaktavyā. nivṛttyuktiḥ sāmarthyād niyamamākṣipatīti. ata evāha – sā cetyādi. seti niyamasyākṣepikā nivṛttiḥ sidhyati param prati. yadi tathābhūtena vacanena prakāśate, tadātmaniyamaṃ (p.360) sādhyātmaniyamam arthād uktisāmarthyād ākṣipati. iti hetoḥ siddho 'nvayaḥ.
katham ityādi paraḥ. idānīm iti niścite vyāpy avyāpakabhāve gamako hetur ity abhyupagame satīty arthaḥ. kathaṃ kena pramāṇena kṛtako 'vaśyam anitya iti pratyetavyo niścetavyaḥ, yena tvayaivam ucyate? kṛtakaḥ śabdo 'nityaḥ. yat kṛtakam, tad anityam ity evaṃ pṛṣṭo vyāptiviṣayaṃ bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ darśayitum āha – yasmād ityādi. 
 HYPERLINK "..\\Dharmakirti\\PVSV_kra.DOC" \l "PV_I_195cd" PVSV 98,6 yasmād vināśasya nivṛttidharmakatvalakṣaṇasya svabhāvāt svarūpamātrād anubandhitā yad vā bhavaty asmād iti bhāvaḥ svo bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ svahetur ity arthaḥ, tasmād evānubandhitā vināśasya vastuni sadbhāvaḥ, tasmāt kṛtako 'nityaḥ. kuta eva? tadahetutvāt. yato na janakād dhetor anyo vināśasya hetuḥ, tasmāt svabhāvād anubandhaḥ.
tad ayam atra samudāyārthaḥ – mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ dvayaṃ pratīyate ghaṭanivṛttiḥ kapālaṃ ca. tathaite vināśarūpatayā pratīyete. tatra ghaṭanivṛtter nīrūpatvenākāryatvād iti vakṣyati | tatkāryatvena tu pratītibhrāntir eva | kāryatve vāsyā na ghaṭanivṛttirūpatvaṃ syāt | ghaṭasambandhitvena kṛtakatvāt | vināśarūpatayā ca na pratītiḥ syāt ghaṭasya sattvāt | kapālasyāpi mudgarakāryatve saty api vināśarūpatā | ghaṭasyānivṛttatvād iti ca vakṣyati | tataś ca kathamasya vināśarūpatayā pratītiḥ | nirhetuke tu vināśe svarasato nivartamāna eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakārī kapālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānārambhakatvāt mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ ghaṭanivṛtteḥ kapālasya ca sadbhāvāttayor vināśarūpatayā vināśasya ca sahetukatvena mandamatīnāmavasāyo yujyata eva |
 mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ santānavicchedāt | tatkathaṃ nirhetukavināśābhyupagamavādināṃ pratītibādhā codyata iti | etam evārtham āha – na hītyādi | naśyanta iti yeṣān tāvat kṛtakānāṃ nāśo dṛśyate te vinaśyantaḥ | tadbhāve vinaśvarasvabhāve svarūpajanakādanyatra hetum apekṣate | kutaḥ | svahetor eva vinaśvarāṇāṃ nivṛttidharmāṇāṃ bhāvāt | yataś ca naśvarasvabhāvaṃ pratyanapekṣatā bhāvānāntasmād yaḥ kaścid kṛtakaḥ sa svabhāvenaiva naśvaraḥ | (195-96)
(p.361)  yadi sahetuko vināśastadāvaśyaṃbhāvī na syād ity āha – sāpekṣāṇām ityādi | hīti yasmāt (|) sāpekṣāṇāmbhāvānāṃ nāvaśyambhāvitā (|) tasmāt nirapekṣobhāvo vināśe vinaśvare svabhāvo hetusāpekṣatve hi ghatādīnāmmadhye keṣāñcin nityatāpi syāt | yeśāṃ nāśakāraṇamasannihitaṃ | bāhulyād vināśakāraṇānāṃ na kvacid asannidhānam iti ced āha – yenetyādi | taddhetor iti vināśahetosteṣām api vināśakāraṇānāṃ nāvaśyaṃ sannidhānam iti sambandhaḥ | kasmāt (|) svapratyayādhīnasannidhitvāt svakāraṇāyatasannidhitvāt | na ca vināśakāraṇāntaṃ kāraṇāni sarvatra sannihitāni | tataś ca vināśahetor asannidhānāt kaścin na naśyed api | saty api vināśahetusannidhāne na niyato vināśaḥ (|) yato na hyavaśyaṃ hetavaḥ phalavantaḥ vināśākhyakāryavantaḥ | kasmāt (|)sahakāryasannidhānaṃ vaikalyaṃ | viruddhopanipātaḥ pratibandhaḥ | etena sāpekṣasya nāvaśyambhāvitvena vyabhicāritvam uktaṃ | (195-96)
 sarveṣāṃ nāśahetūnāṃ nāśasya liṅgatvena ye hetava upādīyante teṣāṃ | kasmāt (|) kāryāvyavasthiteḥ | nāśalakṣaṇakāryātpattiniyamābhāvāt | hetumannāśavādināṃ hetumantannāśaṃ ye vadanti teṣāṃ | yataś cāhetuko vināśaḥ | tattasmād yambhāvaḥ kṛtakonapekṣastadbhāvamprati vinaśvarasvabhāvamprati | tadbhāvaniyato nivṛttidharmakatāyāṃ nitataḥ | dṛśṭāntam āha (|) asambhavetyādi | na sambhavati pratibaddho yasyāṃ sā kāraṇasāmagrī | sakaleti sahakāripratyayena santānapariṇāmena ca paripūrṇṇety arthaḥ | prayogastu | ye yadbhāvaṃ pratyanaprkṣāste tadabhāvaniyatāḥ | tadyathā (p.362) 'sambhavatpratibandhā kāraṇasāmagrī kāryotpādane | anyānapekṣaś ca kṛtako bhāvo vināśa iti svabhāvahetuḥ | (196-97)
 nanvityādinā naikāntikatvamāśaṃkate | kvacit kārye 'napekṣāṇām api keṣāṃcit kāraṇānāṃ nāvaśyantadbhāva ity āha – bhūmītyādi | sā hi kāryajanane 'pekṣāsāmagrī | tasyāmasatyām api kadādit pratibandhakāle 'ṅkurānutpatteḥ | etac ca santānasyaikatvamadhyavasāyoktaṃ |
 netyādinā parijharati | tatra yathoktāyāṃ sāmagryāṃ santānasya pariṇāmaṃ svabhāvāntarotpattilakṣaṇastatra sāpekṣatvāt | tato 'naprkṣatvādityasya hetostatrāvṛttiḥ | kṛtakasyāpy asti vināśaṃ prati kālāntarāpekṣā tato heturasiddha ity āha – naivamityādi | kṛtakasya bhāvasya nāśe kācit kālāntarāpekṣeti vakṣyati |
 syādetad (|) ekasvabhāvā eva bhūmibījādayaḥ kutas teṣāṃ santānapariṇāmāpekṣatvaṃ (|) ato vyābhicāra eva hetor ity āha – tatrāpītyādi |
 etaduktambhavati | na bhūmibījādaya ekasvabhāvāḥ paścādiva prāgapi kāryotpādanaprasaṅgāt | kintūttarottarapariṇāmena bhinnāḥ | tatreti tasyāṃ santānapariṇāmena bhinnāyāṃ sāmagryāmantyā yā sāmagrī | kāryotpādane lakṣaṇāntareṇāvyavahitā sā phalavatyeveti kuto hetoranaikāntikatvaṃ |
 syādetat (|) pūrvā sāmagrī janikāpi satī na niyatety āha – saivetyantyā sāmagrī tatra tāsu madhye 'ṅkurahetur nānyā kācit | kim arthantarhyaṅkurārthibhiḥ pūrvā sāmagryupādīyata ity āha – anyāstvityādi | pūrvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pūrvovasthāviśeṣastad arthaevāṅkurajananasamarthāntyasāmagryartha eva | tenārthibhir upādīyate sāmagrī rūpatayā cādhyavasīyate |
 syād etad (|) antyāyā api sāmagryāḥ pratibandhaḥ sambhavati | tena kāryotpādaniyamābhāvāt sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭānta ity āha na cetyādi | tāmantyāṃ (p.363) sāmagrīntatra kārye janye | ekatra bhāva ityantye kṣaṇe | vikārasyotpattau vā tasyāntyasya kṣaṇasyaikatvahāneḥ pūrvasya pracyutervikārākhyasya ca dvitīyasyotpatteḥ | tataś ca nāsāvantyaḥ syāt |
 atha na tasyāntyasya janakasvabhāvāt pracyutiriṣyate | tadā tadātmano janakātmanaḥ | svabhāvād apracyutasya tadutpādanaṃ kāryotpādanaṃ prati vaiguṇyamakurvāṇasya pratibandhahetor apratibandhakatvād vighātakaraṇāt |
 punarapi vyabhicāramāśaṃkate | yavabījādayo na sāpekṣāḥ (|) kasmin (|) śālyaṅkure kārye janye | kasmāt (|) tadutpattipratyayānāṃ kadācit tatrāpi yavabījādau sannidhānāt | te nirapekṣā api na śālyaṃkuraṃ janayantītyanaikāntika eveti |
 katham iti siddhāntavādī | sāpekṣā evety arthaḥ | eṣām iti yavabījādīnāṃ śālibījasya yastadutpādanaḥ śālyaṅkurotpādanaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa evaiṣāṃ nāstītisambandhaḥ | tatsvabhāvāpekṣā iti śālyaṃkurotpādanasvabhāvāpekṣāḥ |
 kadā ca kathaṃ nirapekṣatvaṃ syādevantarhīti paraḥ | kṛtakānāṃ ca keṣāṃcit satāmvā keṣāṃcit | sa eva svabhāvo nāsti yo naśvaraḥ | tasmāt tatsvabhāvāpekṣatvād vinaśvarasvabhāvāpekṣatvān na vinaśvarā ity asiddhatvaṃ hetor iti |
 etannirākarttumprakramate | śālibījetyādi | ādiśbdād yavabījādīnāṃ | sa svabhāva ity abhimatetarakārya jananājananasvabhāvaḥ svahetor iti kṛtvā | yo yavabījādir na taddhetuḥ | sa śālibījahetur yasya hetur nabhavatīty arthaṃḥ | so 'tatsvabhāva ityaśālyaṃkurajananasvabhāvaḥ |
 nanvataddhetuś ca syāt tatsvabhāvaś cety āha – niyataśaktiś cetyādi | niyatā pratiniyatā śaktir yasya sa tathā (|) sa hetur iti śāliyavabījajananasvabhāvaḥ | svarūpeṇa vibhaktenaiva svabhāvena pratītaḥ pratyakṣataḥ |
(p.364)  syād etat (|) na hetukṛtaḥ svabhāvabhedo bhāvānāṃ kin tu svabhāva eva kasyacit (|) tādṛśasvabhavāvo 'nyasya cānyādṛśa ity āha (|) na cetyādi | ākasmika iti nirhetukaḥ | anpekṣasyāhetoḥ kvacid deśe kvacitkāle | kvacic ca śālibījādau dravye śālyaṃkurotpādanasya svabhāvasya niyamo na syāt | kin tu sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra bhavedapekṣābhāvāt | tasmād deśādikam apekṣya bhavan niyamo hetumān iti gamyate | yathā śālibījādīnāṃ svabhāvaniyamas tathātrāpi kṛtakeṣu, satsu vā niyamaheturvaktavyo yato niyāmakāddhetoḥ kṛtakās santo vā kecin naśvarātmāno jātā nānye |
 syād etad (|) yadi nāma niyāmako hetur na śakyate darśayitun tathāpi sambhāvyata ity āha – na cātraloke naśvarasya svabhāvasya niyāmako hetur asti | na sambhāvyata eveti yāvat | sarveṣāṃ janmavatāṃ nāśasya siddher dṛṣṭatvāt | aniyatahetuho vināśa iti yāvat |
 yadi sarvajanmināṃ vināśasiddher evān tarhi sattvād iti hetur anaikāntikaḥ syāt tad āha – janmītyādi | janmavatām eva svabhāvo nāśī nājanmavatāṃ | nākāśādīnāṃ satām apīti paro manyate | ācārya āha – na vai janmeti | na hi janmavaśād bhāvasya svabhāva utpadyate | tasmān na janma nāśasya hetuḥ | nāpy ākāśādau sattvam astīty āha – na cetyādi | ahetor ākāśādeḥ svabhāvaniyamaḥ svarūpaniyamo 'hetor deśakālaprakṛtiniyamāyogāt | yataś ca sarvajanmināṃ vināśasiddhir ākāśādīnāṃ cāsattvaṃ | tasmān nātra kṛtakeṣu satsu vā hetor naśvarānaśvarajanakatvena svabhāvapravibhāgaḥ | tadbhāvād dhetupravibhāgābhāvāt phalasya kṛtakasya sato vā naśvarānaśvarapravibhāgo nāstīty asamānaṃyababījādinā | seyamivanāśasya nirapekṣatā kvacid vastuni | kadācit kāle vināśasya yo bhāvas tena virodhinī karoti tadabhāvaṃ | tasya kvacit (p.365) kadācic ca vināśasyābhāvaṃ svabhāvena sattayā sādhayati | sarvatra sarvakālam bhāvaṃ sādhayatīti yāvat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yo hītyādi | tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti yasmin kāle bhavati yatra vā dravye | taṃ kālaṃ dravyañcāpekṣata iti nirapekṣa eva na syād ity uktaṃ prāk |
 nanu vināśakahetuvanapekṣatvena vināśasyānapekṣatvaṃ, na tu kālādyanapekṣatvena (|) tat katham ucyate | tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti nirapekṣa eva vināśo na syād iti | yadi ca kālānapekṣo vināśaḥ dvitīyepi kṣaṇe vināśo na syāt tatkālāpekṣatvāt | dravyānapekṣatve ca kasya tarhi vināśaḥ syāt |
 evam manyate (|) jātasya tadbhāve 'anyonapekṣaṇād iti vacanāt | dvitīya eva kṣaṇe vināśo bhavati nānyasmin kṣaṇe | tathā srvasya jātasya bhavati na dravyaviśeṣasya tena dravyā'napekṣatve kasya tarhi vināśo bhavatu (|)
 iti nirastaṃ | kālāntare dravyaviśeṣe ca nāśasya bhave kālāntarasya dravyaviśeṣasya ca vināśakatvem eva syāt | vināśasya tadbhava eva bhāvāt | tasmāt tatkāladravyāpekṣatve nirapekṣa eva na syād ity ucyate |
 tarhīti paraḥ | netyācāryaḥ | sattāyā yo hetur bhāvas tasmād eva tathotpatter naśvarasvabhāvasyotpatteḥ | etad eva spaṣṭayati | sato hi bhvata iti sattāṃ pratipadyamānasya tādṛśasyaiva naśvarasvabhāvasyaiva (|) bhāvāt | nāvśyaṃ sataḥ padārthasya kutaś cit kāraṇād bhāva utpādna iti cet | kecid dhi santopi notpattim anyo yathākāśādaya iti paro manyate | ākasminkīty ahetukā | neyaṃ sattā kasyacid arthasya kadācit kāle kvacid dravye viram eta |
 nanu ca ghaṭādīnāṃ svahetutaḥ sattāniyame katham ākāśādisattāprasaṅgaḥ |
 sattyaṃ (|) kin tu na kasyacid virametety asyāyam arthaḥ | na sa kaścid bhāvo yatsvabhāvosāvākāśādir na syāt sarvātmakaḥ prasajyata ity eke tad ayuktaṃ (|) yadi hi ghaṭādirūpamākāśe syād ahetukaṃ syāt tasya mṛtpiṇḍādikam antareṇa bhāvāt | asmān neyamākāśādes sattā | kasyacid ātmādeḥ kadācit kāle kvacid deśe (p.366) virameta | deśakāladravyaniyatā na bheved ity arthaḥ |
 etad eva draḍhayan nāha – taddhītyādi | taddhi vastu | kiṃcid upalīyetāśrayet | yasya yatra kiṃcid utpādādikaṃ pratibaddhamāyattaṃ | na copalīyeta yasya yatrāpratibaddhaṃ | seyaṃ sattā kvacid apratibandhinī cet | dravyakālāpekṣayā na niyamavatī syāt | tathā cākāśasyeyaṃ sattā nātmamanaḥ | ātmanas sattā na kālasyetyādi na syāt | yataś caivantasmān neyaṃ sattākasmikī kvacin nityābhimateṣv api |
 yadi sattāhetor eva vinaśvarasyotpādaḥ katham idānīm ahetuko vināśa ukta iti vyāghātam āha –
 jātasyetyādinā pariharati | jātasya niṣpannasya tadbhāve vinaśvaratābhāve janakāddhetor anyasyānapekṣaṇāt |
 ahetuko vināśa uktaḥ | uktaṃ cātra prāk yathā na vināśo nāmānya eva kaścid bhāvāt kin tu bhāva eva hi nāśaḥ |
 nanu ca pradhvaṃsābhāvo nāśaḥ sa katham bhāvasvabhāvo bhavatīy āha –
 sa eva hītyādi | yasmāt svabhetor eva kṣaṇasthāyī jātas tasmād bhāva eva nāśa uktaḥ | ya eva sattākālo bhāvasya tam evaikaṃ kṣaṇsaṃ sthātuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathā | na punar utpadya kṣaṇam api tiṣṭhati | yadi tiṣṭhen na vivartteteti vakṣyāmaḥ | yady ekakṣaṇasthāyī bhāvo vināśaḥ kasmāt pravāhavicchedāt prāg api tathā na niścīyate 'niścayāc cākṣaṇikaḥ sa ity āha – tam asyetyādi | taṃ nāsvabhāvam asya ghaṭāder āsaṃsāramavidyānubandhāt madā urdhvaṃ pravāhavicchedakāle vyavasyanti na prāk sattākāle | darśnepīti naśvarasvabhāvasya saty api darśane | na darśanakāle 'dhyavasāyo 'sti | avidyā(sāma)rthyātsadṛśāparotpattyā ca darśanapāṭavasyābhāvāt | yataś ca santānavicchedakāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayas tasmāt tadvaśena niścayavaśena (p.367) | paścād iti yasmin kāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayas tatkālopādhir eva sa bhāvasya vināśasvabhāvo vyavasthāpyate (|) dṛṣṭāntam āha – vikāretyādi | yathā viṣadravyaṃ guhītam api bhrāntisadbhāvāt prāg anavadhāritam ajñaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paścād viṣakṛtasya vikārasya lālāsrutyāder darśanena viṣaṃ vyavasthāpyate tavat | etāvan mātreṇāyaṃ dṛṣṭānto na tu māraṇaśaktir gṛhītā paścād avdhāryata iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tad iti tasmād ayam iva nāśa iti sambandhaḥ | vatuno yā sattā tadvayatirekeṇa na kiṃcid vināśakāraṇam apekṣata iti tadvyāpī sattāvyāpī |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | asāmarthyāc ceti prativacanaṃ | tadhetor iti nāśahetoḥ | cakārādakārakatvāc ca | etad eva vivṛṇvann āha – abhāvakāriṇa ity abhāvakāritayābhimatasya kriyāyāḥ kārakatvasya pratiṣedhāc ceti | avastukārī yobhimataḥ sokāraka eva bhavati | asāmarthyan darśayitum āha – siddhe hītyādi | nāśahetur bhāvād abhinnam vā vināśaṃ kuryāt tatonyam vā | na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhe hi bhāve kārako nāśahetus tam bhāvaṃ na karoti siddhatvād eva | nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | yato nāpy anyakriyān tasya bhāvasya na kiñcit | tadavastuatvāt | tadatadrūpetyādi | bhāvarūpasya tato 'nyasya ca vināśasya kāraṇāc cākiñcitkaro vināśahetur ato nāpekṣyata iti siddham asāmarthyaṃ |
 kriyāpratiṣedhas tu katham ity āha – vināśa iti hi bhāvasyābhāvante hetuman nāśavādino mayante | asmābhir bhāvasvabhāva eva vināśa ity uktaṃ | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ vināśahetur vināśaṃ karoty abhāvaṃ karotīti prāptaṃ | tatraitasmin prāpte sati yady abhāvo nāma kaścit svabhāvaḥ kāryaḥ syāt | tadā kāryatvād aṃkurādivat sa eva bhāva iti nābhāvaḥ syāt | atha yathā ghaṭo ghaṭarūpeṇa kāryaḥ paṭaś ca paṭarūpeṇa kāryo na tu kāryatvād ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati | tathā bhāvo bhāvarūpeṇa kāryo 'bhāvopyabhāvarūpeṇa kāryaḥ syāt | na tu bhāva eva bhavatīti | tad ayuktam bhavatyīti hi bhāvo na bhvatīti (p.368) cābhāvas tenābhāvo bhāvavirodhī | na cābhāvarūpatayā tasyā pratibhāvasanādabhāvarūpatā | bhavanadharmatvenābhāvarūpatayā pratibhāsa eva na syād itīdam eva codyate | na ca parasparaviviktarūpatayā'bhāvānaṃ pratibhāsaḥ | yataś cābhāvasya nīrūpatvādakāryatvan tasmād abhāvaṃ karotīti bhāvaṃ na karotīti vākyārthaḥ syāt | tena kriyāpratiṣedhosya nāśahetoḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | tathāpi kriyāpratiṣedhepy ayaṃ vināśahetur akiñcitkaraḥ | kin iti nāśe'pekṣyate bhāveneti siddhā vināśaṃ pratyanapekṣā bhāvasya |
 nanu nirhetukepi vināśe katham iva nāsaṃ pratyanepekṣā bhāvasya | svabhāvo hi sa tasyetthaṃ yenāpekṣya nivartate virodhinaṃ (|) yathā'nyeṣāṃ pravāho mudgarādikaṃ | tena pūrvam iva rodhino'bhāve nānivṛtteḥ kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti |
 tad ayuktaṃ | yato virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvaṃ yadi vastuno na pūrvam api tadāsya pūrvottararūpayor bhedād nityatvam eva atha pūrvam api sa svabhāvo 'sti tadā pūrvam apy asya nivṛttiḥ syāt | atha tadā virodhyabhāvān na nivartate | kathan tarhi virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvaṃ | saty eva virodhini | virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvasya bhāvān nānyadā | yadi virodhī vastuno nopakārakaḥ kathan tan tadapekṣate | upakāre vā virodhisannidhānepy aparasya bhāvasyotpattir iti pūrvako bhāvas tadavstho dṛśyata | virodhe sannidhānābhāvenānivṛtteḥ | atha nivartate | na tarhi virodhyapekṣayā bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ (|) yadi ca na bhāvam ivanāśayati katham ivarodhī | na ca kṣaṇikavādināṃ virodhisannidhāne sattā no nivartate | kin tarhi notpadyate | tathā hi nirodham upagacchann eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakāryapekṣaḥ papālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānāram bhako bhavatīti santānān utpattir na tu virodhinam apekṣya pravāho nivartate | yataś ca pūrvaṃ santānenotpitsorbhāvasya virodhisannidhāne santānān utpattir ata eva mandamatīnāṃ sahetukanāśādhyavasāyo mudgarādau ca virodhitvāvasāya iti sarvaṃ susthaṃ | tasmān nirapekṣatvād eva yatra nāma kvacid bhavaddṛṣṭo vināśas tatraiṣa svabhāvata eva bhavati |
 nanv ahetukepi nāśe yadaiva ghaṭāder nāśaḥ pratīyate tadaivāhetukaḥ syān na pūrvam apratīter athaikakṣaṇasthāyitvena ghaṭāder utpateḥ pūrvam api nāśaḥ (|) nanu yathaikakṣaṇasthāyitve notpattiḥ svahetubhyas tathā 'nekakṣaṇasthāyitvenāpy utpattiḥ syāt | vicitraśaktayo hi sāmagryo dṛśyante | tatra kācit syād api yā'naśvarātmānaṃ janayed ity āha – (p.369)  asmād ityādi | asmāc ca svabhāvamātrabhāvād anyatrāpi deśādivyavadhānenadṛṣṭe | tathā dṛṣṭe (|) virodhi sannidhānāt pūram api svabhāvata eva vināśo bhavati |
 evam manyate | yeṣān tāvad vināśo dṛśyate teṣāṃ yadi na pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśaḥ syāt tadā vināśapratītir eva na syāt | tathā hi yadi dvitīye kṣaṇe bhāvasya sthitis tadāsau sarvadaiva tiṣṭhet | dvitīyepi kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyī svabhāvatvāt | tadā ca tenāparakṣaṇadvayaṃ sthātavyaṃ | aparasminn api kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyisvabhāvatvād aparasmin kṣaṇe'vasthānaṃ syād evam uttarottare kṣaṇe draṣṭavyam ity āsaṃsāram bhāvasya sthitiḥ syāt |
 atha prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasya kṣaṇadvayasthāyī svabhāvo svabhāvo dvitīye kjṣaṇa ekakṣaṇasthāyī | tathāpi tayoḥ svabhāvayor bhedāt kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt | na tv evam api prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasyānekakṣaṇāvasthāyisvabhāvād akṣaṇikatvaṃ syān nāsaṃsāraṃ sthitiprasaṅgād ity uktatvāt |
 nanu dvitīyepi kṣaṇe bhāvasyottarakṣaṇānavasthānepi pūrvakṣaṇasthāyī rūpābhedena pūrvam api sthānāt kṣaṇadvayasthāyitvam asty eveti cet (|)
 na | pūrvam bhāvasya hy eṣa svabhāvo yadekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhaty anayasmin kṣaṇe sthāsyati | sa eva cet svabhāvo dvitīye kṣaṇe tadāpy ekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhaty anyasmin kṣaṇe dvayaṃ sthāsyatīty evam uttarottarakṣaṇepi draṣṭavyam iti na vināśo bhāvasya syāt | dṛśyate ca (|) tasmād vināśapratīty anyathānupapattyā pratikṣaṇavināśānumānaṃ |
 adṛṣṭeṣu tarhi kṛtakeṣu kathaṃ pratikṣaṇavināśitvānumānaṃ vināśasyaivādarśanāt |
 naiṣa doṣo yasmāt teṣām api prathame kṣaṇe ya eva svabhāvaḥ sa eva cet dvitīyādikṣaṇe tadā'bhūtvā bhavanam eva prathamakṣaṇavat | atha prthame kṣaṇe tasya janmeaiva na sthitir dvitīye ca kṣaṇe sthitir eva na janma | evam api kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt | janmajanminoḥ sthitisthitimatoś cābhedāt | na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā shtitir yuktā | janma cen na tadāsthitis tasyā dvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvitvāt | dvitīyādau kṣaṇepy evam iti sarvatrotpattir eva na sthitir iti kṣaṇikatvaṃ | kiṃ ca parasparabhinnasyāparāparakālasambandhitvasya kṛtakād bhāvād abhinnatvāt kṣaṇikatvam eva |
 so 'yam ityādinā kārikārtham āha – ayam iti vināśaḥ | kvacid ghaṭādau mudgarādisannidhāne tathānyatrāpīti mudgarasannidhānāt pūrvam api | evan deśādivyavadhānepi (p.370) | (198-99)
 yatpūrvam upanyastan tatra dvau vastusādhanāv iti tadupasaṃharann āha – tata iti tasmād yā kācid bhāvaviṣayā kāryasvabhāvābhyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ dvidhaivānumitiḥ | kasmāt tayoḥ kāryasvabhāvayor eva svabhādhye sambandhaniyamāt | kāryaṃ liṅgaṃyasyā anumiteḥ | evaṃ svabhāvo liṅgaṃ yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | yathāsvaṃ vyāpini sādhya iti kāryasya kāraṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ sādhyaṃ (|) svabhāvasyāpi svabhāvo vyāpakaḥ sādhyastasmin sādhye liṅgini tayor eva kāryasvabhāvayor liṅgayoḥ pratibandhāt | (198-99)
 anupalabdhim adhikṛtyāha – pravṛtter ityādi | pravṛtteḥ | sanniścayaśabdavyavahāralakṣaṇayoḥ buddhipūrvatvāt pramāṇapūrvatvāt | tadbhāvānupalambhane tasya pravṛttiviṣayasya bhāvasya pratyakṣānumānābhyām anupalambhane prekṣāvatā pravarttitavyaṃ netīyatā leśenādṛśyaviṣayāyā apy anupalabdher uktā pramāṇatā | tṛtīyas tu hetur anupalabdhigamaka ity ucyata iti sambandhaḥ | aviśeṣeṇeti dṛśyaviṣayety amumviśeṣan tyaktvā sāmānyena kvacid arthe sādhye | sanniścayetyādinā tam evārthan darśayati | pramāṇapṛṣṭhabhāvī sad ti vikalpaḥ sanniścayaḥ | tatpṛṣṭhabhāvyeva sad iti dhvaniḥ sacchabdaḥ | tathaiva sadity anuṣṭhānaṃ sadvyavahāraḥ | teṣāṃ pratiṣ4dhe hi sarvaiva dṛśyaviṣayā'dṛśyaviṣayā ca |
 nanu kārikāyāṃ pravṛttir ity uktan tat kathaṃ vṛttau sanniścayetyādi vyākhyāyata ity āha – sanniścayāddhītyādi | yasmāt satāṃ vidyamānānāṃ niścayāc chabdavyavahārāḥ (p.371) pravarttante tasmāt te sanniścayaśabdavyavahārās trayo 'pi pravṛttyaṅgatvāt pruṣapravṛtter nimittatvāt pravṛttir ity uktaḥ | tasmān na sūtravṛttyor vyāghāta iti |
 kim punaḥ kāraṇam upalambhanivṛttau sadvyavahāro nivartate | tathā hy anupalabdhir eva dviprakārāpy aviśeṣeṇāsattvam ity uktaṃ prāk | tac cāsattvam iva prakṛṣṭāyāmanupalabdhau pratipattṛvaśād uktaṃ | pratipattā hy anuplabhyamānan nāstīty adhyavasyati | na vastuvaśāt | tathā hi viprakṛṣṭe 'rthe sattvasamattvañ ca sandigdhaṃ | tasmāt tāvad dhi sa viprakṛṣṭo bhāvosya pratipattyr nāsti yāvad atrāpratipattiḥ | kasmāt (|) satāpi tena viprakṛṣṭenārthenānupalabdhena tadarthākaraṇāt | asya puṃso 'rthākaraṇāt | sannapy asatkalpaḥ | vastutastvanupalabhyamāno na sannāsan | kasmāt (|) satām api kadācit svabhāvādiviprakarṣād anuplambhān nāsattāniścayaḥ | kvāpi sattāniścyas tasyāsyānupalambhasyāsatsv api tulyatvāt | tad iti tasmāt etat sattvam iti sambandhaḥ | kimbhūtam anupalabdhilakṣaṇandeśādiviprakṛṣṭaṃ pratipattuḥ pramāṇābhāvāt | pryakṣānumānābhāvān nivṛttan na vastuvaśāt kiṃ karoti (|) svanimittān śabdavyavahārān nivartayati |
 upalabdhilakṣaṇam ity anye paṭhanti | upalabdhir eva sattvam upacārrāt tathābhūtaṃ sattvaṃ nivṛttam ity arthaḥ |
 yenaivan tena kāraṇena yāpīyam anupalabdhiḥ (|) keṣām (|) anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānāṃ | yā vastutopy asattvarūpā (|) apiśabdāt pratipattṛvaśād api | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) apravṛttiyogyatvād asadvyavahārayogyatvāt | tasyā apy anupalabdher etatsadvyavahārapratiṣedhakatvena tulyaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ | atra viṣaye sadvyavahārapratiṣedhe |
 yeyam anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhir asanniścayaphalāpi sā | asanniścayaḥ (p.372) phalaṃ yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | (200-201)
 asattāyām ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | asattāyām apy aniścayepi yasmān na hy asti sambhavo yadupalabdhiyogyo bhāvaḥ sakaleṣv anyeṣūpalambhakāraṇeu san vidyamāno nopalabhyeta | na punaḥ pūrvā viprakṛṣṭaviṣyānupalabdhir asattāsādhanī | tathā hi (|) pratyakṣāānumānāgamanivṛttilakṣaṇiavānupalabhiḥ | tatra śāstrasyādhikārosmin prakaraṇe tatrāsambaddhā anāntarīyakā bahavorthāḥ svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇaḥ śāste nādhikriyanta iti yāvat | pratyakṣasyāpi na te viṣayā ityāhātīndriyāḥ | nāpy anumānasya yasmād aliṅgāḥ | naiṣāṃ liṅgam astīty aliṅgāḥ | teṣām atīndiryāṇāmarthānāṃ pramāṇatrayānivṛttilakṣaṇāyā anupalabdhitaḥ katham abhāvaḥ (|) naiva | (200-201)
 so 'yam iti vādī | sarvārthānām iti deśakālasvabhāvaviprakarṣiṇāṃ pramāṇatrayanivṛttyeti pratyakṣānumānāgamanivṛttyā | tasyeti śāstrasya kvacit puruṣārthānupayoginy arthe 'nadikāre viniyogābhāve pravṛtteḥ | yasmāc chāstaraṃ hītyādi | anayeti puruṣārthānupayoginamarthamāśśritya śāstarapravṛttau | abaddhapralāpasyāsambaddhābhidhāyinaḥ śāstarasyāprāmāṇyāt |
 syād etat (|) sarva evārthāḥ pruṣārthopayogina ity atrāha – tatretyādi | tatra krakaraṇa iti puruṣārthacintāprastāve | pratyātmaniyatā iti pratipuruṣaniyatāḥ | etena puruṣāṇāmānantyādānantyaṃ cetovṛttīnām āha – aniyatān nimittād bhavatuṃ śīlaṃ yāsām iti vigrahaḥ | anenaikasminn api puṃsi nimittabhedād bahutvaṃ | evaṃ bhūtāś cetovṛttyo nāvaśyaṃ sākalyena pratipadaṃ nirdeśyā aśakyatvāt | kāladeśavyavahitā vā puruṣārthānupayogino dravyaviśeṣā nāvaśyaṃ nirdeśyās tato na tacchastram ivaṣyīkaroti (p.373) | tāś ca cetovṛttayas te ca viśeṣās tān iti puliṅgenoktāḥ | "pumān striye"ti1* puṃsaḥ śeṣaṃ kṛtvā |
fn. 1*: Pāṇini 1.2.67.
 nāpi pratyakṣasya viṣayā ity āha – na cetyādi | tathā viprakṛṣṭeṣv iti deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu svasāmarthyopadhānāt | svarūpasannidhānāt | jñānotpādanaśaktir nāsti | etenātīndriyā ity etad vyākhyātaṃ |
 anumānasyāpi na te viṣayā ity āha – sa cāvaśyam ityādi eṣām iti deśādivyavahitānāṃ | yeneti kāryopalambhena | nacata iti viprakarṣiṇaḥ | sarvety adṛśyānupalabdhir api | nivṛttiniścayasyābhāvaniścayasya | yata evaṃ tad iti tasmāt | iyam ity adṛśyānupalabhis sadsanniścayaphalā neti (|) sanniścayaphalā na bhavati sadvyavahāranimittā | na cāpy asanniścayaphalā sandehāt | iti heto(ḥ) syādvānupalabdher apramāṇatā | vyavasāyaphalatvād iti niścayaphalatvāt pramāṇānāṃ | pratyakṣam api hi pramāṇaṃ sarvākāragrahe 'pi yeṣv ākāreṣu niścayam āvahati teṣv eva |
 nanu pravṛttiniṣedhapramāṇaṃ syād ity āha – na hītyādi | ityam ity anupalabdhiḥ | niḥśaṃkaparicchedam iti niḥśaṃkaḥ paricchedo yasya cetasa iti vigrahaḥ | saṃśaye sati na pravarttitavyam avaśyam ity evaṃ niścitaṃ ceto na karotity(karotīty??) arthaḥ | saṃśayād api kvacit kṛṣīvalāder lokasya pravṛtteḥ | kathan tarhy pravṛttiphalatvenāsyāḥ prāmāṇyam uktam ity ata āha – tathātve tad ityādi | tathā tena rūpeṇaitadapravṛttikāraṇam anupalambhākhyaṃ niravadyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ yadi niścayapūrvaṃ vyavaharet kaścit | pramāṇapūrvaṃ sadvyavahārādi pravartayet | ity anena dvāreṇa seyamadṛśyānupalabdhir apravṛttiphalā proktā niścitasadvyavahārādipratiṣedhaphalā proktā (|) sandigdhas tu sadvyavahārādir na niṣidhyata iti puruṣasya pravṛttir bhavaty api |
 liṅgātiśayabhāvinīti liṅgam anupalabdhis tasyā atiśayo viśeṣa upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvan tasya bhāvas sadbhāvas sa yasyām asti sā tathoktā | liṅgaviśeṣavatīty (p.374) arthaḥ | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhir iti yāvat |
 atretyādinā vyācaṣṭe | atreti nivṛttiniścaye | yathodāhṛtā prāg iti | (202-3)
  "asajjñānaphalā kācid dhetubhedavyapekṣaye"tyādinā (|) |
 yat punar uktam (|) apramāṇam anupalabdhir iti tannāviśeṣeṇa boddhavyaṃ kin tu svabhāvetyādi | deśādiviprakṛṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ (|) jñāpakaṃ liṅgaṃ | tayor ajñānaṃ |
  "svabhāvajñāpakāj jñānasyāyaṃ nyāya udāhṛtaḥ | " (1.203)
 asattve sādhye nāsti prāmāṇyam iti | svabhāvājñānaṃ pratyakṣanivṛttiḥ | jñāpakājñānam anumānanivṛttiḥ | adṛśyaviṣayāyāḥ pratyakṣānumānanivṛtter ayaṃ nyāya udāhṛta iti samudāyārthaḥ |
 yasyetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yasya kasyacit piśācādeḥ sa iti svabhāvaḥ | tad anupalambhamātreṇeti tena tadviṣayānupalambhamāterṇa pratyakṣanivṛttirūpeṇāsannāma | yathoktaṃ prāg iti | "satām api kadācid anupalambhād" ityādinā | svabhāvājñānam anena vyākhyātaṃ |
 jñāpakājñānam vyākhyātum āha – yopītyādi | jñāpakasyety asya vivaraṇaṃ liṅgasyeti | atīndriyaḥ pratikṣipyate 'rthaḥ | yathā nāsti viraktaṃ ceti ityādi | tathā jñāpakasya liṅgasyābhāvāt svabhāvaviśeṣo vā pratikṣipyate | atara viśeṣaḥ pratikṣipyate na dhārmimātraṃ | yathā nāsti dānetyādi | dānaṃ ca hiṃsā virotiś ceti dvandvaḥ | tadviṣayāś cetanāḥ | dānacetanānāṃ hiṃsāviraticttanānāṃ cety arthaḥ | (p.375) abhyudayahetunā svargādiphalahetunā | atra cetanānāṃ na svarūpaṃ pratikṣipyate tāsāṃ pratyakṣatvāt | kin tv abhyudayahetutvaṃ svabhāvo viśeṣo nāśtīty ucyate |
 nanu cetanānāṃ pratyakṣatvād abhyudayahetutāpi tadātmabhūtatvāt | pratyakṣasyaiveti kuto bhrāntir ityādi |
 pratyakṣepy arthe viparyasto 'pavadetāpīti sambandhaḥ | katham viparyasta ity āha – atatphaletyādi | atatphalā anabhyudayaphalā ye dṛṣṭāś cetanā viśeṣā avyākṛtāḥ | tais sādharmyāt | sādharmyam eva katham ity āha – phalasyānantaryābhāvād iti yā anyā atatphalāścetanāḥ | yāś ca tatphalā ubhayatra tatphalasyānantaryan na dṛśyate | na tāvateti phalasyānntaryādarśanamātreṇa | tadabhāvaḥ phalābhāvaḥ | kasmād (|) vyavahitānām ityādi | hetoḥ sakāśāt kālāntareṇottarottarāvasthāpariṇāmalakṣaṇena vyavahitānāṃ phalānān darśanāt | mūṣikasyālarkkasya conmattakukkurasya viṣavikāra iva sa hi na viṣasaṃcārakāla eva bhavati kin tu sahakāriṇaḥ kālaviśeṣasya sannidhauniṣpadyate | na tu hetvantaram eva tadvat |
 syād etat (|) mūṣikādiviṣavikārasya kālāntare dṛṣṭatvāt sadbhāvo yukta eva dānādiphalan tu na kadācanāpi dṛṣṭam iti kathan tasya sadbhāva ity āha – tad ityādi | tadbhāva iti | tayor dānādiphalātīndriyavastunor bhāve virodhābhāvāt | atra dānādiphale 'tīndriyabhāve vānupalabdhimātram apramāṇaṃ |
 yadi bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāstīty apratikṣepo bhāve 'stitve kiṃ pramāṇan naivāsti pramāṇam ataḥ sattāniścayo na yukta iti paraḥ |
 ata evety ācāryaḥ | atyantam atīndriyasyārthasya sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt prekṣāvataḥ saṃśayo yuktaḥ | yadi vā yad vatu nirākartun na śakyate na ca tasya sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratibhāti | tasyaivaṃ sambhāvanā yuktā bhaved asya kadāciat sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ (p.376) kasyacit pratibhāvataḥ | tasmād arthasaṃśayāt pramāṇasaṃśayād vā 'pratikṣepaḥ |
 anye tu viraktacitte 'byudayahetutve cāta eveti sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt saṃśayos tv iti vyākhyāya | viraktaṃ cittaṃ sarvajñatve bhaved vā pramāṇam ity apratikṣepaḥ | tac ca pramāṇaṃ dvitīye pricchede 'bhidhāsyata iti vyācakṣate |
 yata eva vyavahitasyāpi kāryotpattiḥ | tat asmād atra evātīndriyeṣu madhye keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ svabhāvānāṃ ceti yady api pāṭhakramaḥ | tathāpi yathāyogaṃ sambandhaḥ |
 keṣāṃcit svabhāvanām abhudayahetvādīnāṃ bhavej jñāpakāsiddhiḥ | kathaṃ (|) darśanapāṭavābhāvāt | tadviṣayasyānubhavasya yathāgahītasvarūpaniścayotpādane sāmarthyābhāvāt keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ viraktacittatvādīnāṃ | pratyakṣānumānalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ jñāpakantasyābhāvāt |
 tathābhūtasya kāryasya kasmād abhāva ity āha – kāraṇānām ityādi | na hi kāraṇair vaśyamātmajñāpakaṅ kāryaṃ sarvapuruṣagrāhyam ārabdhavyam iti niyamaḥ |
 anne tv anyathā vyācakṣate | keṣāṃ cit svabhāvānām abhyudayahetuvādināṃ | arthānāṃ ca viraktacittādīnām bhavej jñāpakasya niścāyakasya pramāṇasyāsiddhiḥ | kutaḥ (|) darśanapāṭavābhāvāt |
 etad uktam bhavati | darśanam eva jñāpakaṃ kasyacid arthasya tac cāpaṭutvāt sarvākāraniścayan notpādayati | kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryotpādananiyamābhāvas tenānantarakāryādarśanāt | kāryadvāreṇāpy abhyudayahetutvan na śakyaṃ niṣeddhuṃ | tathātīndriyāṇām arthānāṃ darśanasya manovijñānalakṣaṇasyāpāṭavāt pratyakṣeṇāgarhaṇaṃ | na hi kāryadvāreṇaiṣāṃ niścayaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryotpādananiyamābhāvāt | na hi kāraṇair avaśyamātmajñāpakaṃ kāryaṃ santānāntare janayitavyam iti niyamaḥ | tasmān na pratyakṣaṃ nānumānaṃ teṣām asti |
 neyateti yathoktajñāpakābhāvamātreṇa tadabhāvo 'tīnriyāṇām abhāvaḥ | yasmāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām anupalabdhānām api keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ punar api paryāyeṇa krameṇa kuḍyavivarāvasthitānām arthānāṃ pratyakṣeṇānumānenābhivyaktaeḥ pratīteḥ | tad evaṃ viprakṛṭe svabhāvānupalambho nāsattāsādhanaṃ | nāpi kāryāṇupalambhaḥ |
(p.377)  kāraṇānupalambhas tu tatrāpy abhāvasādhanm ity āha – kārye tv ityādi | kārye tu svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇy api kārakājñānaṃ kāraṇānupalabdhir abhāvasya sādhanam eva |
 svabhāvetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | viprakṛṣṭaviṣayasy svabhāvasyābhāve sādhye svabhāvānupalambha evāpramāṇam ucyate | kāraṇānupalambhas tu pramāṇam eva |
 nanu viprakṛṣṭaviṣaye kāraṇānupalambha eva niścetum aśakyas tat kathaṃ kāryābhāvaṃ sādhayet | sattyam (|) etāvad vaktuṃ śakyate (|) kāraṇam antareṇānuddiṣṭaviṣaye kāryam avaśyaṃ na bhavatītīyatā leśenāsyopanyāsaḥ | ata eva sāmānyenāha – na hy astītyādi |
 nanv ityādi paraḥ | agner vināśepi vāsagrahādau dhūmasya darśanāt | tathā cāsaty api kāraṇe kāryaṃ dṛṣṭam iti vyabhicāraḥ | asati kāraṇe kāryan na syād ity anena vākyena kāraṇasthitikālabhāvi kāryaṃ | yāvat kāraṇasattā tāvat kāryasattety evan na brūmo yena kāraṇanāśepītyādikaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt | kin tarhy anena vākyenocyata ityāha – hetur ahitetyādi |
 evan tāvat sthiratām abhyupagamyoktaṃ | kṣaṇikatve tu kāraṇe vinaṣṭe kāryasthānam eva nāstīti kuto vyabhicārāśaṃkā | tathā hi yognijanyo dhūmakṣaṇas tasyāgnivināśe nāsty evāvasthānaṃ | kṣaṇikatvena vināśāt | yaś ca paścāt sthāyī dhūmaḥ sa dhūmahetuka eva nāgnihetukaḥ | tad eva darśayan nāha – na ca tathetyādi | tathā sthāyīti naṣṭepyādye kāraṇe kālāntarasthāyī | tadupādānaḥ pūrvaniruddhahetūpādānaḥ |
 kathan tarhi pāścātyopi dhūmognihetuka ity ucyata ity āha – pāram paryetyādi | ādyan tāvad dhūmakṣaṇam vahnir eva janayati (|) sa dhūmakṣaṇo 'paraṃ sopy aparam ity evaṃ pāram paryeṇa | etad eva sphuṭayan nāha – santānopakārād iti | prabandhasya prathamato jananāt tatkāryavyapadeśaḥ | tasmād yasya kāraṇasya pāścātyam api kāryam ity evaṃ vyapadeśaḥ (p.378) | yady asya hetoḥ kathaṃcit pramāṇenābhāvaḥ sidhyate tadā tatphalantasya hetoḥ phalan nāstīti niścīyate |
 etac coddiṣṭaviṣayasyābhāvasya sādhanam abhipretyoktam (|) anuddiṣṭaviṣaye tu naitatpramāṇaṃ pratibandhaphalatvāt |
 svabhāvetyādi | arthasyeti vyāpakasya svabhāve 'vyatirikte liṅginyasattvena sādhye svabhāvānupalambhaś ca vyāpakānupalambhaś cābhāvasya sādhanam iti prakṛtaṃ | (203-4)
 svabhāvābhāvetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kaścid iti vyāpakānupalmbhaḥ | yady anupalabhyamāno vyāpakaḥ svabhāvo 'sya vyāpyasya siddhaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pramāṇaṃ | kāraṇavyāpakānupalambhaś ca bhavet pramāṇaṃ yadi tadabhāvas tayoḥ kāraṇavyāpakayor abhāvaḥ pratīyeta hetunā kenacit | svabhāvānupalambhākhyena |
 yadītyādinā kārikāryam āha – yady asya kārakasyābhāvaḥ siddhyed iti sambandhaḥ | vyāpakasya ca svabhāvasyābhāvaḥ | kutaś cid gamakād dhetor ity upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalambhāt | so 'yaṃ kārako vyāpako vā 'san neva siddho yathākramaṃ kāryaṃ vyāpyañ ca nivartayati | tadabhāvāsiddhau kārakavyāpakayor abhāvāsiddau nivarttye 'pi (p.379) kārye vyāpye ca saṃśayāt | (204-5)
 yadi svabhāvābhāve sādhye tadanupalambha evāpramāṇam ucyate | katham idānīm bhāvasta ghaṭādeḥ svayam anupalabdher abhāvasiddhiḥ |
 uttaram āha – dṛśyasyetyādi | viprakṛṣṭe viṣaye svabhāvānupalambhe pramāṇam uktaṃ | na tu dṛśyaviṣaya ity arthaḥ | dṛśyasyeti svabhāvādyaviprakṛṣṭasya bhāvasyānplabdhasya sataḥ | bhāvasya sattāyā abhāvaḥ pratīyate | kadā darśanābhāvakāraṇāsambhave sati | darśanābhāvasya kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāntarāṇāṃ vaikalyantasyāsambhave sati | upalambhapratyayāntarasākalye satīty arthaḥ |
 bhāvo hītyādi viraṇaṃ | svabhāvādyviprakṛṣṭo bhāāvo yadi bhavet | yathāsva grāhakeṇa karaṇaneti yasya yad grāhakam indriyantenopalabhya eva bhavet sa iti yathokto bhāvaḥ | darśanaprapibandhiṣū vyavadhānādiṣu (|) ādiśabdād vaikalyapratibandhādiṣv asatsu | upalambhapratyayeṣu satsv iti yāvat | (205-6)
 tathā bhūtonupalabdhas tv asann iti niścīyate | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tādṛśaḥ sata upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya sataḥ | upalambhāvyabhicārāt | ya evāyaṃ svabhāvasyābhāvaniścaye dṛśyasya darśanetyādinokto 'yam eva hetur veditavyaḥ | kasmin sādhye (|) hetuvyāpakayor abhāvepi sādhye |
 viruddhasya cetyādi | yasyābhāvasādhyas tena yo viruddhas tasyopalabdhau ca syād asattāyāḥ pratiṣedhyābhāvasya niścayaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) viruddhasya bhāvasya bhāve sattāyān tadbhāvabādhanāt | tasya niṣedhyābhimatasya sattābādhanāt |
 yo hītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | kasmān nāvatiṣṭhata ityāha – tad ityādi | tayor viruddhayor ye upādāne tayor anyonyaṃ parasparaṃ yad vaiguṇyantasyāśrayatvena | yathā śītopādānam uṣṇopādānavaiguṇyasyāśraya itaraś cetarasyety arthaḥ | tena kāraṇena viruddhayor (p.380) ekatra yugapadārambhavirodhāt | tayor viruddhayor ekasya bhāve 'py anyābhāvagatir bhavati | yathoktaṃ prāg anupalabdhiprabhede | "na śītasparśo 'trāgner" ityādi | yady apy atrānupalabdhir iti na śrūyate tathāpīdaṃ svabhāvaviruddhākhyaṃ liṅhgam anupalabdhes sakāśān na pṛthag ucyate (|) kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tata evānupalambhād virodhagateḥ | virodhāc cābhāvasādhanād ity uktaṃ |
 bhavatu nāmaivam vidhāyā dṛśyānupalabdheḥ sakāśād bhāvagatiḥ | sā punaḥ katham anumānaṃ (|) naivānumānaṃ kin tu pramāṇāntaram eveti bhāvaḥ |
 kathan na syād ityācaryaḥ |
 dṛṣṭāntetyādi paraḥ | dṛṣṭāntāpekṣaṃ hy anumānam anvayavyatirekavattvāt | dṛṣṭāntāpekṣaṇam evāha – na hīti | asyām ity anupalabdhau |
 kin netyācāryaḥ |
 tad ityādi paraḥ | tad vyomakusumādi | asad iti kathaṃ kena pramāṇenāvagantavyaṃ yenaivaṃ syād adṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt | anapalabdher eva liṅgād vyomakusumādyasadavagantavyam iti cet | tatreti vyomakusumādau | katham adṛṣṭāntikā dṛṣṭāntarahitā 'sattāsiddhiḥ | sadṛṣṭāntatve vānavasthāprsaṅga iti tatrāpya(pa)ropīti kṛtvā | tathā cety anavasthāyāṃ satyāṃ sādhyasyāpratipattiḥ | yataś ca dṛṣṭāntatvenavasthādoṣaḥ | tasmān nirupākhyābhāvasiddhir adṛṣṭāntaikā | tadvad anyatrāpi (|) neha ghaṭonupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalabdher ityādāv api prayoge dṛṣṭāntānapekṣaṇād ananumānam anupalabdhiḥ (|)
 śṛṇvannapītyācāryaḥ | asakṛduktam etat | yathā svabhāvānupalabdhau nābhāvaḥ sādhyate kin tv abhāvavyavahāra iti śṛṇvann api devānāṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ priyo nāvadhāraṇapaṭuryena (p.381) saty api dṛṣṭānte tadasiddhiś codyate | dṛṣṭāntam eva darśayitum upakramate | nimittaṃ hītyādi | upalabhyānupalabdhir dṛśyānupalabdhir yā nimittaṃ kāraṇam asadvyavahārāṇāṃ | sety anupalabdhiḥ svasannidhānād ātmasannidhānāt | svanimittān svam anupalabdhirūpaṃ nimittaṃ yeṣān tānetānasadvyavahārātn sādhayatīti kṛtvā sarvotra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kiṅbhūtaḥ (|) svanimittasāmagrīyogyasannidhānaḥ | svakāraṇānāṃ sāmagrī tasyāṃ yogyaṃ sannidhānaṃ yasyāṅkurādes sa tathoktaḥ (|) prayogaḥ punaḥ | yasya yatra nimittaṃ sakalam apratibadvam asti tatra tena bhavitavyantadyarthāṅkurādi | asti copalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalabdhāvasadvyavahārāṇāṃ nimittatvam iti svabhāvahetuḥ | kasmād (|) atrābhāvavyavahāra eva sādhyate na punar abhāva evety āha – asattetyādi | atra dṛśyānupalabdhāvanupalabdhir eva sattā | yathoktaṃ prāk | tasmād abhāvo na (?) sādhyate | yata evātrābhāvavyavahāraḥ sādhyate 'ta eveyam anupalabdhiḥ svabhāvahetāv antarbhavatīti sambandhaḥ | kāraṇād duśyānupalambhāt kāryasyāsadvyavahārasyānumānaṃ tad eva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyeti sāmānyenānyapadārtham upadarśya paścād bhāvapratyayaḥ | samagrāt kāraṇāt kāryānumāne ca yogyatānumānam iti svabhāvahetāv antarbhāvaḥ (|) vakṣyāmaś caturthe paricchede ( ) |
 dṛśyānupalabdhau bhavatu dṛṣṭānto 'dṛśyānupalabdhau tu katham ity āha – sacchabdetyādi deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu pramāṇanivṛttyā sadvyavahāraniṣedhe sādhye kāraṇābhāvāt kāryasyābhāvaḥ sādhyastenātra na kevalannirupākhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ kun tu nimittasya kāraṇasya vaikalyenābhāvinoṅkurādayopi dṛṣṭāntaḥ | prayogas tu (|) yodvikalakāraṇan tan na bhavati yathā bījaratihoṅkuraḥ | vikalakāraṇaś cādṛśyānupalabdhau sadvyavahāra iti kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ |
 yat punar uktaṃ (|) tadasannirupākhyaṃ kathaṃ pratipattavyam iti tatrāpi nirupākhye dṛṣṭānte | iyam evam ajñānavyavahāralakṣaṇā pravṛttir niṣdhyate | anupalabdhito na tv abhāvaḥ sādhyate | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) anupalabdhītyādi | viṣāṇādiviviktaśaśam (p.382) asatakādyupalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ paryudāsavṛttyā | saiva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ śaśaviṣāṇāsattāyāḥ sā siddhaiva |
 syād etad (|) adṛśyānupalabdhāvasattve viṣayabhūte siddhe | tannimitto 'py asadvyavahāraḥ siddha eveti kin tenāsadvyavahāreṇa | adṛśyānupalabdhāv api sadvyavahāranimittasyābhāvād vyavahārāpravṛttiḥ siddhaiveti sadvyavahāraniṣedhenāpi sādhitena kiṃ |
 tathā pūrvaprasiddhaviṣayopadarśanalakṣaṇena dṛṣṭāntenāpy anupalabdhau na kiṃcit prayojanam ity ata āha – so 'yam ityādi mūḍha praty etat sādhyata iti yāvat |
 kvacid apy asadvyavahāranimittaṃ dṛśyānupalambham abhyupagamyāsadvyavahārapravṛttim ivalomayan na kurvan | adṛśyānupalabdhau tadabhāvaṃ ca sadvyavahāranimittasya pramāṇasyābhāvaṃ cābhyupagamya sadvyavahāranivṛttiṃ ca vilomayann akurvan | yathābhyupagamaṃ pratipādyata iti dṛśyānupalambhena nimittena tvayā 'sadvyavahāro 'nyatra kṛtas tad ihāpy asti (|) tasmād asadvyavahāraṅ kurv iti pratipādyate | tathā pramāṇena nimitena tvayā kvacit sadvyavahāraḥ kṛtas tadihāpy anirupākhye nāsti | tasmād sadvyavahāram mā kurv iti pratipādyate | kim iva nirupākhyāvat | yathā śaśaviṣāṇādāv asadvyavahāranimittasya dṛśyānupalambhasya dṛśyānupalambhasya bhāvād asadvyavahāras tathehāpīti |
 anyad veti (|) yathā sannihitanimittasyā 'ṅkurādeḥ pratipattir eva sadvyavahārasyāpīti | yathā ca nirupākhye pramāṇābhāvāt sadvyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ | anyasmin vā kāraṇavikale kārye nivṛttis tadvad viprakṛṣṭeṣu sadvyavahārasya nivṛttir iti pratipādyate |
 sa eva tāvad upalabdhyabhāvo 'nupalabdhyākhyaḥ kathaṃ kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ (|) na pratyakṣeṇābhāvaviṣayatvavirodhāt | nāpy anumānena pratyakṣapūrvakatvād asya | nāpi pradeśasambandhyanupalambho 'bhāvasy nīrūpatvena sambandhitvāyogāt | pradeśasyānupalambhe ca dharmmasiddher āśrayāsiddho hetur ity anupalabdher na pakṣadharmatvam ity udyotakara prabhṛtayaḥ |
 atrāha – etad uttaratra vakṣyāmas tadviśeṣṭopalambho 'tas tasyāpy anupalambhanan tasmād (p.383) anupalambho 'yaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva sidhyatīti | yat punar uktam anupalabdhau kin dṛṣṭāntopadarśanenety āha – anyatrāpītyādi | vidhisādhanepy anumāne sādhyadharmeṇa vyāpakena vyāpyadharmaṃ kṛtakatvādikaṃ sādhanam icchan pratipādyaḥ kim iti dṛṣṭāntena pratyāyyaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yathāsvaṃ sādhyena vyāpyasya hetor nirdeśād eva vyāpnuvataḥ sādhyadharmasya siddheḥ | niścitārthas sambandhalakṣaṇo yena tasya vyāmūḍham prati smṛty arthaḥ | tad etad dṛṣṭāntena mūḍhaṃ prati smṛtijananam atrānupalabdhau | etad evāha – so 'yam ityādi | anyatrāpīti śaśaviṣāṇādau ( | 205-6)
 atha yad idam ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhir uktaṃ | "na santi pradhānādayo 'nupalabdher" iti tatra prayoge | ācārya āha – kathaṃ ca na syād iti |
 codakaḥ svābhiprāyeṇāha – tadarthetyādi | tadarthasya pradhānārthasya niṣedhe sati pradhānādidharmivācino 'bhidhānasyāprayogāt | na hi vācyamantareṇa vācakasya prayogo 'sti | yadā ca pradhānādiśabdānām aprayogas tadā na santīti pratiṣedhavācyeva śabdo 'vaśiṣyate | tasya ca pratiṣedhyāsaṃkīrttane nirviṣayasya pratiṣedhasyeti pratiṣedhavācinaḥ śabdasyāprayogāt | tathā ca na santi pradhānādaya iti dvayor api pratijñāpadayor aprayogāt | kutra kiṃ sādhyata iti vyarthānupalabdheḥ sādhanayogaḥ | pradhānādīnāṃ ca pakṣabhūtānām abhāvād pakṣadharmo hetuḥ syāt | pratijñāpadayor vā parasparaṃ virodhas tathā hi pradhānādaya iti prayogāt tadarthasannidhānaṃ | punar na santīti vacanāt teṣām asannidhānaṃ | ete ca sannidhānāsannidhāne yugapad ekatra virudhyete | (206-7)
(p.384) naiṣa doṣa iti parihāraḥ | yasmād anādervāsanāyās samudbhūte vikalpe pariniṣṭhitas samāruḍhaḥ śabdārthaḥ sa ca bhāvābhāvobhayāśritatvāt trividho dharmmaḥ | tasmin śabderthe vāhyapradhānādiko bhāvonupādānam asyeti tasmin bhāvānupādāne sādhye | asyeti buddhiparivarttinaḥ pradhānādidharmiṇaḥ | tatheti bāhyapradhānādyupādānatvenānupalambhanaṃ hetuḥ | vāsanopādānatvenopalambhanam evātrānupalambhanaṃ | na tasyaiva vikalpapratiniṣṭhitasya dharmiṇo 'bhāvas sādhyate | kasmāt (|) pradhānādiśabdānāṃ prayogataḥ | tanniṣedhe hi nirviṣayatvāc chabdaprayoga eva na syāt |
 niveditam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi hi svalakṣaṇam abhidheyaṃ syāt tadā svalakṣaṇapratiṣedhe śabdārthasya pratiṣedhāt tadvācinaḥ śabdasyāprayogaḥ syāt | yāvatā niveditam etad yathaite śabdā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayā iti | kintv anādivāsanāyāḥ prabhava utpādo yasya vikalpasya tasmin pratibhāsī yorthas tamviṣayatvenātmasātkurvanti |
 kuta etad vikalpaviṣayam evārtham viṣayīkṛtantīty āha – vaktus tadvikalpabhāja iti bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayasāmānyākāravikalpabhājaḥ (|) kāraṇam āha – yathetyādi | yathāpratibhāsi vastu | pratibhāsivastvanatikrameṇa yā pratipādanasamīha tayā śabdaprayogāt | tasmād vikalpapratibhāsina evārthān viṣayīkurvanti |
 tathā śrotuś ca tadvikalpabhāja iti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadākāravikalpajananāt | bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayasāmānyākāravikalpajananāc ca vikalpapratibhāsina evārthān śabdā viṣayīkurvanti |
 syād etad (|) yadi nāmaivan tathāpi svalakṣaṇaviṣayā śabdāḥ svalakṣaṇapratīter ity āha – na cetyādi | upādānaṃ ca kāryaṃ ca te eva pratyayo jñānan tatrāpratibhāsi (p.385) yadūpan tadviṣayatvena tan na śakyan niścetuṃ | tatropādānapratyayo vaktuḥ pratipādanasamīhārūpo vikalpaḥ śabdasya kāraṇatvāt | kāryapratyayaḥ śabdotthaḥ śrotur vikalpaḥ | na hi sa śabdārtho yaḥ śabde pratyaye na pratibhāsate | na ca tatra svalakṣaṇaṃ pratibhāsate | spaṣṭākāravivekāt |
 nanu kathaṃ vikalpābhāvāśrayo 'rthajanyatvenāvikalpakatvaprasaṅgāt | kathañcābhāvāśrayo 'bhāvasyākāraṇatvāt | kathañcaika ubhayāśrayo 'hetukatvaprasaṅgād ity ata āha – sa tv ityādi | sadasadubhayākāro vikalpaḥ sadasadubhayapratyayas tenāhitā vāsanā tataḥ prabhava utpādo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | iti hetor bhāvābhāvobhayadharma ity ucyate |
 dvitīyaṃ kāraṇam āha – tad ityādi | tasminn neva vikalpe pratibhāsī ya ākāras tasya sadasadubhayarūpatayādhyavasāyas tadvaśena ca | bhāvābhāvobhayadharma ity ucyate | (209)

 etad uktam bhavati | satpratyayāhitavāsanāprabhavas sadākārādhyavasāyīva bhāvadharma ity ucyate | evamabhāvobhayadharmayor api draṣṭavyaṃ pūrvapūrvasadādipratyayāhitavāsanāprabhavatvād eva sadādivikalpānām anāditvam (|) ato na bhāvādijanyatvaṃ | yataś ca śabdārthastrividhaḥ | tat tasmād atra śabdārthe dharmiṇi vyavasthitā vivādāśrayatvena sthitāḥ puruṣās sadasattvaṃ pradhānādeś cintayanti | kathaṃ cintayantīty āha – kim ayaṃ pradhānaśabdād uccaritād vikalpapratibhāsamānortho bāhyapradhānanibandhano bhavati na veti | tasya pradhānādivikalpapratibhāsasya bhāvānupādānatvena dharme sādhye sa eva vikalpapratibhāso buddhisvabhāvatayā pratyātmavedyatvāt svasamvedanapratyakṣasiddhatvād apratikṣepārthortho dharmī |
 nanu ca sa eva vikalpagrāhyārthaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇarūpatayādhyavasāyāt | tataś ca pratyakṣasiddhi eva pradhānādiḥ śabdaś ca svalakṣaṇaviṣaya ity āha – na ca sa evetyādi | sa eva vikalpapratibhāsyartho bāhyaṃ svalakṣaṇam iti śakyam vaktuṃ | kiṃ (p.386) kāraṇam (|) asaṃprāpte 'nutpanne svalakṣaṇe niruddhe ca tasya vikalpapratibhāsasyānapāyāt | kiṃ ca vastuni ghaṭādau viparītākāraḥ parasparavirodhino nityānityādayaḥ | tānabhiniveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣān tīrthāntarīyapratyayānān teṣu bhāvācchārthapratibhāsasya | na ca sa evārthaḥ svalakṣaṇam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ || (209-10)

 amum evārthaṃ saṅgrahītum āha – paramārthaḥ svalakṣaṇan tasminn ekasthānaḥ pravṛttir yeṣān tadbhāvas tattvan tasmin sati śabdānām anibandhanā paramārthanibandhanarahitā pravṛttir na syāt | darśanāntarabhinneṣv artheṣu | atītājātayor vāpīti atītānagate cārthe śabdānām pravṛttir na syāt | tathā kasyācid vāco (')bhūtārthatā mṛṣārthatā na syāt | iti yathoktād dhetor eṣā vāk | bauddhārthaviṣayā | vikalpapratibhāsyarthaviṣayā matā | (210-11)

 tasya ceti pradhānādivikalpapratibhāsasya | yathāsamīhitaṃ rūpaṃ yathāparikalpitam vāhyapradhānādirūpan tadanupādānatve sādhye | tathānupalambha iti yathā samīhitarūpopādānatvenānupalambhostīti kṛtvā na sādhanadharmāsiddhir nāpakṣadharmo hetur ity arthaḥ |
 na punar atra prayoge 'yam eva śabdetyādi | śabdād utpadyate yo vikalpas tatpratibhāsyarthopahanūyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya vikalpapratibhāsyarthasya śrotṛbuddhāv upasthāpanāya (p.387) śabdaprayogāt | tadabhāve vikalpapratibhāsyarthābhāve | tadayogāc chabdaprayogāyogāt |
 api ca yadi śabdārthasya vāpahnavaḥ sādhyate | tadā śabdārthāpahnave sādhye tasya sādhyadharmasya nāstitvasya ya ādhāro dharmī śabdārthalakṣaṇas tasya nirākṛter na sādhyaḥ dharmidharmātmakaḥ samudāyaḥ syāt | kevalaś ca sādhyadharmas siddha eva | nāsti tvamātrasya kvacit siddhatvāt |
 yadītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ sādhyadharmaḥ ādhāreṇa yo vyavacchedo viśeṣaṇam asyedaṃ nāstitvan tadanapekṣaḥ | iti hetor nāpanyasanīya eva vivādakāle | (211-12)

 sadasatpakṣabhedeneti sadasatpratijñābhedena vastvneva cintyate | śabdārthānapavādibhirathakriyārthibhiḥ prekṣāvadbhiḥ | yasmād atra vastuni pratibaddhaḥ phalodayaḥ | (212-13)

 yadi nāmaivan tathāpi kin na śabdārtho vicāraṇīya ity āha (|) arthetyādi | arthakriyāṃ pratyasamarthasya śabdārthasya vicāraiḥ sadasattvavicāraiḥ kin tadadarthināmarthakriyārthināṃ (|) nidarśanam āha ṣaṇḍhasyetyādi | puṃstvarihitasya yad rūpavairūpyantasmin viṣaye kāminyā maithunābhiṣiṇyāḥ kimparīkṣayā | (213-14)

 na hītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | na hi śabdārthosan kiṃcit puruṣārtham uparuṇaddhi nivartayati | san vā samādadhāti karotīti yathāyogaṃ sambandhanīyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yathābhiniveśaṃ puruṣastaṃ śabdārtham bāhyatā 'bhiniveśate 'dhyavasyati tathā tasyāsattvād (p.388) avidyamānatvāt | yathātattvaṃ vā samīhitatvāt |
 yathārthasvalakṣaṇaṃ jñānasvalakṣaṇam vā sthitan tathā śabdenāviṣayīkṛtatvāt | yata evaṃ tasmād ayaṃ puruṣas sadasaccintāyāṃ pravarttamānaḥ sarvadā 'vadhīritavikalpapratibhāso 'napekṣitavikalpapratibhāso vastv evādhiṣṭhānīkaroti viṣayīkaroti yatra vastunyayaṃ puruṣārthaḥ pratibaddhaḥ | agnāv ity agnisvalakṣaṇe | ādigrahaṇād dāhapākādi |
 syād etad (|) īdṛśorthaḥ śabdārthenāpi sādhyata ity āha – na hītyādi | atreti śītapratighātādau | kasmāt tadanubhavāptāvapi | tasya śabdārthasyānubhavāptāvapi | tadabhāvāt tasya śītapratīkārāder abhāvāt | tat tasmād ayam arthakriyārthī puruṣaḥ | tadasamarthan tasyām arthakriyāyām asamarthaṃ śabdārthaṃ prati dattānuyogo dattāvadhāno bhavitun na yuktaḥ | na hi vṛṣasyantī maithunam icchantī ṣaṇḍhasya paricaritum aśaktasya rūpavairūpyaparīkṣāyām avadhatte 'vadhānavatī bhavati |
 udyotakarādyuktadūṣaṇanirāsārthaṃ pṛcchati | yatpunar etad uktam ācāryadignāgena (|) kalpitasyetyādi | tasya korthaḥ |
 uttaram āha – śabdārtha ityādi | kalpanājñānaviṣayatvāc chabdārthaḥ pradhānādiśabdārthaḥ | kalpito vastuno bāhyasya pradhānalakṣaṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ tenāsiddhir anupalabdhir asya pradhānādiśabdārthasya dharma ukto liṅgabhūto bhāvānupādānatve sādhye | nyāyavādinācāryadignāgena |
 (p.389) tena yad ucyate udyotakarādibhiḥ – yadi pramāṇena pradhānaṃ sattvena kalpitaṃ katham asyānupalabdhir ddharmaḥ pratīyate | athāsattvena kalpitaṃ pradhānan tathāpi katham asyānupalabdhir dharmo 'sattvād iti, tadapāstam, yasmāt kalpanājñānaviṣayatvāc chabdārtha eva kalpitaḥ | na tu pramāṇena bāhyaṃ pradhānaṃ sattvena kalpitaṃ | tasyeti pradhānaśabdārthasya bāhyapradhānavastvāśrayaṇānulambha ity ayam abhiprāya ācāryadignāgasya | (214-15)

 yad uktam ityādi paraḥ | pramāṇatrayaṃ pratyakṣānumānāgamalakṣaṇaṃ | anyapramāṇanivṛttāv iti pratyakṣānumānanivṛttau nivṛttir deśādiviprakṛṣṭānāṃ | tayor iti pratyakṣānumānayoḥ | na kiñcid vyāpnoti sarvam eva viṣayīkaroti | tanninivṛttir āgamanivṛttiḥ |
 uktam atreti siddhāntavādī | aaprakaraṇāpannatvād iti puruṣārthacintāprastāvānupayogitvāt | "śāstrādhikārāsambandhā bahavorthā" ity atrāntare (1|201) uktatvāt |
 etac ca bāhyeṣu āgamasya prāmāṇyam abhyupagamyoktam (|)
 adhunā naiva bāhyerthasya prāmāṇyam ity āha – api cetyādi | vastubhis svalakṣaṇais saha | śabdānāntarīyakaatāyā avinābhāvasyābhāvāt tebhyaḥ śabdebhyo nārthasiddhir na bāhyavastuniścayaḥ | yasmāt te hi vaktrabhiprāyasūcakāḥ |
 yady api ghaṭavivakṣātaḥ paṭaaśabdasyotpattis tathāpi sthānakaraṇābhighātāder eva sākṣāt karaṇāt tadutpatter vyabhicārābhāvān nāhetukatvaṃ (|) yaś ca ghaṭavivakṣājanyaṃ ghaṭaśabdam avadhārayati | tasya paṭaśabdāt paṭavivakṣānumānan tadavadhāraṇaṃ ca prakaraṇādinā lokasya vidyata eveti vivakṣānumāne 'vyabhicāra eva |
 (p.390) yathābhāvaṃ yathāsvalakṣaṇaṃ | yata iti yathābhāvaṃ pravṛtteḥ śabdebhyorthaprakṛtir arthasvabhāvo niścīyeta | te hīti śabdāḥ | vivakṣayā varttiyāṣānte tathoktāḥ | tatrāntarīyakā vivakṣānāntarīyakāḥ | tām eva vivakṣāṃ | saiva vivakṣā svalakṣaṇam antareṇa na bhavati (|) ato 'sty eva śabdānām arthāvyabhicāra ity āha – na cetyādi | yathārthaṃ yathāvastu bhavituṃ śīlaṃ yāsāntās tathoktāḥ | kṣīṇadoṣasya kṛpālor yathārthabhāvinī sarvā ity āha – arthe 'pratibaddhopi śabdārthaṃ gamayiṣyatīti ced āha – na cetyādi | tasmin vastuny apratibaddhaḥ svabhāvo yasya śabdalakṣaṇasya | anyaṃ yatrāsau na pratibaddhaḥ |
yadi bāhye vastuni śabdasya nāsti prāmāṇyam, yat tarhīdam āptavādāvisamvādasāmānyāt. yo ya āptavādaḥ, so 'visamvādī, yathā kṣaṇikāḥ sarve saṃskārā ityādikaḥ. āptavādaś cāyam atyantaparokṣe 'py arthe. tasmād ayam apy avisamvādīty evam āptavādasyāvisamvādasāmānyād avisamvāditvād anumānatety āgamasya bāhye 'rthe 'numānatvam uktam ācāryadignāgena.
tat katham ity anenābhyupetabādhām āha. nāyam ityādinā pariharati. etat kathayati – nācāryeṇa bhāvikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kathayatā anumānatvam āgamasyoktam, api tu puruṣapravṛttim apekṣya, yasmān nāyam puruṣaḥ pravṛttikāmaḥ āgamaprāmāṇyam anāśrityāsituṃ samarthaḥ. kiṃ kāraṇam. pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ phalaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ keṣāṃcit pravṛttinivṛttyor iti yathāyogaṃ sambandhaḥ. hiṃsādicetanāviṣayāṇāṃ nivṛtteḥ svargādiphalatvena mahānuśaṃsāśravaṇāt | hiṃsācetanāviśeṣāṇāṃ pravṛtter narakādiphalatvena mahāpāpaśravaṇatvāt | na cātra vastubalapravṛttam anyat ptamāṇaṃ sādhakam asti yenāgamamanapekṣyānyataḥ pramāṇam pravartteta |
 nāpi bādhakam asti yato nivartteta | bādhakābhāvam evāha – tadbhāva iti yathoktābhyāṃ pravṛttinivṛttibhyām iṣṭāniṣṭasya phalasya bhāve virodhādarśanāc ca icchati cāyam āgamavaśena pravartitum. tat sati pravartitavye (p.391) varam evam āgamam parīkṣya pravṛtta ity āgamasya parīkṣayā prāmāṇyam āhācāryaḥ. (215-16)
na ca sarvaṃ śāstraṃ parīkṣayādhikṛtaṃ | kin tu tac cetyādi śāstraṃ | padārthānām parasparasambandhāt sambaddhaṃ | anuguṇaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ phalasādhanopāyo yasmiṃs tadanuguṇopāyaṃ sambaddhaṃ ca tadanuguṇopāyaṃ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | evaṃbhūtam api yadi puruṣārthābhidhāyakan tadā parīkṣādhikṛtaṃ vākyaṃ | ato yathoktasvabhāvād aparam anyad vākyam anadhikṛtam parīkṣāyāṃ |
sambandha ityādinā vyācaṣṭe. vākyānām aṅgāṅgibhāvenaikasminn arthe vidheyapratiṣedhyalakṣaṇe upasaṃhāro mīlanantenopakāraḥ parasparaṃ vākyānāṃ sambandhaḥ | anupakārakaḥ punaḥ keṣām ity āha – daśa dāḍimetyādi daśa dāḍimāni ṣaḍpūpāḥ kuṇḍamajājinaṃ palalam ityevamādīni vākyāni | na hy eṣām ekārthopasaṃhārosti parasparam asambandhāt | anayathety asambaddhatve vaktuḥ śāstrakārasya vaiguṇyam asambaddhābhidhāyitvam udbhāvayet | aśakyopāyo yeṣāṃ phalānantānyaśakyopāyāni | evaṃ bhūtāni phalāni yeṣāṃ śāstrāṇān tāni | phalārthī pumānnādriyet vicārayituṃ | etac cānugaṇopāyam ity etasya vaidharmyeṇa vivaraṇaṃ |
