kaḥ punar asya śāstrasyāvisamvāda ity āha – pratyakṣeṇetyādi prathamo 'rthaḥ śabdo vastuvacanaḥ | dvitīyo viṣayavacanaḥ | tenāyam arthaḥ | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭayor vastunos tadarśayoḥ pratyakṣānumānaviṣayayor yathākramaṃ pratyakṣeṇānumānena ca dvividhena vastubalapravṛttenāgamāśritena cābādhanam asya śāstrasyāvisamvādaḥ | (216-17) |

pratyakṣetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | śāstre pratyakṣābhimatānām pratyakṣatvenopagatānām arthānān tathābhāvaḥ pratyakṣabhāvaḥ pratyakṣeṇābādhanaṃ |
yathetyādinā svasiddhānte pratyakṣābhimatam arthaṃ pañcaskandhasaṅgṛhītan darśayati | nīlādīty anena rūpādīn pañca viṣayān āha – anena ca rūpaskandha uktaḥ | sukhaduḥkhe iti vedanāskandhaḥ | nimittasya strīpuruṣādicihnasyopalakṣaṇaṃ nimittopalakṣaṇaṃ | anena saṃjñāskandhaḥ | rāgādigrahaṇena saṃskāraskandhaḥ | ādiśabdād dveṣamohādiparigrahaḥ | buddhigrahaṇena vijñānaskandhaḥ | nīlādi ca sukhaduḥkhe ca nimittopalakṣaṇaṃ ca rāgādi ca buddhiś ceti dvandvaḥ | evaṃ śāstre pratyakṣābhimatānāṃ pratyakṣatvam eva | nīlādīnāṃ cakṣurvijñānādipratyakṣatvāt (|) sukhādīnāṃ svasamvedanapratyakṣatvāt | atathābhimatānāṃ cāpratyakṣābhimatā(nāṃ) cārthānām apratyakṣatā (|) pratyakṣeṇāvadhānam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | yatheti viṣayopadarśanaṃ | śabdādirūpeṇa sanniveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ sukhādīnān teṣām apratyakṣatā | śabdādisvabhāvānāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ pratyakṣeṇāpratīteḥ
etat sāṃkhyadarśanapratikṣepeṇoktaṃ |
vaiśeṣikādidarśanapratikṣepeṇāha – dravyaṃ dvividhaṃ | adravyaṃ dravyaṃ yathākāśādi | (p.393) anekadravyaṃ ca dravyaṃ | yathāvayavi dravyaṃ | karmotkṣepaṇādikaṃ | sāmānyaṃ sattā gotvādikaṃ (|) ādiśabdād vibhāgādiparigrahaḥ |
 na hi nīlādiviṣayaṃ paṃca vyatirekeṇānyasya pratyakṣatāsti | tadvyatirekeṇānupalabdheḥ | castubalapravṛttam anumānam anāgamāpekṣānumānaṃ | tasya viṣayatvenābhimatānān tathābhāvonumānaviṣayabhāvonumānenābādhakaṃ | catvāri cāryasatyāni | uttaratra pratipādayiṣyate | ananumeyānān tathābhāve 'nanumeyatvam anumānenābādhakaṃ | yathātmādīnām (|) ādiśabdāt pradhāneśvarādiparigrahaḥ | na hy eṣāṃ kiñcitlliṅgam asti yenānumeyāḥ syuḥ | etad api pratipādayiṣyati | viśuddhe viṣayadvaye (      ) 'tyantaparokṣe cāgamaviṣaye paurvāparyavirodhena yasmin cintāṃ pravarttayati tasminn āgamāpekṣam anumānam api | abādhanam iti prakṛtaṃ |
 kīdṛśan tadabādhanam ity āha – rāgādirūpaṃ rāgadveṣamohasvabhāvam adharmam abhyupagamya tatprabhavaṃ rāgādisamutthāpitaṃ kāyavākkarma cādharmam abhyupagapya | tatprahāṇāya tasyādharmasyāpagamāya snānāgnihotrādeḥ | tīrthasnānena pāpakṣayo bhavati | yamuddiśyāgnau ghṛtādikaṃ hūyate tasya pāpakṣayo bhavatīty evamāder anupadeśaḥ | ādiśabdād upavāsādiparigrahaḥ | tathā hi na snānādi pāpam apanayati (|) pāpanidānena rāgādinā virodhābhāvāt |
seyam anantaroktāpratyakṣeṇānumānena dvividhena śakyaparicchedasya śakyaniścayasyāśeṣasya viṣayasya bādhālakṣaṇā | tasyāptāvadasyāvisamvādāt sāmānyāt | yathā śakyaparicchede 'rthe āptavādasyāvisamvādaḥ, tathātyantaparokṣe 'pi, āptavādatvād eva.
PVSV 1.216
tataś cāptalakṣaṇāl liṅgād utpannāyā avisamvādabuddher anumānatācāryadignāgenābhihitā. parokṣe' py arthasya gocara ity atyantaparokṣe ' py asya śāstrasya gocare viṣaye | sā cāgatyābhihitānyena prakāreṇātyantaparokṣe pravṛttyasambhavāt | satyāṃ pravṛttau varam evaṃ (p.394) pravṛtta iti |
tasyetyādi vivaraṇaṃ | tasyāgamasyācāryadignāgena nirdiṣṭānumānabhāvasya | asyety asmābhis sambandhād anuguṇopāyam ityādinā vicāritasya | ata evāha – evaṃbhūtasyeti sambandhādiguṇayuktasyety arthaḥ | pratyakṣānumānagamye tasmin vastuny avisamvādasāmānyād avisamvādatvāt kāraṇād dṛṣṭavyabhicārasyāpavādasya pratyakṣānumānāgamyerthe viṣaye | āptavādād anutpannāyāḥ pratipatter buddher avisamvādo 'numīyate | kasmāt (|) tadāśrayatvād āptavādāśrayatvaṃ cācāryapāramparyopadeśāt siddhaṃ | tadanyapratipattivat | atyantaparokṣād anyasmin viṣaye pratyakṣānumānaviṣaye pratipattivat | tato yathoktād āptavādā(d a)tyantaparokṣe 'rthe yathoktāgāmāśritā buddhiḥ śabdaprabhavāpi satī śabdād utpannāpi | śābdavad iti yathānyaḥ śābdaḥ pratyayo 'bhiprāyamātraṃ nivedayati | tathā neyaṃ buddhir abhiprāyam eva nivedayati | evakārasya bhinnakramatvāt |
kiṃ tarhīṣṭasya pratyakṣānumānāgamyasyārthasyānantaroktena nyāyenāvisamvādād anumānam api pravṛttikāmasya puṃso 'bhiprāyavaśāt | vastutas tv ananumānam, śabdānām arthais saha sambandhābhāvāt | asyaivārthasya khyāpanārtho 'piśabdaḥ.
PVSV 1.217
prakārāntareṇāptavādāvisamvādaṃ darśayann āha – atha vetyādi. heyaṃ sarvaṃ duḥkham. upādeyaṃ sarvakleśaprahāṇam, nirvāṇam. tayos tattvam aviparītaṃ rūpaṃ duḥkhasatyasya nirodhasatyasya ca sahopāyena yad vartate, heyopādeyatattvaṃ tasyopāyam. heyasyopāyaḥ samudayasattyaṃ | upādeyasyopādeya(?yo) mārgasatyaṃ | asya heyopādeyatattvasya sopāyasya bhagavaddarśitasya vastubalāyātena pramāṇena prasiddhito niścayataḥ kāraṇāt | bhagavadvacane satyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇasya pradhānasyārthasyāvisamvādaḥ (|) satyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇo 'rthaḥ pradhānan tadadhigamena nirvāṇaprāpte | tasmāt pradhānārthāvisamvādāt | bhagavadvacanād utpannaṃ jñānaṃ paratrāpy atyantaparokṣe 'py (p.395) arthe 'numānam. vāśabdaḥ pūrvaprakārāpekṣa yā vikalpārthaḥ.
tayor heyopādeyor upāyau tadupāyau | heyaṃ copādeyaṃ ca tadupāyau ceti dvandvaḥ | teṣān tadupadiṣṭānān tenāptenopadiṣṭānāmavaiparītyam anumānena nirūpyamāṇānāmavitathatvam avisamvādaḥ | yathā caturṇṇān duḥkhādīnām āryasatyānāṃ dvitīye paricchede | vakṣyamāṇayā nītyā vicāreṇa | tasyāsyeti bhagavatā pūrvanirdiṣṭasyādhunā vibhaktatvād asya sattyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇasya | kiṃbhūtasya puruṣārthopāyoginaḥ | puruṣārtho nirvāṇaṃ tatropayogaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ sa yasyāsti tathā | ata evābhiyogārhābhyāsārhasyāvisamvādād viṣayāntare 'pi pratyakṣānumānāgamye | tathātvopagama ity avisamvādopagamo na vipralambhāya | na visamvādāya bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anuparodhāt | pramāṇenābādhanāt | pradhāne ca sattyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇe 'rthe puruṣam avisamvādyapunas tṛtīye sthāne vaktur niṣprayojanaṃ yadvitathābhidhānan tasya vaiphalyāt |
tadācit tatrājñānād api tathābhidhānaṃ syād iti ced āha – tad ityādi | ubhayathāpīti ślokadvayanirdiṣṭena prakāreṇa | tad etad āgamasyānumānatvam agatyopavarṇitam iti sambandhaḥ | anumānakāraṇatvād anumānam iti draṣṭavyaṃ | āgamāt pravṛttau satyām varam evaṃ yuktād āgamāt pravṛtto na tu pramāṇagamya evārthe visamvādakād iti |
na khalv evam uktenāpi prakāreṇāgamāśraye jñānam anumānam anapāyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ | kasmād (|) anāntarīyakatvād asamvādatvād artheṣu śabdānām iti niveditam etad. nānantarīyakatābhāvāc chabdānām vastubhiḥ sahe (1|213) tyādinā (|) puruṣasyātiśayāḥ (p.396) kṣīṇadoṣādikatvan tam apekṣyate yadvacanan tad yathārtham apare vādino vidurjānīyuḥ | yathārthaṃ yathāvastu vyavasthitan tathaiva darśanaṃ jñānaṃ yathārthadarśanaṃ | tadādir yasya kṛpāvairāgyādes tad yathārthadarśanādi | sa eva guṇas tena yuktaḥ puruṣa āptas tena praṇayanan tenāptavacanam āgamasyāvisamvāda ity anye | (220-21)

 iṣṭa ityādi siddhāntavādī | yoyam anantaroktorthaḥ sa iṣṭosmākaṃ | kintu śakyeta jñātuṃ puruṣanaiyam yena yotiśayo yathā darśanādilakṣaṇasya tu śakyaḥ |
 sarva evetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sarva eva prekṣāpūrvakārī | āgamamanāgamamvānveṣate nirūpayati | anāgamantyaktvāgamadvāreṇa pravṛttikāmaḥ | na vyasanenāsaktimatreṇa | pravṛttikāmatām api netyādināha – apināmeti kathan nāma | ata ityāgamād anuṣṭheyaṃ sākṣāt karttavyam arthaṃ jñātvā pravṛttaḥ sannarthavān phalavān syām bhaveyam iti | sonveṣamāṇaḥ puruṣaḥ śakyaṃ darśanaṃ niścayo yasminn arthe pratyakṣānumānagamye tasyāvisamvādaḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyām avadhānaṃ | sa eva pratyayovalambanan tenānyatrāpi pratyakṣānumānāgamyepy arthe pravartteta | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) evaṃprāyatvāl lokavyavahārasya (|) evam ityekadeśāvisamvādadarśanenānyatra pravarttanaṃ | prāyo bāhulyena yasmin lokavyavahāre sa tathoktaḥ |
 puruṣaparīkṣayā punaḥ pravṛttāv abhyupagamyamānāyāṃ pravṛttir eva na syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya puṃsas tathābhūtasya yathārthadarśanā diguṇayuktasya | nāniṣṭer apravṛttir eva syād iti sambandhyate | tenāyam artho na punar yathārthadarśanādiguṇayuktānāṃ puṃsāmavitathābhidhāyitvenāniṣṭer apravṛttir eva syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) tādṛśāṃ yathārthadarśanādiguṇayuktānām avitathābhidhānāt | yathāvasthitavastuprakāśavāt |
 kiṃ puna kāraṇan tathābhūtaḥ pumān jñātum aśakya ity āha – tathā hītyādi | ayaṃ pumānevandoṣavān | na vā | evandoṣavān | kintu nirdoṣa ityevamanyadoṣānirdoṣatāpi (p.397) vā durbodhety apare viduḥ | nirdoṣatety etadapekṣayā durbodhety ekavacanena strīliṅgena ca nirdeśaḥ | anyadoṣā ity etadapekṣayā tu durbodhā iti pulliṅgabahuvacanābhyāṃ vipariṇāmaḥ karttavyaḥ | kasmād (|) durbodhatvād duḥprāpyatvād anyaguṇadoṣaniścāyakānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ (|)
 caitasebhya ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | samyag mithyā ca pravṛttiḥ kāyavākkarmalakṣaṇā yeṣāṃ puṃsān te tathā | cetasi bhavāḥ caitasā guṇadoṣāḥ | caitasebhyo guṇebhyaḥ kṛpāvairāgyabodhādibhyo hetubhyaḥ samyakpravṛttayaḥ yathārthapravṛttayaḥ | caitasebhyo doṣebhyo rāgādibhyo mithyāpravṛttāyo viparītapravṛttayo bhavanti | te ceti pareṣāṃ caitasā guṇadoṣāś cetodharmatvenātīndriyāḥ | tato na pratyakṣagamyāḥ | nāpy anumānagamyā atīndriyatvād eva svabhāvaliṅgasyāsiddheḥ | kintu svasmād guṇadoṣarūpāt prabhava utpādo yasya kāyavākkarmaṇaḥ | tena kāryaliṅgenānumeyāḥ | tac ca nāsti | yasmād vyavahāraś ca kāyavākkarmalakṣaṇāḥ prāyaśo vā bahulyena | buddhir pūrvam iti kṛtvā pratisaṃkhānenānyathāpi karttuṃ śakyante | tathā hi sarāgā api vītarāgavad ātmānan daśayanti | vītarāgāś ca sarāgavat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣecchāvṛttitvād vyavahārāṇāṃ puruṣecchayā vṛttiḥ pravṛttir yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ |
 yadi nāma puruṣecchāvṛttayo vyavahārās tathāpi kim ity anyathā kriyanta ity āha – teṣāṃ ceti puṃsāṃ citrābhisamdhitvāc citrābhiprāyatvāt tato yatheṣṭaṃ vyavahārāḥ pravarttanta iti nāsti guṇadoṣaprabhavāṇāṃ vyavahārāṇām vivekaniścayaḥ (|) tad iti tasmād ayam anumātā pumān liṅgasaṃkārāl liṅgavyabhicārād aniścinvan kṣīṇadoṣaḥ katham āgamasya karttāraṃ pratipadyeta naiveti nigamanīyaṃ |
 atha kim ityādi | yo nirdeṣo rāgādidoṣarahitas tādṛśaḥ puruṣaḥ kin naivāsti | astīti pratipādayann āha – sarveṣām ityādi | pratipakṣasammukhībhāve nirhrāsamapacayaṃ (p.398) pratipakṣāsammukhībhāve cātiśayam upacayaṃ śrayante ye rāgādayas te nirhrātiśayāśritāḥ | teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ vipakṣatvāt | yasya ca sammakhībhāvāsammkhībhāvābhyāṃ nirhrāsātiśayam bhajante sa eva teṣāṃ vipakṣo bādhakas tena saha varttata iti savipakṣaḥ | tadbhāvas tattvan tasmāt | sa bādhakatvād iti yāvat | yena ca bādhakena doṣāṇāṃ savipakṣatvan tasya bādhakasyābhyāsāt punaḥ punar nairantaryeṇotpādanād ya sātmībhāvas tadaurjjityantanmayā | tasmād bādhakasātmībhāvād dhīyeran | kṣīyaren | āsravā rāgāgadayaḥ kvacit santāne sātmībhūtadoṣapratipakṣe doṣāṇāṃ ca bādhakaṃ nairātmyajñānam iti pratipādayiṣyati | tasmān na tathābhūtaḥ puruṣo neṣyate etāvan tu brūmaḥ sa tu kṣīṇāsravo durjñāna iti |
 doṣo hītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | doṣā hi rāgādayaḥ | kiṃbhūtā (|) nirhrāsātiśayadharmāṇaḥ | apakarṣotkarṣasvabhāvāḥ santo vipakṣābhibhavotkarṣaṃ vipakṣakṛto yobhibhavastiraskāras tasyotkarṣāpakarṣaṃ sādhayanti gamayanti | tenāyam arthaḥ (|) nirhrāsadharmāṇaḥ vipakṣābhibhavotkarṣaṃ sādhayanti bādhakābhibhavotkarṣeṇa doṣāṇāṃ nirhrāsāt atiśayadharmāṇo bādhakābhibhavāpakarṣaṃ sādhayanti | bādhakābhibhavamāndyena teṣām atiśayadharmatvāt | jvālādivat | ādiśabdācchītoṣṇasparśādiparigrahaḥ | yathā jvālādayo bādhakasyodakāder utkarṣāpakarṣe sati nirhrāsātiśayadharmāṇo yathākramamudakādyabhibhavotkarṣaṃ sādhayanti tadvat |
 nanu ca bāhyārthapratibaddhā rāgādayaḥ bāhyaṃ ca vastu nityaṃ sannihatam eva (|) tatkathaṃ rāgādīnām uccheda ity ata āha – te hītyādi | hiśabdo yasmādarthaḥ | te rāgādayo vikalpaprabhavāḥ | vikalpādayoniśomanaskāralakṣaṇāt prabhava utpāda eṣām iti vigrahaḥ | tathā hy ayoniśomanaskāram antareṇa saty api bāhyerthe notpadyante rāgādayaḥ tatsammukhībhāve na vināpy arthenotpadyanta iti vikalpaprabhavā rāgādayaḥ | tataḥ saty apy upādāne yathoktalakṣaṇe | anādaravivakṣāyāṃ ceyaṃ saptamī | kasyacit manoguṇasya nairātmyadarśanalakṣaṇasyābhyāsāt | apakarṣiṇaḥ apacayavanto bhavantīty arthaḥ |
 etad uktam bhavati | yady api tāvad doṣanidānasya sarvadā nocchedaḥ pratipakṣasyātyantapāṭavābhāvāt (|) tathāpi pratipakṣābhyāsāt mandīkṛtasāmarthyād upādānād apakarṣiṇaḥ kṣāmakṣāmatarā doṣā bhavantīty anena hetur uktaḥ | yadā tu yathoktasya (p.399) manoguṇasya bhāvanāprakarṣaparyantavarttitayā pāṭavaṃ jātan tadā tatpāṭave | tasya manoguṇasya pāṭave sati | anvayaḥ kleśabījamanvety utpadyate 'smād doṣa iti kṛtvā (|) nirgatonvayo yasmin vināśe sa niranvayavināśaḥ (|) sa dharmo yeṣān doṣāṇān te niranvayavināśadharmāṇaḥ | vāsanayā saha vināśadharmāṇa ity arthaḥ | jvālādivat | yathā jvālādayaḥ pratipakṣasyodakāder utkarṣe saty atyantavināśadharmāṇas tadvat | prayogaḥ punaḥ (|) ye yadupadhānādapakarṣiṇas te tadatyantavṛddhau tadabhibhavān niranvayavināśadharmāṇah | tad yathā jvālādayaḥ salilābhibhavavṛddhau | nairātmyadarśanopadhānc cāpakarṣadharmāṇo doṣā iti svabhāvahetuḥ |
 yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena syād api kaścin nirdoṣaḥ | katham ityādi paraḥ | yāvatety ayan nipāto yadety asminn arthe varttate | doṣasātmano vipakṣotpattivad iti cānādikālābhyāsāt | doṣasātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ vipakṣotpattir nairātmyadarśanotpattiḥ | evandoṣavipakṣasya nairātmyadarśanasya sātmatvepi yathāpratyayaṃ | yathākāraṇasannidhānan doṣotpattir api syāt |
 nāyam ity ācāryaḥ | sarvasāṃsārikopadravarahitatvād nirupadravaḥ | bhūtaviparītam anityādisvalakṣaṇam artho viṣayosyeti bhūtārthaḥ | bhūtārthagrahaṇād eva ca mārgaścittasvabhāvaḥ | nirupadravaś cāsau bhūtārthaś ceti nirupadravabhūtārthas tathābhūtaś cāsau svabhāvaś ceti karmadhārayagarbha eva karmadhārayasamāsaḥ nirupadravyasya bhūtārthasya bhūtārthatvenābhyāsāt sātmībhāvagate (|) anena ca cittasvabhāvasya doṣapratipakṣasya viparyayair yathoktāt trayād vilakṣaṇaiḥ sopadravairabhūtārtharasvabhāvaiś ca doṣair na bādhanaṃ | sātmībhūtaṃ mārgam abhibhūya na doṣāṇām utpattir ity arthaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yatnavattve pītyādi | etad āha – sātmībhūtasya mārgasya doṣotpādanāya yat na eva na sambhavati |
 tathāpy abhyupagamyocyate (|) doṣotpādane yatnavattve buddhes tatpakṣapātataḥ | tasmin na doṣapratipakṣabhūte guṇavati nairātmyamārge | pakṣatātena bahumānataḥ | doṣotpādane (p.400) yatnannivarttya | guṇapakṣapātena doṣapratipakṣa eva yatnādhānād iti yāvat |
 svabhāvapadam eva tāvadādau vyācaṣṭe | na hi svabhāvo nairapmyadarśanalakṣaṇaḥ pratipakṣasātmani vyavasthitena puruṣeṇa | ayan tena prayatnena vinā nivartayituṃ śakyaḥ śrotriyakāpālikaghṛṇāvad iti | yaḥ śrotriyaḥ san kāpāliko bhavati tasya śrotriyāvasthāyāṃ yā ghṛṇā sā yathā yatnamantareṇa na śakyate nivartayitun tadvat | mārgasvabhāvanivartanāya yatnaśca kriyamāṇaḥ | prāpyasya rāgādisvabhāvasya guṇadarśanena nivarttyasya vipaśyanāsvabhāvasya doṣadarśanena kriyeta | tac ca doṣadarśanaṃ vipakṣasātmanaḥ doṣapratipakṣasātmanaḥ puṃso doṣapratipakṣena sambhavati | tathā tac ca guṇadarśanam vipakṣasātmano doṣeṣu na sambhavati |
 kasmāt punaḥ pratipakṣe doṣadarśanan na sambhavatīty āha – tasyetyādi | tasya pratipakṣasya nirupadravatvāt | trividho hy upadravo yasyābhāvān nirupadravo mārgaḥ | tathā hi cittam vibaddhaṃ hetur doṣopadravo yaiś cittam vivaddham bhūtārthadarśane na pravartate | kāyacittavyathāhetur duḥkhadaurmanasyopadravaḥ | sāsravasukhasyāpraśāntatayā tadupabhoge vairasyodvegaś ca |
 tatra prathamasyopadravasyābhāvam āha – sarvadoṣahāner iti | sarvasya rāgādidoṣasya hāner vigamāt |
 paryavasthānetyādinā dvitīyasyābhāvam āha – rāgādisammukhībhāvaḥ paryavasthānaṃ ca janma ca paryavasthānajanmanī | tayor yatprativaddhan duḥkhan tasya vivekāt | rāgādyutpattikāle yad duḥkhaṃ kāyacittaparidāhalakṣaṇan tatparyavasthānapratibaddhajātijarāvyādhyādiduḥkhan tu janmapratibaddhaṃ |
 tatīyasyopadravasyābhāvam āha – praśametyādi praśamo rāgādivirahalakṣaṇaṃ nirvāṇaṃ | tasmin yatsukhamanāsravan tasya rasa asvādastasyānudvejanāt | avaimukhakaraṇāt | abhūtārtham abhataviṣayaṃ khalv api rāgādi | na syād iti sambandhaḥ |
 yady abhūtārthaṃ kathan tarhi tasyotpattir ity āha – upādānabalabhāvīti vitathaavikalpavāsanābalabhāvi (p.401) | tadevaṃbhūtarāgādibījāśrayasya vijñānasantānasya viparyayopādānāt rāgādiviparyayalakṣaṇasya pratipakṣasya parigrahān na syān notpadyeta | na tu bhūtārtham aviparītaviṣayaṃ na bhavet | kintu bhaved eva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastubalapravṛtteḥ | yathāvasthitavastusāmarthyenotpatteḥ | doṣasātmyepi tāvat sthitasya | pramānāny anityādibhatākāragrāhīṇi | pratipakṣamārgamāvahanti | (222-23)

 kiṃ punar vipaśyanā sātmani sthitasya | abhūtārthaś ca doṣā rāgādayaḥ | ātmātmīyādhyāropiterthe pravṛtteḥ | te pratipakṣasya bhūtārthasya yat sātmyaṃ svabhāvatvan tasya vācino na bhavanti | yata evaṃ tasmān na punaḥ prahīṇadoṣāṇāṃ doṣotpattiḥ | doṣotpādanayatnepi buddher guṇapakṣapātena kāraṇena rāgādipratipakṣa eva yatnādhānāt prayatnasya karaṇāt | kasya parīkṣāvato yuktyā vicārakasya doṣasātmyepi tāvat sthitasya | viśeṣeṇātiśayena guṇeṣv eva yatnādhānamaduṣṭātmanaḥ pratipakṣasātmani sthitasya |
 kaḥ punar eṣān doṣāṇāṃ prabhava utpattikāraṇaṃ | prabhavaty utpadyatesmād iti kṛtvā | yasya doṣahetoḥ pratipakṣābhyāsena prahīyaṃte |
 uttaram āha – sarvāsām ityādi | doṣajātīnān doṣaprakārāṇāṃ jātir utpattiḥ satkāyadarśanāt | ātmātmīyābhiniveśāt |
 nanu cāvidyāhetukāḥ kleśā āgame uktās tat kathaṃ na vyāghāt ity āha – sā 'vidyeti saiva satkāyadṛṣṭir avidyā | tato nāsti virodhaḥ | kena punaḥ krameṇa doṣāṇāṃ satkāyadarśanād utpattir ity āha – tatretyādi | tatrātmātmīyatvenābhini(vi)ṣṭe viṣaye | tatsnehaḥ | atmātmīyasnehaḥ | tasmād ātmātmīyasnehāt dveṣādisambhava iti kramaḥ |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | nāham ity ātmākārapratiṣedhaḥ | na mamety ātmīyākārasya | anātmākāreṇa nātmīyākāreṇa capaśyataḥ puruṣasya | parigraham antareṇeti | (p.402) ātmātmīyatvena tadanugrāhakatvena parikalpya grahaḥ tena vinā na kvacit viṣaye snehaḥ | na cānanurāgiṇaḥ ātmātmīyādisneharahitasya kvacid dveṣaḥ | anunayam antareṇa tasyābhāvāt | kiṅkāraṇam (|) ātmātmīyetyādi | ātmātmīyor anuparodhiny apratikūlavarttini | udāsīnapakṣe | tadabhāvāt tasya dveṣasyābhāvāt | uparodhapratighātini ceti | ātmātmīyatvena gṛhītasya ya uparodhaḥ pīḍā | tatpratighātini tatpratiṣedhaṃ kurvati | mitrapakṣe tadabhāvāt | dveṣābhāvāt | kiṃtv ātmātmīyasnehaviṣayabhūtavirodhena | yaḥ sthitaḥ pratikūlavarttī | tatraiva dveṣaḥ | tasmān nātmātmīyasneham antareṇa dveṣa iti | tasmād ityādinā nigamanaṃ | yata evaṃ tasmāttau ceti | ātmadarśanātmīgrahau | snehaṃ prasuvāte iti vacanavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | sa ca sneho dveṣādīn prasūte janayati |
 tayos tarhy ātmadarśanātmīyagrahayoḥ ko hetur ity āha – samānetyādi | samānajatīyan tad evātmadarśanan tasyābhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyenādikālam utpattiḥ | tadvāsanā na | tasmāj jātamātmadarśam ātmīyagrahaṃ prasūte | tasmāt satkāyadarśanajāḥ sarve kleśāḥ | (223-24)

 tad eva ca satkāyadarśanam ajñānam avidyety ucyate siddhānte |
 yenaiva satkāyadarśanam evā 'vidyā 'ta eva kāraṇāt mohonidānaṃ pradhānakāraṇan doṣāṇāṃ rādādīnām abhidhīyate sūtrantare1* --- "avidyāhetukāḥ sarvakleśā" iti satkāyadṛṣṭir doṣāṇāṃ nidānam anyatra sūtrāntarebhidhīyate | kasmāt | tatprahāṇe satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ prahāṇe doṣāṇāṃ prahāṇaḥ | "mohan doṣanidānaṃ" doṣa kāraṇam āhur buddhā bhagavantaḥ | kasmād (|) amūḍhasyājñānarahitasya doṣān utpatteḥ punar anyatra pradeśe satkāyadṛṣṭin doṣanidānam āhuḥ | tac caitat kāraṇatvaṃ mohasya satkāyadṛṣṭeś ca pradhānahetunirdeśe sati syān na hetumātranirdeśe | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) anekasmād indriyaviṣayo 'yoniśomanaskārakalāpāj janama yeṣān doṣāṇān teṣām ekasmāt mohāt satkāyadṛṣṭeś cotpattivirodhāt | tasmād anyakaraṇasambhavepi pradhānyaṃ gṛhītvā mohasatkāyadṛṣṭyoḥ kāraṇatvam uktam iti gamyate |
fn. 1: buddhavacane

 yadi cānyo mohonyā ca satkāyadṛṣṭis tayoś ca prādhānyan tadā na ca dvayor mohasatkāyadṛṣṭyoḥ prādhānye saty ekaikanirdeśaḥ | kvacit mohasyaiva nirdeśaḥ kvacit satkāyadṛṣṭer evety arthaḥ | na parabhāgabhāk śobhābhāk vaktur akaiśalamevāvahatīti yāvat | yadā punar anayor na svabhāvabhedaḥ | tadā mohaśabdena satkāyadṛṣṭiśabdena cobhayathāpy ekasyārthasya paryāyeṇa nirdeśena na virodhaḥ prādhānyasya | prādhānyaṃ punas satkāryadarśanasya tadupādānatvena doṣāṇām upādānatvena (|) tac cānantaram eva pratipāditaṃ | pratipādayiṣyate ca dvitīye paricchede |
 tasya ca satkāyadarśanasya praḥāṇe sati doṣāṇāṃ prahāṇataḥ prādhānyaṃ | yata evaṃ tasmāt sambhavati satkāyadarśanāj janma yeṣān doṣāṇān tteṣāṃ tasya satkāyadarśanasya pratipakṣe nairāmyaadarśanan tasyābhyāsāt prahāṇaṃ |
 sa ca kṣīṇadoṣaḥ pumānauddeśiko duranvayo durbodho yadupadeśād yasya kṣīṇadoṣasyopadeśād ayaṃ pravṛttikāmaḥ pratipadyeta. tenopadiṣṭam artham anutiṣṭheta ||o|| (25)

 yathetyādinā kārikārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | rāgādiparīto rāgādiyuktaḥ | deyeti karuṇā | saiva sātmībhūtā dharmatā | ādiśabdāt prajñāśraddhādi | tair yuktaḥ | tattasmād yathā vacanasya puruṣāśrayāt mithyārthatā | tathā sattyārthatāpi | sa iti puruṣaḥ | tām api sattyārthatān nivartayati | na kevalaṃ mithyārthatāṃ | iti puruṣanivṛttau taddharmayoḥ sattyārthatvamithyārthatvayor nivṛttāvānarthakyaṃ vede syāt |
 atha puruṣanivṛttāv api sattyārthateṣyate | tadā sattyārthatāviparyayo mithyārthatā vā syāt |
 (5) syād mataṃ – na puruṣāpekṣayā śabdānām arthavattā kin tu svabhāvata evety āha – na hītyādi | prakṛtyā svabhāvenārthavantaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) samayāt saṃ ketāt | tataḥ śabdebhyorthakhyāter arthapratīteḥ | kāyasaṃjñādivat | hastavikārākṣinikocādayaḥ kārasaṃjñā | yathā tatra samayāt kvacid arhtapratipattistadvat | yadi punaḥ svabhāvata eva śabdā arthaprakāśakāḥ syustadā na samketam apekṣeran | tasmān na svatorthaprakāśanayogyatā śabdānāṃ (|) kin tarhy aprātikūlyantu yathāsaṃketaṃ pravṛttir eva śabdānāṃ yogyatā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) samaye saṃketakāle tasya saṃketakarttur yatra niyoktum icchā tayā yatheṣṭaṃ śabdānāṃ praṇayanāt pravṛtteḥ | yadi punar nisargasiddhāḥ svabhāvasiddhāḥ kvacid arthe śabdāḥ syus tadā nisargasiddheṣu puruṣecchāvaśād yatheṣṭaṃ (p.408) saṃketenārthapratipādanāyogāt |
 tasmād anarthakāḥ svataḥ śabdāstenarthakāssantaḥ puruṣas saṃskārāt puruṣasaṃketād arthavantaḥ | atha mābhūdanarthakatvam iti puruṣasaṃskārāpekṣayārthavattvanteṣām iṣyate | tadā pauruṣeyatayaiva syāt | yasmāt tatsaṃskāryataiva puruṣasaṃskāryataiva caiṣāṃ śabdānāṃ pauruṣeyatā | na puruṣād utpattiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tata eva puruṣasamayād evārthavipralambhād visamvādāt | na puruṣād utpatter vipralambhaḥ | yasmād utpannopi puruṣāc chabdonyathā samita iti mithyārthatāvirodhena yathābhāvaṃ samitaḥ saṃketitaḥ | noparodhī na bipralambhakaḥ | tadanya iti śabdādanyaḥ puruṣadharma unmeṣanimeṣādiḥ svatornarhtakopi yathābhāvaṃ puruṣeṇa samito na vipralambhakastadvat |
 upasamharan nāha – tad iti | tasmād ayaṃ puruṣo nivartamānaḥ svakṛtasamayāt sambhava utpādo yasyā arthapratibhāyāḥ arthabuddhes tām api nivartayati | tad iti tasmāt | kutas tannivṛttyā tasya puruṣasya nivṛttyā sattyārthatā kin tv ānarthakyam eva syāt |
 etena yaducyate |

 yatpūrvāparayoḥ koṭyoḥ paraiḥ sādhanam ucyate |
 tannirākaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛtārthā vedavādinaḥ ||

 pūrvā vedasya yā koṭiḥ pauruṣeyatvalakṣaṇā (|)
 parā vināśarūpā ca tadabhāvo hi nityateti |1
fn. 1: Ślokavārttika

 tadapāstaṃ satyapauruṣeyatve nityatve ca vedasyānarthakyenākṛtārthatvāt |
 (6) atha punar utpattir eva pauruṣeyatā na samayākhyānanna saṃketakaraṇaṃ pauruṣeyatā tenāpauruṣeyatvād eva yathārtho veda iti bhāvaḥ |
 evam apy arthajñāpanahetur arthābhivyaktihetuḥ saṃketaḥ puruṣāṣraya puruṣecchānurodhī (p.409) na yathārtham avaśyam varttata iti girāmāpauruṣeyatvebhyupagamyamāne | ataḥ puruṣecchānurodhinaḥ saṃketāt mithyātvasambhavaḥ |
 (7) kim ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | asyeti vedasya yato hi samayāt saṃketādarthpratītir arhtaprakāśanaṃ sa samayaḥ pauruṣeyas tato vitathopyalīkopi syāt | svātantryāt | tataś ca śīlaṃ sādhanaṃ hetur yasya svargaysa | tathābhūtaś cāsau svargaś ca sumerupṛṣṭhalakṣaṇastasya yadvede vacanantadanyathā samaye na viparyāsayet | niratiśayā prītiḥ svarga itye vamviparītārthaṃ kuryād agnihotrādisādhanena ca viparītārthaṃ kuryāt tena kāraṇenāyathārtham api prakāśanasambhavāt (|)
 sa eva doṣo yaḥ pauruṣeyeṣūktaḥ (|) puruṣadoṣāt sambhāvyavipralambhaḥ pauruṣeya iti |(228)
 (8) nanv apauruṣeya eva śabdārthayoḥ sambandhaḥ | tathā hi yathedānīntanā vṛddhāḥ pūrvaprasiddham eva śabdārthasambandham upadiśanti | tathā pūrvapūrvavṛddhā apīty anāditvād apauruṣeya eva sambandhaḥ | taduktaṃ |
 "śabdārthānāditāṃ muktvā sambandhānādikāraṇaṃ |
 asti nānyadato vede sambandhādir na vidyata" iti1
fn. 1: Ślokavārttika
 sa ca sambandhastripramāṇakaḥ | tathā hi (|) śrotur arthapratipattaye kena cid vṛddhena śabde prayukte 'nyaḥ pārśvasthaḥ pratipattā prayoktāramvācyaṃ vācakaṃ pratyakṣeṇa pratipadyate | śrotuś ca pratipannatvaṃ pravṛttidvāreṇāvagacchati | arthapratipattyanyathānupapattyā ca śabdārthaśritā vācyavācakaśaktiṃ cāvagacchatīti tripramāṇaka eva sambandhaḥ | taduktaṃ ||

 "śabda(ān) vṛddhāmidheyāṃśca pratyakṣeṇātra paśyati |
 śrotuś ca pratipannatvam anumānena ceṣṭayā ||
 anyathānupapattyā ca buddhyecchaktiṃ dhayāśritāṃ
 arthāpattyā ca budhyante sambandhantri pramāṇakam iti |"

 (p.410) tatrāha – sambandhāpauruṣeyatva ityādi | śabdārthayos sambandhāpauruṣayatvebhyupagamyamāne syāt pratītir arhtapratipattir asamvidaḥ | saṃketajñānaṃ samvit | sā na vidyate yasya tasya | akāryaḥ puruṣair ajanyaḥ sambandho yeṣān te tathā | te śabdā artheṣu vācyeṣu puruṣair yathārthaprakāśakatvāt | svabhāvādanyathā viparyasyante vitathajñānahetavo na kriyante | tenāviparyāsenādoṣo visamvādalakṣaṇo doṣo nāsti | idānīm iti sambandhāpauruṣeyatve kiṃ saṃketena prayojanaṃ | yasmāt sa hi śabdārthayos sambandhaḥ sa ced arthapratītihetuḥ sambandhopauruṣeyas tadā nāyaṃ puruṣo nisargasiddhasambandhatvāc chabdād arthaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ samayamapekṣeta | pradīpādivat | apekṣate ca saṃketantasmān na śabdānām arthena sahāpauruṣeyaḥ sambandho rājacihnādivat |
 (9) syānmatam (|) apauruṣeya eva sambandhaḥ sa tu saṃketanirapekṣo pratītyāśraya ity āha – apratītyāśrayorthapratīter evāśrayo vā kathaṃ sambandhaḥ (|) naiva | pratītyanyathānupapattyā sambandhakalpanāt | pratītyabhāve kathaṃ sambandhaḥ | atha (|)
 "jñāpakatvāddhi sambandhaḥ svātmajñānam apekṣate |
 tenāsau vidyamānopi nāgṛhītaḥ prakāśakaḥ
 sarveṣām anabhivyaktānāṃ pūrvapūrvaprayoktrṛtaḥ (|)
 siddhaḥ sambandha ity evaṃ sambandhādir na vidyata iti |"

 tatrāha – saṃketetyādi | saṃketena tasya sambandhasyābhivyaktau | asamarthā niṣphalā saṃketādanyasya sambandhasya kalpanā |
 etaduktam bhavati | saṃkete saty arthapratīter utpattir asati cānutpattir ity anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ saṃketa evārthapratīteḥ kāraâm iti kiṃ sambandhenānyena |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | anabhivyakto prakāśitorthapratītihetuḥ | enam iti sambandhaṃ sa tarhīti sambandhaḥ | saṃketādevārthapratipādane siddhe sati upasthātuṃ sīlaṃ yasya sa (p.411) sambandhaḥ kimakāraṇa kasmān niṣphalaṃ poṣyate |
 (10) naiṣphalyam evāha – nanv ityādi | ityānetāvanmātra eva | yadarthe vācye pratīter jñānasya jananaṃ | tatpratītijananaṃ samayena kṛtam iti niṣphalas sambandhaḥ | nāyogye samayassamarthaḥ | kin tarhi ya evārthapratipatyanyathānupapatyā pratipādakena samarthaḥ pratipannaḥ śabdastatraiva saṃketaḥ samartha iti yogyatā sambandhaś cet | taduktaṃ

 "śaktir eva hi sambandho bhedaś cāsyā na dṛśyate |
 sā hi kāryānumeyatvāt tadbhedam anuvarttate" iti || (saṃbaṃ° 28)

 atrāha – tatkim ityādi |
 evam manyate | naikā śaktiḥ śabdārthayoḥ sthitā kin tu śabdasthā hi vācakaśaktir anyārthe sthātaṃ vācyaśaktir anyaiva | yadā tu śabdaśktiḥ sambandhas tadā ya eva sambandhas sa eva sambandhī prāpta iti pṛcchati (|) tatkimvai śabdaḥ sambandhos tu |
 nanv anyā hi yogyatā 'nyaś ca śabdastatkathaṃ śabdassambandha ity ata āha –
 yasmāt samarthaṃ hi rūpaṃ śabdasyārthapratipādanaṃ prati yogyatā | kāryakāraṇayogyatāvat | kāryakāraṇāya yogyatā kāryakaraṇayogyatā | yathā kāraṇasyātmabhūtā | tadvat | sā cet iti yogyatā tataḥ śabdādarthāntaraṃ tadā kiṃ śabdasya bhavatīti śabdayogyatayos sambandho vācyaḥ | anyathā śandasyeyaṃ yogyateti na sidhyet | yārthāntarabhūtā yogyatā tasyāṃ śabdasyopakāra iti cet | śabdena yogyatāyā upakāraḥ kriyata iti yāvat | tena śabdajanyatvāc chabdhasya yogyatety ucyata iti bhāvaḥ | na śandenopakāro yogyatāyāḥ (|) kutaḥ (|) nityāyā yogyatāya niratiśayatvāt | atha yogyatāyā api śabdena vyatirikta evopakāraḥ kriyate | tadā tasya śabdakṛtasyopakārasya yogyatayā kaḥ sambandha iti vācyaṃ | atha tatrāpy upakāre yogyatayānya upakāraḥ kriyate tadā tatrāpy upakāre yathoktavidhinā 'parāparasyopakārasya kalpanāyām atiprasaṅgāt | tatonavasthāyām upakārāsiddheḥ saiva yogyatayā saha śabdasya sambandhāsiddhiḥ | kiñ ca vyatiriktāṃ yogyatām upakurvāṇaḥ śabdaḥ svarūpeṇaivopakaroti na pararūpeṇa | śabdasyānupakārakatvaprasaṅgāt | (p.412) tadā yogyatāyāṃ ca svataḥ svarūpeṇa śabdasya yogyatve 'rtha eva śabdasvabhāvaḥ pratītijananayogyaḥ kinneṣyate | kiṃ pāramparyeṇeti yāvat | tasmān na yagyatā sambandho na ca sārthapratītihetuḥ | samavāyādevārthapratīteḥ |
bauddhasyāpi tarhi samayaḥ kathaṃ śabdārthayos sambandhaḥ (|) kathaṃ ca na syāt puruṣeṣu vṛtteḥ | asyārthasyāyaṃ vācaka ity arthakathaṃ sa ma yaḥ | sa ca puruṣeṣu varttate na śabdārthayoḥ | na cānyadharmonyasya dharmo 'śvadharma iva goḥ |
 (1) ācāryas tu na kevalaṃ samayo na sambandhonyopi bhāvikaḥ sambandho nāstīty āha – netyādi | tathā hi bhāvānāṃ rūpaśleṣo vā sambandhaḥ syāt | pāratantryaṃ vā parasparāpekṣaṇaṃ vā | tatrāmiśrāṇāmparasparabhinnānāṃ na kaścid rūpaśleṣalakṣaṇas sambandhaḥ | teṣām abhedaprasaṅgāt | ekatvāpatteḥ | tathā siddhānāṃ niṣpannānāṃ rūpāṇāṃ na kaścit pāratantryalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ (|) siddhe pāratantryāyogāt | parasparāpekṣālakṣaṇopi sambandho nāstīty āha – anapekṣaṇāc ceti | siddhasya sarvanirapekṣatvāt |
 (2) ka. yadi tarhi śabdārthayor nāsti sambandhaḥ kathan tarhi śabdārthapratītiḥ | kathaṃ ca śābdaṃ jñānam anumāne 'ntarbhāvyate | samayo vā tadā kiṃprayojana iti (|)
 āha – arthaviśeṣetyādi (|) arthaviśeṣo yaḥ pratipādanābhiprāyeṇa viṣayīkṛtaḥ | tasya samīhā pratipādanecchā | tayā preritā janitā vāk sūcayati prakāśayati svanidānapratibhāsanam arthaṃ | vācaḥ svanidānaṃ pratipādanābhiprāyaḥ | tatprakāśinaṃ kasya sūcayati | ata idam iti viduṣaḥ | ataḥ pratipādanābhiprāyāt sakāśādidamvacanamāgatam iti yo viddhān tasya | iti evaṃ buddhirūpasyābhiprāyalakṣaṇasya vāgvijñapteś ca janyajanakalakṣaṇas sambandhaḥ | tataḥ śabdāt pratipattir avinābhāvād iti (|) tato janyajanakabhāvād vākyādarthapratipattiḥ |
 tena yaduktaṃ (|) padād artham atir yady apy anumānaṃ vākyāt tv arthapratītiḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ (p.413) sambandhāgrahāt (|) na cātrāvinābhāva upayogīti (|)
 tadapāstaṃ | avinābhāvam antareṇa vācyavācakabhāvasyābhāvāt |
 yad apy uktaṃ (|) kathaṃ śabdād arthapratipattiḥ | kathaṃ ca śābdaṃ jñānam anumānentarbhavatīti | tatparihṛtaṃ (|)
 kha. idānīṃ samayaprayojanam āha – tadākhyānam ityādi | tadākhyānam avinābhāvākhyānaṃ samayaḥ | ākhyāyateneneti kṛtvā | tata iti samayāt pratyāyakasyārthapratipādanāṅgasyāvinābhāvalakṣaṇasya siddheḥ pratīteḥ | upacāreṇa samayasya sambandhākhyānāt sambandhavyapadeśaḥ | na tu punaḥ sa eva samayo mukhyaḥ sambandhaḥ |
 tena yaducyate |

 "samayaḥ pratimarttyamvā pratyuccāraṇam eva vā |
 kriyate jagadādau vā sakṛdekena kenacid" iti (|) nirastaṃ |

 ga. nanu yady avinābhāvena śabdārthapratītis tadā śabdasyārthapratipādanaṃ vācakatvena na syāt | dhūmasyevāgnipratipādanaṃ | yadi ca śabdārthayos samayena vinā bhāvākhyānāt samayas sambandha ucyate | agnidhūmayor api samayaḥ syād iti |
 naiṣa doṣo yasmāt | imam artham akṛtasamayenāpi śabdena pratipādayāmīty evamarthasya vācyatvaṃ śabdasya ca vācakatvam āropyārthapratipādanābhiprāye sati yadā śabdaṃ prayuṅkte tadā śabdasya vācakarūpasyaivotpattiḥ |
 gha.nanv arthapratipādanābhiprāyeṇa varṇṇā eva janyante na ca vācakā varṇṇā iṣyante tatkatham ucyate 'bhiprāyād vācakasya śabdasyotpattir iti |
 sattyaṃ (|) kevalamvaktṛśrotror varṇṇaṣveva vācakābhimānād vācakasyaivotpattir ucyate | tasmād asyaiva vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇasyābinābhāvasya śabdārthasambandhasya mūḍhaṃ prati ākhyānaṃ samayas sambandha ucyate | na tu sarvam eva kāryakāraṇabhāvākhyānaṃ samayaḥ (|) tena na dhūmādau sambandhaḥ samaya ucyate | yady api saṃketavyavahārakālayoḥ śabdārthasambandhasya bhedas tathāpi sādṛśyādekatvādhyavasāyena lokasya pravṛttiḥ | ata eva ca yam eva śabdārthasambandhaṃ pūrvapratipannaṃ vaktā kathayati tam eva śrotā pratipadyate | tena yaducyate ||

 "prayekaṃ sa ca sambandho bhidyetaiko 'thavā bhavet |
 ekatve kṛtako na syād bhinnaśced bhedadhīrbhavet | (saṃbaṃdha° 14)
 vaktṛśrotṛdhiyo bhedād vyavahāraś ca (na) duṣyati |
 vaktur anyo hi sambandho buddhau śrotus tathāparaḥ |
 (p.414) śrotuḥ kartuñca sambandham vaktā kaṃ pratipadyate |
 pūrvadṛṣṭo hi yastena taṃ śrotur na karoty asau |
 yaṃ karoti navaṃ sopi na dṛṣṭaḥ pratipādaka" iti (|)

tadapāstaṃ | sarvatra vācyavācakasambandhānāmbhinnānām apy ekatvādhyavasāyena lokasya pravṛtteḥ (|) na cāpy anāditā teṣāṃ pratyabhijñāyā apramāṇatvād iti |(229)
 ṅa. astu vā 'vinābhāvasambandhād anya eva nityaḥ śabdārthayos sambandhaḥ | tena sambandhena girāṃ śabdānām ekārthaniyame sati punaḥ samayaviśān na syād arthāntare yatrāsau śabdo na niyamitastatra gatiḥ pratipattiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | na hi tenaikārthaniyatena sambandhenāsambanddherthe pratītir yuktā | kasmāt (|) tasya sambandhasya vaiphalyaprasaṅgāt | na bhavaty eva tatra pratītir iti (|)
 āha – dṛṣṭaś cetyādi | puruṣecchāvaśāt kṛtaḥ samayosyeti dīpakaḥ prakāśakaḥ |
 aneketyādi | anekārthena śabdasyābhisambandhebhyupagamyamāne yady ekārthaniyamena samayakārobhivyaktiṃ karoti | tadābhimata evārthe karoti na tv anyasminn eva viruddhe iti nāsti niyamas tato biruddhavyaktisambhavaḥ | abhīṣṭād biruddhasyāpy arthasyābhibyaktiḥ sambhāvyate |
 athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ekārthapratiniyame samayavaśād anekārthapratipādanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ virudhyate (|) tasmāt tasya dṛṣṭasya virodho mā bhūditi sarve śabdāḥ sarvasyārthasya vācakāḥ |
 ca. tathetyādinā viruddhavyaktipratipādanaṃ | yathā sarve sarvasya vācakā iṣyante tathedam apy avaśyameṣṭavyaṃ (|) na ca sarvārthaḥ sarvasya kāryasya sādhaka iti nyāyaprāptatvāt | nyāyaṃ cāha – saṃkarād iti | pratiniyatatvāt kāryakāraṇatāyāḥ | tatraitasmin nyāye sati pratiniyatam viśiṣṭam eva vastu sādhanaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasyā bhimatasyārthasya sādhyasya svargādeḥ | tasmin viṣayabhūte | śabdasya kimviśiṣṭasya (|) (p.415) sarvetyādi | sarveṣāṃ sādhyānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ yathāsvaṃ yāni sādhanāni kāraṇāni teṣāṃ vācakatvena sādhāraṇasya tasya śabdasyeṣṭavyaktim eva viśiṣṭasādhyasādhyakatvenābhimata evārthebhivyaktiṃ samayakāraḥ karotīti kuta etat |
 etaduktam bhavati | ya evārtho vastusthityā svargasādhanaḥ kimtatraiva samayakāreṇāgnihotrādiśabdobhivyaktaḥ kimvānyasminn eva svargasādhanaviruddherthe buddhimāndyād iti sandeha eva |
 sa iti śabdaḥ sarvasmin vācakatvenāniyato niyamaṃ kvacid arhte puruṣāt puruṣasaṃketāt pratipadyate | sa ca puruṣo 'viruddhepy arhe saṃketaṃ puryāt | tathā ca na kevalaṃ viruddhavyaktisambhavo yāpīyamapauruṣeyatā vedasyeṣṭā tasyā vyārthā syāt parikalpanā | api nāmeti | kathannāma | asaṃkīrṇṇam aniṣṭenāsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ | iṣṭam evārthamapauruṣeyebhyaḥ śabdebhyo jānīyām iti kṛtvā saṃkarasyeṣṭāniṣṭavyatikarasya hetuḥ puruṣopādīrṇṇo vahiskṛ(?ṣkṛ)to vaidikebhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ | tatraivam avasthite yādṛśāḥ śabdāḥ pauruṣeyābhimatāḥ puruṣaiḥ kvacid vivakṣiterthe prayuktāssaṃkīryante 'niṣṭābhidhāyakatvasambhāvanayā | tādṛśā evāpauruṣeyābhimatā api śabdāḥ sarvārthasādhāraṇāssantaḥ kvacidarthe taiḥ puruṣaiḥ samayena yatheṣṭaṃ viniyamitāḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) teṣāṃ puṃsāntattvāparijñānāt | prakṛtyaiva svabhāvenaiva vaidikāḥ śabdā niyatā abhimaterthe (|) tato na puruṣasaṃskārakṛto doṣa iti cet | evaṃ saty arthaprakāśane nopadeśam apekṣeran | apekṣante ca | svatastebhyorthapratīter abhāvāt | yadi ca te svabhāvata eva pratiniyatāḥ syus tadā yatra kvacidarthe ekadā samitāḥ punaḥ kathaṃcit tatonyathāsaṃketenārthāntaraṃ na prakāśayeyuḥ | prakāśayanti ca | tato na prakṛtyaikārthaniyatā (p.416) iti | svabhāvataścaikārthaniyame | yoyamvaidikeṣu vākyeṣu vyākhātṝṇāṃ vyākhyāvikalpaś cāparāparavyākhyābhedaś ca na syāt | ekārthapratiniyamāt | bhavati ca | tasmāt pauruṣeyavākyavannaikārthaniyatā vaidikāḥ śabdā iti |
 cha. atha syāt (|) niyata evārthe teṣām upadeśa ity ata āha – upadeśas yetyādi | vyākhyābhedena śakyorthanānātvavikalpo yasmin vaidike vākye tattathoktantasmin śakyavikalpe vaidike vākye | vyākhyātṝṇāṃ ya upadeśas tasyeṣṭasamvādo nāsty ayam api kadācid syād asyārtho(yama)nyo veti niyamābhāvāt | iti hetovyārthaivāpauruṣeyatā | tām api kalpayitvā vyabhivātāsaṃkāyā anivṛtteḥ |
 ja. yaś ca śabdārthayoḥ sambandham icchati tena vācyaś ca hetuḥ sambandhasya vyavasthiteḥ | sambandhavyavasthāyāḥ | keṣāṃ (|) bhinnānāṃ parasparabhinnānāṃ śabdārthānāṃ | (1) na tāvac chabdārthayos tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ | yasmād arthā hi bāhyā ghaṭapaṭādayaḥ śabdasya na rūpaṃ na svabhāvaḥ | śabdarūpatve hi ghaṭādīnāṃ abhāvaḥ syāt | nāpi śabdorthānāṃ rūpam artharūpatve hi śabdarūpāhāniprasaṅgāt | yenābhinnātmatayāntarīyakatā syāt | avinābhāvitā syāt | vyavasthābhedepīti vyāvṛttibhedasamāśrayeṇa sādhyasādhanabhedepi | kimiva | kṛtakatvā 'nityatvavat | yathā kṛtakatvānityatvayorvyāvṛttibhedepy ekātmatayā nāntarīyakatā | tadvat |

 (ka) na tāvadādhyaḥ pakṣaḥ | yasmān nāpy ete vaidikā dhvanayo vivakṣājanmāna iṣyante | vivakṣāto janma yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | nityatvābhyupagamāt | ajanmāno vā anutpannā vā santo nāpi vivakṣāvyaṅgyāḥ | nityatvahāniprasaṅgāṭ | vyaṅgyānām utpādyatvād ity uktaṃ prāk |
 (kha) nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa ityāha – nārthāyattā iti | nāpi bāhyārthāyattāḥ | nityatvād eva |
 anye tv ekam eva granthaṃ kṛtvā vyācakṣate | yasmān na vivakṣājanmāno nāpi (p.417) tadvyaṅgyāḥ | tasmād ubhayathāpi nārthāyattā na bāhye vastuni pratibaddhā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ | yataś ca nārthāyattāstataḥ tasmāt | idānīm iti sambandhābhāve | tadanvayaṃ tasyārthasyānvayaṃ sadbhāvaṃ te śabdāḥ kathaṃ sādhayeyuḥ | naiva sādhayeyuḥ | kimbhūtaṃ (|) tatpratiniyamasaṃsādhyaṃ | tasmin bāhyerthe tādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ yaḥ pratiniyamaḥ śabdānāṃ tena saṃsādhyaṃ | bāhyerthe 'pratibandhena niyamābhāvāt | (232)
 3. uktam evārthaṃ ślokena saṅgṛhṇāti | asaṃskāryatayetyādi | (1) sarvayeti | yadi puruṣair arthābhiprāyeṇa śabdā na kriyante nāpi saṃketyante | tadā pumbhirasaṃskāryatayā hetubhūtayā vaidikānāṃ śabdānānnirarthatā syāt | yasmāt puruṣasaṃskāraprabaddhe śabdānāṃ sattyārthatvamithyārthatve | tena tadabhāvānnirarthataiva syāt | (2) nirarthatāparihārārthaṃ punaḥ puruśasaṃskāropagame kriyamāṇe mithyārthatāpi syād iti mukhyaṃ gajasnānam idam bhavet | gajo hi paṅkāpanayanāya snātvā punaḥ paṅkenātmānamavakiratīti | nityo 'nityo vā syād iti vastuno gatyantarābhāvāt | (3) puruśecchāvṛttiḥ puruṣecchāvaśād utpannaḥ syādākuñcanādivat | avṛttir vā | nāsya puruṣecchayā vṛttiḥ | aṅkurādivat | tatrānityā puruṣādhīnatvapakṣe deśādiparāvṛttyā | deśādīnāmanyathātvena ādiśabdāt kālāvasthāgrahaṇaṃ | puruṣāṇāṃ yathābhiprāyamiti yena puruṣeṇa yathā pratipādayitum iṣṭan tathā tena śabdena pratipādanna syād iti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣapratipādanecchāyāṃ satyāmapyanāyattasya śabdasya kadācid yogāt puruṣeṇa niyoktuṅ kadācid apy aśakyatvād ity arthaḥ | parvatādivat | yathā parvatādayaḥ puruṣānāyattāḥ satyāmapīcchāyāṃ na yatheṣṭaṃ niyoktumpāryante (|) tadvat | dṛṣṭaś ca deśadiparāvṛtyā yathābhiprāyaṃ pratipādanaṃ | tasmāt puruṣeṣvanāyattaḥ sambandha iti |

 kha. api cetyādi tatraiva dūṣaṇāntaram āha – dvividho hi śabdānāṃ viṣayaḥ sākṣājjātistallakṣitā ca vyaktir iti | (1) tatra yadi vyaktyā saha sambandhas tatrāha – sambandhināṃ vācyānām arthānāṃ anityatvāt | teṣu vinaśyatsu sambandhasyāpi tadāśritasya vināśa iti na sambandhesti nityatā | parāśraya iti parassambandhī āśrayosyeti kṛtvā | sambandhini sambandhasyāprativandhe sati tayoḥ sambandhinossanbandhitayā ayogāt | na hy apratibaddhena kenacit kaścit tadvān bhavati gaurivāśvena | sa vāśrayaḥ śabdārthasambandhasyānityorthānām anityatvāt | apāye vināśesyāśrayasya sambandhasyāpy āśritasyāpāyaḥ | pradīpāpāye prabhāyā iva tadāśritāyāḥ | anyathā yady āśrayāpāyepy āśrito nāpaitītīṣyate tadāśrayābhimate sambandho nāśritaḥ syāt | tat āśrayavināśevināśān na nityāḥ sambandhaḥ | (p.419) tadāśrayārthaś ca vaktavyaḥ | tasya sambandhasya sambandhinau kenārthenāśrayād ity āśrayārtho vācyaḥ | upakārārtho hy āśrayārthaḥ | sa ceha nāsti (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) nityasya sambandhasyānupakāryatvādanādheyātiśayatvād anupakurvāṇaś cāśrayābhimato nāśrayaḥ syāt |

 atha tasyāpi śabdasya tadutpattisahakāritve sambandho (tpa) tiṃ prati sahakāritve kalpyamāne | samarthasya śabdasya nityotpādanaprasaṅgaḥ | sarvakālaṃ sambandhajananaprasaṅgaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sahakāryanapekṣatvāt | anapekṣatvaṃ punarnityasya śabdasya sahakāribhiranupakārāt | athāsamarthaḥ sahakāryapekṣayā janayet | tadā prāksambandhajananaṃ pratyasāmarthepi paścād apy arthe sannidhikālepyaśaktiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pūrvāsamarthasvabhāvātyāgāt | vastubhūte sambandhe yo doṣoyamvikalpate buddhisandarśite sambandhe nāsti |

 etaduktambhavati | buddhiparikalpitaḥ sambandhastvatparikalpitaḥ sambandhastvatparikalpiteṣv api nityeṣu na virudhyate | tasmāt sa evāśrayituṃ yukto na vāstava iti | yaduktaṃ prāgāśrayasyāpāyena kāraṇenāśritasya sambandhasya vināśādanityaḥ sambandha iti | tatraitasmin dūṣaṇe nityatvāt sambandhasyāśrayāpāyepyanāśo yadi jātivadityucyate | yathā jāternityatvādāśrayanāśeyanāśastadvat sambandhasyeti | (235)
 atrāpy āha – nityeṣv āśrayābhimateṣu jātyādiṣv api kāyaṣu kimāśrayasya sāmarthyannaiva | yeneṣṭaḥ sokiñcitkara āśrayaḥ | śrūyata ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | śrūyata ityanena prasiddhimātrametannirvastukam ity etad āha (|) vyaktyāśritā | kevalannityeṣu jātyādiṣvāśrayasāmarthyamāśrayakṛtamupakāranna paśyāmo yenāsāvāśrayābhimata āśrayaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kutasya siddhasvabhāvasya kāraṇābhāvāt | akārakasya cāśrayasyānapekṣatvāt | (236)

yatparamityuttaraṃ pūrvāparaparāmarśena(?ṇa)samastavarṇṇaviṣayaṃ vijñānantadarthapratītinimittaṃ | tadbhavedityarthapratipādanambhavedanyenāpi yaugapadyajñānenārthapratipādanambhavedityartha iti |

pratipadamantyo varṇṇā yayā buddhyā gṛhyate sā sannihitāsannihitavarṇṇaviṣayatvena smaraṇapratyakṣarūpeti kecidāhuḥ |
 tadapyayuktam (|) ekasya jñānasya pratyakṣāpratyakṣarūpavirodhāt | na ca pratyakṣamevaikaṃ sadasadvarṇaviṣayaṃ | abhāvaviṣayatvavirodhāt | nāpi smṛtirūpaṃ sannihitaviṣayatvenāniṣṭatvāt | ata eva ca padādigrāhakajñānaṃ kalpitaviṣayaṃ syāditi |
 anye tvantyavarṇâparijñāne sati pūrvavarṇṇānubhavāhitasaṃskāraprabodhakāritaṃ smaraṇaṃ sarvavarṇeṣvarthapratyāyakamāvakṣate | tadāha –

 apauruṣeyatāpi vedavākyānāṃ mī māṃ sa kai riṣṭā | karttṛṇāṃ vedasya praṇetṝṇāmasmṛterliṅgāt | kila śabdaścāyuktatākhyāpanāya |
 yāpītyādi vyākhyānaṃ | bahūnāmarthānāṃ karttā na svaryate | na ca te tāvatā 'kṛtakāḥ | tadyathā jīrṇṇakūpādayaḥ | evaṃ hetorvyabhicārādayuktarūpāpīyamapauruṣeyatā | vedavākyānāṃ kartturasmaraṇād varṇyate jaimininā | asyaivamvidhasya vastunaḥ santyadyatvepyanuvaktāra (p.438) iti | kimatra vaktavyaṃ kevalaṃ dhigvyāpakantamaḥ | tathā hi (|) yaḥ kartturasmaraṇādapauruṣeyatāmāha jaiminiḥ | tasyaiva tāvadīdṛśamatisthalaṃ prajñāskhalitaṃ kathaṃ vṛttaṃ jātamiti kṛtvā saha vismayenānukampayā varttata iti savismayānukampaṃ nosmākaṃ cetaḥ | śrutavatopyevamavidyāvilasitamiti savismayaṃ | gāḍhenāvidyābandhena sattvāḥ pīḍyanta iti kṛtvā sānukampaṃ | tadatrāparepīdānīntanmatānusāriâḥ kumārilaprabhṛtayaḥ parīkṣakaṃmanyā evametadanuvadantīti nirdayaṃ niṣkṛpamākrāntaṃ bhuvanaṃ jagad yena tamasā tattthoktaṃ dhigvyāpakantamaḥ | ajñānasyaivātradhigvādo yukto na prāṇinaḥ | yasmāt kaḥ prāṇina evaṃ vādinopi hitepsāvipralabdhasya hitaprāptīcchayā vipralabdhasya visamvāditasyāparādhaḥ | kintvajñānasyaivāyandośaḥ | kiṃ punastasyaivamvadataḥ prajñāskhalitaṃ |
 yasmādidaṃ sādhanamasiddhamanaikāntikañca |(242)
 tatrāsiddhamadhikṛtyāha – tathā hītyādi | smaranti saugatāvedasya karttṛnaṣṭakādīn | ādiśabdād vā madevaviśvāmitraprabhṛtīn | hiraṇyagarbhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vedasya karttāraṃ smarantikāṇādāvaiśeṣikāḥ | tataścāsiddhaṃ kartturasmaraṇaṃ | teṣāṃ saugatānāñca sa vedasya karttṛsmaraṇavādo mithyāvādastataḥ | siddhihetoriti cet | ka idānīmvedādanyopi pauruṣeyaḥ śabdaḥ | na kaścit pauruṣeya ityarhtaḥ | evamiti karttuḥ smaraiavādasya mithyātve | etadeva spaṣṭayannāha – kumārasambhavetyādiṣvityādi | kumārasambhavādiṣu grantheṣu kālidāsādaya ātmānamanyamvā praṇetāraṃ karttāraṃ vyapadiśanto yadevamprativyūhyeran | pratikṣipyeran (p.469) | mithyāvādo yuṣmākaṃ na yūyaṃ praṇetāra iti | tatra kumārasambhavādau karttuḥ prativahanebhyupetabādhā | kumārasambhavādīnāṃ pauruṣeyatvenābhyupagatatvāditicet | nanvidameva kartturasmaraṇamapauruṣeyābhyupagameṅgam sādhanaṃ | tacca kumārasambhavādāvastīti yathoktena nyāyeneti kathamanena pauruṣeyaḥ kumārasambhavādiriṣṭa iti kasya kena bādhā | atha tulyepi nyāye kumārasambhavādau karttuḥ prativahanebhyupatabādhanamiṣyate | tadetadabhyupetabādhanamparasyāpi vedavādinopi vedavākyeṣu praṇetṛprativahane tulyameva | tasya vedavādino vedāpauruṣeyatvamiṣṭamato pauruṣeyatvasyeṣṭatvāt karttuḥ prativahanepyadośaḥ | abhyupetavādhādoṣo nāstīti cet kutosya vedavādinaḥ āgamopādānanimittatāyāḥ parīkṣāyāḥ prāgiyamapauruṣeyo veda ityeva miṣṭirabhyupagatiḥ | apramāṇikā pramāṇarahitā āsīt | tathā hi vedasyāpauruṣeyatvābhyupagame karttursmaraṇaṃ pramāṇamuktaṃ | tatra cānantaramukto doṣa ityapramāṇikeyamiṣṭaḥ |
 atha pramāṇamantareṇa vedasyāpauruṣeyatvamaṅgīkṛtavān vedavādī | tadā 'kasmād grāhī yuktyā vinā grāhakaścāyaṃ mīmāṃsakaḥ kimpunaḥ kvacit pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyatvādau sādhanaṃ pramāṇamapekṣate | yaditi pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyacintayeti pauruṣeyāpauruṣayatvasādhanopanyāsenātmānamāsādayati | yo hyayuktigrāhī sa sarvatra tathaiva pravarttatāṃ | kimiti kvacit pramāṇāvatāraṇenātmānaṃ duḥkhayatīti samudāyārthaḥ |
 tata evāpramaṇikāyā vedasyāpauruṣeyatveṣṭerhetorvedavādino vedasya karttuḥ pratibahanepyanabhyupetabādhāyāmiṣyamāṇāyāntadanyasyāpi tasmāt mīmāṃsakādanyasyāpi puṃsaḥ kumārasambhavādimapauruṣeyamicchatastatpraṇetṛprativahanepyanabhyupetabādhanaṃ tulyamityanupālambhaḥ | tatra prativahanebhyupetabādhetyayamupālambho nāstītyarthaḥ |
 kiṃ cānatiśayadarśītyādi | evaṃ prakārāṇāṃ kartturasmaraṇādityevamādīnāmapauruṣayatvasādhanānāṃ vākyeṣu pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyatvābhimateṣcanatiśayadarśīti sambandhaḥ | tathā hi yathā pauruṣeyāṇāmanekeṇāṃ karturasmaraṇamasti | (p.440) tathā vedavākyeṣvevaṃ kartturasmaraṇādisādhanasyānatiśayadarśī viśeṣadarśī san mīmāṃsakaḥ | puruṣakāryāṇāṃ vā śabdānāṃ dharmāḥ kāryadharmāḥ puruṣānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvādayasteṣāṃ kāryadharmāṇāmvākyeṣu laukikavaidikeṣvanatiśayadarśī san kvacid vaidike śabdetiśayaṃ viśeṣamapauruṣeyatvalakṣaṇamabhyupeti nānyatreti na kiñcidabhyupagame sādhanamastītyapratyayevāyuktevāsya vedavādino vṛttiḥ |
 tadevaṃ yathoktavidhinā kartturasmaraṇādityasiddho hetuḥ | anaikāntikatvamapyāha – dṛśyante cetyādi | upadeśapāramparyaṃ sampradāyaḥ | vicchinnaḥ kriyāsaṃpradāyaḥ puruṣakṛtatvasaṃpradāyo yeṣāṃ vaṭe vaṭe vaiśravaṇādi śabdānānte tathā | anenāsmaryamāṇakarttṛtvamāha – kṛtakāśca pauruṣeyāśca | tataḥ pauruṣeyepi vākye kartturasmaraṇambarttata ityanaikāntikoyaṃ hetuḥ | tāniti vicchinnakriyāsampradāyān | kṛtakān śabdān | yatnavantaḥ pumāṃsamupalabhante 'nena kṛtā iti | naitadevam | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | yatnavatopi karttuḥ smaraṇe niyamābhāvāt | nāvaśyaṃ karttāramupalabhate yatnavānapīti sandeha eva |
 kiñca (|) anyatrāpauruṣeyābhimatepi śabdesya karttā nopalabhyata ityanupalambhasya | upalabhyate vāsyāpauruṣeyasya karttetyupalambhasya na pramāṇāt kutaścinniścayaḥ | kintu paropadeśāt kiṃbhūtādapratyayādapramāṇakāt | evaṃbhūtāccopadeśāt kartturupalambhānupalambhasyāniścayārhatvāt | mayā vedavākyāni kṛtānītyevaṃvādinonupalambhād vedavākyeṣu kartturabhāvo niścīyata ityetadapi nāsti | svayaṃkṛtānāmapi śabdānāmapahnotṛdarśanāt | svayaṃkṛtvāpi śabdā na mayaite kṛtā ityapalapitāro dṛṣyante | tatra ca kimanenaite kṛtāḥ kimvānyeneti niṣṭhāgamanasya niścayagamanasyāśakyatvāt | (242)
 tadevaṃ kartturasmaraṇāditi hetunnirākṛtyānyadapi sādhanaṃ |

 yata evantasmānnaikasya vedakriyāśaktirahitasya parapūrvakamupadeṣṭṛpūrvakamadhyayanandṛṣṭaṃ sarvasya hiraṇyagarbhāderapyadhyayanasya tathābhāvaṃ parapūrvakatvaṃ sādhayati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yasyādhyayanasyānyathā parapūrvakatvamantareṇa yo sambhavastasyābhāvāt | svayamuparacayyādhyayanaṃ na sambahvedityarthaḥ | hiraṇyagarbhādīnāmvedaracanāyāṃ śaktisambhavāt | yastu śaktivikala idānīntanastasya tathāvidhasya svayaṃ kṛtvā vedamadhyetumasamarthasya | tatkriyā vedakriyā tasyāṃ yā pratibhā tayā rahitasya vedakaraṇasamarthayā vuddhyā rahitasyetyarthaḥ | evaṃ bhūtasya puruṣasya yadadhyayanantattathā syādadhyayanāntarapūrvakaṃ syāditi kṛtvā | tathābhūtamiti vedakriyāśakrirahitasya yadadhyayananantadeva | evam vākyaṃ syādadhyayanāntarapūrvakaṃ vācyaṃ syānnāviśeṣeṇa | yatpunaradhyayanaṃ (p.447) puruṣātiśayasambhavena svayam kṛtvādhyayanāt sambhavadviśeṣaṃ | aviśeṣeṇa sarvamadhyayanamadhyayanāntarapūrvakamityucyamānaṃ vyāptyasiddhyā vyabhicāritvānna chāyāṃ puṣṇāti | vivakṣitasādhyāsādhanāt |
 kathamityādi paraḥ | viśeṣasya svayaṃ kṛtvā vedabāhyānāmadhyayanasya sambhavaḥ kathaṃ | yāvateti yadetyarthaḥ | teṣāmapi puruṣāṇāṃ vedasya karttṛtvenābhimatānānvedaracanāyāmaśktiḥ puruṣatvādinānīntanapuruṣavat |
 atrāpītyā cāryaḥ | atrāpi prayoge | na śaktipuruṣayoriti | vedakaraṇasya śakteḥ puruṣasya ca parasparaṃ | na kinncid cirodhadarśanamasti | tataśca brahmādiṣu puruṣatvaṃ hetutvenoktamaviruddhatvānna vedakaraṇaśaktimapanayati | tasmānnāviruddhavidhiḥ | aviruddhasya vidhiryasminnanupalabdhiprayoge  sa evaṃbhūtonupalabdhiprayogo na gamakaḥ | birodhābhāva eva kathamityāha – na hītyādi | atīndriyeṣvatyantaparokṣeṣu brahmādiṣu vedakaraṇaśaktyā saha | sahānavasthānalakṣaṇasya virodhasya pratītiḥ | atīndriyatvādeva | nāpi parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇasya virodhasya pratītiḥ | śaktyaśaktyoḥ puruṣāpuruṣatvayośca parasparamvirodhāt | na śaktipuruṣayoryaḥ puruṣaḥ sa vedakaraṇaṃ pratyaśakto yathedānīntanaḥ puruṣa iti na cāyaṃ prayogaḥ puErvaprayogād iti yadvedādhyayanantadvedādhyayanapūrvakamidānīntanavedādhyayanavadityetasmāt parvaprayogāt bhidyate | tasmādubhayorupādānaṃ vyarthamevetyabhiprāyaḥ |
 yatpunarucyate | yadi puruṣāḥ prāktanā vedam kṛtvā svayamadhyetuṃ śaktāḥ syustadedānīntanā api syuriti |
 atrocyate | puruṣāṇāmviśeṣāsmbhave satyetadanantaroktaṃ syāt | sa ca puruṣāṇāṃ viśeṣāsambhavā(d)  dussādhyaśakyasādhanaḥ | bādhakābhāvāt | tasmād yatraikasya puruṣasyāśaktistatra sarvapuruṣāṇāmaśaktiḥ (|) puruṣatvādityasminnapi sādhane pūrvavadadhyanatvādivat puruṣatvaṃ liṅgaṃ vyabhicāri | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | bhāratādiṣvapi pauruṣeyābhimateṣvidānīntanānāṃ puruṣāṇāmaśaktāvapi kasyacid vyāsādeḥ puruṣātiśayasya (p.448) śaktisiddheḥ |
 yata evantasmāt kāraṇāni vivecayatā vaidikānāṃ vākyānāṃ tālvādivyāpāraṃ kāraiamapanayatā | artheṣu laukikavaidikeṣu śabdeṣu (|) kimbhūteṣu | tadatatpratibhaveṣu tālvādikāraṇeṣvatatkāraṇeṣu svabhāvabhedo darśanīyaḥ | tālvādikāraṇānānī dṛśaḥ svabhāvo tatkāraṇānāmanyādṛśyaḥ svabhāva ityevaṃ svabhāvanānātvam darśanīyaṃ | yena tadatatprabhavatvamvibhāgena jāyate | tadabhāve svabhāvabhedābhāve sarvastadātmā bhavet | sarvaḥ śabdaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ syānna vā kaścillaukikakopi |
 atha syād (|) astyeva tayoḥ svabhāvabheda ityāha – na cātretyādi | atra jagati laukikavaidikayorvākyayoḥ svabhāvanānātvaṃ paśyāmaḥ | asati tasmin svarūpabhede tayorlaukikavaidikavākyayossāmānyasyaiva tulyarūpasyaiva varṇṇānukramalakṣaṇasya darśanādekasya laukikavaidikasya vākyasya kiṃvid dharmmaṃ vivecayan pauruṣeyatvamapauruṣeyatvamvā vibhāgena vyavasthāpayan puruṣa āśaṃkya vyābhicāravādaḥ kriyate | āśaṃkya vyabhicāro vādo yasya puruṣasya sa tathocyate | kena kriyate | tatsvabhāvasmabhavinā tena | laukikavaidikavākyasambhavinā tena varṇiapadaracanālakṣaṇena sāmānyena | pauruṣeyatulyadharmakasya vedasyāpauruṣeyatvamvadan vyabhicāryate iti yāvat |
 nanu vedāvedayostattvānyattvalakṣaṇo vedāvedalakṣaṇo viśeṣostyeva | tato viśeṣāllaukikavaidikayoryathākramaṃ pauruṣeyatvamapauruṣeyatvambhaviṣyatīti paro manyate |
 sattyamityācāryaḥ | nanvīdṛśo viśeṣastayoḥ pauruṣeyatvāpauruṣeyatvasādhako yasmānna kevalamanayoreva laukikavaidikayorviśeṣaḥ | kintarhi (|) ḍiṇḍika purāṇetarayorapi | ḍiṇḍikairnagnācāryaiḥ kṛtasya purāṇasyetarasya ca purāṇasya | īdṛṣo (p.449) viśeṣosti | na ca tāvatā svayaṃ vyavahārārthaṃ svaprakriyābhedadīpanaḥ samayaparikalpito nāmabhedaḥ samjñnābhedaḥ puruṣakṛtimbādhate vedasya | kiṃ kāraṇm (|) anyatrāpi purāṇe 'pauruṣeyatvaprasamgāt | ḍiṇḍiketarapurāṇānāṃ nāmabhedasya vidyamānatvāt |
 yadi tu yā vedavākye varṇṇapadaracanā dṛśyate tādṛśīṃ racanāṃ puruṣāḥ karttu na śaknuyuḥ | kṛtāmvā niṣpāditāmvā varṇIapadaracanāmakṛtasaṃketaḥ śravaṇamātrād vivecayediyaṃ puruṣapūrviketi | tadā vyaktamapauruṣeyo vedaḥ syāt (|) na vivecayati tāṃ racanāntatkathamapauruṣeyo vedaḥ syāt |
 nanvityādi paraḥ | mantrā pi puruṣakṛtā evetyetaduttaratra vicārayiṣyāmaḥ | api ca na mantro nāmānyadeva kiñcit | kintarhi (|) sattyetyādi | yathā bhūtākhyānaṃ sattyaṃ | indriyamanasordamanantapaḥ | tayoḥ prabhāvo viṣastambhavādisāmarthyaṃ sa vidyate yeṣāṃ puṃsānte tathā | teṣāṃ sattyatapaḥprabhāvavatāṃ pumsāṃ samīhitārthasya sādhanantadeva mantraḥ | tadvacanaṃ mantralakṣaṇamadyatvepi puruṣeṣu dṛṣyate eva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | yathāsvam sattyādhiṣṭhānbalād viṣadahanāde(ḥ) stambhavasya sāmarthyopaghātasya darśanāt | tathā śabrāṇāṃ ca keṣāṃcit svaniyamasthānāmadyāpi viṣādyapanaynaśaktiyuktasya kāraṇācchaknuvantyeva puruṣā mantrān karttuṃ | avaidikānāñcavedādanyeṣāṃ vedādanyeṣāṃ baiddhādīnāmiti (|) ādiśabdād ārhatagāruḍamāheśvarādynāṃ mantrakalpānāṃ | mantrāṇāṃ mantrakalpā˜āñca darśanāt | vidyākṣarāṇi mantrāḥ | tatsādhanavidhānopadeśā mantrakalpāḥ | teṣāṃ ca bauddhadīnāmmantrakalpānaṃ puruṣakṛteḥ puruṣaiḥ karaṇāt |
 tasmānna laukibhyo vaidikānāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ |
 tatretyādi paraḥ | tatrāpi bauddhādimantrakalpepyapauruṣeyatve kalpyamāne kathamidānīmapauruṣeyaṃ vākyaṃ sarvamavitathaṃ | kintu mithyārthamapi syāt | tathā hītyādinaitadeva (p.450) bodhayati | bauddhamantrakalpe kiṃsāmaithunātmadarśanādayaḥ ādiśabdādanṛtavacanādaya anabhyudayahetavo duḥkhahetavo varṇyante | itarasmimstvabauddhamantrakalpe ta eva kiṃsādayonyatha cābhyudayahetavo varṇyayante | yadi ca sarve mantrakalpā apauruṣeyāḥ syustadā caitad viruddhābhidhāyi vākyadvayamekatrāpauruṣeyey katham sattyaṃ syāt |
 syādetad (|) bauddhamantrakalpe kiṃsādiśabdānāmanya evāprasiddhortho yo vaudikena mantrakalpenāviruddha iti (|) ata āha – tatretyādi | tatra bauddhe mantrakalpe prasiddhādarthādanyasyārthāntarasya kalpane kriyamāṇe | tadarthāntarakalpanamanyatrābauddhe vaidike mantrakalpe tulyamiti kṛtvā sarvatra mantrakalpeṣvarthāntarakalpanāsambhavenārthānirṇṇayāt | tatpratipāditerthe kvacit pratipattiranuṣṭhānaṃ na syāt | tathā cetyarthāniścayenānuṣṭhānābhāve sadapyapauruṣeyamvākyaṃ puruṣārthaṃ pratyanupayogaṃ |
 bauddhādīnāṃ mantratvameva nāstīti cedāha – bauddhādīnāmamantratva iti | tadanyatrāpi tasmād bauddhādimantrādanyatrāpi vaidike mantre mantratvapratipādanāya kośapānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ | na hi kācid vyaktirastītyabhiprāyaḥ | dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ caitad bauddhādayo na mantrā iti | tathā hi viṣādikarmakṛto viṣakarmādīn kurvanto bauddhā api mantrā dṛśyante | tena tatra bauddhādiṣu mantrakalpeṣvamantratvamapi vipratisśiddhaṃ | viṣakarmādikaraṇaddhāreṇa vaidikānāmapi mantratvavyavasthāpanāt | na ca viṣastambhanādisāmarthyayogāt vedavākyaṃ laukivākyādatiśayavadityevāpauruṣeyaṃ yuktaṃ |
 tathā hi pāṇyaṅgulasanniveśo mudrā | maṇḍalaṃ devatādiracanāviśeṣaḥ | dhyānandevatādirūpacintanaṃ tairanakṣarairaśabdasvabhāvaiḥ svakarmāṇi viṣādyapanayanādilakṣaṇāni kriyante | na ca tāni mudrāmaṇḍaladhyānānyapauruṣeyāṇi yujyante (|)
 syādetat (|) mudrādiṣveva puṃsāṃ karaṇasāmarthyanna varṇṇakrameṣu mantreṣviti |
 (p.451) tanna | yasmāt teṣāṃ mudrādīnāṃ kriyāsambhave satyakṣararacanāyāṃ sattyādimatāṃ puṃsāṃ kaḥ pratighāto viśeṣābhāvāt | tasmānna kiñcidaśakyakriyameṣāṃ puṃsāṃ | puṃsāṃ kaḥ pratighāto viśeṣābhāvāt | tasmān na kiñcidaśakyakriyameṣāṃ puṃsāṃ | yena puruṣeṇākṛtamatiśayamupalabhya laukikebhyo vaidikānāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ kalpyeta |
 yadi bauddhetarau mantrakalpau dvāvapi pauruṣeyo tau ca sattyaprabhavau | avitathābhidhāyipuruṣādutpannau | tatkathamidānīntāveva sattyaprabhavau bhantrakalpau bauddhetarauparasparaviruddhau yujyete | ekatra hiṃsādīnāmanabhyudayahetutvena darśanādanyatrābhyudayahetutvena |
 netyādinā pariharati | na vai sarvatra tau mantrakalpau sattyaprabhavau yenāyaṃ virodhaḥ | kintu prabhāvayuktapuruṣapratijñnālakṣaṇāvapi tau mantrakalpau staḥ | prabhāvavatā puruṣeṇa "ya imāṃ varṇṇapadaracanāmabhyasyati tadvidhiṃ cānutiṣṭhati tasyāhaṃ yathāpratijñātamarthaṃ sampādayiṣyāmī" ti yā pratijñā tallakṣaṇāvapi mantrakalpau bhavataḥ | tatonyathāvādyapi orabhāvayuktau mantrakalpau kuryādevetyavirodhaḥ | sa eva sattyābhāvāt prabhāvaḥ kuta iti vedāha sa | sa prabhāvo gatisiddhiviśeṣābhyāmapi syāt | puṇyena gativiśeṣa eva sa tādṛśo labdho devatādisaṅgṛhīto mantrasiddhiviśeṣo yena sa tādṛśaḥ prabhāvo bhavatīti |
 yadi pauruṣeyā mantrāstadā puruṣatvāt sarve puruṣāḥ kinna mantrakāriṇaḥ (|) na ca kurvanti | tasmādabhimatā api puruṣā na mantrānakārṣurityabhiprāyaḥ |
 tadityādi siddhāntavādī | teṣāmmantrāṇāṃ yat kriyāsādhanaṃ sattyatapaḥprabhāvadi tena vaikalyānna sarve puruṣā mantrakāriṇaḥ |
 yadi punastādṛśaiḥ sattyatapaḥprabhṛtibhirmantrahetubhiḥ puruṣā yuktāḥ syustadā te mantrān kurvantyeva |
 (p.452) api ca kāvyāni tatkriyāpratibhāyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ karotīti kṛtvā tatkriyāpratibhārahitopi sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣatvasāmyāt kāvyakṛt syāt | akaraṇe vā kasyacidanyopi naiva kuryāt | tadvat kāvyakaraṇāsamarthapuruṣavat | ityapūrveṣā vā co yuktiḥ | vyabhicāriṇītyarthaḥ |
 sattyamityādi paraḥ | mantrakriyāsādhanena vikalāḥ puruṣā mantrānna kurvate | kevalantadevātra mantrakriyāsādhanasya sattyādeḥ sākalyaṃ kasyacit puruṣasya na paśyāmaḥ | sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ samānadharmatvāt |
 uktamiti siddhāntavādī | atra codya uktamuttaraṃ | kimuktaṃ | na mantro nāmetyādi | vacanaṃ ca samayaśceti dvandvaḥ | sattyādimatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ samīhitārthasādhanādvacanāt | tathā sattyādiyuktapuruṣapratijñālakṣaṇācca samayānna mantronāmānyadeva kiṃcit | tāni ca sattyatapogatisiddhiviśeṣalakṣaṇāni mantrakriyāsādhanāni kvacidevapuruṣeṣu dṛśyante |
 syādetad (|) yo yaḥ puruṣasya mantrakriyāsādhanarahitastadyathā rathyāpuruṣaḥ | puruṣaścāyaṃ mantrakarttṛtvenābhimataḥ puruṣa iti | tatrāpi sarvapuruṣāstadrahitāstena mantrakriyāsādhanena rahitā ityapi tatsambhavasya mantrakriyāsādhanasambhavasya puruṣatvena saha virodhābhāvāt | anirṇṇayo 'niścayaḥ | mantrakriyāsādhanasya svabhāvanupalambhādeva puruṣe svabhāvaniśvaya iti cedāha – na cetyādi | atikṣasvabhāveṣu akṣātikrāntaḥ svabhāvo yeṣānteṣvatyantaparokṣeṣvityarthaḥ | anupalabdhirnābhāvaniścayasya hetuḥ | ātmani mantrakriyāsādhanānāṃ smṛtyādīnāmanupalambhenaparatrāpyabhāvo niścīyata iti cedāha – na cetyādi | atikrāntajanmādismaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ | paracittāvabodho matiḥ | adṛṣṭeṣu padārthatattvadarśanaṃ prativedhaḥ | sattyamananyathāvāditvam | śaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ | tā mantrahetavaḥ sarvabhāvinyaḥ | sarvapuruṣasantānabhāvinyo (p.453) bhavanti | yena tā ātmani na dṛṣṭā ityanyatrāpi pratikṣiperan |
 idānīṃ smṛtyādīmāṃ kvacideva puruṣe sambhavamāha – tatsādhanamityādi | teṣāṃ smṛtyādīnāṃ yathoktānāṃ yatsādhanamutpattikāraṇantasya saṃpradāya upadeśastasya bhedo viśeṣaḥ kvacidevāgame sambhavo na sarvatra | tadvad guṇāntarasādhanānyapi syuḥ | kvacideva puruṣe bhaveyuḥ | siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ | smṛtyādikāraṇānāṃ kāryabhūtāni yāni guṇāntarāṇi smṛtyādirūpāṇi teṣāṃ sādhanāni niṣpattayopi kvacideva puruṣe syuḥ smṛtyādikāraṇānuṣṭhānāt | yadi smṛtyādi sādhanaṃ syāt kinna dṛśyata iti cedāha – nāpītyādi | sannapi vidyamānopi santānāntarastho manoguṇo draṣṭupuruṣamātreṇa na śakyaḥ | ata eva kāraṇādadṛṣṭasya santānāntarasya manoguṇasyānapahnavopratikṣepaḥ | nāpi puruṣeṣu manofuṇasyotpitsorutpattimicchoḥ pratiroddhā bādhakosti yena tadanyaguṇātiśāyī manoguṇaḥ kasyavidapi nāstīti syāt | puruṣatvādika eva dharmo bādhaka iti cet (|) na | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tasyānyasantānabhāvino bādhyasya guṇasya puruṣamātreṇādṛṣṭeḥ | puruṣatvādinā dharmeṇa bādhyabādhakabhāvāsiddheḥ | abādhakāccāpratikṣepaḥ |
 etenāntaroktena sarvasyārthasya yajjñānantasya pratiṣedhaḥ | ādiśabdād vītarāgādipratiṣedhādayo nirvarṇṇitottarāḥ |
 yathā na vaktṛtvādiliṅgena sarvajñatvādīnāṃ pratikṣepa iti | tatrāpi bītarāgatvādipratikṣepa evambhūtaḥ puruṣo vītarāgatvādiguṇayukto neti nyāyo yuktaḥ | kiṃbhūtaḥ | yādṛśoyamasambhavantatsādhanasmpradāyaḥ | asamabhavantatsādhanasaṃpradāyo vītarāgatvādisādhanasaṃpradāyo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | vītarāgatvādisādhanenopāyena vikalassavītarāgādirna bhavatyevaṃ nyāya iti yāvat | na dṛṣṭajñāpakotatsvabhāva ityapi | adṛṣṭaṃ jñāpakaṃ vītarāgatvādi kiṅgaṃ yasya | sa jñnāpako darśanamātreṇātatsvabhāvo vītarāgatvādiguṇaviyuktasvabhāvo bhavatītyapi na yuktamvaktuṃ | na hi jñāpakānupalambhamātreṇa jñāpyasyābhāvo nyāyyaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | satāmapi keṣāṃcidarthānāṃ liṅgabhūtasya kāryasyānārambhasambhavāt | ārabdhannāma tairatīndriyaiḥ kāryantathāpi svabhāvaviprakarṣeṇāmīṣām (p.454) idaṃ kāryamiti draṣṭumaśakyatvācca | tasmānmantrakriyāsādhanavaikalyaṃ yathaikasya tathā sarvasyetyetadaśakyaniścayamiti sthitaṃ |
 yata evantasmādadhyayanamadhyayanāntaravad adhyayanāntarapūrvakamiti sādhye adhyayanāditi kiṅgaṃ vaybhicāri | bhāratādyadhyayane pauruṣeyādhyayanatvasya bhāvāt |
 vedena viśeṣaṇādadoṣaḥ | adhyayanamātrasya hi vyabhicāro na vedena viśiṣṭasyādhyayananasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | kaḥ punarityādi siddhāntavādī | kotiśayo vedādhyayanasya yena tadvedādhyayanamanyatheti svayaṃ kṛtvādhyetuṃ na śakyate | naiva kaścidatiśayaḥ (|) tato vedādhyayanaṃ ca syānna cādhyayanapūrvakamiti virodhābhāvāt sa eva vyabhicāraḥ | yasmānna hi viśeṣaṇaṃ vedatvamaviruddhaṃ vipakṣeṇānadhyayanāntarapūrvakatvena saha | asmād vipakṣāddhetunnivartayati | kim kāraṇaṃ | abiruddhayorvedatvānadhyayanāntarapūrvakatvenaivādhyayanāt | uktottarametat | bhāratādhyayanepi prasaṅgāt | tadapi hīdānīntanāḥ paropadeśenaivādhīyata iti | tasyāpyādyābhimatamadhyayanamadhyayanāntarapūrvakatvena vedavadapauruṣeyaṃ syāt | vedādhyayanapūrvakameva vedādhyayanaṃ kartturadarśanāditi cet | idamapi prāk pratyūḍhaṃ pratikṣiptaṃ | dṛśyante hi vicchinnakriyāsaṃpradāyāḥ | kṛtakāśvetyādinā | nāpyadarśanamātramabhāvaṃ gamayatīti kṛtvā vyabhicāra eva vedādhyayanatvādityasya hetoḥ | tasmāt vedatvaṃ viśeṣaṇamadhyayanasya hetoratiśayabhāg na bhavati viśeṣādhāyaknna bhavati | vipakṣavirodhābhāvena vipakṣādavyāvarttanāt | upāttamapi viśeṣaṇamanupāttasamaṃ |
 kiñca | yatkiñcad vedādhyayanaṃ sarvantadadhyayanāntaraparvakam iti vedena (p.455) viśeṣitepi hetau vyāptirna sidhyati | viparyaye bādhakapramāṇābhāvena sarvasya vedādhyayanasya tathābhāvasiddheradhyayanāntarapūrvakatvāsiddheḥ | yādṛśaṃ tvadhyayanaṃ svayaṃ karttumaśaktasya tannimittamadhyayanāntaranimittaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tattathetyadhyayanāntarapūrvakameveti syāt | svayaṃ kṛtvādhyetumaśaktasya yadadhyayanantasya dṛṣṭe viśeṣajāṅyādilakṣaṇe tannimittatayā parapūrvādhyayananimittatayā | tattyāgena tasya jāṅyādinimittasyādhyayanasya yathā paridṛṣṭe viśeṣasya tyāgena yadvā tannimittatayā śaktinimittatayā | dṛṣṭe 'vagate viśeṣesvayaṃ kṛtvādhyayanalakṣaṇe tattyāgena tasya viśeṣasya tyāgena vedādhyayanatvasāmānyasya grahaṇaṃ śaktasyāśaktasya vā sarvaṃ vedādhyayanamadhyayanāntarapūrvakamvedādhyayanatvasāmānyāditi kriyamāṇaṃ vyabhicāryeva | kimiva (|) hutāśanisiddhau | agnisiddhau pāṇḍudravyatvavat | agnisādhye dhūme yaḥ pāṇḍuviśeṣo dṛṣṭastattyāgena pāṇḍudravyasāmānyamupādīyamānamagnisiddhau yathā vyabhicāritadvadityarthaḥ |
 etenānantaroktena vyabhicāritvapratipādanena vacanādayaḥ | ādiśabdāt puruṣatvādayaḥ pratyuktāḥ | yathā tepi vyabhicāriṇa iti |
 kasmin sādhye (|) rāgādisādhane | rāgādisiddhau | yādṛśo rāgādiprabhavo vacanaviśeṣo dṛṣṭastattyāgena vaktṛtvasāmānyasya vyabhicārāt |
 astu vetyabhyupagamyāpyāha – sarvathāpyevaṃkṛtvā vedasyānāditā sidhyedādirahitatvamātraṃ sidhyeta | nāpuruṣāśrayaḥ | apauruṣeyatvantu na sidhyet |
 atha tasmādapauruṣeyamātrādevāpauruṣeyatvamiṣyate | tadā syādanyopi lokavyavahāronādipravṛttitvādanarāśrayopauruṣeyaḥ | puruṣa eva hi svayamabhyuhyopakalpyādhīyate | parato vā śrutvādhīyate teṣāṃ puṃsāmavyāpatakaraṇānāmavyāpṛtatālavādīnāṃ svayaṃ (p.453) śabdā dhvanayanti | svarūpaṃ orakāśayanti | yena svayaṃ dhvananenāpauruṣeyāḥ syuḥ | kintu puruṣavyāpāreṇaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ dhvananāllaukikavākyavat pauruṣeyatvameva |
 api syurapauruṣeyāssambhāvyata eṣāmapauruṣeyatvam yadi puruṣāṇāmādiḥ syāt | adhyayanaṃ cānādistadāpyādyasya puruṣasyādhyayanamanyapūrvakamadhyayanāntarapūrvakaṃ na sidhyati | kiṅkāraṇam (|) adhyāpayituranyasya puruṣasyābhāvāt | tatprathamodhyetā tasya vedasya prathamodhyetā svayamabhyuhya vedamadhīta iti kartaiva syād vedasya taditi tasmādayaṃ vedādhyayanalakṣaṇo vyavahāra ekasmādadhītyāparamadhyapayati | sopyanyamiti pūrvapūrvadarśanapravṛttonādiḥ puruṣavyavahāra iti puruṣairevāyaṃ racito vyavahāra iti syānnāpauruṣeya eva | kimiva (|) ḍinbhakapāṃsukriīḍāvat | ḍimbhakā bālāsteṣāṃ pāṃ sukriīḍā yathā pūrvavatdarśanapravṛttatvādanādiḥ puruṣavyavahārastadvat | ādiśabdād bhojanādibyavahāraḥ |
 anāditvādityādi | anāditvād vedasyāpauruṣeyatvebhyupagamyamāne mlecchādivyavahārāṇāmiti svakulakramāgatānāṃ mātṛvivāhādilakṣaṇānāmanāditvāt tathābhāvo vedavadapauruṣeyatvaṃ syāt |ādiśabdādāryavyavahārasyānādeḥ parigraha | tath nāstikyavacasāmapi dharmādharmaparalokāpavādapravṛttānamanāditvāttathābhāvaḥ | apauruṣeyatvaṃ syāt | anāditvameva teṣāṃ kathamiti vedāha – pūrvasaṃskārasamtateḥ pūrvasaṃskāravaśāt santānena pravṛtterityarthaḥ | mlecchavyavahārā anādayaḥ | ke punasta ityāha – mṛtepitari putreṇa mātṛvivāhaḥ kārya iti mlecchānāṃ keṣāṃcid vyacahāraḥ | ādiśabdād vṛddhānāmmāraṇaṃ saṃsāramocanārthamityādivyavahāraparigrahaḥ | ādiśabdopāttamāha – madanetyādi madanatrayodaśyāmparvaṇi madanotsavah | atrāpyādiśabdāt putrajanmotsavādayopyanādayaḥ | nāstikānāṃ laukāyati (p.457) kā nāmvacāṃsi ca | kimbhūtānyapūrvaparalokādyapavādīni | apūrvasya dharmādharmasya paralokasya cāpavādīni pratikṣepakāṇi | tānyapyanādīnīti | liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ |(248)
 katham punarmlecchādivyavahārādīnāmanāditvamityāha – na hīyādi | te ca vyavahārāstāni ca nāstikyavacāṃsīti "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccānyatarasyām"1 iti napuṃsakasyaikaśeṣaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ (|) tān vyavahārāṃstāni ca nāstikyavacāṃsi parairanyaiḥ puruṣairanāhitasaṃskārā avyutpannabuddhaya idānīntanā na pravarttayanti | kintu vyutpāditabuddhaya eva | tepyaparaistepyaparairiti siddhamanāditvaṃ |
