 na tāvad vyaṅgyasyātiśayakaraṇād vyañjakaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastunovasthitarūpasyānādheyātiśayatvāt | nāpyāvaraṇavigamakaraṇāt | āvaraṇābhāvasyākāryatvāt | nāpi jñānakaraṇād vyañjakaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | vastuvad eva tadviṣayasyāpi jñānasya satkāryavādidarśane siddhatvāt | athāsadeva jñānaṃ kriyate | tadā jñānaṃprati kārakatve kasyacidiṣyamāṇe | tathābhūtānāṃ jñānasya kārakaistulyadharmāṇāmanyeṣām api kulālādīnāntathābhāvaprasaṅgena | ghaṭādīn prati kārakatvaprasaṅgena sarvasya vastunaḥ kāryatāprasaṅgāt | viśeṣo vā vācyo yena jñānaṃ prati kārakatvaṃ na ghaṭādīn prati | na cānyo vyakteḥ prakāraḥ sambhavati |
 tasmād ayaṃ kārakābhimatorthakalāpo ghaṭādeḥ kasyacid api na vyaktāv upayujyate | vastuno nādheyaviśeṣatvādinā vyakterniṣiddhatvāt | nāpi kriyāyām upayujyate | kāryakatvānabhyupagamād iti vyartha eva syāt |
 tathā ceti kārakāṇāṃ vaikalye sati | idaṃ jagannirīhaṃ nirvyāpāraṃ syāt | kiṃ bhūtam (|) anupakāryopakārakaṃ | na vidyate upakāryamupakārakaṃ ca yasminn iti vigrahaḥ |
 kiñ ca (|) śabdanityatve sādhye (|) sādhanaṃ pratyabhijñānamaprayogādi yanmatam iṣṭaṃ | yathā nityaḥ śabda ekatvena pratyabhijñāyamānatvāt | taduktaṃ (|) saṃkhyābhāvāt | aṣṭakṛtvo gośabda uccarita iti hi vadanti | nāṣṭau gośabdā ity anenāvagamyate (p.505) pratyabhijānantīti | sataḥ prayogāt | yat prayujyate tat prāk sat | yathā vāsyādi cchidāyāṃ | prayujyate ca śabdorthapratipādane tasmātsopi prayogāt prāk sanniti | ādiśabdāt parārthamuccāryamāṇatvād ityādiparigrahaḥ | taduktaṃ (|) nityastu syāddarśanasya parārthatvāt | darśanamuccāraṇaṃ (|) tatparārthamarthaṃ pratyāyayituṃ | uccāritamātra eva vinaṣṭe śabde | na tatorthampratyāyayituṃ śaknuyādato na parārthamuccāryeteti | anudāharaṇam ity adṛṣṭāntaṃ | na hi nityaṃ kiṃcid asti yatraitatsādhanamvartteta | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgataḥ |
 etad eva tāvat padaṃ vivṛṇvannāha – kṣaṇabhaṅgino hītyādi | vināśasyākaraṇādityuktaṃ prāk | vakṣyate ca paścāt | vināśadvāreṇānityatāṃ pradarśya utpattidvāreṇāpi darśayannāha – utpattītyādi | parataḥ kāraṇād utpattimantaś ca bhāvāstatopi na nityaḥ | parata utpadyanta iti kuta etat | sattāyā ākasmikatvāyogāt | ākasmikatve deśādiniyamo na syād iti prāgevoktaṃ | tad iti tasmāt pratyabhijñānaṃ satprayogādikaṃ liṅgaṃ | sthiraikarūpe vastuni sapakṣabhūte | na kvacidanveti | aparāpareṇānyenānyena svabhāvena parāvṛttirutpattir yathā pradīpādīnānteṣv eva pratyabhijñānādiliṅgam bhedena vyāptandṛṣṭam iti viruddham eva | na cātra dīpatvādisāmānyanimittaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ sāmānyasya pūrvam eva niṣiddhatvāt |
 netyādi paraḥ | na viruddhaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | abhinnāt sthiraikarūpāj janma yasya tasyābhinnajanmanaḥ pratyabhijñānasya dīpādiṣu bhrāntyā bhāvāt | bhrāntiḥ katham iti cet | sādharmyavipralambhāt pūrvottarayoḥ kṣaṇayoryatsādṛśyantena vipralambhād vañcitatvāt | etat kathayati (|) abhrāntaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ liṅgatvenopāttantacca naiva pradīpādiṣu varttate |
 abhinnajanmetyācāryaḥ | kenāvaṣṭambhena kena pramāṇenābhinnajanmapratyabhijñānam ity ucyate | nityasya sāmarthyābhāvāt | etac ca pratyakṣasyāpi pratyabhijñānasya dūṣaṇandraṣṭavyaṃ | pratyabhijñāyamānasyābhedena pratibhāsanād iti cet (|) na (|) tasyaivābhedasya sarvatra vajropalādiṣv api paurvāparyeṇa cintyatvāt | yathā (p.506) pūrvambajrādiṣu svarūpaṃ kiṃ paścād api tadevāhosvidanyad eva kevalaṃ sādaśyādekatvavibhramaḥ pradīpādiṣv iveti cintyametat | yathā vajrādiṣv abhedasya cintyatvantathā bhedasyāpi cintyatvād iti cet | kimbhedaḥ paurvāparyeṇa pratibhāsata ity etad api nirūpaṇīyam eva |
 tenaivety ācāryaḥ | yataś ca naikāntena bhedo 'bhedo vāvadhārayituṃ śakyastenaivānavadhāraṇena saṃśayostu | pratyabhijñāyamāneṣv artheṣu bhedābhedasaṃśayo bhavatu | saṃśayādeva pratyabhijñāyamānatvād bhedaniścaya iti ced āha – na ca saṃśayitāt saṃśayaviṣayāt pratyabhijñānaliṅgācchabdasyaikatvasiddhiḥ |
 pūrvakṣaṇāduttarasya kṣaṇasya vivekādarśanād vivekāpratibhāsanāt pūrvottarakāleṣu bhāvasyaikatvaṃ siddham iti cet |
 netyādi prativacanaṃ | tenāyamartho bhāvasyedānīmpratibhāsa eva kṣaṇapratibhāsaḥ | pūrvāparakālasambandhitvenāpratibhāsanāt | kṣaṇasya ca svarūpeṇa pratibhāsa eva pūrvādikṣaṇād vivekena pratibhāsassumeru(?)bhinnapratibhāsavānna tvavinābhāvena pūrvādikṣaṇāt pratibhāsamānāt | kevalaṃ sa viveko nāvadhāryata iti | tadarthamanumānaṃ pravartate | tadāha na vajrādiṣvavivekasyādarśanam asti | kim kāraṇaṃ (|) paurvāparyeṇa vajrādijñānānāṃ pūrvāparabhāvena vajrādeḥ sadasattvasiddheḥ | tathā hi (|) vajrādyālambanam uttaraṃ jñānaṃ prāgbhavat svakāraṇaviśeṣasya prāgasattvaṃ sādhayati | paścād bhavacca sattvam ity evaṃ jñānapaurvāparyeṇa vajrādiṣu sadasattvasiddheḥ | vivekasadbhāvād bhedasadbhāvāt |
 etad eva sphuṭayannāha – yadītyādi | aparāṇyuttarakālabhāvīni jñānāni prāk pūrvajñānakāle sannihitakāraṇāni syuḥ pūrvajñānavajjātānyeva syuḥ (|) na caivaṃ | tasmādajātāni tu tāni jñānāni prāk | svakāraṇasya vaikalyaṃ sūcayanti | anyathā yadi teṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ prāg api syāt | tatsamarthamvā bhavedasamarthamvā | yadi (p.507) samarthaṃ prāg api janayet | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) samarthasya jananāt | athāsamartham (|) paścād api na janayet | kasmād (|) asamarthasyāpy anādheyātiśayatvena punaḥ kutaścit sāmarthya(ā)pratilambhāt | atha kutaścit sāmarthyaṃ pratilabheta | tadā sāmarthyasya pratilambhe vā sthairyāyogāt | pūrvāsamarthasvabhāvahāneranyasya ca samarthasyotpādāt |
 tasmāt kramabhāvīni vijñānāni svaviṣayasyāpi kramaṃ sādhayantīti sarvapadārthānāmbhedasiddher anityatvaṃ (|) sa evāyam iti jñānaṃ tu sadṛśadarśananimittaṃ |
 yata evantasmād ayaṃ satprayoga ity api yoyaṃ dvitīyo hetur ucyate | tenāpi śabdasya jananam evocyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) prayoktuḥ sakāśācchabdasya sāmarthyāt | abhimatakāryakaraṇe śabdasya sāmarthyapratilambhād ity arthaḥ | anyathā yadi prayokturvyāpārāt prāg eva vāsyādikaṃ śabdo vā svakārye samarthaṃ syāttadā svayaṃ sāmarthye tasya prayokturanupayogāt puruṣānapekṣāṇāṃ svayam eva vāsyādīnāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt | na ca bhavati | tasmāt prayoga ity api | iṣṭasyābhimatasyārthasya cchidādeḥ sādhanaṃ siddhis tatra samarthasvabhāvasyotpādanam eva vāsyādeḥ kathyate | kimbhūtam utpādanaṃ (|) samānajātīyaṃ sadṛśam upādānaṃ pūrvaṃ kāraṇabhūtaṃ kṣaṇam apekṣata iti samānajātīyopādānāpekṣaṃ vāsyādiprayogavat | chidādiṣu prayujyamānānāṃ vāsyādīnāṃ samānajātīyapūrvakṣaṇāpekṣaṇāt | upādānānapekṣaṃ vā | karmādiprayogavac ca | ādiśabdād vīṇādiśabdaparigrahaḥ | na hi karmādiṣu prathamaṃ prayujyamāneṣu pūrvasadṛśakṣaṇāpekṣāsti |
 yopi manyate (|) mā bhūt pratyabhijñānam anumānaṃ vyabhicārāt yat purovasthite vastuni samakṣe pratyabhijñānantatpratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ |tataḥ pratyakṣād eva pramāṇād bhāvānāṃ sthairyasidhir iti | tad apy uttaratra niṣetsyāmaḥ |
 anayā diśā sthairyasādhanāyopanītaḥ kuheturdraṣṭavyaḥ | yasmān naivaṃ kaścid sādhanadharmosta (p.508) sthairyasādhano yaḥ samānajātīyaṃ sthiraikasvabhāmvastvanveti | kasmāt (|) sarvadharmāṇāmetadavasthānāt | aparāparasvabhāvahānyutpādasvabhāvatvāt | sarvasyāḥ sthairyapratyabhijñāyāś ca yuktivirodhādanumānavirodhāt | kathaṃ (|) yathābhidhānaṃ | yatheha śāstre kṣaṇikatvasādhanamabhihitam abhidhāsyate ca | tathā yuktivirodhāt kāraṇādanyepi paraparikalpitāḥ sthairyasādhanahetavo vācyadoṣāḥ |
 evantāvad vyaktikramo vākyaṃ neti prakramya vyaktistrividhā kalpitā | śabdasyātiśayotpādanaṃ | tadāvaraṇavigamo (|) jñānaṃ ceti | tatra nityatvācchabdasya nātiśayotpādanaṃ | āvaraṇābhāvasya cākāryatvānnāpyāvaraṇavigamo vyaktir iti vikalpadvaye pratikṣipte | jñānaṃ vyaktir ity avaśiṣyate |
 (3) tadā ca vyaktikramo vākyaṃ | buddhīnāmānupūrvī vākyam āpadyate |
 na caitad yuktam (|) abuddhisvabhāvatvād vākyasya | tathāpy abhyupagamyocyate | vyaktikramasya ca vākyasyāpauruṣeyatve sādhye buddherevāpauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhyaṃ syāt | tatra buddherapuruṣāśraye puruṣānāśrayaṇe sādhye pratijñāyā bādhā | kaiḥ (|) abhyupetapratyakṣapratītānumitaiḥ samamekakālaṃ abhyupetenābhyupagatena | pratyakṣapratītenānumitena ca | tadānupūrvī buddhyanupūrvī vākyaṃ | sā ca nārthāntaraṃ buddhibhya iti tasyā ānupūrvyā apauruṣeyasvaprasādhane | buddherevāpauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhitaṃ syāt | tatra ca samayaḥ siddhāntosya mīmāṃsakasya bādhyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddhīnāṃ svasiddhānte puruṣaguṇatvenābhyupagamāt |
 pratyakṣabādhāndarśayannāha – pratyakṣaṃ khalv apy etad yadi tā buddhayo manaskārādibhyo bhavantīti | ādigrahaṇādindriyaparigrahaḥ | kīdṛśebhyo manaskārādibhyaḥ (p.509) puruṣa iti vyavahāralāghavārthaṃ kṛtasaṃketebhyaḥ | etatsvamatenoktaṃ | puruṣaguṇebhyo veti vyatikramya puruṣasya guṇebhyaḥ | etat tu paramatenoktaṃ | tasmāt manaskārādibhya utpadyamānāyā buddheḥ kāryatvaṃ pratyakṣasiddhamiti tasyā apauruṣeyatve sādhye pratyakṣabādhā |
 syānmataṃ (|) kāryatāyā apratyakṣatvān na pratyakṣabādheti ced āha – nanv ityādi | kāraṇābhimatasya bhāva eva bhāvaḥ tadabhāve cābhāva ity etau bhāvābhāvaviśeṣau | tābhyāṃ nānyā kāryatā bhāvasya (|) sa yathokto bhāvaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ | tadabhāve tvabhāvaḥ kathaṃ pratyakṣasiddha iti ced āha – abhāvopi | anupalabdhir eva lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvo yasyābhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ sopi pratyakṣasāmarthyasiddhaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | tadanyaviviktarūpambhāvam eva pratipādayata pratyakṣaṃ sāmarthyādabhāvaṃ gamayatīti sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ | yataś ca manaskārādibhāvābhāvābhyāṃ buddhibhāvābhāvau | tata eva tadbhāvabhāvitvāt puruṣakāryatā buddhīnām anumeyā | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anvayavyatirekaliṅgatvādasyāḥ kāryatāyāḥ | tadanenanumānabādhoktā |
 atha syān na vyaktikramo vākyaṃ | kin tu varṇṇānupūrvī vākyam ity ata āha – kiṃ cetyādi | varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśādānupūrvyā bhedaḥ sphoṭeneti pūrvoktena sphoṭavicāreṇa | abhinnāpi prāg eva niṣiddhā (|) bhedābhedaṃ ca muktvā vastuno nānyā gatir asti | tadā ca vyāpināmvarṇṇānāmānupūrvī kalpanāropitā syāt | kathaṃ vā tadānīmapuruṣāśrayā | puruṣāśrayaiva syāt |
 varṇṇetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyatirekiṇī bhinnasvabhāvānupūrvī | pūrvoktena sphoṭavicārānukrameṇaiva prativihitā |
 vākyanna bhinnamvarṇebhyo vidyatenupalambhanād (|) ityādinā dūṣaṇenānupūrvy api pratikṣiptā |
 nāpi sā varṇasvabhāvā | sarorasa iti pratipattibhedabhāvaprasaṅgāt | na cāpi sā tattvānyattvābhyāmavācyā | vastusvabhāvasyaitadvikalpānatikramāt | tattvānyattvavikalpānatikramāt (p.510) | tasmādatadrūpeṣu vastubhūtabhinnānupūrvīrahiteṣu varṇṇeṣu tadrūpasamāropapratibhāsinyā ānupūrvīsamāropapratibhāsinyā buddherayamvibhramaḥ syādānupūrvīti | sā cānupūrvī kathamapauruṣeyī pauruṣeyyeva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddherviṭhaṃ (?) panena vyāpāreṇa pratyupasthāpanāt | sandarśitatvāt |
 api cātyantikasya nityasya kasyacitsvabhāvasyābhāvāt | bhavatā vidyamānena dhvaninā śabdenāvaśyamanātyantikenāsthireṇa bhavitavyaṃ | sa ca dhvanirahetukaḥ syāt | puruṣavyatirekeṇānyo heturasyetyanyahetuko vā | tatrāhetukatve nityambhavet | anyānapekṣaṇāt | anyahetukatve tu na ca puruṣavyāpārād bhavet | bhavati ca puruṣavyāpārāt | tasmāt pauruṣeya iti gamyate |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | anātyantiko dhvaniranyo vā pṛthivyādikābhāva iti kathamidaṃ gamyate |
 sattetyācāryaḥ | nāśasya sattāmātrānubandhitvāt | kāraṇādanityatā dhvaneḥ | sannityeva kṛtvā nāso bhavati na kāraṇāntaram apekṣate | saṃśca śabdaḥ | tasmānna nitya iti samudāyārthaḥ |
 kasmāt sattāmātrānubandhī vināśa ity āha – na hītyādi | yasmānna bhāvānāṃ nāśo nāma dharmāntaraṃ kutaścinnāśakāraṇād bhavati |
 yata evaṃ (|) tad iti tasmād bhāvasvabhāva eva nāśo bhavet | kuta etad (|) bhāvasyaiva svahetubhyaḥ sakāśāt taddharmaṇo vināśadharmaṇo bhāvād utpatteḥ | ekakṣaṇasthitidharmakatvam eva vināśaḥ (|) tac ca hetubhya evotpadyata iti yāvat |
(p.511) kṛtakānām eva satāṃ vināśo nānyeṣāṃ satāṃ | taduktaṃ (|) ''sadakāraṇa vannityam'' iti (|)
 na cetyādi | na ca bhāvaviśeṣasya kasyacitsvabhāvo vināśaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyottaratra niṣetsyamānatvāt | tasmād bhāvamātrasvabhāvaḥ syād vināśaḥ | sattāmātrasvabhāvaḥ syāt | tena kāraṇena śabdonyo vā sarva eva bhāvaḥ sattābhājanaḥ sattādhāraḥ sanniti yāvat | anātyantika iti siddhaṃ |
 na siddham iti paraḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyaiva vināśasyāparajanmāsiddheḥ | parasmāj janma parajanma | na parajanmāparajanma | tasyāsiddheḥ | vināśasyāhetukatvāsiddher iti yāvat |
 tathā hy agninā kāṣṭhaṃ dagdhaṃ | daṇḍena ghaṭo bhagna iti vināśahetavo 'gnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnāmbhāvānāndṛśyante | tathā hyagnyādibhāve kāṣṭādīnāṃ nāśastadabhāve cānāśa ityanvayavyatirekānuvidhānaṃ nāśasyāsti | etac ca hetutadvatorhetumatorlakṣaṇam āhuḥ | taduktaṃ |

 ''abhighātāgnisaṃyoganāśapratyayasannidhiṃ |
 vinā, saṃsargitāṃ yāti vināśo na ghaṭādibhir'' iti (|)2

 netyādinā pratiṣedhati | nāgnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādervinā karaṇālloke vināśahetavaḥ pratīyante | kin tu pūrvapūrvasya kāṣṭhādikṣaṇasya svarasanirodhe svayam eva nirodhe sati | anyasyottarasya kṣaṇasya nikṛtasya bhasmādirūpasyotpatter agnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnāṃ vināśahetavaḥ prajñāyante na tu vināśasya karaṇāt | kutaḥ punastasya vikṛtasyotpattir ity āha – viśiṣṭetyādi | viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayo 'gnyādiḥ sahakārī tadāśrayeṇa |
 abhyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ (|) astu vāgniḥ kāṣṭhavināśahetuḥ (|) sa nāśognijanmā | (p. 512) agner janma  yasyeti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāṣṭham vāhosvitkāṣṭhādarthāntarantatrāgner vināśakam (|)
 hetos sakāśānnāśasyārthāntarasyotpattau bhavet kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) avināśāt | kāṣṭhasya kim ity arthāntarāt kāṣṭhādarthantarasya nāśasyotpattau janmani sati kāṣṭamabhūtaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ nāma | vaivābhūtam iti yāvat |
 yadi nāmāvinaṣṭantathāpy arthāntarotpatyā tasya darśanam iti ced āha – na dṛśyate veti (|) kim iti na dṛśyate | dṛśyata eva | yadi tv arthāntarotpatyārthāntaraṃ vinaṣṭaṃ na dṛśyate vā | tadātiprasaṅgo hy evaṃ syāt | arthāntarasya yasya kasyacid uttpatyā sarvam abhūtaṃ syāt | na vā dṛśyata | sa eva padārthognijanmā | na sarvaḥ | asyakāṣṭhasya vināśo loke vināśarūpatayā pratīter iti yāvat |
 etad eva grahaṇakavākyaṃ yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi sa evāgnijanmā kāṣṭhasyābhāvo vināśaḥ | tad iti  tasmād idaṃ kāṣṭhamabhūtatvād vināṣṭatvānnadṛśyata iti |
 bhavatvityādinā pratiṣadhati | bhavatu tasyāgnijanmanorthasyedannāma saṃjñā yad idam abhāva iti | tathāpi nāmamātreṇa katham anyānyasya vināśaḥ | na hi kasyacid arthasyāgnijanmano vināśa iti nāmakaraṇamātrena kāṣṭhaṃ na dṛśyata iti yuktaṃ |
 nanu likapratītatvād vināśa evāsau na tasya vināśa iti nāmakaranamātram ity ata āha –
 na cānyaḥ padārtho 'nyasya vināśo 'tiprasaṅgāt | sarve padārthāḥ kāṣṭhasya vināśaḥ syād (|) etac cānantaroktam eva smarayati |
 (p. 513) evam manyate | yathā sarvapadārthānām arthāntaratvāt na kāṣṭhavināśarūpatayā pratītis tathā 'gnikṛtasyāpy arthāntaratvānna kāṣṭhavināśarūpatayā pratītiḥ syāt |
 syād etad (|) yadyarthāntaratvād agnikṛtasyārthasya na vināśarūpatā | dhūmasyāpi tarhy agnikāryatā na syād arthāntaratvād ghaṭavat | bhavati ca tad arthāntaratvāviśeṣepyagnikṛtasya kāṣṭhavināśarūpatā bhaviṣyatīti (|)
 ata āha – aviśeṣāt | tasyāgnikṛtasya vastubhūtasya kāṣṭhādarthāntaratvena tadanyebhyo ghaṭādibhyo viśeṣābhāvāt | kathām vināśarūpatā nivṛttirūpatvād vināśasyeti bhāvaḥ | ghūmasya tvārthāntaratvepy agnikāryatvaṃ yuktam eva | arthāntarasyāgnikāryatvena saha virodhābhāvād iti yatkiñcid etat |
 kāṣṭhegnikṛtaḥ svabhāvo nāśo na sarvaḥ ghaṭādistato nātiprasaṅga iti cet |
 kāṣṭhe 'yamagnikṛto vināśa iti kāṣṭhavināśayoḥ kassambandhaḥ | parasparamanupakāryopakāratvāt | naiva sambandhosti |
 kāṣṭhamāśraya āśrayosyāstītyāśrayī vināśaḥ | tata āśrayāśrayisambandhostīti cet |
 naitad evaṃ | tasyāsrayāśarayisambandhasya niṣetsyamāntvāt |
 vināśo janyaḥ | tasya kāṣṭhaṃ janakaṃ | tato nāśakāṣṭayor janyajanakabhāvasambhandhaś cet |
 tadāgner iti kiṃ | agneḥ sakāśānnāśo bhavatīti kim ucyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kāṣṭhād evatasya nāśasya bhāvād utpatteḥ |
 tadapekṣād agnyapekṣāt kāṣṭhānnāśasyotpatter adoṣaḥ | agnikṛto nāśo na syād iti yo doṣa uktaḥ sa nāstīti cet |
 vahneḥ sakāśād (na) tiśayalābhinaḥ kāṣṭhasya vahnimprati kāpekṣā | naiva kācit | vahneḥ sakāśāt kāṣṭhasyātiśayalābhe vā 'parasya dvitīyasya kāṣṭhasyātiśayasamjñakasya janmasyāt | tathā ca pūrvakāṣṭhamapracyutikāraṇaṃ | nāsya pracyutikāraṇam astīti vigrahaḥ | tathaiva prāgvad dṛśyate |
 syādetad (|) yata evāgner atiśayavato dvitīyasya kāṣṭhasya janma | tata evāgneḥ (p.514) pūrvasya kāṣṭhasya vināśa iti (cet) |
 kaḥ pūrveṇa kāṣṭhenāsya vahnikṛtasya vināśasya sambandha iti sa eva prasaṅgaḥ | kāṣṭha iti kaḥ sambandha ity anantaram evoktaḥ |
 athāpyāśrayāśrayibhāvādikamāśrīyate | tadā tasya niṣetsyamānatvād ityādi sarvaṃ punarāvarttate ityaparyavasānaś ca prasaṅgaḥ syāt |
 tad iti tasmād avaśyaṃ vināśasambandhasya yogyaḍ kāṣṭhasyottaramatiśayaṃ pratyupakurvāṇognirapūrvam eva kāṣṭhañjanayatīti pūrvaṃ kāṣṭhantadavasthandṛśyetetyupasaṅhāraḥ |
 kiñca | kāṣṭhavināśa iti kāṣṭhābhāva ucyate (|) na cābhāvaḥ kāryaḥ | vidhinā kāryatvopagame tasya bhāvatvaprasaṅgāt | tasmād abhāvaṃ karoti bhāvan na karotīti | kriyāpratiṣedhamātraṃ | tathā ca tatkārī cābhāvakārī vākāra eva kriyāpratiṣedhamātratvād iti kṛtvā kāṣṭhavināśena vahnyādiranapekṣanīya ityuktaṃ sāmānyatadvatorādhārādheyacintāsthāne |
 kiñca (|) svabhāvābhāvasya kāṣṭhādisvabhāvasya yo 'bhāvo nāśastasya tataḥ kāṣṭhādisvabhāvād bhedebhupagamyamāne | tatorthāntarādabhāvāt kāṣṭhādir bhāvo nivartate | tatstasmād bhāvannivartamānasya kāṣṭhādeḥ svabhāva eva samarthitaḥ syāt | asato nivartamānasya sattvameva samarthitaṃ syād iti kṛtvā kathamagnyādikṛtena vināśena kāṣṭhādirabhūto nāma |
 yata evantasmānna anyonyasya vināśaḥ | arthāntaramarthāntarasya na vināśa ity arthaḥ |
 abhyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ (|) astvanyo vināśastasminnarthāntare vahnikṛte kāṣṭhantadavastham eveti kasmān na dṛśtate | etad eva sādhayannāha – koyamvirodhaḥ | (p.515) agnijanitasya vināśasyārthāntarasya yo bhāvaḥ | yacca kāṣṭhasya darśanantayoḥ | tathā ca kāṣṭhantadavasthaṃ dṛśyeta |
 nanu "yosāvarthāntaraṃ bhāvo vahnikṛtaḥ sa kāṣṭhavināśaḥ | vināśarūpatayā pratīteḥ | vināśaś cābhāvo yaś ca kāṣṭhābhāvaḥ | sa kāṣṭhavirodhirūpa eva kriyate | na cāyamarthāntaratvād ghaṭavad virodhirūpatayā karttumaśkyaḥ (|) na hi ghaṭavadarthāntaratvād ghūmognikāryo na bhavati | tasmād yathārthāntarabhūtopi ghūmogninā kriyate, tathā virodhirūpo vināśaḥ kriyate | yayoś ca parasparaparihāreṇa virodhastayor ekabhāva evāparasyādarśanam iti katham agnikṛtasyārthāntarasya vināśasaṃjñitasya virodhino bhāve kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ syād ity ucyata" iti śaṅkraḥ | 1
 tad ayuktaṃ (|) yatorthāntarasyāgnikāryatvena saha virodhābhāvād (|) ghumasyārthāntaratvepyagnikāryatvam aviruddham eva | vahnikṛtasya tv arthāntarasya bhavanadharmatayā bhāvarūpatā | yaś ca bhāvaḥ sa kathamabhāvo vaḥ (|) virodhād vināśaś cābhāva iṣyate | tatorthāntarabhāvena viruddho vināśaḥ | na cārthāntarasyāpi vināśarūpatayā pratibhāsanāt | kāṣṭhādivināśarūpatā | svarasanirodho hi nimittam vināśapratibhāse |
 svarasanirodhānabhyupagame tu kathamarthāntarasyāpi vināśarūpatayā pratibhāso bhāvarūpatvādityādāvevoktaṃ | tatkathāmucyate (|) vināśākhyasyārthāntarasya virodhinaḥ kṛtakatvāt kāṣṭhasyādarśanam iti | nīrūpatve tu vināśasya syād bhāvena sahāyaṃ virodhaḥ (|) kintu tadāpy arthāntaratvaṃ hetujanyatvaṃ cāsya na syānnīrūpatvād eva | tasmādagninārthāntarasya karaṇe kāṣṭhantadavasthaṃ dṛśyeta |
 tenāgnikṛtenārthāntareṇa parigrahataḥ svīkārāt kāṣṭhaṃ na dṛśyata iti cet |
 evaṃ sati tadarthāntaraṃ kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇam iti prāptaṃ | tacca na yuktaṃ (|) yato na tenārthāntaraṃ kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇam iti prāptaṃ | tac ca na yuktaṃ (|) yato na tenārthāntareṇa kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇaṃ sambhavati |
 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tenārthāntareṇāgninā kṛtena | tadity agnikṛtamarthāntaraṃ | na caitadāvaraṇakalpitaṃ yuktaṃ | yasmādāvaraṇaṃ hi | āvriyamāṇerthadarśanam vibadhnīyāt | nābhighātādīni  dravyasāmarthyāni vibadhnīyāt | andhakārā(p.516)vṛtānāṃ ghaṭādīnām abhidhātādhidarśanāt | tatra svadeśe parasyotpattivibandhobhighātaḥ | ādiśabdād gandharasādiparigrahaḥ | athāvaranaṃ sarvasāmarthyaṃ kāṣṭhasya nibandhnīyāt | tadā sarvapratibandhe cābhyupagamyamāne | na tvanenaivāvaraṇena kāṣṭhannāśitaṃ syān na vahninā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tenaivāsya kāṣṭhasya sarvaśaktipracyāvanāt | tathā ca sati punas tatrāpy agnikṛterthāntare nāśahetāvagnāviva prasaṃbāt | kāṣṭhavināśaṃ prati yognau doṣo vistareṇo ktaḥ sorthāntareṇāpy agnikṛtena kāṣṭhanāśe kriyamāṇe syāt | tathā cānavasthā | tenāpy arthāntareṇāgnikṛtena nāśenāparamarthāntarannāśākhyaṃ karttavyantenāpy aparam ity anavasthā syād |
 atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ity apracyutā eva kāṣṭhasyābhidghātādisāmarthyādayaḥ |
 tadāpyapracyuteṣu vāsya kāṣṭhasyābhidhātasāmarthyādiṣu | satā vā tenānyenāgnijanitena kāṣṭhasya kiṃ vināśitaṃ yena tadāvaraṇantathā ca kāṣṭhaṃ dṛśyeta | yadi cetyādi | (|) agneḥ samudbhavo yasyeti vigrahaḥ | agnisamudbhūtena vināśākhyenārthena parigrahād ity arthaḥ | tadā vināśasya vināśitvaṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) utpatteḥ | utpattimatvād vināśopi kāṣṭhavad vināśī syād iti yāvat | tato vināśavināśāt punaḥ kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ syāt |
 avaśyam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | utpattimatā satā kāṣṭhavināśenāvaśyaṃ vinaṣṭavyaṃ | tasmin kāṣṭhanāśe vinaṣṭe sati punaḥ kāṣṭhādīnām unmajjanaṃ syāt | prādurbhāvo bhavet |
 hantṛghātetyādinā paramāśaṃkate | caitrasya yo hantā tasya hantur ghate sati yathā | hatasya caitrasyāpunar bhāvaḥ (na) punar anutpattiḥ | atrāpi kāṣṭhanāśe vinaṣṭepyevaṃ kāṣṭhasyāpunar bhāva iti cet |
 (p.517) hantur ityādinā pratividhatte | nedaṃ samādhānaṃ yuktaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) hanturamaraṇatvataḥ | na hi hantā caitrasya maraṇasvabhāvaḥ | kintarhi (|) mārayitā | tato yuktaṃ yat tannāśe caitrasyāpunarbhavanaṃ maraṇe tvanivṛtte 'vaśyaṃ punarbhavanaṃ syāt |
 vināśetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | vināśasya vināśepi na vastunaḥ pratyāpattir na pūrvarūpagamanaṃ | yasmānna hi hantari hatepi tadvatastena hantrā puruṣeṇa hataḥ pratyujjīvati | nāyamparihāro yuktaḥ | kasmād (|) hantuḥ puruṣasya tadghātahetutvāt | tasya caitrasya yanmaraṇantaddhetutvāt | na tv asau hantā maraṇasvabhāvaḥ |
 etad eva spaṣṭayannāha – netyādi | nāśahetoragnidaṇḍādernivṛttau satyāmivanaṣṭena bhāvena punarbhavativyam iti na brūmaḥ | evam abhidhāne bhavedeṣa parihāraḥ | kin tarhi (|) vah vyādinā kāṣṭhāderbhāvasyābhāvo yaḥ kriyate tasya | kimbhūtasya (|) atyantānupalabdhilakṣaṇasya | karmmasthā ca kriyātropalabdhiḥ | tatpratiṣedhenātyantānupalabdhiḥ sarvasāmārthyaviraha ucyate | tasyaivabhūtasyābhāvasya nivṛttau satyāṃ | svabhāvāvasthiteḥ sakāśād bhāvasya kānyā gatiḥ | svabhāvasthitir eva gatir iti yāvai |
 hantari tu vinaṣṭe na yuktaṃ punar bhavanaṃ | yasmād dhantā hi caitrasya na nāśakalpaḥ | kin tarhi (|) daṇḍādikalpaḥ daṇḍāditulyaḥ nāśahetutvāt | nāśaklpaṃ hy asya caitrasya maraṇam (|) tannivṛttau tasya nāśakalpasya maraṇasya nivṛttau syād evāsya caitrasya punar bhāvaḥ | evantāvat nāśasyārthāntaratve doṣa uktaḥ |
 anarthāntaratvamadhikṛtyāha – ananyatvepītyādi | vastuno nāśasyānanyatvepi syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭham eva tu | tasya ca kāṣṭhasya svahetor utpannasya satvāt | na (p. 518) vahnyādibhiḥ kiñcit karttavyam iti tatsvabhāvasya nāśasyāhetutvaṃ | nātastattvānyatvavikalpānnāśasya vastudharmasya vidyatenyā gatiḥ |
 anarthāntara ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kāṣṭhādanarthāntarabhūto yadā vināśastadā tadeva kāṣṭham eva tadvināśākhyamvastu bhavati | tac ca kāṣṭhādi | vahnyādisannidhānāt prāgevāstīti | kim atra kāṣṭhādau vināśye sāmarthyam vahnyāvīnām iti draṣṭavyaṃ | kvacid daṇḍādīnām iti pāṭhaḥ sa tu ghaṭādīn purodhāya vyākhyeya | tasmāt tadmukārāt | tatra kāṣṭhādau vināśahetūnāmanupakārāt tena kāṣṭhādinā vināśahetavo nāpekṣyante kathaṃcit kenāpi rūpeṇa | nāpy asya kāṣṭāder idam vahnyādikaṃ vināśahetur iti sambandhamarhati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyopakāranibandhanatvāt | anyathopakāram antareṇa sambandhakalpanāyāmatiprasaṅgāt | sarvaḥ sarvasya sambandhī syāt |
 syād etat (|) na sākṣād vanhyādiḥ kāṣṭhāderupakārakaḥ kintu tatsambandhibhūtopakārakaranād iti (|)
 ata āha – pāramparyeṇetyādi | vahnyādinā kāṣṭhādeḥ sambandhibhūta upakāraḥ kriyate na sākṣād iti (|) evaṃ pāramparyeṇopakārepi kalpyamāne 'vaśyam ayam vikalponvetyanugacchati | sa kimpāramparyeṇāpyupakārorthāntaramāhosvit tadeva kāṣṭhādikam iti | tatra tasmāt kāṣṭhāderarthāntaratvepyupakārasya | tasya kāṣṭhāder ayam upakāra iti kas sambandha iti | tatra kāṣṭhādau tasyāgnikṛtasyopakārasyopakārakatvaṃ paryanuyojyaṃ | tadantareṇa sambandhābhāvāt | ādiśabdāt tatrāpy aparopakārakalpanetyanavasthādoṣādiparigrahaḥ | tathānanyatvepy upakārasya tadavasthaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭhamevetyādinā ya uktaḥ tasmāt sato vidyamānasya rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramāt kāraṇāt |
 syād etat (|) sato rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramād vināśahetukṛtaṃ tūpakārotpādanam asad eveti |
 (p. 519) ata āha – upakāretyādi | rūpaniṣpādanalakṣaṇatvāt | sadrūpaniṣpādanalakṣaṇatvāt | tataś ca tadvā vastu tena vināśakena karttavyam anyadvā | ubhayathā cokto doṣa iti | tadatatkriyāvikalo nāśahetur na karttaivaiti na kasyaciddhetuḥ | ahetuś ca daṇḍādi nāpikṣyate vinaśvareṇaghaṭādinā | tasmāt svayaṃ sattāmātreṇāyambhāvastattatsvabhāvo vinaśvarasvabhāva iti |
 pradhvaṃsābhāvannāśaṃ gṛhītvā parasya codyamāśaṃkate | ahetutvepītyādi ahetur hi bhavannityambhavet | nityatvāc ca bhāvakālepi nāśo bhavedityevambhāvanāśayoḥ sahabhāvaprasaṅgaścet |
 nāyandoṣaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) asataḥ pradhvaṃsalakṣaṇasya nāśasya nityatā kutaḥ |
 syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyapi nāśaḥ kṣaṇikavādino 'hetukaḥ sovaśyaṃ nitya iti kṛtvā bhāvastadabhāvalakṣaṇo vināśanivṛttirūpaḥ | vināśaś ca tadabhāvalakṣaṇo bhāvanivṛttirūpaḥ | ekasya saha syātām iti |
 naitadevaṃ | kasmāt (|)  tasyābhāvasyāvastutvena nityādidharmāyogāt | na hyasatyayannityānityavikalpassambhavati | tayornityayor vastudharmatvāt | vināśasya ca bhāvanivṛttilakṣaṇasyākiñcittvāt |
 kiṃ ca (|) bhavati hy utpadyamānasya nityaṃ sattvāt kenacit sahabhāvaḥ syāt (|) na ca vināśo bhavati | kevalamekalakṣaṇasthitidharmā bhāvaḥ svayam eva na bhavatīti kriyāpratiṣedhamātrametat | tasmādadoṣonantaroktaḥ |
 punar api parābhiprāyamāśaṃkte | yadi vināśo sanniṣyate tadā vināśasyā(p. 520)sattve satyabhāvanāśitvaprasaṅgaḥ | bhāvasya nāśitvaṃ na syād ity ayam api prasaṅgo na yujyate | yasmād bhāvasya nāśenārthāntareṇa nāsmābhirvināśanamiṣyate |
 katham ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kathamasan vināśo bhāvaṃ nāśayedasato vyāpārāyogāt | ataḥ kāraṇādavināśī bhāvaḥ syād ity aprasaṅga eva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vināśādarthāntarabhūtād bhāvasya nāśānabhyupagamāt |
 yo hītyādinaitadeva samarthayate | yo hi vādī nivāśa iti kiṃ cinnety āha – sa kathamtato niḥsvabhāvānnāśād bhāvasya nāśamicchet (|) necchet |
 katham ityādi paraḥ | asatyavidyamāne vināśe kathambhāvo naṣṭo nāma | naiva vinaṣṭaḥ syāt | tathā hi pratyutpannāvasthāyāmasadvināśāḥ | asadvināśo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | te na hi naṣṭā gaṇyante | yadā ca bhāvasya nāśo nāsit tadā kathāntena sa vyapadiśyate nāśavāniti | na hi yo yena svabhāvenātadvān asambandhavān | sa padārthastenāsambandhinā tathā vyapadiśyate | tadvāniti vyapadiśyate śabdena | pratīyate vā jñānena |
 netyādinā pariharati | na vai bhāvasya nāśo nāstyevāi tvastyeva nāśaḥ | kathan tarthi nāstītyucyate | sa tu nāsti nāśo yo bhāvasya bhavati | yadi vināśo na bhavati kathan tarhi vināśostītyucyata iti (|)
 āha – bhāva eva tu kṣaṇasthitidharmā | ekakṣaṇasthāyī nāśaḥ |
 yadi bhāva eva nāśaḥ kathan tarhi bhāvasya nāśo bhūta iti loko vyapadiśatīti (|)
 ata āha – tamasyetyādi | asya bhāvasya tamekakṣaṇasthāyisvabhāvaṃ sadṛśāparotyattivipralambhādupalakṣitaṃ | uttarakālaṃ santānocchittāvanupalambhenāsthitipratipattyā | vibhāvayanto niścinvantaḥ | vināśosya bhāvasya bhūta iti yathā pratīti vyapadiśanti vyavahāriṇaḥ puruṣā ityuktaṃ prāk |
 (p. 521) yasmānna hi bhāvasya niṣpannasya kiñcidrūpāntaramvināśākhyamanyadvā kadācid bhavati | sa eva bhāvaḥ kevalaṃ svahetubhyas tathābhūta ekakṣaṇasthāyī bhavati | tad iti tasmānna kenacidvināśākhyena bhavata | sa bhāvo nāṣṭo nāma | kintarhi (|) svabhāva evāsya bhāvasya sa ekakṣaṇāvasthānaśīlaḥ | yena sa bhāvo naṣṭo nāma anyathā svayamatatsvabhāvatvenyasannidhānepyanāśāt |
 yadi nāśo nāma na kiñcit | kathantarhīdānīmahetuko nāśo bhavatīty ucyate bhavadbhiḥ | yasya hi svabhāva eva nāsti tasya kimahetukaḥ sahetuko veti cintayā | bhāvasya nāśa iti vyatireko vā kathaṃ |
 naśyannityādinā pariharati | bhāvo naśyannaparāpekṣaḥ | paraṃ vināśahetuṃ nāpiekṣata iti kṛtvā | na jñāpanāyetyaparāpekṣatvajñāpanāya | sā nāśāvasthāsmābhirahetur uktā | tasyā nāśāvasthāyāś cetasā vikalpabuddhyā bhāvād bhedaṃ vyatirekamāropya (|)
 etad uktam bhavati (|) ahetuko bhāvasya vināśo bhavatīti sahetukosya vināśo na bhavatīty arthaḥ |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na bhāvo jātaḥ sannaparasmād vināśahetornāśaṃ pratilabhate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtasyaiva naśvarasvabhāvasyaiva svayaṃ sattāhetoreva jāter utpatteḥ | iti hetor aparamanyam vināśahetutven kalpitam apekṣata ityaparāpekṣaḥ | tathābhūtaś cāsau dharmaś ca vināśākhyaḥ | aparāpekṣadharmas tasya pratiṣedhārthaṃ | sahetukavināśapratiṣedhārtham iti yāvat | tatsvabhāvajñāpaneneti bhāvasya vinaśvarasvabhāvajñāpanena | svabhāva eva tathocyata ity anena sambandhaḥ | tathocyata ity ahetukosya vināśo bhavatītyucyate | kadācittanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ | bhāvasyānyasmāt kimvināśo bhavati na cityetāvanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ | kena prakāreṇocyate | dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād arthāntaram iva vināśākhyaṃ dharmaṃ cetasā buddhyā vibhajyāsya bhāvasya vināś iti vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā | tadetad yathoktena prakāreṇābhāvād avyatirikta(p.522)nnāśitvantatvato vyavasthāpitam api mandamatayo nāśaṃ guṇaṃ dharmaṃ samāropyātmānamākulayantītyanena sambandhaḥ |
 kasmāt punasta evamākulayantīt ity āha – kvacid ityādi | rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau vyatirekavibhaktiprayoge tathādarśanāt | sambandhinor vibhāgadarśanāt | ihā bhāva nāśo bhavatīty anena ghoṣaṇāmātreṇa vipralabdhāḥ | bhāvasya vyatiriktaṃ nāśaṃ guṇaṃ dharmāṃ samāropya | tasya ca yathā kalpitasya guṇasya bhāvaṃ sattāṃ samāropya | taṃ nāśākhyaṃ guṇaṃ sahetukamahetukamvā darśanabhedena samāroya bhāvacintayā vastucintayā | kiṃbhūtayā (|) apratiṣṭhitatattvayā | apratiṣṭhitantattvaṃ yasyāṃ cintāyāṃ | tayātmānamākulayanti |
 svatopītyādiṇā parābhiprāyamāśaṃkate | yasyāpi svayamevāhetuko nāśo bhavati | tasyāpi svatopyabhāvasya vināśasya bhāveṅgīkriyamāṇe | ayantattvānyattvalakṣaṇo vikalpaścetasaḥ |
 nanvityādinā vyācaṣṭe | na parabhāvitvam aparabhāvitvam ahetukatvepīty arthaḥ | bhāvasya vastuno yo nāśastasya svata eva bhavataḥ | ayantattvānyattvavikalpastukyaḥ (|)
 kimarthāntarannāśo bhāvāduta bhāva eveti | tatra yadyarthāntarantadā kimarthāntarasya nāśasya bhāve sattāyāmbhāvo na dṛśyate | athānarthāntaraṃ vināśastadānarthāntaratvepi tadeva ghaṭādikameva tannāśakhyambhavati | tattsmānna kiñcid asya padārthasya jātam iti kathaṃ vinaṣṭo nāma |
 nanvityādinā pariharati | atra prastāve | uktaṃ (|) kimuktaṃ (|) na tasya bhāvasya kiṃcid vyatiriktam vā nāśākhyam dharmarūpam bhavati | kathan tarhi vināśī bhāva ity āha – na bhavatyeva kevalam ity uktaṃ prāk |
 (p.523) etad eva sphuṭayannāha – na hītyādi | na hy ayam ahutukavināśavādī bhāvasya svahetorniṣpannasya kaścid bhāvarūpo 'bhāvarupo ka vināśonyo vā sthityānyathātvādiko dharmo bhavatityāha – kintarhi sa eva bhāvo na bhavatīti bhāvanivṛttimātramāha – tenāyam arthaḥ (|) prathame kṣaṇe bhāvo 'bhūto bhavati | dvitīye kṣaṇe tasya na bhāvo bhavati nābhāvo vā | nāpi svarasahānirvā bhāvati | kevalaṃ svayam eva nivartate |
 yadi punar nāśābhidhānena kasyacid dharmasya bhāvam utpādaṃ brūyānna bhāvonena vādinā vivartitaḥ syāt | bhāvanivṛttir na kathiteti yāvat | tathā ca bhāvanivṛtttau prastutāyāmarthāntarasyānyasya vidhānādaprastutamevoktaṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na hi kasyacid vināśākhyasyābhāvasya bhāvanivṛttirūpasya vā bhāvenotupādena bhāvaḥ padārtho nabhūto nāma | yena tadvidhānena bhāvasya svanivṛttiḥ syāt |
 etaduktam bhavati | yathā bhāvasya vijñānabhāve bhāvo na vivarttate kevalantadvijñānantatsambandhi syāt | tathā bhāvasya nivṛttir bhavatīty abhyupagame sa eva nivṛttyākhyo dharmas tatsambandhī syān na tu bhāvo nivarteteti katham asya nivṛttiḥ syāt | tasmāttadā sa bhāvo na bhūto nivṛtto yadi svayaṃ na bhavet |
 tena yad ucyate | nanv abhavanam api yadi bhāvasya na bhavati | tadā 'vināśitvaṃ | atha bhavati | tadbhinnamvā syād abhinnamvā 'nayoś ca pakṣayorbhāvasya sarvadā darśanaṃ syādavināśāt | tasmānnābhāvasya vināśaḥ (|) kathantarhi bhāvaḥ sarvadā na pratīyate pramāṇābhāvād iti (|)
 tadapāstam | dṛśyasya hi sattāyāḥ pramāṇaviṣayatvena vyāptatvāt | tadabhāvādabhāvaḥ | bhāve vāvaśyaṃ pramāṇaviṣayatvam iti kathamapratipattiḥ | athādṛśyarupatayāsya bhāvastadā tarhi dṛśyarūpatāyā nivṛttiḥ | sā ca bhāvād bhinnā 'bhinnā vā (|) anayoś ca pakṣayor bhāvasya darśanaṃ syād iti doṣastadavastha eva | tasmād bhāvasyābhāvanamapi na bhavati nāpyavināśitvadoṣaḥ | svarūpeṇa nivṛtteḥ |
 nanu bhāvanivṛtter nīrūpatvenarūpiṇo bhāvādanyattvam iti cet |
 nanu yasya rūpam eva na vidyate tasya katham anyattvaṃ tatkim ekatvam astu | tadapi nāstyarūpatvāt | tasmād bhāvena sahāsyāstattvānyattvaniṣedhamātraṃ kriyate | śaśaviṣāṇavat |
 (p.524) natvevamapi kathaṃ dvitīyakṣaṇe bhāvo na bhavatītīṣyate (|) yato yadi dvitīyakṣaṇe bhāvastadā kathantatra nāstītīṣyate virodhāt | atha nāsti tadā kathaṃ bhāvo nāstīty ucyate 'sattvād iti |
 tadyuktaṃ | yataḥ prathamnepi kṣaṇe bhāvo bhavatīti lokebhidhīyate | tatra ca yadi bhāvaḥ kathambhavatītyucyate | tasmāt sarvatra buddhisthameva bhāvaṃ kṛtvā vidhipratiṣedhavyavahāra iti yat kiñcid etat |
 tasmāt sthitam etat (|) tadā sa bhāvo na bhūto yadi svayaṃ na bhved iti |
 nanu svayambhāvo na bhavatītyanenāpi vākyena svayamevābhāvo bhāvasya bhavatīty ucyate | tadā ca sa eva doṣa ity ata āha – na bhavatīti cetyādi | caśabdo yasmād arthe | yasmād bhāvo na bhavatīti ca prasajyapratiṣedha eṣaḥ | na paryudāsaḥ | yatraprasaktasya nivṛttimātrameva kriyate na vastvaṃśasya saṃsparśaḥ sa prasajyapratiśedhaḥ | yatra tvekaniṣedhenānyavidhānaṃ sa paryudāsaḥ | anyathehāpi prasajyapratiṣedhepi kasyacid vastuno bhāve | vidhāne sati | na pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) ubhayatrāpi prasajye paryudāse ca | vidheḥ pradhānyāt |
 yadi ca prasajyapratiṣedhepi vidhistadā pratiṣedha eva nāsti | evaṃ cāpratiṣedhāt kasyacit paryudāsopi na syāt kvacit | kiṃ kāraṇam | yadi hi kiṃcid vastu kutaścinnivartteta | tadā tadvyatireki | nivartamānād vastuno vyatirekisaṃspṛśyeta | tatparyudāsena nivarttyamānaparyudāsena | yathā 'brāhmaṇamānayeti brāhmaṇaparyudāsena kṣatriyādeḥ saṃsparśāt (|) tac ca kasyacinnivartanameva nāsti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvatra kasyacinnivṛttir bhavatīty uktepi na bhāvavyavacchedaḥ kasyacit pratīyate 'pi tu nivṛttiśabdenāpi kasyacid bhāvasyaiva pratīteḥ | na cānena vādīnā bhāvasya nivṛttiṃ bruvāṇenāpi nivṛttirvaivoktā kintvarthāntarabhāva evoktaḥ syāt | tathā ca yasya paryudāsena yadviviktam ucyate na tayoḥ parasparavivekah siddhḥ | asati ca viveke na paryudāsaḥ | tadanyavivekenānyopādanalakṣaṇatvāt paryudāsasya | tadevaṃ (p. 525) yathoktena prakāreṇa vyatirekābhāvādanvayopi na syāt | anvayaḥ kasyacid arthasyānugamo vidhānantanna syād ity arthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyānvayasyaikasvabhāvasthitilakṣaṇatvāt | tatsthitiś caikasvabhāvasthitiś ca tasmād anyasya vyatireke parihāre sati syāt | sa ca tadanyavyatireko nāsti tvanmatena | iti evaṃ śabdād apravṛttinivṛttikaṃ jagat syāt | śābdasya vidhipratiṣedhavyavahārasyābhāvaḥ syāt | na caivam ity avaśyaṃ kasyacid vyavacchedamātram śabdavācyamabhyupagantavyaṃ |
 yataścaivantasmād yasya bhāvasya nāśo bhavatītyucyate sa svayameva na bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt (|) na punar asya dharmāntaraṃ kiñcin nāśo nāma vidhīyate | caitrasya putra ity atra yathā vāstavo bhedas tathā bhāvasya nāśa ity atrāpi vyatirekavibhaktes tulyatvād ity ata āha – netyādi | na vai ghoṣamātreṇa caitrasya putra ity anena śabdena sāmyād viṣayāntaradṛṣṭo vidhiḥ | caitrasya putra ity atra dṛṣṭovidhirvāstavo yaḥ sa sarvatra bhāvasya nāśa ity atrāpi yojanām arhati (|) śabdapravṛttimātreṇa vastuyojanāyā ayogāt |
 etadeva nahītyādinā prāha – kasyacit puruṣasya gardabha iti nāmakaraṇāt bāleyadharmā gardabhasya dharmā manuṣyepi na hi yojyāḥ | tathā na caitrasya putro bhavatītyatra vākye dṛṣṭo vidhirarthāntarasya putrasya vidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam iti nāśepi yojyaḥ | bhāvasya nāśo bhavatīty atrāpi bhāvād vyatireko nāśo vidheyaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) virodhāt | nāśasyābhāvarūparvādabhāvasya bhavanavirodhādityuktaṃ |
 yadi nāśo nārthāntaraṃ kasmād bhāvasya nāśo bhavatītyevam abhidhīyata iti (|)
 ata āha – evaṃ cetyādi | bhāvasya nāśa ityabhidhānepi prayojanamāveditameva | "arthāntaram iva dharmiṇo dharmaṃ cetasāvibhajya tanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ svabhāva eva tathocyata"1 ityādinā niveditatvāt |
 tasmādabhāvasyākiṃcittvāt tattvānyattvavikalpo na tulyaḥ | ato bhāve (p.526) vastuno bhavane eṣa tattvānyattvavikalpaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) bhavanasya vidher vastvanurodhataḥ |
 nanv atiśayotpattāv api sa eva tasyātiśaya utpanna iti kathaṃ naṣṭo nāma (|) tena nāyaṃ tadavastho naṣṭo nāma | yena svayaṃ na bhavati | tena naṣṭo nārthāntarotpādādityuktaṃ | na hyatiśayotpattyā svayaṃ na bhūto nāma (|) abhāvasya sarvātiśayopākhyā nivṛttyā sarvabhāvadharmavivekalakṣaṇatvāt | bhāvasya cotpattisamāviśalakṣaṇatvāt |
 bhāva ityādinā byācaṣṭe | bhāvo bhavanam utpāda iti yāvat | sovaśyambhavantamapekṣate | bhavitāramapekṣate (|) bhavitāramantareṇa bhavansyābhāvāt | sa ca bhāvaḥ vyāpāre svabhāva eva vastveva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) niḥsvabhāvasya kvacid bhavatītyādike samāveśābhāvāt | sambandhābhāvāt | na ca vyāpāro nāmārthāntaraṃ | kintu vyāpāra iti hi yathābhūtasvabhāvotpattirviśiṣṭasvabhāvotpattiḥ (|) sā cotpattir niḥsvabhāvasya nāśasya kathaṃ syāt |
 yadi niḥsvabhāvasya nāsti vyāpārasamāveśaḥ katham idānīm bhavaty abhāvaḥ śaśa viṣāṇam ityādivyavahāraḥ śaśaviṣāṇamabhāvo bhavatīti bhavanalakṣaṇena vyāpāreṇa vyavahāra ityarthaḥ | ādiśabdād vandhyāsuto 'bhāvo bhavatīti parigrahaḥ |
 netyādinā pariharati | na vai śaśaviṣāṇaṃ kiṃcid abhāvonyadvā bhavatīti vidhinocyate | api tvevam iti śaśaviṣāṇamabhāvo bhavatīty anena vākyenāsyeti śaśaviṣāṇasyābhāvo bhavati (|) bhāvo na bhavatīti bhāvapratiṣedhaeva kriyate | api ca vyavaharttāraḥ puruṣāḥ | etacchaśaviṣāṇādikamevamabhāvo bhavatīti vyāpāravadiva samāropyādarśayanti | kenacit prakaraṇena | kiṃ śaśaviṣāṇādikamabhāvo bhavati na bhavatīti prastāvasamāśrayeṇa | na tu tacchaśaviṣāṇādikamabhāvo bhavati na bhavatīti prastāvasamāśrayeṇa | na tu tacchaśaviṣāṇādikaṃ vyavahāramātreṇatathā vyāpārayuktambhavati | yasmāt sarvārthavivecanaṃ sarvorthasvabhāvavirahastatra śaśaviṣāṇādau tattvaṃ | na tvasataḥ kasyacid bhavanādeḥ samāveśaḥ |
 (p. 527) sahetukopi vināśa evam bhaviṣyatīti cedāha – netyādi | evaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat sarvārthavirahalakṣaṇo vināśah pareṣṭaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastuni tasya vināśasya bhāvād utpatteḥ | yaś ca bhavati sa kathamabhāvo virodhāt |
 yadi punarasāvai vināśo niḥsvabhāva eva kevalaṃ vaktṛbhirevambhavatīti vyāpāravāniva khyāpyate | na tu svayantathābhavanadharmā nīrūparvād asya | tadaivam iṣyamāṇe 'bhāvo bhavatīty api bruvāṇena | na kiñcid bhavatītīṣṭameva | kriyāpratiṣedhamātratvād asya vākyasya | tasmāt svayamanadhyāropitenākāreṇa kvacid vastuni bhavan svabhāvo vikalpadvayaṃ nātivarttete tattvamanyattvaṃ ceti prakārāntarābhāvāt °|| (280)
 rūpādiskandhasvabhāvaḥ pudgalo na bhavatyahta ca rūpādibhyo nānyaḥ | tasma tattvānyattvam ativarttata eva svabhāva iti cet |
 tanna (|) yasmādatattvamevātatsvabhāvatvameva svabhāvasyānyattvam iti |
 yadi pudgalopi na skandhasvabhāvastadā skandhebhyonya eva | yato na hi prasiddhānyattvayo rūparasayorapy anyad eva parasparamanyattvaṃ (|) kintvatatsvabhāvatvam evānyattvantac ca pudgalepy astīti sopi skandhebhyonya eveṣṭavyaḥ |
 nanvatatsvabhāvatvepi parasparaṃ svabhāvāpratibandhonyattvam iti cet | sa capratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣvasti tato tatsvabhāvatvepi nānyattvaṃ skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasyeti |
 koyamityādinā pratiṣedhati | koyaṃ pratibandho nāma pudgalasya skandheṣu yena pratibandhena | sa ca nasyād iti skandhasvabhāś capudgalo na syāt | nānyasvabhāvaś ca skandhebhyaḥ | anyaḥ svabhāvosyeti | vigrahaḥ |
 skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya janma tad eva janma pratibandha iti cet |
 (p.528) evaṃ sati kāryatvāt skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya tattvānyattvenāvācyatvam iṣṭaṃ | tathā ca sati sarvakāraṇānāmparasparamavācyatā syāt | tathā ceti kāryatvādavācyatve | sarvaḥ sarvasya kathaṃcid iti sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa copayogīti sarvatra kāryakāraṇabhāvānna ca kaścit  kutaścid anyaḥ syāt | evaṃ cānantaroktenāvācyatālakṣaṇenāvācyatetyapi bruvatā kāryakāraṇabhāva eva śabdāntareṇoktaḥ syānnārthabhedaḥ kaścit | anyattvantu na niṣiddhan eva | yasmāt svabhāvayoḥ parasparamananugamanamamiśrībhavanamanyattvambrūmaḥ | sa ca svabhāvānanugamaḥ svabhāvavatāṃ sarvapadārthānāmastyeveti parasparamanyattvam eva | na cānyaḥ pratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣu | yasmānna hi janmalakṣaṇājjanmasvabhāvāt svabhāvapratibandhādanyaḥ pratibando nāma | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anāyattasya tadutpattyā tatrāpratibanddhasya | tena saha yo vyabhicārastasyāvirodhāt | tatopratibandhāt pudgalsyaskandhebhyonyattvaṃ | dharmabhedāc cānyattvaṃ | tathā hy avācyatvam pudgalasya dharmaḥ skandhānāntu parasparamvācyatvam iti dharmabhedaḥ |
 yadyapi na janmakṛtaḥ pratibandhastathāpi pudgalasya skandheṣu jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandha iti cet |
 syād ityādinaitad eva yajjñānaṃ yasya pudgalasya jñānaṃ | tadgatāv iti rūpādigatau niyamena tasya pudgalasya pratibhāsanāt | jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandhastathā hi rūpaśabdādigrahaṇenaiva pudlagrahaṇam iṣyate | cakṣurādivijñānavijñeyatvāt pudgalasyeti | tena jñānakṛtāt pratibandhāt | tatpudgalākhyamvastu skandhebhyonyattvenāvācyamatadrūpam apy askandhasvabhāvam api |
 netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na pudgalasya rūpādipratipattināntarīyakaṃ jñānaṃ | kiṃ (p. 529) kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya pudgalasya rūpādisvabhāvamapahāya niḥsvabhāvatvāt svayaṃ | yasmāt sa eva hi tasya svabhāvo yo rūpādirūpaḥ pratibhāti |
 athārūpādisvabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ | tadā'rūpādisvabhāvatve 7sya pudgalasyātadvadrūpādivat pṛthakpratibhāvaprasaṅgāt | na ca pratibhāsate tato nāstyeva pudgalaḥ | yato dṛśyasyāpratibhāsamānasya cābhāvāt | athādṛśyaḥ pudgala iṣṭate (|) tadā adṛśyatvepi pudgalasyeṣyamāṇe na tadrūpaṃ jñānanna pudgalākāraṃ jñānam iti kasya kimāyattā pratītiḥ | na rūpādijñānanāntarīyakaṃ pudgalajñānam ity arthaḥ | tathā ca na jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandha iti bhāvaḥ |
 rūpadyāyattapratītitvād eva pṛthak pudgalo na pratibhāsata iti ced (|)
 āha – na cetyādi | yad vastu yadāyattapratītikam yatpratibaddhopalambhanantasya svabhāvapratibhāsa eva na ca naśyatīti sambandhaḥ | kim ivety āha – prakāśetyādi | yathā nīlādīnāmālokapratibaddhajñānānāmāloke pratibhāsamānepi svapratibhāso na naśyati | ālokavyatirekeṇā teṣāṃ pratibhāsanāt | tadvat pudgalasyāpi syāt ||
 api ca kā ca tasya pudgalasya pratyāsattiḥ sambandhastatra skandhe | yaditi | yena pratyāsattikāraṇena tasmiṃs kandhe 'nātmarūpe 'pudgalasvabhāve pratibhāsamāne svayampratyupatiṣṭhate | ātmānaṃ grāhayatīti yāvat |
 atiprasaṅgo hy evaṃ syāt | apratibaddhe pratibhāsamāne yadi niyamena pudgalaḥ pratibhāseta | tadā yasya kasyacitpratibhāsanenyopyatyantāsambandhaḥ pratīyata ity arthaḥ | pratīyamānasya pudgalasya tadupādānatārūpādyupādānatāpratyāsattir iti cet (|) koyamupādānārthaḥ | na tāvat pudgalasya rupādīnāñca yathākramaḍakāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | tasyānabhyupagamāt | kāryakāraṇabhāvābhyupagame vā na rūpādidarśane niyamena pudgalasya darśanaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yato na kāryakāraṇe | anyonyapratītipratyupasthāpane | yathā kāryāt kāraṇapratītistathā na kāraṇāt kāryapratī(p. 530)tir bhavatīty arthaḥ | na pudgalasya rūpādināntarīyakatā kintu pudgalasya yā pratīti stasyāḥ | tanāntarīyakatā rūpādināntarīyakatā |
 saiva pratyāsattir iti cet |
 nanu saiva pratītes tannāntarīyakatā | rūpādiṣu pudgalasyāsti pratibandhe na yuktety ucyate |
 akāryakāraṇayor api pudgalarūpādyoḥ pratibandho bhaviṣyatīti (|)
 ata āha – akāryakāraṇayor na kaścid vāstavaḥ prativandhaityasakṛduktaṃ yatpratipattināntarīyakaṃ yajjñānam ity api yad ucyate | tajjñāne rūpādiviveke | pudgalajñāne sati syāt | tac ca nāsti | yato yaḥ pudgale vijñāne svarūpeṇa na pratibhāsate svarūpāsaṃsargiṇānyāsaṃsargeṇetyarthaḥ | tasya kiñcijñānaṃ na hīti sambandhaḥ | tadabhāvād yathoktajñānābhāvādartharūpasya pudgalākhyasyābācyatālakṣaṇaṃ na sidhyati |
 tad iti tasmād vastutaḥ paramārthataḥ kvacid bhavatā kenacidarthena tatra tattvānyatvabhājā bhavitavyaṃ | vastuno gatyantarābhāvāt | yasya tu kṣaṇikavādino vinaś yato bhāvasya na kiñcid bhavati kevalaṃ sa bhāvaḥ svayam eva na bhavatīti mataṃ | tenābhāvo bhavatīty api bruvatā na bhāvo bhavatiti pratiṣedhamātramevoktaṃ na kasyacid vidhānaṃ | tato vābhāvaṃprati kṣaṇikavādinastattvānyatvavikalpasyāvatārostīti manyate |
 yadapītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yad apy ayaṃ kṣaṇikavādī bhāvasyābhāvo bhavatīti vidhisaṃsparśineva śabdenāha – tadapi bhāvo na bhavatītyevoktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ hi sa bhāvo nivartito bhavati yadi kañcinna vidhīyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratiṣedhe bhāvamātravyavacchede vidherasambhavāt |
 yataś ca vinaśyato bhāvasya na kaścid vastudharmo bhavati | tata evāsya bhāvasya vināśe na kaściddhetuḥ | tathā hi vinaśyatā bhāvenāpikṣata paro vināśahetuḥ | yadi (p. 531) tena bhāvasya kāryaṃ karttavyamvidyteta kiñcana | na tu kiñcit kāryam asti | tasmād akiñcatkaramvināśakāraṇaṃ | yaccākiñcit karamvastu | tatkiṃ kenacidapikṣyate | naivāpekṣyate |
 satītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sati hi karttavye kārakambhavati | na ca naśyato bhāvasya kiṃcit kāryam ityuktaṃ | tasmād yo nāma kaścinnāśahetuḥ sa bhāve na kiñcit karotītyakiñcitkaro nāpekṣaṇīyo vināśahetuḥ |
 tatkatham ityādi paraḥ | yadi vinaśyato nātiśayaḥ kaścidutpadyate | katham idānīm anutpannātiśayaḥ | anutpannotiśayosyeti vigrahaḥ | tadavastha eva pūrvarūpāvastha eva bhāvo vinaṣṭo nāma |
 nanvityādi siddhāntavādī | vināśahetoḥ sakāśād bhāvasyātiśayotpattāvapyaṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ sa eva tasyātiśayo nāśākhyaḥ | utpanna iti sa bhāvaḥ kathaṃ naṣṭo nāma | na hyanyabhāvenyasya nāśaḥ | yata evantena kāraṇenāyambhāvastadavastho na naṣṭo nāma | kintu yena yasmāt svayaṃ na bhavati tena naṣṭo nārthantarasya nāśākhyasyotpādādityanantaramevoktaṃ | yato na hi nāśakhyasyātiśayasyotpattyābhāvaḥ svayaṃ na bhūto nāma | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) abhāvasya sarve yetiśayāḥ | sāmarthyalakṣaṇāḥ | yāścopākhyāḥ vyapadeśāsteṣāṃ nivṛttyā | sarvasāmarthyavyapadeśanivṛttyety arthaḥ | sarvasya bhāvadharmasya bhavanarūpasya dharmasya yo viveko virahastallakṣaṇatvāt | bhāvasya cotpattisamāveśalakṣaṇatvāt | yasmād bhavatīti | bhāva ucyate | tenotpattiyogī bhāvaḥ | yataścaivantasmānnābhāve bhāvasya vināśe kasyacid anyasya bhāvo bhavanantasyopakṣepaḥ | na kasyacid bhavanam ity arthaḥ |
 (p. 532) eteneti svabhāvapratipādanena | ahetukatvepi nāśasyāṅgīkriyamāṇe sa nāśaḥ prathamamabhūtvā bhavatītyevam abhūtvā nāśasya bhāvataḥ kāraṇāt tasya nāśasyāṃkurādivat sattā syāt | nāśitvaṃ ceti | sattānāśitvadoṣasya yat prasañjanantatpratyākhyātametenaiva |
 yopītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ahetukepi nāśe 'sya nāśasyābhūtvā bhāvāt sattā 'nityatvaṃ ca durnivāraṃ abhūtvā bhavannahetuko bhavatītyapi viruddhaṃ kādācitkasyāhetutvāvirodhāt | sopi doṣopanyāso 'nenaiva vināśasya nīrūpatvapratipādanena pratyākhyātaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vināśakāle kasyacid dharmasya bhāvānabhyupagamāt |
 yathā tukye vastutve keṣāṃcid eva janmināmutpattimatāṃ pratigho nāma svadeśe parasyotpattivivandhalakṣaṇaiṣṭo na sarveṣāṃ | tathā bhāvānāmutpattimatāmeva nāśasvabhāvo bhavatu (|) na tvanutpattimatāmākāśādīnāṃ | tathā ca "yat sattatkṣaṇika"mityetad vyabhicārīti |
 athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | bhavatu nāma | svabhāva eṣa bhāvānāṃ (|) kosau svabhāva ityāha – ya ime kṣaṇisthitidharmāṇaḥ | kṣaṇasthitir dharmo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | sa tu kṣaṇasthitidharmasvabhāva utpattimatāmeva bhāvānāmbhaviṣyate | na tvamutpattimatāmākāśādīnāṃ |
 yasmān na hi svabhāva ityeva kṛtvā sarvaḥ sarvasya svabhāvo bhavati | pratighātmatāvat | yathā pratighātmatā vastusvabhāvatvepi na sarvasya bhavati tadvad ity arthaḥ |
 sattyamityā cāryaḥ | sarvaḥ sarvasya svabhāvo na bhavatīti sattyametat | tathāpy ayaṃ sapratighasya janako 'yaṃ neti svabhāvaniyamāddhetoḥ svabhāvaniyamaḥ ;hale 'yaṃ pratighe 'yaṃ neti | nānitye tu nānityatvaviṣaye kṛtakānāṃ rūpabhedosti yena kasyacinna(p. 533)śvaraḥ svabhāvaḥ syānnānyasay (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) aniryasvabhāvasya bhedakānāṃ hetunāmabhāvataḥ | sarveṣāmvinaśvarasvabhāvasay jananāditiyāvat |
 nanu nāśasvabhāvo bhāvānānnānutpattimatāṃ yadīti codyaṃ prakṛtaṃ | na ca tatrānitye rūpabhedosti bhedakānāmabhāvata ityayamparihāro yuktaḥ | na hyākāśādīnāṃ svahetukṛto vinaśvarasvabhāvonutpattimattvāt | tatkathaṃ  sattyam ityādyuktam iti |
 evam manyate (|) yathā sattvaṃ vyabhicāryuktantathā kṛtakopi kaścinnaśvaraḥ kaścinnetyāśakte | tenādāveva kṛtakatvasya vyabhicārantāvat parigartuṃ sattyamityādyuktam ityadoṣaḥ |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | anya iti sanidarśanādikaḥ | akasmād iti hetumantareṇa niyamavān | kvacit syāt kvacinneti | yādṛśī tu pratiniyataviṣayā | pratighādidharmmajanakasya hetoḥ śaktisthitiḥ | śaktiniyamastādṛśaṃ hetuśaktyanurūpaṃ phalambhavatīti kṛtvā hetusvabhāvaniyamāt phalasvabhāvaniyama iṣṭaḥ | ākasmilatve tu nirhetukatvesya phalasvabhāvaniyamasyokto doṣaḥ | deśakālaprakṛtinivamo na yujyata iti | tasmāt pratighātātmatāyā hetustasya svabhāvastasya pratiniyamavat | na naśvarajananapratiniyatasvabhāvaṃ hetubhūtambhāvasya paśyāmaḥ | kaścideva naśnaraṃ janayennasarvam ity evaṃ naśvarajanane pratiniyataḥ svabhāvo yasya bhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ | yena hetupratiniyamena | tajjanmā vinaśvarajananāddhetorjanma yasya sa tathā syānnaśvaraḥ syānnānyo yastadvilakṣaṇahetujanmeti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|)
 nanv ityādi paraḥ | sarvākārebhyo hetubhyo janma yeṣāmbhāvānānte naśyantītīdamapyaniśceyameva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) tāsāṃ hetusāmagrīṇāmarvāgdarśanairaniḥśeṣadarśanāt sākalyenādarśanāt | kasyāścit sāmagrayā naśvarajanikāyā darśanādadṛṣṭā api tajjātīyatayā tathā bhūtā niścīyanta iti ced (|)
 (p. 5.34) āha vicitretyādi | vicitrā śaktiryāsāmiti vigrahaḥ | sāmāgryo dṛśyante | tatra vicitraśaktiṣu sāmagrīṣu madhye kācit sāmagrī syādapi yā bhāvamanaśvarātmānaṃ janyet |
 netyādinā pariharati | ayaṃ ca parihāro nāśasvabhāvo bhāvānāṃ nānutpattimatāṃ | yadītyatrapicodye draṣṭavyaḥ sādhāraṇatvāt | nāyandoṣaḥ (|) kasmāt (|) jñeyādhikārāt |
 etadeva spaṣṭayannāha – ye kadācit kāle kvacid deśe kenacit puruṣeṇārthā jñātāḥ santaḥ punarna jñāyante teṣāṃ santānānubandhī nāśa iti brūmaḥ | ye cājñātāḥ santo jñāyante jñātā vā unar na jñāyante (| ) ta eva kṛtakā anityāssādhyante | anena cakṛtakatvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptiḥ sattvādityanena viścīyata ity uktam bhavati |
 nanu ca yadyapi te jñātāssanto na jñāyante tathāpi kathanteṣāmanityatvam iti (|)
 ata āha – yasmānna hy asti sambhavo yat te jñānajananasvabhāvāḥ pūrvampunaranaṣṭāstasminneva svabhāve sthitā na janayeyuḥ |
 sahakāryabhāvānnajanayantīti ced (|)
 āha – apekṣerannāparaṃ | na hyasya sambhavostīti sambandhaḥ | kiṃkāraṇaṃ (|) tajjananasvabhāvasya niṣpannatvāt |
 atha syāt (|) teṣvanapekṣeṣv api kasyacit kadācijjñānaṃ nivartteta | sarvasyasarvadā svaviṣayāṇi jñānāni janayeyuḥ | na caivam | kadācit jñānadarśanāt | tataś ca jñānamajanayanto janakasvabhāvāt pracyutā iti gamyate |
 yattarhyajñeyaṃ kṛtakamakṛtakamvā tannaivambhaviṣyatīti (|)
 ata āha – naityādi | na caivaṃbhūtamajñeyaṃ kiṃcidasti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvasyārthasya kenacit puruṣeṇa kadāciñjñānāt | atha tajjñānam api na janayet | tadā (p.535) jñānamātrārthakriyāyām apu asāmarthye tatsāmarthyarahitambastveva na syāt | tathā hi tallakṣaṇamarthakriyāsāmarthyalakṣaṇamvastv iti vakṣyāmaḥ | tasya cārthaktiyāsamarthasya vastunaḥ krameṇārthkriyāṃ kurvato vināśāvyabhicārādahetutvācca vināśasyasattānubandhī vināśaḥ siddhaḥ | ata evānantaroktāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvasādhanācchabdārthayossambandhasyāpi nityatā pratyākhyeyā | dūṣyā |
 (ne)tyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ata eva yathoktād vināśasya vastumātrānubandhāt | śabdavad (|) yathā śabdasya nityatā pratikṣiptā tadvat sambandhasyāpi nityatā pratyākhyeyā | evantāvat sambandhaṃ vyatiriktamabhyupagamya doṣa ukto 'dhunā 'vyatirikta eva sambandho na yujyata iti (|)
 āha – yā ca śabdaktiryogyatākhyā yogyatāsaṃjñitārthapratipattyāśrayo jaiminīyairvarṇṇyate | sā yogyatāśabdārthāntaram eva na bhavati | tathā hi bhāvānāṃsvabhāvātiśaya eva vivakṣitārthakriyāsamartho yogyatetyāveditaṃ prāk | "samarthaṃ hi rūpaṃ śabdasya yogyate" tyādinā |
 tena śabdasyānityatve yogyatāyā apy anityatvam avyatirekād iti bhāvaḥ |
 (p.536) astu vā śabdād arthāntaraṃ yogyatā | tathāpi śabdaśaktiś ca dūṣitā veditavyā | kaiḥ (|) sambandhadoṣaiḥ prāguktaiḥ |
 ukto hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sambandhaḥ sambandhibhyorthantaram ity evamvāde 'nekaprakāro doṣa uktaḥ |
 "sambandhināmanityatvānna sambandhesti nityatā" ityādinā | tenaiva prāguktena doṣeṇa śabdaśaktir api sambandharūpeṇa kalpitā dūṣiteti kṛtvā na punaḥ pṛthagucyate doṣaḥ |
 tadevaṃ nāpauruṣeyo vedaḥ |
 bhavatu nāmāpauruṣeyastathāpi na tasya satyārthatā niścetuṃ śakyā | yasmādapauruṣeyamityeva kṛtvā na vaidikamvacanaṃ yathārthajñānasādhanaṃ | aviparītārthajñānahetuḥ | yasmāt puruṣāgasā puruṣadoṣeṇāduṣṭo vahnyādinā (|) ādiśabdājjyotsnādiḥ (|) anyathāpi dṛṣṭo vitathājñānaheturdṛṣṭa ity arthaḥ |
 bhavatvityādinā vyācaṣṭe | bhavantu nāmāpauruṣeyā vaidikāḥ śabdāstathāpi sambhāvyamevaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmayathārthajñānahetutvam | yato na hi puruṣadoṣopadhānādeva | puruṣadoṣe rāgādibhirupadhānāt | saṃskārādeva | artheṣu jñāpyeṣu jñāpakānāṃ śabdānāṃ jñānavibhramo jñānaviparyāsaḥ | prakṛtyāpi mithyājñājajananasyasambhāvyatvāt | yasmāt tadrahitānāmapi puruṣadoṣopadhānarahitānāmapi pradīpādīnāmvitathārthajñānjananāt | ādiśabdājjyotsnādīnāṃ (|) kutra (|) nīlo tpalādiṣu | tathā hi ratrau pratīpo nīlotpale raktapratibhāsajñānahetuḥ | jyotsnāpīte vastre śuklajñānahetuḥ | taditi tasmād ime vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ puruṣasaṃskāranirapekṣāḥ syuriti sambandhaḥ prakṛtyā ca svabhāvena cārtheṣu pratītihetavo jñānahetavaḥ syuḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvaviśeṣāt svarūpaviśeṣāt | kimiva (|) vahnyādivat | (p. 537) vitathavyaktayaś ca syurniyamena | vitathā vyaktayorthapratipattayo yebhyaḥ śabdebhya iti vigrahaḥ | vitathavyaktaya eva sadā vaidikāḥ śabdā ity asyaviyamasya kāraṇaṃ nāsi (|) tato niyamakāraṇābhāvād vitathavyaktaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā ityetat kalpanamayuktam iti cet | tavāpimīmāṃsakasyāvitathajñānahetavo vaidikāḥ śabdā ity asminnavitathavyaktiniyame kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) naiva kiñcit | tasmāt tvanmatena yathārthavyaktiniyamatvāt prakṛtyā svabhāvenāyathārthavyakriniyamaḥ kinnakalpyate |
 athavā yathā vahnyādayo ghaṭādiṣu nīlotpalādiṣu cārtheṣu yathāyogaṃ satyāsatyajñājahetavastathā vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmartheṣu mithyetarajñānaheturvenobhayajñānahetutvaṃ syāt | yasmānnahyapauruṣeyā api vahnyādayo vanadavacandrālokādirūpāḥ | ekatra ghaṭādau divā yathārthajñānahetavopi santaḥ sarvatra nīlotpalādāvapi rātrautathā bhavanti yathārthajñānahetavo bhavanti | tathā vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmapyapuruṣeyatvepyubhayaṃ syāt | yathārthāyathārthajñānahetutvaṃ syāt |
 bhavatvityādi paraḥ | vahnyādīnāṃ kṛtakatvāt kāraṇād yathāpratyayaṃ yasya na punarnityeṣu śabdeṣvetat sahakāripratyayabalena mithyājñānahetutvamasti | nityānāṃ sahakāribalenānyathā pravṛttyasambhavāt |
 nanvityādi siddhāntavādī | evaṃvidha iti sahakāribalenārtheṣyanyathā parivṛttilakṣaṇostyeva dharmmaḥ (|) tatrāpīti vaidikeṣv api śabdeṣu | kiṃkāraṇaṃ (|) teṣām api vaidikānāṃ saṃdetabalādanyathāvṛtteḥ puruṣecchānuvidhāyisaṃketabalenānyathā pratītijananād ity arthaḥ |
 atha saṃketabalānna teṣāmartheṣu parāvṛttiriṣyate | kintu nityatvāt svabhāvata eva svaviṣayajñānajananasvabhāvā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ | tadā kāryasya svaviṣayajñānasya (p.538) yo jananasvabhāvastatra sthitau caiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ samayādeḥ (|) ādiśabdād anyasyāpi karaṇavyāpārāder apekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt kāraṇāt | tato vaidikāccabdāt pratītir jñānam artheṣu sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt | na cāsti sarvasya sarvadārthapratītiḥ | tasmānna vaidikāḥ śabdā arthapratītipratiṣṭhitasvabhāvāḥ kintu samayādikamapekṣyanta eveti | tepi mithyājñānasya hetava iti tadavastho doṣaḥ |
 api ca (|) tasmin śabde 'kṛtake mate iṣṭe sati na jñānahetutaiva syāt | yasmānna hi nityebhyo vastusāmarthyāt svarūpopadhānasāmarthyena janmāsti kasyacit | jñānasyānyasya vā (|)
 yadyakṛtaka ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyakṛtakaśśabdo vaidikastatortheṣu pratītir eva na syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratītīryādi | itaradajanmājanma ca itaracceti vigrahaḥ | tayoḥ kālo pratīter janmetarakālayos tukyarūpasya nityatvādekarūpasya pratītir janmani sāmarthyasambhāvanā 'yogāt | pratīterajanmakāle yattasya janakaṃ rūpantasminneva svabhāve sthitasya janakatvavirodhāt | kiṃ kāranam (|) evam anena rūpeṇāyaṃ nityābhimato janako naivamanena rūpeṇājanaka ityevam vivecanīyasya pṛthag vyavasthāpy asya rūpabhedasya svabhāvabhedasyābhāvāt | nityasya sarvadaikarūpatvāt |
 ekasvabhāvopi pūrvajanakaḥ paścājjanako bhaviṣyatīti ced (|)
 āha netyādi | asya nityasyājanako yādṛśaḥ svabhāvastādṛśa eva janako na yuktaḥ | ekarūpatvāt | sahakāriṇamadhikaṃ prāpya paścājjanayatītyādi mithyā | yatonyāpekṣāpi sahakāryapekṣāpi nityasya niṣiddhaiva prāk |
 yata evantasmānnityānāṃ śabdānāṃ kvacid artheṣu puruṣe jñānajananasāmarthyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kadācijjñānasyājanane sati paścādai tatsvabhāvatvānnityamajananaprasaṅgāt |
 atha mābhūdeṣa doṣa iti nityaṃ svakāryaṃ kurvantyevetīṣyate |
 (p. 539) tadapi nāsti | svaviṣayajñānakāryasya sātatyādarśanāc ca | na te śabdāḥ kathaṃcit kenacit prakāreṇa karttāra ityetac coktaṃ prak |
 syād etat (|) nityebhyopyākāśādibhyo buddhayo bhavantyeva kasyacit kadācid iti (|)
 ata āha – yā apyetā nityābhimateṣv ākāśādeṣu pratipattayo buddhayo bhaviṣyantītīṣyate | tā api na tatsvabhāvabhāvinyo nākāśādisvabhāvāyattajanmānaḥ | nityānāṃ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthkriyāvirodhāt |
 kim punarutpattau tāsāṃ nimittam iti (|)
 āha – na hītyādi | anādiḥ samānajātīyo yo vikalpastenāhitā yā vāsanā śaktistata udbhūtā utpannā | yathāgamaṃ samāropito ya ākāśādyākārastadgocarāstatpratibhāsinya eva kevalaṃ gatāḥ | tatra bāhyatvena kalpiteṣv ākāśādiṣu jāyante | na tu tā buddhayor thagocarā nākāśādisvalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ |
 svalakṣaṇetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svalakṣaṇaviṣayā hi buddhir niyamena tasya svalakṣaṇasya yogyatā sāmarthyantasyopasthānaṃ sannidhānantadanuvidhāyinī tadbhāva eva bhāvinīti kṛtvā | asyā buddher yat kāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yogyaṃ samarthantasmin kāraṇeyogye sati sābuddhirbhavatyeva | tadevaṃ nyāye sthite yadi nityānāṃ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇe kasyacit puṃso jñānaṃ syāt | tadā nityaṃ kāraṇasya sannidhāt sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt |
 nāpi sahakāryapekṣayā nityānāṃ kasyacit kadācijjñānajananantathā hi kāryo janayaḥ sahakāribhir viśeṣo yāsāṃ vyaktīnāntā hi vyaktayaḥ kathaṃciddeśakālāvasthāniyamena kvacit kārye upayujyamānā hetutvam pratipadyamānāstasya kāryasyopajanane (p. 540) yogyo yotiśaya ātmabhūtastasya pralambhe hetumbastuviśeṣaṃ sahakāriṇam iti yāvat |
 tathetyanityatvavat | nityo bhāvo kāryaviśeṣonādheyātiśayaḥ kenacit puṃsā gṛhyamāṇastatkāraṇāpekṣaḥ grahaṇasahakārikāraṇāpikṣo yadi grahaṇam asya puṃso janayet | yuktaṃ yatenaiva puṃsā gṛhyeta nānyena sahakāripratiniyamāt | tac ca sahakāryapekṣayā  jananaṃ nityasya na sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sthitasvabhāvatvād | niytasya sahakāriṇā nādheyātiśayatvād iti yāvat |
 tataś ca nityaṃ jananasvabhāve sthitatvāt sarveṇa puṃsā samamekakālaṃ gṛhyetātha sarveṇājanakatvānna gṛhyeta | tadā sa evāsya svabhāva iti na vā kenacit puruṣeṇa kadācid gṛhyeta | iti hetos san nidyamāno nityo bhāvo yadi kenacit yogināpi dṛṣṭastadā na kaścinnityo 'tīndriyaḥ syāt sarveṣāmavaśyaṃ kenacid darśanāt | tathā cāsu nityaṃ sarvapuruṣāṇām indriyagrāhya eva syāt sarvapuruṣamprati jñānajananasāmarthyāviśeṣāt | na cedaṃ sarvapuruṣagrāhyatvannityasyāsti | tasmādarthasāmarthyānapekṣā ākāśādisvalakṣaṇasāmarthyānapekṣakāḥ samāropitagocarāḥ | yathāgamamadhyāropitā 'kāśādyākārapratibhāsinya ity arthaḥ | āntaramevopādānakāraṇamāśityadīdṛśaṃ vikalpavāsanāprabodhaṃ | ākāśādivikalpanānāditā | yā āhitā vāsanā tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādanaṃ pratyābhimukhyaṃ | yata evārthasāmarthyānapekṣā ata eva bāhyārthśūnyā bhrāntaya evākāśādiṣu sarvasya puṃso bhavnti |
 sthitam etat (|) nāsti nityebhyaḥ kāryotpāda iti | śabdāttu dṛśyate kadācijjñānakāryantasmānnāparāvṛttidharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ | ekarūpatāyāṃ aparāvṛttireva dharmo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | kintu jñānaṃ jñānaṃ pratyarthā bhinnavṛttya eva |
 atha nityam ekarūpā eva tadā ttatve vā | ekarūpatve vā'bhyupagamyamāne 'vitathārthapratītaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā iti kuta etat | avitathā arthapratītir yebhya iti vigrahaḥ |
 (p. 541) syānmatam (|) "agnirhimasya bheṣajam" ityādivaidikavākyasyāvitathatvāt sarvasyāvitathatvam iti (|)
 ata āha – na hītyādi | na hyagnirhim asya bheṣajaṃ pratipakṣa ityevamādiṣu vedavākyeṣvagneḥ śītapratighātasāmarthyamvedavākyāt | prāgapi yathāsaṃketam lokaprasiddhaṃ khyāpyata iti kṛtvā sarvam adṛṣṭārtham api vedavākyantathā bhavati | avitathambhavati | lokaprasiddhe hyarthe lokasya samketānusāreṇa vyavahāro dṛṣṭaḥ | tatolokasya svecchākṛto yah saṃketastenānu paścād vyavahārakāle vyavahārakāle vyavahārāt | sandeha eva kimayaṃ lekaḥ svasaṃketamanuvidadhat | anusaran |
 agnirhimasya bheṣajamityādivākyādevampratyetyagneḥ śītāpanodasāmarthyam iti niścinotyāhosvicchabdasvabhāvasthiteḥ śabdasya svabhāvena prakṛtyā sāmarthyaniyamādevaṃ pratyetīti | yadā ca dṛṣṭa evārthe vaidikasya śabdasya svatorthapratipādanaśktissandigdhā tadātyantaparokṣepyarthe nitarāṃ sambhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ |
 nanvanādilokaprasiddhyanuvidhānevaiva vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmarthavattā na ca tatra sandehaḥ pratibhāsata iti (|)
 ata āha – lokecchayā parāvarttyamānā yathāsamayamartheṣu niveśyamānāḥ punar anyatra deśādiparāvṛttāvanyathetyarthāntaraniveśena parāvartyamānāḥ śabdā dṛśyante | iti hetor lokaprasiddhyānuvidhānepyaṅgīkriyamāṇe sambhavatyevaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmanyathābhāvo mithyātvaṃ | prasiddherevāniyatatvāt |
 tasmāt kasyacid vaidikasya vākyasyā"gnir himasyabheṣajam" ityādikasyāviparītyadarśanepi sarveṣāṃ vidavākyānāntathābhāvassatyārthatvanna sidhyati |
 akṛtakatvādeva satyārthatvam iti ced (|)
 (p. 542) āha – akṛtakasvabhāvatvehyeṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ mithyārthaniyatopi kaścicchabdaḥ syāt | iti hetoḥ svabhāvaparijñānadayaṃ  satyārtho yaṃ mithyārtha ityevaṃ vivekena śabdasvabhāvāniścayāt sarvatra śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt | satyārthm vaidikamvākyam akṛtakatvāditi prayoge kriyamāṇenvayābhāvāt |
 vyatirekiprayogamāha – mithyātvam ityādinā | mithyātvaṃkṛtakeṣveva dṛṣṭam iti hetor akṛtakamvacaḥ satyārthaṃ yadīti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vyatirekesya virodhivyāpanāt | akṛtakasya hetoryo vyatirekaḥ kṛtakatvantena satyārthatvaṃ yatsādhyantasya vidodhimithyātvantasya vyāpanāt | vyatirekasyeti karttari ṣaṣṭhī | hetuvyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena satyārthavirodhino mithyārthatvasya vyāptatvāt | vaidike śabdo 'kṛtakatvāt kṛtakatvanivṛttau mithyārthtvanivṛtteḥ satyārthatvaṃ sidhyatveva |
 yathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yatkiñcinmithyārthamvacaḥ tadakhilanniḥśeṣaṃ kṛtakam iti kṛtvā | hetorakṛtakatvasya vyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavyatirekasya | sādhyaṃ satyārthatvaṃ tasya vyatireko mithyātvantasya vyāpteranyatrākṛtake mithyārthatvasyāsambhavāt kāraṇād akṛtakaṃ satyārtham iti syād vināpyanvayena | satyārtham vaidikamvaco kṛtakatvād ity atra prayoge yadyapyanvayo nāsti | tathāpyanvayena vinā sidhyaty evety arthaḥ | yasmād yo hy artho mithyātvalakṣaṇo yena kṛtakatvenāvyāptastatra mithyātve tadvyatirekastasyāvyāpakasya kṛtakatvasya vyatireko kṛtakatvena mithyārthatāyā vyāpyteḥ | na ca viruddhasya sambhavo yato na ca viruddhayoḥ kṛtakatvākṛtakatvayorekatra mithyātve sambhavosti | tenākṛtake satyārthatvaṃ vijātīyasya mithyārthatvasyāsambhave | satyārthamithyārthatvābhyāṃ nānyā gatirastīta gatyantarābhāvādakṛtakatvena satyārtha eva bhavitavyam ity akṛtakatvād iṣṭā(p. 543)rthasya satyārthatvalakṣaṇasya siddheḥ kimanvayena | tatsādhanatvāc ca liṅgasya iṣṭārthasādhanatvāc ca liṅgasya vyarthamanvayadarśanaṃ | kasmād (|) yathoktavidhinā vyatirekamātreṇaiva sādhyasiddher iti |
 sattyametadityā cāryaḥ |
 vipakṣāddhetor vyatireke siddhe sati sādhyaṃ sidhyediti sattyametat | yadi sattyārthatā 'kṛtakatvavipakṣayor mithyātvakṛtakatvayor vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ sidhyet | tadā kṛtakatvena vyāptān mithyārthatvādakṛtakannivartate | sa tu vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo vipakṣayor na siddhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | yasmāt mithyātve 'kṛtakatvasyāsambhave 'sambhavanimittaṃ bādhake hetāvanukte sati | bhāvassattvantasyāpyakṛtakatvasya mithyātve śakyate | akṛtakaṃ ca syānmithyārthaṃ ceti | (290 ab)
 nanu ca mithyātve kṛtakatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ (|) yatra ca kṛtakatvantatra kathamakṛtakatvam iti (|)
 ata āha – viruddhānāmityādi | viruddhānām api padārthānām ekavyāpakadarsanāt | yathā prayatnāprayatnanāntarīyakāṇāmanityānāmekena kṛtakatvena vyāptiḥ |
 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyakṛtakatvākhyāsya hetossādhyavipakṣe mithyārthatve 'bhāvaḥ sidhyettadā sādhyasya satyārthatvasya vyatirekaṃ mithyātvaṃ hetuvyatirekaḥ hetorakṛtakatvasya vyatirekaḥ kṛtakatvākhyo vyāpnuyāt | na ca tasyākṛtakatvasya tatra mithyārthatāyāmasambhave bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
 akṛtakatvād eva vedasya mithyārthatāyāmavṛttir iti ced (|)
 āha na cetyādi | mithyārthatvenāviruddhasyākṛtatvasya vidhirmithyārthatā pratiṣedhasya sādhano yuktaḥ | kasmād (|) atiprasaṅgāt | evaṃ hi yasya kasyacid vidhānena yasya kasyacidabhāvaḥ pratīyeta |
 kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasyākṛtake kathaṃ vṛttir iti ced (|)
 āha – na caikatra kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasya punar anyatrākṛtake 'sambhava eva (|) kintu sambhava eva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) pṛthagviruddhasahabhāvināmpṛthag iti (p. 544) vyaktibhedena viruddhasahabhāvināmviruddhairarthair ekatra bhāvinām api darśanāt | anityatvavat prayatnānantarīyaketarayoritaradaprayatnānantarīyakaṃ | anityatvaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvena saha dṛṣṭamaprayatnānarīyakatvena saha dṛśyate |
 yadyevamakṛtake mithyātvasyādarśanādabhāvaḥ sayād iti (|)
 ata āha – na ca tathāvidhasyetyakṛtakasya sato mithyātvasyādarśanādasatvameva |
 yasmānna vipakṣe hetorasattāsiddhiḥ sarvatonupalambhanādity uktaṃ prāk | tataś cāsiddhāyāṃ vipakṣāddhetor asattāyāṃ sandigdhavipakṣād vyatirekitā |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ayam yuruṣamātraka ityarvāgdarśī sarvamvastu draṣṭuṃ samartho yenāsya puṃso darśananivṛttyā na tathā syāt | adṛṣṭo na syāt | yasmād (|) yasya hi puṃso jñānaṃ jñeyasattāṃ na vyabhicarati | sad ity eva kṛtva yasya sarvasmin jñ(jñe?)ye jñānaṃ pravartate tasya jñānaṃ jñeyavyāpakaṃ nivartamānaṃ jñeyam api nivartamānaṃ jñeyamapi nivartayati | atosāvadarśanānnāstītyevaṃ vruvāṇaḥ śobheta | na sarvam (|) tad iti | tasmād (|) ime bhāvāḥ santopyanupalakṣyāḥ apohyāḥ syuḥ | kathaṃ (|) svabhāvadeśakālaviprakarṣeṇa | svabhāvaś ca deśaś ca kālaś ca tairviprakarṣo vyavadhānam iti vigrahaḥ | sannapi kaściddeśakālābhyāṃ svabhāvena ca viprakaṛṣṭaḥ piśācādivat | (291)
 nanu kālavyavahitānāmatitānāgatānāmanupalambhādasatvaṃ yuktamabhāvādeva | satyaṃ (|) kevalamatītānāgatānāmedānīmanupalambhepi kadācit sattvaṃ bhūtaṃ kadācid bhaviṣṭatīty anupalambhābhāva iti |
 tathā hītyādinaitadeva bodhayati | ko hyasarvadarśī | atyantaparokṣerthe vacanasyākṛtakasya samvādanaṃ itarasya kṛtakasya vacanasyātyantaparokṣerthe | itaradvetyasambādanaṃ bhāvayituṃ niścetuṃ samarthaḥ (|) naiva | pareṇa kṛtakasyāsamvādanam iṣṭam iti dvayam uktaṃ |
 (p. 545) syād etad (|) ekasya vedavākyasya samvādadarśanāt sarvatra vede samvādanam iti (|)
 ata āha – pratipāditaṃ caitaccheṣavadanumānacintāyāṃ pūrvam eva | kiṃ pratipāditam ity āha – kvacid ityādi | kvacid deśakāle vā | tathetyetena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānāmarthānāṃ punar anyathābhāvaḥ | pūrvadṛṣṭākārād vaiparītyaṃ | etadevāḥ | yathetyādi saṃskāraviśeṣāt kṣīramadhvādipariṣkā(rā)dilakṣaṇāt | āmalakīphalāni ca kvaciddeśe madhurāṇīti sambandhaḥ | na cedanīmataddarśinā | madhuranimbaphalādyadarśinā | tāni madhurāṇi nimbaphalāni pratikṣeptavyānyeva | tathā vedavākyānāmmithyātvaṃ yadi nāma dṛṣṭantathāpi na śakyampratikṣeptuṃ | tasmādakṛtakaṃ ca syānmithyārthaṃ cetyakṛtakamithyārthatvayorna virodhampaśyāmaḥ |
 nanu mithyārthatāyāmakṛtakatvasyānupalambhādabhāva ity ata āha – na hīyam anupalabdhiradṛśyātmasvadṛśyasvabhāvertheṣvabhāvasya sādhiketyuktaṃ prāk | yataś cākṛtakatvasya na mithyātve 'bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | tena yat kiṃcinmithyātvantatsarvaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ | iti evammithyārthatvasya kṛtakatvenāvyāptiḥ | kiṅkāraṇamaniścayāt | akṛtakatvasya mithyārthatve vyatirekāniścayādityarthaḥ | na cāniścitavyatirekāddheto ssakāśāt sādhyasiddhiḥ |
 tathā hi svasādhyena hetoranvayo vyāptiḥ | vyatireko vā vipakṣād vyāvṛttir vā | satvaṃ vā hetoḥ sādhyadharmiṇi | pakṣadharmmam ity arthaḥ | etāni ca trīṇi rūpāṇi jñānaiḥ pramāṇair yadi saidhyanti kīdṛśaistanniścayaphalaustasya rūpatrayasya niścayaḥ phalaṃ yeṣām iti vighraḥ | tadā tāni trīṇi rūpāṇi vavakṣitasya sādhyasya sādhanambhavanti | yathoktamācārya dignāgena | ya eva hyubhayaniścitavācī | vādiprativādibhyāṃ niścitasya hetulakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ sa sādhanandūṣaṇam vā ashiddhatvādilakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ śabdaḥ prativādinā dūṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa prayuktaḥ | nānyataraprasiddhaḥ sandigdhavādo vādiprativādibhyāmanyataraprasiddhasya sandigdhasya cobhayoranyatarasya ca yo vācakaḥ śabdaḥ sa na sādhanaṃ (p. 546) nāpi dūṣaṇaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) punaḥ sādhanāpikṣatvāt | aniścitasya niścayārthaṃ punaḥ pramāṇāpekṣatvāt | na cākṛtakatvena saha mithyārthatvasya virodho niścito yenākṛtake mithyātvasya vyatirekaḥ siddhaḥ syāt |
 atha syād (|) akṛtakatvādeva vede mithyātvaṃ na bhavatīti ced (|)
 āha – ko hītyādi | yasmāt ko hi sacetā akṛtakatvena sahādṛṣṭavirodhasya mithyātvasya sambhavamvedavākyeṣu pratyācakṣīta | taditi tasmādayamakṛtakatvasya hetor yatho kto vyatireko na sādhanaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) saṃśayāt | itaś ca vyatirekī hetor nāstīti darśayannāha –
 api cetyādi | yatra viṣaye sādhyavipakṣasya | sādhyaṃ satyārthatvantadvipakṣasya mithyātvasya varṇṇayate vyatirekitā | yatkṛtakaṃ na bhavati tanmithyārthanna bhavatīti | ya eva mithyārthatvavyavacchedasya viṣayaḥ | sa evāsya kṛtakasya hetoḥ sapakṣaḥ syād (|) ataḥ kāraṇāt sarvo heturanvayī | anvayavyatirekī (|) vyatirekasya prakṛtatvāt | na vyatirekyevety arthaḥ |
 nanu sādhyadharmasāmānyena samānorthaḥ sapakṣaḥ sādharmyadṛṣṭānta ucyate | na cāyamihāsti (|) tatkathaṃ sa evāsya sapakṣaḥ syād ity ucyate |
 satyaṃ (|) sapakṣasādhyatvenānvaya eva sapakṣa ucyate | ata evāha (|) sarvo heturatonvayīti |
 yad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yatkiñcin mithyātvasyābhāvasiddhau satyāṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kṛtakatvābhāve bhavato mithyārthatvasya tena kṛtakatvena  vyāptyayogāt | tasmād vyāptimicchatā | mithyārthatvasya kṛtakatvanivṛttyā nivṛttireṣṭavyā | yaiva ca sādhyasādhanavijātīyayormithyātvakṛtakatvayor vyāvṛttisiddhiḥ | kṛtakavanivṛtyā (p. 547) mithyārthavannivartata ityevam rūpā | sauvākṛtakasya hetoḥ satyārthatvenānvayasthitiranvayavyavasthitiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vipakṣavyavacchedalakṣaṇatvāt sādhyasya satyārthatvasya | vipakṣo mithyātvantasya kṛtakatvanivartano kṛtake yo vyavacchedo vyāvṛttistallakṣaṇatvāt |
 kiñca (|) satyārthatāpratiṣedho mithyārthatvaṃ | tasya ca mithyārthatvasyākṛtake yadā pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtastadā pratiṣedhadvayañjātaṃ | asmāc ca satyārthatāvyavacchedarūpāt pratiṣedhadvayāt satyārthatāvidhisiddher iti hetoḥ kānanvayānvayarahitā | sādhanavyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavyatirekasya mithyātvasya vyāptisiddhir naivānanvayā vyāptisiddhiḥ |
 tad iti tasmānna kaścid dhetur ananvayo nāma | kintu sarvonavayavyatirekavāneva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) ekavyavacchedasyākṛtake mithyārthatvavyavacchedasya | vijātīyasiddhimāntarīyakatvāt | mithyārthatā vijātīyasya satyārthatvasya yā siddhistannāntarīyakatvāt |
 yady ekavyavacchedastadvijātīyasiddhināntarīyakastadā 'nityanirātmādivyavacchedepi anityatāyā nirātmatāyā ādiśabdād duḥkhatvādīnāñ ca | yadā kvaciccchaśaviṣāṇādau vyavacchedaḥ kriyate tadāpi tathā syāt | mithyārthatāvyavacchedena satya(ā)rthasiddhivadanityatvādivijātīyānānnityasātmakasukhatvādīnāṃ siddhiḥ syāt | na caitadiṣṭaṃ (|) tathātrāpi mābhūd iti paro manyate |
 netyādinā parihārati | nāyandoṣaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vyatirekavyavacchedasya bhāvarūpatvāt | vyatireko 'bhāvo (|) abhāvasya ca yovyavacchedo nivṛttistasya bhāvarūpatvāt | abhāvanivṛttyā bhāvavyavastheti yāvat | tadanenabhāvalakṣaṇam uktaṃ | asmād eva vacanādidamapyarthāduktambhavati | bhāvavyavacchedasyābhāvarūpatvād iti | tadanena bhāvābhāvayos tāvallakṣaṇam uktaṃ | tatra yasmin vyavacchidyamāne | na bhāvānuṣaṅgaḥ | yasmiṃś ca vyavacchidyamāne bhāvānuṣaṅgastaddarśayannāha – na bhāvetyādi | bhāvasvabhāvasya vyavacchede sati na bhāvānuṣaṅgo na bhāvasyākṣepaḥ | bhāvo na bhava(p. 548) tīti tatpratiṣedhasyaiva sambhavāt | abhāvavyavacchedasvabhāvasya virahamātrasya tu yo vyavacchedas sa niyamena bhāvasyopasthāpano bhāvasyākṣepakaḥ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) bhāvābhāvayor anyonyaṃ yo viveko virahastadrūpatvāt | tatsvabhāvatvāt | bhāvavivekasyābhāvarūpatvādabhāvavivekasya ca bhāvarūpatvād ity arthaḥ |
 evantāvad bhāvābhāvavyavacchedayor bhāvānākṣepākṣepakatva1muktvā prakṛtaṃ yojayatyabhāvarūpastvityādinā | satyārthatāyāstu yo vyatireko mithyārthatālakṣaṇaḥ | sa satyārthatā 'bhāvarūpā sa vyatiricyamānaḥ kṛtakatvanivṛtyā nivartamāno bhāvaṃ satyārthatālakṣaṇamupasthāpayatyakṛtake |
 1: B. bhāvānākṣepakatvamuktvā |

 yadi tu satyārthatvaviparītarūpaṃ mithyārthatvampareṇābhyupagamyate | tadā vedavākyeṣu kṛtakanivṛttau mithyātvam2 eva na syānna tu satyārthatvantataś cānarthakyaṃ syād iti vakṣyati | tasmādabaśyaṃ satyārthatā bhāvarūpā3 | mithyārthatālakṣaṇo dharma eṣṭavyaḥ (|) sa ca vyatiricyamānassatyārthatāyā bhāvamupasthāpayati | naivaṃ nairātmyādayo viraharūpāḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) bhogaḥ sukhaduḥkhānubhavastayoradhiṣṭhānaṃ svīkārastatrāsvatantraḥ paravaśo hyātmā svabhāvo nirātmā | svabhāvaparyāyotrātmaśabdaḥ | kiṃ punah kāranam (|) evaṃ bhūtaḥ svabhāvo nirātmā | svabhāvaparyāyotrātmaśabdaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam (|) evaṃbhūtaḥ svabhāvo nirātmā bhavatītyāha – tatsvātantryetyādi | tasmin kriyābhogādhiṣṭhāne yatsvātantryaṃ tallakṣa(ṇa)4tvāt | tatsvabhāvatvādevātmanaḥ paraiḥ kalpitasya | atastadvaidharmyeṇāsvatantrasvabhāvo nirātmā bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ |
