 6: B. svātantryaḥ |
 yasyāpi naiyāyikādernābhāvarūpa ātma(ā)vyatirekaḥ (|) kintarhi (|) svabhāvābhāva eva tasya naiyāyikāderbhāvarūpasya nairātmyasya vyavacchede nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt | iti hetoḥ śaśaviṣāṇādau nairātnyavyavacchedepyātmano nānvayānuṣaṅgaḥ | ātmanānvayonugamo na bhavatītyarthaḥ | yathā ca śaśaviṣāṇādau nairātnyavyavacchedepyātmano nānvayānugamastathā jīvacchīre 'nairātmyepi nairātmyābhāvepi mātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt |
 athavānyathā vyākhyāyate | mīmāṃsako ktavyatirekinirākaraṇaprastāvena naiyāyiko ktamapi vyatirekiṇaṃ nirākarttum āha – yasyāpītyādi | yasyāpi naiyāyikādernābhāvarūpa ātmā vyatirekaḥ (|) kintarhi (|) nairātmyambhāvasvabhāva eva | tasyaivamvādino naiyāyikasya bhāvarūpasya nairātmyasya vyavaddhede nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt | bhāvavyavacchede bhāvāntarānuṣaṅgābhāvāt | iti hetoryatra prāṇādimatvantatrātmeti nānvayānuṣaṅgaḥ | yathā ca nānvayānuṣaṅgastathā sādhyadharmiṇyanairātmyepi nairātmyanivṛttāvapi nātmano bhāvasiddhiḥ syāt |
 etad eva prayogapūrvakandarśayannāha – yathetyādi | idaṃ jīvaccharīraṃ na nirātmakaṃ prāṇādimatvāditi | āśvāsaḥ prāṇaḥ | ādiśabdāt praśvāsādiparigrahaḥ | atra prayoge jīvaccharīrasya sātmakarvaṃ sādhyanna cobhayasidhaḥ | sa pakṣabhūta ātmāstīti nānvayaścintyate | kevalaṃ sādkyasyātmano hetoś ca prāṇādimattvasya yathāktamaṃ yau vipakṣau nairātmyamaprāṇādimatvaṃ ca tayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvacintāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāmapramāṇādimatva eva nairātmyaṃ dṛṣṭantadabhāve vyāpakasyāprāṇādi(p. 550)mattvasyābhāve ca vyāpyaṃ nairātmyaṃ | prāṇādimati nāstīti nyāyāt | svayaṃ na bhavadapi nairātmyaṃ prāṇādīnāṃ hetutvenābhimatānāmātmani sapakṣabhūte na siddhimupasthāpayati | nairātmyasya bhāvarūpasya vyavacchedepyanātma1lakṣaṇasya bhāvasyānākṣepāt | tataḥ satyapi vyatirekrenvayānuṣaṅgābhāvād vyatirekyeva hetuḥ prāṇādiriti nayāyikasyeṣṭashiddhireveyatā granthena darśitā |
 1: B. °pyātmalakṣaṇasya |
 
 etasminnabhyupagame doṣamāha – tathetyādi | aprāṇādimatvanivṛttyā prāṇādibhyo nivarttyamānam api nairātmyaṃ | yathā prāṇādīnāmātmani sapakṣabhūte na siddhimupasthāpayati | tathā sādhyepi jīvaccharīre prāṇādihetubhirnnairātmyaṃ vyudasyamānaṃ kevalaṃ syāt | na tvātmana upasthāpakaṃ |
 etad eva grahaṇakavākyaṃ spaṣṭayannāha – nairātmye 'bhāvādityādi | nairātnyeprāṇādīnāmabhāvāt prāṇādayastannirasanā nairātmyamātravyavacchedakā nātmopasthāpakāḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatra sātmake prāṇāder bhāvāshiddheḥ | na ca jīvaccharīre nairātmyasyātmaviruddhasya nivṛttyātmasiddhiah | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vipakṣānnairātnyāt prāṇādervyatirekadarśanepi kriyamāṇe sapakṣepyātmani prāṇādīnāṃ siddhiprasaṅgāt |
 yata evaṃ (|) tasmānnaviparyayavyāptiḥ | sātmakatvaprāṇādimatvavipakṣayornairātmyāt prāṇādimattvayor na vyāptisiddhir ity arthaḥ | kadā (|) nairātmyāt prāṇādervyatirekāsiddhau | evaṃ hi hetuvipakṣeṇāprāṇādimattvena sādhyavipakṣasya nairātmyasya vyāptisiddhiḥ syāt yadi prāṇādibhyo nairātmyaṃ | nivartteta | sā ca nivṛttiranvaye sati syāt | tadāha (|) tatsiddhireva cetyādi | tasya vyatirekasya siddhirevānvayasiddhiah | tannāntarīyakatvāttasya | vyatirekasiddhirevānvayasiddharuktā |
 athānvayasiddhirneṣyate | tadā 'siddhau cānvayasya | tadvyatirekavrttisiddhāvapi tasyātmano vyatireko nairātmyantasya prāṇādeḥ sakāśānnivṛttisiddhāvapi | tadasiddhistasyātmanassapakṣabhūtasyāsiddhir iti kṛtvā sādhyepi jīccharīre nairā(p. 551)tmyanivṛttāvapyātmano 'siddhiprasaṅgaḥ | taditi tasmādanvayā 'nvayarahitā na vyatirekavyāptiḥ sādhyasādhanavipakṣayor na vyāptir ity arthaḥ |
 abhyupagamyāpīti tu brūmaḥ | bhavatu nāmānanvayā viparyayavyāptiḥ | jīvaccharītācca nairātmyanivṛttau sātmakatvam jīvaccharīrasya prakārāntarābhāvāt | satyārthatāsādhane tvakṛtake hetāv ayam prakāro na sambhavatīty āha – mithyārthatāyā ityādi | mithyārthatāyāstu sādhyavipakṣabhūtāyāḥ pauruṣayatvena vyāptyā hetubhūtayā śabdād apauruṣayānnivṛttāv api na satyārthatvamakṛtakasya sidhyet | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) satyārthatvavyatirekeṇānarthakyasya prakārāntarasya sambhavāt | satyārthatvamithyārthatve na dvairāśye tu śabdānāmetat syāt | mithyārthatvanivṛttau satyārthatvaṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) ekanivrttau mithyārthatānivṛttau satyārthatāvyatirekeṇa gatyantarābhāvāt | dvaurāśyameva tu nāsi gatyantarasambhavād (|) ataste śabdā anarthā api syuriti neṣṭasiddhir na satyārthatāsiddhiah |
 śabdebhyorthapratīteḥ kāraṇānnānarthakāiti cet | nāyaṃ svābhāvikorthapratyayaḥ kintveṣa puruṣavyāpāraḥ syāt | saṃketaḥ puruṣavyāpārastatphalatvāt puruṣavyāpāra ityabhedenoktaḥ puruṣavyāpārāt syād ity arthaḥ | kimvat | prasiddhād arthād arthāntaravikalpavat |
 etad eva vyācaṣṭe | yathetyādi | jaiminīyairiṣṭenārthena bharatorvaśyādivaritādikasyātadarthatvepi tadbharatacaritamurvaśīcatitaṃ | ādiśabdādanyasyāpi pururavaścaritādergrahanaṃ | dvitīyenādigrahaṇe na bharatādīnāṃ caritādanyadapyavasthāviśeṣādikarmathamanye mīmāṃsakālokaprasiddhādarthādanyathā vyācakṣate | bharato yūpaḥ | urvarśī pātrī | araṇirvetyādinā |
 vyākhyātṛvikalpitād arthapratītir na bhavatyeveti ced (|)
 āha – tadanusāreṇetyādi | vyākhyātṛbhirvikalpitārthānusāreṇa | keṣāṃcicchotṝṇāṃ pratītir bhavatyeva (|) tatheti bharatādiśabdavyākhyāvat | svabhāvādanarthakeṣvapi vedavākyeṣvarthavikalpah puruṣakṛtaḥ syānna śabdasvabhāvakṛtaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vaidike(p. 552) bhyorthapratipattau puruṣasya jaimimiprabhṛter upadeśāpekṣaṇāt | kimiva (|) arthāntaravadeva | bharatorvaśyādiśabdānām arthāntaravikalpavadety arthaḥ | svabhāvatorthapratipādanepi npuruṣopadeśamapekṣiṣyanta ityapi mithyā | yato na hi prakṛtyā svabhāvenārthaprakāśanāstaṃ puruṣopadeśamapekṣante vahnyādayaḥ | puruṣastu svamātmīyaṃ samayavyāpārasaṃketasāmarthyenācakṣāṇaḥ parasmai upadiśati | yathāyaṃ śabdosminnarthe mayā prayukta iti nyāyyaṃ (|) na tu prakṛtyārthaprakāśane puruṣopadeśo nyāyyaḥ |
 atha puruṣasamitārthavannisargasiddhopi vedortheṣu puruṣopadeśamapekṣate | tadā yaś ca puruṣeṇa samitaḥ saṃketito yaś ca nisargeṇa svabhāvena siddhorthaḥ | tayor dvayor api puruṣopadeśāpekṣaṇaṃ pratyaviśeṣāt | anyaś ca kaścidviśeṣo nāsti yenāyaṃ puruṣasamitoyaṃ nisargasiddhaiti pratīyeta | ataḥ kāraṇādeko vaidikorthe naisargikaḥ | nisarge bhava ityādhyātmāditvāṭṭhak | anyo laukikaśabdorthe pauruṣeya iti duravasānaṃ | durbodhaṃ | vibhāgasādhakapramāṇābhāvāt |
 asti viśeṣo nisargasiddhasya vaidikasya ko(pi)pramāṇasambādaḥ | pramāṇāntarānugamanaṃ | yastu naivaṃ sa pauruṣeya iti cet | etad uttaratra niṣetsyāmo yathā nāstyantaparokṣerthe pramāṇāntaravṛttir ityādinā granthena | puruṣopadeśāpekṣanādinā ca samānadharmaṇorlaukikavaidikayoḥ pramāṇasamvādamātraviśeṣādekatra vaidike 'pauruṣeyatvena kalpyamāne | bahutaram idānīṃ laukikamekavākyaṃ pramāṇasambādyapauruṣeyaṃ kalpyaṃ syāt | yasmāt santi puruṣakṛtānyapi vākyāni kānicid "anityā vata saṃskārā"1 ityevamādīni | evam vidhānīti praṃāṇasambādīnīti kṛtvā teṣvapauruṣeyatvaprasaṅgah |
 1: dhammapade
 
 atha pramāṇasambādinopi laukikasya pauruṣeyatvantadā tadvadeṣāmapi vaidikānāṃ (p. 553) śabdānām abhipretārthavattā pauruṣeyī ca syāt pramāṇānurodhinī ca pramānāsamvādinī ceti na viśeṣaṃ paśyāmo vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ laukikebhyaḥ |
 vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ mantratvādevāpauruṣeyatvam iti darśayannāha – api cetyādi | vyāhataṃ parasparaviruddhaṃ | tathā hi (|) mantrāṇāṃ kasyacitpuruṣasya samayatve pratijñāvyavasthāpitatve sati kārtyasādhanaṃ yuktamabhimatakāryasiddhir mantraprayogād yukteti |
 yadyeta ityādinā vyākhyānaṃ | ete mantrā yadi kasyacit prabhāvavataḥ karttuḥ samayaḥ syād iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | samayavyavasthāpitatvātsamaya ityucyante | kathaṃ punar asu samayaḥ kṛta ityāha – parārthetyādi | parārthaparatā parārthapradhānatā | kṛpāluteti yāvat | tasyā anurodhena | anyato vā kutaścid yaśaḥprabhṛterhetoḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | kīdṛśosau samaya ityāha – yathetyādi | yathā matpraṇītametad vākyaṃ (|) kiṃ bhūtam (|) abhimatārthopanibandhanaṃ | mantrasya kartturabhimato yortho vidhiviśeṣaḥ | āvāhanavisarjanādilakṣaṇaḥ sa nibandhanaṃ pravṛttyaṅgaṃ yasmin vākye tattathoktaṃ | evam ity anenānuktameṇa niyuṃjānaṃ prayuṃjānaṃ puruṣamanenārthena puruṣābhimatena phalena yojayāmīti samayaḥ syāt | tadā mantraprayogāt kadācit vidhisamāptau | abhimatārthaniṣpattiḥ syāt | kavisamayādiva | yathā kenacit kāvyaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ (|) matpraṇītaṃ kāvyaṃ yah paṭhati | tasmai mayedam dātavyamityatastatkṛtakāvyapāṭhakānāṃ yathā pratijñātārthaniṣpattistadvat |
 atha bhāvaśaktiḥ śabdasvabhāvasyaiva sā tādṛśī śaktiryenābhimatamphalambhavati | na yathābhimatāt puruṣasamayāt | tadā syādanyatrāpi | yathā kathaṃ citprayuktānmantrādapi | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) varṇṇātmakasya mantrasyāviśeṣatah |
 netyādi vyākhyānaṃ | na vai puruṣasamayāddhetormantrebhyortha(siddhiḥ) kintarhi (|) bhāvasya varṇṇarūpasya mantrasya svabhāva eṣa (|) yadi na mantrāḥ kasyacid (p. 554) vidhipūrvanniyuktāḥ phaladāḥ |
 tattarhītyādi (|) siddhāntavādī | tattarhi mantrākhyānaṃ varṇṇānāṃ rūpaṃ sarvatreti vidhirahite kāle | viparītādiprayoge vā'viśiṣṭam iti | yathākarthaṃ citpāṭhānukramaṃ vidhiṃ collaṃdhya prayuktādapi mantrādabhimataṃ phalaṃ syāt | yasmād varṇṇāeva hi mantro nānyat kiñcid varṇṇavyatiriktaṃ |
 tatkramo varṇṇakramo na varṇṇā eveti cet (|)
 tadasat (|) yasmād varṇṇebhyaḥ ktamasyārthāntaratvaṃ ca varṇṇānupūrvī vākyaṃ cedityatrāntare pūrvameva nirākṛtaṃ |
 netyādi vyākhyānaṃ | varṇṇebhyaḥ kramasyāvyatireke ca varṇnā eva mantrāste ca varṇṇā aviśiṣṭāḥ sarvatra pratilomapāṭhādāviti sarvathā yathākathañcit prayuktā phaladāḥ syuḥ | na ca phaladā bhavanti | na kevalaṃ vidhibhraṃśe na phaladāḥ prayutānarthakāriṇaeva bhavantītyāha – upaplava ityādi | upadravaḥ | upaplavaḥ | tu śabdotiśaye | alpīyasopi vidhikramasya bhramśād dṛṣṭaḥ | sa ca puruṣasamayatve mantrāṇāṃ yujyate | nāpauruṣeyatve |
 kasyacit samayatvepi kathamupaplava iti cedāha – kasyacidityādi | mantrasya karttrā ye vidhayo nirdiṣṭāsteṣāṃ madhye kasyacidvidheranuṣṭhānād devatāyāḥ sannidhirbhavati | tatssannidheranyasya vidhiviśeṣasyāsākalyenāsampādanena | devatāyāvirādhanāt khedanāccopaplavaḥ syāt | tatrāvītarāgā devatā virāgitā svayamevānarthaṃ katoti | vītarā(gāḥ) tu na svayaṃ | tadabhiprasannāstvanye devatādayaḥ kurvantīti draṣṭavyaṃ |
 yatra mantre na kaścid api vidhiḥ kriyate tatra katham iti (|)
 āha – sarvetyādi | sarvavidhibhraṃśe tu kasyacideva samayasya mantrapraṇetṛkṛtasya (p. 555) vidheranuṣṭhānād devatāyā asannidher nārthanarthau |
 kiṃcetyādinā doṣāntaramāha – nivāritaṃ kramasyārthāntsaratvam | bhavatu vā varṇṇebhyaḥ kramasyārthāntaratvam anarthāntaratvam vā | tatrānarthāntaratve kramasya varṇṇātmā varṇṇasvabhāva eva mantraḥ | arthāntaratve tu tatkramātmā | varṇṇakramātmā | tasya varṇātmanastatkramātmano vā mantrasya kīdṛśasyārthahetoḥ puruṣārthakāraṇasya hetubhirakṛtatvānnityasya nityaṃ sannidhānam iti kṛtvā nivyantadarthasiddhiḥ syāt | tebhyo mantrebhyaḥ puruṣārthasya niṣpattiḥ syāt | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yato yasyā hi bhāvaśakter mantraśakteḥ sakāśāt mantrasādhyasya phalasyotpattiḥ sā bhāvaśktiraviphaleti na phalavaikalyaṃ syāt | yasmānna hi kāraṇasya sākalye sati kāryasya vaikalyamasattvaṃ yuktaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyāvikalasya kāraṇasya kāryamakurvato kāranatvaprasaṅgāt | nityatvepi mantrāṇāṃ na kevalānmantraprayogād iti mantrasambandhādiṣṭasiddhiḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tasya mantrasya vidhānāpikṣarvād iti cet | tadayuktam yasmānmantrasya vidhānāpekṣatve 'bhyupagamyamāne tasyāpekṣaṇīyasya vidhānādermantraṃ pratyasāmarthyamanādheyātiśayatvānmantrasya |
 tadvyācaṣṭe | yadi hītyādi | vidhānādibhi[rmantra kalpo1] vidhistasmādanyato veti kutaścitsahakāriṇaḥ sthānaviśeṣādessakāśāt kañcit svabhāvātiśayamāsādayeyurlabheran | tadā sahakātī tatrotpādye mantrasya svabhāvātiśaye samarthopekṣyaḥ syāt | na ca nityeṣvetadatiśayotpādanam astīty uktaṃ prāk | tat kim ayaṃ sahakāryatiśayotpādanaṃ pratyasamartho mantrairapekṣyata iti kṛtvānapekṣā mantrāḥ sadā kāryaṃ kuryuḥ | yadi1 kārakasvabhāvā(ḥ) no cennavā kadācit kāryaṃ kuryuranati(p. 556)śayāt svabhāsya sarvadā tulyatvāt |

 kiṃ ca (|) sarvasya puṃsaḥ pātakādiyuktasyāpi sādhanaṃ phalahetavaste na mantrāḥ syuḥ | samayanirapekṣā yadīdṛśī mantrāṇāmbhāvaśaktiḥ | atha syād yajamānenaiva prayuktāḥ phaladā iti (|)
 ata āha – prayokturbhedo viśeṣo yajamānatvantadapekṣā ca | nāsaṃskāryasya mantrasya yujyate | yadi bhāvaśaktyaiva samayānapekṣayā mantrāḥ phaladā na te mantrāḥ phaladānam prati kañcit puruṣaṃ parihareyuḥ | anyaṃ vā śūdrādikaṃ | yasmānna hyanyamayajamānaṃ prati svabhāvo mantrāṇāṃ kāryakaranasvabhāvo 'tadbhāvo bhavatyajanakasvabhāvo bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya janakasvabhāvasya tenābrāhmaṇena cānapakarṣaṇāt | akhaṇḍanāt | anyena ca yajamānādinānutkarṣaṇāt | ataś ca kāraṇāt kenacit puruṣeṇa saha mantrāṇāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvayogaḥ | tadayogāc ca yathākramaṃ brāhmaṇenānyena ca mantrāṇāṃ pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt sarvasya sādhanaṃ syuriti | ata eva na niryātvād evāsya mantrasyāsaṃskāryatvāt prayoktā | kārye niyoktā kaścid btāhmaṇonyo vā nāsti yataḥ prayoktā mantrasādhyam phalam aśnuvīta labheta brāhmaṇa eva nānyaḥ | tathā hi yathā śūdrādirapāṭhako na kiṃcit karotīti na prayoktā tathā brāhmaṇopi (|) tataḥ saṃskārāpratipatter iti |
 kiñca saṃskāryasyāpyādheyātiśayasyāpi bhāvasya vastubhedo hi kāraṇabhedo hi bhedako na a brāhmaṇaśudrādīnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ paramārthatosti | kevalaṃ lokavyavahārakṛto vipraśūdrādibhedaḥ | tena lokavyavahārabhinnānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ prayoktaṇāmbhedānniyamo mantraśktau na sambhavati | yena brāhmaṇa eva phalamāsādayenna śūdraḥ |
 (p. 557) kva tarhyayanniyamaḥ syād iti (|)
 āha – samaye bhavet | yadā samayo mantrastadā samayasya karttā vastusvabhāvānapekṣaḥ samayaṃ karoti | yathāloke ye brāhmaṇāḥ prasiddhāstebhyaeva prayoktṛbhyaḥ phalandāsyāminānyebhya iti syānniyamaḥ |
 ādheyetyādinā vyākhyānaṃ | ādheyo janyo viśeṣo yeṣānte bhāvāḥ | taddhetor viśeṣahetoḥ svabhāvabhede sati | tato viśeṣahetoḥ sakāśādāsāditātiśayatvādekatrānyathābhūtaḥ punaranyatra kāraṇāntare 'nyathā syurna tvabhede kāraṇasyānyathābhāvaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāviśeṣe sati kāryasyāviśeṣāt |
 atha kāraṇāviśeṣe kāryasya viśeṣastadā viśeṣe kāryasyāpyabhyupagamyamāne | tasya viśeṣasyāhetukatvaprasaṅgād ityuktaprāyaṃ |
 taditi tasmād ime maṃtrāḥ kāryā apyanityā api | hetukṛtāt svabhāvabhedāt phaladāyino 'pi na śūdrādiprayogepyanyathā syuraphaladāḥ syuḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|)  śūdra iti vipra iti brāhmaṇa ityabhidhānaṃ saṃjñā yayoḥ puruṣayostayorbuddhīndriyadeheṣu svabhāvabhedābhāvāt | prativyakti svalakṣaṇabhedostīti cet (|) na | tasya brāhmaṇeṣvapi prativyakti sambhavāt | jātikṛtas tu bhedo nāstīty ucyate | nanvayaṃ brāhmaṇo 'yaṃ śūdra iti loke nāmabhdedosti | tathā sammānādivyavahārabhedaś ca (|) tataḥ svabhāvabhedovasīyata iti | ced (|)
 āha – na hītyādi | puruṣecchānurodhino brāhmaṇādināmabhedāt satkārādivyavahārabhedāc ca svabhāvabhedānubandhināṃ yathā kāraṇamutpannena svabhāvabhedenānugatānāmarthānāmanyathātvaṃ | na hi svabhāvabhedostīti sambandhaḥ | tayor brāhmaṇaśadrayoḥ puruṣayor jātibhedostīti cet |
 (p. 558) tannaivam | yasmāt sa khalvityādi | sāmānyaniṣedhānniṣiddhaiva jātiḥ (|) kevalamabhyupagamyocyate | sa khalu bhavannapi jātibhedastridhā iṣṭaḥ | ākṛtiguṇśaktibhede sati | gavāśvavat | gavāśvasyeva gavāśvavat | tatrākṛtibhedaḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ sa prativyakti bhedavatṇṣvapi goṣvanugāmṇvidyate (|) nāśvavyaktiṣu | guṇabhedo (?daḥ) kṣīrādīnāṃ rasavīryavipākādibhedena sa ca samānajātīyāsu vyaktiṣvanugāmī dṛṣṭaḥ | na vijātīyāsu | śaktibhedānurūpakāryasāmarthyalakṣaṇaḥ | yathā gavāvdohādisāmarthyaṃ nāśvānāṃ | tadevaṃ samānajātīyavyaktyanugāmināmākṛtyādibhedānāmupalambhāt kāmaṃ gavaśvādiṣvastu jātibhedaḥ kalpyeta | sakṛcca gavādiṣu vyutpanno deśakālādibhedepyanupadeśam ity upadeśamantareṇainaṃ jātibhedaṃ likaḥ pratipadyate | ayaṅgaurayamaśva iti naivam brāhmaṇādibhedamanupadeśaṃ pratipadyate | tadvaditi gavāśvavat | anayor brāhmaṇaśūdrayoḥ kaṃ cid api guṇaṃ viniyataṃ samānajātīyāsveva vyaktiṣu sthitampaśyāmaḥ | guṇagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam | evamākṛtibhedaṃ śaktibhedaṃ ca viniyataṃ na paśyāmaḥ | apaśyantaścākṛtyādibhedaṃ kathaṃ śūdraviprayor jātibhedaṃ pratipadyemahi | naiveti yāvat | tathā hyadhyayanaśaucācārādiviśeṣaḥ sarvo vyabhicārī | yaś ca gaurapiṅgalakeśatvādilakṣaṇa ākārabhedaḥ kalpyate sa brāhmaṇeṣv api keṣucinnāsti | śūdreṣu ca vidyate keṣucit |
 yadi na jātibhedaḥ vipraśūdrayoḥ kathantarhyayaṃ brāhmaṇādiśvdaśravaṇād bhinnā pratītirbhavatīti (|)

 api cetyādinā dūṣaṇāntaramāha – anabhivyaktaḥ (na) śrotraviṣayannītaḥ śabdo yaiḥ karaṇaistālvādibhistānyanabhivyaktaśabdāni | teṣāṃ karaṇānāṃ prayojanaṃ vyāpāraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syād iti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | yatroṣṭhādiprasapandamātreṇa upāṃśujapaḥ kriyate | sa vyarthaḥ syād iti vākyārthaḥ | yatroṣṭhādipraspandopi nāsti kevalaṃ manasā mantracintanaṃ sa manojapaḥ | vā śabdaḥ samuccaye | manojapaś ca vyarthaḥ syāt | yasmācchabdo hi śrotragocaraḥ śrotragrāhya eva śabdah (|) śabdasvabhāvaś ca mantraḥ | upāṃśumānasayoś ca japayoḥ śrotragrahaṇābhāvādaśabdatvam (|) aśabdatvāccāmantratvaṃ ca japan kathaṃ phalavān syāt | gṛhyata iti grahaṇaṃ | śrotragrāhya ity arthaḥ | tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya śabdasya sa tathoktaḥ | tadatikrametiprasaṅgāt | śrotragrāhyaṃ śabdaṃ muktvā manojapāderjñānātmakasya śabdatva iṣyamāṇe rasādīnāmapi śabdatvm syāt |

 atha tulye kāryakāraṇabhāvalakṣaṇe laukiko varṇṇakramaḥ kṛtrima iṣṭo the[……………………] prasajanti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatrāpi ghaṭādiṣv evaṃ kalpanāyā vaidikaśabdakramavat kalpanāyāḥ sambhavāt | yathā puruṣavyāpāreṇa sa eva vaidikaḥ kramo vyajyata iti kalpanā | tathā ghaṭādayopīti | (p. 575) viśeṣābhāvāc ca | na hi puruṣavyāpārānuvidhāyitvena ghaṭādeḥ sakāśā[……………………] stasya viśeṣa iti ced āha – tānityādi | tān api ghaṭādīn paraiḥ pūrvakaiḥ kulālādibhir ghaṭādīnāṃ racanā | tasyādarśanaṃ pūrvam eva | tān dṛṣṭavaiveti yāvat | anayaḥ pāścātyopi kulālādiḥ karoti | nānupadeśaṃ | paropadeśapūrvikā ca yeṣāṃ pratipattis teṣām apauruṣeyatve [……………………vai] dikaḥ kramaḥ kartturasmaraṇādapauruṣeya iṣṭaḥ | evaṃ tarhi ghaṭādayopy aviditakarttāraś ca kevit | vahutarakālāc channadeśe ghaṭādayo dṛśyante (|) na ca teṣāṃ karttā smaryate | tasmāt tulye puruṣavyāpārānuvidhāne yady apauruṣeyo vaidikakramas tadā sarveṣāṃ ghaṭādīnām akri[……………………]yathā vā kartturasmaraṇād vaidikakramasyākriyā | evaṃ keṣāṃcit kadācit ghaṭādīnāṃ amaryamāṇakarttṛkāṇām akriyābhiniveśos tu | na caivaṃ (|) tasmān na caiveyaṃ laukikī vaidikī ca varṇṇānupūrvī puruṣakṛteti sambandhaḥ | kasmād iti (|) āha – prasiddhetyādi | prasiddhiḥ kāryakāraṇbhāvo [……………………vi]śeṣaṇsamāsaḥ | teṣāṃ dharmaḥ svakāraṇānvayavyatirekānuvidhānantasyānatikramāt |
 yat eva pauruṣeyā mantrās tata eva prākṛtebhyaḥ puruṣebhyo sādhāraṇatā viśiṣṭatā siddhā | keṣāṃ (|) mantrākhyakramakāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ | maṃtrasaṃjñitam varṇṇakramaṃ kuruvanti ye | teṣāṃ kenā [……………………]masya parijñānaṃ samīhitārthasampādanaśaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyebhyosādhāraṇatety āha – anyeṣāṃ prākṛtādīnāṃ puruṣāṇāntayoḥ | jñānaprabhāvayor abhāvataḥ |
 ayam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | varṇṇānām ayaṃ karamo viṣanirdhātādisamartho nānya inyevaṃvibhāgena yadyanyopi prākṛtapuruṣo jānīyāt tadā tamvarṇṇakramantathaiva vibhāgenaiva (p. 576) pratipādyetānutiṣṭhat (|) na caivaṃ pratipadyate (|) tasmād ayaṃ mantrākhyo varṇṇānukramaḥ svabhāvato yadi nāma kāryakṛdabhyupagato mī māṃ sa kai stathāpi kaścid eva puruṣair atīndriyaśaktibhedayukto vijñāta iti kṛtvāsti parokṣārthadarśī puruṣo yo mantrantatsāmarthyantadanuṣṭhānañ ca vetti |
 yady api satyatapaḥprabhāvavatāṃ samīhitārthasādhanaṃ vacanaṃ mantra ity uktaṃ (|) tathāpy abhyupagamyocyate (|) svabhāvatopi kāryakṛnmantra iti | kāryakṛtmantrakaraṇena vā mantraphalaśakatijñānena vā puruṣātiśaya ity uktam bhavati | anumānāt mantrāmantraparijñānāt parokṣadarśino 'bhāva ity atrāha – na hītyādi | ayam arthaḥ (|) varṇṇānukramalakṣaṇo viṣādyapanayane samartho 'yan tu varṇṇānukramo na samartha iti | evaṃ na hi śakyaṃ liṅgāt pratyetuṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) mantrāmantravibhāgenāsaṃkīrṇṇasya liṅgaviśeṣasyāsiddheḥ |
 nanu ca varṇṇarūpayor mantrāmantrayoḥ pratyakṣeṇa grahṇe phaladānaśaktir api tadavyatirekāt pratyakṣagṛhītaiveti (|)
 ata āha – pratyakṣayor ityādi  anupadiṣṭayor ity ayaṃ mantro nāyam mantra ity evam akathitayor aparijñānāt | ayam viṣādyapanayane śakto 'yam aśakta ity evam niścayāt | upadeśepīti (|) yadi nāma kenacid upadiṣṭam bhavatyayaṃ mantra evaṃ kāryakārīti | tathāpi kathaṃcit kenacid apy ākāreṇa mantrasya yaḥ svabhāvavivekas tasyāpratīter aniścayāt | upadeśasyāprāmāṇyāt | anyatra kāryasamvādāt | mantrasādhyakāryaprāptyā tvayammantra iti niścayaḥ syāt | tasya ca mantrasya sādhyasya kāryasya kāraṇāt prāg iti mantrānuṣṭhāt prāg draṣṭum aśakyatvāt | tadānīn tasya satvād iti bhāvaḥ | na cāniścitasya mantrasyānuṣṭhānaṃ sambhavati | tasmād avaśyaṃ mī māṃ sa kenātīndriyārthadarśī puruṣobhyupagantavyo yo mantrāmantrasvabhāvaṃ vivecayati (|) anyathā mantrānuṣṭhānaṃ na syāt |
 na cāyamantrākhyo varṇṇakramaḥ svabhāvato viṣādyapanayanādeḥ kārakaḥ kintu (p. 577) puruṣasamayāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kasyacinmantrānuṣṭhāyinaḥ puruṣasyāśumantrasiddheḥ anyasya tattulyamantrakriyānuṣṭhāyinaḥ cirāt siddheḥ | svato hi phaladāne 'yaṃ kālabhedo na yujyate mantrasya kenacidutkarṣānutkarṣākaraṇāt | anyasya puruṣasya mantrāt phalaniṣpattau vratacaryādyapekṣaṇān na  svabhāvato mantraḥ kārakaḥ | vrataṃ mantrakalpavihito niyamas tasya caraṇam anuṣṭhānaṃ | apiśabdād dhomādiparigrahaḥ | svabhāvato hi phaladāne | kiṃ vratacaryādyanuṣṭhānenāpekṣitena | tatotiśayānutpatteḥ | tathaikasmād api mantraviṣayāj japahomādikarmmaṇaḥ sakaśāt kayościt puruṣayos tulyaṃ vidhimanutiṣṭhator apy ekasyārthadarśanād anyasyānarthadarśanān na svabhāvataḥ phalaṃ | svabhāvatas tu phaladāne tulyorthayogaḥ syāt | vahatām apīti (|) | viṣādyapanayanaṃ kurvatām api mantrāṇāṃ punaḥ kālāntare tenaiva puruṣeṇa prayuktānāṃ kasyacit kāryasya visamvādādakaraṇāt | na hy ayaṃ prakāro vastusvabhave yuktaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvasya sarvatra puruṣādau tulyatvāt | yo hi yasya svabhāvo na sa kañcid apekṣya svabhāvo bhavati | yadā tu puruṣakṛtāt samayāt phalam iṣyate tadāyamadoṣaḥ | tathā hi (|) puruṣas tu mantrasamayasya karttā | svecchāvṛttir iti kṛtvā kaṃcit puruṣam anugṛhṇāti nāparam iti yuktaṃ | kena kāraṇena | sattvasabhāgatāviśeṣāt | mantrakriyānuṣṭhātuḥ sattvasya mantrapraṇetrā saha sabhāgatā tulyaśīlācārādinā | ādiśabdād upapradānādiparigrahaḥ | tadvaśāttadanurāgāt | sevāviśeṣād vā | japahomādinād eva tārādhanaṃ sevāviśeṣas tasmād vā | kañcid anugṛhṇāti puruṣaṃ | nāparaṃ sattvasabhāgatādirahitaṃ |
 vratetyādinā paramāśaṃkate | niyamasyānuṣṭhānaṃ vratacaryā | vratacaryā ca vratacaryābhraṃśaś ceti virūpaikaśeṣaḥ | ādiśabdaḥ praty ekam abhisambadhyate | vratacaryādinā vratacaryābhraṃśādinā cety arthaḥ | vratacaryādinā dharmopacaye sati siddhir iti sambandhaḥ | tathā prakṛtyā svabhāvena dhamrātmano vā puṃsaḥ siddhiḥ | vratacaryābhraṅśādinā tvadharmopacaye sati | adharmātmano cā prākṛtyā puruṣasyāsiddhir iti vākyārtho yojyaḥ | svabhāvatopi mantrāt phalaniṣpattau yathoktena prakāreṇa siddhyasiddhibhedo bhaviṣyatīti paro manyate |
 (p. 578) netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na dharmāpekṣāt mantrāt phalasiddhiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) dharmaviruddhānam api mantrasiddhihetūnāṃ vratānāṃ ḍā ki nī bha gi nī tantrādiṣu darśanāt | ḍā ki nī tantre | caturbhaginītantre | ādiśabdāt | cairyahetuṣu kambuki nī tantrādiṣu darśanāt | kāni punas tāni dharmaviruddhānīty āha – krauryetyādi | krauryaṃ prāṇibadhaḥ | steyaṃ cauryaṃ | dviṃ(?dvīṃ)driyasamāpattir maithunaṃ | hīnakarma mārjārāśucidhūmapradānādi | ādiśabdād anyasyāpi dharmaviruddhasya grahaṇaṃ | tāni krauryādīni bahulāni bhūyāṃsi yeṣāṃ bratānāntāni tathoktāni | taiś ca tathoktair vratair mantrasiddhiviśeṣāt | tathā hi (|) ḍā ki nī tantre samayavyavasthā | yadā prāṇinaṃ hatvā khādati tadā mantrasiddhimāsādayati | tathā kambu ki nī tantre steyācaraṇāt siddhir uktā | tathā maithunācaraṇāt siddhipradā kācid eveti bhaginītantrāntare kvacit samayaḥ |
 kauryādy eva dharmā bhaviṣyatīti ced (|)
 āha – na cetyādi | evamvidho krauryādilakṣaṇo dharmasvabhāva iti yathāvasaraṃ paścānnivvedayiṣyāmaḥ | evantāvad adharmād api siddhir dṛṣṭā |
 darmād api siddhir na dṛṣṭety āha – maitrītyādi | satvānāṃ hitasukhacintanammai trī | śau caṃ dvividhaṃ | bāhyamāntarañ ca | bāhyaṃ snānādi | āntaraṃ steyādinivṛttiḥ | dānādinā parānugraho dharmaḥ | maitrīśaucadharmāḥ pare pradānāni yeṣānte tathoktāḥ | tathābhūtānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ | tannimittam eva maitryādikam eva nimittaṃ kṛtvā kasyāśit siddher iti maitrīviparyayeṇa yā labhyā tasyā asihheḥ | viparyayeṇa ca dveṣādinā punaḥ siddheḥ | na dharmopacayāpekṣāt mantrāt phalasiddhir iti | dveṣādisamutthitopi krauryādir mantravidhānenānuṣṭhitas san dharma eveti (|)
 ata āha – na cetyādi | ekarūpāddhi sādilakṣaṇāt karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt sa tadvirodhyadharmavirodhī dharmo yuktaḥ | adharmaś ceti mantravidhānād anyatra tata eva hiṃsādeḥ sakāśād adharmaś ca na yuktaḥ | na hy adharmahetor dharmo bhvati virodhāt | tathā hi (|) yenaiva dveṣādyāśayena mantravidhānād anyatra hiṃsādikurvato 'dharmo bhavati | tenaivāśayena mantravidhānānuṣṭhānepi hiṃsādikaṃ triyata iti kathan tasya dharmāṅgatvam iti |
 (p. 579) yadi dveṣādikṛtatvān mantravidhānenānuṣṭhitopi krauryādir adharma eva katham idānīm adharmātmano vratāder iti pūrvoktāt | krauryādilakṣaṇād vratāt | ādiśabdād anyasmān nihīnād aśucidhūpadānādilakṣaṇāt | dharmasya phalam iṣṭasambhogādilakṣaṇaṃ katham aśnute bhajate jāpī |
 netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī | na caitas yādharmātmano vratādes tadiṣṭaṃ phalamvipākaḥ karmaphalaṃ | kin tu pūrvakṛtasya śubhasya karmaṇo vipākaḥ (|) kimvad iti (|) āha  brahmahatyāyā ādeśastasyānuṣṭhānāt sampādanāt | grāmapratilambhavat | yathā kaścit kañcit puruṣaṃ niyuṃkte | mārayemaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ahante grāmandāsyāmīti | sa tasyādeśasyānuṣṭhānād grāmaṃ pratilabhate | na ca tad brahmahatyāyā phalaṃ | kintu tadbra(hma)hatyācaraṇenārādhitaṃ puruṣaṃ sahakāriṇaṃ prāpya pūrvakaṃ śubham eva karma tathā phalati |
 adharmātmanas tarhi tasya vratasya kiṃphalam ityāha – tasya tu krauryādilakṣaṇasyādharmātmano vratasyāgāmi bhaviṣṭajjanbhabhāvi phalam iṣṭaṃ narakādi |
 yadi śubhasya karmaṇa iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ kaintenādharmātmanā mantrādiprayogeṇāpekṣiteneti ced (|)
 āha – sa tvadharmātmā | ḍā ki nī mantrādiprayogaḥ | ādiśabdāt krauryādivrataprayogaḥ | tasyeṣṭaphalasya śubhasya karmaṇaḥ | iṣṭam phalaṃ yasya karmaṇa iti vigrahaḥ | kathañcit kenacit prakāreṇopakārāt pācakaḥ phalasya dāyakaḥ |  kathaṃ punaḥ kuśalasyākuśalam upakārakam bhavatīti (|)
 āha – citratvād upakāraśakteḥ | sahakāribhāvo hi citraḥ | kadācit kuśalasyākuśalaṃ sahakāri | akuśalasyāpi kuśalaṃ | yathātyartham udārakuśalakāriṇo na narakādiduḥkhaphalam aśubhaṃ karma kuśalaṃ sahakāri prāpyehaiva janmani | vyādhyādiduḥkhamātraṃ datvā kṣīyate | adharmātmako mantrādiprayogaḥ | kathaṃ cid iṣṭaphalasya karmaṇa upakāraka ity uktaṃ |
 yatra yena prakāreṇopakāras tandarśayan nāha – puruṣaviśeṣo mantrasya praṇetā sa (p. 580) evāśrayas tena vipākaḥ phaladānaṃ sa eva dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya sa puruṣāśrayavipākadharmā | dharma iti puṇyaviśeṣaḥ | teneti puruṣeṇa kṛtaḥ pūrvajanmani | sa tathā tadārādhaneneti | sa dharmas tathā krauryādyācaraṇāt | tadārādhanena mantrapraṇetṛpuruṣārādhanena phalatīti |
 etad eva spaṣṭayannāha – tadityādi | tena mantrapraṇetrā puruṣeṇa vihitā krauryayuktavratādiprayogastenopakāraḥ | karmaṇaḥ paripoṣaḥ | tena vipākaḥ phaladānaṃ dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya tasyaivaṃ dharmaṇaḥ | tatphalasyeti | iṣṭaphalasya karmaṇaḥ kṛtatvāt kāraṇāt | tadārādhanena phalatīti |
 vināpi mantrapraṇetrā puruveṇa tadupakārāt | tasyaiva yantrasya kevalasya japādinā vyāpāreṇopakārānmantrātphalam iti vet | tataś ca puruṣārādhanena phalatīti yaduktan tadayuktam iti paro manyate |
 netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī | naitad evaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣetyādi | mantrapraṇetuḥ puruṣasyākāro varṇṇasaṃsthānādiḥ | svabhāvaḥ śāntaraudrādiḥ | caryā kāyavāgvyāpāralakṣaṇā ceṣṭā | teṣām ākārādīnām adhimokṣo 'dhimuktis tasyā vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | mantrasyādhiṣṭhātā puruṣaś cen nāsti | kim arthasyākārādīn adhimucyet | atheṣyate tasyāpi puruṣasyopakārakatvan tadā tasyāpi mantrapraṇetuḥ puruṣasya mantrāt phalasiddhiṃ pratyupakārakatve 'ṅgīkriyamāṇe siddhaḥ puruṣaviśeṣosādhāraṇaguṇaḥ | asādhāraṇā guṇā asyeti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadadhimukter eva puruṣaviśeṣākārasvabhāvacaryādhimukter eva viṣakarmādikaraṇāt | tasmān na mantrāḥ puruṣapraṇītā api tadupayoganirapekṣāḥ puruṣaviśeṣopayoganirapekṣāḥ svabhāvena prakṛtyaiva phaladāḥ | kintu puruṣaviśeṣopayogasāpekṣā eva |
 yady asādhāraṇaguṇa eva puruṣo mantrasya praṇetā | kathaṃ prabhāvādiviśeṣarahitā api tantravido mantrān bhāṣanta iti (|)
 (p. 581) ata āha – yepītyādi | mantrapratibaddhāni śāstrāṇi tantrāṇi tāni vidantīti te tantravidaḥ kecidadyatvepi mantrānapūrvān kāṃścana kurvate | tan na teṣāṃ kevalānām asāmarthyaṃ | kin tu yat tantramāśritās te tasya tantrasya praṇetā yaḥ puruṣātiśayas tasya prabhoḥ svāminaḥ sa prabhāvaḥ sāmarthyaṃ | kasmāt (|) taduktanyāyavṛttitaḥ | tasmāt prabhuṇā yastebhyas samayādiko nyāya upadiṣṭastasyānuvarttanāt | prabhustuṣṭastatpraṇītān api mantrānadhitiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ |
 rathyāpuruṣetyādinā pūrvapakṣopanyāsapūrvakaṃ kārikārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | rathyāpuruṣā apīti sāmānyapuruṣā api kecena gāruḍikaprabhṛtayo mantralakṣaṇatantrajñāḥ kiñcid viṣādiśamanalakṣaṇaṃ karma kurvanti | na ca te viśiṣṭāḥ surāpānādyanyṣṭhānāt | tahānyopīti prabhāvavattvenābhimato mantrasya praṇetā 'natiśayaś ca syāt | rathyāpuruṣavadatuśatarahitaś ca syāt mantrāṇāṃ ca kartteti | tathā ca prabhāvavān puruṣo na sidhyatīti manyate |
 netyādinā pariharati | na prabhāvarahitānāṃ mantrakaraṇaṃ (|) ye tu rathyāpuruṣā api mantrān kurvanti teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ prabhāvavataiva tantrasya praṇetrādhiṣṭhānāt mantrakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ |
 etad eva darśayannāha – tatkṛtaṃ hītyādi | tena prabhāvātiśayavatā puruṣeṇa kṛtasamayamanupālayanto rakṣantaḥ | tadupadeśena ceti prabhāvayuktapuruṣopadeśena ca vartamānā mantrakriyāsamarthāḥ kuta etat |
 tad ityādi tasya prabhāvato yassamayaḥ | yaścopadeśas tatra nirapekṣāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ mantraracanāyām asāmarthyāt | tatra samayo yasyātikramāt punar maṇḍalapraveśādiḥ karttavyo  jāyate | tatonyadvidhānām upadeśa ityanayor bhedaḥ | tatrāpīti rathyāpuruṣakṛteṣv api mantreṣu tadākāradhyānād eva | prabhāvavataḥ | puṃsaś cākāradhyānāde(re)va (|) ādiśabdāt svabhāvacaryādhyānasya parigrahaḥ | tena mantrasya prayogāt pravarttanāt | yata evantasmāttadadhiṣṭhānam eva prabhāvavatpuruṣādhiṣṭhānam eva tattādṛśam unneyaṃ boddhavyaṃ | yatte svayaṃ kṛtair mantraiḥ karma kurvantīti |
 (p. 582) api ca (|) kecit tantrajñā mantraṃ kurvantītyabhidadhatā puruṣātiśaya eva samarthitaḥ syāt | yasmāt sopi tādṛśastantrajño mantrasya karttā prabhāvavān eva | tadanyair atantrajñaiḥ puruṣair asādhāraṇaśaktitvād iti kṛtvā | yataś ca puruṣādhiṣṭhitānām eva mantrāṇāṃ phalaṃ | tasmāt kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāś ca phaladā ityevammantrā vācyāḥ phalepsunā | mantrād phalamicchatā na nityā mantrāḥ kintu kṛtakāḥ kṛtakatvepi na phaladāne puruṣanirapekṣā ity arthadvayam ādarśayituṃ kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāś ceti dvayopādānaṃ |
 na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na hi nityānāmvaidikānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ prayoga uccāraṇaṃ sambhavatyanādheyātiśayatvāt | na cāprayuktebhyo mantrebhyaḥ phalam iti kṛtvā prayogāt phalamicchatā kṛtakā mantr vācyāḥ | pauruṣeyāś ca | puruṣādhiṣṭhitāś ca phaladā vācyāḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣādhiṣṭhānamantreṇa vinānyato  bhāvaśaktyāder asambhavatphalānām mantrāṇāṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhānād eva phaladarśanāt | yathā ca na bhāvaśaktyā mantrebhyaḥ phalotpattis tathā pratipāditaṃ (|)
  "sarvasya sādhanante syur bhāvaśaktir yadīdṛśī"tyādinā (1|267)
 nidarśanaṃ cāha – yo madīyaṃ kāvyāday evaṃ paṭhiṣyati tasya mayāyam arthaḥ sampādanīya ity evaṃ kṛtaḥ samayo yasmin kāvyādau ādiśabdāc chilpasthānādau | sa kṛtasamayaḥ kāvyādiḥ tasminn iva tadvat | yathā tatra kāvyādipāṭhakānāṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhānāt phalantadvanmantreṣv apīty arthaḥ | puṃsāmatīndriyārthadarśanaṃ prati śaktir nāstīty evam aśaktisādhanam asāmarthyasya sādhanaṃ yannāma kiñcit mī māṃ sa kai r ucyate tatsarvamanenaiva mantrakāriṇāṃ jñānaprabhāvātiśayasādhanena nirākṛtaṃ |
 pratipāditā hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | pratipāditā hi puruṣakṛtā mantrāstaedadhiṣṭhānāc ca phaladā mantrā ity etad api pratipāditaṃ |
 na ca sarve puruṣā mantrān karttum adhiṣṭhātuṃ vā śaktāḥ | tad iti tasmād asti kaścid atiśayavān puruṣo mantrasya kartteti | tasyātiśayavataḥ puṃsaḥ pratikṣepasādhanāny api (p. 583) prativyūḍhāni pratikṣiptāni | etena ca paroktasyātiśayapratikṣepashādhanasya na viyuddhāvyabhicāritvam udbhāvyate (|) kin tarhi puruṣātiśayapratikṣepasādhanāni vastubalāyātāni na santy evety anena vyājena kathyate | na hi vastubalāyātaṃ puruṣātiśayaṃ nirākarttṛ kiṃcit sādhanam asti |
 nanu cedam asti vivakṣitaḥ puruṣo nātiśayavān buddhimattvāt | indriyavatvāt | vacanāt puṃstvāt | rathyāpuruṣavad iti (|)
 ata āha – buddhīndriyetyādi | buddhiś cendriyaṃ ca uktiś ca puṃstvaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ | ādiśabdāt prānādimattvādi | puruṣātiśayanirākaraṇasādhanaṃ yat tu varṇṇyate (|) tatsarvaṃ pramāṇābhaṃ pramāṇābhāsam anaikāntikam iti yāvat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vipakṣavṛtteḥ sandehena sarvasya śeṣavattvāt | na hi śeṣavat ity anaikāntikatvāt | yathārthety aviparītā gatir anumeyapratipattir asti |
 yat tv ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yat tu puruṣātiśayapratikṣepasādhanantattvagamakam eveti sambandhaḥ | tat punaḥ sādhanaṃ | buddhīndriyayogād ityādi | kasmād agamakam ity āha – pratikṣepetyādi | pratikṣepaś ca sāmānyaṃ ca pratikṣepasāmānye | tayoḥ sādhane tayor ayogāt | tathā hi (|) buddhimattvādinā sādhanena nāsti puruṣātiśaya iti pratikṣepo vā sādhyeta | yad vā yosau puruṣātiśayaḥ sa rathyāpuruṣaiḥ samāna itītarapuruṣasāmānyaṃ sādhyeta |
 tatra na hītyādinā pratikṣepasādhanasyābhāvam āha – na hy atīndriyeṣv artheṣv ataddarśinotīndriyārthādarśinaḥ pratikṣepaḥ sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) satām apy eṣām tīndriyāṇām arthānām arvāgdarśanasyājñānāt | tasmān nādarśanamātrātpratikṣepa iti bhāvaḥ |
 nāpi viruddhavidhānāt puruṣātiśayasya pratikṣepaḥ yasmād ata evātindriyatvād eva puruṣātiśayasya buddhitvādinā hetunā | dvividhasyāpi virodhasyāsiddheḥ | avirodhinā ca vaktṛtvādinā puruṣātiśayasyaikatra sambhavāvirodhād ity uktaṃ prāk |
 (p. 584) nāpītyādinā sāmānyasādhanasyābhāvam āha – nāpītareṇārvāgdarśinā puruṣeṇa tasyātiśayavataḥ sāmānyasiddhis tulyatāsiddhiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) atīndriyadarśanādilakṣaṇasya viśeṣasya yo sambhavas tasya jñātum aśakyatvāt | īdṛśeṣu ca parasantānavarttiṣu puruṣamātrāpratyakṣeṣv atīndriyārthadarśanādiṣu | yā kācid asambhavaprasādhanyanupalabdhir upādīyate | tasyā anupalabdheḥ prāg eva hetutvapratikṣepāt |
 kiṃ ca (|) puṃstvādisāmyepi yathāsvaṃ saṃskārāt kasyacit prajñām evāder atiśayadarśanāt tathānyasyāpy atiśayasyasambhāvyatvāt | tasmāt sambhavadviśeṣāḥ puruṣāsambhavadviśeṣe cetarapuruṣasāmānyāsiddher ity apy uktaṃ prāk |
 tasmāc cheṣavadanumānam etad vaktṛtvāder vṛttir na drśyate | tathāpi bādhakābhāvena vyatirekasya sandehādasamarthaṃ | api caivaṃvādina iti nāsty atīndriyārthadarśīpuruṣa ity evaṃ vādino jai mi nī yāḥ svam eva vādam iti kathaṃcid atiśayavato jai mi nyādeḥ sakāśād vedārthagatirbhavatīti puruṣātiśayābhyupagamavādaṃ punar nāsty atīndriyārthajñaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścid ity anayā svavācā vidhurayanti bādhante 'tiśayavatpuruṣapratikṣepeṇa vedārthagater asambhavāt (|) tathā hi (|) ayam artho 'smākan nāyam artha iti svayamvaidikāḥ śabdā na vadanti | tenāgnihotraśabdānāṃ yobhimatorthaḥ sa kalpyo bhavet puruṣai rmī māṃ sa kaiḥ | tac ca nāsti | yatas te hi puruṣā rāgādisaṃyutā rāgādiyuktāḥ | tato na tatkalpito 'rthaḥ prramāṇaṃ |
 atha tasya vedārthasya kaścit jjai mi nyā di reva vettā kalpyeta | tatraikapuruṣobhimatastatvavit (p. 585) | vedārthatattvajño nānyaḥ puruṣa iti kiṃkṛtaḥ | nātra kiñcit kāraṇam asti mī māṃ sa ka sya puruṣatvāviśeṣāt sarvo vā vetti | na vā kaścid iti bhāvaḥ |
 atha puruṣatvādisāmyepy asādhāraṇaśaktiyukto vaidikānāṃ śabdānām atīndriyair arthaiḥ saha sambandhasya vettā kaścij jai mi nyādiḥ kalpyate (|) tadā tadvajjaiminyādivat | puṃstve puruṣatve tulyopi katham apīti nirnimittam anyopi kaścij jānī jñānātiśayavān | kasmān na vo na yuṣmākam abhimato jai mi nyā divadanyopi jñānavān prasajyata iti yāvat |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | eta āgacchata bhavanto brāhmaṇā ayam asmākam artho bhavadibhargrāhyo nānya ity evaṃ vaidikāḥ śabdā na vikrośanti na kathayanti yena tebhyorthagatiḥ syāt | kevalam ity avadhāraṇe | anabhivyaktārthaviśeṣasaṃsargā eva śrutiṃ śrotravijñānam abhipatantyārohanti (|) anabhivyaktorthaviśeṣeṇa saha saṃsargaḥ sambandho yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | tatrājñātārthasambandheṣu śabdeṣu śrutim abhipatatasvekaḥ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ kiñcid arthaṃ svecchānurūpaṃ kalpayatyanyopi puruṣoparam arthaṃ kalpayatīty anirṇṇaya eva padārthasya |
 svābhāvikaḥ śabdānāmarthasambandhastenaikārthapratiniyamo bhaviṣyatīty āha – nety āha – na ca kaścic chabdānāṃ svabhāvapratiniyamaḥ svabhāvena prakṛtyārthais saha sambandho yenānekārthakalpanāyām api kevalaṃ samayavaśāt tantamarthamāviśanto vācyatvenopādadānā dṛśyante | teṣām vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ kaścit tattvamācaṣṭe nāpara iti na nyāyyam iti sambandhaḥ | kīdṛśānām aviditārthaniyamānāṃ | aviditorthaniyamo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) atyakṣāveśāt | atīndriyasya svargādisādhanasyārthasya viṣayatvenātmasātkaraṇāt | na hī atīndriyārthasya śabdasyārthaniyamam arvāgdarśanaḥ śakto jñātuṃ | tatrāvidvān eva | rāgādidoṣopaplutaḥ | kaścij jaiminiḥ śavarasvāmī vā | teṣāṃ śabdānāntattvam ācaṣṭe | asyāyam evārtha iti (p. 586) nāparaḥ | aparo 'pi puruṣo jaiminyādyaviśiṣṭo na tattvam ācaṣṭa iti bhedavyavasthānaṃ na nyāyyam ayuktitvāt |
 atha kutaścid anirdeśyarūpād buddhīndriyādīnām (|) ādiśabdād abhyāsasyātiśayāt kāraṇāt sa eva jaiminiprabhṛtir vedārthamvetti nāparaḥ prākṛtaḥ puruṣa itīṣyate | tadā tasya jaiminiprabhṛteḥ kutoyamatīndriyajñānātiśayaḥ | atīndriyasya vedārthatattvasya jñānātiśayonyair aviditatattvair aviśiṣṭasya |
 bhavatu vā jai mi ni prabhṛtiḥ puruṣotīndriyārthasya vettā | tathā jai mi nyādivadanyopi puruṣātiśayo bau ddhā dya bhimato deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭānām arthānāṃ draṣṭā | kim asambhavī | kasmād avidyamāno dṛṣṭo yena pratikṣipyate | sopy atīndriyārthadarśyas tv itīṣyatāṃ | na cedabhimatopi jai mi nyādir mā bhūt | yato na hi tatpratikṣepasādhanāni | bau ddhā dyabhimatapuruṣātiśayapratikṣepasādhanāni puruṣatvādīni kānicit santi (|) yāni nainam vedārthavivekakāriṇaṃ jai mi ni prabhṛtiṃ nopalīyante | na viṣayī kurvanti | kintūpalīyanta eva | teṣām api puruṣatvādiyogāt |
 atha pruṣatvādisādhanasambhavepi jaiminyāder viśeṣa iṣyate | tadā yathāyam atīndriyavedārthavivecanalakṣaṇe viśeṣosya jaiminiprabhṛter iṣṭaḥ | tatsādhanasambhavepīti | tasyātīndriyārthadarśipuruṣapratikṣepasādhanasya puruṣātvādeḥ sambhavepi | tathānyasyāpi puruṣasyātīndriyārthadarśanaṃ syād ity anabhiniveśa eva bhavatāṃ mī māṃ sa kā nāṃ yuktaḥ |
 nātīndriyārthadarśīti kṛtvā jai mi ni prabhṛter vedārthajñānam iṣṭam api tu | yasya vākyaṃ pramāṇasamvādi | sa puruṣo vedārthavid yadīṣyate |
 jai mi ni prabhṛter eva ca vedārthavivecanaṃ kurvato vacanaṃ pramāṇasamvādīti paro manyate |
 netyā dyā cā ryaḥ | nedam uttaraṃ yuktaṃ yasmān na hy antaparokṣeṣu  vedārtheṣu svargādisādhanatveṣu pramāṇasyāsti sambhavaḥ |
 (p. 587) syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | na vayaṃ puruṣapramāṇyāḥ kasyacij jaiminyāder vedavyākhyānam abhiniviṣṭāḥ (|) kan tarhi (|) pramāṇasamvādād vyākhyānam abhiniviṣṭāḥ | etad eva vyanakti | bahuṣv api vedavyākhyātṛṣu  madhye | yo vedasya vyākhyātā | yathā vyākhyāterthe pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ saṃsyandayati yojayati sa tādṛśo vyākhyātānnumanyateṅgīkriyate nānya iti |
 tan netyādinā pratiṣedhati | dharmādharmāv adṛṣṭaṃ | ādiśabdāt svargādisādhakatveṣv atīndriyeṣu pratyakṣādipramāṇāntarāvṛtteḥ | na vedārthe kasyacit pramāṇasamvādi vacanaṃ | yasmāt tadasambhavād eva hi | atyantaparokṣe pratyakṣādipramāṇasyāsambhavād eva hi | tatpratīty arthantasyātīndriyasya pratīty artham āgamaḥ upayācyate prārthyate | anyatheti yady āgamagamyepy arthe pramāṇāntarasamvādād evārthaniścayas tadā saty api tasmin nāgame tadgamyerthe yadi pramāṇāntarasyāvṛttiḥ syāt (|) tadā pramāṇāntarāvṛttāv āgamāt kevalād apratipatteḥ | tataś ceti pramāṇāntarātkevalād ity āgamarahitārthapratipatter asādhanam evāgamaḥ syāt | pramāṇānttarabhāvābhāvābhyām evārthapratipatter bhāvābhāvāt | kevalād āgamanirapekṣād anyatopi pratyakṣādeḥ pramāṇād atīndriyerthe pratipattiḥ kintv āgamasahitāt pratyakṣāder atīndriyārthapratipattir iti cet |
 katham iti si ddhā nta vā dī | katham atīndriyaś ca nāma svargādisiddhyupāyaḥ pratyakṣādiviṣayaś ca virodhāt |
 syān mataṃ (|) naivātyantaparokṣerthe pratyakṣādīnāṃ sādhakatvaṃ kintu te punaḥ pratyakṣādayaḥ svaviṣayepy ātmīye viṣayepy āgamam apekṣyaiva sādhakāś cet tathā cāgamasyaiva pramāṇyam iti paro manyate |
 anāgametyādi si ddhā nta vā dī | nāsmin nāgamostīty anāgamognyādipratyayo dhūmāder liṅgān na syāt |
 (p. 588) netyādi paraḥ | na vai āgametīndriyeṣv artheṣu pravṛtte pratyakṣādipramāṇam āgamaviṣayenviṣyate | yenāyandoṣaḥ | syāt |
 tataś ca kevalāt pratipatter asādhanam evāgamaḥ syād iti | kintu saivāgamasyātīndriyeṣv api pravṛttir na jñāyate | tenāgamapravṛttiḥ pratyakṣādikam apekṣata iti cet |
 athātīndriye pratyakṣādyasamarthaṃ (|) tato samarthan tu pratyakṣādi āgamapravṛttim api naiva sādhayiṣyati yato yathā svargādisādhakam atīndriyan tathā sā cātīndriyeṇārthena sambaddhā āgamapravṛttir atīndriyā | katham anyena pratyakṣādinā siddhā | naiva siddhā | yena tadarthaṃ pratyakṣādir anviṣyata iti yatkiñced etat |
 bahuṣv api vyākhyātṛṣu yaḥ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ saṃsyandyati tasya bhāṣitaṃ gṛhyata iti bruvato pauruṣeyatvād āgamalakṣaṇād anyaś caivam āgamalakṣaṇaṃ syāt | etad evāha – tathā hītyādi | yasya puruṣasya vacanaṃ pramāṇasamvādi | tatkṛtantena puruṣeṇa saṃskṛtaṃ vaca āgama iti prāptaṃ | vacanasya ca saṃskāras tadarthasya pramāṇānugṛhītatvakhyāpanaṃ | idantad anyad āgamalakṣaṇaṃ | tathā ca nirarthā vyarthā 'pauruṣeyatā āgamalakṣaṇatveneṣṭā |
 tulyetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yaś ca pramāṇasamvādivacanena puruṣeṇārthaḥ kalpito yaś cetareṇa tayor arthayos tulyepy apauruṣeyatvāgamavāde sati pramāṇabalādāgamasyāpauruṣeyasyāpi kvacid arthe pramāṇasamvādinyāgamatva iṣyamāṇe 'gnihotrādivākyānāṃ pramāṇasamvāda āgamalakṣaṇaṃ syāt | nāpuruṣatriyā | apauruṣeyatvam āgamalakṣaṇam na syāt | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyā apuruṣakriyāyā abhimatā 'nabhimateṣu puruṣopadiṣṭeṣu sarvārtheṣu tulyatvepi pramāṇenābādhanāt pratipatter iṣṭatvāt |
 (p. 589) etad uktam bhavati | pramāṇasamvāditvenāgamārthapratipatter iṣṭatvād ity arthaḥ | tadbhāvepy apauruṣeyatvabhāvepi tulyenyatrāpramāṇasamvādinyarthe pratipatter aniṣṭhatvāt pramāṇasamvādo vacanānām āgamalakṣaṇaṃ syāt |
 yadi cātyantaparokṣerthe 'nāgamajñānasambhava āgamanirapekṣasya jñānasya sambhavaḥ | tadātīndriyārthavit kaścid astīti svam ābhimatam bhavet |
 yadi puruṣasya jai mi nyā der vedārtham ākhyātuḥ parokṣerthe svarggādisādhanopāye āggamānapekṣaṃ jñānayāthātathyaṃ jñānasyāvaiparīty amiṣyate | tadā jai mi nyādivadanyepi puruṣāḥ saṃtyatīndriyārthadṛśa itīṣṭaṃ syāt |
 syād etat (|) nātīndriyam arthaṃ pratyakṣato jānāty api tv anumānena jñātvopadiśatīti (|)
 tan na | yataḥ (|) pratyakṣapūrvakāṇām anumānādīnām asambhavāt | kadā 'taddarśanetena pratyakṣeṇātīndriyasyādarśane (|) pratyakṣetyādinaitad eva spaṣṭayati | teṣv atīndriyeṣv artheṣu pratyakṣāvṛtteḥ kāraṇāt pratyakṣapūrvakāṇāṃ pramāṇāntarāṇām asambhavāt |
 atadālambanaṃ pratīyata iti tasya pratyakṣāder ālambanam viṣayaḥ | na tadālambanam atadālambanaṃ pratyakṣādyaviṣayan tasya pratīyate niścayārtham āgamonviṣyata ity adhyāhāraḥ | pramāṇāntarasya tv anumānader atīndriyerthe  vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam atīndriyaviṣayam anvākarṣati sādhayati | pratyakṣapūrvakatvād anumānādeḥ | iti hetoḥ puruṣātiśayotīndriyāṇām arthānāṃ draṣṭā mī māṃ sa kai ranivāryaḥ syāt | nivāritaś ca | tasmān nāsty atīndriyerthe pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ |

 api ca (|) bhavatu nāmāpauruṣeyo vedastadvyākhyānañ ca tathāpi rāgādimatā puruṣeṇa puruṣāyopadiśyamānamanaṣṭasaṃpradāyam evādyatvepy anuvarttata iti (atrāpi) pramāṇābhāvāt samayaḥ śapathādiḥ śaraṇaṃ | āgamabhraṃśakāriṇām ityādinā saṃpradāyavicchedena racanāntarasambhavam eva samarthayate | āgamabhraṃśakāriṇāṃ puṃsāmanyathā | pūrvaracanāvaiparītyena racanādarśanād iti sambandhaḥ | anyathā racanāyāṃ kāraṇam āha – āhopuruṣikayetyādi | āhopuruṣikayety ahaṃmānitvena | yathā sāṃ khya nāśakamā dha ve na sāṃkhyasiddhāntasyānyathā racanaṃ kṛtaṃ | taddarśanavidveṣeṇa vānyathā racanāsambhavāt | yathā ma hā yā na vidviṣṭānāṃ mahāyānapratirūpakasūtrāntararacanaṃ | tatpratipannakhalīkaraṇāyeti | tasmin darśane yaḥ pratipannaḥ puruṣas tasya khalīkārāyānyathāracanāsambhavaḥ | tatpratipannakhalīkāra eva kathaṃ | dhūrtavyasanena | vyasanamidandhūrttānāṃ yatparaḥ khalīkartavya iti | anyato vā kutaścil lābhādikāt |

 upacayahetum āha – kiṃcetyādi | parimitāś ca te vyākhyātṛpuruṣāś ca teṣāṃ paramparām evātra vedavyākhyāne bhavatāṃ mī māṃ sa kā nāṃ śrṛṇumaḥ | tatra teṣu madhye kaścid vedasya vyākhyātā dviṣṭādīnām anyatamaḥ syāt | kaścid vedadarśane vidviṣṭaḥ sonyathāpy upadiśet | tathā kaścid ajñaḥ dhūrttā vā | tathā ca vedavyākhyāyām anāśvāsaḥ |
 yata evaṃ tasmān nāpauruṣeyād vedavyākhyānād vedārthasiddhiḥ | nāpi sāmayikāt sāṃketikāl lokavyavahārādvedārthasiddhiḥ | lokasya rāgād upaplutatvāt |
 bhavantu vā nisargasiddhā vaidikāḥ śabdās samayanirapekṣāḥ | evam apy asāmayikatvebhyupagamyamāne | vyavahāre nānārthānāṃ gavādiśabdānāndarśanāt | sarvatra vaidikepi śabde na tadāśaṃkā 'nivṛtter iti sambandhaḥ | nānārthaśaṃkāyā anivṛtter ity arthaḥ | laukikānām eva nānārthatvan na vaidikānām iti ced āha – kasyacid ityādi | tasyāpi vaidikasya kasyacid prasiddhārthasyeti yatra śabdaḥ prasiddho nārthastasyāprasiddhasya vā svarūpeṇa śabdasya | punar vyutpattipradarśanenārthaḥ kalpanīyaḥ puruṣaiḥ | tathā ca sati punaḥ kiṃ yathā sthitam evārthaṃ puruṣo vaidikānāṃ śabdānām upadiśati kimvāviparītam iti sarvatra nānārthā śaṅkāyā anivṛtteḥ |
 aniṣṭerthe prayuktā api vaidikāś śabdā na tatra pratītiṃ janayantīty apy ayuktaṃ | (p. 598) yataḥ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca yathārthan niyogepi | vīpsāyām avyayībhāvaḥ | yasmin yasminn arthe niyogassaṃketas tasmin saty apy avaiguṇyena tatra tatrārthe yathāsamayaṃ yathāsaṃketaṃ pratītijananāt | na cāniṣṭenyathāpratītijananaṃ | yata iṣṭāniṣṭayor arthayoḥ pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvena pratītajananasyāviśeṣāt | tataś cāviśiṣṭānāṃ sarvartheṣu vaidikānāṃ śabdānām ekam arthaṃ kim viśiṣṭm atyakṣasaṃyogaṃ  (|) śabdena saha sambandho yasya sa tathoktaḥ | anatyakṣadarśini | arvāgdarśini puruṣasāmānye ko vivecayet (|) naiva kaścid vivecayet | yato lokāt pratītiḥ syāt |
 api ca (|) ayaṃ mī māṃ sa kaḥ svayam api na sarvatra vede prasiddhimanusarati | yena prasiddhāl lokapravādād vedārthagatiḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | yasmāt svargorvaśyādiśabdaś ca | svargaśabda urvarśī śabdaḥ | ādiśabdān na nda na va nā di śabdaś cārūḍhārthasyāprasiddhārthasya vācako 'nena vedavādinā nirvarṇṇyamāno vyākhyāyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ | tathā hi prākṛtapuruṣātiśāyino ye puruṣaṃ viśeṣās teṣāṃ niketaḥ sthānaṃ | mānuṣātikrāntaṃ sukham atimānuṣaṃ tasyātimānuṣasya sukhasyādhiṣṭhānam āśrayaḥ | nānāprakārāṇyupakaraṇānyupabhigavastūni yasmin | sa nānopakaraṇaḥ svarga iti lokapravādaḥ tannivāsinī svarganivāsinyapsarā urvarśī nāmeti lokapravādaḥ | taṃ lokapravādamanādṛtya manuṣyeṣv eva niratiśayā prītiḥ svargaḥ | urvaśī cāraṇiḥ | pātrīvetyādinā | lokaprasiddhād arthād anyām evārthakalpanām ayaṃ jai mi nyādiḥ kurvāṇognihotrādiśabdāntareṣv arthanirṇṇaye | kathaṃ prasiddhiṃ pramāṇayet | naiva pramāṇayed iti yāvat |
 tatrāgnihotrādiśabdeṣu lokaprasiddhārthakalpanāyā avirodhāt pratītasyaivārthasyābhyupagama iti cet | svargorvaśyādiśabdeṣu tu prasiddhārthabhyupagame pramāṇavirodhād anabhyupagama iti paro manyate |
 (p. 599) netyādinā si ddhā nta vā dī | bhedam anantaroktaṃ yujyate | yasmād atrāpi svargārvaśyādiśabdeṣu lokaprasiddhetīndriyerthebhyupagamyamāne | pramāṇena virodhāsiddheḥ | na hy atra pratyakṣam anumānaṃ vā bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti | anyatrāpīty agnihotrādiśabdeṣv api lokaprasiddhārthakalpanāyām avirodhasya duranvayatvāt | sādhakapramāṇābhāvena durbodhatvāt |
 etad eva sādhayannāha – viruddhām api yathāprasiddhām agnihotrāt svargāvāptimāndyādayaṃ jai mi nyā dirna lakṣayed api kadācid iti saṃśayaḥ | kiṃ ca (|) virodhāvirodhau ca nānyāv eva (|) kin tarhi (|) bādhakasādhakapramāṇavṛttī | yathoktasyānupalambhākhyasya bādhakasya pramāṇasya vṛttir virodhaḥ | sādhakasya pratyayānumānasya pramāṇasya vṛttir avirodhaḥ | te ca virodhavirodhasvabhāve | bādhakasādhakapramāṇavṛttī | atyakṣw 'tīndriye vastuni nābhimate | na hi deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu svargādisādhaneṣu bādhakaṃ sādhakaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ pravartate | yadā caivan tat kathaṃ naiva tadvaśād iti virodhāvirodhavaśāt | virodhavaśāt svargādiśabdeṣu prasiddhārthapratītir avirodhavaśāc cāgnihotrādiśabdeṣu prasiddhārthapratītiḥ |
 atha mataṃ (|) na sādhakapramāṇavṛttir avirodhotīndriyerthe kiṃ tvāgamasaṃjñitasyāgnihotrādivacanasya lokaprasiddhārthavācakatvena pravṛttir evāvirodha iti (|)
 ata āha – na cetyādi | lokaprasiddhārthavācakatvenāgnihotrādivacanasya pravṛttir evāvirodho na ca | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyatrāpi svargorvaśyādiśabdāḥsthānāpsaroviśeṣādiṣv eva pravṛttā loke dṛśyante | tataś cāviśeṣād ubhayatra prasiddhārthaparigrahos tu | na caikatrāpi |
 kiṃ ca (|) apauruṣeyo vedākhya āgamaḥ sa ca svam arthaṃ svayaṃ na prakāśayati kin tu tasyāgamasya lokapravādād arthasiddhir abhyupagamyate | tatra punar lokaprasiddhyaṅgīkaraṇepi virodhacintāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ sarvatrāgame 'nāśvāsaḥ syād atīndriye virodhāvirodhayor niścetum aśakyatvāt |
 anāśvāsam eva sādhayannāha – satyapītyādi | saty api tasminn apauruṣeya (p. 600) āgame | svargādiśabdavācyasya svargādyarthasyātathābhāvāt | tathābhāvas tathātvaṃ (|) yathā loke prasiddhasvargārthagrahaṇam atathābhāvād aprasiddhārthagrahaṇād anyasyāpy agnihotrādiśabdasya śaṃkanīyatvāt | kim asya lokaprasiddha evārthaḥ kim vā svargādiśabdavadanya eveti | etad eva kutaḥ (|) pramāṇavṛtteḥ | na hy atra lokaprasiddhārthagrahaṇe pramāṇaṃ pravarttata iti |
 yad uktam ityādi paraḥ | yad uktam (|) "agnihotraṃ juhuyādi"ty atra vākyeśvamāṃsabhakṣaṇasya codanābhidhānantasya vikalpaḥ kalpanā bhavatv iti | sa doṣo na bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vedasyaiva pradeśāntare tatheti bhūtaviśeṣe ghṛtādikaṃ prakṣiped ity evam asyāgnihotrādivākyāsyārthacarccanāt | vyākhyānāt |
 netyādi si ddhā nta va dī | nedam uttaraṃ yujyate | tasya pradeśāntarasthasya vyākhyābhūtasya vākyasyārthaparijñānāt | tataś ca pradeśāntereṣv api vyākhyābhūteṣu tathārthakalpanāyā iti | śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇakalpanāyā anivāryatvāt |
 yadītyādy asyaiva samarthanaṃ | yadi hy ayam apauruṣeyo vedākhyaḥ śabdarāśiḥ kvacit pradeśāntare viditārthaḥ syāt tadā tato viditārthāt pradeśāntarāt pariśiṣṭasyārthapratītiḥ syāt | yāvatā te tu vaidikāḥ śabdā bāhulyepy aparijñānārthatvād andhā eva sarva iti kṛtvā puruṣeṇa yatheṣṭaṃ praṇīyante vyākhyāyante |
 yata evaṃ tasmāc chabdāntareṣu tādṛkṣivati | agnihotraṃ juhuyād ityādi vākyānām vyākhyābhūteṣu tādṛśy evāstu kalpanā | kīdṛśī (|) ity āha – yādṛśy agnihotrañjuhuyātsvargakāma ity asya kalpanā kṛtā pradeśāntarepi śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇakalpanāstitvati yāvat |
 api ca prasiddhiś ca nānyad eva kiṃcit | kin tarhi (|) nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vadaḥ (p. 601) sa ca vādaḥ pramāṇanneṣyate bhavatā | sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ rāgādyupaplutatvāt | bhūya iti punaḥ | tataś ca lokapravādād apramāṇatvena pūrvaṃ vyavasthāpitāt punar vedārthagatir iti yugapat kim etad viṣṭakāmitaṃ | yad eva vastv apramāṇatvena dviṣṭaṃ | tad eva punaḥ pratipattihetutvena kāmitam abhilaṣitam iti parasparavirodhaḥ |
 na prasiddhir nāmānyā janapravādāt | kin tu janapravāda eva prasiddhiḥ | te ca sarve janā asambhāvanīyayāthātathyavacanā asambhāvanīyaṃ yāthātathyamaviparītatvaṃ yamin vacane | tadasambhāvanīyayāthātathyaṃ vacanaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) rāgāvidyāparītatvāt | rāgāvidyābhyāṃ vyāptatvāt | tad iti tasmād eṣāṃ janānāṃ pravādo na pramāṇaṃ |
 bāhulyāj janasya tatpravādaḥ pramāṇam ity api mithyā | yataḥ (|) na hi bahunāṃ janānāmmadhye kasyacid ekasyāpi puruṣasya samyakpratipatter abhāve sati lokasya bāhulyam arthavad bhavati prayojanavad bhavati | kim iva (|) pārasī ketyādi | yathā bahubhiḥ pārasīkairmātari maithunācaraṇān na tannyāyyam bhavati | evaṃ bāhulyepi rāgādimatāmatīndriyerthe vacanam apramāṇam eveti |
 atha teṣām eva rāgādimatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vacanāt punaḥ parokṣasyāgnihotrādiśabdavācyasyārthasya pratipattir iti | kathan tad eva yugapad ekasminn eva kāle dveṣyaṃ kāmyaṃ ca yujyate |
 agnihotrādiśabdasya yasminn arthe lokaprasiddhistāmullaṃdhya tyaktvā | tatorthāntarasya śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇādeḥ kalpane na nibandhanaṃ kāraṇam iti | tasmāt prasiddhir eva gṛhyata ity etad apy ayuktaṃ | yataḥ prasiddher apramāṇatvāt tadgrahe prasiddhigrahe kinnibandhanaṃ (|) naiva kiñcid iti prasiddher api graho mābhūd iti |
 (p. 602) prāptyetyādinā pūrvārddhantāvad vyācaṣṭe | prasiddhyā prāptasyārthasya pratilomanena tyāgenānyatrāprasiddherthe pravṛttir guṇadoṣadarśane sati yuktā | yadi prāpterthe doṣadarśanaṃ syād aprāpte ca guṇadarśanaṃ | na cāgnihotrādiśabdānāṃ prasiddherthe doṣadarśanam asty aprasiddhe vā guṇadarśanan tataḥ prasiddhe evānvayonugamanam iti cet |
 netyādinā pratiṣedhati | etac ca paścārddhasya vivaraṇaṃ | naitad evaṃ (|) kiṃṅkāraṇaṃ (|) prāpteḥ pramāṇavṛttilakṣaṇatvāt | sādhakena hi pramāṇenārthasya prāptir niścīyata iti prāpteḥ pramāṇavṛttilakṣĪṇatvam ucyate | na ca prasiddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ yena siddhortho nyāyaprāptaḥ syāt | tataś ca tām enāṃ prasiddhim apramāṇayato mī māṃ sa ka sya tanmukhena prasiddhidvāreṇāgnihotrādiśabdavācyasyārthasya yā pratītiḥ sā yatkiñcana grahaṇam apramāṇakatvāt | yathā kathañcit tadgrahaṇam ity arthaḥ |
 tataś cāgnihotrādiśabdasya lokaprasiddhortho nyāyaprāpto na bhavatīty evaṃ nyāyāllokaprasiddhasyārthasya prāptipratiṣedhāt kāraṇādagnihotrādiśabdānām icchayārthaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ |
 tatra mī māṃ sa kair agnihotrādiśabdānāṃ yorthaḥ parikalpyate dahanadravyādilakṣaṇo yaś ca pareṇa śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇalkṣaṇastayoḥ svaparavikalpayor ubhayathāpīti yadi prasiddhyanupālanam atha nānupālanan tathāpi pramāṇābhāvādicchayā parigrahe tulyā vṛttir iti kṛtvā kaḥ prasiddhānurodho yena prasiddher arthakalpanā kriyate |
 api ca (|) prasiddhyaiva sarvaśabdānām arthaniścaye | iyannānārthatvena śaṃkotpāditā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmānnā(nā)rth vṛttitvam agnyādiśabdānān tatra prasiddhau dṛśyate |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na prasiddhes sakāśādekārthaniścayaḥ śabdānām vaidikānāṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tata eva prasiddher eva śaṃkotpatteḥ | tathā hi nānārthā agnyādiśabdā loke dṛśyante | tac ca nānārthadarśanaṃ lokavādo lokapravādaś ca pratītir ata eva (p. 603) lokavādānnā(nā)rthateti kṛtvā tato lokavādād vaidikānāṃ śabdānām ekārthaniyamo na yuktaḥ |
 aniyatārthatvam eva draḍhayannāha – anyathetyādi | svayaṃ svabhāvato nānāśakter anekārthapratipādanayogyasya dhvaneḥ śabdasyānyathāsambhadābhāvāt | abhimatādarthādarthāntare vṛttir anyathā | tasyā arthāntaravṛtter asambhavonyathā 'sambhavas tasyābhāvāt | pratiṣedhadvayena vidher abhyupagamādanyathāpi sambhavasya bhāvād iti yāvat | tataś cātīndriyārthavṛttiṣu vaidikeṣu śabdeṣv avaśyam anekārthavṛttitvena śaṃkayā bhāvyaṃ | keṣāṃ niyāmakam apaśyatā puṃsāṃ pratiniyataviṣayasādhakaṃ pramāãm apaśyatāṃ | (326)
 yata evaṃ tasmād (|) aviditaḥ arthavibhāgo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | teṣv aviditārthavibhāgeṣu śabdeṣv ekam artham abhimataṃ (|) kiṃ bhūtam (|) atyakṣasaṃyogaṃ | atyakṣotīvibhāgeṣu śabdena saha sambandho yasyeti vigrahaḥ | ālambanaṃ pramāṇantad abhāvādanālambano niḥpramāṇakassamāropo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tam evaṃ bhūtam artham iva niścatya vyācakṣāṇo jai mi niḥ | tadvyājeneti veda evaṃ prāheti vedopakṣepeṇa svam eva matamāheti kṛtvā yastīrthya(?rtha)karo nirvyājam evam āha – aham eva svayamvadāmīti | tasmāt tīrya(?tha)kārāntarādasya jai mi ner na viśeṣaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
 aviśeṣam eva sādhayannāha – tathā hītyādi | sa cāsāvarthaś ceti tadarthas tasya prakāśanam vacanaṃ | tatra vyāpāras sāmarthyan tena śūnyasya rahitasya vedasya | tatsamāropeṇety arthaprakāśanavyāpārasamāropeṇa……………………evamvaktīti yadabhidhānanta (……………………) svavacanam eva tasya tad iti yāvat | tatkāriṇā vacanavyāpāraśūnye vederthaprakāśanavyāpārasamāropakāriṇā jai mi ni nā kevalam mithyāvinī tataivātmanaḥ samuddyotitā syāt | na tu pauruṣeyād vacanādasya viśeṣaḥ |
 (p. 604) etad eva sphuṭayannāha – tathā hītyādi | kaḥ panthā pā ṭa li pu traṃ gacchatīti pṛṣṭaḥ kaścana puruṣa āha – na jāne svayam ahaṃ kevalam eṣa sthāṇur ayaṃ mārga iti vaktīty evam eko mārgopadeśasāmarthyaśūnyasthāṇuvyājena mārgam ācaṣṭe | anyas tv āha – na sthāṇor vacanasāmarthyam asty aham eva svayaṃ jñātvāyaṃ mārga iti brabīmīti | tayor evam abhidadhatoḥ svayam vacanabhedaḥ parīkṣyatāṃ yady asti naivāstīty abhiprāyaḥ |
 nirabhiprāya ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | abhiprāya idaṃ cedaṃ ca kariṣyāmīti cetanā | tatpūrvakaḥ prayatno vyāpāraḥ | abhiprāyaś ca vyāpāraś ca vacanaṃ ca | tāni na vidyante yasminsa tathoktaḥ | tasminn evam bhūte sthāṇau mārgaprakāśaktvaṃ samāropyopadiśat ekasya puṃsaḥ svatantrasya vā sthāṇunirapekṣasyāparasya mārgam upadiśata iti sambandhaḥ | etayor dvayoḥ puruṣayoḥ svayam vacanopagame na kaścid viśeṣonyatra jaḍasya pratipattimāndyāt jaḍasya śrotuḥ pratipattimāndyam eva viśiṣyate | yatobhiprāyādiśūnyasya sthāṇor vacanaṃ pratipadyate sthāṇūr eva vaktīti | evaṃ jai mi ner vedavyājena svamataṃ bruvato jaḍaḥ pratipattimāndyāt veda evaṃ brūta iti pratipadyate |
 api ca vaidikasya śabdasyaikārthapratiniyame satyenamekārthapratiniyamaṃ jai mi nirjānīyāt | yāvatā śabdasya vācakasya sarvatrārthe vācakatvena yogyasyaikārthadyotane niyatiḥ kuto naiva | na hi śabdasya kaścid arthaḥ svabhāvena nisargasiddhyā niyatosti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvatra vācyerthe yogyatvāc chabdasya |
 atha punar na yogyatā sarvatrārthe śabdasya tadāpy ayogyatve ca tadapracyuter ayogyatāsvabhāvānn ity asya śabdasyāpracyuteḥ kāraṇāt puruṣāṇām avidheyasyānāyattasya kvacid arthe upanayanam vācakatvena niyojanaṃ | niyuktasyāpy apanayaṃ | nedānīm ayaṃ śabdo vācaka iti tasyāsambhavāt | bhavati ca (|) tasmāt sarvatra śabdā yogyā (p. 605) ity ekārthadyotanaṃ nāsti |
 bhavatu vā vaidikānām ekārthaniyamas tathāpy atīndriyam arthaniyamaṃ puruṣo jñātum aśaktaḥ | tad evāha – jñātā vātīndriyā arthāḥ kena puruṣeṇa | na hi mī māṃ sa kotīndriyārthadarśinaṃ kañcid icchati | vivakṣāvacanād ṝte (|) vivakṣāyāḥ prakāśanam avacanam iva vakṣāvacanan tena vinā | vaktur abhiprāyakathanamantareṇātīndriyā naiva kenacij jñātā ity arthaḥ |
 puruṣetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kayācid vivakṣayā puruṣeṇa praṇīte uccārite śabde sa puruṣastām vivakṣāṃ kadācit kvacic chrotari nivedayed idaṃ mayā vācyatvena vivakṣitam iti | vivakṣāpūrvakāṇāṃ śabdānām arthe niyamaḥ pratīyetāpi | apauruṣeye tu śabde vivakṣāpūrvaṃ kenacid aprayukte vidyamānopy arthaniyamaḥ kathaṃ jñeyaḥ (|) naiva kathaṃcit | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvabhedasyābhāvāt | na hi vaidikasya śabdasya kaścit svabhāvo bhinnosti sa ekatrābhimaterthe niyato yaddarśanādiṣṭārthapratītiḥ syāt | saty api vā svabhāvabhede sa svabhāvabhedaḥ pratyakṣo vā syād apratyakṣo vā | na tāvat pratyakṣaḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) pratyakṣasya svabhāvasyopadeśanirapekṣasya | svayaṃ pratītiprasaṅgāt | athāpratyakṣaḥ (|) apratyakṣatvepi pramāṇāntarasyābhāvena kenacid apy arvāg darśanena jñātum aśakyatvāt |
 abhyupagamyaitad uktaṃ | na cāsti kaścid viśeṣo ya ekārthapratiniyataḥ | sarvaśabdā hi sarvārthapratyāsattiviprakarṣarahitāḥ |
 na hi kecic chabdāḥ kvacid arthe pratyāsannā viprakṛṣṭā vā bhāvato 'pi tu teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ sarvārtheṣu svabhāvatas tulyānām ekārthaniyame vaktur vivakṣā hetuḥ | saṃketastatprakāśana iti tasyāś ca vivakṣāyāḥ prakāśanaḥ saṃketaḥ | tathā hy ayam artho (?rthaḥ) tena vivakṣita iti saṃketādavagamyate | sā ca vivakṣāpauruṣeye śabde nāstīti kṛtvā (p. 606) tasyāpauruṣeyasya śabdasya sā yathoktā ekārthatā kutaḥ (|) naiva |
 vivakṣā hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | vivakṣayā hetubhūtayā śabdortheṣu niyamyate 'syaivārthasyāyaṃ vācaka iti | na tu svabhāvataḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya śabdasya kvacid vastunyapratibandhena sambandharahitatvena kāraṇena sarvatrārthatulyatvāt | yatrāpi śabdasya pratibandhaḥ sthānakaraṇeṣu tataḥ śabdānām utpatter abhivyakter vā | teṣām api karaṇānāṃ sarvaiḥ śabdair abhidhānaniyamabhāvāt | na hi sarve śabdāḥ karaṇānām evābhidhāyakāḥ | karaṇābhidhāyī punaḥ śabdaḥ karaṇāni pratipādayed apīti sarvagrahaṇaṃ |
 yata evaṃ tasmād vivakṣāprakāśanāya saṃketaḥ kriyate (|) kīdṛśaḥ (|) abhiprāyanivedanalakṣaṇaḥ | vaktur abhiprāyaprakāśanalakṣaṇaḥ | apauruṣeye tu śabde na vivakṣā niyāmikā | nāpi saṃketas tatprakāśanaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣanivṛtter eva kasyacid abhiprāyasyābhāvād iti kṛtvā naikārthaniyamo vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ | niyame vā | na tajjñānaṃ naikārthapratiniyamajñānaṃ kasyacit | arthe svabhāvata ekārthaniyatā vaidikāḥ śabdā na vivakṣātaḥ |
 tadā svabhāvaniyamebhyupagamyamāne sa śabdonyatrārthe tayā vivakṣayā na viyujyate |
 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi saṃketanirapekṣaḥ svabhāvata eva śabdertheṣu nilīno yuktaḥ syāt uktam atrottaraṃ (|) "kvacid vastunyapratibandhād aniyata" iti |
 api ca (|) svābhāvikena nisargasiddhe vācyavācakabhāve 'bhyupagamyamāne | na punar vivakṣayā yatheṣṭaṃ śabdonyatrārthe niyujyate | na hi rūpaprakāśane svabhāvato niyataṃ cakṣuḥ śabdaprakāśane niyoktuṃ śakyate | niyujyate ca yatheṣṭaṃ śabdaḥ (|) tasmān na svabhāvaniyataḥ | hastasaṃjñādivat | svabhāvatorthapratiniyame śabdānāṃ saṃketaś ca (p. 607) nirartho niṣphalaḥ syāt | yato na hi svabhāvabhedaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣa indriyagamyaḥ svapratītau paribhāṣādikaṃ | paribhāṣā saṃketaḥ | ādiśabdāt saṃketasmṛtyādiparigrahaḥ  |kim iva (|) nīlādibhedavat | yathā nīlādiviśeṣāḥ svapratītau saṃketādikaṃ nāpekṣante tadvat | tadapekṣapratītayas tu saṃketāpekṣapratītayas tu ye | te na vastusvabhāvāḥ | na vastuno nisargasiddhāḥ viśeṣāḥ (|) kin tarhi (|) sāmayikāḥ saṃketakṛtāḥ | kim iva (|) rājacihnādivat | yathā rājñā svapratītaye samitā dhvajādayaścinhabhedāḥ | ādiśabdād dhastasaṃjñādiparigrahaḥ | yaś ca sāmayikas sa svabhāvaniyato yuktaḥ | nisargasiddho na yuktaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya sāmayikasya puruṣasya puruṣecchayā pravṛtteḥ |
 vaidikasya śabdasyārthe nisargata eva svabhāvaviśeṣo niyataḥ sa tu saṃketena vyajyata iti ced (|)
 āha – ata evetyādi | yasmād icchāvṛttis saṅketo 'ta eva kāraṇāt | saṃketādekārthaniyatasya svabhāvaviśeṣasya vyaktau niyatiḥ kutaḥ (|) naiva |
 tad vyācaṣṭe (|) svecchāvṛttissaṃketassa ihaivābhimaterthe karttuṃ śakyate nānyatreti noparodhosti (|) na vācakam asti | tataś ca sa saṃketaḥ puruṣaiḥ svecchayā kriyamāṇastam evaikārthaniyataṃ svabhāvaṃ vyanikti nānyam iti na niyamosti |
 yatra saṃkete svātantryam icchāyā niyamo nāma tatra kaḥ | naivāsti niyama ity arthaḥ | tenāniyatatvena kāraṇenāsya vaidikasya śabdasyeṣṭām evābhimatārthaviṣayām eva | yogyatāṃ saṃketo na dyotayed iti |
 tad evam apauruṣeyatvaṃ nāgam alakṣaṇam iti pratipāditam |
 (p. 608) idānīm ekadeśāvisamvādanam āgamalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣayitum upanyasyati | yasmād ityādi | kila śabdonabhiprāyadyotakaḥ | agniḥ śītanodayaḥ śītasya nivārakaḥ | etenāgnir himasya bheṣajamity etad vākyaṃ yathā satyaṃ tathānyad api vākyam agnihotrādikaṃ juhuyād ity ādikam avitatham etat sādhyaṃ | vedaikadeśatvād iti hetuḥ | evam aparo vṛ ddha mī māṃ sa ko bravīt | uktavān |
 anyas tv ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | anyas tu mīmāṃsakaḥ | yathoktadoṣopahatatvāt | apauruṣeyam āgamalkṣaṇaṃ parityajyānyathā prāmāṇyamvedasya sādhayitukāmaḥ prāha – avitathānītyādi | yatrāpratipattir iti yeṣu vedavākyeṣv avitathatvena bau ddha syāpratipattistānyavitathānīty anena viśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇāt | vaidaikadeśatvād iti | sāmānyasya hetutvenopādānān na pratijñārthaikadeśatā hetor asti | yathā (|) "agnir himasya bheṣajaṃ" pratipakṣa ityādi vākyava(t) | ādiśabdād dvādaśa māsā samvatsara ityādivākyaparigrahaḥ |
 uttaram āha – tasyetyādi | tasya vādina idaṃ sādhanaṃ śeṣavat | kasmād (|) vyabhicāritvāt īdṛśam anumānaṃ nyāyavidā ācārya di gnā ge na pra mā ṇa sa mu cca ye pratikṣiptam iti sambandhaḥ | kim iva śeṣavad ity āha – rasavad ityādi | yathā svāditena phalena tulyarūpatvād anāsvāditam api phalaṃ tulyam ity etad anumānaṃ śeṣavat | tadvat | adṛṣṭā api taṇḍulā pakvā ekabhāṇḍe pacanāt | dṛṣṭapakvataṇḍulavad ity evam ekabhāṇḍe ca pākavat | yathaiva tadanumānaṃ tathā mī māṃ sa ko kta m iti |
 svayam ityādinā vyākhyānaṃ | īdṛśam anumānaṃ svayam ācāryeṇāsādhanam uktam iti (p. 609) sambandhaḥ | kva (|) nai yā yi kā nāṃ śeṣavad anumānasya vyabhicāramudbhāvayatā pra mā ṇa sa mu cca ye | kim iva | yathā tulyarūpatayā hetubhūtayā 'nāsvāditānām api phalānāmāsvāditaphalena | tulyarasasādhanavat | ekasthālyantargamād iti ca hetunā | dṛṣṭaparipakvataṇḍulavad adṛṣṭataṇḍulānāṃ pākasādhanavat | tadasādhanatvanyāyaś ceti tasya śeṣavatonumānasyāsādha(na)tvanyāyaś ca | yasmād adarśanamātreṇa vyatirekaḥ pradarśyata ityādinā pūrvam evoktaḥ | nanu ca (|)
 "āptavādāvisamvādasāmānyādanumānatā" (pra° vā° 1|218)
 ityādinā ācārya di gnā ge nāpy ekadeśāvisamvādanam āgamalakwaṇam uktam eveti (|)
 āha – uktaṃ cedam ityādi | uktaṃ cedam (|)
 "ekadeśāvisamvādirūpam āgamalakṣaṇam (|)"
asmābhirnāyaṃ puruṣo nāśrityāgamaprāmāṇyamāsituṃ samartha" ityatrāntare |
 tatraikadeśāvisaṃvādanam āgamalakṣaṇaṃ nātyantaprasiddhaikaviṣayasatyatāśrayam api tu tattvāgamalakṣaṇaṃ yo 'rvāg darśanena pramāṇataḥ śakyaparicchedaḥ | aśeṣo viṣayas tasya sarvasya śakyavicārasya viṣayasya (|) śakyo vicārosyeti vigrahaḥ | yathāsvaṃ pramāṇena vidhipratiṣedhasvīkṛtasiddhivat (?) viśuddhā śāstre pratyakṣaviṣayatvenābhimatānāṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ | yathā bau ddha si ddhā nte buddhyādīnāṃ | tathā vastuvalāyātānumānaviṣayābhimatānāṃ vastubalānumānaviṣayatvaṃ | yathā duḥkhasatyādīnāṃ | āgamāpekṣānumānaviṣayābhimatānāṃ ca tathābhāvaḥ | trividhasya viṣayasya yathāsvaṃ pramāṇena vidhisiddhiḥ | pratyakṣādipramāṇā vi[ṣaya……] tā nāma pratyakṣāditvaṃ yathāsvaṃ pramāṇena pratiṣedhasiddhiḥ | evaṃ vidhipratiṣedhasiddhau satyām pariśeṣṭeṣv atyantaparokṣeṣv artheṣu śabdānāṃ nāntaratīyakatābhāve sambandhābhāve saty api varamagatyā saṃśayitasya puruṣasya pravṛttis tatreti sarvasmin vastunyadṛṣṭavyabhicāra āgame kadācid avisamvādasambhavāt |
 nanv anyatreti (|) yatrāgame yathoktaviṣayaśa[………………ta]pratyakṣadiviṣaypi (p. 610) dṛṣṭaḥ pramāṇenoparodho vā | yane puruṣeṇa tasya puruṣasya pravṛttir na yuktetyevam āgamalakṣaṇam uktam asmābhiḥ |
 yaḥ punar mī māṃ sa kādiḥ prākṛtapuruṣāṇāṃ viṣayasya vahaner yacchītapratighātasāmarthyantasyābhidhānam agnir himasya bheṣajam ity etad vākyam vedaikadeśabhūtaṃ satyārthaṃ | dṛṣṭāntatvenopadarśya sarvaṃ satyārthamvedalakṣaṇaṃ śāstram ity āha – kimbhūtaṃ śāstraṃ śakyaparicchede pramāṇagamye 'pi viṣaye pramāṇavirodhād bahutaram ayuktam api tad evaṃbhūtaṃ śāstraṃ pratijānāno mīmāṃsakādir jayed dhāṣrṭyena bandhakīm iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ |
 vahutaram ayuktam apīty uktantaddarśayann āha – nityasyetyādi | badad ity etatpadaṃ sarvatra sambandha(nīyaṃ |) nityaḥ karttā puruṣostīty evan nityasya puṃsaḥ karttṛtvam vadacchāstraṃ | tathā nityān bhāvān vadat | atīndriyānapratyakṣānarthānaidriyān pratyakṣān vadat | tathā viṣamam ayuktaṃ hetuṃ bhāvānāṃ vadat | tathā bhāvānām viṣamāṃ sthitiṃ | nivṛttiñ ca bhāvānām viṣamām vadat | etac ca vṛtto spaṣṭayiṣyāmaḥ | yathoktād anyad vā vastu vyastagocaraṃ | vyastaḥ pratikṣipto gocarovakāśo yasya tat tathoktaṃ | kena vyastagocaram ity āha – pramāṇābhyāṃ pratyakṣān upekṣeṇānumānena viruddham vadac chāstraṃ | tad evam anekāyuktārthābhidhāyakaṃ śāstraṃ satyārthaṃ pratijānāno vādī | jayed dhāṣṭryena bandhakīṃ |
 kim akṛtvā pratijānāna ity āha – virodham ityādi | śakyavicāre vastuni śāstrasya virodhamasamādhāyāparihṛtya puruṣaśāstrapravṛttau nimittaṃ śāstrārthañ ca sambandhānuguṇopāyapuruṣārthalakṣaṇam apradarśya pratijānānaḥ |
 apracyuter ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | apracyutaṃ pūrvaṃ rūpaṃ | anutpannaṃ cāparaṃ rūpaṃ (p. 611) yasyeti vigrahaḥ | īdṛśaḥ kila pumān sukṛtaduṣkṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ krameṇa karttā | karmaphalānāṃ ca bhoktā | kena prakāreṇa bhiktā karttā cety āha – pūrvakarmajanitasukhaduḥkhādisamvittiṃ prati samavāyikāraṇabhāvenātmā karma phalānāmbhiktāḥ | tad uktaṃ |
 "sukhaduḥkhādisamvittisamvāyas tu bhoktṛte"ti |
 śubhāśubhakarmakaraṇe jñānaprayatnādikaṃ prati adhiṣṭhānabhāvenātmā karmaṇā karttā | tad uktaṃ (|)
 "jñānayatnābhisambamdhaḥ karttṛtvan tasya bhaṇyata" iti |
 ādigrahaṇāt | aḍarūpasyāpy ātmanaś cetanāyogena bhoktṛtvaṃ gṛhyate | tad uktaṃ (|)
 "bhoktā ca cetanāyogāt cetanaṃ na svarūpata" iti |
 tad evaṃ samavāyikāraṇādhiṣṭhānabhāvādinety āha vedaḥ | tac caitad ayuktam ity āveditaprāyaṃ | svayam eva śāstrakāreṇa nityānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāsambhavandarśayatā | nityatvaṃ cāyuktaṃ keṣāṃ(cid bhā) vānām veda āheti sambandhanīyaṃ | kasmād ayuktam (|) akṣaṇikasya kramayaugapadyābhyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodhena vastudharmātikramāt | arthakriyāsamarthaṃ hi vastu | tac cārthakriyāsāmarthyam akṣaṇikasya na sambhavatīty asad eva (|) tatkutas tasya vastudharmaḥ | apratyakṣāṇyeva sāmānyādīnīti (|) ādiśabdāt kriyāguṇādīni pratyakṣāṇīty āha vedaḥ | janma ca sthitiś ca ni(vṛ)ttiś ca tāś ca bhāvānām viṣamāḥ prāha vedaḥ | janmano vaiṣamyeṇa viṣayo hetur bhāvānām uktaḥ sūtre |
 tam eva viṣamaṃ hetum āha – anādheyasyetyādi | nityatvādanādheyātiśayasya prāg ity arthakriyākālāvasthāyāḥ pūrvam akarttuḥ paścāt parāpekṣayā sahakāryapekṣayā | janakatvam āha vedaḥ | tac caitad yuktam iti vistareṇa pratipāditaṃ |
 niṣpatter ityādinā viṣamasthity abhidhāyitvam vedasy āha – svahetuto niṣpatter niṣpannatvād akāryarūpasya bhāvasy āśrayavaśena sthānam āha vedaḥ | taccaitad ayuktaṃ sarvaniraśaṃsya nānyabalena sthānam iti prāk pratipāditaṃ |
 viṣamāṃ nivṛttindarśayann āha – kāraṇāc ca vināśahetoḥ sakāśād bhāvānām vināśa ity āha (p. 612) vedaḥ | tac cāyuktama(………………)dvināśasyeti pratipāditaṃ |

 ke punas te dharmā ity āha – sambandhetyādi | paras paraṃ padārthānāṃ saṅgatārthatā sambandhaḥ | śakyasādhana upāyaḥ | anuguṇopayaḥ | yaḥ śāstre puruṣārthasādhana u[kta…………dṛ] ṣṭassa puruṣeṇa sādhayituṃ śakyata iti yāvat | abhyudayaniḥśreyasaṃ puruṣārthaḥ | sambandhaś cānuguṇopāyaś ca puruṣārthaś ceti dvandvaḥ | teṣām abhidhānāni |
 nanu virodhāsamādhānād eva śāstrasyāgrāhyatvam uktan tat kiṃ śāstradharmāpradarśanenoktena |

bahubacanenāpi paśyata śabdena sambadhyamano mātar ity eva prayukta iti | anye tu paśyata mātaraḥ puruṣasyeti paṭhanti | dharmasya sādhanabhūtā patnī dharmapatnīti madhyapadalopī samāsaḥ | yayi kāraṇam āha – tenetyādi | jaraṃś cāsau kāṇaś ceti jaratkāṇaḥ | vṛddhakāṇenety arthaḥ | tatra jaradgrahaṇena vayovaikalyam uktaṃ | paraṃ rūpasthānaṃ cakṣur iti tadvaikalyāt kāṇagrahaṇena vairūpyaṃ | grāmyagrahaṇena vaidagdhyādiguṇavaikalyaṃ | kāṣṭhahārakagrahaṇena kṛcchrajīvitvāt dāridryam uktaṃ | tad evaṃ vṛddhatvādiguṇayuktena puruṣeṇa saṅgaty arthaṃ prārthitāpi satī | nāhan tena saha saṅgatā prāk | rūpaguṇānurāgeṇa | rūpaṃ prāsādikatā | guṇo vaidagdhyādiko dharmaḥ | rūpaguṇayor anurāgobhilāṣas tena hetunā | maṃtrimukhyadārakaṃ mantripradhānadārakaṃ yuvānaṃ putraṃ | [mantrimu]khyaś cāsau dārakaś ceti vigrahaḥ | tam evaṃbhūtaṃ dārakaṃ kāmayeham iti katham idaṃ sambhāvyate | tatra vṛddhādidoṣacaruṣṭayavaiparīty enamantrimukhyadārake guṇacatuṣṭayam uktaṃ | rūpagrahaṇena prāsādikatvaṃ guṇagrahaṇena vaigdhyādiḥ | mantrimukhyagrahaṇenaiśvaryaṃ | dārakagrahaṇena vayoguṇaḥ | etac ca bamdhakyā dhārṣṭyāt preritam eva kevalasvam vaca[naṃ na] tu yuktiyuktaṃ | rūpādīnām eva kāmahetutvān (p. 614) na tu vārddhakyādīnāṃ |
 evaṃjātīyakam ityādinā dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ dārṣṭāntike yojayati | evaṃjātīyakam iti bandhakīprativacanatulyaṃ | etadatyantaparokṣerthe vedasyāvisamvādānumānaṃ (|) kim bhūtasya vedasya śakyavicāre vastuni dṛṣṭapramāṇavirodhasya | dṛṣṭaḥ pramāṇavirodhosyeti vigrahaḥ | [vahniśītanodana]dṛṣṭāntenānumānaṃ | bahneḥ śītapratīkāravacanena | yathāgnir himasya bheṣajam iti vākyam avisamvādi | tathānyad api vedavākyam avisamvādīti |
 tatra dharmapatnīsthānīyo vedaḥ | vipratipattitulyannityasya puṃsaḥ karttṛtvādyabhidhānaṃ | netratulye pratyakṣānumāne | na ca dṛṣṭavyabhicārāyāḥ patnyā vacanaṃ garīyas tasya puruṣasya yena [………………] yamvipratipattiṃ dṛṣṭvāpi svadarśanam apramāṇīkṛtya tasyā vacanaṃ yathārthaṃ kuryāt | evam vedoktārthabādhakayoḥ pramāṇayor apramāṇyaṃ kṛtvā na vedasya patnīsthānīyasya dṛṣṭavyabhicārasya vacanādatyantaparokṣaṃ pratipadyemahīti | (336)
 atraiva doṣāntaram āha – sidhyedityādi |evam iti yathā dṛṣṭaikasatyābhidhānamātreṇa yadi sarvo vedaḥ | […………pra] māṇaṃ sidhyet tadā sarvaḥ puruṣas sarvatrātha pramāṇam syāt | yasmān na hi puruṣe bahubhāṣiṇyekaṃ vacanaṃ satyārthaṃ nāsti (|) kintv asty eva |
 yathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yathedam atyantam abhidhāyitvaṃ | ekāntena satyavāditvam atiduṣkaraṃ | atyantaduḥkhena triyata iti kṛtvā | tathātyantaṃ | satyābhidhānam atiduṣkarantatraivaṃsthite nyāye | ekasya […………vaca] nasya kathaṃcid iti kā ka tā lī ya nyāyenāpi yassamvādassatyārthatvan tena hetunā | tasmād avisamvādakād vacanād aviśiṣṭasya tadvacanarāśer iti yasya tadekamvacanam avisamvādi dṛṣṭantasya puruṣasya vacanarāśeḥ | tathābhāve 'visamvāditve 'bhyupagamyamāne | na kaścit puruṣo nāptaḥ syāt | kin tu sarva evāptaḥ syāt | na caivaṃ | tasmān naikadeśāvisamvā[dāt………prāmā]ṇyam iti |
 (p. 615) api ca yo nāma kaścit kasyacid gamakaḥ sa tatsvabhāvastajjanyo vā san gamayennānyathā | na cāyaṃ dhvanirvācyatvenābhimatānāṃ castūnāṃ svabhāvaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmād vaktari dhvaniḥ sthito na hy anyasvabhāvonyatra varttate | vastanāṃ kārya vā (|) nāyaṃ dhvaniḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmād vaktari matidhvanir bhavati | tenāyam arthaḥ | (|) yasmād vaktur icchāmātrapratibaddho na vāhyavastu […………] ity arthaḥ | na ca tadvyatiriktasyeti svabhāvakāryavyatiriktasyārthasyāvyabhicāritā vidyate |
 netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tāvacchabdaḥ krame | etad vaktṛstham vacanaṃ na tāvad vācyānām arthānāṃ svabhāvaḥ | nāpy eṣāṃ vācyānāṃ kāryaṃ | ki(ṅ) kāraṇaṃ (|) tadabhāvepi | vastūnām abhāvepi vivakṣāmātreṇa bhāvād utpatter na ca kāryasvabhāvābhyām anyaḥ kaścit kasyacid avyabhicārī hetur asti | vā[……………] vyabhicāre ca sati śabdasya tatonyathāpīti | tasmād bāhyārthād anyathāpi vāhyārthabhāvepīty arthaḥ | tatsambhavāt tasya śabdasya sambhavāt kāraṇāt | tasya śabdasya bhāvāt tatpratītir vāhyārthapratītir ayuktā |
 syād etad (|) yady api vācyād vastunorthāntaraṃ vacanantathāpi tasya vācyasya kāryam eveti gamakam eva | yasmād vācakānāṃ śabdānāṃ yā pravṛttir utpattir abhivyaktir vā sā vā[cya dṛ]ṣṭikṛtā | vācyasyārthasya yaddarśanantatkṛtā | vācye hi sati taddarśanantaddarśanaṃ (|) taddarśanāt tadvivakṣā | vivakṣāto vacanam iti pāramparyeṇa vacanam arthakāryam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
 syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasmād vācakasya śabdasya vācyadarśanena pravṛtteḥ |
 (p. 616) evam ityādinā pratividhatte | evaṃ satīti yady arthavaśenaiva vacanapravṛttes sarvā vacanapravṛttiḥ satyārthā……daikatrābhidheye āgamabhedena parasparaṃ viruddhārthā sā vacanavṛttiḥ katham bhavet | naiva bhavet | sarvapravādeṣv ekārtheva bhaved iti yāvat |
 yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yady eṣa niyamo vācyam vastvantareṇa vācyena vastunā vinā śabdo na pravarttata iti tadā paraspara viruddhārthābhidhānād bhinneṣu pravādeṣu siddhānteṣc ekatra vastuni | nityānityā [de………vi]ruddhasya svabhāvasyopasaṃhāreṇa samāropeṇa vacanavṛtir na syāt | yato na hy asty ayaṃ sambhavo yadekaḥ śabdo niḥparyāyam iti prakārāntareṇa vinety arthaḥ | nityaś ca syād anityaś ceti | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ (|) tena ghaṭādir api niḥparyāyan nityaś ca | nityaś ca na sambhavaty eva | bhavati ca kasyacit pradāde nityaḥ śabda iti [va………]ttir anyasyānitya ity evaṃ sātmako nirātmaka ityādi |
 tasmān nāsti śabdānāṃ bāhyair arthais saha sambandhaḥ |
 yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena pratipattuḥ puruṣasya | vastubhiḥ sahāgamā nāntarīyakā avinābhāvino [na kathaṃcit pratipattuḥ sidhyanti tatkustebhya] āgamebhyo vastvanāntarīyakebhyo[rthaniścayo na vā niścayaḥ | āgamasya pramāṇāṃ] na sarvonveṣate kintv ajño janaḥ | samanveṣate kim arthaṃ (|) tadādarśitārthapratipatteye | tenāgamenopadarśitasyārthasya pratipattyarthaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam ajña eva samanveṣate nānya ity āha – samadhigataṃ yāthātathyaṃ padārthānām aviparītaṃ rūpaṃ yaisteṣām adhigataparamārthānāṃ paropadeśānapekṣaṇāt | yenāpy ajñenānveṣaṇīn tasya […………ā] tīndriyā guṇā yasya puruṣasya sotīndriyaguṇaḥ (|) yaścāt puruṣaśabdena viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | tasya puruṣasya vivecane 'yaṃ (p. 617) sarvajño nānyo vā vitathābhidhāyīty evaṃ vibhāgakriyāyām asāmarthyāt | tat kutas tathābhūtapuruṣapraṇītaṃ vacanam āgamatvena niścitya pravartteta |
 na ca sarvasya sarvāṇi vacanāni yathārthaṃ pravarttamānāni para……………nāṃ ca samīhitobhīṣṭo yorthas tasya sattāmantareṇāpi vṛttim paśyataḥ pratipattuḥ puruṣasya bhavitavyam eva vāci śamkayā | kim iyaṃ yathārthā vāṅ neti veti | keṣāṃ vāci | adṛṣṭavyabhicāravacasām api | śakyavicāre vastunyadṛṣṭavyabhicāraṃ vaco yeṣān teṣām api vāci | apiśabdād dṛṣṭavyabhicāravacasām api vāci sutarāṃ śamkayā……………………yena śaṃkā tena kāraṇena na yuktam anenāśena pratipattrā kasyacit puruṣasya vacanena kiñcid vastu niścetuṃ | yataś cāniścayas tasmād asya pratipattes tannivṛttyāpy āgamanivṛttyāpi pratiṣwdhyābhimatasya bhāvasyābhāvo na prasidhyati |
 yad uktam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yad uktaṃ prāk (|) sarvaviṣayatvād āgamasya sati vastunyavi[samvādenā……] karaṇāt | tannivṛttilakṣaṇetyāgamanivṛttilakṣaṇānupalabdhiḥ svabhāvādiviprarṣiṇopy arthasyā nāvaṃ sādhayiṣyatīti | tad ity abhāvaniścāyakatvam asyety āgamasya naivāsyāgamasya | sarvaviṣayatvam asti | puruṣārthāsambaddhānām arthānām aviṣayīkaraṇāt |
 abhyupagamyāpy ucyate | āgamasya sarvaviṣayatve [pi yadi…………yady a]vṛttiḥ (p. 618) syāt tadā vastvantareṇāvṛttau satyāṃ syād āgamanivṛttilakṣaṇasyānupalambhasyābhāvaniścāyakatvaṃ (|) tac ca nāsti vastvantareṇāpy āgamasya vṛtteḥ |
 evaṃ ca sati tatorthavyabhicāriṇa āgamāt pratipattukāmasya puṃsobhimatārthāsiddhir ity uktaṃ | tena kāraṇena viprakṛṣṭeṣv asan niścayaphalety asad vyavahāra [viṣa……………………] na sidhyati |
 tasmān na pramāṇatrayanivṛttāv api pratyakṣānumānāgamasaṃjñitasya pramāṇatrayasya nivṛttāv api deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭeṣv artheṣv aniścaya ity upasaṃhāraḥ |
 ayuktābhidhāyitve diḍūmātrantīrthikānān darśayann āha –
 (1) veda ityādi | iti śabdo vādaśabdaś cātra vakṣyamāṇakassambandhanīyaḥ | tenāyam arthaḥ (|) vedaprāmā[ṇya………………jāḍye] liṅgaḥ |
 nanu guṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhād vedasya prāmāṇyam iti bhavitavyaṃ |
 nāyaṃ doṣo lokaprasiddhānām viśiṣṭānām eva guṇānān tatra grahaṇāt | asya ca liṅgam adhikaraṇaitāvatva ityādiko nirdeśaḥ |
 (2) kasyacit nai yā yi kā derīśvarastattvādīnām karttety ayam api vādo jāḍye liṅgaḥ |
 (3) tīrthasnāne dharmecchā jāḍyaliṅgam apa[ra……………] mohādis tajjanitaṃ ca kāyavākkarmma dharmas tadviparītañ ca jalasaṃśleṣamātralakṣaṇaṃ snānam iti kutas tato dharmaprāptiḥ | vistareṇa nirākṛtaś cāyantīrthasnānavāda ācārya va su ba ndhu prabhṛttibhir iti neha pratanyate |
 (4) śīlādiguṇavaikalyepi brāhmaṇoham iti jātivādenāvalepo darpo jāḍyaliṅgam ayuktatvāt | [tathā hi pra……………gṛ]hītvā jātivādāvalepaḥ syāt | brāhmaṇena pitrā vrāhmaṇyā garbhe ya utpādastaṃ vā samāśritya | tatra vastubhūtasāmānyaniṣedhān na pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | nāpy uttaraḥ brāhmaṇabrāhmaṇīśarīrayor aśucisvabhāvatvena śarīrāntarād aviśeṣāt |
 (p. 619)(5) anaśanādinā śarīrapīḍanaṃ santāpas tasyārambhonuṣṭhānaṃ pāpahānāya | pāpasya [……………] jāḍye liṅgaṃ | tathā hi (|) sarvasya pāpasya nidānaṃ lobhadveṣamohāḥ | taiś cāviruddhaḥ mantāpārambha iti kutas tena pāpaśuddhiḥ |
 etāni paṃca liṅgāni jāḍye | kiṃviśiṣṭe jāḍye | dhvastaprajñāne | pramāṇāvalamvijñānaṃ prajñānantad dhvastaṃ yasmin jāḍye tat tathoktaṃ | nyāyanusārijñāna rahita ity arthaḥ | yathāsthalam upādānāt pañcety uktam……………liṅgānīti ||0||
